name: A Life in Weeks
description:
See your life in weeks. Remember the moments that made them yours.

A Life in Weeks brings a life calendar, a weekly journal, and personal cards together on your iPhone. Give a week a color, leave a few words, and return to it whenever you want. No account. No ads. Your entries stay on your device unless you choose to export them.

MAKE EACH WEEK YOURS
Explore your life as a grid, with one cell for each week. Tap a week to see its dates, choose a color, and write an entry of up to 2,000 characters. Search your entries by a word or phrase to find a moment again. Saved week colors stay the same when you change themes.

FOCUS ON THIS CHAPTER
Create a chapter for the next year, a milestone birthday, or a stretch of life you want to notice. Choose a date or an age-based goal, then switch between that chapter and the bigger picture. Your goal is a scale you set, not a prediction of how long you will live.

KEEP TIME YOUR WAY
Start weeks on Monday, today, or a date you choose. Your chosen start stays fixed. Changing your birthday does not move the original dates of your journal entries. Revisit the weeks you have recorded without pressure to fill every empty cell.

CARDS FOR EVERYDAY LIFE
Start with seven sample cards or create your own. Make cards for life progress, time, anniversaries, text, and week grids. Choose layouts, styles, and sizes, then edit, duplicate, pin, or delete them.

A GLANCE FROM YOUR HOME SCREEN
Add life progress or a chosen card to your Home Screen, and life progress to your Lock Screen. Different card widgets can show different cards. Choose displayed content with privacy in mind: journal-related cards may show personal text or colors. Widget refresh timing is managed by iOS.

A GENTLER VIEW OF TIME
Gentle display is on by default, hiding remaining days and weekends. You can also hide percentages and progress bars. Choose from 12 accent colors and multiple light and dark backgrounds. Optional icon updates can follow life progress in 5% steps or your chosen appearance; iOS may display an icon-change prompt.

LOCAL DATA, YOUR OWN BACKUPS
Your birthday, entries, cards, and chapters are processed locally, not uploaded to a developer server. Export a JSON backup to a location you choose and restore a compatible backup in Settings. Restoring replaces current data after confirmation, so export a backup first. Exported files contain private content; keep them safe. System backups and any cloud storage you choose have their own data handling.

Available in Chinese and English, with language selection in the app. Your own writing is not automatically translated.

This app does not predict lifespan or provide medical advice.

Keep the big picture. Make room for today.

name: Actualízate: Papers y Casos
description:
Lo mejor que lees como médico casi nunca viene de un algoritmo: viene de otro médico. El paper que te mandó un amigo, el caso que comentaron en el pasillo, la guía que cambió tu forma de tratar.

El problema es que hoy todo eso se pierde en grupos de chat, entre stickers, turnos y cadenas. Actualízate lo resuelve.

MANTENTE AL DÍA CON LO QUE LEE TU GENTE
Tu inicio se llena con lo que publican los médicos en quienes confías: novedades, investigación y casos clínicos. Nada de contenido de relleno ni publicaciones de desconocidos.

LO BUENO YA NO SE PIERDE
Cada artículo queda guardado con sus fuentes y adjuntos, ordenado por especialidad y fácil de encontrar. Guarda lo que quieres releer y búscalo cuando lo necesites.

HABLA DE MEDICINA EN CONFIANZA
En las redes públicas cada opinión te expone. Aquí no: todas las cuentas son privadas, siempre. Solo tus amigos leen lo que publicas y tú decides quién entra a tu red.

LOS CASOS QUE NO SALEN EN LOS LIBROS
Aprende de la práctica real de tu red. Antes de publicar un caso, la app te pide confirmar que está anonimizado: sin nombres, RUT ni fechas exactas.

COMPARTIR TOMA UN MINUTO
Escribe desde tu iPhone, entre un turno y otro. Títulos, listas, citas, fuentes, PDF y fotos, sin pelear con el formato.

TÚ ELIGES A QUIÉN LEER
Sin algoritmos y sin publicidad. Cuando algo que compartiste le sirve a tu gente, lo sabes.

Actualízate es un espacio de intercambio entre profesionales: no constituye recomendación médica ni reemplaza el juicio clínico. Lo que se publica es responsabilidad de quien lo publica.

name: Adagio Running
description:
Adagio coaches your running cadence and keeps you on target.

Set a target cadence or pace and start running. Drift off target and Adagio tells you: a spoken cue, a vibration, or a full-screen colour change. With Apple Music, it plays the songs from your playlist whose tempo matches your stride.

LIVE COACHING
• Live cadence from your Apple Watch, a Garmin watch, or your iPhone's motion sensors
• Set your target by cadence or by pace, or build interval workouts with a new target for every segment
• Spoken cues when you need to speed up or slow down
• Distance, pace and your route on a map, from GPS

PULSE MODE: COACHING YOU CAN FEEL
• Vibration cues on your watch or phone, and full-screen colour states, with no sound needed
• Designed with Deaf and hard-of-hearing runners in mind
• Optional metronome to lock in your cadence

MUSIC MATCHED TO YOUR STRIDE
• Connect Apple Music and Adagio picks the songs in your playlist that match your target steps per minute
• Or run without music: all the coaching still works

YOUR WATCH
• Apple Watch: starts with your workout, shows cadence and pace, and saves the run with its route to Fitness and Health
• Garmin: the free Adagio watch app (from the Connect IQ Store) shows live cadence and pace and saves your run to Garmin Connect

AFTER THE RUN
• Summary with cadence, time on target, pace, distance and route
• Strava uploads are in limited beta while Strava reviews Adagio, so spots are limited

Adagio has no ads and no tracking. Workouts stay on your iPhone.

name: Airspace Pro
description:
Staring at a sectional and not sure what airspace you are looking at? Airspace Pro teaches you to read it off the real FAA chart, one tap at a time, until the lines and numbers make sense.

Built by a flight instructor, from the creators of NavLog Pro, for student pilots getting ready for their written test and their checkride.

TAP THE CHART The sectional fills the screen. The Controller points at a spot and asks what airspace it is. Pick the class, then read its floor and ceiling. Get it right and the boundary lights up; get it wrong and you are shown how the chart draws it.

LESSONS YOU CAN WATCH AND HEAR Ten short lessons, from the big picture to Class A through G, special use airspace, the Mode C veil and reading altitudes. Every step has its own moving picture and is read aloud by the crew, with a quick question to check it stuck.

WRITTEN AND CHECKRIDE PREP A 60-question written test on airspace, with questions asked on the real sectional, marked against the 70 percent pass line. Then the Examiner's oral questions, each one explained.

EVERY CHART SYMBOL 47 flashcards and a quiz: airports, obstacles, navaids, airspace boundaries, special use airspace and more. Tap a card to hear it explained.

EXPLORE ANY SPOT Tap anywhere for the layers of airspace above it, from the ground up: what you need to enter, the equipment, the weather minimums, and a side view of the upside-down wedding cake.

A PLAN BUILT AROUND YOU Tell the crew what you are working on, when your checkride is and what gives you trouble. You get a daily plan around your home airport, a countdown to your date, and a drill built from the questions you miss.

A STREAK TO KEEP The Daily Challenge is five questions around a different US airport each day, with a result card to share. Name That Airport tests your airport codes just for fun.

TOOLS A crosswind check with a runway you slide to its number, a Zulu clock, and cheat sheets for weather minimums, light gun signals, transponder codes and more, to print as one PDF.

ALWAYS CURRENT Class B, C and D boundaries come from FAA data, with a new cycle every 28 days: one tap, no app update. No account, no ads, no tracking. Your answers stay on your device.

FREE AND PRO Free: the Daily Challenge, the Explorer, the first two lessons, the airport flashcards, Name That Airport, the Zulu clock, one crosswind check and one look at the cheat sheets. Airspace Pro unlocks Tap the Chart, every lesson, every symbol and the quiz, Written Prep, Checkride Prep, your plan, the Weak Spots drill, and printing. Choose yearly (with a 3-day free trial), monthly, or a one-time lifetime purchase. Payment is charged to your Apple Account. Subscriptions renew automatically unless cancelled at least 24 hours before the end of the period. Manage or cancel in Settings, your Apple Account, Subscriptions.

WHAT THE DATA COVERS Class E, Class G, special use airspace and temporary flight restrictions are taught in lessons and by rule; they are not read from the data, and TFRs are never shown.

FOR TRAINING USE ONLY Airspace Pro is a training aid. It is not an approved source of aeronautical information and must not be used for actual navigation. Check current charts, NOTAMs and an official briefing before every flight.

Terms of Use: https://navlogpro.app/terms Privacy Policy: https://navlogpro.app/privacy

name: Albore
description:
Albore is a camera for people who love the feel of film but want the freedom of RAW.

Every shot saves two files:
• a Bayer RAW (DNG) you can edit later in any RAW editor
• a finished HEIF with the film look you chose

FILM LOOKS
Ten looks made for the RAW data of iPhone cameras: Standard, Vivid, Soft, Documentary, Realistic, Portrait, Negative, Cinema, Silver and Black & White. Natural keeps Apple's own rendering. The viewfinder shows the look live, so what you see is what you get.

RECIPES
Save up to seven recipes: a look with its intensity, dynamic range, white balance and color shift. One tap brings a recipe back, and its name goes into the photo's file name, so you always know which one you used.

CONTROL
• Exposure by swiping on the viewfinder, and a dial for exposure, light and intensity
• White balance in Kelvin and a color shift grid
• Dynamic range: DR100, DR200, DR400 or Auto
• A button for every back camera of your iPhone
• Frames from 3:2 to 65:24; Photos keeps the full image and Revert brings it back
• Night mode merges several frames into a cleaner HEIF
• Flash, self-timer, grids and a level

YOUR PHOTOS, SAFE
• The RAW reaches your library within seconds
• If the app is closed while saving, the photo is saved the next time it opens
• Albore stops before your phone runs out of space, so no shot gets lost
• Your photos can be gathered in an Albore album

PRIVATE
No account, no ads, no tracking. Albore doesn't use the internet; your photos and location stay on your phone.

Albore is made for iPhones that capture Bayer RAW. On a camera without RAW, it applies the film look to Apple's photo and saves a HEIF.

name: Beat the Bottleneck
description:
Beat the Bottleneck is a free, competitive Theory of Constraints game for plant teams, built on ReliaSim® production line simulation.

A bottling line runs at 54% efficiency. You get one move to raise it.

The line runs from Bulk Storage through the Filler, Capper, Labeler, Case Packer and Palletizer to the Warehouse. Its machines stop for 36 different reasons, and with no buffers every stop holds up the whole line. The question is the one the Theory of Constraints starts with: what limits this line, and what one change gets the most out of it?

Your move is one of two:

- Fix one interrupt. 27 are listed under their machines, with how often each stops the line and how long it is down, over 90 days or on an average 8-hour shift. Tap one to see its time to failure and time to repair as PDF, CDF or survival curves, then pick it and it never happens again.
- Add buffers. Place up to 4 slots of storage between machines, so one machine can keep running for a while when its neighbor stops.

Then run the line. ReliaSim scores your move over ten 90-day runs, each with its own random stops, and shows every run next to the line as it is: your line efficiency, how many points you gained, the spread of the ten runs and the pallets made.

The obvious move isn't always the best one. The interrupt with the most stops isn't the one that costs the most time, and the one that costs the most time isn't always the best fix.

For plant teams
Play it in a workshop or a training session. Everyone makes a move on the same line, and the board shows who got the most out of it. It's a quick way to talk about constraints, buffers and downtime with numbers everyone can see.

How it works
A short walk-through shows where the numbers come from: the stops the line logs, how ReliaStats turns them into time-to-failure and time-to-repair curves, and how the simulation plays them out. ReliaSim is ChiAha's production line simulation software, validated against a published plant model (Fischel & Lange, WSC 2020: within 1% of measured OEE).

The board
Sign in with Apple to put your best move on the board. The board shows your first name, last initial and company. You can delete your account from Account at any time.

Build this game for your plant
The same game can be built on your own line: your machines, your stops, scored by ReliaSim. Tap "Build this game for my plant" to ask the ReliaSim team. ReliaSim training for plant teams is at reliasim.com.

Beat the Bottleneck is free, with no ads and no in-app purchases. It needs an internet connection: every score comes from the ReliaSim server. The web version is at beatthebottleneck.com.

ReliaSim® is a ChiAha™ product.

name: BeeApp PMU
description:
BeeApp is an assistant and trainer for permanent eyebrow makeup artists by Bee Company.

PIGMENT SELECTION IN 5 STEPS
Mark the client's skin tone and undertone, hair and eye colour and any old PMU — and get a working pigment mix in drops: base, "Warmer" and "Lighter". Each option shows the bottles, drop counts and the ratio.

• Couperose, cool undertone and iris markers taken into account

SELECTION HISTORY
Every calculation is saved: find a client by name or date and repeat the mix at the touch-up.

LESSONS AND EXERCISES
Step-by-step video lessons — paper, strokes, mapping schemes, colour theory. Send your work for review and get the trainer's feedback right in the app.

TRAINERS
A course quiz and a movement trainer to practise strokes.

NOTIFICATIONS
Know at once when the trainer replied or reviewed your work.

Sign in with Google, Apple or Telegram — one account on all your devices and in Telegram.

BeeApp is an educational and reference tool. The decision about a procedure, the choice of pigments and responsibility for the result stay with the artist.

name: Coloring Book: Kids by Kluera
description:

30 PICTURES FREE

PICTURE PACKS

PREMIUM

FOR YOU AS A GROWN-UP

NO ADS, NO ACCOUNT

From Kluera.

name: Crate Courier
description:
Welcome to Pier Ten. The ships are in, the crates are stacked, and the delivery pads are waiting.

Crate Courier is a classic grid puzzle: walk the courier around the dock and push every crate onto a glowing pad. You can only push, never pull, and only one crate at a time — so one hasty shove into a corner can end the shift. Plan ahead, count your steps, and clear the yard.

FEATURES
• 10 handcrafted levels, from a gentle warm-up to six-crate brain teasers
• Simple controls: tap the arrow pad, swipe the board, or use a hardware keyboard
• Live step counter, instant Reset, and free Previous/Next navigation between levels
• Foreman Rook, an on-device assistant who explains the rules, briefs each level, spots dead ends and points to the next useful push
• Dock Radio: chat with the Pier Ten crew — Juno, Pip and Marta — for tips and harbor gossip
• Built-in video tutorial
• Relaxed soundtrack with separate music and sound toggles
• Works fully offline on iPhone and iPad, no account, no ads, no tracking

Grab your gloves — the harbor is counting on you.

name: Dancing Turkey
description:
Bring a dancing pilgrim turkey to your Apple Watch this Thanksgiving!

Dancing Turkey is an Apple Watch app with a cheerful cartoon turkey in a pilgrim hat. He blinks while he waits, and when you tap him he dances to a classic Thanksgiving song. When the song ends, the dance ends too. Tap again any time to stop.

FEATURES
• Animated pilgrim turkey that dances when you tap him. Real song included!
• Blinks now and then while waiting for the next dance
• 10 festive scenes: barn dance, harvest field, disco, grandfather's house in the snow, Thanksgiving feast, autumn forest, parade, grandma's kitchen, country stage and harvest moon
• Time and date at the top, in 12-hour or 24-hour format
• 5 clock fonts and any color you like for the time, date and stats
• Steps, heart rate and battery at a glance
• Music switch: turn it off for a silent dance, the watch shows a muted speaker icon
• Dimmed always-on look that keeps the time and date easy to read

CUSTOMIZE FROM YOUR IPHONE
Open the app on your watch, then use the companion iPhone app to swipe through the scenes, pick a clock font and color, switch the music on or off, and choose 12-hour or 24-hour time.

WATCH APP AND WATCH FACE
Dancing Turkey is a watch app: the turkey shows while the app is open on your Apple Watch. From the iPhone app you can also install a matching Apple photo watch face with the turkey in all 10 scenes. It includes a complication that opens the app with a single tap. You can also add the complication to your favorite watch face or to the Smart Stack.

Tip: to keep the app on screen longer, open Settings on your watch, go to General, then Return to Clock, and choose After 1 hour.

HEALTH DATA
Dancing Turkey reads your steps and heart rate from Apple Health to show them on your watch. Your data stays on your devices.

HELP AND SUPPORT
The iPhone app includes a FAQ section with answers to common questions and a contact page if you need us. The More tab shows our other animated watch faces.

REQUIREMENTS
Apple Watch with watchOS 10 or newer, paired with an iPhone running iOS 17 or newer.

Happy Thanksgiving, and keep on dancing!

name: E6B Plus
description:
E6B by NavLog Pro is a flight computer that teaches you how it works, built for student pilots.

E6B CALCULATOR
• Wind correction angle, true heading and groundspeed
• True airspeed
• Pressure altitude and density altitude
• Time, speed and distance
• Fuel burned and endurance
• Runway headwind and crosswind
• Conversions: knots, mph and km/h; nautical miles, statute miles and kilometers; gallons, liters and pounds of avgas; Celsius and Fahrenheit; inHg and hPa

Answers update as you type. Tap "Show me how" on any answer and the crew works it through with your own numbers, one step at a time, with the rule of thumb you can use in the airplane.

A WHIZ WHEEL YOU TURN BY HAND
The real thing, on screen. Turn the ring, mark the wind dot, slide the card and read the answer, with the Instructor guiding each move. Flip it over for the circular slide rule: time, speed, distance and fuel. Type what you read and the app checks it against the exact math.

LEARN
Nine short lessons, one idea per screen: reading the scales, time and distance, fuel, pressure altitude, density altitude, true airspeed, the wind problem, crosswind on the runway and conversions. Each has quick questions to check it stuck.

PRACTICE WITH THE EXAMINER
Flight computer questions written the way the FAA knowledge test asks them: the givens, one question, three answers. Every answer is marked and explained. Build a daily streak and see which kinds of question to work on.

FREE EVERY DAY, OR ONE PAYMENT FOR EVERYTHING
Free, every day: a 15-minute pass for the calculator, a 15-minute pass for the whiz wheel, the first lesson and five practice questions. If you like, the app reminds you when the next day's passes are ready.

Pro is a single purchase, not a subscription. It takes the daily limits off the calculator and the whiz wheel and unlocks every lesson, unlimited practice and your score history. No account, no ads, no tracking, and it works with no connection.

FROM THE MAKERS OF NAVLOG PRO
The same crew that teaches the paper navlog in NavLog Pro: the Instructor, the Briefer and the Examiner.

FOR TRAINING USE ONLY
This app is a training aid. It is not an approved source of aeronautical information and must not be used for actual navigation. Check every number against your aircraft's POH, current charts and an official weather briefing.

Terms of Use: https://navlogpro.app/terms
Privacy Policy: https://navlogpro.app/privacy

name: Einbürgerungs-Test

• Gezielt lernen: Fehlertrainer, Karteikarten, Bundesland-Training, Themen-Lernen, Bildfragen und Smart-Lernen
• Lernplan bis zu deinem Prüfungstermin, mit täglicher Lernerinnerung
• Fortschritt: Prüfungsreife, Verlauf deiner Probetests und Schwachstellen je Themenfeld

Pro kostet einmalig 5,99 € und gilt dauerhaft, auch auf deinen anderen Geräten mit derselben Apple-ID.

DATENSCHUTZ
Keine Werbung, kein Tracking, kein Konto. Dein Lernfortschritt bleibt auf deinem Gerät.

HINWEIS
Dies ist keine offizielle App des BAMF oder der Bundesregierung. Die Fragen stammen aus dem Gesamtfragenkatalog des Bundesamts für Migration und Flüchtlinge (Anlage 1 der Einbürgerungstestverordnung, Stand 07.05.2025). Die Übersetzungen sind maschinell erstellt und inoffiziell; maßgeblich ist der deutsche Text.

name: EMIVA Health
description:
Was habe ich gegessen? Wann ging es mir gut? Und was fiel mir an Tagen mit Beschwerden auf?

EMIVA Health entstand aus dem Wunsch einer Familie, wiederkehrende Beschwerden im Alltag besser festzuhalten und mögliche Muster zu erkennen. Ein kurzer Check-in reicht, um eine Mahlzeit, deine Stimmung oder eine Beschwerde festzuhalten.

• Mahlzeiten und Snacks mit Uhrzeit speichern. Frühere Einträge erscheinen beim Tippen als Vorschläge.
• Stimmung festhalten und Beschwerden wie Bauchschmerzen, Kopfschmerzen oder Migräne mit Beginn und Stärke dokumentieren.
• Wetter optional ergänzen. Für Orte in Deutschland kann EMIVA bei verfügbarer DWD-Stationsabdeckung Temperatur, Luftdruck, Luftfeuchtigkeit und Wetterlage über Bright Sky hinzufügen.
• Das Tagebuch nach Tag, Woche und Monat durchsuchen.
• In Kreisdiagrammen sehen, welche Mahlzeiten und Beschwerden du in der Woche, im Monat oder im Jahr am häufigsten erfasst hast.
• Wiederholte zeitliche Beobachtungen prüfen, etwa wie oft du nach Haferflocken Bauchschmerzen eingetragen hast.

EMIVA berechnet die Auswertung auf deinem Gerät. Die Beobachtungen können als Gesprächsgrundlage dienen. Aus ihnen lässt sich keine Diagnose oder Ursache ableiten.

Du kannst EMIVA 30 Tage kostenlos ausprobieren. Danach kostet die dauerhafte Freischaltung in Deutschland einmalig 1,99 €. Der Test endet ohne automatische Abbuchung. Vorhandene Einträge bleiben nach Ablauf lesbar. Mit der Vollversion kannst du weiter Einträge erfassen und sie automatisch über deine private iCloud-Datenbank mit Geräten synchronisieren, auf denen derselbe iCloud-Account aktiv ist.

name: Equine,
description:
Good horse care is built one thoughtful day at a time. Equine helps riders and horse owners bring training, rest, observations, and everyday care into one clear record for each horse.
Plan purposeful rides with structured routines, set dates around your week, and use a session timer to follow each phase. Afterward, record the ride, note how your horse responded, and keep photos or voice notes with the details you want to remember.
Keep training in context
See upcoming sessions alongside recent work. Record ride duration, effort, discipline, footing, outcome, distance, and notes to build a useful history over time.
Care for the whole routine
Log care events, set follow-up reminders, and record rest days. Add observations about appetite, movement, energy, and response so everyday changes have a place in your horse’s history.
Keep each horse’s story together
Create a profile for each horse, switch between horses, and browse a timeline of training, care, rest, and observations. Add photos and voice notes to records when more context helps.
Make records useful beyond today
Review the week’s work, choose a horse and date range, then export selected records and attachments as an archive you can keep or share.
Made for riders, horse owners, and people responsible for the day-to-day care and training of horses. Equine brings the practical parts of a horse routine together, helping you plan what comes next and remember what has already happened.
Equine is an organization and record-keeping tool, not veterinary advice, diagnosis, or clearance to ride. Consult a qualified veterinarian or trainer when appropriate.

name: F.R.I.D.A.Y – Monitoring & AI
description:
F.R.I.D.A.Y is the mobile and TV companion for your F.R.I.D.A.Y monitoring server. It shows what is happening across your servers in real time, and its AI agent, FRIDAY, finds the cause when something breaks and prepares the fix. A person always decides.

KNOW WHAT'S BROKEN, FAST
• Live overview of hosts, containers and projects
• Problems sorted by severity, updated in real time
• Live metrics for every host: CPU, memory, disk, network and container health

FRIDAY FINDS THE CAUSE
• Watch FRIDAY think, run read-only checks and explain what it found in plain words
• It reads logs, traces and the code that is actually deployed
• Ask follow-up questions in chat

FROM ALERT TO FIX, STEP BY STEP
• Every incident is a clear ticket: what happened, why, the fix, and how to roll back
• Approve a fix to open a pull request; approve a deploy when it is merged
• Approvals need Face ID or Touch ID and are signed on your device and written to the audit log
• Nothing changes on a server without your approval

ALERTS THAT MATTER
• Push notifications for fixes waiting for you and for Disaster and High problems
• On-call aware, with quiet hours and optional critical alerts for disasters

ON APPLE TV
• A wall display for your operations room: overview, problems and AI incidents
• The TV can watch but never approve

REQUIREMENTS
F.R.I.D.A.Y needs a F.R.I.D.A.Y server (self-hosted or provided by Synetal Solutions) connected to Zabbix 7.0 or later. Sign in with your organisation's single sign-on.

Zabbix is a trademark of Zabbix LLC. F.R.I.D.A.Y is made by Synetal Solutions and is not affiliated with Zabbix LLC.

name: Faltlabor – Cube Nets
description:
How do six squares become a cube? Faltlabor helps children explore cube nets through hands-on discovery: predict first, check next, then understand why.

The app combines a freely rotatable 3D workspace with varied learning activities:

• Net Architects: build your own nets and fold them continuously
• Folding in Your Head: identify opposite faces across different cube nets
• Error Workshop and Net Clinic: investigate invalid nets and repair them
• Research Lab: discover all 11 cube nets
• Rolling Cubes: follow rolling paths and predict the top face

Three levels of adaptive hints support children without giving the answer away. A protected parent area shows learning progress stored only on the device.

Designed for ages 8–10 and primary grades 3–4. No advertising, no account, no in-app purchases and fully available offline.

name: FeraTV: Araç TV & IPTV
description:
FeraTV, park halindeyken araçta geçen zamanı değerlendirmeniz için tasarlanmış sade bir medya ve yolculuk uygulamasıdır: kendi yayın listelerinizi oynatır, web'de gezinmenizi sağlar, yolculuklarınızı özetler ve çevrimdışı oyunlar sunar.

FeraTV hazır kanal veya içerik içermez. İzlenen her şey sizin eklediğiniz listelerden ve açtığınız sitelerden gelir.

OYNATICI
• Kendi M3U / M3U8 listelerinizi adresle ya da dosyadan ekleyin
• Kanal arama, favoriler ve akıcı HLS oynatma
• Telefondaki videoları galeriden ya da dosyalardan açın
• AirPlay ve resim içinde resim desteği

TARAYICI
• Yerleşik web tarayıcı: adres yazın ya da arayın
• Favoriler, geçmiş ve düzenlenebilir kısayol panosu
• Masaüstü site görünümü ve içerik boyutu ayarı
• Tarama verilerini tek dokunuşla temizleyin
• Hazır kısayollar (YouTube gibi siteler) yalnızca birer yer imidir ve yalnızca park halindeyken kullanılabilir

SÜRÜŞ GÜVENLİĞİ
• Araç hareket ettiğinde görüntü otomatik olarak gizlenir; bu kilit kapatılamaz
• Hız, konumunuzdan yalnızca cihazınızda okunur
• İsterseniz sürüşte yalnızca ses devam eder

ARAÇ VE YOLCULUK
• Anlık hız, yolculuk mesafesi ve süresi
• Yolculuk geçmişi, rota haritası ve park yeri hatırlatma
• Yakıt hacmi ve fiyatıyla yaklaşık maliyet hesabı
• Desteklenen araç ünitelerinde isteğe bağlı eşleşme ile canlı araç bilgileri (yalnızca okuma)

OYUNLAR
• Kelime Avı, 2048, Sudoku ve Mangala
• Tamamı çevrimdışı ve ücretsiz

ARAÇ EKRANINDA
• iPhone'un ekran yansıtmasını destekleyen araç ya da adaptörlerde görüntüyü araç ekranına taşımak için adım adım rehber

GÖRÜNÜM
• Biri açık, üçü koyu dört tema

GİZLİLİK
• Hesap yok, kayıt yok, reklam yok, takip yok
• Listeleriniz, geçmişiniz, yolculuklarınız ve ayarlarınız yalnızca cihazınızda tutulur

GÜVENLİK UYARISI
Video yalnızca araç park halindeyken izlenmelidir. Sürüş sırasında uygulamayı kullanmayın; yerel trafik kurallarına uymak sizin sorumluluğunuzdadır.

NOT: FeraTV bir oynatıcı ve tarayıcıdır; herhangi bir kanal, yayın veya içerik sağlamaz. Yalnızca izleme hakkına sahip olduğunuz yayınları ekleyin.

name: Fitaal
description:
Elevate your fitness routine with the app! It's your all-in-one solution to easily monitor your workouts, track progress, and achieve your fitness goals with engaging insights and motivation.

The app offers an array of features, including:

Workout Tracking
Seamlessly capture all your workout data from gym equipment or manually enter it for a complete record.

Training Plans
Optimize your workouts with personalized plans provided by your fitness facility or trainer.

Activity Levels
Stay motivated with encouraging milestones as you progress to higher levels.

Fun Challenges
Challenge yourself with time-based activities that reward you with kudos, activity points, and prizes.

Schedules
Manage and book classes with ease to keep yourself on track.

And much more!

The app integrates with HealthKit to help you save your workouts and contribute to your fitness goals and challenges.

Have a comment or question about the app? Email our team directly at digitalsupport@egym.com.

name: FlowISP Mobile
description:
O FlowISP Mobile é o app oficial para clientes e técnicos de provedores de internet que usam o sistema FlowISP.

Para clientes: acompanhe suas faturas, pague por PIX ou boleto, acesse a segunda via, veja seus contratos, abra chamados de atendimento e fale com o suporte do seu provedor — tudo em um só lugar, com a identidade visual do seu próprio provedor.

Para técnicos e funcionários: execute ordens de serviço em campo, registre fotos e assinatura digital do cliente, e trabalhe mesmo sem internet — os dados sincronizam automaticamente assim que a conexão voltar.

O app se conecta com segurança à API do seu provedor FlowISP; nenhuma informação de conta, fatura ou ordem de serviço é armazenada fora do seu provedor.

name: FVS 2026
seller_name: Autodoc Processamento de Dados Ltda EPP
description:
System for recording and managing the non-conformities found during construction service inspections.

This app works together with the FVS Web system, provided by AutoDoc Tecnologia Web.

The data available to the demo user is for testing purposes only. For more information, please contact AutoDoc Tecnologia Web.

name: Gamjp
seller_name: IP Tech Group s. r. o.
description: 作業記録を整理し、デジタルな解決策を提供します。いつでも手動でデータをエクスポートしてファイリングを作成することができます。私たちは皆あなたのデータのプライバシーを重視しています。私たちの目標は安定して透明で実用的なユーティリティを提供して、ユーザーの理解と効率的な管理を助けることです。フィードバックの提出をサポートし、淡い色と濃い色のテーマを自由に切り替えることができ、優れたサービスとユーザー体験の提供を目指しています。インターフェースやプロセス、体験全体について何かアイデアがありましたら、いつでも教えてください。あなたの実体験は、どんな想定よりも価値があります。ご意見をよく読み、整理し、まとめ、参考にして、今後の改善に活用します。

name: Gear & Grub List: Camping
description:
The Gear & Grub List application itself is written in the English language.

Gear & Grub List is a camping checklist, packing list and trip planner in one app. Build checklists for food, camping, backpacking, your car and your RV or trailer, tap what you need, and everything lands on one shopping list, kept together by checklist and category. Keep your camp recipes in US or metric measures, and save the campsites you love with photos and GPS coordinates so you can find them again. It works without signal.

FIVE CHECKLISTS YOU BUILD AND EDIT
• Food: camp food, produce, meat, bakery, pantry, drinks and snacks
• Camping: shelter, sleep, camp kitchen, fire and light, comfort, tools and safety
• Backpack: pack and carry, shelter and sleep, water, kitchen, clothing, navigation and safety
• Automotive: fluids, tires, emergency kit, tools and road-trip comfort
• RV & Trailer: hitch and towing, leveling, tanks and water, power and propane
• Every checklist starts with common items by category, so a new trip starts in seconds
• Add, rename or delete items and categories, and search a whole checklist
• Give any item a size, a price and a note, like "20°F rated" or "5W-30"

ONE SHOPPING LIST, KEPT TOGETHER BY CHECKLIST AND CATEGORY
• Tap anything on any checklist and it goes on your shopping list
• The list keeps each checklist together, A to Z: Automotive, Backpack, Camping, Food, RV & Trailer
• Inside each checklist, items are grouped by category, with the category or recipe shown under each item
• Tap an item to cross it off as you get it; press and hold to take it off the list
• Clear the list when you're done; your items stay saved for the next trip
• Works without signal; changes catch up when your phone is back online

CAMP RECIPES AND MEAL PLANNING
• Keep your camp cooking recipes with servings, ingredients and steps
• Switch any recipe between US measures and metric
• Recipe categories for breakfast, dinner, desserts and more, plus your own
• One tap puts a recipe's ingredients on your shopping list, tagged with the recipe they're for; one more tap takes them off
• Import a recipe from most recipe websites by pasting the link, or paste the recipe text
• Starts with example camp recipes: skillet breakfast hash, foil-packet potatoes, one-pot campfire chili and classic s'mores

SAVED CAMPSITES WITH PHOTOS AND GPS COORDINATES
• Save the campsites you want to find again: a name, your notes and up to three photos
• Made for the spots that are hard to find twice: dispersed camping, BLM land, state park sites and that one perfect pull-off
• Take photos with the camera or choose them from your library
• Paste the coordinates from Google Maps, or tap Use my location while you're at the site
• Open in Google Maps puts a pin on the spot, so you can get directions back next season
• Your location is used only when you tap Use my location

YOUR ACCOUNT
• Sign in with your email, and your checklists, shopping list, recipes and campsites are on every phone you sign in on
• Delete your account and everything in it from the app at any time

14-DAY FREE TRIAL, THEN GEAR & GRUB PRO
• Use every screen free for 14 days, fully working. The trial starts when you tap Start free trial, can be used once per account, and nothing is charged for it
• When the trial ends, your lists, recipes and campsites stay saved, and Gear & Grub Pro keeps every screen open
• Gear & Grub Pro is an auto-renewing yearly subscription (US$4.99 a year; the App Store shows the price for your country)
• Payment is charged to your Apple ID when you confirm the purchase. The subscription renews automatically each year unless it is turned off at least 24 hours before the end of the current year. Manage or cancel it in your Apple ID settings under Subscriptions
• No ads, and nothing about you is sold

Terms of Service: https://geargrublist.com/terms
Privacy Policy: https://geargrublist.com/privacy
Support: https://geargrublist.com/support

name: Gensogoyomi: Element a Day
description:
Gensogoyomi is a daily chemistry calendar that takes one to three minutes a day.

Each day you open the card for "Today's Element", answer a quiz about it, and solve a puzzle to balance a chemical equation. Every element you open is added to your collection on the periodic table.

DAILY FLOW
1. Today's Element
Open the card to read how the element was discovered, where its name comes from, where it is used in everyday life, and some trivia. Basic data such as atomic mass and electron configuration is included.

2. Today's Quiz
One multiple-choice question with four options about today's element. An explanation appears after you answer.

3. Today's Reaction
Set the coefficients in front of the reactants and products so that the number of atoms matches on both sides. You have three tries. If you miss, the atom counts on each side are shown as a hint. An explanation of the reaction appears when you finish.

4. Result and Share
See your result for the day and your streak, and share the result as text.

ELEMENT COLLECTION
Opened elements are colored in on the periodic table. Try to collect all 118. You can reread any card you have collected.

FEATURES
- Cards for all 118 elements (discovery, name origin, uses, trivia)
- 137 chemical equations that start from basic middle and high school level and get harder over time
- Everyone gets the same puzzles on the same day
- The day changes at midnight on your device's clock
- Content is built into the app, so it works offline
- Your answers and coefficients are saved, so you can continue later on the same day
- Streaks to help you build a daily habit
- Daily reminder at a time you choose (8:00 by default; arrives only if you allow notifications)
- No account required. Your records are stored only on your device
- Available in 76 languages, following your device's language
- Missed just one day? Watch a video ad to the end to revive your streak

The content of the cards and equations has been checked against sources such as public institutions, scientific societies and universities.

PRICE
The app is free. There are no in-app purchases. The only ads are video ads you can watch to revive a broken streak.

Support: support@fujibit.com

name: Glucose Blood: Sugar Tracker
description:
When you need to discuss your glucose readings at an appointment, you shouldn't have to reconstruct weeks of notes. Glucose Blood keeps blood sugar results, insulin, medication, blood pressure and weight in one dated diary—with meal context, charts and an easy path to a report for your clinician.

ONE PLACE FOR YOUR DAILY HEALTH LOG

• Blood glucose: record readings with date and time, choose mg/dL or mmol/L and keep your target range in view.
• Insulin and medication: keep doses and medication records alongside glucose readings.
• Blood pressure, pulse and weight: follow systolic and diastolic pressure, pulse with BP readings, and weight over time.
• Reading context: mark fasting, before or after meals, and before or after exercise; add a note to explain the number.

TURN READINGS INTO PERSPECTIVE

Browse charts, trends and summaries to see how your numbers change. Use the calendar, history and filters to find a specific day or event. Get an estimated A1C (HbA1c) based on saved glucose readings; the app identifies when there isn't enough data for a dependable estimate.

BUILT FOR THE ROUTINE, NOT THE EXTRA WORK

Build a routine that fits your day with reminders for glucose, insulin and medication. Before an appointment, select a date range, record categories, averages and optional estimated A1C to create a PDF report you can share with your clinician.

PUT YOUR APPLE HEALTH READINGS TO WORK
With your permission, import recent blood glucose, weight and blood pressure records from Apple Health directly into your Glucose Blood diary. Choose when to import; records already imported are not added again. Bring your existing readings into your charts without re-entering them.

PREMIUM: THE COMPLETE GLUCOSE BLOOD EXPERIENCE
Premium unlocks all app features: adding and managing your health records, glucose charts and insights, estimated A1C, medication and insulin tracking, reminders, Apple Health import and customizable PDF reports. Subscription options and prices are shown before purchase. Your subscription renews automatically unless canceled; manage or cancel it in your Apple subscription settings.

IMPORTANT

Glucose Blood is a personal tracking tool, not a glucose meter or medical diagnosis service. Estimated A1C is not a lab test and does not replace professional medical advice.

https://glucose-blood.com/terms

Privacy Policy:
https://glucose-blood.com/privacy

name: jadwalQ: Booking & Invoice
description:
jadwalQ Smart Booking & Invoice membantu MUA dan pemilik bisnis beauty lainnya dalam mengurus operasionalnya.

BOOKING LEBIH RAPI
• Formulir booking online milikmu sendiri: klien memilih layanan, tanggal, dan lokasi, lalu mengirimnya langsung kepadamu.

INVOICE & PEMBAYARAN KLIEN

TIM & KEUANGAN

SALSA, ASISTEN PINTAR (bila diaktifkan untuk bisnismu)

name: Jellybooth - Digicam & Booth
description:
Fold it and it's a camera. Open it and it's a booth.
Jellybooth turns your iPhone Duo into the cameras you grew up with.

SEVEN CAMERAS
DIGI 2004 (an early-2000s digicam), DAILY 28 (an everyday compact) ONCE 27 (a disposable), TOY CAM, MONO 27, FILM 35 and POP INSTANT are all free. Swipe to switch. Every camera develops the same scene in its own color, each with its own shutter sound.

OPEN IT FOR THE BOOTH
Four shots make one strip. Point the phone at a friend and they see themselves on the outer screen. Half-fold it, stand it on a table, and everyone fits in a group Booth.

ALBUM, STICKERS AND A PEN
Photos sort themselves by day and neighborhood. Add stickers, draw with the pen, and share at story size.

FREE, NO ADS
All seven cameras, every sticker pack, the Booth and the album are free. No ads. No sign-up.

Photos stay on your phone. No account, no server.

Made for iPhone Duo. On other iPhones the cameras, the Booth and the album all work. Outer-screen preview and the table Booth need a Duo.

name: Journal de Soif
description:
Ta cave, et les soirées qui la vident.

Journal de Soif garde les bouteilles que tu as, celles que tu ouvres, et avec qui. Chaque moment partagé reste dans ton carnet.

UNE PHOTO, ET LA QUILLE EST EN CAVE
Pointe l'étiquette : domaine, millésime, appellation, la fiche se remplit toute seule. Tu sais ce que tu as, combien il en reste et ce que ça vaut.

CHAQUE QUILLE SAIT QUAND S'OUVRIR
L'app suit l'apogée de chaque bouteille : à laisser dormir, prête, ou à ouvrir vite. Plus de grand cru oublié au fond du casier.

DERRIÈRE CHAQUE BOUTEILLE, UN MOMENT
Tu l'ouvres, tu dis avec qui : en solo, en amoureux, entre copains, en famille. Les photos, une note de plaisir, un mot sur la bouteille : le moment est gardé, et la cave se met à jour toute seule.

TA CAVE, CASE PAR CASE
Dessine tes casiers et range chaque bouteille à sa place. Pas de casier ? Une photo du bazar, une épingle, c'est retrouvé.

« DIS-MOI LE MENU, JE M'OCCUPE DU VIN »
Le sommelier pioche dans ta cave la bouteille qui ira avec ce soir. Pas dans un catalogue : dans tes casiers, en priorité celles qui sont prêtes.

ET AUSSI
• Les fiches des appellations, pour apprendre en buvant
• Tes données restent à toi : tu supprimes ton compte depuis l'app, quand tu veux

Gratuit.

L'abus d'alcool est dangereux pour la santé. À consommer avec modération.

name: Kalan Zaman: Ömür ve Aile
description:
Kalan Zaman, önündeki yılları sevdiklerinle, yazlarla, bayramlarla ve kitaplarla ölçer. Böylece neye öncelik vereceğini görürsün.

Bu sayılar bir geri sayım değil, bir davet.

SEVDİKLERİNLE KALAN ZAMAN
• Annenle, babanla, kardeşlerinle, büyüklerinle kaç gün ve kaç buluşma kaldığını gör
• Eşinle, sevgilinle, çocuklarınla, arkadaşlarınla ve evcil hayvanlarınla geçecek zaman
• Görüşme sıklığını değiştir, sayının nasıl değiştiğini anında gör
• Kalan yazlar, bayramlar, hafta sonları ve okuyabileceğin kitaplar

SAYIDAN EYLEME
• Her gün için küçük, kişiye özel görevler: "Anneni ara", "Bir arkadaşına yaz"
• Planlarını gün ve saatiyle kur, istersen takvimine ekle
• Ziyaret takibi: kimi ne zaman gördüğünü kaydet, yıllık hedefinle karşılaştır
• Doğum günü ve yıldönümü hatırlatmaları

SAĞLIK HATIRLATMALARI
• Çocuk aşı takvimi (Sağlık Bakanlığı takvimine göre)
• Yaşına ve cinsiyetine göre tarama hatırlatmaları (KETEM önerileri)
• Evcil hayvan aşı ve bakım takvimi

ANA EKRAN WIDGET'LARI
• Bugün: günlük görevlerin, dokunarak işaretle
• Sevdiklerin: kalan günler bir bakışta
• Günün sözü: her gün yeni bir söz
• Sağlıkla ilgili hatırlatmalar widget'ta istersen gizli kalır

KALAN ZAMAN PRO
• Döngü (regl) takvimi ve tahminler
• Takviye ve vitamin hatırlatmaları
• Kendi tekrarlayan hatırlatmaların

Hesap yok, reklam yok. Girdiğin bütün bilgiler yalnızca telefonunda saklanır.

name: Kaucyjka - licznik kaucji
description:
Kaucyjka to najprostszy licznik kaucji w Polsce. Dodajesz butelki i puszki jednym kliknięciem, a aplikacja od razu pokazuje, ile pieniędzy odzyskasz przy zwrocie.

CO POTRAFI

Licznik trzech rodzajów opakowań
Butelka PET i puszka to 50 gr, szkło zwrotne 1 zł. Stawki są zgodne z polskim systemem kaucyjnym, więc kwota zawsze się zgadza.

Skaner kodów kreskowych
Zeskanuj kod na opakowaniu, zamiast wybierać rodzaj z listy. Skaner działa w całości na Twoim telefonie - kody nie są nigdzie wysyłane.

Mapa punktów zwrotu
Zobacz sklepy i automaty w okolicy razem z informacją, czy przyjmują PET, puszki i szkło. Dane o punktach uzupełniają sami użytkownicy, więc mapa jest tym dokładniejsza, im więcej osób z niej korzysta.

Statystyki i odznaki
Sprawdź, ile opakowań oddałeś, ile zaoszczędziłeś i ile CO2 udało się uniknąć. Za kolejne progi dostajesz odznaki.

Przypomnienia
Jeśli butelki zalegają w domu, aplikacja przypomni o zabraniu ich przy okazji zakupów. Powiadomienia możesz wyłączyć w każdej chwili.

Poradnik
Krótkie artykuły o tym, jak działa system kaucyjny: które opakowania są objęte kaucją, co z małpkami, jak korzystać z butelkomatu.

BEZ HASEŁ I BEZ REKLAM

Logujesz się kodem z maila, więc nie ma hasła do zapamiętania. Nie pokazujemy reklam i nie sprzedajemy nikomu danych. Konto możesz usunąć w aplikacji, w zakładce Profil.

DLA KOGO

Dla każdego, kto odkłada butelki i puszki w kuchni i nie wie, ile to właściwie jest pieniędzy. Kaucyjka odpowiada na to pytanie w dwie sekundy.

Kaucyjka jest niezależna od sieci handlowych i operatorów systemu kaucyjnego. Nie wypłacamy kaucji - pieniądze odbierasz w sklepie lub automacie przy zwrocie opakowań.

name: KM Studio – Kone Moctar
description:
KM Studio è l'app di Kone Moctar Studio, personal trainer e massaggiatore professionale a Vizzolo Predabissi (Milano). Con l'app hai tutto il tuo percorso in tasca.

ALLENAMENTO
• La tua scheda giorno per giorno, preparata da Kone, con foto e spiegazione di ogni esercizio
• Spunta le serie e scrivi i carichi: il recupero parte da solo e i chili finiscono nel tuo storico
• Schede pronte per obiettivo da seguire subito: dimagrire, massa muscolare, tonificare, glutei e gambe, forza, principianti, postura, allenamento a casa
• Il programma del tuo corso di gruppo, ogni giorno

PRENOTAZIONI
• Prenota one to one, corsi di gruppo e massaggi in pochi passaggi, con gli orari liberi in tempo reale
• Scala le sedute dal tuo abbonamento o paga online con carta, Apple Pay, Klarna o PayPal
• Ricevi un avviso se un orario cambia

PROGRESSI
• Peso con grafico, massa grassa e storico dei carichi
• Il tuo piano alimentare sempre a portata di mano

CHAT CON KONE
• Scrivi direttamente al tuo personal trainer, anche con foto

L'app è per i clienti di KM Studio: crei l'account in un minuto dalla schermata di accesso, oppure te lo crea Kone.

Info e prenotazioni: kone-studio.com · WhatsApp 392 269 6468

name: Larknudge
description:
Larknudge keeps your notes, lists, tasks, reminders and events in one calm place. What you write is private to you. What you share goes only to the team you choose.

YOUR DAY AT A GLANCE
The Today screen shows what matters now: tasks due, reminders and events coming up, and the lists you are working through. The calendar shows your month, with a dot on every day that has something planned.

NOTES, LISTS AND TASKS
• Write notes and attach photos.
• Build shopping or packing lists and tick things off as you go. In a team list you can see who ticked what.
• Add tasks with an optional due time and assign them to a teammate.
• Set reminders and repeating events that fire on your device, even without a connection.

WORK TOGETHER
Create a team for your family, flatmates or colleagues and invite people by email. Team events ask everyone to answer Going, Maybe or Can't, so you see who is in at a glance. Team items are visible to team members. Your personal items stay yours: nobody else sees them, not even the team's owner.

WORKS OFFLINE
Everything you create is saved on your phone first and syncs when you are back online. Open the app on the train, in a basement or on a plane and keep working.

NOTIFICATIONS YOU CONTROL
Choose which notifications you want: invitations, replies, changes and cancellations. Set quiet hours, so nothing buzzes at night.

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
• Personal items are visible only to you.
• Photos are re-processed on upload, which removes hidden metadata such as the place where a photo was taken.
• No ads, and we do not sell your data.
• You can delete your account in the app. Your data is permanently removed after a short grace period.
Read the privacy policy and terms of use in the app at any time under Profile.

SIGN IN YOUR WAY
Use your email and password, or sign in with Apple, Google or GitHub.

YOUR LANGUAGE
Larknudge is available in English, Czech, German, French and Spanish. Choose the language in Settings.

Questions or feedback? Write to us at info@larknudge.com or use the contact form on larknudge.com.

name: LegitGM
description:
LegitGM puts the box score in your pocket. Every game kept on LegitGM, from rec leagues and tournaments to high school and club seasons, is here: final scores, full box scores, play-by-play, game flow, and season stats for every player and team.

FOLLOW YOUR PLAYERS AND TEAMS
Tap the star on any player, team or event, and Following shows their latest games in one place. No account needed. Sign in with Apple or your email to keep your follows on every device and to follow games live as they happen.

EVERY GAME IN DETAIL
• Box scores for both teams: minutes, points, rebounds, assists, steals, blocks, turnovers and shooting
• Play-by-play for the whole game
• A game flow chart that shows who led, by how much, and when the runs came
• Upcoming games with tip-off time and rosters

PLAYERS, TEAMS AND EVENTS
• Player pages with per-game averages, shooting percentages, PER and every game they played
• Team pages with record, team stats, roster and results, season by season
• Event pages with standings, top players and every game

BROWSE AND SEARCH
Search any player, team or event. Browse recent games, top teams and top players, and filter by season, level and stat keeper.

FROM THE STAT SHEET TO YOUR PHONE
Scan the QR code on a LegitGM stat sheet or tap a shared LegitGM link, and the game opens right in the app.

Stats are kept courtside by the coaches, leagues and stat keepers who run each game. See something wrong? Use Report a Problem on any game, player, team or event and we'll look into it.

name: LendTrail: Lending Ledger
description:
LendTrail keeps the small details of lending your own things in one place. Record an item, hand it over to a named borrower and keep a clear trail when it comes back.

• Add items with a category, current condition and personal notes.
• Save a whole-item handover with the borrower, due date and condition snapshot.
• Find active, overdue and returned handovers without opening each item.
• See a person's complete borrowing trail, with active and returned counts.
• Record the return condition while keeping the original handover unchanged.
• Archive items you are keeping and delete completed trails when you no longer need them.
• Export a readable PDF ledger or a CSV table through the iOS share sheet.

Your lending records are stored locally. No account, contact access, reminders, subscriptions or advertising are required. LendTrail is an informal personal record; it does not send messages to borrowers or create legal agreements.

name: LineForge: Text Workbench
description:
Bring order to everyday text with LineForge. Type or paste a list, build a sequence of operations, and inspect exactly what each step changes before you copy or share the final result.

A practical set of operations:
• Trim whitespace from line edges.
• Collapse horizontal whitespace and remove blank lines.
• Replace literal text without regular expressions.
• Convert to uppercase or lowercase.
• Sort lines in either direction and remove duplicate lines while retaining the first occurrence.

The order is yours. Preview the original and every completed step with real line, word, character and UTF-8 byte counts. Save an ordered recipe to apply the same process to another input, or keep a draft containing both original text and its independent step snapshot. Reopen drafts, edit recipes and search your local library.

Copy is explicit. Share the final output as UTF-8 TXT or a line-numbered CSV through the native system share sheet. Text processing and saved drafts work offline. No app account, advertising or user-data synchronization is required.

name: Meenu: AI Speaking Coach
description:
Meenu is a daily speaking coach for job interviews, presentations and everyday conversations. Answer one question out loud each day and get clear feedback you can use straight away.

HOW IT WORKS
- Pick your goal: ace an interview, pitch and persuade, lead a meeting, tell a story, explain clearly, debate, or small talk.
- Get a fresh question every day, tuned to your role and goal.
- Take 15 seconds to think, then answer out loud for up to 60 seconds.
- See your replay with every um, hedge and long pause marked.
- Read a better version of your answer, then try a follow-up question.

WHAT YOU GET
- Filler words, hedges and pauses highlighted in your transcript
- Speaking pace and clarity feedback
- A rewritten, stronger answer to learn from
- Pronunciation tips
- Streaks and progress you can see over time
- Practice in 12 languages, including English, Hindi, Spanish, French, German, Portuguese, Japanese and Korean

One account works on iPhone and on the web at meenuspeech.com.

MEENU PRO
Meenu needs a Pro subscription to practise. Choose monthly or yearly. Payment is charged to your Apple ID when you confirm the purchase. Your subscription renews automatically unless you cancel at least 24 hours before the end of the current period, and your account is charged for renewal within 24 hours before the period ends. You can manage or cancel your subscription in your Apple ID settings at any time.

Terms of Use: https://meenuspeech.com/terms
Apple Standard EULA: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/
Privacy Policy: https://meenuspeech.com/privacy

name: Metsästäjätutkinto: Harjoitus
description:
Läpäise metsästäjätutkinto ensimmäisellä kerralla. 365 harjoituskysymystä, 88 riistalajin tunnistuskuvat ja aidon kokeen simulaatio – suomeksi ja ruotsiksi.

KOESIMULAATIO KUIN OIKEASSA TUTKINNOSSA
• 60 kysymystä, 90 minuutin aikaraja
• Sama pisteytys: enintään 8 virhettä
• Heti tulos ja läpikäynti jokaisesta vastauksesta

365 KYSYMYSTÄ, 6 AIHEALUETTA
• Lainsäädäntö
• Aseet ja turvallisuus
• Lajintunnistus
• Riistabiologia
• Metsästysetiikka ja -käytäntö
• Pyyntivälineet ja menetelmät
Jokaisessa kysymyksessä selitys ja viittaus metsästyslain tai -asetuksen pykälään. Sisältö tarkistettu ajantasaista metsästyslakia vasten (muutos 693/2026).

LAJINTUNNISTUS
• 88 lajia tarkoin kuvin, tuntomerkit ja metsästysajat
• Helposti sekoitettavat lajiparit rinnakkain, esim. heinätavi ja tavi
• Rauhoitettu, riistalaji vai vieraslaji – opi status samalla

OPI VIRHEISTÄSI
• Väärin menneet kysymykset kerätään omaksi kertaukseksi
• Laskuri koepäivään asti pitää harjoittelun aikataulussa

TOIMII ILMAN VERKKOA
Harjoittele teoriakysymyksiä mökillä, metsässä tai passissa. (Lajikuvat tarvitsevat verkkoyhteyden.)

SUOMEKSI JA RUOTSIKSI
Vaihda kieltä yhdellä napautuksella – hyödyllinen myös, jos teet tutkinnon ruotsiksi.

KOKEILE ILMAISEKSI – KERTAOSTO, EI TILAUSTA
Metsästäjä Pro avaa kaiken pysyvästi. Kaikki tulevat päivitykset sisältyvät.

Sovellus ei ole Suomen riistakeskuksen virallinen sovellus.

name: mitte – Tuner
description:
mitte is a tuner you can feel. Play a note, and your iPhone tells you how close you are – on the screen and in your hand.

FEEL
• Off pitch, a steady hum that grows stronger the closer you get
• Dull when you're flat, crisp when you're sharp
• Right in the middle: the hum stops, a soft pulse and a green light
• End a note in tune and mitte gives you a little "well done"

FOR EVERY MUSICIAN
• Chromatic, for voice and any instrument
• Guitar in standard, Drop D, DADGAD, open and lower tunings, 7-string and baritone
• Bass with 4, 5 or 6 strings, ukulele, violin, viola, cello, double bass, mandolin, banjo, bouzouki, balalaika, charango, oud
• Transposing instruments in B-flat, E-flat, F, A, G and D: trumpet, clarinet, sax, horn and more see the note as written
• Note names the way you learned them: C D E ... B, C D E ... H (with Cis, Es and B), or Do Re Mi
• Sharps or flats
• Concert pitch from 415 to 466 Hz

LISTEN
• Tap a string or the note to hear it, and tune by ear
• Precise to a cent, from a 5-string bass's low B up high

Light and dark mode, seven accent colors. No account, no ads, no tracking, no in-app purchase. mitte listens only while it's open, and what it hears never leaves your iPhone.

From the makers of kasten, takt, hall, welle and spur.

name: Moasoom: Budget & Savings
description:
Save today, breathe tomorrow — Moasoom

"How much do I have left this month?" Stop doing the math.
Moasoom turns your budget into one simple number: what you can spend today.

◆ Your daily allowance
Your monthly budget, minus what you've spent and the bills still coming, divided by the days left. Start your month on payday if you like.

◆ Soomdong, your coin buddy
Smiles when you're on track, sweats when it's close, and says "It's okay, let's save again tomorrow" when you go over. Encouragement, not nagging.

◆ Log in 3 seconds
A big keypad and simple categories make every entry quick. Supports 20+ currencies, including cents.

◆ Savings goals for tomorrow
Travel, an emergency fund, a home… Set a target and a date, and Moasoom tells you how much to save each month. Your sprout grows into a flower as you save.

◆ Bill & subscription reminders
Add Netflix, phone, rent and more. Get a reminder the day before, and it's logged automatically on the payment day.

◆ Calendar & insights
See daily spending on a calendar and where your money goes in a chart. Share your monthly report as an image.

◆ No sign-up, no ads, just your phone
No account and no ads. Everything stays on your device and is never sent anywhere. Backup files and CSV export included.

◆ Moasoom Plus (optional)
Unlock unlimited goals and bills, spending insights and monthly reports, and CSV export. Choose a monthly or yearly subscription, or a one-time lifetime purchase. Subscriptions renew automatically unless cancelled at least 24 hours before the end of the period, and can be managed in your store account settings.

Made by APRILSOOM, a one-person studio.
Instagram @aprilsoom.office · support@sumandshim.com

Terms of Use (EULA): https://sumandshim.com/moasoom-terms
Privacy Policy: https://sumandshim.com/moasoom-privacy

name: Morse Code Torch
description:
Turn your iPhone's camera light into a Morse code signalling lamp, and learn Morse code as you go.

SEND MESSAGES IN MORSE
Type a message and Morse Code Torch flashes it from the camera light, using correct Morse timing. Choose a speed from 5 to 15 words per minute, and see the dots and dashes as you type.

LEARN MORSE CODE
A built-in guide covers every letter, number and punctuation mark, with how Morse timing works and tips for learning it.

STROBE
An adjustable strobe, from a slow pulse to fast flashing, controlled with one finger.

TORCH
A steady light from a dim glow to full brightness, with a single slider.

MORSE CODE TORCH PRO
One purchase, no subscription. Pro adds:
• Tap Morse: tap out Morse on the screen to signal with the light, see what you've spelled, and play it back on repeat
• Repeat: send a message several times, or until you stop it
• Full-speed strobe: up to 15 flashes per second, for as long as you like

Pro restores on all your iPhones signed in with the same Apple Account.

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
No accounts, no ads, no tracking and no data collected. The app uses the camera's light only, never the camera itself.

SAFETY
Flashing lights can trigger seizures in people with photosensitive epilepsy. Don't use the strobe around anyone who may be affected. Morse Code Torch is for learning and fun. It isn't a safety or emergency device, so in an emergency, contact the emergency services.

Requires an iPhone with a camera flash.

name: Movilidad Cuenca
description:
Live buses and tram in Cuenca, Ecuador, plus the city's event calendar. Free, no sign-up.

BUSES
• Find nearby stops on the map.
• See which lines stop there and how long until the next bus.
• View the full route of any line.
• Follow bus positions on the map.

TRAM
• All 28 stations on Line 1.
• Live arrivals at every station, in both directions.
• Trams in service on the map.
• Ruta Activa: discounts and perks at partner businesses when you show your ticket or card.
• Links to buy tickets from participating providers.
• Virtual library with free books for your ride.

WHERE TO?
• Type your destination and we'll tell you which bus or tram to take.
• We show where to board, where to get off and whether you need a transfer.
• Walking distance and an estimated trip time.

EVENTS IN CUENCA
• Concerts, theater, fairs, film and more in a day-by-day calendar.
• Add events to your calendar and share them.
• Organizing something? Submit your event for free; we review it before publishing.

MADE FOR CUENCA
• No accounts or passwords: open the app and go.
• We only use your location while you use the app, to show nearby stops. We don't store it.
• Available in Spanish and English.
• Free, supported by ads.

Movilidad Cuenca is an independent app. It is not affiliated with the Municipality of Cuenca, Tranvía de Cuenca or SIR Cuenca. Transit, business and library data come from those organizations' services; times are estimates.

name: MuntLab: Huishoudboekje Budget
description:
MuntLab is a household budget book that does the sorting for you. Add the statement from your bank (CSV, Excel, PDF or TXT) and MuntLab puts every payment in a category.

Your month
How much you spent this month, compared with what is usual for you. Which items came out higher. And one thing to do.

Money check
After every upload MuntLab looks at your fixed costs: what went up, what is new and what seems to have stopped. You see what a price rise costs you per year, and which contracts are worth comparing. In the autumn you see how many days are left to cancel your health insurance.

Your fixed costs and subscriptions
Rent, insurance, energy, phone and subscriptions in one list, with the amount per month and around which day it is debited. And what leaves your account in the next 30 days.

Spending
Per month and per year, per category. Tap a category to see the payments behind it. Is something in the wrong category, change it: MuntLab remembers it next time.

Budgets
Set a budget per category and see how much is left this month.

A monthly nudge
Turn on a monthly reminder to upload your new statement.

No account
You don't sign up. MuntLab reads your statement on your phone and keeps your data there. Make a backup whenever you like.

MuntLab does not give financial advice. It shows what happens with your money, so you can decide.

name: MustBe - Become Who You Want
description:
Is there someone you want to become? A world champion, a marathon finisher, a florist — anyone.
MustBe lets you name "who you must be," log every day, and grow a pixel character along the way.

■ must Be ___, Day n
Name who you want to become and Day 1 begins. Every entry adds a day and XP, and your character grows from LV.1.

■ Your character moves when you log
Log a session and watch your character hit the heavy bag, jump rope, or sprint. Level-up days come with a special growth scene.

■ More than one you
Boxing, running, flower arranging. Create several MustBe and grow each one in its own theme color.

■ Line of the day
Save one tip or sentence you don't want to forget. It comes back on Home and your widgets with the date you wrote it.

■ Widgets
See your line of the day, which day you're on, and your character's level right on your Home Screen and Lock Screen.

■ 30-day challenges
Follow Out-Boxer, Pace Runner, or Winger routines for 30 days to grow even faster.

■ Apple Calendar sync
Each MustBe gets its own calendar in its theme color. Edit or delete an entry and the calendar follows.

■ Your character from a photo
Pick a photo and MustBe picks up skin and hair colors for your character. The photo isn't saved.

Your entries stay on your device.

name: Muzawil - Health License Prep
description:
Prepare for your Saudi Commission for Health Specialties exam with a clear plan and questions that teach you why.

25,000+ reviewed questions for 20 exams, organized by each exam's official blueprint and weights. Every question comes with an explanation and a short Arabic summary.

• 20 exams in one app
Medicine (SMLE), Nursing (SNLE), Pharmacy (SPLE), Dentistry (SDLE), Laboratory, Radiologic Technology, Respiratory Care, Clinical Nutrition, Public Health, Psychology, Physiotherapy, Paramedics, Anesthesia Technology, Optometry and more. Each exam keeps its own progress.

• Answer, then understand why
After every answer: the explanation, why each option is right or wrong, and a two-line Arabic summary.

• Your day, ready when you open the app
A daily plan sized to your time: new questions plus reviews of your mistakes at the right moment, on a road map from foundations to exam day.

• Six ways to study
Today's session, smart review, flashcards, match, recall, and practice by topic.

• Prometric-style mock exams
Timed blocks like the real exam, with your score broken down by section.

• Know your readiness
Readiness against the pass mark, accuracy per section, your weakest topics and your streak.

• Study walls on iPad
Notes, pen drawings, PDFs, questions and cards on one board, free-form or as a grid. Make questions from your own files with on-device intelligence.

• Offline, no account
The whole bank is inside the app and your progress stays on your device. No ads, no data collected.

Free and Pro
Free includes 15 explained questions a day, the daily plan, flashcards, match, recall, progress, and one wall on iPad. Pro unlocks every question with no daily limit, mock exams and unlimited walls.
• 49.99 SAR a month, or 99.99 SAR for 3 months (or your local equivalent).
• Payment is charged to your Apple Account at confirmation of purchase. The subscription renews automatically unless canceled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period.
• Manage or cancel it in your App Store account settings.

This app is independent and not affiliated with the Saudi Commission for Health Specialties (SCFHS) or Prometric. Questions come from openly licensed medical question banks and questions written for the app (sources are listed in the app); they are not past exam questions.

Terms of Use: https://farisalbalawi.github.io/SCFHSPrepWeb/terms.html
Privacy Policy: https://farisalbalawi.github.io/SCFHSPrepWeb/privacy.html

name: MyPortal.gr
description:
Το MyPortal.gr στο κινητό σας: ενημέρωση με άποψη για την πολιτική, την οικονομία, την κοινωνία, την αυτοδιοίκηση και τα διεθνή, με την ταχύτητα και την άνεση μιας εφαρμογής.

ΡΟΗ ΕΙΔΗΣΕΩΝ
Οι τελευταίες ειδήσεις με μια ματιά. Περάστε από τη Ροή στην Πολιτική, την Οικονομία, την Κοινωνία, τα Παραπολιτικά, την Αυτοδιοίκηση και τις Συνεντεύξεις.

ΟΛΕΣ ΟΙ ΕΝΟΤΗΤΕΣ
Διεθνή, Υγεία, Τεχνολογία, Αθλητικά, Γαστρονομία, Lifestyle, Τα Νέα της ΔΕΘ – HELEXPO και όλες οι ενότητες του site, μαζί με τις εκπομπές και τα podcasts του MyPortal.gr Web TV.

Καθαρά άρθρα χωρίς περισπασμούς, φωτογραφίες σε πλήρη οθόνη με zoom, βίντεο και αναρτήσεις που ανοίγουν απευθείας στο YouTube, το X ή το Facebook.

ΑΠΟΘΗΚΕΥΣΗ ΓΙΑ ΑΡΓΟΤΕΡΑ
Κρατήστε τα άρθρα που σας ενδιαφέρουν και διαβάστε τα όποτε θέλετε. Τα τελευταία άρθρα που ανοίξατε διαβάζονται και χωρίς σύνδεση.

ΑΝΑΖΗΤΗΣΗ
Βρείτε γρήγορα άρθρα για τα θέματα και τα πρόσωπα που σας ενδιαφέρουν.

ΟΠΩΣ ΣΑΣ ΒΟΛΕΥΕΙ
Φωτεινό ή σκούρο θέμα και ρυθμιζόμενο μέγεθος κειμένου.

ΠΡΟΣΒΑΣΙΜΟΤΗΤΑ
Λειτουργεί με το VoiceOver και με μεγάλα γράμματα, σύμφωνα με τις οδηγίες WCAG 2.1 επιπέδου AA.

Κοινοποιήστε τα άρθρα με ένα άγγιγμα στους φίλους σας.
