name: Abyss Angler Landing Lab
description:
Take a more precise approach to fishing with Abyss Angler Landing Lab, a specialized offline utility designed to help anglers understand fishing line strength, evaluate knots, configure landing nets, and prepare their equipment for a successful fishing session.

Whether you enjoy freshwater fishing, trout fishing, spinning, or experimenting with different fishing tackle configurations, Abyss Angler Landing Lab provides practical calculation tools and visual references to support your setup decisions.

FISHING LINE STRENGTH ANALYSIS

Explore how the strength of your fishing setup depends on its individual components.

Enter the rated strength of your main line and leader, adjust connection parameters, and estimate the effective strength of your complete configuration.

Identify the weakest connection in your setup and understand how knot efficiency can influence the overall result.

Visual diagrams illustrate the relationship between the main line, knot, leader, and fish.

KNOT AND CONNECTION EVALUATION

Examine the role of knots in fishing tackle performance.

Compare material strength with estimated connection efficiency and understand why a fishing line may perform differently after a knot has been tied.

Use simplified calculations to identify potential limitations before your next fishing session.

LANDING NET DESIGN STUDIO

Configure a landing net based on your preferred fishing conditions and target species.

Adjust hoop length and width, explore elliptical hoop geometry, and review calculated perimeter measurements.

Visualize net proportions through a technical illustration with clearly displayed dimensions.

Explore different materials and prepare a net configuration suited to your equipment.

PERSONAL LANDING PLAN

Bring your fishing equipment together in one organized planning environment.

Select a target fish species, review fishing line specifications, and examine the dimensions of your chosen landing net.

Create a practical reference for checking whether your equipment configuration matches your intended fishing activity.

VISUAL FISHING EQUIPMENT TOOLS

Understand your setup through clean technical diagrams, interactive controls, and immediate calculation updates.

Explore fishing line paths, connection points, net geometry, and equipment dimensions without complicated workflows.

OFFLINE ACCESS

Abyss Angler Landing Lab is designed for offline use.

Access calculation tools, inspect equipment configurations, and explore your fishing setup without relying on an active internet connection.

BUILT FOR CURIOUS ANGLERS

Designed for fishing enthusiasts who want to go beyond basic tackle selection and better understand the technical relationships between their equipment.

From fishing line strength to landing net geometry, every tool helps turn equipment specifications into useful information.

IMPORTANT INFORMATION

Strength calculations are simplified estimates based on user inputs and assumptions. Actual performance may vary with material condition, knot quality, wear, environmental factors, and equipment handling.

Abyss Angler Landing Lab is a planning and educational utility. It does not guarantee equipment performance or successful fish landing.

Explore your fishing setup with greater clarity using Abyss Angler Landing Lab.

name: AckPush
description:
AckPush is a notification hub for the things that work for you. Your apps, scripts and AI agents send it a question, and you answer straight from the notification on your phone: tap Approve or Deny, pick one of the buttons they offer, type a quick reply, or snooze it for later. The answer goes back to whatever asked.

Good for:
- AI coding agents that need a go-ahead before they deploy, merge or spend money
- Scripts and cron jobs that should ask before doing something risky
- Your own apps and automations that need a human decision

How it works:
- Create an app in the AckPush console at ackpush.com and get an API token (or connect an AI assistant over MCP).
- Send a message with a title, a body and up to a few buttons.
- Answer it from the notification. The sender reads your answer from the API or receives it on a signed webhook.

Everything you receive also lands in the in-app inbox, so you can come back to it later.

Privacy: AckPush only stores what it needs to deliver your messages and your answers. No ads, no tracking. You can delete your account and all of its data from Settings in the app.

AckPush is free during early access, which is invite-only for now. Request an invite at ackpush.com.

name: AD Recorder
description:
AD Recorder is the visit recorder for American Driveway's sales team.

Your CRM appointments are on one screen, with a big Record button on each. Tap it at the door and get on with the visit: the recording keeps going with the screen locked, while you measure in ArcSite, show the presentation in Safari, or look at photos.

No signal at the house? No problem. Recordings are saved safely on your iPad or iPhone and upload to the CRM by themselves when signal comes back, even hours later. If a call comes in, recording picks back up on its own when you hang up.

In the CRM, each visit is transcribed and filed on the customer, with coaching notes for the sales team.

• Today's and upcoming appointments, saved for dead zones
• One-tap recording, plus recording without an appointment for stop-bys
• Keeps recording in the background and through interruptions
• Warns you if the microphone stops hearing anything
• Low battery and storage warnings before the visit
• Uploads automatically; audio is deleted from the device once the CRM has it

For American Driveway team members. Sign in with your CRM account.

name: Africa Sportfishing
description:
Africa Sportfishing is the catch log, weigh-in and points app for sport fishing clubs and boats across West Africa, starting with JHMMC (Jim Holder Memorial Marine Club) in Monrovia, Liberia.

LOG YOUR FISH AT SEA
Tap the species, then Kept, Released or Lost. The spot and time are saved for your crew, even with no signal, and sent when you're back in range. Night trips carry on past midnight.

YOUR BOAT'S LOG AND SEASON
Every trip, fish by fish. See your season in numbers: fish caught, billfish released, your best month, the busiest time of day, and trends year against year.

CATCH MAP WITH DEPTH CONTOURS
Your crew's spots on a depth chart of the coast, with the coordinates of every fish. Your exact spots stay private to your crew; other anglers only ever see rough areas.

WEIGH-INS WITH AUTOMATIC POINTS
At the weigh station, the weighmaster registers each fish with a photo on the scale. Points are worked out from the club rules, so there are no sums and no mistakes. The club secretary checks every weigh-in before it counts, any captain can dispute a fish, and every change is recorded.

LIVE LEADERBOARD AND RECORDS
Points by boat all season, the biggest catches, Ocean and River divisions, tournament results, and the club's record book by species.

TOURNAMENTS
Captains enter their boat and name their anglers from their phone. New tournaments are announced to everyone.

A PAGE FOR EVERY BOAT
Each boat's fish, its biggest catch and its place this season, with photos.

THE CLUB FEED
Weigh-ins, fish landed at sea and club announcements as they happen, with notifications for the ones you choose.

FOR CLUB OFFICERS
A secretary desk for reviews, disputes, corrections, tournament sheets, memberships and announcements, with an activity log of every change. Download the leaderboard, the members list and each tournament's registration sheet as PDF or Excel.

Your privacy: no ads, no tracking, and we never sell your data. Delete your account any time from the app.

name: AfterClass: Parents' Planner
description:
Which measures did the piano teacher say to practice? You’re scrolling through messages again. AfterClass is an iPhone app for parents to keep assignments, class schedules, lesson balances, and fees together.

【ASSIGNMENTS AND DAILY CHECK-INS】
· Type or paste practice notes or homework after each lesson for free. Convert photos of handwritten notes, workbook pages, or chat screenshots to text (Pro)
· Today’s practice sits at the top of the schedule. Tap to check in when it’s done
· See your practice streak and whether this week’s goal is met
· Set a weekly practice goal and reminder time for each class

【ADD CLASSES BY TEXT OR PHOTO】
· Type or paste “Piano Tuesdays and Thursdays at 4:30 PM, Main Street Music” to create a class for free
· Scan schedules or registration forms (Pro); import school schedules and school-calendar holidays too

【AI CLASS SUGGESTIONS】
· Based on your child’s age and weekly schedule: what’s worth keeping, where it’s too full, and what you might add. Free version: 2 requests per month

【THE FAMILY’S CLASS SCHEDULE】
· Week and month views, with a color for each child. Filter to see just one child
· Flags overlapping classes for one child, or pickup and drop-off times too close together for two kids
· Save the week as an image for whoever’s driving

【ABSENCES, RESCHEDULING, MAKEUPS】
· Tap a session to mark an absence, reschedule, add a makeup, or cancel
· Choose whether an absence uses a lesson credit

【LESSON CREDITS AND FEES】
· Packages: purchased, bonus, and used credits, expiration date, and estimated run-out date based on the current schedule
· Pay per session: sessions logged automatically, absences excluded. Send a list to the teacher to check; reset to zero once paid
· Monthly fees: paid/unpaid status for each month, with payment reminders (Pro)
· Set a session to use 1.5 or 2 credits

【REMINDERS】
· Free pre-class reminders can include travel time
· Alerts for low lesson balances, expiring packages, and monthly payments due (Pro)

【SHARE WITH FAMILY】
· Sync to a separate calendar in the Calendar app (Pro)
· Share a free schedule link. Family can open it in WeChat or a browser without installing the app. Absences and schedule changes update automatically

【NO ACCOUNT NEEDED】
· No sign-up, no ads, and no limit on kids or classes

Keep using text-based class entry, assignments, daily check-ins, schedules, lesson and fee tracking, pre-class reminders, and schedule sharing for free. AI class suggestions include 2 requests per month. Photo recognition, lesson balance and payment alerts, and calendar sync require Pro. Pro offers an annual subscription or a one-time purchase; both support Family Sharing.

SUBSCRIPTION
Pro is available as a yearly auto-renewing subscription or as a one-time purchase. Payment for the yearly subscription is charged to your Apple Account at confirmation of purchase. The subscription renews automatically unless auto-renew is turned off at least 24 hours before the end of the current period, and your account is charged the yearly price at that time within 24 hours before the period ends. You can manage or cancel the subscription at any time in your Apple Account settings.

name: AgentRealm
description:
AgentRealm is a private inbox for the AI agents and automations that work for you.

A research assistant, a store bot, a nightly script, or any tool that can send a web request can check in when it finishes work. You read every update in one feed on your iPhone, and your bots can ask you a quick question when they need a decision.

What you can do:

- Sign in with your email and a one-time code. There is no password to remember.
- Add an agent and give it a secret key. It works with Claude, ChatGPT, Codex, Grok, Zapier, n8n, Make, cron jobs, or your own scripts.
- Read a live feed of check-ins, each marked ok, warning, or error, with notes, numbers, and links.
- Answer questions from your bots with one tap, like "Send it" or "Wait a day."

- Give each bot its own robot face.
- Delete your account and all of its data from the Account page at any time.

Plans: AgentRealm is free with one bot. Pro ($14 a month) and Team ($29 a month) add more bots, questions, and quiet-bot alerts. Paid plans are billed on the AgentRealm website through Stripe.

FULL VERSION (one-time purchase) • Unlimited assistants and servers • Browser assistant: the AI searches, opens pages, clicks and types — and asks before anything sensitive • Compare models side by side on the same question • Automatic memory and long-chat summaries • Video frames, PDFs and documents as context • Apple Pencil markup and handwriting on iPad • Siri, Shortcuts, Action Button, widgets, Dynamic Island • Backup and restore

name: AIMosaic: Photo Blur & Redact
seller_name: Guangzhou Biaojiefu Network Technology Co., Ltd.
description:
AIMosaic finds the private details in your photos and screenshots and covers them in one tap.

Before you share a chat, a delivery label, an order screenshot or a group photo, AIMosaic scans it right on your iPhone for faces, phone numbers, emails, ID and card numbers, addresses, license plates, one-time codes, QR codes and barcodes, and masks them instantly. Everything happens on device: no internet, no uploads, no sign-in.

AUTO-DETECT AND REDACT
• Faces and avatars in selfies and group shots, with fun emoji covers
• Text: phone numbers, emails, ID and card numbers, addresses, order numbers, codes and plates
• QR codes and barcodes, including payment and pickup codes

FINE-TUNE IN SECONDS
• Tap a detected area to toggle it; long-press text to hide only the words you choose

• Seven styles: solid, mosaic (pixelate), blur, ink, grain, color stripes and color checks

• Text watermarks with your own wording, color, size, angle and spacing

SHARE SAFELY
• Exports strip GPS and EXIF metadata
• Save a copy and keep your original, in PNG or JPG at the size you need
• Open images from Photos, the Files app, the share sheet or the Photos editing extension

PRIVACY FIRST
AIMosaic collects no personal data. No accounts, no ads, no tracking. Your images never leave your device.

Tip: automatic detection can miss things. Zoom in to check before sharing, and use an opaque solid cover for anything sensitive.

name: Akmon Fitness

Akmon turns training into a campaign. Choose who you train as — Bodybuilder, Athlete, Warrior, Yogi, Superhero, Cowboy or Pirate — and every session moves your character forward.

• Wealth — one money goal, one spending limit, a weekly check-in
• Strategy — one chess puzzle a day, with a rating that climbs as you do

No accounts, no ads, no tracking. Your data stays on your iPhone and in your own private iCloud, where only you can read it.

name: AlohaKai
description:
AlohaKai is an offline audio guide for the Hawaiian Islands. It works without a signal, keeps your location and questions on your device, and uses Apple Intelligence to answer follow-up questions when you want more than the recording.

FREE TO START
Explore five essential Oahu stops at no cost: Pearl Harbor National Memorial, Diamond Head, Waikiki Beach, Hanauma Bay, and Iolani Palace. Each includes a map pin, practical notes, and an offline narration.

HAWAII COMPLETE — ONE-TIME UNLOCK
Unlock the full library for $9.99 once. No subscription, no account, no ads.
• 200 places across Oahu, Maui, Kauai, the Big Island, Molokai, and Lanai
• 20 museum packs with 105 galleries and exhibits
• Pre-generated English narration for every place
• Cover photographs across the library
• Offline maps and GPS-triggered narration
• Museum label scanning: photograph the label, match the exhibit, and hear its story
• Apple Intelligence guide for follow-up questions on supported devices
• Restore purchases on any device signed in with the same Apple Account

BUILT FOR THE ROAD
The guide starts when you arrive. Places are ordered by distance, and narration can also be started manually. Map, audio, and text stay available offline. Apple Maps provides the online basemap; packs with offline map tiles can fall back to MapLibre.

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
Location, camera, photos, speech, and Apple Intelligence run on your device. Photos are not saved or uploaded. The app does not create an account, show ads, or include analytics. It contacts Wikipedia only when you ask for narration for a place outside the active pack.

name: App Locatel Mobile
description:
Locatel PDV Mobile permite a los equipos comerciales consultar, desde el celular, el desempeño de los puntos de venta (PDV) Locatel.

El acceso es solo para colaboradores autorizados: el registro requiere un correo corporativo y cada cuenta es aprobada por un administrador antes de ver información.

RESUMEN COMERCIAL
• Venta neta, ticket promedio, transacciones y unidades del mes.
• Rentabilidad estimada: costo de referencia, margen bruto y margen %.
• Gráficas de evolución mensual.
• Valores en pesos colombianos (COP) o en dólares (USD) con un solo toque.

PUNTOS DE VENTA
• Lista de PDV con búsqueda por nombre, código, ciudad o dirección.
• Filtra por ciudad y ordena por venta, transacciones, ticket y otros indicadores.
• Cada usuario ve solo los PDV que tiene autorizados.

DETALLE DE CADA PDV
• Indicadores comerciales y generales del punto de venta.
• Evolución de ventas y volumen operativo de los últimos meses.
• Venta promedio por día de la semana.
• Ventas por línea comercial, subcategoría y forma de pago, con su histórico.
• Datos del PDV: ciudad, dirección, teléfono y fecha de apertura.

DATOS ACTUALIZADOS
La información se actualiza automáticamente cuando hay una nueva publicación de datos y se guarda en el dispositivo para consultarla de forma ágil.

SEGURIDAD Y PRIVACIDAD
• Acceso con correo corporativo y aprobación administrativa.
• Permisos por usuario: acceso a todos los PDV o solo a los asignados.
• Puedes eliminar tu cuenta en cualquier momento desde "Mi cuenta".
• Sin anuncios ni compras.

name: AppScout - Find Something New
description:
App Scout helps you discover apps, websites and software from across the internet, one at a time.

HOW IT WORKS
• See one app at a time, with a short description and how many people have visited it.
• Tap Like if it interests you, Dislike if it doesn't, or swipe to the next one.
• App Scout learns from your likes and from people with similar taste, so your feed keeps getting more relevant.

FEATURES
• Personalized feed that improves the more you use it
• Browse every listing, sorted by most liked, with search
• Your liked apps, saved in one place
• Open any app's website right inside App Scout
• Share a great find with a friend

No account needed. Just open the app and start exploring.

Every listing is reviewed by our team before it appears.

name: Arago - Rhythm & Wonder
description: Arago is a Popular Science air-traffic-control game for curious learners who want to understand how airport movements fit together. Explore an airport atlas with regional, hub, and international scales, then choose from 80 authored scenarios across eight families covering arrivals, departures, crossings, weather, emergencies, aircraft damage, priority movements, and international operations. Set Calm, Busy, or Dense traffic pressure; inspect aircraft profiles; prepare a schedule plan, preview conflicts, apply a safe sequence, or cancel before commitment. During a shift, protect runway and taxiway space while responding to scripted weather, emergency, and damage events, then finish with a deterministic command log and replay that explains each result. Revisit saved shifts, search the catalog, and open 24 knowledge cards that connect each decision to a plain-language aviation idea. The product opens through Welcome and Continue, includes Settings with policy links and Clear Data, has no profile step, and does not request camera, photo library, microphone, location, notification, or tracking access. Completed runs and preferences remain available on the same iPhone until you choose Clear Data; policy pages open only when requested.

name: Arali
description:
Arali brings customer messages, calling, and AI call notes into one mobile workspace. Built for sales and customer-facing teams, it helps you stay connected and keep track of important conversations while you’re away from your desk.

CUSTOMER MESSAGES, TOGETHER
Access conversations across your connected communication channels. Filter messages by channel and search by name or phone number to find the conversation you need.

CALL CUSTOMERS ACROSS MARKETS
Use the built-in dialer to call from your available Arali numbers. Call customers in the United States, Australia, Singapore, and supported countries across Europe. Calling availability and rates vary by destination and plan.

AI NOTES AFTER CALLS
Review call recordings and AI-generated notes after supported calls. Revisit important details and prepare for your next conversation without relying on memory alone.

STAY CONNECTED ON THE GO
Move between messages and calling in one app, so you can keep customer conversations moving wherever you work.

Arali is built for sales, account management, and customer success teams.

name: Asciiquarium
description:
An aquarium for your TV, drawn entirely in ASCII art.

Fish swim by in every color, seaweed sways, bubbles rise, and a castle sits on the sand. Now and then something bigger passes through: a shark, a whale, a ship, a submarine, a sea monster, swans, ducks, dolphins, swordfish and jellyfish.

Open Asciiquarium and leave it running. It keeps your TV awake while the tank is on, and after four hours without a button press it lets your TV dim again, so it can't burn into an OLED screen.

THE REMOTE
• Click to drop a fishhook, and click again to reel it in.
• Play/Pause opens Options while the tank keeps swimming.
• Back closes Options, or leaves the app.

OPTIONS
• How many fish, and the full or the classic set of creatures
• Which special creatures can appear
• A solid or gradient background
• Small, medium or large text

No ads, no accounts, no tracking. Asciiquarium collects nothing.

Based on asciiquarium by Kirk Baucom. Free software under the GNU GPL; the source code is on GitHub.

name: Asset Log: Maintenance Tracker
description:
Asset Log is a maintenance log for the things a small business or a household depends on: mowers and diggers, vans and trailers, power tools, boilers, generators. Give each one a QR sticker, scan it, and its whole history is in your hand. No account to create, and no limit on how many assets you keep.

STICK, SCAN, LOG
- Print QR label sheets from the app, for common A4 and US Letter label packs and for Brother and Dymo label rolls.
- Scan a sticker with the camera and the asset opens at once.
- Log a service, repair or inspection in seconds: what was done, who did it, labour, parts and their cost, and photos of the work.
- Already have barcodes or tags on your equipment? Adopt them instead of printing new ones.

NEVER MISS WHAT IS DUE
- Reminders by date, by meter, or whichever comes first: every 12 months or every 250 hours.
- Meters in hours, kilometres or miles, with the next service date estimated from how fast the meter moves.
- One Due list across everything you own, overdue first, with search and filters.
- A daily notification at the time you choose.

KNOW WHAT YOU HAVE AND WHO HAS IT
- Every asset with its photo, serial and registration numbers, make and model, purchase cost, warranty date and location.
- Check tools out to a person and back in again.
- Categories, locations, people and suppliers you set up once.
- Search by name, tag, serial, make or place.

ON A COMPUTER TOO
Desktop access shows your asset log in a web browser on the same Wi-Fi, served straight from your phone: a big screen for entering a fleet or reviewing a year. A pairing code keeps it yours.

FREE, WITH ONE OPTIONAL SUBSCRIPTION
Free on every plan: unlimited assets, work records, readings, reminders and photos, QR label sheets, Desktop access, and backup and restore. The free version shows adverts: a full-screen advert at most once every 20 minutes, only when you move between tabs.

The optional yearly subscription removes the adverts and adds reports and exports:
- Reports: spend by month, by asset and by kind of work, with downtime.
- The asset register, work log, spend report, reminders list and any asset's full history as PDF or CSV files, for the insurer, the accountant or the buyer of a machine.

YOUR RECORDS STAY WITH YOU
Your assets, records and photos are stored on your phone, not on our servers. Back up to a file you keep wherever you like.
- On iPhone and iPad, an optional backup to your own iCloud Drive.
- App lock with Face ID or Touch ID.
- The free version's adverts are served by Google, and a support message you choose to send reaches us; your records are not part of either. The privacy policy has the detail.

GOOD TO KNOW
- Asset Log keeps its records on one phone or tablet. It does not sync between devices or team members; move to a new phone with a backup.
- It is a record-keeping aid. It does not certify that equipment is safe or legal to use, and it does not replace the inspections and tests the law requires.

Terms of Use (EULA): https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/
Privacy Policy: https://brightscalelabs.com/asset-log/privacy/

name: AstroPart
description:
A simpler way to find parts for humanoid and AI robots.

Scan a robot or part QR code, read a supported NFC label, select a QR photo, or enter a reference. See registered manufacturers, models, part numbers, batches and production dates. Check the manufacturer's compatibility conditions, then use Nearby to find supplier contacts. When nearby stock is unavailable, the service can expand to suppliers that declare shipping to your country. You can also search by country or city without location permission.

Public lookup and registration-hash verification are free. Availability is provided by manufacturers and authorized suppliers; confirm stock, delivery and installation directly with them. No wallet or token is required.

Built toward the on-chain future of robotics. The current release verifies stored registration hashes; production chain anchoring will be offered through a future approved integration. A QR or NFC label identifies a record and does not by itself authenticate a physical part.

Contact manufacturers through their own MA account, with email as the next option. Manufacturers can register in MA and add their complete MA ID to AstroPart Factory. Other contact channels are optional.

name: AstroPart Factory
description:
Free registration for the parts that keep robots moving.

AstroPart Factory helps approved manufacturers create records for humanoid and AI robots and their parts, generate QR labels, publish compatibility rules and maintain supplier availability. Configure a production-line template once, then use its scoped API credential to issue unit labels from your own manufacturing system. Your marking software can encode the returned URL for printed labels, laser marking or NFC tags.

On iPhone, the native Check label tool reads QR or supported NFC labels and displays the registered model, part, batch and hash for first-article checks. The workspace also supports native QR image export.

The current catalog-registration and lookup service is free. Apply for a workspace and receive a single-use sign-in code after approval. Use Settings and fitment to manage public contacts, service-point locations and account deletion. No payment or token purchase is required.

Built toward the on-chain future of robotics. The current release verifies stored registration hashes; production chain anchoring will be offered through a future approved integration. A QR or NFC label identifies a record and does not by itself authenticate a physical part.

Contact manufacturers through their own MA account, with email as the next option. Manufacturers can register in MA and add their complete MA ID to AstroPart Factory. Other contact channels are optional.

name: ATLANTICDMA
description:
It records what was practiced each time, how much was used, how many sets were completed, and how long it lasted.

These numbers remain in their original positions. You can scroll back or view them in sequence.
When viewed by week, it forms a column; when viewed by day, it is a row of points.
The longer the accumulation, the more clearly you can see when the change began.

The cumulative number of sets, the cumulative number of seconds, and the maximum value each time do not overlap with each other.
Nor will they be erased by a later one. Looking at the same set of numbers from a different perspective may lead to different conclusions.
Therefore, it keeps the original version, and when you want to view it, it is right there.

name: Atlas Recharge : Bornes Maroc
description:
Atlas Recharge est la carte des bornes de recharge pour véhicules électriques au Maroc.

Ouvrez l'application, la carte se centre sur vous et affiche les bornes les plus proches : puissance, types de prise, gratuite ou payante, état signalé par la communauté.

TROUVER UNE BORNE
• Carte de toutes les bornes référencées au Maroc, de Tanger à Dakhla
• Filtres par prise (Type 2, CCS, CHAdeMO), puissance minimale et gratuité
• « À proximité » : les bornes autour de votre position en un geste
• Itinéraire vers la borne dans Google Maps ou Waze

PLANIFIER UN TRAJET
• Indiquez départ et arrivée, l'application propose les arrêts de recharge sur la route
• Export du trajet vers votre application de navigation

LA COMMUNAUTÉ
• Avis et notes des conducteurs sur chaque borne
• Signalez une borne en panne ou réparée
• Ajoutez une borne manquante

VOTRE COMPTE (facultatif)
• Bornes favorites et trajets enregistrés
• Notifications quand une borne que vous avez signalée change d'état
• Fiches des modèles électriques vendus au Maroc

La carte, la recherche, les itinéraires et les avis sont accessibles sans compte.

name: AtStores Admin
description:
AtStores Admin is the free app for store owners on AtStores, India's local store discovery platform. Run your shop from your phone and reach more customers near you.

MANAGE YOUR STORE
• Register your store with address, timings, category and photos
• Use your current location to fill in the store address
• Update store details and images anytime

PRODUCTS AND SERVICES
• Add products or services with price, discount and offer price
• Organise items into categories
• Mark new arrivals and upload product photos

OFFERS
• Create offers and discounts for selected products
• Preview offers before publishing
• Turn offers on or off with one tap

BOOKINGS
• See booking requests from customers for service stores
• Accept, reschedule or complete bookings

VISITORS AND CUSTOMERS
• Track store views, product views, wishlist adds and offer views
• See which products are most viewed and wishlisted
• View customers interested in your products and send them extra offers
• Message customers on WhatsApp with your store link

YOUR STORE WEBSITE
• Request and manage a website for your store

AtStores Admin is for store owners registered on AtStores. Log in with your mobile number and OTP.

name: AtStores: Find Stores Near You
description:
AtStores helps you discover local stores, offers and services near you, all in one app.

FIND STORES NEAR YOU
• Browse shops and service providers around your location
• Filter by category: fashion, salon & spa, restaurants, electronics, grocery and more
• See distance, timings, address, photos and ratings for every store
• Call, WhatsApp or get directions to a store in one tap

OFFERS AND COUPONS
• See the latest offers and discounts from stores near you
• Claim exclusive coupons and keep them in one place

PRODUCTS AND SERVICES
• View products and services with prices, discounts and offer prices
• Add products to your wishlist and save your favourite stores

BOOK APPOINTMENTS
• Book services at salons, spas and other service stores
• Choose your date and time slot and track your bookings

YOUR PROFILE
• Log in with your mobile number and OTP
• Manage your profile, bookings, orders, wishlist and saved stores
• Get notifications about your bookings and new offers

RATE AND REVIEW
• Share your experience by rating stores you visit

AtStores connects you with real local businesses in your city. Shop local, save more.

name: Australia Citizenship Test2027
description:
Prepare for the Australian citizenship test with practice questions written from the official booklet, Australian Citizenship: Our Common Bond.

PRACTISE THE WAY THE REAL TEST WORKS
• 999 three-option multiple-choice questions covering all four testable Parts of the booklet
• Quizzes by Part, random quizzes, a custom length, or every question in Practice Mode
• Instant feedback with a short reason for every option, plus extra context after each answer
• Questions you get wrong come up more often, so your practice targets your weak spots
• Listen: have each question and its answers read aloud

MOCK TEST (FULL VERSION)
• 20 questions, 5 from each Part, with a 45-minute timer, set out like the real test
• Scored with both pass rules: all 5 Australian values questions right and at least 15 out of 20
• Review later flags, a question grid, and a full review of your answers afterwards

TRACK YOUR PROGRESS
• A test readiness score, with a separate Australian values indicator
• Pass rate, study streak, study time, questions covered and a recent-scores chart
• Areas needing improvement and most-missed questions, with Focused Practice and Practise My Mistakes (full version)

STUDY NOTES
• The four testable Parts and the glossary, rewritten in plain English
• Search across all the notes, with your reading progress saved

FREE AND FULL VERSION
• Free: 500 questions, every practice quiz type, progress tracking and the study notes
• Full version (one-off A$2.99, no subscription): all 999 questions, the Mock Test, Focused Practice and Practise My Mistakes

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
• No account, no ads and no tracking. Your progress stays on your device.

This app is an independent study tool. It is not affiliated with, endorsed by or approved by the Australian Government or the Department of Home Affairs. Questions and notes are written in our own words, based on Australian Citizenship: Our Common Bond (CC BY 4.0). Always check the official website for the latest information about the citizenship test.

name: Avri: Medication Reminders
description:
Avri is a calm, simple way to remember the medicines you already take. You add your medicines and choose your times, and Avri gives you a gentle reminder when each one is due.

Privacy first. There's no account and no sign-up. Everything you enter stays on your iPhone, and we never see it.

YOUR DAY AT A GLANCE
• Today shows what's due, grouped into morning, afternoon, evening and night
• Tick a dose with one large button, and see how many you've taken today
• Tap a dose for "Remind me in 15 min" or "Skip this dose"
• Medicines you take only when needed get their own section, with a simple log

REMINDERS YOUR WAY
• Every day, on chosen days of the week, or only when needed
• Medicines due at the same time share one reminder
• Mark a dose as taken right from the reminder
• A follow-up reminder if a dose hasn't been ticked, after 10 or 30 minutes, or none
• Discreet reminders by default, or full detail, or a private phrase of your own, such as "Time for a cup of tea"

READ YOUR LABEL
• Take or choose a photo of your pharmacy label, and Avri fills in the name, strength, directions and more
• The photo is read on your iPhone and isn't kept
• You check every detail against your label before saving, and you always set your own times

YOUR SHELF
• See every medicine on a simple shelf, with how many are left
• Gentle notices when you're running low, a refill date is near, or a medicine is close to expiring

MADE TO BE EASY TO READ
• Large, clear text, with Larger and Largest sizes
• Three looks: Rosé, Linen and Tweed, each with a dark mode
• Travelling? For each medicine, choose to follow local time or keep a steady rhythm

IMPORTANT
Avri only reminds you based on what you enter. It isn't a medical device and doesn't give medical advice. It doesn't check doses, interactions or whether a medicine is right for you. Reminders can be missed if your phone is off, silenced or out of battery, so don't rely on Avri alone for a medicine you can't miss. Ask your doctor or pharmacist about your medicines. In an emergency, call 911.

SUBSCRIPTION
Avri requires a subscription after a 3-day free trial: $3.99 a month or $24.99 a year. The free trial is available once per Apple Account. Payment is charged to your Apple Account when you confirm the purchase. Your subscription renews automatically unless you cancel at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. You can manage or cancel it any time in your Apple Account settings.

Terms of Use: https://cheskatenterprises.com/avri-terms
Privacy Policy: https://cheskatenterprises.com/avri-privacy
Support URL: https://cheskatenterprises.com/avri

name: Azkar: Prayer & Dhikr
description:
Azkar helps you keep your prayers, your azkar and your Quran reading every day, and shows you how you are doing over time.

PRAYER TIMES
• Accurate prayer times for where you are, with all the common calculation methods and both Asr methods
• A live countdown to the next prayer
• Log each prayer as on time, in congregation or made up, with one tap
• Reminders, and an adhan alarm that sounds even in silent mode
• Qibla compass

AZKAR
• Morning, evening and before-sleep azkar, and the azkar after each prayer
• One dhikr at a time, counted with a tap, with your progress kept every day
• A tasbih counter, with your own dhikr if you wish

THE QURAN
• The mushaf in its 604 Medina pages
• Mark where you stopped, and follow your khatmah
• Set a date to finish a khatmah and see the pages a day it takes
• Keep track of the surahs you have memorised and when you last reviewed them

TRACKER
• Streaks for the five prayers and the azkar
• Prayers and fasts to make up, including those from before you started
• Fasting, Ramadan, tarawih and the last ten nights
• Charity and zakat, with a reminder on your yearly zakat date
• Your own duas, brought forward on the day of Arafah, in the last ten nights and on Friday afternoons
• A review of each Hijri year
• Export to a spreadsheet, and automatic backups to a folder you choose

ON YOUR IPHONE AND APPLE WATCH
• Lock Screen and Home Screen widgets to tick off today's prayers
• A Live Activity for the next prayer
• An Apple Watch app to log prayers and count tasbih
• Siri and Shortcuts

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
No account, no ads and no tracking. Everything you record stays on your iPhone.

Available in English and Arabic.

name: BarbaVox – Real Estate CRM
description:
BarbaVox is a mobile CRM for real estate agents. After a conversation with a client, there is no need to type notes: say what your client is looking for, and BarbaVox saves the memo, sends it to your agency's server and suggests CRM data from it.

VOICE MEMOS
• Record a short summary of the conversation with one tap.
• Your agency's server turns speech into text and extracts the details: purchase or rent, property type, locations, budget, rooms, requirements and priority.
• Every detail comes with a quote from the memo, so you can see where it came from.
• Calls are never recorded. Only your own summary is recorded, and only when you start recording.

YOU APPROVE EVERY CHANGE
• Extracted details are only suggestions. In the review you write the note for the client history and choose the changes: update a search, add a next step, record interest in a property.
• The note and the changes are saved together, only after you approve them.

CALLS, CLIENTS AND NEXT STEPS
• Call history with memos, search and filters by client, date and memo.
• Client profile with calls, voice and typed notes, search requests and next steps.
• New client or new search in a few taps, with a duplicate warning by phone number.
• Reminders for next steps arrive on time, even offline, with Call now, Mark as complete and Remind me tomorrow actions.
• Your agency's property listings always at hand.

WORKS OFFLINE
Everything you do is first saved on the phone, in an encrypted database, and sent as soon as you are back online.

WHO IT IS FOR
BarbaVox is used by real estate agencies that run the BarbaVox system. Accounts are created by the agency: you sign in with the email and password your agency gives you.

Languages: English, Bosnian, Croatian, Serbian (Latin) and German. Light and dark theme.

Privacy: data goes only to your agency's server, over HTTPS. No ads and no tracking.

name: Basil: Your Smart Chef
description:
Basil is a smart chef for home cooks. He keeps every recipe you want to cook in one place, takes you through each one a step at a time, and helps you make it better the next time.

SAVE RECIPES FROM ANYWHERE
• Paste a link from a recipe website.
• Photograph a page from a cookbook or a handwritten card.
• Paste the text, or type it in yourself.
Basil reads it and sets it out the same clear way every time: ingredients, steps, time and servings.

COOK A STEP AT A TIME
• Cook mode shows one step at a time in large type, with the ingredients that step needs.
• A timer is ready when a step gives a time.
• The screen stays awake while you cook.

ASK BASIL ANYTHING
• "Can I make this vegetarian?" "I've only got 300g of chicken." "What can I use instead of buttermilk?"
• Ask for a change and Basil rewrites the recipe. Keep it as a variation beside the original.
• Basil learns what you like and who you cook for, so his answers suit your kitchen.

WHAT'S IN THE FRIDGE
• Tell Basil what you have, or take a photo of your fridge, and say how long you've got. He suggests three dishes you could cook now.

KEEP TRACK OF WHAT YOU'VE COOKED
• Log each cook with a rating, a photo and a note.
• When something wasn't quite right, Basil suggests what to change next time.

COOKBOOKS
• Group recipes into cookbooks that read like real ones, a recipe to a page.
• Share a recipe or a cookbook with a link, or let someone you choose edit a cookbook with you.

IDEAS FOR WHAT TO COOK NEXT
• Basil's Picks suggests dishes from what you cook and what you haven't tried yet.

Basil is an AI chef. He can be wrong, so check anything that matters to you, and he does not give medical or allergy advice. The app asks your permission before anything of yours is shared with the AI service.

No adverts. You can delete your account and everything in it at any time in Settings.

name: Basin Kings
description: For members of Basin Kings. The Basin Kings Grappling app gives members an easy way to manage their training from anywhere. Check in to class, book sessions, manage your account and payments, access member content, and stay connected with Basin Kings.

name: Bauklok DuelFace
description:
Bauklok Duelface turns your iPhone into a timer for strategic games. Simply place your device in the center of the table, and each player will have a display screen facing their assigned direction. Whether playing chess, Go, shogi, or other board games, everyone can easily track time and take turns.

After each move, players simply tap their clock to change turns. If you accidentally tap the wrong time, you can undo it and restore the previous time. The app supports 2 to 4 players, allowing you to name the game, choose colors, and arrange turns clockwise or counterclockwise.

You can choose between seven timer modes: fixed time, plus time after each move, Delay, Bronstein, Byo-yomi, Hourglass, and individual time for each turn. The available settings suit various game styles, and you can also create and save your own custom configurations.

When time is running out, the watch will signal a countdown, displaying tenths of a second and changing the border to red to indicate danger. Sound and vibration feedback can be customized to your liking.

The fun isn't just in the matches themselves. Bauklok Duelface saves the time of each move, a progress chart, and each player's achievements. You can view win rates, head-to-head records, average thinking time, or close victories, and conquer achievement milestones with your friends.

name: Baven: Cleaner & Organizer
description:
Baven finds duplicate photos, similar shots, old screenshots and big videos, then shows you exactly what it found. It never deletes anything on its own. You choose, you confirm, and you can always put things back.

HOW IT KEEPS YOUR PHOTOS SAFE
• Nothing is deleted until you tap Empty and confirm. iOS then asks you to confirm again.
• Suggestions wait in the Pool, a trash that never empties itself. Put Back always works.
• Before deleting, Baven re-checks that each photo is still the exact one you chose. Anything that changed is left alone.
• Mark people, albums or photos as Never touch.
• A private on-device record shows what you removed and when.
• Optional Face ID before the Pool is emptied.

WHAT IT DOES
• Duplicates: exact copies are byte-checked, and Baven shows which copy it keeps.
• Similar photos and bursts: compare side by side and pick the best shot.
• Screenshots: review them yourself, nothing is pre-selected.
• Large videos: sort by size, preview, and pick what to remove.
• Blurry photos: shown for your review only.
• Compress videos and photos to save space.
• Swipe to clean: a fast, one-handed way to go through your library.
• Duplicate contacts: review and merge.
• Space story and goal: see how much you can free and how much is waiting in Recently Deleted.

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
All analysis happens on your phone. Your photos and contacts are never uploaded, and Baven has no ads.

HONEST PRICING
Baven is free to try with a daily allowance for emptying. Baven Pro removes the allowance and adds bulk tools, as an annual subscription with a free trial or a one-time lifetime purchase. No weekly plans. The price is shown before any purchase, and you can cancel any time in your Apple ID settings.

Subscriptions renew automatically unless cancelled at least 24 hours before the period ends. Manage them in Settings > Apple ID > Subscriptions.
Terms of Use: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/

name: BB официант
description:
ВВ официант — приложение для работы официантов в подключённых ресторанах.

Открывайте заказы по столам, добавляйте блюда и напитки, учитывайте пожелания гостей и следите за приготовлением.

В приложении:
• Заказы и столы вашего зала.
• Поиск позиций меню и работа с модификаторами.
• Разделение позиций по гостям и комментарии к блюдам.
• Статусы приготовления и подачи.
• Стоп-лист и доступность позиций.
• Работа с программой лояльности подключённого ресторана.
• Светлая и тёмная темы.

Для работы нужны подключённый ресторан и учётная запись сотрудника. Доступные действия зависят от прав сотрудника и настроек ресторана. Приложение предназначено для персонала; гостям устанавливать его не требуется.

Для знакомства с интерфейсом выберите демо-режим на стартовом экране. Демо работает с вымышленными данными, без подключения к настоящему ресторану.

name: BCS Seattle
description:
The BCS Seattle app is for members and friends of Baloch Community Services of Seattle, a 501(c)(3) nonprofit.

• Membership: apply to join, see your membership status and manage your contribution plan.

• Elections: nominate yourself or another member, propose questions for the ballot, read candidates' statements, and vote on leadership positions and community initiatives. Keep your confirmation codes, and see the results once they're published.

• Giving: give to BCS Seattle or to a community fundraiser. Payments are made securely with Stripe on our website.

• Community funds: see where BCS Seattle's money comes from and where it goes.

• Receipts: download your contribution receipts for your taxes and your donation receipts, and share or print them.

• Members and resources: the member directory and BCS programs such as the funeral and burial fund.

• Notifications: if you turn them on, get reminders when elections open and close, and a notice if a payment doesn't go through.

Some features are for approved members. You can apply to become a member in the app or at bcsseattle.org.

name: Beblet
description:
Welcome! We’ve put great care into building this product and look forward to your valuable suggestions.

Beblet is an errand planner organized the way you actually move through your day: by place.

Instead of one long to-do list, every place you go is a Stop: the pharmacy, the hardware store, the post office, the grocery, the bank, the dry cleaner, or any spot you add. Each stop keeps its own list, so when you walk in you see exactly what you need there and nothing else.

TYPE IT, TAG IT
The quick-add bar understands plain language. Type "batteries @hardware" or "stamps @post" and the item lands on the right stop. Tag a place you haven't used yet and Beblet opens a new stop for it. Add "every week" or "monthly" and the item comes back on its own.

RIDE TODAY'S LINE
Plan your outing like a transit route. Drag the stops you'll visit today onto Today's Line and put them in order. Tap Depart and the run clock starts. At each station, tap to open its list and check things off. Finishing a stop's list lights the station, and the train moves on to the next one. Finish the line and the run is saved.

RECURRING ERRANDS
Milk every week at the grocery, a prescription every month at the pharmacy: repeating items go back on their stop by themselves once enough time has passed since you last picked them up.

RUNS & STATS
The Runs timetable keeps every finished line, with the stops you visited, how many errands you finished, and how long it took. The departures board shows errands done this month, runs this month, your average run time and your most visited stop.

DESIGNED LIKE A METRO
Big signage type, platform-sign panels, and a route line with a moving train that runs through the whole app, from the bottom navigation to the end-of-run screen.

PRIVATE AND SIMPLE
No maps, no location permission, no ads. Sign in with email, Google or Apple to sync your stops across devices, or skip and ride as a guest. You can turn a guest ticket into an account later without losing anything. It works offline, and you can delete your account and all your data from Depot at any time.

Beblet: errands, sorted by the stop.

name: Before You Land
description:
Landing somewhere new? Before You Land tells you what's different from home: the plugs, the voltage, the time, the money, which side of the road they drive on, the emergency numbers and whether to tip.

Compared with home
Choose your home country once. Every destination then says what that means for you: "Adapter needed: Type G", "120 V here vs 230 V at home", "8 hours ahead of you", "They drive on the left, unlike at home".

One page per country
• Plugs and voltage, with drawings of each socket type
• A live local clock, and every time zone for big countries
• Current weather for the capital or another major city, plus typical highs, lows and rain for every month
• The currency and today's rate against yours, with a converter that works offline
• The country calling code, and emergency numbers you can call with one tap
• Driving side, tap water and tipping in restaurants, taxis and hotels

Packing lists
Make a list for each trip. It starts with the basics and adds what this destination needs: the right plug adapter, some local cash, a warm jacket if your dates are usually cold. Add your own items, tick them off, drag them into order and save a list as a template for next time.

Passport check
Add your passport's expiry date once (it stays on your phone) and choose your travel dates. The app checks the common 6-month rule and the Schengen area's rules, then opens the official entry requirements from your government (GOV.UK, the US State Department, Canada, Australia, New Zealand, Ireland or Hong Kong) or the IATA Travel Centre. It never guesses at visa rules.

English and 繁體中文
Switch between English and Traditional Chinese with one tap. Country names, tips, packing lists and dates switch too.

Works offline
Everything is on your phone except the current weather and rate updates, so it works on the plane and without roaming. The last rates are saved and dated.

Free and private
No account, no ads, no tracking. Your lists and passport dates never leave your phone.

Country facts come from open data and official sources, reviewed by hand. Rules change, so always check official sources before you travel.

name: Begad Food Terminal
seller_name: BEGAD GENERAL TRADING COMPANY MPANY L.L.C
description:
Begad Food Terminal is the order tablet for restaurants that sell on Begad Food in the UAE.

Install it on an iPad or iPhone in your kitchen, enter the pairing code Begad gives your restaurant, and keep it open on its charger:

• New orders ring loudly until someone accepts or rejects them
• Choose how many minutes the order needs, and mark it ready when it is
• See every order by status: New, Preparing, Ready and Done today
• Each order shows the dishes, options, customer notes, payment and total
• Go busy or close for new orders with one tap
• Print an order ticket with AirPrint
• English and Arabic

The app is for Begad Food partner restaurants. To become a partner, contact Begad at support@begad.ae.

name: Begla
description:
Keep the sounds that make a moment yours.

Begla is a personal sound journal for travelers, nature lovers, and anyone who wants to remember everyday life through sound.

Record rain by your window, waves from a trip, or the atmosphere of a favorite place. Add a photo cover, date, place, and notes to keep the story behind each sound.

• Record up to 10 minutes per memory.
• Revisit recordings in a visual monthly timeline.
• Search by title, place, or notes.
• Organize sounds into personal collections.
• Share a recording through the iOS share sheet, or export a collection as a ZIP sound pack—only when you choose. There is no public feed or social network.

Record, organize, and listen offline. No account required. Begla does not upload your recordings, notes, or covers to our servers. Your memories are stored in the app on your device; if you use iCloud Backup, your device backup settings may include app data. Save separate copies of recordings you want to preserve.

Please respect others' privacy and obtain any consent required when recording.

A little place for the sounds you want to keep.

name: Belcub Logs
description:
Kütüğün hacmini gözle tahmin etmek hem zaman alır hem de hataya açıktır. Belcub Logs bu işi sizin yerinize yapar.

Uygulamanın kalbinde hacim hesabı yer alır. Çapı ve boyu girmeniz yeterli; uygulama standart tablolara bakarak kütüğün hacmini anında hesaplar.

Yuvarlak kereste, silindire benzeyen bir gövdeye sahiptir ve hacmini çapla boy birlikte belirler. Bu yüzden iki ölçüyü de doğru girmek, güvenilir bir sonucun anahtarıdır.

Standart tablolar, sektörde yaygın olarak kullanılan ölçü ilişkilerine dayanır. Uygulama bu tabloları sizin için okur; hangi çap ve boyun hangi hacme karşılık geldiğini kafanızdan hesaplamak zorunda kalmazsınız.

Aynı çap ve boy her zaman aynı sonucu verir. Bu tutarlılık sayesinde yığınınızdaki her kütüğü aynı ölçüyle değerlendirirsiniz. Rakamlarınız birbirini tuttukça içiniz de rahat eder.

Hesapladığınız kütükleri partilere ayırın. Parti, birlikte fiyatlandırmak istediğiniz kütüklerden oluşan gruptur. Böylece kütükleri tek tek değil, anlamlı gruplar hâlinde yönetirsiniz.

Her partiye bir fiyat belirleyin. Tutarlar dolar ($) cinsinden gösterilir; bir partinin toplam değerini net biçimde görürsünüz.

Hazırladığınız her parti otomatik olarak kaydedilir. Bugün oluşturduğunuz bir partiye yarın ya da haftaya kaldığınız yerden devam edebilirsiniz.

Kayıtlı partileriniz, sizin dijital çalışma defterinizdir. Eski bir hesabı bulmak için dağınık notlar arasında kaybolmanıza gerek yok. Hangi partinin ne değerde olduğunu, dönüp baktığınızda hep aynı yerde bulursunuz.

Bir kereste işletmesinde çalışıyorsanız, yığınınızdaki kütüklerin hacmini ve değerini düzenli takip etmek size ciddi zaman kazandırır. Yığın büyüdükçe elle takip zorlaşır; hacim hesabını uygulamaya bıraktığınızda aklınız asıl işinize kalır.

Kereste ticareti yapıyorsanız, her alım ve satımda hacimle fiyatın aynı düzende kalması işinizi netleştirir. Elinizde net bir rakam olduğunda pazarlıkta çok daha rahat hareket edersiniz.

Belcub Logs ile hacim, parti ve fiyat tek bir uygulamada buluşur. Ayrı defterler, tablolar ve notlar yerine tek bir düzen vardır. Kafa karışıklığı azalır, işiniz sadeleşir.

Bir kütük, bir parti, bir fiyat. Hesap düzeninizin temeli bu üç parçadır.

İlk kütüğünüzü hemen bugün girin. Çapı, boyu ve hacmi görün; partinizi oluşturun, fiyatını yazın ve kaydedin.

name: Believers Corner
description:
Believers Corner is a home for Christian fellowship: your church, your Bible study group and your daily walk with God, all in one app.

FELLOWSHIP FEED
Share testimonies, prayer requests, encouragement and what God is doing in your life. Post text, photos and videos, comment on and save posts, and follow believers who inspire you.

SERMON SHORTS
Watch short, uplifting sermon clips and Christian videos in a full-screen feed. A quick word of encouragement whenever you need it.

YOUR CHURCH, CONNECTED
Find your church or set up a page for it. Church leaders can share announcements and upload sermons so members never miss a message, even when they can’t attend in person.

BIBLE STUDY GROUPS
Create or join study groups with friends, your cell group or your church family. Chat together, share voice notes and photos, and keep the conversation going between meetings.

PRIVATE MESSAGES
Message other believers one to one. Message requests keep your inbox in your control.

READ THE BIBLE
A built-in Bible reader lets you open any book and chapter, so Scripture is always a tap away.

STAY IN THE LOOP
Get notified when someone comments on your post, messages you, or when your church shares an announcement or a new sermon.

FIND YOUR PEOPLE
Search for believers, churches and groups. See connections and grow your circle of faith.

SAFE AND RESPECTFUL
Believers Corner is built for encouragement. You can report content, manage who can message you, and delete your account and data at any time from Settings.

Believers Corner is free to download and use.

Join a community that prays together, studies together and grows together.

name: Bellevue Montessori School
description:
The Bellevue Montessori School family admissions app keeps your child's admission in one place, from the first inquiry to the enrollment agreement.

See where you are
• A clear step-by-step journey for each child: inquiry, virtual conversation, parent tour, child visit, application, admissions offer and enrollment agreement.
• Always know what is needed from you next, and when it is the school's turn.

Book and manage visits
• Choose a time for your virtual conversation, parent tour or child's school visit from the times admissions has opened.
• See confirmed times in Pacific time, with the meeting link or arrival notes.
• Reschedule or cancel before the meeting starts.

Complete each step on your phone
• Tell us about your family, fill in the application, review and respond to an admissions offer, and sign the enrollment agreement.
• Notes from admissions appear right where you need them.

Stay informed
• Get a notification when admissions confirms a visit, returns your application, releases an offer or agreement, or shares news with families.

Simple and private
• Sign in with a one-time code sent to your email. No password to remember.
• The app is for parents and guardians. It has no ads and no tracking.
• You can ask to delete your account and data at any time, in the app or on the web.

The app is for families applying to Bellevue Montessori School. Admissions creates your account with the email you gave the school; use that email to sign in.

name: Besclim Auto
description:
Besclim Auto to aplikacja dla właścicieli samochodów, która pomaga oszacować, ile może kosztować naprawa uszkodzonej części, zanim pojedziesz do warsztatu.

Na początek wybierasz uszkodzoną część pojazdu. Następnie określasz, jak poważne jest uszkodzenie. Na tej podstawie aplikacja przygotowuje przedział kosztów naprawy w dolarach ($), więc wiesz, czego się spodziewać, zanim zadzwonisz do mechanika.

Wycena to coś więcej niż jedna kwota. Każdy wynik zawiera podział kosztów na części zamienne i robociznę, dzięki czemu widzisz, z czego składa się cena i które pozycje najbardziej wpływają na końcową sumę. Jeśli większość kosztów to zakup części, a nie godziny pracy, łatwiej porównasz oferty różnych warsztatów i zadasz konkretne pytania.

Do każdej naprawy aplikacja dołącza listę kontrolną. Znajdziesz w niej czynności i kontrole, które warto wykonać przed naprawą i po niej, żeby niczego nie przeoczyć. Lista pomaga też uporządkować rozmowę z mechanikiem – od razu widać, co zostało już sprawdzone, a co wymaga uwagi.

Zapisane wyceny i listy kontrolne są przechowywane na Twoim urządzeniu. Możesz do nich wrócić w dowolnej chwili, na przykład przy kolejnej wizycie w warsztacie albo porównując kilka napraw.

Besclim Auto powstała z myślą o kierowcach, którzy chcą wiedzieć więcej, niż usłyszą w warsztacie. Wybierz część, oceń uszkodzenie i sprawdź, czego możesz się spodziewać.

name: Best Spades Scorekeeper
description:
Spades Score is the easiest way to keep score when you play the card game Spades. No pencil, no arguments, no math.

BID, THEN SCORE
Before each hand, type everyone's bid in order around the table: a number, Nil, or Blind Nil when allowed. Everyone sharing the game sees the bids during play. Afterward, type the tricks each player took. "All the rest" gives the current player whatever is left, and the app checks that the count adds up.

SCORING DONE FOR YOU
Making your bid scores 10 a trick bid, plus 1 for each extra trick (a bag). Coming up short loses 10 a trick bid. Collect 10 bags and take the 100-point penalty, with leftover bags carried over. Nil is worth plus or minus 100 and Blind Nil plus or minus 200. A Nil bidder's tricks count as bags, not toward their partner's bid.

WHO DEALS
Every hand shows the dealer and who bids first and leads. The deal moves left each hand.

PARTNERS OR CUTTHROAT
Play with 2, 3, 4 or 6 players. With 4 players choose two partnerships or everyone for themselves. With 6 players, play three partnerships with two decks. Partners sit across from each other, and teams can have names.

CELEBRATIONS
Full-screen animations for a made Nil and Blind Nil, a Boston (all 13 spades), and getting Bagged. Confetti for the winner.

YOUR HOUSE RULES
Set the target score (500 by default), the bag penalty, Blind Nil, and whether the game ends at minus 200.

REMEMBERS YOUR PLAYERS
Everyone you add is saved for next time, with a win-loss record and the Nils they've bid and made. Both partners get the win. Reset records whenever you start a new season, and restore them if you change your mind.

RULES TAB
A quick reference for 2, 3, 4 and 6 players, the full rules, scoring examples and common house rules.

GAME NIGHT EXTRAS
Add where you played, with a map and directions. Add photos from your library or camera. Play music from Apple Music, or open a Spotify or Apple Music playlist in one tap.

SHARE A GAME
Invite other players through iCloud so they can follow the score live on their own iPhone or iPad.

BUILT FOR IPHONE AND IPAD
Your games and players sync across your devices with iCloud. No accounts, no ads, no tracking.

name: Bewujuk
description:
Bewujuk is a local lock-screen wallpaper studio. Photograph a wall or choose a photo, place the subject under a live clock, then save a lock and home pair on this device.

Live preview, shifting the still, clock templates, and tone never use a credit. Saving a lock and home pair uses 1 credit. Credits stay on this device. Erase All Data removes every wall pair, draft, remaining credit and the agreement from this device.

Camera is used when you tap Photograph a wall. Photos is used when you tap Choose a photo. Microphone is used when you tap Speak a tone so a spoken line such as cooler morning can be written onto the still. Bewujuk does not send your photos off the device.

Notifications may be asked once after you agree. Bewujuk sends no notifications of its own.
