name: Beyond Average
description:
Beyond Average puts your studio's AI agent in your pocket. It's the same agent you use in the Beyond Average desktop apps and on the web, built for game creators, so every chat follows you from your PC to your phone and back.

CHAT WITH YOUR AGENT
• Ask for scripts, systems, game ideas, balancing and fixes, with code you can copy or share.
• Pick the model and how hard it thinks (Quick, Balanced or Deep), turn on web search, and run your saved skills.
• Attach photos and files, queue follow-ups while a reply is running, and stop it any time.
• Long-press any message to copy, share, regenerate, read it aloud, or edit and resend.

RUN IT ON YOUR PC
• Pair your computer once with a matching code, then choose "Run on" in any chat.
• The agent works in your real project folders on your PC while you're away from your desk.
• Every change asks first: Allow once, Always allow, or Deny, right on your phone.
• You stay in control: revoke this phone or forget a PC at any time.

NEVER MISS A REPLY
• Notifications when a reply, task or scheduled run finishes, with quiet hours and an "only when I'm away" option.
• An inbox for everything that happened while you were gone.

MADE FOR YOUR PHONE AND IPAD
• Two columns on iPad, swipe actions, search across your chats, and offline copies of recent chats.
• Optional Face ID or passcode lock, hidden in the app switcher.

A Beyond Average account is required. Plans and credits are managed on beyondaverage.io.

name: Bhagavad Gita: Gita You Live
description:
Read the complete Bhagavad Gita and understand the conversation between Krishna and Arjuna, with Sanskrit verses, English translation, Hindi and English explanations, and audio for every passage.

START WITH A CLEAR PATH
Browse all 18 chapters in four reading groups. Open a section to see its context, then read or listen from its first verse. Begin with Arjuna’s crisis, or go directly to Krishna’s main teaching at 2.11. Scene-setting, questions and teachings are identified so you can follow the whole conversation.

READ AND UNDERSTAND
• Original Sanskrit alongside Annie Besant’s historical English translation.
• Original editorial explanations in English and Hindi.
• Search verses, meanings and references, save passages and resume your reading place.
• Chapter introductions, section guides and a glossary of key terms.
• The complete text is included for offline reading.

LISTEN IN YOUR CHOSEN LANGUAGE
Hear the Sanskrit verse first, followed by its English translation and explanation, or a Hindi explanation. Choose a narration voice, change playback speed and set a sleep timer. Download chapters for offline listening and use background or lock-screen playback. Audio recordings download separately from the app.

BRING A TEACHING INTO YOUR DAY
Explore practical guidance for overthinking, anger, distraction, self-criticism, unnoticed effort and changed plans. Try the free seven-practice journey on difficult conversations. Keep a small action, return for a check-in and write a private reflection.

FREE CORE, OPTIONAL COURSE
The complete reader, chapter guides, listening, downloads, introductory journey and private notes are free. Working with uncertainty is an optional fourteen-practice course: the first practice is free, with a one-time purchase for the rest. There is no subscription.

YOUR OWN SPACE
No advertisements or app account required. Notes, bookmarks and progress stay on your iPhone. Export your writing when you choose.

ABOUT THIS EDITION
This app follows the 1922 fourth edition of Annie Besant’s translation, including Arjuna’s additional opening question in chapter 13: 701 source-numbered passages, where many editions count 700. Sanskrit, historical translation and contemporary editorial explanations are labelled separately. Narration uses generated recordings; the explanations and pronunciation await independent expert review.

App menus and controls are in English. Hindi is available for verse explanations and narration.

Support: https://gita.meldorigins.com/support/
Privacy: https://gita.meldorigins.com/privacy/

name: Bidpocket: Quotes & Invoices
description:
Bidpocket makes estimates and invoices on your iPhone. Describe a job out loud and Bidpocket fills in quote lines, priced from the items and rates in your own price book.

• Estimates and invoices, built line by line or by voice
• Your price book: save items and rates once, reuse them on every document
• One tap turns an estimate into an invoice, with every line copied
• PDF in Letter or A4, sent with the share sheet or your email app
• Add clients from your contacts, one at a time
• Track Unpaid, Paid and Overdue, with optional reminders that go only to you
• CSV export and Export all PDFs, free in every plan
• No account. Your documents are stored on this iPhone.

Free: drafts, voice, price book, estimate-to-invoice, status, CSV and Export all PDFs, plus re-sharing or printing any document you have already shared. Send 3 new documents each calendar month.

Bidpocket Pro is a yearly auto-renewing subscription: unlimited new documents, your logo, and no "Made with" line. Free trial for eligible new subscribers.

Sending more than 3 new documents a month requires Pro. Voice capture works on supported iPhones.

Payment is charged to your Apple Account. The subscription renews automatically unless cancelled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period (or trial). Manage or cancel in Settings › your name › Subscriptions.

Terms of Use (Apple standard EULA): https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/
Privacy Policy: https://bidpocketapp.com/privacy/

Bidpocket makes estimates and invoices from what you enter. It doesn't give tax, legal or accounting advice, doesn't work out what tax you owe, and doesn't check that your documents meet the rules where you or your clients are. Some places require specific invoice details or electronic invoicing; ask a tax professional. Bidpocket doesn't process, hold or send payments.

name: Birdaboo: Pet Bird ID & Care
description:
Meet Birdaboo, the pocket companion for pet bird owners. Point your camera at any bird and Birdaboo identifies the species and its colour mutation in seconds — from budgies and cockatiels to lovebirds and African greys.

When the bird is one of the 20 species in the Library, its result opens a care card: diet, cage setup, temperature, and the early signs of illness to watch for, written for each species.

Keep every bird's profile in My Birds: name, hatch date, sex, mutation, photos and notes. Everything syncs to your account, so your flock follows you to a new phone.

Browse the Library of popular pet bird species — no account needed.

Birdaboo works in English and Arabic, with full right-to-left support.

A free account is needed to scan, because each identification uses a paid AI service. You get 5 scans a day, free. Scan photos are sent only to identify your bird and are not kept on our servers. When a bird is found, a copy stays on your phone in your scan history, and you can remove it at any time. You can delete your account at any time in Settings.

name: BizJumper
description:
BizJumper is the marketplace for sport horses: one place to look for the right horse and to present your own, with complete profiles and international visibility.

BizJumper takes no commission on the sale: sellers and buyers talk to each other directly.

FIND THE RIGHT HORSE
• Show jumping, dressage, eventing, ponies, foals and young horses
• Filters for type, discipline, level, age, sex, budget and location
• Grid or map view, to find horses near you
• Complete profiles: photos, videos, stud book, height, level and passport
• Save your favourites and find them whenever you want

PRESENT YOUR HORSE
• Create a listing in a few steps, with photos and videos from your phone
• Pick your stable's location on the map
• All your listings on one page, to update or close when the horse is sold
• Dealer account for those who work with many horses

ALWAYS UP TO DATE
• Notifications when your listing is approved
• Reminders to keep your open listings up to date
• Available in Italian, English and French

You can delete your account at any time from your profile.

name: Blind Putt
description:
It's golf, except you can't see the course.

Every green hides a few things: rocks, ramps, sand, water, and the cup. You putt from a number on the edge and the game tells you one thing, where the ball came out. A rock sends it straight back. A ramp turns it. Sand stops it cold. Water costs you a stroke and tells you nothing, which is rude but fair.

From those exits you work out what's on the green, place your guesses, cross off the empty squares, and find a way into the cup. Fewer strokes wins. If your map of the green is right when the ball drops, you get a stroke back.

HOW IT PLAYS
• Tap a number to putt. Every putt is a stroke
• Map the green with pieces from the tray, and cross off what you've ruled out
• Par 3, 4 and 5 greens, from Easy to Expert
• Perfect Map: get the whole green right and take a stroke off

TOURNAMENT
• Nine holes, par 36, getting harder as you go
• Pick a perk before hole 1, after hole 3 and after hole 6
• Twelve perks, from a free practice swing to a Yardage Book that counts every square the ball rolled
• Your last 50 scorecards are kept

DAILY HOLE
• One green a day, the same for everyone
• One try. No practice round, no peeking

SHARE A COURSE
Every round and every hole has a short code. Send it to a friend and they play the exact same greens, so there's no arguing about who got the easy one.

NO NONSENSE
No ads, no accounts, no internet needed. Nothing about you leaves your phone. The whole game is free.

name: BLOCK COUNT · FORM
description:
Look closer. Count further.

BLOCK COUNT · FORM is a spatial puzzle about counting blocks in rotating 3D structures. Look for hidden blocks, repetition, symmetry and layers to discover the answer.

• 100 puzzles, from simple patterns to complex reasoning
• 10 extreme EX puzzles unlocked after clearing all regular puzzles
• A complete rotation every 12 seconds
• Block-by-block counting, patterns and formulas after each correct answer
• A one-time first-attempt record and separate practice best times
• Share the same puzzle and your time through KakaoTalk
• Korean, English, Japanese and Simplified Chinese

Each wrong answer adds five seconds to your time. Leaving a first attempt means later attempts are recorded as practice.

Hold up to five tickets. Starting a challenge uses one; finishing without a wrong answer returns it. After tickets are spent, they refill to five after 30 minutes. Optional rewarded ads can also refill tickets.

No account is required. Progress and records are stored on your device. Try the free 34-block sample without recording a score.

name: Bluinzwelt
description:
Bluinzwelt is a quiet notebook for birders who want their own record—not another social feed.

REAL-WORLD USE
• After a walk or balcony watch: species, when, where, how many, optional condition tags, and a short note—on your phone only
• One spot, many birds: timed sit counts while you stay put and log species as they appear
• Patch memory: each place keeps species seen there, sit sessions, and what’s new at that spot this year
• Life list lite: species list builds from your records; target species show “Seen” when you log a match

name: Böcek Ligi: Penaltı Düellosu
description:
Böcek Ligi'ne hoş geldin! Gece stadyumu dolu, tribünde binlerce böcek, ortada sen ve kaleci.

KAYDIR VUR: Parmağını kaleye doğru kaydır; kaydırdığın yer topun gittiği yerdir. Hızlı kaydır, sert vur. Kaleci yem verirse sen de duraksa, son anda köşeyi değiştir.
DOKUN UZAN: Kalecisin! Topun geleceği köşeye dokun, top gelirken bir kez daha dokun ve parmak ucuyla çıkar.
LAF SOKAN BÖCEKLER: Her gol, her kurtarış, her direk bir atışma. Rakibin sana güler, sen ona; istersen susturursun.
DÖRT EFSANE KALECİ: Baba, Diva, Okuyucu ve Duvar. Her birinin huyu ayrı: biri hep aynı tarafa yem verir, biri en çok vurduğun köşeyi ezberler.
BÖCEK KUPASI: Mahalle'den Süper Kupa'ya 20 maç, maç başına 3 yıldız. Günlük görev, seri, çöp poşeti ve dolap: top izleri, füze görünümleri, gol sevinçleri.
Son Kaçıran Kaybeder ve Mutfak Antrenmanı modları, dram tekrarı ve paylaşılabilir 9:16 klip.

İnternetsiz oynanır. Hesap yok, reklam yok, veri toplanmaz.

name: Bomonti Farm
seller_name: MONOTEKS TEKSTIL SANAYI VE TICARET LIMITED SIRKETI
description:
Bomonti Farm, Kırklareli'deki Bomonti Hayvancılık'ın çevresinde geçen, çok oyunculu bir süt çiftliği oyunudur. Boş bir parsel ve bir miktar sermayeyle başlarsın; hedef 5.000 sağmal inek.

Zincirleme bir çiftlik
• İlk küçük ahırını kur, ilk ineklerini al, sütünü köy toplayıcısına sat.
• Soğutma tankıyla kooperatife, büyüdükçe fabrikaya ve primli sözleşmelere geç.
• Tarla al; yonca, mısır ve hasıl ek; silajını ve kuru otunu kendin üret.
• Gübre, yem, sağımhane, ekip ve maaşlar: her halka bir sonrakini açar.

Canlı bir dünya
• Her dünyada 100 çiftlik aynı takvimde yaşar. Dünya saati durmaz: bir oyun günü 10 dakika sürer, sen yokken de çiftliğin çalışır.
• Boş parseli yalnız sınır komşusu alabilir: erken gelen ve hızlı büyüyen en iyi toprağı kapar.
• Komşu çiftlikleri haritada gör, tarlanı ilana çıkar, sıralamada yerini al.

Gerçekçi ve adil
• Sürüdeki her inek tek tek izlenir: laktasyon, gebelik, verim, sağlık.
• Bomonti'nin haftalık damızlık kontenjanı için diğer oyuncularla yarışırsın.
• Bütün hesaplar sunucuda yapılır; hile yapılamaz.

Hasan Usta eğitimde sana adım adım eşlik eder. Oyun ücretsizdir; reklam ve uygulama içi satın alma yoktur.

name: Braver: Social Confidence
description:
You know what you want to say. Then the moment comes and you go quiet.

Braver is a daily workout for social confidence. One small real-world quest a day, short lessons that explain why your mind goes blank, and voice training that shows you how you actually sound. Small reps, most days, until talking to people feels normal.

One quest a day
Every day you get one real-world quest, sized to where you are right now. Ask someone what they would order. Hold eye contact a beat longer. Explain something you know well in under a minute. After each one you tell Braver how it felt, and the next quests get bigger or smaller to match. A stretch, never a panic. Not feeling today's one? Swap it.

64 lessons in 4 courses
Each lesson takes 3 minutes or less. You read a little, then pick what you would say in a real situation and see how it lands.
- Foundations: why you go quiet, and how to stop
- Conversation Skills: starting, keeping it going, listening, groups and exits
- Dating & Relationships: approaching, flirting without cringe, from chat to date
- Life & Status: body language, voice, being taken seriously, charisma
Every chapter ends with a real-world mission.

Voice training
Talk out loud and get a score for clarity, confidence, structure and engagement, plus one thing that worked and one thing to try next time.
- Steady pace: stay between 120 and 160 words a minute
- No fillers: drop "like", "you know" and "basically"
- Fill the room: speak up and hold it
- Free talk: draw a card and talk for one minute
Braver uses your phone's speech recognition to turn what you say into text. It never records, stores or uploads your audio. To write your feedback, the text of your practice may be sent to an AI model. Voice training works in English.

Your confidence card
Every quest, lesson and drill adds XP to four stats: confidence, approachability, charisma and flirting. Level up and your card goes from Bronze to Silver, Gold and finally Holographic. Share it when you are proud of it.

Streaks that forgive
Show up and your streak grows. Miss a day and a streak freeze covers it. A week in a row earns you another freeze.

A proof log
Every quest and mission you finish lands in your proof log. On a bad day, read the list. That is you, doing the thing.

Meet Bravo
Bravo the lion starts as a cub. His mane grows through five stages as you level up. If you want, he sends one reminder a day, and he learns the hour you actually show up.

Made for you if
- You go quiet in groups
- You overthink every conversation, before and after
- You freeze around people you find attractive
- You want to be taken seriously at school or work

No sign-up needed
Just open it and start. Sign in with your email only if you want your progress on a new phone. You can delete your account and data from the You tab at any time.

Free first day, then Braver Pro
Your first day is free, with everything unlocked. From day two Braver needs a Braver Pro subscription: yearly with a 3-day free trial, or weekly. Prices vary by region and are shown in the app before you buy. Payment is charged to your Apple Account when you confirm the purchase, or when the free trial ends. Subscriptions renew automatically unless you cancel at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. You can manage or cancel your subscription in your App Store account settings.

Braver is a self-improvement tool, not therapy or medical care.

Terms of use: https://getbraver.lol/terms
Privacy policy: https://getbraver.lol/privacy

name: Brivoxen
description:
• Save a flight with total rise, number of risers, and available run
• Divide the rise into equal risers
• Treat treads as one fewer than risers and divide the run across them
• Show the single-step diagonal and the whole-flight stringer as a hypotenuse
• Report 2 × riser + tread against the common 24–25 inch rule of thumb
• Run riser, tread, and stringer math without saving a flight
• Erase the local file from the manual

name: CabinWork
description:
CabinWork puts your upcoming video meetings on your car's screen, ready to join with one tap while you are parked.

HOW IT WORKS
1. Open cabinwork.app in your car's browser. It shows a code.
2. Scan the code with CabinWork on your iPhone and allow calendar access.
3. Your meetings for the next 7 days that have a video link appear on the car's screen. CabinWork updates them in the background while the app stays open or in the background.

WHAT YOU GET
• Your next meeting front and center on the car's screen, with a large Join button
• Works with Google Meet, Zoom, Microsoft Teams and other common meeting links
• Every calendar already on your iPhone: work, personal and school
• Join from this phone: take the same meeting on your iPhone when you want its camera and microphone
• Light and dark appearance that follows your car's display setting, where the car's browser reports it

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
• The only calendar details that leave your phone are the title, time and video link of meetings. Notes, guest lists, locations and events without a video link stay on your iPhone.
• Your meeting list is stored encrypted, replaced on every sync, and deleted when you disconnect.
• No account, no ads, no analytics, no tracking.

TIPS
Optional tips are in-app purchases that help cover what it costs to run CabinWork. They unlock nothing.

WHERE IT WORKS
CabinWork runs in your car's built-in web browser. It was built and tested first in a Tesla; other cars with a full browser may work, and compatibility varies by vehicle and software version. Your meeting provider's own site handles the call, including camera and microphone.

PARKED USE ONLY
Join meetings only while parked. Never use video or interact with the car's screen while driving.

CabinWork is published by Zimmerman Legacy Holdings, LLC and is not affiliated with Tesla or any meeting provider.

name: CampfireBreak
description:
A quiet moment by the fire, on your iPhone or iPad.

Light a campfire in a pine forest and listen to the wood crackle. Watch the flames flicker as the logs char and gradually turn to glowing embers and ash. Put it on while you read, wind down for the evening, or take a break between tasks.

• Watch flames and embers rendered in real time.
• Choose a burn time of 15 minutes, 30 minutes, 1 hour, 2 hours, or 4 hours.
• Tap the scene to hide the controls and enjoy a full-screen view.
• Keep the crackling sound on or mute it for a quiet fire.

Start with oak logs, a stone fire ring, and four ways to stack the wood. The optional Campfire Plus Pack is a one-time purchase that unlocks six additional backgrounds, including a moonlit lake and an aurora, plus five more wood types, eight more fire pits, and all flame colors.

name: CAPM Ace: Exam Prep 2026
description:
Pass the CAPM with a study plan that fits in your day. CAPM Ace turns the official exam outline into short lessons, exam-style practice and timed mock exams, so you always know what to study next and how ready you are.

BUILT AROUND THE REAL EXAM
• Covers all four domains of the current CAPM exam outline: Project Management Fundamentals (36%), Predictive Methods (17%), Agile Frameworks (20%) and Business Analysis (27%)
• Mock exams are weighted like the real test and timed at real exam pace, about 72 seconds per question

LEARN
• 16 bite-size lessons, 4 to 8 minutes each, with exam tips
• Clear explanations of the topics people miss: earned value, critical path, Scrum roles, requirements and stakeholders

PRACTICE
• 500+ original exam-style questions, each with an explanation
• Quick 10 sessions that bring up questions you haven't mastered yet
• Domain drills to work on your weak spots
• Mistake review that brings back every question you missed

MOCK EXAMS
• Mini mock (50 questions) and a full 150-question, 3-hour mock exam
• A pace coach tells you if you're ahead or behind
• Flag questions and jump around with the exam navigator
• Results broken down by domain, with a review of every miss

FLASHCARDS
• 94 key terms with spaced repetition
• Cards you miss come back sooner

FORMULA LAB
• EVM calculator: CV, SV, CPI, SPI, EAC, ETC, VAC and TCPI, with a plain-English reading
• PERT estimates, communication channels and a full formula sheet

TRACK YOUR READINESS
• Readiness score weighted by the exam outline
• Day streaks, accuracy by domain and an exam-day countdown
• Confetti and applause when you finish a lesson, quiz or mock exam

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
No account, no ads, no tracking. Your progress is saved only on your iPhone, and the app works offline.

FREE VS. CAPM ACE PRO
The free version includes 4 lessons, 20 practice questions, 25 flashcards and the Formula Lab. CAPM Ace Pro unlocks everything: all 16 lessons, all 500+ questions, mock exams, mistake review, all 94 flashcards and your readiness score.

SUBSCRIPTION DETAILS
CAPM Ace Pro is available as an auto-renewing subscription: $2.99 per month or $24.99 per year (prices may vary by country). Payment is charged to your Apple ID account when you confirm the purchase. The subscription renews automatically unless you cancel at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. Your account is charged for renewal within 24 hours before the end of the current period. You can manage or cancel your subscription in your App Store account settings.

DISCLAIMER
CAPM Ace is an independent study aid. It is not affiliated with, endorsed by, or sponsored by the Project Management Institute, Inc. (PMI). CAPM, PMP, PMBOK and PMI are registered marks of the Project Management Institute, Inc. All questions and study notes are original content. They are not actual exam questions.

name: Cardweave
description:
Cardweave designs tablet-woven bands and walks each pick on this iPhone.

You thread four holes on every card, set the forward or back slant, and group the turns into packs. The loom shows one repeat as a band, and marks a pack that needs to turn the other way. You can balance a pack so the twist comes back to zero.

Follow the weave one pick at a time. Each pick shows which way the cards turn, and the band grows from the fell. Stop anywhere and come back to the same pick.

A warp slip tells you how much yarn to cut for the length, fringe, and loom waste you enter. Share one repeat as a PDF or a picture.

Bands stay on this phone. There is no account and no sign-in.

name: Cardworthy: Card Value Scanner
description:
Cardworthy tells you what a trading card is worth and what to do with it: sell, grade or hold. Every price shows where it comes from and when it was updated. We never guess a number.

SCAN OR SEARCH
- Point the camera at a card or pick a photo. Most cards are read right on your iPhone with Apple's Vision framework, free and with no limit.
- Not sure which card it is? Cardworthy shows the closest matches instead of guessing.
- Search by name or card number at any time, no limit.

THE EXACT PRINTING, THEN THE PRICE
- The same card is often printed several ways: normal, holo, reverse holo, 1st Edition, promo. You confirm which one you have, because the price depends on it.
- Estimated market value from public market data via TCGdex, with the source and the update date next to it.
- A 7-day vs 30-day trend where the data has it.
- No data for a printing? The app says so instead of making up a figure.

SELL, GRADE OR HOLD
- A clear suggestion for every priced card, with the reason behind it.

YOUR COLLECTION, FREE AND UNLIMITED
- Add as many cards as you like. No account, no card limit.
- Saved on your iPhone and in your private iCloud.
- Total value in your currency, folders, sorting, condition, your own price and sold cards.
- Export everything to CSV.

CARDWORTHY PRO
- Condition estimate from a photo: a likely grade range with notes on corners, edges and surface, plus the grading math (what a graded copy must sell for to cover the fee).
- Portfolio history: a chart of your collection's value over time.
- Unlimited AI scans for cards your iPhone can't read on its own. Free users get 5 AI scans a day.

AI and privacy: a photo leaves your iPhone only when you ask for an AI scan or a condition estimate, and only after you agree. It goes to our server and Anthropic's Claude API, is not kept after the answer and is not used for training. AI only identifies the card or estimates its condition; it never sets a price.

Currently supports English-language Pokémon Trading Card Game cards.

Prices are estimated market values, not an appraisal or financial advice. Condition results are estimated, not an official grade.

Unofficial app. Not affiliated with or endorsed by any card publisher.

Subscription: Cardworthy Pro is available as a yearly subscription ($34.99 per year, with a 3-day free trial) or a monthly subscription ($5.99 per month). Prices may differ by country and are shown in the app before you buy. Payment is charged to your Apple Account at confirmation of purchase. The subscription renews automatically unless cancelled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. Manage or cancel it in your Apple Account settings. Any unused part of a free trial ends when you buy a subscription.

Privacy Policy: https://cassianvire.com/cardworthy/privacy/
Terms of Use: https://cassianvire.com/cardworthy/terms/

name: Carolado
description:
Carolado gets you to your destination with live traffic and reports from other drivers. No account needed. Carolado is run by a company from Austria on its own servers in the EU, with no ad tracking and no selling of your data.

NAVIGATION
• Choose from up to three routes, with turn-by-turn voice guidance and automatic rerouting
• Live traffic with delay times and faster alternatives
• Speed limit always in view, even when stopped, with an adjustable speed warning
• Information at every border: possible border checks, vignettes, tolls and the switch to left-hand traffic
• Avoid tolls and vignettes, motorways, ferries or unpaved roads
• Search sorted by driving time, with opening hours
• Home, work and favourites with your own names
• Street names in Latin script, even in countries with other scripts
• Portrait and landscape, light and dark
• Music controls right on the map

DRIVING TOGETHER
• Report crashes, traffic jams, hazards, roadworks and closures with a few taps
• "Still there?": drivers on site confirm or refute reports
• A trust system protects against false reports and bots
• Carolado learns detours around reported closures from community trips
• Map editor: suggest speed cameras, speed limits and closures, and others review them
• Friends: share your location with selected friends for one hour, one day or permanently, and navigate straight to them

SPEED CAMERAS AND POLICE
Carolado shows fixed speed cameras, section controls with your average speed, and police reports only in countries where this is legally allowed, for example not in Switzerland and Liechtenstein. What counts is your location. Where it is not allowed, the feature stays off. In Germany, drivers may not use such warnings while driving, so turn them off in the settings there.

TRUCKS AND ELECTRIC CARS
• Truck mode: routes based on weight, height, width, length, axle load and dangerous goods, warnings about narrow roads and truck toll information
• Breaks according to EU driving time rules at suitable rest areas, and break suggestions on long car trips
• Electric cars: charging stops based on battery, consumption, connector and provider, with state of charge on arrival and charging time

CAROLADO PREMIUM
• Offline maps for cities, regions and countries with speed cameras (where allowed), speed limits and search
• Navigation without network in downloaded areas
• Traffic forecast for your route and as a map layer with "When to leave?". It is built from community trips and grows with every trip. At first it is only available in a few areas.
• All colour themes and a custom colour for your route

Carolado Premium is an annual subscription. It renews automatically for one year unless you cancel it in your Apple Account settings at least 24 hours before it ends. Payment is charged to your Apple Account. The app shows the price in your currency before you subscribe.

PRIVACY
Without an account, Carolado only knows you by a random device ID. Only if you agree, trip points from your navigation contribute to traffic conditions and the traffic forecast. The start and end of every trip are never evaluated, and you can change your choice at any time in the settings. You can delete all your data yourself in the app.

In English and German. Maps and routes worldwide.

Privacy Policy: https://carolado.com/en/privacy

name: Çekim
description:
Çekim, namazdan yeni kalktığında elindeki tesbihi sayar.

Sabah, öğle, ikindi, akşam veya yatsıdan birini seç. Sübhanallah, Elhamdülillah ve Allahuekber sırayla gelir. Her cümle 33 tanedir. Yanlış bir tane geri alınır. Üç cümle bitince bu çekim sende kalır.

description:
Cep Kararı, karşı cinsten biriyle buluşmadan eve dönerken cebine giren tek nesneyi tutar.

Akşam o nesnenin adını, cebine nasıl geldiğini, üzerindeki satırı, sabaha bırakılan cümleyi, karşıdaki kişiyi, bu akşamın yerini ve randevu gününü yazarsın. name: Chaenggim: Warranty & Receipts
description:
"Is my fridge still under warranty?" "When did I last change the water filter?" Chaenggim remembers for you.

Chaenggim keeps your receipts and warranty cards as photos, and reminds you before a warranty ends and when a household filter or consumable is due.

■ How it works
1. Tap [+] and choose Receipt, Warranty or Supply
2. Snap a receipt — the total, date and store are filled in for you
3. Snap a warranty card — the purchase date is read, pick the warranty length and the end date is calculated
4. Pick a supply like a water filter or AC filter and set how often to replace it

■ Why you'll like it
• Monthly spending: collect receipts and see this month and last month at a glance (no complicated budgeting)
• Warranty reminders: get notified 7, 14, 30 or 60 days before a warranty ends, with the receipt photo ready for repairs
• Replacement reminders: water filter, AC filter, air purifier filter, shower filter, toothbrush, smoke alarm battery and more
• Save a receipt and its warranty in one go
• Big text, big buttons, simple screens. Korean and English

■ Your records stay on your phone
• No sign-up, no servers — photos and records are never uploaded
• Text recognition runs on your phone, even offline
• Only two permissions: camera and notifications

■ Good to know
• Text recognition isn't perfect. Please check what was read
• Deleting the app deletes your records. Make a backup file before switching phones

■ Free and lifetime purchase
• Free: unlimited receipts, up to 10 warranties and 5 supplies, all reminders, loading backup files. One banner ad on the "Saved" screen
• Lifetime purchase (one-time payment): unlimited warranties and supplies, make backup files (move to a new phone), export to Excel, monthly totals by store, no ads

Contact: help@morup.kr

name: Chain Pop: Chain Reaction
description:
Line them up. Tap POP. Watch the whole board go up in one glorious chain reaction.

Chain Pop is a bright, satisfying puzzle game about setting up the perfect pop. Slide balloons around the board, then tap POP: the glowing corner balloon bursts and fires the way its arrow points. Every balloon it hits bursts and fires too, and touching balloons of the same colour pop together. Get it right and a single tap clears the entire board in an explosion of light, sparkles and fireworks.

EASY TO LEARN, HARD TO MASTER
• 294 hand-checked puzzles, every one guaranteed solvable
• Start with gentle 3×3 boards, grow into 4×4 and packed 5×5 brain-teasers
• Earn up to three stars by clearing each board in as few tries as possible

EXTREME MODE
Beat the main game and unlock Extreme: full boards with no gaps, where you shift whole rows and columns and balloons wrap around the edges. 40 fiendish puzzles for true chain masters.

DAZZLING SKINS
Earn coins as you play and unlock stunning balloon styles: glowing Neon, oil-slick Chromatic, sparkling Gemstone and the legendary Galaxy, with a swirling galaxy inside every balloon.

PLAY YOUR WAY
• A free daily gift of coins and hints that grows every day you come back
• Stuck? A hint shows you the next move
• No timers, no lives: relax and play at your own pace
• Game Center leaderboards and achievements

Free to play, with optional ads and in-app purchases for hint packs and removing ads.

name: Cheats & Map by GTA-Cheat.com

Cheats & Map is the unofficial companion app of gta-cheat.com, the fan site dedicated to Grand Theft Auto news, maps and cheat codes.

PICK YOUR GAME
Choose your version of the game — GTA 6, GTA 5, GTA Online, GTA 4, San Andreas, Vice City, GTA 3, GTA 2 or GTA 1 — and the whole app adapts.

name: Checkmate Garden
description:
Play chess, solve a puzzle every day, and watch your garden grow.

PLAY THE AI
Five opponents, from Seedling (just learning the moves) to Grandmaster Tree (strong and patient). Hints and take-backs are there when you want them.

A PUZZLE EVERY DAY
365 puzzles from the Lichess puzzle database, each checked with Stockfish: easy at the start of the week, harder toward the weekend. Keep your streak, share your stars without spoilers, and replay the archive.

GROW YOUR GARDEN
Wins and solved puzzles earn seeds. Plant them to unlock new boards: Garden Stone, Night Bloom and Paper & Ink.

CHALLENGE A FRIEND
Turn any position into a link or a short code. Your friend plays it from the exact same spot.

PLAY ONLINE
Live games with a clock (3+2 to 15+10) or turn-based games at your own pace, against players around the world through Game Center.

MADE FOR EVERYONE

name: Chiến Binh Giữ Làng
description:
Yêu ma tràn về, cổng làng lung lay. Nổi trống trận lên và dẫn dân làng đội nón lá đi đánh đuổi yêu quái trong game chiến thuật thả quân đậm chất truyền thuyết Việt!

DỄ CHƠI, KHÓ GIỎI
• Thóc tự về theo thời gian. Chạm thẻ bài để gọi quân, quân tự tiến lên giao chiến.
• Nâng Ruộng ngay giữa trận để thóc về nhanh hơn. Ruộng lên cấp, cổng làng cũng đổi dáng theo.
• Phá hang quỷ để thắng. Để cổng làng vỡ là thua.
• Hiệu lệnh THỦ / CÔNG: gom quân trước cổng rồi xung phong một lượt, hoặc kéo cả đội né chiêu của trùm.

11 CHIẾN BINH, MỖI NGƯỜI MỘT NGHỀ
Dân Binh, Cung Thủ, Khiên Binh, Nỏ Thần, Thầy Lang, Kỵ Binh, Thần Công, Thầy Pháp, Voi Chiến… cùng hai huyền thoại: Rồng Lửa uốn lượn trên không phun lửa thiêu cả hàng địch, và Thánh Gióng cưỡi ngựa sắt vung tre ngà quét sạch quân thù.

30 MÀN, 3 CHƯƠNG, 5 CON TRÙM
Từ Đồng Lúa Đầu Làng, Luỹ Tre Xanh tới Biển Đông Dậy Sóng và Quỷ Thành Núi Lửa. Đối đầu Mộc Tinh, Hồ Tinh, Ngư Tinh, Xà Tinh và Quỷ Vương, mỗi con trùm một bộ chiêu riêng.

TRẬN NÀO CŨNG CÓ CHUYỆN
• Chim Lạc mang quà bay ngang trời: chạm trúng để nhận thóc, vàng hoặc thuốc hồi sức.
• Liên hoàn: hạ địch dồn dập để được thưởng thêm vàng.
• Mỗi đợt tấn công có một đầu lĩnh đội vương miện dẫn đầu. Hạ nó là có thưởng lớn.
• Tử thủ: cổng làng nguy cấp thì mõ làng báo động, dân làng tiếp thóc cứu viện.
• Ba sao mỗi màn, rương sao, quà hằng ngày và kỷ lục thời gian để quay lại phá.

DOANH TRẠI
Dùng vàng nâng cấp từng chiến binh, cổng làng và kho thóc. Xếp đội hình 5 thẻ cho hợp từng màn, tra sổ tay yêu quái để biết mặt từng loại địch.

ĐẬM CHẤT VIỆT
Nón lá, luỹ tre, cổng làng, trống trận; nhạc ngũ cung với tiếng đàn, sáo, trống, cồng. Toàn bộ hình ảnh và âm nhạc được làm riêng cho game.

• Chơi được khi không có mạng.
• Miễn phí, không có mua hàng trong ứng dụng. Game có quảng cáo; quảng cáo có thưởng là tuỳ bạn chọn xem để nhận thêm vàng, nhân đôi phần thưởng hoặc hồi sinh.

name: Chinese Sudoku: Hanzi Puzzle
description:
Chinese Sudoku turns the classic number puzzle into a fun way to learn Chinese characters.

Instead of digits 1–9, each puzzle uses Chinese characters like 一, 二, 三. Tap any character to hear its pronunciation and see its pinyin and meaning. Before long you'll recognise them without thinking.

GAME MODES
• Classic Sudoku in 4x4, 6x6, 8x8 and 9x9 grids – perfect for beginners and experts
• X-Sudoku with extra diagonal rules
• Survival mode – race the clock and keep your run alive
• Daily Challenge – a new puzzle every day, with streaks to keep you coming back

LEARN AS YOU PLAY
• Audio pronunciation for every character
• Pinyin and English meaning helpers
• Themed character packs: Nature, Animals, Colours, Food, Body, Directions, Verbs and more
• Character quizzes to test what you've learned

MORE TO ENJOY
• Earn coins, unlock packs and premium themes
• Track your stats and weekly leaderboard
• Hints and error checks when you get stuck

Whether you're learning Mandarin or just love Sudoku, Chinese Sudoku is a relaxing way to train your brain and build your vocabulary – one puzzle at a time.

name: Chords to Midi by DHC Beats
description:
Your chords. Your next track.

Chords to MIDI Pro brings a focused Chord Studio and practical audio tools to music and beat producers. Build a progression, hear it instantly and export the notes as MIDI for your DAW.

CHORD STUDIO
• Four editable chords with major, minor and diminished triads
• 24 playing styles, from piano and ensemble to Hip-Hop, Cloud Rap, Afrobeat and Dance
• Harmonic dice with curated chord progressions
• Instrument previews with piano, guitar, strings, short brass and synth
• Adjustable tempo, looping and a visual piano roll
• Standard MIDI export without sample audio

YOUR AUDIO TOOLS
• Chord Detector (Beta): view estimated chords with time sections, correct them and assign them to the Studio
• BPM & Key: estimate tempo and key from local audio files
• Pre-Delay & Decay: calculate tempo-matched reverb times and copy values

FOR IPHONE, IPAD AND MAC
An interface adapted to each device. English and German. Local processing without an account or server. Buy once and use every feature, without subscriptions or in-app purchases.

Import audio files up to 50 MB and 3 minutes. Audio analysis provides estimates and may differ with complex songs. MIDI contains notes; choose your sound in your DAW.

name: Choreline: Private Chores
description:
No ads ever. No data tracking. No account creation.

Choreline keeps the housework from sneaking up on you. Give each chore a rhythm (every 3 days, every 2 weeks, every 3 months) and Choreline shows what's late, what's due today and what's coming this week, room by room.

SHORT ON TIME?
Tap "I have time", pick 15, 30 or 60 minutes, and Choreline builds a plan from your most overdue chores that actually fits. Tick them off as you go.

SMART ABOUT "LATE"
• Two days late on a daily chore matters more than two days late on a quarterly one, so the list is ranked that way
• Mark a chore done and its next date moves on by itself
• Skip a round without pretending you did it
• Undo, in case your thumb slipped

AWAY MODE
Going on holiday? Turn on Away mode. When you're back, every due date shifts by the days you were gone, so you don't come home to a wall of "late".

ORGANIZED YOUR WAY
• Rooms with icons, in the order you walk through your home
• Effort for every chore: 5, 15, 30 or 60 minutes
• History for each chore
• Optional sample home to get started in seconds

ONE GENTLE REMINDER
Turn on a daily reminder at the time you pick. It only appears on days when something is due.

YOUR DATA, YOUR COPY
• Back up everything to one file, saved wherever you like through Files: iCloud Drive, another file provider or your device
• Optional passphrase protection (AES-256)
• Export your chores as a CSV spreadsheet
• Optional App lock with Face ID, Touch ID or your iPhone passcode

FAIR PRICING
• Free for 7 days with every feature
• Then a single $1.99 in-app purchase unlocks it for good. No subscription, ever
• If you don't buy, nothing is held hostage: you can still see everything, export it and back it up

PRIVACY, PLAINLY
• No account, sign-in or email
• No ads, analytics, crash reporting or tracking SDKs
• No app networking code; Apple handles the optional purchase
• Your home stays in the app's private storage on your phone

Choreline is for one household manager. There's no sharing between phones.

Made by Southwest Blueprints with AI assistance.

name: ChunoCue
description:
ChunoCue te ayuda a planificar la producción tradicional de ch'uño en el altiplano andino. Usa el clima, el tamaño del lote y el tipo de proceso para decidir cuándo empezar, cuánta papa procesar y qué resultado puedes esperar.

Qué puedes hacer

• Ventana climática
Registra temperatura nocturna, día, humedad y sol. La app indica si es buen momento para iniciar el tendal.

• Ciclo de proceso
Estima noches de congelado, días de secado y posibles atrasos por mal clima.

• Escala del lote
Con el peso y el tamaño de la papa calcula el área de tendal, la capacidad del lote y el producto estimado.

• Plan negro o blanco
Compara el ch'uño negro con la tunta o moraya: pasos de congelado, remojo, prensado y secado.

• Pérdidas y rendimiento
Guarda papa inicial y producto final. Compara el rendimiento por temporada, clima y proceso.

Para quién es
Productores, familias y comunidades que elaboran ch'uño con frío nocturno y sol del día, no con secado industrial.

Por qué ayuda
Menos duda al empezar, mejor uso del espacio y más claridad sobre atrasos y pérdidas.

ChunoCue: frío de noche, sol de día, mejor planificación.

name: Church Remote
description:
Your equipment. One remote.

Church Remote brings your church’s AV equipment together on iPhone and iPad. Find supported devices on your local network, open their controls, and keep the equipment you use organized by room.

PLAYLISTER
Find compatible Apple TVs running Playlister and open their local web remotes.

PROPRESENTER
Browse playlists, libraries, presentations, and slide thumbnails. Tap a slide to show it, move forward or back, control presentation media, and clear presentation layers. See the current live slide while browsing your presentation.

COMPANION
Find Bitfocus Companion and open its official Web Buttons page directly. Use your configured buttons, labels, colors, and live feedback, and choose visible pages and layout with the configuration gear. No emulator is required.

X32
Select an input channel from 1–32, read its fader level, and raise or lower the volume in small steps.

SAVED WEB PORTALS
Save a local equipment page, give it a useful name, and assign it to a room. Each portal stays on its saved equipment address. Public websites and off-equipment navigation are blocked.

KEEP YOUR PLACE
Switch between devices without starting over while the app remains open. Keep your ProPresenter presentation, Companion Web Buttons view, and X32 channel ready to return to. Memory pressure or restarting the app can reset navigation sessions.

KNOW WHAT’S AVAILABLE
See reachable devices, check connections, and keep offline equipment in your saved list with its last known information. Search by device or room, mark favorites, and rename equipment to match your space. Availability reflects the control connection; it does not independently confirm physical power state.

BUILT FOR YOUR LOCAL NETWORK
Church Remote connects directly to your equipment. No Church Remote account is required. Device names and history are saved on your device, and full saved portal addresses are kept in Keychain.

REQUIREMENTS
Compatible equipment and its enabled network control interface are required. Your iPhone or iPad must be able to reach that equipment on the network. ProPresenter requires its network API; Companion requires its local web interface. Discovery depends on device advertisements and network settings, with manual address and port entry available. Saved portals that require cloud sign-in, external resources, or an untrusted certificate may not work.

Church Remote is an independent app and is not affiliated with or endorsed by the makers of Playlister, ProPresenter, Bitfocus Companion, or Behringer X32. Product names belong to their respective owners.

name: ÇİFT: Number Merge Puzzle
description:
ÇİFT is a calm number merge puzzle about one decision: where to drop a pair.

Every turn, two number tiles fall side by side into two neighbouring columns of a 5 × 6 board. Only tiles stacked on top of each other merge: drop a 2 onto a 2 and it becomes a 4; if a 4 waits below, the chain carries on to 8, then 16. A good drop clears space and scores big. A careless one fills a column you still need.

The pair always keeps its order, so the spot that suits the left tile has to work for the right one too. You see the current pair and the next one, so you can plan two moves ahead — a brain teaser that rewards logic, not speed.

• Drop two tiles, merge equal numbers downward
• Chain reactions that score every tile they create
• Targets that grow from 256 to 512, 1024 and 2048
• See the next pair before you place the current one
• No timer, no energy, no rush — play offline
• A three-step interactive tutorial
• Automatic save — close the app and pick up the round later
• Personal best that only counts unassisted rounds
• VoiceOver labels for every cell and button
• 12 languages

STUCK? When all four drop positions are blocked, you can clear the top row and keep going — up to three rescues per round. Rescues cost gems: 10, then 20, then 30. The first rescue is also free with Premium, and on iPhone and iPad you can watch an optional ad for it instead. Gem packs are one-time purchases and your gem balance syncs between your devices through iCloud. Scores after a rescue are marked as assisted.

ÇİFT PREMIUM (weekly or yearly subscription, both with a 1-week free trial for eligible new subscribers)
• iPhone and iPad: no ads, and your first rescue every round without an ad
• Mac: your first rescue every round, free
• All platforms: four exclusive colour themes

Payment is charged to your Apple Account after the free trial ends. The subscription renews automatically unless canceled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period; manage or cancel it in your App Store account settings.

Terms of Use (EULA): https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/
Privacy Policy: https://www.aidogtranslator.de/privacy

name: Clackity – Duo Flip Clock
description:
Clackity is a split-flap clock for your desk, your nightstand and your iPhone Duo.

It looks and sounds like the departure boards in old train stations. Every minute, the flaps tumble over and land on the new time with a soft clatter. Around the clock, smaller flaps show the date, the weather, sunrise and sunset, and your battery. It's calm, it's always on, and it's easy to read from across the room.

Designed for iPhone Duo. Works on any iPhone.

CLOCK
• Big flaps for the time, small flaps for everything else
• Each flap turns over its drum card by card, like the real thing
• 12- or 24-hour time, from your phone's settings
• Five classic typefaces: Futura, Avenir Next, Helvetica Neue, DIN Alternate and Rockwell
• A soft flip sound, or none at all

WEATHER
• Temperature, conditions, high and low, and chance of rain
• Now and then the big flaps flip to the sky and temperature, then back to the time
• Sunrise and sunset times

TIMER
• Swipe the clock to set a timer: left flaps for minutes, right flaps for seconds
• Watch it count down, flap by flap
• A gentle chime when it's done, not an alarm

IPHONE DUO
• Fold it into a tent and it stands on your desk as a dedicated clock
• A lit ring around the camera glows with the weather and counts down your timer
• Open it and hold it upright for a full departures board

On other iPhones the board fills the screen, and the Dynamic Island gets the same lit ring.

MAKE IT YOURS
• Choose what each row shows, and in what order
• Touch and hold the board to arrange it

BUILT TO STAY ON
• The board shifts slightly over time, so nothing burns in
• It dims when you're not using it, and again after dark
• On iPhone Duo, the screen stays awake only while it's folded into a tent

PRIVACY
• No account, no ads, no tracking
• Your approximate location is used only for local weather, from Apple Weather

Clackity is made by an independent developer. Pay once and it's yours: no subscription, no in-app purchases.

name: ClearToDig 811
description:
ClearToDig 811 tracks every locate ticket on every job and tells you, to the minute, when you're clear to dig and when the ticket expires. Built by a Virginia land developer and licensed underground utility contractor who got tired of tracking tickets on the dash of his truck.

NAME THE JOB, PICK THE STATE, ADD THE TICKET
• Set up a job once, then add as many tickets as it takes: phases, refreshes, re-marks
• Works in all 50 states and DC, with each state's wait time and ticket life built in
• Paste your 811 confirmation email and the ticket number, dig start, and expiration fill in for you
• Weekends and holidays handled for you

COUNTDOWN AND ALERTS
• Live ticking countdown to your legal dig start
• Green CLEAR TO DIG when the wait is up
• Alerts the night before, when you're clear, when it's time to refresh, and the day before it expires
• Add clear-to-dig and refresh dates to your iPhone calendar with one tap
• Every job on one board, most urgent first: red, yellow, green

UTILITY RESPONSES
• One tap opens your state's 811 center with your ticket number copied
• Paste the positive response email and every utility gets checked off automatically
• Or mark each utility Marked, Clear, or Conflict yourself
• A conflict flags the ticket red

PHOTOS OF THE MARKS
• Every photo stamped with date, time, GPS, and ticket number
• Add a note to every photo
• Proof of where the paint was before you dug

PDF AND EMAIL
• One tap builds a PDF with the ticket, times, every utility response, notes, and photos
• Send it to yourself, the GC, the owner, or the locator by email, text, or AirDrop

YOURS TO KEEP
• One price. No subscription, no account, no ads
• Everything stays on your phone

ClearToDig 811 is a reminder and record-keeping tool. It does not submit tickets for you. Always follow the legal start time and expiration on your official ticket, confirm every utility has responded, and respect the marks. Not affiliated with the Common Ground Alliance or any 811 center.

name: Clefy: Learn Music Theory
description:
Learn music theory the fun way, five minutes at a time.

Clefy turns reading music into short, playful lessons. Tap a note, hear it instantly, and watch your streak grow. No account, no ads, works offline.

WHAT YOU'LL LEARN
• Read the treble and bass clef, note by note
• Rhythm: whole, half, quarter and eighth notes, beats in 4/4
• The piano keyboard, sharps, flats and enharmonics
• Ear training: higher or lower, major or minor
• Intervals, from 2nds to octaves
• Major scales: C, G, F and D
• Chords: build and hear major, minor and diminished triads

HOW IT WORKS
• 8 units and 32 bite-size lessons
• Instant piano sound for every note you tap
• Mistakes come back at the end of the lesson until you get them
• Smart review drills your weakest notes and sounds
• Daily goal, XP and streaks keep you coming back
• Gentle daily reminder at the time you choose

FOR EVERY MUSICIAN
Piano, guitar, violin, voice, ukulele or saxophone: theory works the same on every instrument. Great for beginners, students preparing for theory exams, and anyone who wants to finally understand what's on the page.

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
No sign-in, no tracking, no data collection. Your progress stays on your iPhone.

Privacy Policy: https://clefy-frontend.vercel.app/privacy/
Terms of Use (EULA): https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/

name: Clicker Stand
description:
Clicker Stand is the companion app for the dumpling-shaped Clicker device.

• Connect over Bluetooth — your phone receives each click and relays it to your friends.
• Wake up a friend's clicker — when you press yours, the clicker on their desk reacts.
• Send drawings — draw a tiny pixel picture and send it to a friend's clicker screen.
• Dumpling World — meet the dumplings of friends who are online in a 3D world.
• Forest Dumpling — a mini game: press and release to jump. Play together in two-player co-op mode.
• Rankings — compare today's and this week's clicks with friends.

Most features need a Clicker device.

name: Clokia – Time Clock
description:
Clokia is your company's working-time record: simple for the team, clear for whoever manages it.

For employees
• Clock in, start and end breaks, and clock out with one tap.
• Keeps working without signal: entries are saved on your phone and sent automatically when you reconnect.
• See your hours by day, week and month, and accept your monthly report.
• Request time off, absences and corrections, and follow their status.
• See your shifts and confirm you have read them.
• Clock in by scanning your work center's QR code.

For managers and administrators
• See who is working right now at a glance.
• Plan the team's shifts and publish them.
• Approve requests and review workday issues.
• PDF, CSV and Excel reports for your accountant.

Privacy and security
• Your company records your location only at the moment you clock in, and only if enabled.
• Two-step verification for administrators and a session protected in your iPhone's Keychain.
• You can delete your account from within the app.

Clokia needs a company account: ask your administrator to invite you, or create yours in the app.

name: Closeout: Landlord Deposit
description:
Closeout is the offline iPhone toolkit for landlords who need clear security-deposit return records—deadlines, move-in and move-out photo evidence, itemized charges, and a shareable PDF statement. No account. No cloud login. Your data stays on your device until you choose to share or back it up.

BUILT FOR SELF-MANAGING LANDLORDS
• Set deposit rules and a statement deadline per property
• Capture room-by-room move-in and move-out photos
• Log itemized charges with receipts, vendor notes, and after-repair photos
• Follow a countdown from move-out to your statement due date
• Export a PDF package: itemized statement + evidence + supporting files
• Back up / restore locally; optional Face ID or device passcode lock

WHY CLOSEOUT
• Offline-first record keeping—works without signing in
• One clear workflow from move-in photos → charges → export
• Soft, honest framing: organize records and prepare statements (not legal advice)

FREE
• 1 property address (unlimited leases on that address)
• Full workflow for photos, charges, and export
• PDFs include a small “Closeout free” footer

CLOSEOUT PRO — ONE-TIME PURCHASE
• Unlimited property addresses
• Watermark-free PDF exports
• Pay once — no subscription

IMPORTANT
Closeout is a record-keeping and organization tool. It is not a law firm and does not provide legal advice. The app does not ship statutory legal text—any notice or statement wording comes only from what you paste under Rules → Required wording. Always verify deadlines and requirements for your property’s jurisdiction.

Privacy: photos, leases, and exports stay on your device unless you choose to share or back them up. No ads. No tracking SDKs.
Support: dxywill@126.com

Terms of Use (EULA): https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/

name: Codeberry
description:
Codeberry teaches you the basics of programming in short, easy lessons. Pick a language, read one lesson at a time, and learn at your own pace.

THREE LANGUAGES, TEN LESSONS EACH
Start with Swift, Kotlin or C++. Every course walks through the same beginner topics:
• Hello, World!
• Comments
• Variables and constants
• Data types
• Operators
• Strings
• If and else
• Loops
• Functions
• Arrays, lists and vectors

EASY TO READ
Each lesson takes only a few minutes and follows the same simple layout:
• Why it matters
• A clear explanation of the topic in plain words
• Short code examples you can copy
• Common mistakes to avoid
• Key takeaways

BUILT FOR LEARNING
• Mark lessons as complete and see your progress for every course
• Continue where you left off
• Save lessons to come back to later (bookmark feature)
• Search across all lessons
• Adjust the text size for comfortable reading
• Light and Dark mode

PRIVATE AND SIMPLE
• No account or sign-up required
• No ads
• Works fully offline, because all lessons are bundled inside the app
• Your progress and saved lessons stay on your device

Whether you are starting your first programming course or refreshing the basics, Codeberry gives you the perfect learning experience.

Note: Codeberry is an independent app and is NOT affiliated with or endorsed by Apple Inc. or JetBrains. Swift is a trademark of Apple Inc. Kotlin is a trademark of JetBrains s.r.o.

name: CodeHark
description:
CodeHark is a remote control for AI coding agents that run on your own computers. Start a task from your iPhone or iPad, watch it work, and get a notification when it is done.

Connect your Mac, Windows PC or Linux machine to your CodeHark account once (from codehark.com). Then start a chat in the app: the agent reads your project, edits files and runs commands on that machine, and you see every step as it happens. CodeHark does not run your code on your phone and does not provide any AI model: the agents and the models are yours.

WHAT YOU CAN DO
- Chat with an AI coding agent about a project folder on your computer
- Watch answers, commands and file changes stream in live
- Attach photos, screenshots and files, or dictate a message by voice (recognised on your device)
- Browse and download files from your workspace
- Organize chats by project folder, search, rename and archive them
- Get a notification when a task finishes or fails (optional)
- Let the agent drive a browser on your computer

CODEHARK PRO
Free: one machine and one running chat at a time.
Pro unlocks:
- Up to 5 machines on one account
- Several chats running at the same time, on different machines
- Transfer a chat to another machine, or continue it with a different agent or model
- Desktop control: the agent can see and use the desktop of your computer
- A virtual desktop for graphical apps without touching your own screen
If your subscription ends, nothing is deleted: your chats and files stay, and extra machines become read-only until you subscribe again.

YOUR CODE STAYS WITH YOU
Commands run and files live on the machines you connect. What you send to the AI goes to the model provider you choose. The chat history is stored on the CodeHark server so you can read it from any device. No ads, no tracking, no third-party analytics.

WORKS WITH
OpenAI Codex and Claude Code, using your own ChatGPT or Claude account, or an API key from a supported provider. Those accounts are not included and are billed by their providers. CodeHark is not affiliated with or endorsed by OpenAI or Anthropic.

GETTING STARTED
1. Create your free account at codehark.com.
2. Install CodeHark on your computer from the website and connect it.
3. Sign in here and start a chat.

SUBSCRIPTION INFORMATION
CodeHark Pro is an auto-renewing subscription, monthly or yearly, with a 7-day free trial for new subscribers. Payment is charged to your Apple Account at confirmation of purchase (after the free trial ends, if you have one). The subscription renews automatically unless you cancel it at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. Your account is charged for renewal within 24 hours before the end of the current period. Manage or cancel in Settings > [your name] > Subscriptions on your device. Any unused part of a free trial is forfeited when you buy a subscription.

You can delete your account and all its data at any time in the app (Account).

Privacy Policy: https://codehark.com/privacy
Terms of Use: https://codehark.com/terms
Apple standard license agreement: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/

name: Comet Drop
description:
Comet Drop is a physics arcade game for iPad. Aim the cannon, fire a comet and watch it ricochet through a field of pegs. Clear every orange peg before you run out of balls.

FEATURES
• Three built-in levels, and as many of your own as you like.
• Real physics: every bounce, collision and explosion is simulated, frame by frame.
• Special pegs: Kaboom pegs explode and push everything nearby; Spooky pegs turn the floor into a portal back to the top; Stubborn pegs can be knocked into other pegs.
• Pegs with hit points, and solid blocks to play around.
• A moving bucket: land the comet in it for a big bonus.
• Four planets with their own gravity: Space, Mars, Saturn and Earth. Switch them mid-game.
• A trajectory guide that bends with gravity, so you can line up your shot.
• Level designer: place, rotate and resize pegs, set their hit points, then save your level and play it.
• No ads, no in-app purchases, no accounts and no tracking. Works offline.

Comet Drop started as a university project at the National University of Singapore and was polished for release. Its physics engine is written from scratch, and the source code is on GitHub.

CREDITS
Space background: Solar System Vectors by Vecteezy (vecteezy.com). Music: "Bravery Run" (CC0, OpenGameArt.org). Sound effects: Pixabay.

name: ConduitCalc - Conduit Bending
description:
ConduitCalc is an offline conduit bending calculator for electricians, apprentices and field crews.

FEATURES
• Offset: spacing, shrink and angle
• 90° stub: target height, bender deduct and mark position
• 3-point saddle: center-to-side spacing
• Conduit path diagram
• Field formula reference
• Chinese / English
• No account, no network, no ads, no subscription

Verify against your bender, conduit and local electrical code before bending.

name: ConstancIA: Actas de reuniones
description:
Después de una reunión toca redactar el acta: quién estaba, qué se decidió y quién se encarga de qué. ConstancIA hace ese trabajo por ti.

GRABA DONDE ESTÉS
• Con el iPhone o el iPad sobre la mesa, o con el Apple Watch en la muñeca.
• En el Mac, también las videollamadas: tu micrófono y el audio de Zoom, Teams, Meet o cualquier otra app.
• Desde la esfera del reloj, el botón de Acción o Siri.
• Con la pantalla bloqueada: el tiempo y el botón de parar se ven en la pantalla bloqueada y en la isla dinámica.
• Pausa la grabación cuando haga falta y sigue después en la misma reunión.
• A prueba de imprevistos: el audio se guarda en partes de 5 minutos.
• Importa también tus grabaciones de Notas de Voz o de Archivos.

TRANSCRIBE EN TU DISPOSITIVO
• El reconocimiento de voz de Apple convierte el audio en texto en el propio dispositivo: el audio no sale de tus dispositivos.
• Toca cualquier frase y escucha ese momento de la grabación.
• Busca en todas tus transcripciones y actas.

EL ACTA, LISTA PARA ENVIAR
• Resumen, decisiones, tareas con responsable y plazo, temas tratados y preguntas abiertas.
• Tipos de acta para reuniones de trabajo, juntas de propietarios, consejos y juntas de socios, y entrevistas.
• Compártela en PDF, envíala a los convocados del evento o pasa las tareas a Recordatorios.
• Corrige los asistentes cuando haga falta.

TÚ ELIGES LA IA
• Apple Intelligence: gratis, sin clave y sin conexión. La reunión no sale del iPhone.
• O Claude, OpenAI, Google Gemini y OpenRouter con tu propia clave, o tu servidor de LM Studio. Solo se envía el texto de la transcripción, nunca el audio.

INTEGRADA EN TU IPHONE
• Calendario: cada reunión toma el título y los convocados del evento.
• Siri y Atajos: «Acta de la última reunión en ConstancIA».
• Sincronización opcional con tu iCloud entre iPhone, iPad y Mac (el audio no se sincroniza).
• Bloqueo opcional con Face ID.

PRIVADA POR DISEÑO
ConstancIA no tiene servidores ni cuentas. No hay publicidad, analítica ni seguimiento.

Grabar una conversación en la que participas es legal en España, pero avisa siempre a los participantes. La app lo explica en «Acerca de».

Requiere iOS 26, iPadOS 26 o macOS 26. Para transcribir hace falta un iPhone 12 o posterior, un iPad con chip A14 o M1 o posterior, o un Mac con Apple silicon. Apple Watch con watchOS 26, opcional. Apple Intelligence, en los iPhone compatibles con la función activada.

name: CoreFix
seller_name: HALOOL ALASR FOR INFORMATION TECHNOLOGY ESTABLISHMENT
description: CoreFix منصة SaaS لإدارة طلبات الصيانة والمرافق والموارد والأساطيل، طوّرتها حلول العصر لتقنية المعلومات داخليًا بالكامل. تجمع كل أطراف العملية في مسار واحد واضح: مقدّم الطلب، والإدارات المنفذة، والمستودعات، والمالية، والإدارة العليا.

name: Coreflow
description:
Coreflow, pilates salonlarının ve bireysel eğitmenlerin derslerini, öğrencilerini ve paketlerini tek yerden yönettiği uygulamadır.

ÖĞRENCİLER İÇİN
• Eğitmeninin müsait saatlerinden saniyeler içinde randevu al
• Haftalık plan kur: istediğin günleri seç, ders hakkın kadar haftaya yayılsın
• Telafi hakkı: derse gelemezsen saatini değiştir, ders hakkın yanmasın
• Ders hakkını, paket süreni ve yaklaşan derslerini takip et
• Eğitmeninle uygulama içinden yazış
• Online derse uygulamadan görüntülü katıl

EĞİTMENLER İÇİN
• Haftalık müsaitliğini ve izin günlerini belirle
• Günlük ders listesi, yoklama ve öğrenci notları
• Öğrencilerine mesaj gönder, dersleri taşı veya iptal et

SALON SAHİPLERİ İÇİN
• Eğitmen ve öğrenci davet et, rolleri yönet
• Paket ve ödeme takibi, ders raporları
• Birden fazla salon ve bireysel eğitmen hesabı

ÖNE ÇIKANLAR
• Ders hatırlatmaları ve mesaj bildirimleri
• Türkçe ve İngilizce
• Reklam yok, verilerin satılmaz
• Hesabını istediğin zaman uygulamadan silebilirsin

Coreflow, salonunun ya da eğitmeninin davetiyle kullanılır; uygulamada "Salon / eğitmen bul" ekranından katılma isteği de gönderebilirsin.

name: Corner Pizzeria
seller_name: YENI PROJELER REKLAM YAZILIM TICARET LIMITED SIRKETI
description:
Open the shutters, fire up the oven and run the friendliest little pizzeria in the neighbourhood. Read the order card, put the toppings on the dough in the right order, slide the pizza into the oven and take it out before it burns. Serve it hot and the customer leaves a tip.

A WHOLE NEIGHBOURHOOD TO FEED
• 100 shifts in ten chapters, each with a clear goal and a bonus star to chase.
• Start with tomato and cheese, end with 20 toppings: basil, salami, sucuk, chili, eggplant, arugula, parmesan, artichoke, tuna, capers and finally the anchovy.
• 30 recipes from Margherita and Funghi to the house specials.
• Hurried customers, big family orders and couriers that need a boxed pizza.
• Pour lemonade and ayran alongside the pizzas.
• Later shifts bring a second board and ingredient bins that run empty.

GROW YOUR KITCHEN
• Earn cash every shift and spend it on a hotter oven, a second oven slot, a second board and a helper who keeps baking while you are away.
• Master your craft: oven stone, warming plate, quicker hands, a tip jar and bigger bins.
• Decorate the walls with plants, lamps, plates, a radio and bunting.
• Collect gold for new aprons, a gilded sign and new kitchen looks.
• Daily tasks with small rewards.

A KITCHEN THAT TALKS
The chef cheers in Italian with subtitles, customers thank you in your own language. Every line is voiced in English, German and Turkish.

FRIENDLY FOR EVERYONE
• A step-by-step tutorial and a "How to play" guide.
• Large buttons, calm colours, reduce-motion option.
• Plays offline. English, German and Turkish.

PRIVACY FIRST
No account, no ads, no purchases. Anonymous gameplay data and crash reports are only collected if you allow it, and you can change your mind any time in Settings.

name: Cosigners
description:
Cosigners is a free group trip planner where everyone gets a say in the itinerary. Pick a destination and dates, then send your friends the invite link. They can join without creating an account.

• Suggest a dinner spot or a day trip and see who’s in.
• Add the ideas you agree on to the itinerary. Everyone sees the schedule in the trip’s local time.
• Check when people land and where they’re staying.
• Save the flight prices you find so the group can compare options before booking.

Available on iPhone, iPad, and the web at vibecosigners.com.

name: Coworker: Voice Dictation
description:
Coworker turns your voice into clean, ready-to-send text on your iPhone. Switch to the Coworker keyboard, tap the mic key, speak naturally, and your words appear where you were typing: in Messages, WhatsApp, Mail, Slack, Notes or anywhere else.

WHAT YOU GET
• The Coworker keyboard: one big mic key in any app. Tap to speak, or hold to talk.
• Clean text: filler words taken out, punctuation and capitals put in.
• Your Dictionary: teach Coworker names and terms so they're spelled right every time.
• Transcriptions: every dictation kept, searchable, and copied in one tap.
• Voice notes and audio files: share them to Coworker and get the text.
• Dictate from the Action Button, Control Center or Shortcuts, with a Live Activity while Coworker listens.
• Today and Stats: how many words you dictated and how much time you saved.
• English, Greek and many more languages.
• One account on iPhone, Mac, Windows and Android.

FREE AND PRO
Coworker is free to start. Coworker Pro gives you unlimited dictation on all your devices, with monthly and yearly plans billed to your Apple Account. New subscribers get a week free. A plan renews automatically unless you cancel at least 24 hours before the end of the period, in your Apple Account's subscription settings.

PRIVACY
Coworker listens only while you dictate. What you say is sent to Humanlike's servers to be turned into text, and your dictations stay in your account so you can find them again. You can delete your account, and everything in it, from Settings in the app.

THE KEYBOARD AND FULL ACCESS
An iPhone keyboard can't use the microphone, so Coworker's keyboard hands each take to the Coworker app and types the words back. iOS calls that Full Access. The keyboard has no letter keys, and it reads nothing you type.

Terms of Use: https://humanlike.co/terms
Privacy Policy: https://humanlike.co/privacy

name: Crest Together
description:
Crest is a private place for one family.

Everyone in the family takes a seat. You join with a family link and a PIN you choose. There is no email, no phone number and no password to set up. Only the people in your family can see what is inside.

WHAT YOUR FAMILY CAN DO

• A family feed for words and photos, with reactions and comments.
• One question each week. Answer it, and then you see what everyone else said.
• Private notes to one person. Only the writer and the reader can open a note.
• A birthday wall that stays secret from the birthday person until the day.
• Holiday plans, so the family can sort out who goes where.
• A family calendar that shows who is coming.
• Wish lists, so people can see what you would love to get.
• Time capsules: write something now for someone to open later.
• A photo of the week.
• A wins and prayers board.

SEATS AND PARENTS

Each person has a seat with a name, a photo and a soft color. A parent can add a profile for a young family member and post and answer on their behalf. That profile never signs in.

SAFE BY DESIGN

• Reporting: tap the three dots on a post, comment, note or profile and choose Report.
• Blocking: block a family member and you stop seeing what they post.
• Family owners and admins can remove content and release seats.
• You can delete your account yourself, inside the app.
• No ads, no tracking, no in-app purchases, and no third-party code in the app.
• Your family's information is stored in the United States.

TRY IT FIRST

Tap "Look around a sample family" to see Crest with made up people. You do not need to sign in. The sample is private to you and is deleted after 24 hours.

Crest is free. You must be 13 or older to have an account. Crest is made by WebPro360.

Privacy: https://crest-6k6.pages.dev/privacy
Terms: https://crest-6k6.pages.dev/terms
Support: https://crest-6k6.pages.dev/support

name: Crew Rest Planner
description:
Crew Rest Planner maakt in een paar seconden een eerlijk rustschema voor een driemans- of viermansbemanning op lange vluchten.

Vul in wanneer de rust ingaat en wanneer je landt, kies hoeveel minuten voor de landing iedereen terug moet zijn, en de app verdeelt de rust. Het schema staat in dezelfde vorm als op papier: per wisselmoment wie er rust (X) en wie er in de cockpit zit (1, 2, 3).

• Driemans en viermans, 1, 2 of 3 keer af
• Vastleggen of flexibel: bij flexibel ga je af en meld je terug wanneer je terug bent; de rest van het schema schuift mee
• Verdeel ieders rust over het eerste en tweede deel met een sleepbalk
• Minimale en maximale pauze instelbaar
• Bepaal de volgorde door rollen te slepen
• Waarschuwing als de rust per persoon onder het ingestelde minimum komt — de app past je keuzes nooit stilletjes aan
• Alarm aan het eind van elke rust: een melding, of een wekker over het hele scherm die ook klinkt als de iPad op stil staat
• Aankondiging 5 of 10 minuten vooraf, zodat de ander zich op tijd klaar kan maken
• Vereist iPadOS 26 of nieuwer
• Alle tijden in UTC, afgerond op 5 minuten
• Licht en donker thema
• Werkt volledig offline; er worden geen gegevens verzameld of verstuurd

Belangrijk: Crew Rest Planner is een persoonlijk hulpmiddel. De app is niet goedgekeurd door een luchtvaartmaatschappij of luchtvaartautoriteit en vervangt geen officiële procedures of handboeken. Controleer het schema altijd zelf tegen de regels die voor jouw vlucht gelden.

name: Crokinole Rivals: Board Game
description:
Crokinole Rivals is the classic crokinole board game for your phone: flick wooden discs, dodge the pegs and sink yours in the centre hole for 20 points. Play offline against the computer, or play a two player game with a friend on one device — no wifi needed.

If you enjoy carrom, shuffleboard, table hockey or curling, you'll feel right at home: crokinole is the tabletop dexterity game that mixes all of them, and it's easy to learn in a minute.

A REAL FLICK, NOT A BUTTON PRESS
• Drag back, aim and release — every shot is physics, not luck
• Discs glide, ricochet off pegs and knock each other off the board
• Optional aim guide shows where your disc will go
• A short tutorial teaches the rules of crokinole step by step

12 RIVALS WITH CHARACTER
• Play against computer opponents with their own styles: hitters, careful guards who hide behind pegs, and snipers who chase the 20
• Climb from the Kitchen Table to the Club, the Tournament and the World Championship
• Win streaks, head-to-head records and a rivalry album to complete
• Beat the champion at the top table

2 PLAYER BOARD GAME — PASS AND PLAY
• Two player crokinole on one phone or tablet, just like the real board
• Challenge family and friends: a perfect family game for game night, travel or a quiet evening

PLAY OFFLINE, ANYWHERE
• No internet and no account needed for single player
• Quick matches, practice mode and a free daily Lucky Flick

MAKE THE BOARD YOURS
• Collect wooden boards — maple, birch, walnut, cherry — plus disc sets and effects
• Earn everything by playing, or speed up with optional purchases

HOW TO PLAY CROKINOLE
Players take turns flicking discs toward the centre of the board. If your opponent has discs on the board, your shot must hit one of them. Discs score 5, 10 or 15 points by ring, and a disc in the centre hole scores 20. The round winner scores the difference, and the first to 100 wins. Crokinole is also known as pichenotte.

Free to play with optional in-app purchases and ads.

Terms of Use (EULA): https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/
Privacy Policy: https://vicsotheme.com/crokinole-rivals/privacy/

name: Cuplove: Love Days Counter
description:
Cuplove counts every day you two have been together and keeps every memory safe. Open the app and see how many days you have shared, which milestone is coming up, and the moments you love most.

COUNT YOUR DAYS
• Days together from the date you choose, counting from day 0 or day 1
• Automatic milestones: 100 days, 1 year, 1,000 days and beyond
• Special dates on the solar or lunar calendar, with countdowns
• Reminders before milestones, birthdays and anniversaries

10 THEMES
Light, Pastel, Cinematic and seven styles from around the world: Vietnam, Korea, Japan, USA, India, Mexico and France. Each has its own colours, fonts and Today page. Paired, you both wear the same look.

MEMORIES
• Photos and notes for every moment
• Four ways to browse: grid, timeline, scrapbook and calendar
• Photos centre on faces automatically, or frame them by hand

LOVE LETTERS FOR LATER
Write a love letter and seal it until the day you choose: day 1,000, a birthday or next year's anniversary. Ten letter papers, from ruled paper and cherry blossoms to a starry night.

HOME SCREEN WIDGETS
34 widget styles for your day count and your photos: polaroid, movie ticket, calendar, heart, cassette, passport, plant and many more.

MEMORY FILMS AND CARDS
• Turn your photos into a video with music, made on your iPhone
• 9:16 milestone cards for your Story

TWO PHONES, ONE STORY
Pair with a code to share your start date, memories, photos, special dates and letters, on iPhone and Android. Add a moment on one phone and it shows up on the other. A sealed letter opens only on its day.

NEVER LOSE A MEMORY
Back up with Sign in with Apple or Google. New phone or reinstall, everything comes back.

PRIVATE BY DEFAULT
Everything stays on your iPhone unless you choose to pair two phones or back up. We never sell your data.

Privacy Policy: https://cuplove.appsgenz.vn/privacy?lang=en

name: Da Camera
description:
Da Camera – Capture More Than One Perspective

One moment. Multiple perspectives.

Da Camera lets you record videos using multiple cameras simultaneously, right from your iPhone. Capture the world around you and your own reactions at the same time, without extra equipment or complicated editing.

Simply choose your favorite layout and start recording.

KEY FEATURES

Dual Camera Recording
- Record with the front and rear cameras simultaneously.
- Capture the scenery and your reactions together.
- Preserve every moment from two different perspectives.

Picture-in-Picture (PiP)
- Add a selfie camera overlay to your video.
- Move and position the overlay wherever you like.
