- Perfect for reactions, travel videos, and daily vlogs.

50/50 Split-Screen Recording
- Display two camera views in a single layout.
- Record both perspectives at the same time.
- Great for vlogging, interviews, and everyday moments.

Portrait & Landscape Recording
- Capture portrait and landscape videos in a single recording session.
- No need to record the same scene twice.
- Create content for different platforms with ease.

Easy Video Management
- Automatically save your recordings.
- Browse and revisit your captured moments.
- Keep your videos organized right inside the app.

FREE & PRIVATE

- Completely free to use.
- No account or registration required.
- No videos or personal data uploaded to servers.
- Your recordings are processed and stored locally on your device.

Whether you're traveling, creating vlogs, recording reactions, or capturing everyday memories, Da Camera gives you more ways to tell your story.

Da Camera – One Recording. Multiple Perspectives.

Note: Simultaneous multi-camera recording depends on device compatibility.

name: DarkDivNet
description:
Many animals that once lived in Australia's national parks are gone from them today. DarkDivNet is a free, public catalogue of those parks and the species that have vanished from each one, so the stories are easy to find, read and share.

Browse without an account. Everything in the catalogue is open to everyone.

WHAT YOU CAN DO
• Explore national parks, each with photos and the species recorded as missing from it
• Look up species by common or scientific name, with photos and a status such as extinct in the park or locally extinct
• See when each species was last recorded in a park, and whether the year is documented or estimated
• Search and filter by park, species or status
• See the numbers on the Stats screen to find where the losses are greatest
• Tap any photo to see the whole image, full size
• Save your favourite species and parks to find them again quickly

SIGN THE PETITION
Help bring these animals back. Add your name to our petition asking park agencies and governments to fund reintroduction, habitat restoration and monitoring. Follow the live signature count in the app and share the petition on Facebook, WhatsApp and Instagram, or copy the link.

JOIN THE COMMUNITY
Create a free account to edit your profile, suggest a new species or park, send a correction, and follow what happens to your suggestions. An administrator reviews every suggestion before it joins the catalogue. You can delete your account at any time inside the app.

YOUR PRIVACY
You don't need an account to browse. The petition uses your email only to stop the same person signing twice, and it is never shown publicly. No ads, no tracking.

PHOTO CREDITS
Photos come from Wikimedia Commons or were uploaded by our administrators. Credit and licence are shown with each image.

Developed by Hexated Tech, https://www.hexated.com

name: DebitPanel
description:
DebitPanel prépare le débit de vos panneaux de bois, mélaminé, MDF ou contreplaqué, et vous guide coupe après coupe devant la scie.

Saisissez vos panneaux et vos pièces, ou importez votre liste en la photographiant. DebitPanel calcule un plan de coupe réalisable sur une scie à format : chaque coupe traverse entièrement le morceau posé sur la machine.

PENSÉ POUR L'ATELIER
• Ordre de découpe pas à pas : la cote à régler sur la butée, le morceau à mettre de côté, la coupe en cours surlignée sur le plan
• Reprise de la découpe là où vous vous étiez arrêté
• Plan en plein écran, zoom au pincement, écran qui reste allumé
• Grands boutons, chiffres lisibles, mode sombre

UN CALCUL QUI RESPECTE LE MÉTIER
• Largeur du trait de scie
• Sens du fil des panneaux et de chaque pièce
• Délignage, bord par bord si besoin, uniquement là où il est utile
• Chants : vous saisissez les cotes finies, l'app calcule les cotes de débit et le métrage de chant
• Plusieurs matériaux dans un même projet
• Trois priorités au choix : moins de pertes, coupes simples, ou une grande chute réutilisable

MOINS DE PERTES, MOINS DE DÉPENSES
• Rendement, pertes et coût matière de chaque projet
• Chutes exploitables conservées en stock et réutilisées dans les projets suivants
• Comparaison des trois priorités en un toucher

IMPORT ET EXPORT
• Import d'une liste par photo, fichier CSV ou texte copié
• Dossier de débit en PDF : synthèse, plan de chaque panneau, ordre de découpe, étiquettes à imprimer
• Sauvegarde et partage d'un projet dans un fichier

VOS DONNÉES RESTENT CHEZ VOUS
DebitPanel fonctionne entièrement hors ligne, sans compte et sans publicité. Aucune donnée n'est collectée : vos projets restent sur votre iPhone.

name: Décima FM
description:
Décima FM 101.9, la radio inteligente de Castellón, ahora en tu iPhone. Escúchanos en directo, mira qué ha sonado, pide tu canción y dedícala a quien quieras con tu propia voz.

EN DIRECTO, DONDE ESTÉS
• Un toque y estás escuchando Décima FM en directo.
• Sigue sonando con la pantalla bloqueada o mientras usas otras apps.
• Controla la radio desde la pantalla de bloqueo y el Centro de Control, con la canción que suena en cada momento.
• Los mejores éxitos de pop, reggaeton, urbano y dance comercial, las 24 horas.

¿QUÉ HA SONADO?
• Mira la canción que suena ahora y la que sonó antes.
• Consulta todo lo que ha sonado en la última hora y a lo largo del día.
• ¿Te ha gustado una canción? Márcala con el corazón y guárdala en «Mis favoritas» para no olvidarla.

PIDE TU CANCIÓN
• Busca en el catálogo de Décima FM y pide la canción que quieras escuchar.
• Te decimos a qué hora va a sonar, y te avisamos cuando esté a punto de sonar para que no te la pierdas.
• Consulta en «Tus peticiones» cómo va cada una.

DEDÍCALA
• Dedica una canción a tu pareja, a tu familia o a tus amigos.
• Escribe tu mensaje y lo locutamos nosotros, o grábalo con tu propia voz y suena en Décima FM.
• ¿Prefieres WhatsApp? También puedes escribirnos desde la app.

RADIO DESPERTADOR
• Elige la hora y los días, y Décima FM te despierta cada mañana.
• Suena como una alarma aunque el iPhone esté en silencio. Toca «Escuchar Décima» y empieza el día con la radio en directo.
• Pruébalo cuando quieras: suena en 10 segundos.

Y ADEMÁS
• Temporizador de apagado: duérmete escuchando Décima FM y la radio se apaga sola.
• Avisos de Décima: entérate de sorteos, concursos y novedades de la emisora.
• Comparte con tus amigos la canción que está sonando.

Décima FM es la nueva radio musical de Castellón: los éxitos del momento y la mejor compañía, en el 101.9 FM y en cualquier parte a través de esta app.

Escúchanos en el 101.9 FM (provincia de Castellón) y en decimafm.com.
Síguenos en Instagram y Facebook: @decimafm

name: Desafio Ace Tenis
description:
Desafio Ace runs amateur tennis tournaments in cities across Spain. Register in the app, play opponents of your level and follow the whole competition from your phone.

HOW IT WORKS
• Pick a tournament in your city, register and pay securely by card.
• Answer a short level survey: we use it to build balanced groups.
• League phase: you play 9 matches against opponents in your group, spread over three rounds. You and your opponent agree the day and court (with a WhatsApp button to message them).
• Knockout phase: the top 8 of each group play quarter-finals, semi-finals and a final.
• There is one champion per group.

EVERYTHING IN THE APP
• Match schedule and deadlines for each round.
• Result entry: your opponent confirms it (or it is validated automatically after 72 hours).
• Live group standings and knockout bracket.
• Notifications when a result needs confirming, a match is pending or you have a new opponent.
• Your profile with statistics and tournament history.
• Waitlist when a tournament is full.

FOR PLAYERS AGED 18 AND OVER
Two editions a year: Spring Edition (February–June) and Fall Edition (September–February).

More information: https://desafio-ace.web.app

name: Die Gate
description:
Die Gate sizes the gate of a casting die from the cavity volume, the allowed fill time and the metal speed, on this iPhone. Area = volume ÷ (fill time × speed), with a default speed for each metal grade that you can change.

Drag the gate on the die section to try another opening and watch whether the fill time stays inside the ±15% band. Convert the area to a round gate or to a rectangle from 1:1 to 4:1.

After a trial pour, enter the real fill time and any short shot, porosity or flash. Die Gate learns the speed the metal actually reached, sets this shot beside the next one, and flags Recheck venting when the speed is more than 15% off plan. For multi-cavity dies, split the total gate equally or drag the dividers to weight each cavity.

The board on the first screen shows every die's speed against plan, so the one to look at first stands out. It is a shop aid, not a flow simulation. Everything stays on this iPhone. There is no account and nothing to buy.

name: Dimensy
description: Measure spaces, objects, and delivery paths before buying large items for your home. Choose what you are planning to install and follow an interactive measurement process tailored to that object. The system checks dimensions, clearances, access points, opening zones, and the complete delivery route. Change any measurement and see connected compatibility results update immediately. Visual checks help reveal the first point where an installation or delivery may fail. Save different measurement scenarios and compare alternative placement options. Finish with a consolidated dimensional check before purchasing or arranging delivery.

name: Discipline Lifestyle
description:
Discipline Lifestyle helps you build the habits that come from being focused and disciplined, starting with the gym.

PLAN YOUR WEEK
Assign routines to each day from Sunday through Saturday and see at a glance what today asks of you.

BUILD YOUR ROUTINES
Group exercises into routines like Push Day, Pull Day, Leg Day or Conditioning, in the order you do them. Reuse the same exercise in as many routines as you like. Edit it once and it updates everywhere.

STRENGTH AND CARDIO
• Strength: weight, reps and sets, in pounds or kilograms. Leave weight blank for bodyweight moves.
• Cardio: minutes plus the measurements each machine uses, like steps per minute on a stair climber or speed and incline on a treadmill.
• Type any number directly, or nudge it with + and –.

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
No account, no ads, no tracking. Everything is saved on your iPhone as you go, and you can export a backup file anytime from Settings.

WHAT'S NEXT
This is the first step. Future versions will track daily consistency, gym time by week, month and year, weight, sleep and more, so you can see whether you're maintaining or falling behind, without being pestered.

name: DispoJet
description:
DispoJet est l'agenda de prise de rendez-vous pensé pour les équipes de vente.

Vos prospects choisissent un créneau libre sur votre page de réservation. Le rendez-vous arrive tout seul dans votre agenda Google ou Outlook, avec son lien de visio, et DispoJet envoie les confirmations et les rappels à votre place.

L'application DispoJet vous donne votre tableau de bord dans la poche :

• Une notification à chaque nouveau rendez-vous, annulation ou report
• Un rappel 15 minutes avant chaque rendez-vous, avec le téléphone du prospect
• La liste de vos rendez-vous à venir, passés et annulés
• La fiche de chaque prospect : coordonnées, réponses au questionnaire, historique
• Appel, WhatsApp ou SMS en un geste depuis un rendez-vous
• Vos contacts, vos types de rendez-vous et vos disponibilités
• Les statistiques de votre équipe : rendez-vous, présences, absences

Connexion simple avec votre compte Google ou par un lien reçu par e-mail.

Vous n'avez pas encore de compte ? Créez-le gratuitement sur dispojet.com, puis connectez-vous dans l'application.

name: Dog Salon - Cozy Grooming
description:
Welcome to Dog Salon, a cozy, cloud-soft grooming parlor for dogs.

Take your time trimming each dog's fur with a comb, small scissors, large scissors, thinning shears and clippers. Pet the dog to build rapport; every dog has its own personality and reacts differently.

FEATURES
• Four breeds: Pomeranian, Bichon Frise, Maltese and Toy Poodle
• Many tools: comb, small scissors, large scissors, thinning shears and clippers with selectable guard lengths
• Build rapport by petting; each breed has its own personality
• Compare your work with a finished-look sample
• Create before-and-after photos to save and share
• Automatic per-breed saving, so you can pick up where you left off
• Sound effects and haptics can be turned on or off

PEACE OF MIND
• No login, no ads, no in-app purchases
• Works fully offline
• All data stays on your device

Available in English and Korean; the app follows your device language.

name: Dog Weight Tracker: PawGram
description:
Dog and cat weight tracking, without the busywork.

Save weigh-ins, follow real changes and keep the feeding instructions you already have ready for everyday care. PawGram brings the record together for you, your household and your next vet visit.

START FREE. NO ACCOUNT REQUIRED.
• Track one active dog or cat with unlimited weight entries.
• Use pounds, kilograms, grams or ounces.
• Add dates, notes and where each measurement came from.
• See a clear chart and changes between recorded weights.
• Add a target weight supplied by your veterinarian.
• Set a weigh-in reminder and save weight PDFs, CSV files or a backup file.
• Import an existing weight history from CSV.

The tracker works offline. Use “hold my pet” to subtract your own scale reading when a direct measurement is difficult.

CLEAR FEEDING CARDS WITH PRO
Turn your existing daily amounts or calorie instructions into measurable portions and meal splits. Combine a fixed wet-food amount with a measured second food, reserve the extras you specify and keep label values saved for next time.

PawGram uses your numbers. It does not choose a diet, calorie requirement or target weight. Rounded amounts and differences are shown so you can check the card against your instructions.

SHARED CARE, WITH A CLEAR RECORD
Invite up to three caregivers to the pets you choose. See who marked a meal as served and when. A meal with no entry stays “Not recorded.” Sync status helps everyone see how current their copy is.

KEEP THE HISTORY USEFUL
Pro supports up to five active pets, saved foods, dated feeding-card versions, meal reminders and visit-summary PDFs. Reuse a previous setup without retyping and bring weights, notes and feeding changes to the next appointment.

BACKUP YOU CAN TURN ON
With Pro and an account, enable cloud backup and sync across devices. Recovery lists the latest 200 deletions and 300 edits from the last 90 days. If Pro ends, your cloud copy is retained for 12 months. Keep a backup file too.

CHOOSE YOUR PRO PLAN
Annual, monthly and lifetime options unlock the same current Pro features. Subscriptions renew automatically unless cancelled in Apple account settings at least 24 hours before the period ends. Lifetime is one payment for the current Pro features for as long as PawGram operates. Localized prices and any eligible offer are shown before purchase.

Your recorded weights and previously unlocked feeding cards remain readable if Pro ends. Cloud features need an account. The owner’s Pro plan covers invited caregivers.

For dogs and cats. PawGram is a recordkeeping and calculation tool, not veterinary diagnosis or treatment. Follow your veterinarian’s instructions and contact them about unexpected weight changes, appetite loss or other concerns.

Terms: https://paw-gram-weight-companion.replit.app/terms
Privacy: https://paw-gram-weight-companion.replit.app/privacy
Support: https://paw-gram-weight-companion.replit.app/support

name: Doop Tower Defence
description:
Doop Tower Defence is a tower defence game drawn in paper and ink. Enemies walk a fixed path to your core. You build towers beside the path and pop every one of them before it arrives.

THIRTY MAPS IN THREE CHAPTERS
Chapter one teaches the basics on open meadows. Chapter two adds tunnels, water and high ground. Chapter three forks the path, ices the straights and sends gliders over everything.

TEN TOWERS, THREE UPGRADE PATHS EACH
Dart, Frost, Cannon, Sniper, Laser, Tesla, Flame, Rail, Beacon and Missile. Every tower has a Faster path, a Stronger path and a Special path of its own. Armour, insulation and tunnels decide which tower wins where.

PERMANENT RESEARCH
Stars earn crystals. Crystals buy research ranks that make a tower a little stronger on every map, for good. Research is refundable, so you can rebuild your plan at any time.

FAIR BY DESIGN
Every map can be won at research rank zero. The in-level crystal trade is capped, so no level can be bought.

COMMUNITY LEVELS
Draw your own map in the level editor, publish it, and play and rate maps made by other players.

PLAYS OFFLINE
No account is needed and your campaign progress stays on your phone. Sign in with Apple or Google if you want your stars, research and crystals on every device.

name: DotMend
description:
DotMend helps campus, venue, and building maintenance teams find missing bird-safe window markings, plan repairs, and document what still needs attention.

Map the glazing
Organize panes by floor, window order, and group. Enter pane dimensions, horizontal and vertical dot spacing, the first dot position, and the area to be checked. DotMend builds the expected dot grid. Duplicate a layout for matching panes and inspect each pane separately.

Inspect dots and measure gaps
Zoom in on the dot map to mark individual points, select a rectangle, or jump to a row and column. Record intact, missing, unchecked, and intentionally excluded dots. The façade heatmap helps you find panes with concentrated losses. Open a pane to see its longest horizontal and vertical runs of missing dots and the largest gap measured in verified sections.

Compare repairs and check tape stock
Compare spot patches and partial row replacement side by side. Review estimated tape, crew time, and cut lengths. Enter the remaining length on each roll to see where the proposed cuts fit. DotMend flags continuous cuts that cannot fit on any single roll.

Record work and prepare a handoff
Confirm work by dot, row, or area and record actual tape use by roll. After a partial repair, DotMend updates roll balances, recalculates gaps, and keeps missing and unchecked points on the list. Preview the handoff for one pane or the entire site, then share a PDF or CSV through iOS.

Use DotMend on iPhone or iPad without an account or internet connection. Site data, inspections, and work records are stored on the device, with backup export and restore. Create your own site to get started, or open the separate sample site to try the workflow.

name: Dovewing: Bible Chat & Study
description:
Ask a question about faith or the Bible and get a short, calm answer that points to real passages.

Dovewing is an AI study helper. The AI writes the explanation, but it never writes the verses. Every passage you see is read from the Bible stored on your phone, so you can check it yourself. If the AI names a verse that does not exist, Dovewing drops it before you see it.

ASK IN YOUR OWN WORDS
Type what you are wondering: "How do I forgive my brother?", "What does the Bible say about worry?", "Why did Jesus speak in parables?" Tap a feeling such as anxious, grieving or grateful for starting points.

SCRIPTURE YOU CAN CHECK
Answers carry numbered markers. Tap one to jump to the passage, then open the whole chapter. Eight Bible translations are included and work offline.

WHERE CHRISTIANS DISAGREE
On questions like baptism, the answer says so and shows the main views side by side, instead of pretending there is only one.

READ AND KEEP
Read any chapter, jump to a verse by name, save verses with a note, and turn an answer into a short reading plan with a reflection question for each day. A gentle daily reminder is optional.

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
No account. Your questions are sent to our server and to OpenAI only to write the answer, and are not used to train AI. Your saved questions, verses and plans stay on your phone.

FREE AND PLUS
Reading, saving and plans are free, with a few questions every day. Dovewing Plus is a one-time purchase that raises the daily limit and lets you keep asking in the same thread.

Dovewing is an AI tool and can make mistakes. It is a study aid, not pastoral, medical or crisis advice. If you are in crisis, Dovewing shows where to find a helpline.

Privacy Policy: https://dovewing.sanghuynhxuan.com/privacy

name: Drama Caliber
description:
Drama Caliber is an offline workbench for aspect-ratio gates, composition guides, delivery specs, and static look-parameter previews—built for editors, cinematographers, post teams, and short-form creators.
Use classic film and series reference frames to see how different parameters reshape a picture before you lock a deliverable. No film library browsing, no poster maker, no shot notes, no video playback, and no social feed—just clear parameter reference and preview.
FRAME LAB
• Preview common gates: 4:3, 1.37, 1.85, 16:9, 2.00, 2.39, 9:16, 4:5, 1:1, and custom
• Soft matte vs hard matte
• Live gate readout with UHD/FHD long-edge pixel fits
• Save the current stack as a local preset
COMPOSITION GUIDES
• Rule of thirds, golden ratio, center cross, diagonals
• Title safe and action safe
• Fibonacci cue with adjustable opacity
DELIVERY SPECS
• Theatrical, broadcast, streaming, and social format cards
• Resolution, frame-rate notes, codec hints, and safe-margin guidance
• Apply a gate straight into Frame Lab with a matching reference still
LOOK BENCH
• Exposure, contrast, saturation, warmth, vignette, and fade
• Quick looks: Neutral, Noir, Tungsten, Teal
• Static preview only—sense parameter impact without grading software
WORKSPACE
• Preset archive with pin, rename, delete, JSON export/import
• Pixel math for aspect → resolution
• Sensor-crop FOV reference
• Import your own calibration frames from Photos (stored on device)
Designed to work fully offline. No accounts. No tracking SDKs. Your presets, favorites, and imported frames stay on your device.
Drama Caliber helps you check framing, matte, safe areas, and delivery crops with confidence—before the timeline gets locked.

name: Dri Sky Fix Duo
description:
Ohjaa kahden hengen korjaustiimiä kelluvien taivasasemien halki.

Tutki koko taistelukenttä ja valitse sitten toimija, käytettävä symbolilla merkitty taito sekä kohteeksi sopiva sijainti. Vuoropohjainen taistelu perustuu tarkkaan sijoittumiseen: selkeä 2 × 3 -vihollisruudukko, yhteinen energia ja neljä ennalta määriteltyä symbolikykyä, jotka mahdollistavat korjaamisen, läpäisevät iskut, suojauksen ja kokonaisen sarakkeen kattavat hyökkäykset.

Kulje vaakasuuntaista reittiä kolmen alueen halki. Selvitä kohtaamiset, kunnosta majakat, paranna työvälineitä leirissä ja tutustu vihollisten toimintamalleihin tutkimuspäiväkirjassa. Pelissä ei ole nopeustestejä eikä korttipakan rakentamista – voit suunnitella jokaisen toiminnon rauhassa ennen sen suorittamista.

Saavuta keskellä sijaitseva observatorio ja avaa uudelleen aiemmat reitit sekä lukemattomat matkapäiväkirjan merkinnät. Peli on suunniteltu vaakasuuntaiseen pelaamiseen iPhonella ja iPadilla, ja sen selkeästi etenevän kampanjan voi suorittaa omaan tahtiin.

name: Driveroo
description:
Book your chauffeur with Driveroo for journeys from Frankfurt and the Rhine-Main region to destinations across Europe.

YOUR JOURNEY, SIMPLY ORGANISED
• Create an account and manage your profile
• Plan one-way journeys and hourly bookings
• Enter pickup and destination addresses with search suggestions
• Choose your date, time and vehicle category
• Book for yourself or a guest
• Review the total price, including any applicable pickup approach fee, before payment
• Pay securely through Stripe
• View your own journeys and booking status

FOR YOUR PLANS
Airport transfers, business travel, city-to-city journeys or an hourly chauffeur: choose an available Business, Premium or Van category.

Available in German and English. Pickups start in Frankfurt and the Rhine-Main region, with destinations across Europe. Quotes and availability depend on your route, date and vehicle category.

Driveroo is a brand of Viventum Drive. Learn more at driveroo.de.

name: dropmeter Ballistic Calculator
description:
Know your clicks at every distance, from your own groups, not from a formula alone. Try dropmeter Pro free for 7 days.

Shoot groups at a few distances, tap the hits on the screen or type the group center, and dropmeter fits one trajectory through your own impacts. Every click and every hold that follows is checked against those groups.

YOUR GROUPS, CHECKED
• Range entry: tap each impact on a grid or type the group center, and enter the clicks you dialed. One shot is enough; three or more give a 95 % band.
• Data check: every group is marked Fits or Check, with the velocity your impacts imply, your scatter and the farthest distance you shot.
• Click value check: see whether your turret really moves what its label says.
• No range day yet? Start from a chronograph reading and the BC; the rows stay marked as calculated until you shoot them.

SHOT PLANNER
• Line-of-sight distance and angle, measured with the phone if you like. Wind is chosen, not typed: Calm, Light, Moderate or Strong, from a clock direction.
• Temperature and pressure: the phone's barometer fills in the pressure, or convert a weather report with your altitude.
• Cold weather: dropmeter knows how your load's velocity changes with temperature, from a typical value, a second chrono reading or a cold check group, and corrects for it.
• The answer in words: "14 clicks up" or "hold 35 cm high", with the left/right correction and a 95 % band from your own groups.
• Energy at the distance compared with a minimum for roe deer, red deer, whitetail or wild boar.

THE RANGE CARD
• Curve and table move live as you change angle, temperature, pressure or the turret.
• Every row says verified or extrapolated, and every printout names the farthest distance you measured.
• Optional columns for energy and for uphill and downhill angles.
• Print it: credit-card size, A6, or A4 with uphill and downhill columns, plus a turret tape for your turret and a target sheet in A4 or Letter.

EVERY RIFLE YOU OWN
Set up as many rifles as you like, each with its own scope, load and table. Clicks in cm/100 m, MOA or mrad; metric or imperial; English or German.

YOUR DATA STAYS YOURS
No account, no server, no tracking. Your rifles, loads and sessions stay on your iPhone and, if you turn on the automatic backup, encrypted in your own iCloud account. Export an encrypted backup, CSV or JSON at any time, with or without a subscription.

SUBSCRIPTION
dropmeter needs a subscription to use: dropmeter Pro Yearly (US$39.99 per year, starting with a 7-day free trial for new subscribers) or dropmeter Pro Weekly (US$3.99 per week). Prices may vary by country. Payment is charged to your Apple Account when you confirm the purchase, or when the free trial ends. The subscription renews automatically at the same price for the same period unless you cancel it at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. Manage or cancel it in your App Store account settings. Restoring a purchase and exporting your data always work without a subscription.

Terms of Use: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/
Privacy Policy: https://nisse80.github.io/dropmeter/en/privacy.html

A range card is valid only for this rifle, this load and these conditions. Check it at the range before you rely on it. dropmeter computes from your own measurements; it does not replace a verified zero, a safe backstop or your judgment of the shot. You alone decide whether to shoot.

name: Dyelight: Color Gradient Sort
description:
A calm puzzle where you move scattered color tiles back into a smooth gradient.

The four corner colors are your guide. Swap two tiles at a time and a jumbled board settles into a single picture. There is no timer, no move limit and no game over. Undo is free, as many times as you like.

WHAT MAKES IT DIFFERENT

• A Color Book of 360 named colors
Every board you finish gives you a card with the name of one of its colors, such as Indigo Blue or Citron. Colors look a little different once you know what they are called.

• Finished boards become your wallpaper
Turn any finished board into a wallpaper sized for your screen, with no logo and no watermark. Save it to Photos, then set it as your wallpaper.

• No ads or pop-ups while you solve
No ad ever appears while you are solving a puzzle or looking at the result. Full-screen ads come only after the short rest screen that follows every tenth board.

• Four color vision modes
There are modes for people who find reds, greens, or blue and yellow hard to tell apart, plus one you solve by lightness alone. These are not screen filters: each mode builds its boards from colors that stay distinguishable. Cards and progress add up the same way in every mode.

• Endless Palette
Finish all 360 boards in 12 chapters and a run of boards that never ends opens up.

• Today's Palette
One new board every day. Skip a day and you lose nothing.

PLAY OFFLINE
Every board works without an internet connection. Only a few things, such as ads, purchases and restoring purchases, need you to be online.

ADS AND PURCHASES
Dyelight is free to download. It contains ads and optional in-app purchases.
• Remove Ads: removes full-screen, app-open and banner ads for good. Rewarded ads remain, and play only when you choose to watch one.
• Dyelight Pass (30 days): removes the same ads for 30 days. It does not renew.
• Hint packs (10 or 30), Paint Box (three wallpaper styles) and Dye It All (Remove Ads + Paint Box + 50 hints).
Color cards, wallpapers and levels are never sold. You collect them by playing.

PRIVACY AND CONTACT
Dyelight does not ask for your name, email or contacts, and it never reads your photo library; it only saves pictures to it. To show ads and improve the app, some information such as device identifiers is sent to advertising and analytics services. The privacy policy lists what goes where. "Delete my data" in Settings erases the game data stored on your device and in the cloud at any time.

Privacy policy: https://mojoday.app/dyelight/privacy
Contact: mojoday.official@gmail.com

name: Ear bloom tool
description:
Train your ear in 5 minutes a day — no account, no internet, just listening.
Most ear training happens passively. EarBloom turns it into an active game: hear an interval or chord, pick what you heard, and know instantly if you are right.
LEARN BY LEVELS
• 64 sections, 640 questions, 8 levels
• From 3 basic intervals to full chord progressions
• Every section takes about 5 minutes
HEAR IT, NAME IT
• Four clear choices with instant feedback
• Replay any question or hear the correct answer side by side
• Miss a question twice? It goes to your review notebook automatically
MADE FOR REAL PRACTICE
• Every sound is synthesized on your device — works fully offline
• Nothing is uploaded, no account needed, no data collected
• Piano, guitar and organ tones, with your choice of the lowest root
• Light and dark themes included
STAY MOTIVATED
• Daily streaks and lifetime accuracy at a glance
• Custom quizzes: choose drill types, 10, 20 or 50 questions
• Level badges reward steady progress

name: Easy Snapchat Memories Backup
description:
Preserve and protect your most cherished memories with Easy SnapChat Memories Backup – the all-in-one private archive, gallery viewer, and cloud sync companion.

Have you requested and downloaded your personal Snapchat data export, but don't know how to easily view or organize hundreds of ZIP files and JSON history records? Easy SnapChat Memories Backup solves that effortlessly. Open your export files directly from the iOS Files app or iCloud Drive, unpack your photos and videos into a gorgeous timeline, and back them up safely to your personal Google Drive account with a single tap.

KEY FEATURES:

• ONE-TAP DATA EXTRACTION
Simply select your downloaded data export ZIP or JSON archive from the iOS Files app or iCloud Drive. The app automatically extracts, sorts, and organizes every photo and video into a chronological timeline.

• BEAUTIFUL MEMORIES VIEWER
Browse your photos and videos just the way you remember them. Features full-screen HD viewing, pinch-to-zoom, fluid video playback, and date-based timeline navigation by month and year.

• DIRECT GOOGLE DRIVE CLOUD SYNC
Never worry about losing a memory. Connect your personal Google Drive account and back up your entire memories archive to a secure, organized folder in your cloud drive.

• 100% PRIVATE & ON-DEVICE
Your privacy is our priority. Media extraction happens directly on your device. Your photos and videos are never uploaded to any third-party servers, they stay strictly on your phone and your private Google Drive account.

• SECURE BIOMETRIC PROTECTION
Keep your private moments safe from prying eyes with built-in Face ID and Touch ID app lock protection.

• SEAMLESS SHARING & EXPORTING
Share any memory with friends and family via AirDrop, Messages, or save individual photos directly to your iPhone Camera Roll with one tap.

• BUILT-IN DEMO MODE
New to the app? Tap "Try Sample" to explore all viewer and sync features instantly with a curated demo dataset before importing your personal export.

HOW IT WORKS:
1. Request your data export from Snapchat Settings and save the download to your iPhone Files app or iCloud Drive.
2. Open Easy SnapChat Memories Backup and tap "Select File" to pick your ZIP or JSON archive.
3. Watch the app organize your timeline, then tap "Back Up Now" to sync your memories safely to Google Drive!

------------------------------------------
DISCLAIMER:
Easy SnapChat Memories Backup is an independent utility created to help users store, view, and manage their personal downloaded media archives. This application is NOT affiliated with, sponsored by, maintained by, or endorsed by Snap Inc. or Snapchat. "Snapchat" and "Snap" are registered trademarks of Snap Inc.

name: EasyDoc Scan: PDF Scanner
description:
Scan paper documents, receipts and notes into a tidy library on your iPhone, then share them as PDF or JPG. Exports never carry a watermark.

SCAN AND EDIT
• Scan with the iPhone camera, with automatic edge detection and perspective correction.
• Import photos from your library, or images and PDFs from Files.
• Crop, rotate, reorder and delete pages, and add pages to a document later.
• Choose Color, Grayscale, Black & White or Brighten, and fine-tune brightness and contrast.

ORGANIZE AND SHARE
• Keep documents in folders, rename them and find them with search.
• Export multi-page PDFs in A4, US Letter or fit-to-image size, or save pages as JPG.
• Share with Mail, Messages, AirDrop, Files or print, using the standard share sheet.
• Light, dark or system theme.

FREE
Up to 20 saved scans per calendar month. The free version shows ads.

PREMIUM (optional subscription)
• Unlimited scans and no ads
• Text recognition (OCR) on your iPhone: copy, share and search the text of your scans
• Sign documents with your own signature
• Merge and split documents
• Password-protect PDFs

Premium is available as a weekly or yearly auto-renewable subscription. The yearly plan includes a 3-day free trial for eligible new subscribers. Prices are shown in the app before you buy. Payment is charged to your Apple Account at confirmation of purchase (or when the trial ends). Subscriptions renew automatically unless cancelled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. Manage or cancel anytime in your Apple Account settings. You don't need a subscription to use the free version.

GOOD TO KNOW
No EasyDoc account is needed. Your documents are stored on your device. Ads and subscriptions use an internet connection. Please check scan and text-recognition results before relying on them, and keep copies of important documents.

Privacy Policy: https://sites.google.com/view/easydoc-scan/privacy-policy
Terms of Use: https://sites.google.com/view/easydoc-scan/terms

name: EditFast: AI Video Editor
description:
EditFast is the AI video editor that works like a real editor in your pocket. Pick a video, tell it what you want in plain words, and get a finished edit back, right on your phone.

WHAT EDITFAST AI DOES
• Cuts pauses, repeats and mistakes so your video is tight
• Word-by-word captions synced to your voice, in styles made for Reels and TikTok, with per-word animation and automatic emoji
• Motion graphics designed for what you say: numbers that count up, comparisons, lists, titles
• Zooms at the right moments, sound effects and music
• Turns a long video into short reels, each with a score so you know what to post first
• Captions in another language, under your words or instead of them
• AI voice-over from your script, and one-tap voice cleaning that takes out noise and echo
• Removes "um", "uh" and other filler words in one tap
• Auto cut: removes the pauses as soon as you add a video
• Remembers your style and your brand: logo, colors, handle

EDIT IT YOURSELF — FREE
A full editor like the apps you know: a timeline, 125 video effects, 66 transitions, 70 caption styles, animated stickers, 236 sound effects, music, text and filters — no credits needed. Split, trim and reorder clips, change the speed with speed curves, reverse, stabilize, add keyframes and masks, set the volume of each part, and resize for TikTok, Reels or YouTube with the speaker kept in frame. Captions are free every day too.

READY MOTIONS
A library of almost 80 ready motion graphics: headlines, follow and subscribe buttons, counters and charts, chat bubbles, frames and name tags. Edit the words and the color, and drop them on your video. No credits needed.

YOU STAY IN CONTROL
Every layer stays editable: move it, trim it, change its words — or just ask the AI to change it.

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
Your video is edited and exported on your phone, and the file never leaves your device. Only what the edit needs (frames from the video and the audio to transcribe) is processed securely.

CREDITS
AI edits, voice-overs and voice cleaning use credits, and the price is shown before anything is made. Editing by hand and your daily captions are free. Buy a pack in the app whenever you need more.

name: Ekodia Ön Muhasebe

description:
Ekodia LITE – Geleceğin Akıllı Ön Muhasebe ve Fatura Çözümü!

İşletmenizin finansal süreçlerini yönetmek hiç bu kadar kolay, hızlı ve akıllı olmamıştı. Ekodia Faturam; Fatura kesiminden cari hesap takibine, stok yönetiminden kasa-banka ve şirket kredi kartlarına kadar tüm ön muhasebe ihtiyaçlarınızı tek bir modern mobil uygulamada bir araya getiriyor.

Üstelik Türkiye'de bir ilk: Yerleşik "Ekodia Yardımcı Zeka" ile muhasebenizi sadece konuşarak veya yazarak yönetebilirsiniz!

EKODIA YARDIMCI ZEKA İLE TANIŞIN 
Muhasebe işlemleriniz için formlar arasında kaybolmanıza gerek yok. Ekodia Yardımcı Zeka, doğal Türkçe komutlarınızı anlar ve sisteminizde saniyeler içinde icra eder: 
"Merkez kasasından 750 TL kırtasiye masrafı kaydet." 
"Ahmet Yılmaz firmasından Yapı Kredi hesabımıza gelen 25.000 TL tahsilatı işle." 
"Kasa hesabından Ziraat Bankası'na 50.000 TL virman yap." 
"Bu ay en çok ciro yapan ilk 5 müşterimizi listele." 
"En çok satan ürünlerimizi ve güncel stok durumunu getir." 
"Bu ayki toplam masraflarımızı ve genel durumumuzu özetle." Ekodia Yardımcı Zeka talebinizi inceler, veritabanınızda ilgili kayıtları oluşturur ve size şık, anlık bilgi kartları sunar.


TEMEL ÖZELLİKLER & MODÜLLER

1. Hızlı Fatura
Satış ve iade faturalarını saniyeler içinde hazırlayın, PDF çıktısını WhatsApp, e-posta veya AirDrop ile anında müşterinizle paylaşın. 
Otomatik cari bakiye güncellemesi ve stok düşümü.

2. Kapsamlı Cari Hesap (Müşteri & Tedarikçi) Yönetimi 
Müşteri ve tedarikçilerinizin güncel borç/alacak bakiyelerini anlık takip edin. 
Detaylı cari hesap ekstresi görüntüleyin ve paylaşın. 
Müşterilerinize tek tıkla doğrudan uygulama içinden telefon araması veya WhatsApp mesajı başlatın.

3. Akıllı Stok ve Ürün Yönetimi 
Barkod okuyucu (Kamera ile barkod/karekod tarayarak saniyeler içinde ürün bulma). 
Alış/Satış fiyatları, KDV oranları ve birim tanımları. 
Gerçek zamanlı stok miktarları, stok giriş/çıkış hareketleri ve kritik stok uyarıları.

4. Kasa ve Banka Hesapları 
Nakit kasalarınız ve tüm banka hesaplarınız tek ekranda. 
Çoklu para birimi desteği (TL, USD, EUR). 
Kasalar ve banka hesapları arasında anında çift taraflı virman (transfer) işlemi.

5. Şirket Kredi Kartları Yönetimi 
İşletmenize ait tüm şirket kredi kartlarının limit ve güncel borç takibi. 
Karttan yapılan harcama ve ödemeleri tek dokunuşla kaydetme. 
Karta bankadan yapılan borç ödemelerini eşleme ve kapatma.

6. Gelir, Gider ve Masraf Takibi 
Günlük işletme harcamalarını (yemek, akaryakıt, kira, fatura vb.) kategorilerine göre kaydedin. 
Harcamalarınızı grafiklerle görselleştirin; paranızın nereye gittiğini her an bilin.

7. Yönetici Paneli & Canlı Finansal Raporlar 
Şirketinizin genel durumunu gösteren modern gösterge paneli (Dashboard). 
Ciro grafikleri, tahsilat oranları, vadesi geçen alacaklar ve kârlılık analizleri.

8. Üst Düzey Güvenlik & NetGSM SMS Doğrulaması 
Çift aşamalı SMS OTP güvenliği ile şifre sıfırlama ve hesap koruması. 
Rol bazlı yetkilendirme ve çoklu kullanıcı desteği. 
Uçtan uca şifrelenmiş kurumsal bulut mimarisi.

9. Canlı Destek & Çağrı Merkezi Entegrasyonu 
Uygulama içerisinden anında canlı destek başlatın veya destek talebi (ticket) oluşturun. 
Sorularınıza uzman destek ekibimizden dakikalar içinde yanıt alın.

KİMLER İÇİN UYGUN? 
KOBİ'ler, Şahıs Şirketleri ve Limited/Anonim Şirketler 
Saha satış ekipleri ve plasiyerler 
E-ticaret satıcıları ve perakende mağazalar 
Serbest meslek sahipleri, danışmanlar ve hizmet sektörü 
Faturalama ve finans takibini ofise bağımlı olmadan cebinden yönetmek isteyen tüm girişimciler.

İşinizi cebinizden büyütün, finansal kontrolü Ekodia ile elinize alın!

name: Elderthrone: Life Counter
description:
Elderthrone is a fast, clear life counter for tabletop card games, built for real game nights.

TAP, DON'T SWIPE
Every player's area is split into a big − side and a big + side. Tap to change life by 1, hold to change it by 10. There are no drag gestures, so a bump of the table never opens a menu or changes a total by accident.

EVERY SEAT FACES ITS PLAYER
Lay the phone in the middle of the table. Each player's life total turns to face them, with layouts for 1 to 6 players. Sitting somewhere else? Tap the rotate button to turn any player's area to face them.

GAME MODES
• Commander — 40 life, commander damage, 2–6 players
• Standard 1v1 — 20 life for 60-card formats
• Brawl — 25 life head to head, 30 in multiplayer
• Oathbreaker — 20 life
• Two-Headed Giant — two teams sharing 30 life, 15 poison
• Custom — any life total and player count

COMMANDER DAMAGE, DONE RIGHT
Tap the CMD button to see and set damage from each opponent's commander, by name, including partner commanders. Damage comes off life automatically, and 21 from a single commander knocks a player out.

COUNTERS AND TABLE STATE
Poison, energy, experience, commander tax, storm, rad and tickets. Monarch, the initiative, City's Blessing, and day/night.

TOOLS
• Pick a random first player
• Dice (d4 to d100) and coin flip
• Game timer and full life history
• Keeps the screen awake, with haptic feedback

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
No accounts, no ads, no tracking. Your game is saved on your phone so you can pick up where you left off.

Elderthrone is unofficial fan-made software. It is not affiliated with, endorsed, sponsored or approved by Wizards of the Coast. Magic: The Gathering is a trademark of Wizards of the Coast LLC.

name: Electrical Aptitude Test Prep
description:
Preparing for the aptitude test used by electrical apprenticeship programs? This app gives you 600 original practice questions and shows you how to solve every one of them.

START WITH A FREE SKILL CHECK

Answer 10 quick questions across every topic. You get an estimated score against your study target and see exactly which topics need the most work, before you spend a single minute on the wrong ones.

WHAT IS INSIDE

• 600 questions written for this test, each with a step-by-step explanation
• Equations and inequalities — 130 questions
• Expressions and polynomials — 90 questions
• Functions and graphs — 110 questions
• Number series — 90 questions
• Reading comprehension — 45 original passages, 180 questions

A REAL MOCK EXAM

The practice test follows the structure of the real one: a first section of 33 algebra and functions questions in 46 minutes, a short break, then 36 reading comprehension questions in 51 minutes. Each section is timed on its own and reading questions come in blocks of four that share a passage, exactly as they do on test day.

BUILT FOR ADULTS GOING BACK TO MATH

Most people taking this test finished high school years ago. Every explanation starts from the step before the one you forgot, and no question needs a calculator — just like the real test.

STUDY THE WAY THAT WORKS

• A daily goal you set yourself, with a streak to keep you honest
• Smart practice that puts new questions and old mistakes first
• Mistake review that brings back what you got wrong until it sticks
• A readiness score so you know where you stand before you book

PRIVATE AND OFFLINE

No account, no sign-up, no ads and no tracking. Every question lives inside the app, so you can study on a job site with no signal. Your progress stays on your device.

ONE PAYMENT

The first topic is free. Full access is a single purchase that unlocks every topic and the timed mock exam for good. Nothing renews and there is nothing to cancel.

Practice material only. All questions and reading passages are original. This app is independent and is not affiliated with, endorsed by or connected to any union, apprenticeship committee or test provider.

name: Emoji Battery Widget · Wattie
description:
Your battery, with a face.

Wattie turns the number you check all day into a little buddy. It fills up like a glass, smiles when it is full, gets nervous at 20 %, cries at 10 % and lights up the moment you plug in.

WIDGETS THAT REACT
• Home Screen widgets in two sizes, Lock Screen widgets in three, StandBy ready
• Eight moods that follow the real charge, charging and Low Power Mode
• Tap your buddy to refresh the level right away

21 BUDDIES, ALL ORIGINAL
Wattie the battery, a cat, a bear, a frog, a ghost, a boba cup, a fox, a panda, an axolotl and more. Every one is an original glossy 3D toy with eight moods of its own.

MAKE IT YOURS
• Body color and juice colors for low, medium and full
• Backdrops: plain, gradients and patterns
• Bows, crowns, caps, party hats and other accessories
• Drag the charge slider to see every mood before you save

CHARGING SHOW
A full-screen animation with your buddy, the percentage and a clock. Set it up once in Shortcuts and it starts every time you connect a charger. Pick a plug-in sound, or keep it silent.

DYNAMIC ISLAND
While you charge, your buddy sits in the Dynamic Island and on the Lock Screen with the time on charge.

STATUS BAR WALLPAPER
Make a wallpaper with your buddy hanging next to the battery icon. Wattie knows where the status bar sits on your iPhone, and you can drag the buddy to line it up.

GOOD TO KNOW
• No app can replace the system battery icon. Wattie decorates around it and gives you widgets that really follow your charge.
• iOS reports the battery to widgets in 5 % steps and refreshes them on its own schedule.
• No ads. No account. Nothing leaves your iPhone.

WATTIE PRO
Unlocks every buddy, charging show, backdrop, palette and accessory. Weekly, yearly or one-time purchase; subscriptions renew automatically until cancelled.

Terms of Use: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/
Privacy Policy: https://globapps.netlify.app/wattie/privacy/

name: ENSIDEX Post
description:
Manage your social publishing plan with ENSIDEX Post.

For existing ENSIDEX workspace members:
• Switch between assigned clients while keeping their content separate.
• Review a weekly or monthly campaign calendar.
• Create captions, add photos, and reuse your client media library.
• Prepare separate Feed and Story drafts for Instagram and Facebook.
• Review content, leave feedback, approve exact revisions, and submit approved cards for supported publishing connections.
• Track saved content and inspect publication results.

Platform availability depends on the accounts connected to your workspace and each platform’s permissions. Some channels require additional steps on the website. There is no account creation or payment flow in this app.

name: EpicMail - Unified Email Inbox
description:
All your inboxes. Finally together.

A unified inbox for Gmail, Outlook, Yahoo, iCloud, IMAP, and POP3.

EpicMail brings the email accounts you already use into one organized experience on iPhone. See every connected inbox together, or focus on one account, folder or label.

ONE PLACE FOR YOUR EMAIL
- Search across connected email accounts.
- Recognize accounts at a glance with distinct colors.
- Star, archive, label, move, restore, mark as spam or delete.
- Select multiple messages for mailbox cleanup.
- Open attachments and follow conversation history.

SEND FROM THE RIGHT ADDRESS
- Choose the sending account for each message.
- Find matching EpicMail contacts as you type recipients.
- Add To, Cc and Bcc recipients.
- Write rich-text messages with formatting, lists, quotes and links.
- Attach photos and files, use account-specific signatures and save drafts.
- Reply, reply all and forward.

CONTACTS, LABELS AND MAIL LISTS
Keep contacts and colorful labels close to your inbox. Create Mail Lists with up to 50 members. Each person receives a separate email, so recipients do not see the other addresses on the list.

CONNECT THE ACCOUNTS YOU ALREADY USE
Add Gmail and Microsoft accounts with provider sign-in. Guided setup helps you connect Yahoo Mail, iCloud Mail and other IMAP or POP3 accounts. Manage account colors, folders, filters and signatures in EpicMail.

CONTROL AND PRIVACY
Remote images are blocked by default to reduce sender tracking. Recently opened messages are kept in an encrypted on-device cache. Authenticator-app two-factor authentication and named, revocable device sessions help protect your EpicMail account.

GET STARTED
Sign in with your existing EpicMail account. This app is a companion to the EpicMail service.

Need help? Visit epicmail.org/contact or email support@epicmail.org.

name: EthnicSpectrum
description:
民族色谱 —— 56 个民族 · 服饰头饰与生活色谱

中华民族传统色谱，56 个民族，一个一个讲清楚。

【四个页面】

• 民族：首页是一把展开的色卡扇、一条五十六格的藏格条，外加「今日一族」——
  五十六族每天轮一族。点开任一族，族名、分布、主色、上衣、冠饰、居所、
  生计、节庆、俗谚逐行翻。
• 色谱：五十六族一页排下来，每族一块色卡 —— 色名、族名与分布地。可按族名、
  按色相、按地区三种排法切换，也可只看收藏。
• 收藏：收下的族与色卡都在这里，只存在你自己的设备上。
• 设置：识谱难度（简单 / 标准 / 困难）、色卡排序、色盲辅助、只看收藏、
  数据重置。

【难度】

简单 —— 先露出族名、分布、主色、上衣四行，其余自己点着翻
标准 —— 衣、冠、饰、居都露出来，生计、节庆、俗谚再点
困难 —— 十行全在，但每行都要亲手翻开：自己先猜，再看答案

难度只改「一打开族册先露出几行」，别的一概不动，随时切得回来。

【色盲辅助】

色卡可加编号与织纹，不单靠颜色分辨。

【素材说明】

插图取自《皇清职贡图》刻本原画等公有领域（公共版权）来源，每张都注明出处；
当某族在清代画谱里没有对应图版时，图由 App 自行绘制。

本 App 的插图与文字素材全部来自公有领域（公共版权）来源，或在 App 内自行绘制，
不打包任何受版权保护的第三方图像、字体、音频或视频素材。

【隐私】

不联网、不登录、没有账号、不请求任何系统权限。你的收藏与各项设置只存在
你自己的手机里，卸载即彻底删除，我们看不到也拿不走。App 全程不发起任何网络请求。

【适合谁】

对中华民族传统色谱感兴趣的人 —— 学生、老师、编辑，以及纯粹想把它看明白的人。

版本 1.0

name: Eureka by Rick
description:
Eureka teaches you five quiz facts each evening and makes sure you still know them next month.

EVERY EVENING
Five new facts, each with a hook that makes it stick: a picture, a short story or a link to something you already know.

WARM-UPS
Your facts come back as questions just before you would forget them, worded differently each time. Tap a capital on a map with no names on it, slide a date in among the ones you know, name the painting from the painting. Answer by typing, tapping or saying it out loud.

YOUR WEEKLY QUIZ
Once a week Eureka writes you a quiz of five rounds from your own facts. Play it against the clock and against your own past weeks.

KEPT IS WHAT COUNTS
Your record shows how many facts you still know thirty days later, every quiz you have played and how ready you are in each category.

3,300 FACTS, TEN CATEGORIES
Geography, history, arts, music, film and TV, science, sport, food and drink, words, and an optional set about the Netherlands in Dutch. Pictures come from Wikimedia Commons, each with its credit.

CAPTURE ANYTHING
Heard something worth keeping? Tell Siri, share it from another app or add it yourself, and it joins your facts.

A TRICK A WEEK
Memory techniques that actually work, practised on the facts you are already learning.

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
No account, no ads, no tracking. Your facts and scores stay on your iPhone.

On iPhones with Apple Intelligence, questions are reworded each time and answers that are nearly right are judged more kindly. Everything else works on any supported iPhone.

name: EVE Oriente
description:
La aplicación oficial de la Expoenergética es la herramienta digital clave para optimizar tu asistencia y facilitar el intercambio profesional durante el evento. Diseñada con un enfoque ágil e intuitivo, integra las funciones esenciales para una participación fluida:

Agenda completa en tiempo real: Consulta el cronograma detallado de ponencias, paneles y actividades, con horarios actualizados para organizar tu recorrido sin perderte nada.

Conexiones rápidas con escáner QR: Olvídate del intercambio tradicional de tarjetas físicas. Escanea el código de otros asistentes o expositores para guardar y gestionar contactos comerciales al instante.

Credenciales digitales integradas: Accede a las instalaciones y áreas restringidas mostrando tu pase digital directamente desde la pantalla de tu móvil.

Perfil profesional personalizable: Muestra tu información de contacto, empresa, cargo e intereses clave para destacar dentro del ecosistema energético del evento.

name: Evo by Uneevo
description:
Evo is Uneevo's AI assistant, now on your phone. Ask in plain language and get answers from your workspace data: projects in progress, this week's allocations, logged hours, team skills, usage and billing.

• Real-time answers with tables, lists and charts you can export as CSV.
• Confirmation before any change: Evo shows what will change and only proceeds when you confirm.
• Conversation history with search, favourites and question editing.
• Attach photos and documents, or dictate your question.
• Scheduled tasks: ask Evo for a daily or weekly summary at the time you choose.
• Plan usage always visible, with limits and resets.
• Portuguese, English, Spanish, French, German, Arabic and Chinese, with light and dark themes.

Evo uses your organisation's Uneevo account (email and password or your organisation's sign-in). Accounts are created by your organisation; you cannot sign up in the app.

name: ExcuseSprout
description:
Can't make it tonight? Running late? Not sure how to turn someone down? ExcuseSprout gives you a few ways to put it, from straightforward replies to jokes for people who know your sense of humor.

Type a few keywords or pick a situation. Get three built-in replies at a time, choose practical, playful, or a mix, and draw again until something fits. If there's no exact keyword match, the app looks for a related situation or offers general replies.

Browse everyday situations around work, school, plans with friends, borrowing things, dating, and saying goodbye to a relationship. The situations and wording vary by language. Sensitive conversations include clear, respectful ways to say what you mean.

Copy a reply, save favorites, or revisit recent draws. Everything stays on your device. Saved replies keep their original language when you switch languages.

Choose from 17 languages, with regional wording for selected locales. All replies are written in advance and included in the app. No online AI, account, ads, or subscription. Works on iPhone and iPad, even offline.

Playful replies are meant for a laugh with the right audience. Use your own judgment about what fits the situation.

name: Exidex Arcade
description:
Exidex Arcade is a shelf of 23 small games you can play with one thumb.

Each one is a single idea you get in ten seconds and chase for a week:

• Tailshake: every car you pass copies your steering a beat late
• Paperweight: two buttons, six paper boxers, one belt
• Stormstack: stack a lighthouse through a growing night storm
• Floe: crack the sea ice and set the wolves adrift
• Moonpile: drop little worlds, fuse twins, build a star
• Plummet Up: the harder you fall, the higher you fly

And 17 more: Hen Over Heels, Piñata Pileup, Blinkwise, Daywinder, Duskdash, Blunderbug, Crankfall, Needlepoint, Snap Coil, Umbracast, Echo Drift, Fold & Fire, Grip & Slip, Upswing, Core Drop, Wobble Brawl and Guard Duty.

FIND YOUR GAME FAST
Search any game by name or by what you do in it. Recently played keeps your favourites one tap away, and Surprise me drops you into one you haven't tried.

ONE CALLSIGN, EVERY BOARD
Pick a callsign and your best run in every game goes on its board. No email, no password. Link a second phone with a six-character code and keep the same name.

PLAYS ANYWHERE
Every game is inside the app and plays with no connection. Scores you make offline post the next time you're online.

DARK MODE AND ARABIC
Light or dark, English or Arabic: the app follows your phone, or pick your own under You.

FAIR AND QUIET
No ads. No purchases. No tracking. Offensive callsigns are refused, any player can report a name or a fake score, you can hide a player, and you can delete your callsign and scores from inside the app at any time.

name: EZContact AI
description:
EZContact brings your business conversations from WhatsApp, Instagram and Messenger into a single inbox, with AI agents that answer your customers 24/7.

With the EZContact app you can work from your phone just like from your computer:

• Unified inbox: every WhatsApp Business, Instagram and Facebook Messenger chat in one place.
• AI agents: your assistant answers questions, shares prices, books appointments and captures leads. When a customer needs a person, it assigns you the conversation and lets you know.
• Instant notifications: get alerted as soon as a customer writes or a chat is assigned to you.
• Teamwork: assign conversations to your agents, leave internal notes and use tags to follow up.
• Sales pipeline: move each conversation through stages on a kanban board and see where every lead stands.
• Quick replies and templates: answer in seconds with saved replies and send approved WhatsApp templates.
• Contacts and campaigns: review each customer's history and send campaigns to your contacts by tag.
• Reports: conversations, response times, agent performance and results from your Meta ads.
• Works with WhatsApp Business coexistence: keep using your WhatsApp Business app while EZContact handles the same number.

EZContact is for businesses that already have an EZContact account. Sign in with the same user you use on the web.

name: Faiszr
description:
Faiszr is a daily cooking aid tool that offers recipes categorized by regions, ingredient lists, and step-by-step cooking instructions. You can adjust the recipe portions, convert common units, view ingredient substitution suggestions, and use a preparation list, timer, and cooking course schedule to manage the cooking process. The built-in assistant matches existing recipes based on the recipe name, ingredient keywords, and time conditions. After logging in, you can save personal information, synchronize saved recipes and supported practice records. Cooking tips are for reference only and cannot replace food safety checks; please combine the ingredient labels, actual cooking conditions, and necessary temperature measurements for judgment.
