name: Faka Vapa Nova
description:
Faka Vapa Nova measures the boxes you draw by hand. Draw on paper as you always do, photograph the page, pin the corners of one box, and the app works out where your edges actually converge, then tells you, edge by edge and in degrees, how far each line missed.

Nothing is projected onto your paper and nothing is traced. Faka Vapa Nova judges the freehand drawing you already made.

WHEN YOU USE IT

After a page of practice boxes.
Photograph the page or choose a photo you already have. Drop eight numbered pins on the corners of one box; a loupe under your finger keeps each pin exact, and the hidden back corner can be skipped and estimated. Tap Solve: the twelve edges are sorted into their three families, each family's vanishing point is solved by least squares, and the true convergence lines are drawn over your own drawing.

When a box looks wrong and you cannot say why.
Every critique gives a mean miss, the worst edge, the spread of the vanishing points and a verdict against your tolerance: strict 2°, normal 4° or loose 6°. A twelve-row edge table shows the angle you drew against the true angle, and a nine-fault atlas names the habit behind the miss, from a back corner that drifts to edges that never converge, with its cause and its fix.

When you want to see a pose before you draw it.
The Bench draws an exact box in one, two or three point perspective. Drag the box to turn it, slide the horizon, change the viewing distance and watch the cone of vision, with live figures for vanishing points and foreshortening. Set any pose as a drill.

When you are planning the next session.
Fourteen drills in four tiers, from a one point box to a cluster of five, each with three steps, a target in degrees and a chart of your attempts. Twelve everyday still-life subjects, from a shoebox to a storage trunk, come with their box proportions and what to watch. Eight drawing mediums keep their own figures, so you can see whether your fineliner or your charcoal holds the line better.

When you want a record of the week.
The sheet keeps every critique on a ruled practice page with a calendar of practice days and a trend for each edge family. Export a critique strip, a tall column of your boxes with their misses and verdicts, straight to your photo library.

Faka Vapa Nova works fully offline. Your photographs and critiques stay on your phone.

name: Fave Case: Acrylic Stand Maker
description:
Turn a favorite photo into a digital acrylic stand and arrange it in your own case.
Fave Case is a fan display app for making standees and decorating a 3D shelf on your iPhone.
Use photos of your favorites, family, or pets to build a personal collection.

- Make a standee from one photo
Choose a photo and your iPhone cuts out the subject to make a standee. Adjust its shape, touch up the cutout, or turn it into pixel art. Add a name and the date you welcomed it into your collection.

- Decorate your own case
Arrange your standees and adjust the number of tiers, layout, and case size. Change the lighting colors and directions to suit your display. Rotate the case with your finger to view it in 3D, then save your preferred angle.

- Place it in a photo or camera view
Place a standee or case over a photo or the live camera view, then capture and save the result. You can also save an image of just your case or standee against a black background.

- Your photos stay on your device
Selected photos are processed and stored on your device, never sent to a server. Available in Japanese and English.

- Start for free
Create up to 4 cases and 15 standees.

- Fave Case Premium (one-time purchase)
・Create unlimited cases and standees
・No ads

name: FeastQuilt
description: Το FeastQuilt σε βοηθά να οργανώνεις τις ονομαστικές γιορτές και το κέρασμα στο σπίτι. Κράτησε τις ημερομηνίες της οικογένειας, χώρισε τους καλεσμένους ανάλογα με το πόσο πιθανό είναι να έρθουν και χρησιμοποίησε τις προηγούμενες χρονιές για μια πρακτική εκτίμηση. Οργάνωσε τη λίστα για καφέ, γλυκά, ποτά και μεζέδες, προσάρμοσε τις ποσότητες και ακολούθησε το πρόγραμμα της ημέρας. Παρακολούθησε το όριο εξόδων και τις πραγματικές δαπάνες και, μετά τη γιορτή, σημείωσε πόσοι ήρθαν, τι άρεσε και τι θέλεις να αλλάξεις. Τα στοιχεία αποθηκεύονται τοπικά στη συσκευή, χωρίς εγγραφή, ώστε η εμπειρία κάθε γιορτής να σε βοηθά στην επόμενη.

name: FieldLink: Crew & Timesheets
description:
FieldLink is the app for crews that work on site: construction, plant hire, cleaning, events, landscaping and trades.

For staff
- See your shifts for the week: where, when and what to bring.
- Clock on and off at the project site. Your phone checks you are there, so there is nothing to fill in later.
- Start and end smoko and lunch with one tap. FieldLink reminds you when a break is due.
- See your hours for the week and whether each timesheet is approved.
- Keep your licences and tickets up to date and get a nudge before they expire.
- Get notified about new shifts, changes and approvals.

For admins
- Who's on now: every site, who is working, on a break or late, live.
- Schedule the week, send shifts and see who has confirmed.
- Approve timesheets in bulk and export them for payroll.
- Projects, staff, equipment and documents in one place.

FieldLink accounts are set up by your employer. If your company uses FieldLink, you will get a text or email with your sign-in link.

name: FieldStamp
description:
1. SCREEN RECORDING
Recorded on a physical iPhone running the latest iOS, starting from launching the app. The video is attached to this submission (Attachment field).
It shows: sign in with the demo licence key, filling in a docket (job details, hours, safety checklist, client signature), creating the PDF and the share sheet, taking a site photo that is stamped with the date and project, the photo report, past dockets, Settings, and logging out.
- Account registration: there is none in the app. Companies are set up by Axiom Advisory after they sign up on our website, so in-app account deletion is not required (Guideline 5.1.1(v)). Users can ask for deletion at admin@axiomadvisory.org, as the privacy policy explains.
- User-generated content: photos and dockets are private to the user's own company. Nothing is published or shared with other users, so there is no public content to report or block.
- Paid content: none. There are no purchases, upgrades, prices or payment links in the app.

2. PURPOSE AND AUDIENCE
FieldStamp is a business tool for construction and civil contractors in Australia (concrete cutting, civil works and similar trades). Crews on site use it to take site photos stamped with the job, date and time, and to fill in their company's docket (hours, equipment, materials, safety checklist and the client's signature) on the phone. A signed PDF goes to the office the same day, replacing paper dockets that get lost or arrive days late, and photos are filed by project for later disputes and invoicing.
It is sold to many independent construction companies (not a single organisation's internal app), so it is distributed publicly.

3. HOW TO ACCESS THE MAIN FEATURES
- Sign in: the first screen has one field, "Licence key". Enter the key given in the Sign-In Information user name field (the password field repeats it). There is no password. It opens a sample company called "App Review Demo".
- Dockets (bottom bar): fill in the form, sign in the signature box, tap PDF to save or share it.
- Photos (bottom bar): Take photo or From library; the photo is stamped with date, time and project. Save & Store files it.
- Account (bottom bar): Past dockets, Photo report, Settings (logo, photo stamp, projects), Log out.
- Scan docket and Rewrite use AI (see 4). The app asks permission before sending anything to the AI service.
No sample files are needed. Camera and photo library permission are only requested when adding a photo.

4. EXTERNAL SERVICES
- Cloudflare (Workers, D1 database, R2 storage): hosting, data and photo storage.
- Anthropic Claude (AI): reads a photographed paper docket (Scan docket), tidies note wording (Rewrite) and reads rate cards (Import rates). Only used after the user allows it in the app; data is not used to train models.
- Resend: sends the docket emails the user asks for.
- Xero (optional): companies that connect their Xero account can create invoices from dockets.
- Stripe: companies' subscription billing, handled on our website only, never in the app.
Sign-in uses our own licence keys; no third-party sign-in service.

5. REGIONS
The app works the same in every region where it is offered, in English. It is not currently offered in the European Union.

6. REGULATION
FieldStamp does not operate in a regulated industry (no financial, medical, legal or government services) and does not include protected third-party content. It stores the user's own business records.

name: Fifth Slip
description:
Fifth Slip is for the moment you are standing on the Yoshida trail and something has changed. Choose Seventh Station, Honhachigome, or the summit. Check headache, nausea, unsteady steps, or being still breathless. This iPhone subtracts 2305 from that station's altitude and writes the planning hours: 2 from the seventh station, 3 from Honhachigome, and 4 from the summit. The slip is a PDF kept on this iPhone for the person waiting at the fifth station. It carries your name and contact, the station, the meters down, the hours, and 119. You hand it on with the system share sheet.

It does not diagnose, measure, or say you may keep climbing. It does not show weather, an opening notice, a bus time, or a map. There is no account and no network. The record stays on this iPhone.

name: Fish & Jam
description:
The baby fish are crying: they lost their mama! In the reef, every mama fish looks in one direction. Tap her: if nothing blocks her, she swims straight to a shell, and the babies of her colour join her. Full family = big cuddle!

A sweet, clever puzzle: pick the right order, keep your 5 shells free and chain cuddle Cascades before the timer runs out.

ENDLESS LEVELS
• Levels with 1, 2 or 3 stars, smarter and smarter
• 8 worlds, each with its own little story
• A Boss every 25 levels, with an exclusive accessory and a family photo for your album
• New surprises along the way: sleepy turtle, puffer fish, prankster octopus, guardian crab, mystery mama, frozen mama…

DUEL
• First to reunite 100 babies in 60 seconds wins!
• Play against players worldwide or challenge a friend with a code
• Preset reactions (never free chat) and rematch
• Monthly leaderboard

YOUR OWN REEF
• Decorate your home screen: castle, corals, lights…
• Your reunited families swim there
• Trails, cuddles, shells, backgrounds and accessories to earn with seaweed

AND ALSO
• Daily challenge, Zen mode without timer, Legendary challenge
• The great migration every weekend
• Win streaks, missions, trophies, daily gift
• 3 helpers: extra shell, magic bubble and Shuffle
• Colour-blind mode, 11 languages, iPhone and iPad, plays offline

The game is free. It contains a few ads: none before level 10, never during a game, and bonus videos are always optional. Optional purchases: No-ads pack, seaweed packs.

A question or an idea? Write to us: Mrf91@outlook.fr

name: Fit-2-Fight
description:
Prepare for your next Air Force fitness assessment with Fit 2 Fight. Calculate a projected score, track workouts, and build an improvement plan around your next test date.

- Calculate scores for supported fitness events and body composition.
- Log workouts and review progress over time.
- Build improvement plans with scheduled sessions and a seven-day pre-test recovery buffer.
- Add each planned workout directly to iPhone Calendar with its exercise instructions and no alert.
- Track a confirmed test due date and export calendar reminders.
- Search the included fitness manual.

Fitness records stay on your device unless you choose to export or share them. Calendar events are saved to your selected system default calendar and may sync through your calendar provider.

Fit 2 Fight is an independent planning tool, not an official assessment or medical service. Confirm test requirements, restrictions, and due dates with your fitness staff.

name: Fiturea
description:
Fiturea is the fitness community where your journey lives. Find personal trainers and nutritionists near you, share your progress with people who get it, and see how far you've come.

FIND THE RIGHT COACH
• Discover personal trainers and nutritionists by goal, specialty, city or distance
• See each professional's experience, credentials, area of expertise and strength PRs
• Follow coaches you like and message them directly

SHARE YOUR JOURNEY
• Post photos and videos of your workouts, meals and milestones
• Like, comment, mention friends and use hashtags
• A home feed full of motivation from the people you follow

TRACK YOUR PROGRESS
• Your Fiturea Fitness Score at a glance
• Log height, weight, body fat, muscle percentage and BMI
• Record personal bests for bench press, squat and deadlift
• Set goals and watch yourself close the gap

MADE FOR YOU
• Pick your interests — from strength training and HIIT to yoga, running and nutrition
• Available in English and Arabic
• Private profiles, follow requests, blocking and reporting keep you in control

Fiturea is for motivation and general fitness tracking only. It is not medical advice. Talk to a qualified healthcare professional before starting a new exercise or nutrition program.

name: FLARE!: grill game
description:
Your phone is the grill.

MADE FOR IPHONE DUO
On iPhone Duo the phone itself is the barbecue: the inside of the lid on top, the coals below, and the hinge is the lid. Open it wider and air rushes in, the coals wake up and the flames climb. Lower it and the fire calms down. Fold it shut mid-round and the grill keeps cooking with its lid down. Prefer a finger? Switch to touch control in Settings.

ON ANY IPHONE
Drag the lid open and closed with your finger. Same fire, same foods, same 30 services.

COOK BY FEEL
• More air, more fire: faster cooking, more risk.
• Watch, listen, feel: color, smoke, sizzle and haptics tell you how it's going.
• Flip at the right moment, then decide when to SERVE. Too early is raw, too late is charcoal.
• Every result comes with one line on what to change next time.

EIGHT FOODS, EIGHT DECISIONS
Sausages that roll on their own. Burgers that need a flip. Marshmallows that catch fire if you look away. Steak that wants a hard sear first. Corn you turn side by side. Fish you may flip exactly once. Peppers that want it HOT. Fatty kebabs that flare up all the time.

FROM BACKYARD TO CAMPFIRE
• Backyard: learn the fire, then juggle two foods at once.
• Beach: the sea breeze picks up. Lower the lid before the gust hits.
• Campsite: the embers slowly fade. Open wide to wake them, but an open fire pit flares up.
Each place ends with a party: longer services, hardest orders last.

MORE TO PLAY
• Combo orders with up to three foods on the grill, and a hot middle.
• Practice: any food you've met, no orders, no score, unlimited AGAIN!
• Daily Special: three fresh orders every day.
• Endless: orders keep coming and get harder. Three misses and the kitchen closes.
• Stars for every service and 14 achievements.

FAIR AND QUIET
No ads. No account. No tracking. Plays offline. Sound and haptics can be switched off separately, and there's a reduce-motion option.

name: Flashcard New HSK 3.0
description:
Learning with New HSK 3.0 Standard Course?
Study the right words in each lesson’s exact order, without building your own deck.
Review your current lesson and return to the words on your Needs Practice list.

FOLLOW THE LESSON YOU ARE LEARNING

Choose a course → open a lesson → start. Each lesson keeps the textbook’s word order, making it easy to study alongside the book. Included: Courses 1–4, 68 lessons and 1,848 lesson entries. Repeated words and different readings keep their own place in each lesson.

Hanzi, pinyin and Vietnamese meanings stay together on study cards and word lists. The English interface also includes English meanings. Hear a word at normal or slow speed, read an available example, or add a personal memory note.

REVIEW YOUR LESSON. FOCUS ON DIFFICULT WORDS.

Review the lesson you are studying, in the same word order—not a mixed deck from unrelated lessons.

Mark a word as Needs Practice to collect it in a separate list. Choosing Again also adds the card. Repeat that list as often as needed, then remove each mark when ready; a positive answer does not remove it automatically.

VARY THE PRACTICE, NOT THE CONTENT

Open More Practice inside a lesson or your marked list. Try listening, meaning-to-Chinese recall, multiple choice, pinyin typing or freehand writing without choosing the content again. Self-test modes show the complete Hanzi, pinyin and meaning only after revealing the answer.

USEFUL EXTRAS, A SIMPLE ROUTINE

• 1,560 selected bilingual examples for context—not an example for every entry.
• Pause and resume, undo the last answer, add notes and star useful words.
• See lesson progress and review activity; turn on study reminders if helpful.
• Study on iPhone or iPad, keep progress on the device and export a backup when needed.

Pay once. No ads, subscriptions or in-app purchases. No account required; bundled vocabulary and practice work offline. There is no automatic cross-device progress sync.

PRACTICE AND COVERAGE

Audio uses the iOS Mandarin speech voice, not human recordings. Offline audio requires a voice downloaded on the device. Pinyin practice checks sounds, not tones. Handwriting is for self-checking, not character recognition, stroke grading or pronunciation scoring.

An independent study companion, not an official or endorsed product of the textbook publisher or HSK organizer. Included scope: Standard Course 1–4, not the complete nine-level HSK 3.0 syllabus. Examination results are not guaranteed.

name: Flight Landing Gear Alarm
description:
Flight Landing Gear Alarm provides a supplemental landing-gear checklist reminder using your aircraft’s public ADS-B data.

Enter an aircraft tail number once. The connected service follows the aircraft automatically and sends a notification when a sustained descent meets your chosen airport-distance and height settings—even while the app is in the background.

FEATURES
• Automatic background tracking by aircraft registration.
• A following-aircraft notification when takeoff is detected.
• Adjustable airport radius in nautical miles, descent rate, descent confirmation time, and airport-relative height limit.
• A spoken/tone alarm lasting 1–20 seconds, with a 10-second default.
• One reminder per detected approach, with rearming after a sustained go-around climb.
• Local and background notification tests, plus a simulated approach mode.
• On-device flight activity and alarm preferences.

Default detection settings: within 3 nautical miles of an eligible airport, sustained descent of at least 150 ft/min for 20 seconds, and within 2,500 feet above the airport’s published elevation.

IMPORTANT LIMITATIONS
This app does not sense landing-gear position and cannot determine whether gear is extended or locked. It does not replace an aircraft’s gear-warning system, checklists, approved procedures, or pilot judgment. Configure and test the app before flight; do not interact with the phone during critical phases of flight.

Internet access is required on the phone and tracking service. ADS-B coverage, aircraft filtering, inaccurate or delayed data, network outages, service availability, and Apple push delivery can delay or prevent reminders. Airport-relative height uses approximate ADS-B barometric altitude; it is not terrain clearance.

Notifications and sounds must be allowed. This version uses Time Sensitive notifications and respects Silent mode, notification sound settings, Focus permissions, and device volume. Critical Alerts that override Silent mode are not included in this version.

DATA SOURCES
Public aircraft positions: ADSB.lol (ODbL). Airport data: OurAirports (public domain). No phone GPS, microphone, contacts, or advertising tracking is used.

Support: harvard@usweixin.com

name: Floox CRM
description:
Floox CRM on your phone puts your sales team inside every conversation. Leads that reach you on WhatsApp or through your website chat show up instantly, with the full history and everything the AI already knows about them.

CHATS THAT FEEL LIKE WHATSAPP
• Inbox with unread counts, previews and times
• Reply with text, photos and voice notes (hold to record)
• Delivery ticks: sent, delivered and read
• AI replies are labelled, and you switch the AI on or off per chat
• 24-hour window closed? Send an approved template in one tap

YOUR LEADS, ORGANIZED
• Search, stage filters and sort by score
• AI-generated profile: score, interest, objections and summary
• Pipeline stages, notes, comments and upcoming meetings
• Call, copy the number or open the chat right from the lead

NEVER MISS A MESSAGE
• Push notifications for every new message
• Tap a notification to open the right chat
• Light and dark mode, Portuguese and English

Floox CRM is for teams already using Floox CRM on the web (crm.floox.ai). Sign in with the same account.

name: FlowPad: Pad, Click e VS
description:
O FlowPad junta em um só app o que você leva para o palco: pad contínuo, click, drums, texturas e o seu VS.

PAD EM CAMADAS
• Pads contínuos nos 12 tons, com troca de tom em crossfade, sem corte seco.
• Até 4 camadas de timbre (Worship, Intense, Chops e Angel Choir), cada uma com o seu fader, para você montar o seu som ao vivo.
• High-cut para escurecer o pad e encaixar na banda.

CLICK COM SAÍDA SEPARADA
• Metrônomo com tap tempo, compasso e acento no tempo 1.
• Saída dividida: pad em um canal, click no outro. Com um cabo Y, o pad vai para a mesa e o click para o fone da banda.

DRUMS E TEXTURAS
• 8 pads de drum no estilo octapad: boom, kick, palmas, tom, shaker, hihat, swell e crash.
• Texturas de ambiente (pássaros, chuva e fogo) para os momentos de oração.

MÚSICAS
• Salve cada música com tudo junto: tom, mistura das camadas, andamento do click e texturas.
• No culto é um toque: a cena inteira entra de uma vez.

STUDIO: O SEU VS
• Importe a sua multitrack (MP3, WAV ou .zip) direto dos arquivos do iPhone.
• O app reconhece click e guia pelo nome e manda os dois para o fone da banda.
• Mixer por track com volume, mudo, solo e medidor de sinal.
• Mude o tom do VS em tempo real. Click e guia continuam no tom original.
• Exporte a mixagem em MP3 e compartilhe com o grupo.
• Os seus arquivos ficam guardados no aparelho. Nada de pagar nuvem.

FEITO PARA O AO VIVO
• Continua tocando com a tela bloqueada e com o iPhone no silencioso.
• Funciona sem internet depois de instalado.
• Tela fixa, sem rolagem, com tudo ao alcance do dedo.

PLANOS
• Free: os 12 tons, 2 camadas de pad e crossfade.
• Pro: tudo liberado. 4 camadas, click, drums, texturas, músicas ilimitadas e o Studio com VS, mudança de tom e exportação. Assinatura anual ou mensal.

A assinatura é cobrada na sua conta Apple e renova automaticamente, a menos que seja cancelada pelo menos 24 horas antes do fim do período. Você gerencia ou cancela nos ajustes da sua conta Apple.

Termos de Uso: https://flow-pad-five.vercel.app/termos/
Política de Privacidade: https://flow-pad-five.vercel.app/privacidade/

name: Fossil Brush Studio
description:
Discover the details beneath the dust in Fossil Brush Studio, a fossil restoration puzzle game.

Carefully brush away layers of soil, choose the right tool, and protect each specimen as you work. Once the fragments are uncovered, rotate and fit them into their matching outlines to complete the restoration.

Explore 100 levels that combine careful brushing with spatial puzzles. Pay attention to your brushing speed, preserve specimen integrity, and complete each challenge before time runs out. Built-in hints, extra time, and temporary protection offer help when you need it.

Designed for casual puzzle players and fossil enthusiasts, Fossil Brush Studio offers a hands-on challenge that rewards patience, observation, and precision. It provides an accessible way to enjoy fossil-themed puzzles without specialist knowledge or equipment.

Play offline, save your progress locally, and return whenever you are ready for your next restoration. No account or login is required.

name: FSP-to-Go
description:
Prepare for the medical language exam (FSP) anytime, anywhere — on iPhone, iPad, Mac and Apple Watch.

FSP-to-Go brings together medical terminology, clinical cases, exam questions and interactive exercises to make preparing for the Fachsprachprüfung more convenient, varied and effective.

Everything you need to prepare

• 1005 medical terms to expand your professional vocabulary.
• 386 clinical cases based on published accounts from people who have taken real exams.
• Reference values for laboratory tests and other medical investigations.
• Exam questions to practise medical terminology and professional communication in German.

Learn in the way that suits you

Medical terminology

Learn medical terms with interactive flashcards, test your knowledge in different quiz modes and practise using the correct articles.

Clinical cases and exam questions

Explore situations based on FSP candidates’ experiences, become familiar with typical exam questions and improve your medical communication skills.

Learn through play

Reinforce your knowledge with built-in mini-games that make regular practice engaging.

Learn from mistakes

Return to challenging questions, review your mistakes and give more attention to topics that need further practice.

See your progress

Track your achievements, complete learning activities and fill your progress rings. Even short daily sessions bring you closer to your goal.

No subscriptions or hidden charges

All learning materials and app features are available without additional subscriptions or hidden in-app purchases.

Important information

FSP-to-Go is an independent educational app for preparing for the Fachsprachprüfung Medizin. It is not an official product of examination boards and does not guarantee that you will pass the exam.

Clinical cases are based on publicly available accounts and recollections from exam candidates. As these materials reflect personal experience, they may contain inaccuracies, incomplete information or subjective interpretations.

FSP-to-Go is solely for language training for foreign-trained doctors preparing for the Fachsprachprüfung Medizin. Clinical cases, exam situations and reference values are learning materials, not official clinical recommendations. They must not be used to diagnose or treat real patients or make clinical decisions.

Medical information may become outdated. For medical questions, consult current official sources, clinical guidelines and qualified professionals.

Source links are available in the laboratory section, in disease study screens, and in About and Settings.

name: Fuzzy Radio
description:
Fuzzy Radio is an independent radio station for guitar pop, post-punk, indie and alternative rock, from new wave and Britpop to the best new bands. Online worldwide and on DAB in East London and Essex.

LIVE

Tap play and you’re listening. See the show on air and the song that’s playing, with its artwork. Playback carries on in the background and on your lock screen, so you can keep listening while you use other apps.

SCHEDULE

See what’s on today and for the week ahead, from the music shows to our presenters’ programmes in the evenings.

RECENTS

Heard something you liked? See the last 20 songs we played, with the time each one started.

The app is free, has no adverts, needs no account and doesn’t collect any personal data.

name: GantFlow
description:
PLAN SMARTER. TRACK PROGRESS. REACH YOUR GOALS.

GoalFlow Timeline brings task management, interactive Gantt charts, and long-term goal tracking together in one powerful planning app. Organize your day, visualize your schedule, and connect everyday tasks to your bigger ambitions.

INTERACTIVE GANTT TIMELINES

Visualize your schedule instead of navigating endless task lists.

• Hourly, daily, weekly, and monthly timeline views
• Scrollable schedules for short-term and long-term planning
• Adaptive layouts that fit more tasks into your calendar
• Timeline and list views for different planning styles
• Flexible task scheduling and rescheduling

LONG-TERM GOAL TRACKING

Turn ambitious goals into manageable steps.

• Create long-term goals with associated subtasks
• Track completion automatically based on finished tasks
• Organize tasks by their associated goals
• Automatically inherit colors from parent goals
• Monitor progress without manually updating percentages

TASK MANAGEMENT

Stay organized as priorities change.

• Create and edit tasks with titles, dates, and details
• Assign stages: To Do, Tracking, Postponed, or Done
• Set custom colors for independent tasks
• Move tasks as your schedule evolves
• Navigate between calendar and list views

TASK DEPENDENCIES

Understand what needs to happen before the next step.

• Link tasks through prerequisites
• Review prerequisite details before selecting them
• Organize related activities into structured workflows
• Plan complex projects with greater clarity

REMINDERS AND DATA MANAGEMENT

Keep your plans accessible and under your control.

• Set reminders for important tasks
• Save your planning data locally on your device
• Import and export JSON backups
• Import compatible GoalFlow Timeline Android backups

ONE APP FOR TODAY AND TOMORROW

Whether you're planning daily responsibilities, organizing a project, tracking personal development, or working toward a major milestone, GoalFlow Timeline helps you see what needs to get done and how it contributes to your future.

Make progress visible. Turn plans into action. Build toward what matters.

name: GearheadPass - ASE Tech Prep
description:
Prepare for the ASE Automobile tests A1–A8 and the G1 Maintenance & Light Repair test with 1,700+ practice questions written to the current ASE task lists.

ALL NINE TESTS IN ONE APP
Every test has its own section with its content areas and its own mock test:
• A1 Engine Repair
• A2 Automatic Transmission/Transaxle
• A3 Manual Drive Train & Axles
• A4 Suspension & Steering
• A5 Brakes
• A6 Electrical/Electronic Systems
• A7 Heating & Air Conditioning
• A8 Engine Performance
• G1 Maintenance & Light Repair

EXAM-STYLE TIMED MOCKS
• Each mock has its test's number of scored questions and time limit (for example, A5: 45 questions in 75 minutes)
• Questions are drawn across the content areas in proportion to the test's weighting
• One countdown for the whole test, free movement between questions, flag questions to come back to, and a review grid before you submit
• Results by content area show where to focus next, and your mock history tracks your progress

QUESTIONS LIKE THE REAL TEST
• Technician A / Technician B questions and EXCEPT questions, as on the exam
• 350+ exhibit questions with wiring diagrams, data tables, scan-tool data and photos of worn parts
• Diagnosis scenarios with the readings you need to reason to the answer
• Every question has an explanation that covers why the right answer is right and why the others are wrong

ENGLISH AND SPANISH
• Use the whole app in English or Spanish
• Switch any single question between English and Spanish with one tap

STUDY YOUR WAY
• Practice by content area and track your progress in each one
• Retake the questions you got wrong
• Flash cards for quick review

TRY IT FREE
The free version includes 5 questions from every content area, and you can take as many mock tests as you like using those questions. Unlock all 1,700+ questions and full-length mocks with a monthly, 3-month, 6-month or annual subscription, or a one-time lifetime purchase.

Subscriptions renew automatically unless cancelled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. Manage or cancel them in your Apple Account settings.

Not affiliated with or endorsed by the National Institute for Automotive Service Excellence (ASE). ASE is a registered trademark of NIASE.

Privacy Policy: https://www.webrichsoftware.com/privacy.html
Terms of Use: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/

name: Gearworks Islands
description:
Gearworks Islands is a STEM puzzle adventure with 13 islands, from Grade 1 through College.

Explore a colorful map, walk into workshops, and learn by doing. Solve challenges in math, science, engineering, and computer science. Wire realistic circuits. Program a helper robot. Then spend the parts you earned on a monster truck and race your rival, Nix Bolt.

ISLANDS AND WORKSHOPS
• Sprout Shore through Rover Rocks — one island for each grade, 1 to 12
• Balance Bench, Gear Gallery, and other labs that grow more challenging as you go
• Circuit Shed: connect a battery and LED, then series and parallel circuits, 3-way and 4-way switches, and house wire colors, with a safety note
• Robot Helper: program Pip with steps, loops, and simple sensors
• Build a truck and race — hills, mud, and power all matter

PLAY YOUR WAY
• Add local player profiles on the device and switch between them with a name list
• Progress is saved on the device — no account to create
• Plays offline, in landscape, on iPhone and iPad
• No ads

SUBSCRIPTION
Gearworks Islands is free to download. Sprout Shore (Grade 1) is free to play. Full access to every island is a subscription: 7 days free, then $4.99 a year (or the equivalent in your local App Store), unless you cancel at least 24 hours before the end of the trial or the current year. Payment is charged to your Apple Account. The subscription auto-renews unless you turn off auto-renew in your Apple Account settings. A parent gate appears before a purchase starts.

name: GESP码力觉醒
description:
「GESP 码力觉醒」是一款面向 10–20 岁青少年及编程初学者的原生 iPhone / iPad / Mac 三端编程考级伴学工具，覆盖 C++ 与 Python 1–8 级全阶段备考与算法思维训练。

【核心功能亮点】
1. 阶梯绘本课程（C++ / Python 1–8 级）
用通俗易懂的编程故事、生活案例与分步代码讲解核心语法，从零基础输入输出到递归、动规与图论，循序渐进掌握考点。

2. 历年全真题库与举一反三变式
收录多期真题（单选题、判断题、编程大题），每题配备逐行解析、常见易错点提示，并提供针对性的举一反三变式练习，告别死记硬背。

3. 算法动画室（可视化单步执行）
把抽象的排序、查找、递推、栈与队列、深搜广搜转化为可单步播放的交互动画与变量状态追踪，帮助孩子真正看懂代码每一步是怎么跑的。

4. 全真限时模拟考场与学情诊断
90 分钟沉浸式限时模考，客观题自动判分、编程题支持测试用例评测，考后生成多维度知识掌握度诊断与薄弱点复盘。

5. 免配安全云端代码沙盒
无需在本机折腾复杂编译器环境，打开即可编写并运行 C++ / Python 代码，智能代码诊断贴心提示常见语法错误。

6. 智能错题本与荣誉勋章系统
结合艾宾浩斯记忆规律自动安排错题重练，通过连续打卡与徽章成就激励孩子养成每日编程习惯。学习进度与错题记录安全保存在设备本地沙盒中，离线也可随时刷题复习。

name: GestionaCleaner Cleaning
seller_name: TCH-INNO FIGURE OUT & SOLVE IT S.L.
description:
GestionaCleaner is the app for the staff of cleaning companies that use the GestionaCleaner platform. Your company creates your account: there is no sign-up in the app.

With the app you can:
• See your services for the day, with the address and directions.
• Clock in and close each service, also without coverage (it is sent when coverage returns).
• Tick off the work done and the materials, and report incidents with photos.
• Check your working hours and request overtime.
• If you are a supervisor: planning, supervisions and site contacts.

Location is only checked when you clock in or out, to know how far you are from the site. It is not used in the background and your location is not stored.

You need a user account from your company to log in.

name: GIM - Workout Log
description:
GIM is a gym log built around one idea: you should see what your training actually does.

LOG FAST
• Start a workout from a template or from scratch
• Sets, reps, weight, timed sets (planks, holds) with a built-in timer
• Rest timer, supersets, warm-up sets, notes
• Suggested loads from your last sessions (double progression)
• Live Activity and widgets for your running workout

SEE YOUR MUSCLES
• A detailed muscle map with 35 muscle parts, coloured by how much you trained them
• Weekly set targets per muscle group and per muscle part
• Insights that show what to train next

102 BUILT-IN EXERCISES
• Muscle roles from ExRx.net and peer-reviewed research
• Forms for each movement: equipment, grip, handle, stance
• Instructions and common mistakes, home and outdoor options
• Add your own exercises, or edit the built-in ones

TRACK PROGRESS
• Records, estimated 1RM and charts for every exercise and form
• Body weight, height and body measurements, progress photos
• Apple Health integration
• Import from Strong or Hevy, export to CSV

YOURS
• Your data is stored on your iPhone and in your private iCloud, so it follows you to a new phone
• No account, no ads, no tracking
• Nine app colours, with an icon that follows your choice
• English and Hungarian

PRICING
Everything is open for the first 7 days. After that, your own exercises, workouts and templates keep working; the built-in exercises and the muscle map unlock with a single one-time purchase. No subscription.

name: GitaScroll - Bhagavad Gita
description:
GitaScroll turns the Bhagavad-gita into a feed you can scroll. Swipe up and each verse comes alive: narrated in English in a deep, calm voice, set to its own music, and acted out on screen by glowing animated figures, so you see what Krishna is saying while you hear it.

Five minutes of scrolling, and you have taken in wisdom that has guided people for thousands of years.

WHAT YOU GET
• One verse per screen, narrated in English with word-by-word captions
• A unique animated scene for every verse that acts out its meaning
• A different mythic music track for every verse
• Tap any Sanskrit word (shown in romanized IAST) to see what it means
• Word-for-word breakdowns for every verse
• Short quizzes between verses to help the teaching stick
• Like, save and share your favourite verses
• A library of every verse, plus your saved ones
• Plays even with your iPhone on silent; no sign-up needed

NEW VERSES COMING SOON
More verses from the Gita are on the way, each with its own narration, music and animated scene, so there is always something new to scroll.

Made for anyone curious about the Bhagavad-gita, whether you are reading it for the first time or have studied it for years.

name: GlamPeek: Makeup Mirror
description:
GlamPeek is a pocket makeup mirror for iPhone. Open the front camera, choose a detail to inspect, and adjust the screen light from cool to neutral or warm white.

- Use 1×, 2×, 3×, pinch zoom and pan, with a visible full-face reset.
- Freeze a frame for inspection, then return to the live mirror.
- Capture an eye-makeup check with a 3- or 5-second timer. The completion signal follows successful photo capture. Test the signal first or choose an ordinary photo timer.
- Pin a selected area from your current photo beside the live mirror. Zoom, flip, move, resize or collapse the reference independently.
- Save up to five editable settings presets. Use left-handed controls, landscape layouts and quick-launch widgets.
- Save to Photos or open the system share sheet only when you choose.

All V1.0 features are free with no time limit and no ads. Images are processed on your device. Leaving the app or locking the screen ends unsaved temporary checks and references. System photo syncing and sharing follow your system settings.

Digital zoom may reduce clarity. Screen settings and lighting affect color. GlamPeek does not provide beautification, professional color matching or skin diagnosis.

Privacy Policy: https://glampeek.expdf.cn/en/privacy/

name: Glide Remote: TV Touchpad
description:
Glide Remote turns your iPhone into a fast touch remote for compatible smart TVs on your home Wi-Fi. The everyday remote is free. Unlock Pro once, if you want the extras.

CORE REMOTE (FREE)
• Find and pair a compatible TV on the same Wi-Fi.
• Navigation, OK, Back, Home, volume, mute, playback, colour keys, and power.
• Touchpad: swipe to move the pointer, tap to click, two fingers to scroll.
• A real keyboard, including Arabic, for TV search boxes and on-screen keyboards.
• Default pages and shortcuts for apps and inputs.
• Power on with Wake-on-LAN when the TV allows “Turn on via Wi-Fi”.

GLIDE REMOTE PRO (ONE-TIME UNLOCK)
• Gamepad, Racing, and Swipe modes, with Classic and 3D styles and saved mappings.
• Remote Cast: see the TV picture on your phone and touch it to move the pointer.
• Full-screen overlay controls while you watch the picture.
• Customise pages and buttons: add, remove, rename, and reorder.

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
• Works only on your local network.
• No account, no ads, no analytics, no tracking.
• Your TV pairing key stays on your phone.
• The Pro unlock is a one-time Apple In-App Purchase. There is no subscription. Payment is handled by Apple.

TRY IT WITHOUT A TV
Demo mode lets you explore the free screens before you connect. Restore Purchases is available if you reinstall or change iPhone.

Requirements: a compatible smart TV on the same Wi-Fi as your iPhone. For power-on, enable “Turn on via Wi-Fi” in the TV settings. iPhone, iOS 17 or later.

Glide Remote is an independent app. It is not affiliated with, endorsed by, or sponsored by any TV manufacturer. All product names, logos, and brands are the property of their respective owners.

name: Glucio: Blood Sugar Log
description:
Glucio is a simple blood sugar diary for your glucose meter. Write down a reading in seconds — fasting, before or after a meal — see whether it is in your target, and bring a clear logbook to your doctor.

FAST ENTRY
• Big keypad in mg/dL, mmol/L or g/L
• Fasting, before meal, after meal, bedtime or night — Glucio suggests it from the time of day
• Breakfast, lunch, dinner or snack, 1 or 2 hours after
• Carbs, insulin units and notes, if you want — for your records only
• On iPhone with Apple Intelligence, photograph your meter’s screen: the number is filled in, you check it and save.

YOUR TARGETS
• ADA targets for diabetes, ADA targets in pregnancy, or the numbers your doctor gave you
• Every reading is marked: low, in target, above target — with color, word and icon
• A clear warning for very low and very high readings

AFTER MEALS
• A reminder 1 or 2 hours after you start eating
• The day strip shows fasting, before and after each meal at a glance
• Averages by meal and how much your sugar rises after breakfast, lunch and dinner

REPORT FOR YOUR DOCTOR
• PDF logbook in the familiar paper format: days × fasting, breakfast, lunch, dinner, bedtime, night
• Averages, time in target, low readings, estimated HbA1c and your lab HbA1c results
• Send it by email or messenger, or print it; CSV table for Excel

MORE
• Morning fasting reminder
• 3-day 7-point profile: before and after each meal and at bedtime
• Medications with reminders
• Profiles for your family on one phone, each with their own targets

YOUR DATA STAYS YOURS
• Stored only on your phone. No account, no ads, no cloud of ours
• Optional copy to Apple Health and a backup file you can save anywhere

GLUCIO PRO
Charts and reports for any period, the 7-point profile, more reminders, medications and family profiles. Yearly with 7 days free, or a one-time lifetime purchase.

IMPORTANT
Glucio does not measure blood sugar: use your glucose meter. Glucio does not calculate insulin doses, is not a medical device and does not replace your doctor. Targets are set by your doctor. Discuss your results with a doctor.

Privacy policy: https://glucio.sanjardev.uz/privacy
Terms of use: https://glucio.sanjardev.uz/terms

name: Golem Temple Maze
description:
Wake the Lava Golem and escape the ancient temple!

Explore 20 hand-built temple mazes filled with vines, slides, trapdoors, silver thorn patches and hidden coins. Find the golden key, dodge the emerald bugs (or squish them!), and open the treasure chest to unlock the next level.

FIVE ELEMENTAL GOLEMS
• Lava Golem — the original stone giant
• Ice Golem — fires volleys of ice thorns
• Fire Golem — hurls blazing fireballs
• Thunder Golem — calls down yellow lightning
• Void Golem — strikes with purple lightning

ROLL, JUMP AND SMASH
Curl up into a rock ball to roll at speed, jump gaps, and slam the ground to stun bugs around you.

PLAY TOGETHER
Host a game and share your 6-letter code — friends join instantly and explore the same maze with you in co-op.

COLLECT AND PROGRESS
• Gather temple coins in every level
• Claim a daily gift with a 7-day streak
• Climb the ranks from Novice Explorer to Golem Master
• Track your best times, bugs squished, keys found and more

Original music and sound effects, touch controls made for iPhone and iPad.

name: Goow
description:
Move freely with Goow. Rent a vehicle from an owner by the hour, day or trip, or list your own vehicle and make it available when you’re happy to rent it out.
Find a vehicle for your plans: Need a car for a few errands, a business appointment or a weekend trip? Browse available vehicles and compare rates, availability and booking rules before you book.
Book for the time you need: Choose from hourly, daily or trip-based bookings, depending on what the owner offers. Review the vehicle details and rental terms before confirming.
List your own vehicle: Set your rates, choose when your vehicle is available and tell renters the rules for using it. Keep your listing up to date as your plans change.

name: GravityPainterr
description:
What if you could paint the pull of gravity itself?
In Gravity Painter you never touch the ball. Instead, you draw gravity zones on the board and let physics do the rest. Blue pulls down, red pulls up, green pulls left, and purple pulls right. Guide the glowing ball past obstacles, hazards and moving platforms, and into the portal.
HOW IT WORKS
Pick a color and drag to paint gravity zones
Press Launch and watch the ball react
Your paint is limited, so plan carefully
Finish with less paint to earn up to three stars
10 HANDCRAFTED LEVELS
Each level introduces a new idea:
Reverse gravity and sideways pulls
Bridges across gaps
Moving platforms and pistons
Mazes with narrow corridors and hazards
Overlapping zones, where pulls add together
A final test that combines everything
FEATURES
Real-time physics with momentum, bounce and friction
Undo, eraser, clear-all and restart
A hint that can paint a working solution for you
Neon visuals, glowing portals and particle effects
Sound effects with a mute option, plus haptics
Progress saved automatically
Plays fully offline, with no ads and no accounts
Paint the pull. Guide the ball. Master gravity.

name: Grid Down: Merge & Survive
description:
It's 3:17 in the morning and the power is out. Every clock in Alder Creek stopped two minutes before the lights went. Your father's bunker has a workbench, a battered crate of supplies and a list of rules he never explained. Merge your way out of the dark.

MERGE TO BUILD
Tap a crate to pull out supplies, then drag two matching items together to make something better. Matches become lanterns, lanterns become generators, scraps become fence panels. Ten supply chains, from food and water to comms and power, each with its own crate that gets stronger as you level it up.

FILL YOUR NEIGHBORS' ORDERS
Walt, Dale, the Lindqvists and the rest of the court are counting on you. Fill their orders to earn stars and coins, and earn their trust. Every household has a story, and some of them are keeping secrets.

RESTORE THE PLACES OF ALDER CREEK
Spend stars to repair the kitchen, the garage, the substation and more. Each restored place moves a mystery story forward across 24 chapters, told through short scenes with Walt, Dale, Hollis and a dog named Buck (you can rename him).

PIN THE CLUES ON THE WALL
Every chapter gives you a clue. Pin them to the Wall, follow the red string, and work out what happened at 3:17. Learn the seven rules your father left behind.

LISTEN TO THE 9 PM BROADCAST
Every evening at nine, a voice comes over the radio and reads names into the dark. Tune in to hear it live and earn a reward. Miss one and Hollis will tell you what you missed. An optional 8:55 PM reminder is a local notification on your phone.

HOLD THE FENCE
After dark, shapes come out of the fog. Sweep your lantern across the fence and they stop where the light touches them. It is a quick 45 second reflex game with real stakes for your bench.

FAIR, CALM AND OFFLINE
No ads. No account. Everything runs on your phone and works without a connection. Your progress is saved on your device and can be kept in your own iCloud. A Supply Run leaderboard shows a simulated board of story characters, not other players.

OPTIONAL PURCHASES
Grid Down is free to play. You can buy Insulators (the game currency), kits and a seasonal Lineman's Pass. What you buy has fixed contents, nothing you pay for is random, and the drop rates for free crates are published in the Co-op counter under "Drop rates". Non-consumable purchases can be restored from Settings.

Grid Down is a work of fiction. Alder Creek, Larkin County and its co-op are invented. Made by Hive Asset Group, LLC (Spacesuit Game Studios).

name: Groga
description:
Groga is a slice-reading trainer for potters who laminate coloured clay. Stack stained clays into a loaf, fold it, roll it, restack it, pull a wire through, and the pattern on the cut face is already decided. Groga teaches you to see that pattern coming before you cut.

HOW IT WORKS

1. Pick your clays.
Tell Groga which stained clays sit on your shelf: porcelain, cobalt, yellow, pink, red brown, black, green or teal. Those colours become your bench palette and the colours every drill deals.

2. Read the cut.
A fresh slice appears on the plate. Four move sequences sit below it, and only one of them made that slice. The other three are near misses built by changing a single move, a fold count or the band order, so every wrong answer shows you exactly which step you misread. Switch to Predict the slice and it runs the other way: you get the loaf and the moves, and you choose the slice they produce.

3. Learn the twelve moves.
Stack, half fold, accordion, spiral roll, bullseye wrap, cane bundle, checker restack, chevron restack, twist, bias slice, push wave and taper stretch. Each move has a before and after drawing, numbered steps, the tools it needs and the faults it tends to cause, with the cure for each.

4. Build on the bench.
Add layers from 1 to 12 mm, reorder them, then chain up to five moves and watch the slice redraw as you change them. Choose a target form, from a pinch bowl to a pendant, and Groga works out the loaf height, how many slices you get at that thickness, the seam count and the shrinkage spread between your clays. If the spread is wide enough to risk a seam crack, the bench tells you before you wedge a single block.

5. Drill your own slices.
Photograph a real slice from your studio, or pick one from your library, crop it square and record the moves that made it. It becomes a drill card in My slices, so you drill on your own work.

6. Keep score and keep the sheet.
Each round ends with your score, the slices you missed and mastery for each move, so the next round can target your weakest fold. Save a loaf and export its sheet to Photos: the slice, every band from top to bottom and every move in order.

ALSO ON THE SHELF
- A clay shelf with stain and shrinkage figures for all eight clays
- A tool rack: wire, tissue blade, rolling pin and guide sticks, fettling knife, metal rib, slip brush, turntable, plastic sheet
- A fault atlas of seven laminating faults, each with its cause and cure
- Rounds of 8, 12 or 16 slices, readouts in millimetres or inches, step hints on or off

Groga works fully offline and needs no sign-up. Cut the next slice, read it, and get it right before the wire goes through.

name: Grovega
description:
Grovega shows the numbers from your ad accounts on your phone, in Grovega Insights.

Connect your Google Ads and Meta Ads accounts once on the web, and the app keeps your numbers up to date. Open it to see how yesterday, last week or last month went.

WHAT YOU SEE
• Spend, revenue, ROAS, conversions, cost per conversion, clicks, impressions and click through rate, each compared with the period before
• A trend chart you can scrub with your finger
• Every campaign from every platform in one searchable list
• Your last Overview, saved on your phone, so you can still read it when you have no signal

STAY IN THE LOOP
• A short alert when an ad account needs you to sign in again
• A heads up before a Meta login runs out
• A message when an account has failed to update twice in a row
Nothing else. No marketing messages.

PRIVATE BY DEFAULT
• Unlock with Face ID or Touch ID, with your phone passcode as the fallback
• We only ever read your numbers. We never change, pause or create anything in your ad accounts
• Disconnect an account at any time and its numbers are deleted

HOW IT WORKS
Sign in with your Grovega email and password. Connect and reconnect your ad accounts on the web, in your browser, where Google and Meta ask you to sign in. Your plan is managed on the web too.

Grovega Insights is a view only dashboard. It is not affiliated with Google or Meta.

name: GunCollector: Gun Inventory
description:
Know exactly what you own.

GunCollector keeps your firearms, ammo, NFA items and accessories in one place — and it works at the range, in the safe room, and anywhere else your phone has no signal.

ADD A FIREARM FROM A PHOTO
Take a picture and GunCollector identifies the make, model and caliber and fills in the specifications for you to review. Scan the serial number with the camera instead of typing it. Ammo, accessories and NFA items can be added from a photo too.

YOUR WHOLE COLLECTION, IN YOUR POCKET
Photos, serial numbers, purchase details, notes and receipts for every item. Search and filter the collection, and see firearms, rounds on hand and estimated value on the dashboard.

RANGE TRIPS AND ROUND COUNTS
Log a range trip and the rounds you fired are deducted from your ammo inventory and added to each firearm's cleaning counter automatically.

MEASURE YOUR GROUPS
Photograph your target, mark the holes, and GunCollector calculates group size in inches, MOA and mils, plus mean radius.

DOPE CARDS
Create and edit DOPE cards for each rifle and keep them with you — no printouts to lose.

NFA RECORDS
Track suppressors, SBRs, SBSs and other NFA items with their paperwork photos, so your records are on your phone when you need them.

MAINTENANCE
Round-count-based cleaning reminders and a full maintenance history for every firearm.

WORKS OFFLINE
Your collection is stored on your phone, so everything is readable with no signal. Changes you make offline sync automatically when you're back online.

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
• Your offline copy is encrypted on the device.
• Optional Face ID lock and optional screenshot blocking.
• Location data is stripped from every photo before it's uploaded.
• No ads and no ad tracking. Your data is never sold.

WORKS WITH THE WEB APP
Everything syncs with GunCollector on the web at guncollector.app, where you'll also find insurance valuation reports and chronograph import.

GunCollector is a record-keeping tool for firearms you already own. It does not sell, list or transfer firearms or ammunition.

name: Hadir Chat
description:
Hadir Chat puts your customer conversations in your pocket. Messages from WhatsApp, Instagram, Facebook Messenger, your website chat and email arrive in one inbox your team shares, so you can reply, assign and close a conversation from your phone just as you would on the web dashboard.

The app is built Arabic first, fully right to left, and runs in English when your phone is set to English.

Shared inbox
• Reply with text, a photo, a file or a voice message
• Assign a conversation to a teammate or a team; add labels and private notes
• Make a sensitive conversation private to you, and move a customer to a cheaper channel with a personal link
• Use canned responses and macros
• Search conversations, customers and messages; Arabic search ignores differences in how hamza and taa marbuta are written
• See each conversation's service level and how long is left to reply

Hadir AI
• A suggested reply you review before sending
• A summary of the conversation and suggested labels
• Improve the wording of your reply, fix mistakes and pick a tone
• The text of a voice message, shown under it
• Ask Hadir AI about the conversation in front of you
• Your account's Hadir AI knowledge sources, which administrators can add to from the phone too

The whole customer on one screen
• Past conversations, and the deals, tasks and appointments linked to the customer

Sales and follow-up
• A deals board by pipeline stage; move a deal from one stage to the next
• Send a quotation to the customer inside the conversation
• Today's and overdue tasks in one list
• Companies and the customers who belong to them

Appointments
• Your agenda by day or by week
• Book an appointment for a customer from the open times, straight from the conversation

For administrators
• Create a WhatsApp campaign from Meta-approved templates and follow delivery and reads
• Turn automatic replies on or off and review their results
• Set the prayer-time pause
• Short reports on conversations, response times and customer satisfaction
• Team availability, roles and the activity log

Notifications
• An alert for a new message, a conversation assigned to you, or a mention
• Alerts for tasks, appointments, service levels and campaigns
• Choose in Settings which ones reach you

Sign-in and permissions
• Email and password with two-step verification, or sign in with your company account
• Everyone sees what their role allows, exactly as on the web

The app needs a Hadir Chat account. Some features appear depending on what your account has turned on and on your role in it.

name: Haine Serralheria
description:
Haine Serralheria é o sistema da serralheria no celular. Você faz o orçamento da obra, manda no WhatsApp, o cliente aprova pelo link e o estoque baixa quando a obra termina.

ORÇAMENTO E OBRA
• Monte o orçamento com material do estoque, mão de obra, frete e desconto. Você vê o lucro e o cliente vê o total.
• Escolha o orçamento detalhado ou o simplificado.
• Ponha fotos do serviço ou do projeto, que o cliente vê junto com o orçamento.
• Mande no WhatsApp. O cliente abre o link e aprova com o nome dele.
• Acompanhe cada obra do orçamento até a entrega.

ESTOQUE, BARRAS E RETALHOS
• Cadastre o material com medida, espessura e preço por barra.
• Chegou material? Lance a entrada e o saldo sobe na hora.
• Sobrou pedaço de barra ou chapa? Guarde como retalho. Antes de cortar barra nova, o app mostra os retalhos daquele material.
• Importe e exporte o estoque por planilha.

FATURAMENTO
• Quanto entrou no mês, o lucro e a meta.
• Vendas de balcão e cadastro de clientes.

A EQUIPE
• Convide quem trabalha com você por um link. Cada pessoa entra com o perfil dela: administrador, vendas ou oficina.
• A oficina não vê custo nem lucro.

NO CELULAR E NO COMPUTADOR
Entre com a mesma conta no celular e no computador (haine.pages.dev). O que você faz num aparece no outro.

Feito no Brasil, para serralheiros.

ASSINATURA
O Haine Serralheria funciona por assinatura mensal ou anual, com 3 dias grátis para começar. Quem assina é o dono, e a assinatura vale para toda a equipe da serralheria. Ela renova sozinha até você cancelar nos Ajustes do iPhone (toque no seu nome > Assinaturas), pelo menos 24 horas antes do fim do período.

name: Handy Mouse: Phone Trackpad

WORKS LIKE A REAL MOUSE
• Left and right buttons. Press and hold to drag.

name: HandyHood
description:

HandyHood is like a ride app, but for skills. Post anything you need done and say what you'd like to pay. People nearby with the right skills - neighbors and local pros - send you their price. You pick the one you like.

name: Helios: UV Index Widget, Timer
description:
How many minutes can your skin take in the sun right now? Helios is a UV index app with a home screen widget, your burn time for each SPF and a sunscreen reminder. UV index for your city, hour by hour, and a reminder when it is time to reapply.

UV INDEX NOW AND BY THE HOUR
The current UV index in one big number with its level, from low to extreme. Under it, the forecast for every hour of daylight and the protection window: the hours when the UV is above 3 and your skin needs cover. Today's UV index, the current UV index right now and the day's max UV in one place, with the UV forecast hour by hour. Drag the wheel to any hour, or tap one in the list, to see its UV, temperature, cloud cover and what to wear. A simple UV tracker for your day.

BURN TIME FOR YOUR SKIN TYPE
Choose your skin type once, from I to VI. Helios shows how long you can stay in the sun before sunburn with no sunscreen, SPF 15, SPF 30 and SPF 50, side by side, at today's UV level. Change the sunscreen and the minutes change. The six skin types run from very fair to dark, and Helios also shows how long your skin takes to burn at noon.

SUNSCREEN TIMER AND REMINDER
Pick the sunscreen you just put on and start the timer. It counts the time that application protects you and sends a reminder when it runs out. Reapplied? One tap restarts it. Choose SPF 15, 30 or 50 and the SPF timer counts down, with a banner showing the time left.

UV INDEX WIDGET
Small and medium widgets for your home screen, plus two for your lock screen: the current UV index with its color, or the day's wheel with the protection window. They work with no connection and all of them are free. Helios Pro adds a large widget, a strip with the UV now, today's max and your time to sunburn, a sunscreen timer widget with a live countdown, and four color themes.

ANY CITY
Type a city and Helios shows its UV index, sunrise, sunset, temperature and cloud cover. Home, the beach, the mountains, wherever you are going.

UV ALERT AND MORNING REPORT
Every morning, at the time you choose, a notification with the day's peak UV and the hours when your skin needs protection. With Helios Pro, a UV alert notifies you as soon as the UV index goes above 3, 6 or 8, as you choose.

HELIOS PRO
• 3-day forecast, hour by hour
• Threshold alert: a warning when the UV goes above 3, 6 or 8
• Up to 10 cities
• Large widget with the next hours and the next two days
• The UV you received in each timer session, with your history by week, month and year
• Water, sand and snow: burn time and timer adjusted for the surface that reflects the sun
• Strip and timer widgets, and widget colors

One annual plan with a 7-day free trial, or a lifetime purchase.

UV FORECAST FOR TOMORROW AND THE DAY AFTER
With Helios Pro the UV index forecast reaches 3 days, hour by hour, to plan a trip, a run or a day at the beach.

WATER, SAND AND SNOW
These surfaces reflect sunlight, so your skin burns sooner. Tell Helios where you will be and the burn time and the sunscreen timer adjust.

YOUR SUN EXPOSURE
Each sunscreen timer session records the UV you receive. See today's total and your history by week, month and year.

UV INDEX LEVELS
The UV index rates the strength of the sun's ultraviolet radiation: the higher the number, the sooner your skin burns. UV levels: Low 0-2 · Moderate 3-5 · High 6-7 · Very high 8-10 · Extreme 11+. From 3 upwards, sun protection is recommended: sunscreen, a hat and sunglasses, and shade from high levels. Avoid the sun at very high levels and stay out of it at extreme ones.

name: HemCraft Log

MANAGE GARMENT ORDERS
Create orders for alterations, bespoke garments, size adjustments and repairs. Record client requests, garment photos, quotes, due dates and staff assignments. Save drafts and follow each order through your studio’s workflow.

KEEP MEASUREMENTS IN CONTEXT
Record measurements in centimeters or inches, review previous values and flag details for rechecking. Link measurement versions to work orders so each garment retains its original reference.

RECORD PROGRESS & FITTINGS
Track sewing steps, working time, tools and progress photos. Capture fitting feedback, compare original and target dimensions, and link adjustments to rework tasks.

COMPARE BEFORE & AFTER

TRACK MATERIALS

MANAGE PAYMENTS & DELIVERY
Prepare quotes, record deposits and installments, and review outstanding balances. Complete garment quality checks, confirm final measurements and capture the recipient’s handwritten signature at delivery.

KEEP YOUR WORKROOM ORGANIZED
Manage client records, service prices, workflow templates, appointments and reminders. Capture workroom notes with photos and optional on-device English dictation on supported devices.

EXPORT & BACK UP
Create PDF reports and CSV exports, then share them through iOS. Back up and restore your studio records, or connect a shared Files folder to exchange studio data between iPhones with conflict review.

name: Hevanti: Daily Chitas
description:
You finished today's Tanya. Could you explain it to a friend?

Hevanti is daily Chitas for people who want to understand what they learn. The name is Hebrew for "I got it!", and that is the goal for each of the four daily portions: Chumash with Rashi, Tehillim, Tanya and Hayom Yom.

Open the app and today's learning is waiting. Each portion comes two ways:

LESSON. A short explanation in plain language. Examples from regular life, visuals you can tap and play with, and one question at the end to check that it landed.

TEXT. The original, with nekudos, for when you want to learn inside.

Switch between the two whenever you like. Hevanti remembers which one you were in and where you stopped.

WHAT'S INSIDE

• Chumash: the day's aliyah with Rashi
• Tehillim: the portion for the day of the Hebrew month
• Tanya: the day's portion on the Chabad daily schedule, with an explanation beside the text
• Hayom Yom: the entry for today's date
• English translation of the verses when you want it (Metsudah, via Sefaria)
• Parsha calendar for Israel or the Diaspora

MY DAILY TEHILLIM

Build your own daily order: the Rebbe's chapter, the Rebbetzin's chapter, chapter 20 on days without Tachanun, and personal chapters for you and the people you daven for. Enter a name and a birthday, in the Hebrew or the secular calendar, and Hevanti works out the chapter and moves it up on each birthday.

IT TALKS TO YOU

Tell Hevanti your first name and whether to address you as he or she. The lessons speak to you that way. The Torah text and the halacha stay as they are for everyone.

KEEP GOING

• A daily ring that fills as you finish each of the four
• Your streak and your history, day by day
• 14 color palettes and adjustable text size
• Full English and full Hebrew

FREE

Hevanti has no ads and nothing to buy. You don't need an account. Sign in with Apple or Google only if you want your progress on more than one device.

The Rebbe asks every Jew to learn Chitas each day. Hevanti is for the days you want to close the app and say: I got it.

FREE AND PRO

name: Hyttevern
description:
Hyttevern er et rolig, lokalt verktøy for deg som eier eller bruker hytte i Norge.

Når du forlater hytta, er det lett å glemme én av de viktige sikringene. Her kvitterer du ut hovedvannkran, varmtvannstank, elektriske kontakter og kjøleskap. Hver registrering får dato og klokkeslett og blir liggende i en låst tidslinje. Neste gang noe skal dokumenteres, har du sporet klart.

Avtal tilsyn med en hyttevenn. Skriv ned hva dere har avtalt, før oppdrag og legg inn svaret etter at dere har snakket sammen. Da ser du hvor mange ganger naboen har sett til hytta, og hva som ble observert.

Sett din egen snøgrense ut fra takmateriale, takvinkel og hvor mye snø du er komfortabel med. Appen spør ikke værtjenester. Du fører inn det du selv måler, og får et varsel når din grense er passert. Rydding kan planlegges, registreres og merkes utført.

Gå gjennom fem faste punkt på utsiden hvert år, med notat og bilder lagret på enheten. Neste år kan du sammenligne samme punkt og se hvordan frost, fukt og vær har preget hytta.

Det er også plass til det som ikke ble gjort. Risikodagboken lar deg føre ærlig logg over glipper, uten belæring, og viser mønster over år og årstider.

Før fornyelsen av forsikringen kan du samle årets småskader, råd fra selskapet og premieendring på én side.

Alt du skriver og alle bilder blir liggende lokalt på denne enheten.

Hyttevern er et personlig huskeverktøy. Det er ikke forsikring, juridisk rådgivning eller en faglig vurdering av tak og bygg. Sjekk alltid dine egne forsikringsvilkår og kontakt selskapet ved tvil.

name: Inci AI: Skincare Scanner
description:
Snap the label. Know if it's right for your skin in seconds.

HOW TO USE Inci AI
1) Tell us about your skin (optional)
2) Snap the ingredient list on the back of a product*
3) See key actives, notes and conflicts with your routine*

Inci AI reads the ingredient list (INCI) on the back of any cosmetic. Take a photo and get a clear breakdown in seconds: key actives, what each ingredient does, and notes on fragrance, allergens and pregnancy.

CHECK YOUR WHOLE ROUTINE
Add your products to your morning and evening routine. Inci AI shows which actives shouldn't be layered together, such as retinol with benzoyl peroxide or vitamin C with strong acids, and tells you how to use them instead.
• Routine compatibility score
• Conflict warnings with clear fixes
• Application order, from cleanser to sunscreen
• Alerts for missing sunscreen and over-exfoliation

COMPARE TWO PRODUCTS
Pick two products and instantly see if you can use them at the same time.

MORE THAN A SCANNER
• Scan a barcode or product QR code, or snap the label. Product not found? Snap the label once and it's added for everyone
• Ingredient library: 150+ actives and ingredients worth a note, explained
• My shelf: track when you opened each product and see how long it keeps
• Every ingredient explained in plain words
• Quick in-store verdict: suitable, caution or not for you
• Skin journal: weekly photos compared side by side, stored only on your phone
• Dark mode and a shareable result card

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
• No account or email needed
• Photos are analyzed and never stored
• Your routine stays on your phone
• No ads

IN YOUR LANGUAGE
Scan a label in any language and read the results in English, Turkish, Spanish, German, French, Portuguese, Italian, Arabic, Russian, Hindi, Japanese, Korean or Indonesian.

PRO SUBSCRIPTION
Inci AI Pro starts with a free trial and unlocks ingredient scans, routine checks and product comparisons. If you don't cancel before the trial ends, the subscription starts automatically. Payment is charged to your Apple Account. The subscription renews automatically unless cancelled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. Manage or cancel anytime in your App Store account settings.

Inci AI provides general cosmetic information. It is not a medical device and doesn't replace advice from a dermatologist, doctor or pharmacist. AI analysis may contain errors; the product label is always the authoritative source.

Ideas or questions? Email us at support@inciai.app.

name: InkGrid: QR & Barcode Maker
description:
InkGrid is a simple barcode and QR Code tool: create, scan and keep the codes you use, all on your iPhone or iPad. It is completely free, with no ads, no in-app purchases, no account and no network connection.

Create
• QR Code, Data Matrix, Aztec, PDF417, Code 128, Code 39, EAN-13, EAN-8, UPC-A, UPC-E and ITF-14
• Live validation as you type: clear error messages, check digits added for you, one-tap fixes, full-width to half-width conversion, removal of invisible characters, and length and capacity hints
• QR Code content types: URL, text, email, phone, SMS, Wi-Fi, contact (vCard), calendar event and location
• Format options: QR error correction level, EAN/UPC add-on (2 or 5 digits), Code 39 check digit
• Style: foreground and background colors, transparent background, size, rotation and human-readable text; QR dot and finder styles and a center logo
• Live preview, and every code is scanned back automatically to confirm it reads
• Export PNG (choose the resolution), SVG or PDF, then share, save to Photos, save to Files or print

Scan
• Scan common 1D and 2D codes with the camera, including formats such as GS1 DataBar and Codabar
• When several codes are in view, tap the one you want
• Flashlight, zoom and tap to focus
• Decode codes from a photo
• Results are organized by type: URL, Wi-Fi, contact, calendar event, location, phone, email and product code
• Links never open automatically; you are warned about http, punycode, look-alike characters and URL shorteners
• Sound and vibration can be turned off, and a code that stays in view only beeps once

History
• Created and scanned codes are saved automatically (each can be turned off in Settings)
• Favorites, names, search, and filters for created, scanned and favorite codes
• Sensitive content such as Wi-Fi passwords is masked
• Deletions can be undone
• Presentation mode: full screen, maximum brightness, screen kept on, 1D codes turned landscape automatically, and swipe between favorites. Handy for showing a membership card at the counter

Convenience
• Home Screen widget that shows a favorite code, or scans and creates in one tap
• Quick actions on the app icon: scan, new barcode, new QR Code
• Share text or a link from another app to make a QR Code; share an image to decode it
• Two-column layout and multitasking on iPad
• Light and dark appearance, VoiceOver and Dynamic Type

Privacy
• No data collected: no analytics, tracking, ads or third-party SDKs
• The app makes no network requests
• The camera is used only for scanning, and images are processed on your device
• Photo library access is used only to save images you export
• Backups are .cnbarcode files that you export yourself; they work between the iOS and Android versions, so you can take your codes to a new phone

Languages: Traditional Chinese and English

name: Insight K9

Insight K9 gives authorized trainers and staff access to their daily work on iPhone and iPad. Check the schedule, start a client intake, book a lesson, and open client and dog profiles. Review safety notes, record training progress, and check invoice status from the same portal.

name: InstaReady: Video Optimizer
description:
InstaReady gets your video ready before you post it. Pick a clip, tap Optimize, and the app checks how it was recorded, does only the processing it needs, and hands you a file that is ready to share.

It is not a video editor. There is nothing to trim, no filters and no timeline. It is a one-tap preparation step for the video you already have.

HOW IT WORKS
1. Analyze: InstaReady reads your clip's codec, resolution, frame rate (including variable frame rate), HDR or Dolby Vision, color, and rotation.
2. Decide: it picks the least processing that will do the job. If a clip is already in good shape, it keeps the original untouched and tells you so.
3. Process: when a change is needed, your iPhone's hardware encoder does the work on your device, for example converting HDR video to standard color, or fixing an odd frame rate or rotation.
4. Check: the result is validated before you see it, and you can preview it and compare it with the original.
5. Share: save to Photos, or send it to Instagram or any other app with one tap.

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
- Your videos are processed on your iPhone. They are never uploaded to our servers, and we never see them.
- No account, no sign-up, no email.
- The Privacy Policy and Terms of Use are one tap away inside the app.

FREE AND PRO
- Free: 3 optimized videos a day. After that, watch two short ads to unlock another export, or go Pro. Ads are shown in the free version only.
- InstaReady Pro: unlimited exports, no ads, and your full export history. Manage or cancel the subscription any time in your Apple ID subscription settings.

MORE
- Recent exports history on the home screen
- Works in 11 languages: English, Uzbek, Russian, Turkish, Spanish, Portuguese, Arabic (right-to-left), Hindi, Indonesian, French and German
- Follows your iPhone's language, with a language switcher in the app

InstaReady is an independent app. It is not affiliated with, endorsed by or sponsored by Instagram or Meta Platforms, Inc. Instagram is a trademark of Meta Platforms, Inc.

name: Interrail España

name: Inyeon Platform

Follow up on leads and missed calls, review call history, and keep customer details close at hand. Work through your inbox, approve replies, confirm bookings, and track quotes and work orders from your phone.

Capture photos for quotes, work orders, and your business knowledge. Check your daily digest, review account activity, and switch between the businesses you manage with the same permissions as the web console.
