name: IPL – Interactive Pitlane
description:
Lights out. Ego on. IPL is the paddock in your pocket: reflex mini-games to measure your real speed, predictions for every Grand Prix weekend and a career to build, made for F1 fans.

Test your reactions on the starting lights, nail a pit stop without flinching, answer the quiz without stalling. Every run earns XP, and every record is one tap away from a share card with your name on it.

Make your predictions before qualifying: pole, podium, fastest lap. Create a private league, invite your mates with a code and fight for the standings all season long.

Climb from Karting to Super Licence through F4, F3 and F2, unlock badges, keep your streak alive and claim the daily mission. The season calendar and the countdown to each race weekend are waiting in the Paddock.

IPL is not affiliated with Formula 1, the FIA or any racing team or brand. All trademarks belong to their respective owners.

name: Iron Exodus: Armored Train
description:
THIRTY-ONE YEARS AFTER THE ASH WINTER, 412 SURVIVORS BOARD ONE ARMORED TRAIN AND HEAD NORTH.

Iron Exodus is an explosive pixel-art train defense game. Raiders, drones and armored trucks attack from both sides while your train keeps rolling. Buy turrets with scrap, merge identical ones into deadlier tiers, evolve them and turn every wave into a chain of explosions.

MERGE & EVOLVE
• Six turret types: machine gun, cannon, flamer, tesla, rockets and laser
• Drag a turret onto its twin, or just tap a glowing one, to merge up to tier 6
• Reach tier 4 and choose one of two evolutions: Rotary Barrels, Napalm Shells, Dragon's Breath, Death Ray and more (12 in total)
• 32 upgrade cards between waves, from piercing rounds to a once-per-run Iron Will

BLOW EVERYTHING UP
• Fuel tankers that take the whole convoy with them
• Explosive barrels by the tracks: tap and watch the chain reaction
• Elite raiders: volatile, shielded or lightning fast
• Call in artillery anywhere on the ground, then pull the whistle for FULL STEAM

TUNNELS, BRIDGES AND BOSSES
• Enter a tunnel and everything beside you meets the wall
• Cross a bridge and raiders off the rails fall into the chasm
• Six bosses, including the Red Warden's armored train, a burrowing worm and a mechanical spider

A STORY WORTH THE RIDE
• 10 chapters across desert, ruined cities, ash plains, toxic canals, glaciers and the Bastion
• Radio drama with Chief Nermin, Gunner Tarık, Ece, the Red Warden and the voice called North Star
• Every lost wagon costs passengers, and the ending changes with how many you bring home

KEEP COMING BACK
• Endless Line with record markers on the tracks
• A new Daily Run every day with its own rules and three stars to earn
• 42 medals, five train paints, missions, ranks and permanent workshop upgrades
• Pick a crate after every run for bonus parts

Fully offline. No ads, no tracking, no account.
English, Türkçe, Deutsch, Français, Español, Português, Italiano, Русский, Polski, Bahasa Indonesia, 日本語, 한국어, 简体中文, 繁體中文

name: Isotope
description:
Isotope is a periodic table you can actually read.

Every one of the 118 elements gets a card: the symbol, the name, a photograph of something the element actually is out in the world — a pencil for carbon, a banana for potassium, party balloons for helium — and the full numbers behind it.

WHAT IS IN IT

• All 118 elements, each with 22 properties: atomic weight, electron and shell configuration, electronegativity, covalent and van der Waals radii, melting and boiling points, density, thermal conductivity and expansion, crystal structure, Mohs and Brinell hardness, bulk and Young's modulus, speed of sound and electrical resistivity.
• A photograph of every element, with a line explaining what you are looking at and what the element is doing in it.
• A short description of each element: what it is, and one thing worth remembering.
• Search by name, symbol or atomic number.
• A quiz with three ways to play, for finding out whether any of it stuck.
• Temperatures in Kelvin, Celsius or Fahrenheit — it starts with whatever your device is set to.
• Light and dark themes, and a layout built for phones and tablets alike.

HONEST ABOUT ITS DATA

Where a value is not known — and for the heaviest synthetic elements most are not — the app says "Unknown" rather than inventing a number. Every field's source is documented: atomic and thermodynamic data from IUPAC-aligned and NIST-derived compilations, and the bulk material properties from the standard reference tables, which are less complete and are labelled as such.

NO NONSENSE

No account. No ads. No tracking. No network connection needed for anything — every photograph and every number ships inside the app. Nothing about you leaves your device, because nothing about you is collected.

Free. No purchases, ever.

name: Jar Slip
description:
Jar Slip is for one head of napa cabbage on the board.

Weigh the cabbage, name the jar, and write your name and contact. The head is cut into four quarters. Coarse salt is 8 percent of the weight. Under 3000 g the quarters rest 4 hours and are turned once an hour. At 3000 g and over they rest 6 hours and are turned every 2 hours. After three turns, the paste is scaled from the same weight: rice porridge, gochugaru, garlic, ginger, fish sauce, salted shrimp, sugar, Korean radish, and scallion.

Choose a cool, mild, or warm room. After the jar is sealed, the first taste is counted on this iPhone: 5 days when cool, 3 days when mild, or 2 days when warm. The slip is a PDF saved on this iPhone for whoever keeps the jar. Share it from the system share sheet.

Amounts and the file stay on this iPhone. There is no account, and nothing is uploaded.

name: Jardinera
description:
Jardinera пам'ятає за вас, коли полити, обприскати, підживити, обрізати й пересадити кожну рослину. П'ять окремих календарів, у кожного свій ритм.

Графік підлаштовується під погоду. У спеку інтервали скорочуються, у прохолоду подовжуються — застосунок бере прогноз для вашого міста й рахує сам. Кількість води береться з діаметра горщика й виду: кротон у чотирнадцятому горщику й монстера у двадцять четвертому п'ють по-різному.

Якщо рослини стоять на балконі, Jardinera стежить за холодом, спекою, вітром і зливою й каже, кого заносити в дім і коли. Одна холодна ніч — це «занести на ніч». Три ночі з п'яти нижче того, що витримує вид, — сезон на балконі скінчився. Навесні застосунок так само підкаже, коли можна виносити назад, і нагадає привчати поступово.

Довідник на 48 видів: норми поливу влітку й узимку, обприскування, підживлення, пересадка, світло, вологість, отруйність для котів і собак та одна практична підказка до кожного. Бромелії поливають у розетку, фіалку — тільки в піддон, циперус живе з горщиком у воді. Це не вміщається в «полив раз на 7 днів», тому так і написано.

Щоденник пишеться сам. Полили — лишається дата й кількість води. Фото робляться просто в застосунку, тож видно, як рослина змінювалася з місяцями.

Є вимірювач світла по тіні від долоні — бо iPhone не дає застосункам датчик освітлення — і він приймає число з люксметра. І кнопка «ще волого» на випадок, коли застосунок поспішає: після кількох відкладань він сам запропонує той інтервал, який цій рослині справді підходить.

Без реєстрації, без підписки, без реклами. Дані живуть у вашому телефоні, їх можна зберегти копією й перенести на інший.

Українською та іспанською.

name: Jarrie
description:
Social media for the things you and your friends actually talk about. No ads, no influencers, no strangers. Just the trips, recipes, shows, books and buys your friends think are worth it, and a place to share yours.

TRAVEL Drop a pin on every city you've been to and give it a score. Add a note so you remember why. Your countries and continents tally up as you go, and there's a Someday list for the places you still want to see.

FOOD Paste a link and Jarrie pulls in the recipe, or type in your own. Rate it out of ten and see how much of it your pantry already covers. Eating out? Log the dishes worth ordering again.

ENTERTAINMENT Movies, TV and books all in one place. Mark what you've finished, what you're watching and what's next, give it a rating, and check where it's streaming. Coming from Letterboxd or Goodreads? Bring your history with you.

THINGS Bought something great, or a total dud? Add a photo and a quick verdict so your friends know what's worth the money before they buy.

FRIENDS Find friends by name or from your contacts. Their latest trips, recipes, picks and finds show up in one feed where you can like and comment. When you both rate the same city, book or recipe, Jarrie lets you know.

YOUR CALL You choose which areas friends can see and which notifications reach your phone. You can report or block anyone, and delete your account and everything in it from Account whenever you like.

name: Jemma: Things & Home Guides
description:
Jemma keeps your household knowledge in one place. The app interface is in Finnish.

THINGS AND PLACES
Save an item, its location and an optional photo. Search your saved names and places. Jemma remembers what you enter; it does not track objects automatically.

DEVICES AND INSTRUCTIONS
Create a device card with its manufacturer, model, your own instructions and a link to the manufacturer’s manual. Your notes are shown separately from the original manual. Jemma does not generate operating instructions or control appliances.

YOUR DATA ON YOUR IPHONE

BACKUPS
Export your data as a JSON backup, including photos and device notes. Restore missing entries while preserving existing records. Backups up to 100 MB are supported. Records do not automatically sync between devices.

START FREE
Save up to 10 items and devices in total. Jemma Unlimited is an optional one-time purchase for adding unlimited entries. No subscription. Existing entries can be viewed, edited and deleted without payment. Restore purchases using the same Apple Account; purchase restoration and data backups are separate.

name: JokerBam: Mahjong Score Keeper
description:
The score keeper for American mahjong (mah jongg) tables: enter the value printed on your card, tap how the hand was won, and JokerBam shows what every player pays, and why.
Keep tonight's sheet and your group's league standings in one place.
No account, no ads, works offline. Scoring, the sheet, one league and every Learn article are free.

SCORE A HAND
• Tap the winner and the discarder: every player has a colour and an avatar
• Pick the hand's printed value: 25, 30, 35, 40, 50, 75 or any other
• Discard, self-pick or wall game, jokerless or not, and the card section if you like
• Each player's payout appears as you tap, with the reason, such as "×2 discarder"

TONIGHT'S SHEET
• A score card per player with running totals and a crown for the leader
• Tonight's awards: most points, most mahjongs, biggest hand, jokerless
• Settle up: the fewest payments that square the night's points
• Undo or delete any hand, and share a recap image with the group

LEAGUES FOR YOUR GROUP
• Standings across game nights for your weekly group or club, with a podium
• Pick who is at the table each night; up to 12 players per league
• Wins, jokerless wins, self-picks and how often each player discarded
• One league is free

LIVE LEAGUES AND PHOTOS
• Go live with a league and share a 6-letter code: hands anyone adds show up on every phone (Pro for the organiser, free to join)
• Keep a photo of the winning hand with the score, and a photo wall for the season
• Track your card: tag a winning hand by section and line number, name lines in your own words, see which lines your group wins

TOOLS FOR THE TABLE
• Dice for East to break the wall
• The Charleston, pass by pass: right, across, left, the second Charleston and the courtesy pass
• East moves to the right after every hand, so everyone knows who deals

YOUR HOUSE RULES
• Discarder pays double, or everyone pays the same
• Self-pick and jokerless bonuses, the way your table plays them
• Wall-game payout, pie and the fifth-player rule
• Standard table play is the default, with a one-line note on every rule

LEARN THE GAME
• Quick answers: who pays what, where jokers go, the Charleston, calling tiles, dead hands
• How to play American mahjong, step by step, and the rules in plain words
• How to read the yearly card. JokerBam never reproduces the card's hands: you score from your own card
• A glossary of tile and table terms, from bams and craks to pung, kong and quint

GAME-NIGHT REMINDER
• A weekly reminder on your phone so nobody forgets mahj night
• No sign-up and no account. Your games stay on your phone unless you share a league live

JOKERBAM PRO
For groups that want more:
• Live leagues on every phone
• Player stats and charts: totals by night, win rate, streaks, form, most-won lines and the photo wall
• Unlimited leagues and head-to-head records
• PDF score sheets, CSV export and league backups
Pro is available as a weekly, monthly or yearly subscription, or as a one-time lifetime unlock. Prices are shown in the app before you buy. The free features stay free forever.

SUBSCRIPTION TERMS
Payment is charged to your Apple ID account at confirmation of purchase. A subscription renews automatically unless it is canceled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. Your account is charged for the renewal within 24 hours before the end of the current period. You can manage or cancel your subscriptions in your Apple ID account settings at any time after purchase. The lifetime unlock is a one-time purchase and does not renew.

Privacy policy: https://jokerbam-app.web.app/privacy
Terms of use: https://jokerbam-app.web.app/terms

JokerBam keeps score for a tabletop game you play in person. Scores are points: there is no betting, no money and no prizes in the app.

JokerBam is not affiliated with, endorsed by or sponsored by the National Mah Jongg League.

name: Junbi Taekwondo
description:
Junbi t'aide à apprendre le vocabulaire coréen du taekwondo et à préparer ton prochain passage de grade.
Choisis ta ceinture : l'app te propose les termes et le programme de ton prochain grade.
Dans Junbi, tu trouves :
360 termes classés par thème : commandes, positions, blocages, coups de pied, poomsae, arbitrage…
Des cartes à retourner avec le coréen, la romanisation, une illustration et la prononciation à écouter
Des révisions espacées : les termes que tu rates reviennent plus souvent
Le programme de chaque grade, du 10e keup au 9e dan, avec les poomsae à présenter
Les conditions d'examen des dan en France, avec des liens vers les documents de la fédération
Une liste de vérification avant l'examen et tes statistiques
Un bilan à partager avec ton enseignant
Junbi t'aide à réviser le vocabulaire. Seul ton enseignant peut juger ta technique. Les programmes sont indicatifs : ton club peut les adapter.

name: KA Wedding
description:
KA Wedding is the guest app for Kashika & Arjun's wedding in the hills, 17–19 January 2027, at Storii by ITC Hotels, Akanni Naina Tikkar, Himachal Pradesh.

It is for invited guests. You will need the invite code from the couple to get in.

WHAT'S INSIDE

• The programme: three days, hour by hour, with what to wear and a button to add each event to your calendar.
• Live updates: the couple post what is happening right now ("Tea is being served"), with a notification on your phone.
• The wedding camera: 27 photos a day, like a disposable camera. No previews and no retakes. Everyone's photos develop together the next morning.
• The shared album: every guest's photos in one place. Add your own from your phone, like your favourites, save and share them.
• Guest chat: rooms for everyone, for getting there, for the Sangeet and for lost and found. Reply, react, and send photos and voice notes.
• RSVP: tell the couple who is coming and about any food needs.
• Your table and room: see your Sangeet table and your room number once they are assigned.
• Good to know: getting there, the weather at the resort, what to pack, and answers to the usual questions.
• Get to know everyone: a short introduction from each guest, so faces are familiar before you arrive.
• Help when you need it: an SOS button that alerts the couple's team, and one-tap calling for the hotel reception.
• Travel documents (optional): share your ID and tickets privately with the wedding team for check-in and transfers.

YOUR PRIVACY

You join with an invite code and your name. No email, no password. You can report or block anything in chat or the album, and you can delete your account and everything you posted from inside the app at any time.

name: Kachuful Judgement
description:
Bring your people to the table.

Kachuful (also known as Judgement) is the classic Indian trick-taking card game, made for private rooms of friends and family. Create a room, share its six-letter code, and play together from your phones.

HOW IT PLAYS
• Each round, everyone bids exactly how many hands they will win.
• Follow suit, play your best card, and watch the trump move round the table: Kaali (spades), Chukat (diamonds), Fulli (clubs), Lal (hearts).
• Make your bid exactly to score. Miss it, even by one, and the round scores nothing.

YOUR TABLE, YOUR RULES
• 2 to 8 players.
• Quick, Classic or Full sessions.
• +10 or ×10 scoring for an exact bid.
• Everyone confirms the rules before the first deal.

MADE FOR REAL EVENINGS
• Tap a card once to select it and again to play it.
• The scorebook, the last hand and the rules are a tap away.
• Phone ringing? Your seat waits for you. If a friend has to step away, the table can play legal cards for them until they return.
• Room chat and reactions, with mute, report and block.
• Friends without the app can join from a browser at kachuful.yashos.dev.

FREE AND PRIVATE
No ads, no purchases, no accounts. You play as a guest with a nickname, and you can delete your data in the app at any time.

Privacy: https://kachuful.yashos.dev/privacy
Support: https://kachuful.yashos.dev/support

name: Kaira
description:
Kaira ist ein Tagebuch in Wochen. Statt langer Einträge hältst du fest, was eine Woche ausgemacht hat – mit einem Foto oder einem einzigen Satz. So entsteht Woche für Woche eine Spur dessen, was dir wirklich wichtig ist.

DEINE WOCHEN
• Ein Raster aus Wochen zeigt dein Leben auf einen Blick
• Halte Momente mit Foto oder Satz fest
• Verknüpfe Momente mit den Menschen, die dabei waren
• Farbige Lichter und Filter helfen dir, Muster zu erkennen

DEINE LIEBSTEN
• Sammle Ideen für die Menschen, die dir nahestehen
• Sieh auf einen Blick, bei wem du dich wieder einmal melden möchtest
• Verpasse keinen Geburtstag mehr

PERSPEKTIVE
• Die Lebensansicht in Jahresblöcken zeigt, wie viel Zeit hinter und vor dir liegt
• „Diese Woche“ holt dich jeden Tag sanft ins Jetzt

Kaira ist kein soziales Netzwerk. Es gibt keine Likes und keine Follower, nur dich und das, was zählt.
Deine Einträge bleiben auf deinem iPhone.

name: Keeperfall: Survival Craft
description:
Keeperfall is a hand-drawn survival crafting game where the dark itself is the enemy. Gather wood and stone, craft tools, build a camp and keep your fire burning through day, night and four hard seasons. Play offline, at your own pace, with no account needed.

You are a Keeper, someone who carries an ember inside. The valley has no quests and no mercy: food spoils, winter freezes, and the Gloam takes shape around anyone who stays in the dark too long. Light is the only thing that holds it back.

SURVIVE THE CLOCK
• A full day and night cycle, four seasons and changing weather: rain, thunderstorms, fog and summer heat waves.
• Watch your hunger, health, resolve and body temperature. Every choice costs one of them.
• Each season brings its own Warden, a boss that comes back angrier if you let it go.

GATHER, CRAFT AND BUILD
• Chop trees, mine rock, pick berries, set snares, hunt and catch fish.
• Unlock recipes at crafting stations: tools, weapons, armour, lanterns and warm clothes for the cold.
• Build a base with walls, chests, farms, a cooking pot and a fire that can get away from you.

EXPLORE A NEW WORLD EVERY TIME
• Every seed grows a new procedurally generated world.
• Go down into caves with no sun, cross the sea on a raft to islands worth the trip, and find the hamlets of the Stayed.
• Read the cold letters that tell what happened to this valley.

KNOWLEDGE IS PROGRESSION
• Nothing levels up. What you learn is what you carry into the next world.
• Death is real: prepared Keepers can come back, unprepared ones start again.

MADE FOR PHONES
• Touch controls with a virtual stick and buttons that change with what is in front of you, a large readable interface, and your world is saved when you leave the app.
• Works fully offline; the internet is needed only to open or join a room. No ads.

PLAY WITH FRIENDS
• A full day and night cycle, four seasons and changing weather: rain, thunderstorms, fog and summer heat waves.
• Watch your hunger, health, resolve and body temperature. Every choice costs one of them.
• Each season brings its own Warden, a boss that comes back angrier if you let it go.

GATHER, CRAFT AND BUILD
• Chop trees, mine rock, pick berries, set snares, hunt and catch fish.
• Unlock recipes at crafting stations: tools, weapons, armour, lanterns and warm clothes for the cold.
• Build a base with walls, chests, farms, a cooking pot and a fire that can get away from you.

EXPLORE A NEW WORLD EVERY TIME
• Every seed grows a new procedurally generated world.
• Go down into caves with no sun, cross the sea on a raft to islands worth the trip, and find the hamlets of the Stayed.
• Read the cold letters that tell what happened to this valley.

KNOWLEDGE IS PROGRESSION
• Nothing levels up. What you learn is what you carry into the next world.
• Death is real: prepared Keepers can come back, unprepared ones start again.

MADE FOR PHONES
• Touch controls with a virtual stick and buttons that change with what is in front of you, a large readable interface, and your world is saved when you leave the app.
• Works fully offline; the internet is needed only to open or join a room. No ads.

PLAY WITH FRIENDS
• Open a room and share its six-character code: up to six Keepers in one world, over the internet or on the same Wi-Fi.
• Chat, keep an eye on your friends' health, and bring a fallen friend back.

Free to try: play the first season in up to two worlds. One purchase unlocks the full game, every season, as many worlds as you like, and online play with friends. Optional in-app purchases add new Keepers, seasonal outfits and an ink art book. They add variety, never power. While the game is new, the Founder's Pack holds it all, with Founder looks found nowhere else.

name: Kept&Go
description:
Kept&Go is made so you never forget who you need to get back to with an answer, and about what — or to try again with the person you called who didn't pick up. We remind you, and manage the reminders you've already managed to forget. You get a notification on your screen when it's time.

No typing needed.

SAY IT
Tap the mic and say: "Remind me Thursday at 9 to send Dana the quote." Kept&Go finds who, what and when.

CONFIRM IN A TAP
Only the parts we're unsure of need your attention — for example, which Dana. Adjust, tick, save.

GET REMINDED AT THE RIGHT TIME
A notification arrives with one-tap actions: open WhatsApp with your message ready, snooze, or mark done.

YOU STAY IN CONTROL
Kept&Go never reads your chats and never sends anything for you. You press send.

Available in English and Hebrew. Free. No account — your data stays on your phone.

name: KerfPlan calc
description:
KerfPlan calc turns a parts list into a clear cutting plan: it fits every piece onto your sheets, accounts for the saw kerf, and shows exactly where to cut — all on your device, with no account and no internet.
PLAN BEFORE YOU BUY
• Enter sheet size and quantity, then add the parts you need
• Saw kerf and edge trim are included in the math
• See how many sheets the job really takes before you pay for them
A CUTTING PLAN YOU CAN FOLLOW
• One diagram per sheet with part numbers and dimensions
• Rotation and grain direction respected per part
• Leftover offcuts listed, so usable scraps are not wasted
• Clear warning when a part cannot fit at all
MADE FOR THE WORKSHOP
• Works completely offline — no sign-in, no data collected
• Save unlimited projects and reuse a layout for the next build
• Export a diagram to your photos or share it with the client
• Metric and imperial, light and dark themes

name: Kockatorony
description:
A Kockatorony a társasjátékozó baráti társaságok eredménykövetője. Rögzítsd a meccseket telefonról egy perc alatt, és a statisztikát az app számolja helyetted.

MECCSEK EGY PERC ALATT
• Válaszd ki a játékot, a résztvevőket, írd be a pontokat – a helyezést az app számolja, döntetlennel együtt.
• Indítsd el a meccset a játék elején: sorsold ki a kezdőjátékost, tarts szünetet, a végén írd be a pontokat.
• Egyéni, csoportos és kooperatív játékmód, kiegészítők, kampány- és legacy-játékok alkalmai.
• Játékspecifikus pontozólap kategóriánkénti részpontokkal.
• Vendégjátékos is lehet a meccsen, fiók nélkül.

CSAPATOK
• Hozd létre a társaságod csapatát, és hívd meg a többieket linkkel vagy e-mailben.
• Mindenki ugyanazokat a meccseket látja, bárki rögzíthet.

STATISZTIKA
• Ranglista, győzelmi arány, formagörbe, győzelmi sorozatok, rekordok.
• Játékonkénti statisztika: átlag- és rekordpontszám, játékidő, ki nyert a legtöbbször.
• Trófeák a mérföldkövekért, győzelmekért és sorozatokért.

JÁTÉKOK A BOARDGAMEGEEK-RŐL
• A játékkatalógus a BoardGameGeek adataira épül (Powered by BGG), magyar nevekkel, ahol van magyar kiadás.
• Ha a BGG-n is vezeted a meccseidet, a BGG-fiókod összeköthető, és a meccseid áthozhatók.

ÉRTESÍTÉSEK
• Push-értesítés, ha egy csapattárs lezár vagy módosít egy meccset, ha meghívnak egy csapatba, vagy ha trófeát szerzel. Az appban bármikor kikapcsolható.

A Kockatorony non-profit hobbiprojekt: ingyenes, nincs benne reklám és fizetős funkció, az adataidat nem adjuk el. Ugyanaz a fiók működik a weben is: app.kockatorony.hu.

name: Koi-Koi by Tamaki
description:
Koi-Koi by Tamaki is a classic Hanafuda card game for two players.

Match cards by month, capture them, and build scoring sets called yaku. When you have a yaku, stop and take the points, or say Koi-Koi and keep playing. If you call Koi-Koi and your opponent scores first, they take the round.

Play against Tamaki at Easy, Medium, or Hard. Pass one phone between two people. Or host a room and send a 6-character code to a friend.

A standard match is 12 rounds. You can also play 3 rounds, 6 rounds, to 50 points, to 100 points, or with no limit.

No accounts. Names, the sound setting, and a random seat id stay on your device. Online play sends your display name, room code, and the cards you play only while the room is open.

name: KTP Waterjet Studio
seller_name: KHANG THINH PHAT BUSINESS TRADING COMPANY LIMITED
description:
KTP Waterjet Studio hỗ trợ xưởng gia công và người vận hành máy cắt tia nước tổ chức công việc trên iPhone và iPad.

CÔNG CỤ CHÍNH
• Tính chi phí cắt theo chiều dài, tốc độ, vật tư, điện, nước, nhân công và thông số máy do người dùng nhập.
• Nhập bản vẽ DXF 2D, xem và chọn các đường cần cắt để tính tổng mét dài; có thể nhập chiều dài thủ công.
• Tạo nhanh bản vẽ lavabo, bàn đá, chậu rửa, các hình học và bản vẽ phác thảo theo số đo; xuất DXF và chuyển sang tính giá.
• Lưu dự toán, mẫu ảnh mặt cắt và phiếu hỗ trợ trên thiết bị.
• Tra cứu thư viện kỹ thuật được KTP biên soạn, catalogue máy và linh kiện.
• Liên hệ KTP qua Zalo, điện thoại hoặc email để được tư vấn và xác nhận giá, cấu hình, phụ tùng.

Giao diện có tiếng Việt, tiếng Anh, tiếng Trung giản thể, tiếng Thái và tiếng Khmer. Không cần tạo tài khoản. Các công cụ chính xử lý dữ liệu trên thiết bị; liên kết liên hệ và website cần kết nối mạng.

Kết quả tính giá là dự toán dựa trên dữ liệu đầu vào. Việc đối chiếu ảnh mặt cắt chỉ có tính tham khảo, cần kiểm tra mẫu thực tế. Bản vẽ phải được kiểm tra kích thước, dung sai và đường chạy dao trước khi sản xuất. Ứng dụng không điều khiển trực tiếp máy CNC và không thay thế hướng dẫn an toàn của máy.

Phát triển và hỗ trợ bởi Khang Thịnh Phát — MachineKTP.com.

name: KundliPandit
description:
Meet Pandit Ji, your personal Vedic astrologer, available any time, in Hindi or English.

Tell Pandit Ji your date, time and place of birth. KundliPandit calculates your janam kundli in seconds, then you can ask anything that is on your mind: love, marriage, career, money, family and relationships. Every answer is based on your own birth chart, not a generic rashifal.

WHAT YOU CAN DO

• Ask Pandit Ji anything: chat naturally in Hindi or English and get clear, personal guidance from your chart.
• Your janam kundli: your North Indian birth chart with lagna, rashi, nakshatra and the houses explained in simple words.
• Daily prediction: a personal forecast every morning, with your good and bad timings of the day (Rahu Kaal, choghadiya) and your energy for the day.
• Panchang: today's tithi, nakshatra, yoga, karana, sunrise and sunset, plus upcoming festivals and vrats.
• Kundli matching: Ashtakoot guna milan out of 36 for marriage, with a clear explanation of each koota.
• Remedies: simple, practical upay based on your chart: mantras, daan and daily practices.
• Palm reading: take a photo of your palm and get a reading of your heart, head, life and fate lines.
• Mantra counter and gentle daily reminders.

WHY KUNDLIPANDIT

• Real calculations: kundli, panchang and guna milan are computed from planetary positions (Lahiri ayanamsa).
• Personal, not generic: answers use your own chart.
• Hindi and English: switch any time.
• Private: you can delete your account and all your data from Settings at any time.

KUNDLIPANDIT PREMIUM

Your first question is free. KundliPandit Premium gives you up to 15 questions every day plus full access to predictions, remedies, matching and palm reading.

New subscribers get a 3-day free trial, then ₹599 every 3 months (or the equivalent price in your country). Payment is charged to your Apple Account when you confirm the purchase, or when the free trial ends. The subscription renews automatically unless it is cancelled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. You can manage or cancel it any time in your Apple Account settings.

PLEASE NOTE

Pandit Ji is an AI astrologer. Answers are generated by AI from your birth chart and are meant for guidance and entertainment. They are not a substitute for medical, legal, financial or other professional advice. If an answer seems wrong or inappropriate, tap the flag icon to report it.

Terms of Use: https://kundlipandit.in/terms-of-service/
Privacy Policy: https://kundlipandit.in/privacy-policy/
Support: support@kundlipandit.in

name: LABELX: Storage Box Inventory
description:
Know what's inside every box. Find anything in seconds.

LABELX turns your storage boxes into a searchable digital inventory. Photograph what's inside, give each box its own LabelCode label, and find any item later by searching or by scanning. It works offline, keeps your data on your iPhone, and costs one time only.

THE PROBLEM
You packed the garage, attic or storage unit, and now you can't remember which box holds the Christmas lights, the tax papers or the camera gear. Opening every box takes hours.

HOW IT WORKS
1. Create a box. A name is enough; add a photo, category and location if you like.
2. Add what's inside, with photos and quantities.
3. Print the box's LabelCode label and stick it on.
4. Search for an item to see the exact box and shelf, or scan the label to open the box instantly.

LABELCODE: SCANNABLE ONLY IN LABELX
Every box gets its own LabelCode, a distinctive round-cornered dot code with the LABELX mark in the middle. It carries only a private box ID, so it never changes when you rename or move a box, and other scanner apps cannot read it.

FEATURES
• Boxes with unique IDs (BOX-0001), cover photos and categories
• Items with photos, quantity, condition, estimated value and notes
• Instant local search across items, notes, boxes, categories and locations
• Nested locations: Home > Attic > Shelf B
• Beautiful printable labels: four templates, several sizes, label printers, A4 or US Letter sheets, PDF and PNG export, AirPrint
• Archive, duplicate, move and bulk-edit boxes and items
• Recently Deleted keeps removed boxes and items for 30 days
• Full backup and restore, CSV and PDF inventory export
• Light and Dark mode, Dynamic Type and VoiceOver support

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
No account. No ads. No tracking. No cloud. Your photos and inventory stay on your iPhone and every feature works without internet. Export a backup whenever you like to keep a copy of your own.

ONE-TIME PURCHASE
Pay once. No subscriptions, no in-app purchases, no item limits.

Perfect for moving house, garages, attics, closets, storage units, workshops, photography gear, seasonal decorations and family archives.

Get LABELX and stop opening boxes.

Privacy Policy: https://elariolabs.com/legal/labelx-privacy
EULA(Terms Of Use): https://elariolabs.com/legal/labelx-terms

name: Lagoona
description:
Lagoona es la mesa de control para equipos de ventas que atienden a sus clientes por WhatsApp, Instagram y Messenger desde un solo lugar.

Conecta los canales de tu negocio y responde todas las conversaciones desde una sola bandeja, con el contexto completo de cada lead: su etapa en el embudo, su información de contacto y todo el historial.

CARACTERÍSTICAS

• Bandeja unificada: WhatsApp, Instagram y Messenger en una sola lista de conversaciones.
• Conversaciones multicanal: cambia de canal dentro del mismo chat sin perder el hilo.
• Embudos y etapas: mueve a cada lead por tu pipeline de ventas sin salir del chat.
• Plantillas de WhatsApp para reabrir conversaciones.
• Notas de voz, fotos, videos y documentos, con envío múltiple.
• Biblioteca del proyecto: reutiliza archivos ya subidos sin volver a cargarlos.
• Filtros y búsqueda para encontrar cualquier conversación al instante.
• Notificaciones push para no dejar esperando a ningún cliente.
• Equipos: asigna leads y responde junto a tus compañeros.

Lagoona es el complemento móvil del CRM de Lagoona: necesitas una cuenta de tu organización para iniciar sesión.

name: Laid Row
description:
Laid Row is for the moment you close the kana textbook and the chart on the desk is still blank. Choose hiragana or katakana, then lay one row before you leave the chair.

Each mora shows its reading. You tap the kana. A right cell stays open. A missed cell stays covered and keeps the kana you tapped. Clear rows, voiced rows, and contracted rows are all on the chart. ぢ is shown as di and づ as du, so they stay apart from ji and zu. You can hear the mora on this iPhone.

Rows laid, open cells, and cells still blank are counted on this iPhone. The row stays here for you. There is no account, network, sample row, vocabulary, kanji, grammar, stroke-order lesson, file, or payment.

name: Lakrei Empresas
description:
O Lakrei Empresas é o aplicativo da equipe de recepção de empresas, prédios comerciais e coworkings que usam o sistema Lakrei Empresas. Ele troca o caderno e as planilhas por um registro rápido, com foto, aviso ao colaborador e comprovante de quem retirou.

COMO FUNCIONA
• Chegou uma encomenda: o recepcionista fotografa a etiqueta, escolhe o colaborador e o setor (ou a sala) e pronto. O colaborador é avisado com o local onde a encomenda ficou guardada e o código de retirada.
• O colaborador veio buscar: o recepcionista confere o código, colhe a assinatura na tela (ou no celular de quem retira) e a entrega fica registrada, com data e hora.
• Poucos toques, botões grandes, feito para o balcão da recepção, no iPhone e no iPad.

PRINCIPAIS RECURSOS
• Registro com foto da etiqueta, número da prateleira e local de guarda (inclusive geladeira para refeições e delivery).
• Tipos de volume próprios do ambiente corporativo: encomenda, correspondência, documento, equipamento de TI, material de escritório, refeição e outros.
• Encomenda pessoal e encomenda confidencial seguem as regras definidas pela organização: a confidencial não descreve o conteúdo no aviso e só o destinatário retira, com assinatura.
• Leitura da etiqueta com sugestão do destinatário, quando a organização ativa o recurso.
• Leitura do QR da etiqueta pela câmera para localizar a encomenda na hora da entrega.
• Entrega com código de retirada e assinatura, inclusive para vários volumes de uma só vez, e retirada por pessoa autorizada.
• Correspondência em lote: uma foto do monte de envelopes e a escolha do setor de cada um.
• "Sem aviso": lista as encomendas cujo destinatário não está cadastrado na unidade, para a recepção avisar a equipe do setor.
• Devolução de compras do colaborador e devolução ao remetente, com foto, assinatura e acompanhamento da coleta pela transportadora.
• Registro de ocorrências: encomenda extraviada, avariada ou entregue à pessoa errada.
• Avisos do dia e relatório de turno: o próximo turno sabe exatamente o que ficou pendente.
• Entrada protegida por e-mail e senha, com verificação em duas etapas para quem a ativar.
• Para quem atende mais de uma organização, troca de organização dentro do próprio app.

PARA QUEM É
Recepcionistas e equipes de recepção de empresas, prédios comerciais e coworkings que já usam o Lakrei Empresas. O acesso é criado pelo gestor da organização: o aplicativo não permite criar conta sozinho. O painel do gestor, com relatórios e cadastros, fica no site.

REQUISITOS
• Conta criada pelo gestor da organização.
• Conexão com a internet (Wi-Fi ou dados móveis) para registrar e consultar as encomendas.
• Câmera do aparelho para fotografar etiquetas e ler o QR (a permissão é pedida só quando necessária).

name: Lala - Breakfast Together
description:
Welcome to Lala — where breakfast lovers share their mornings and find their people.

Post what's on your plate, pick up recipes worth waking up for, and talk with people who take breakfast as seriously as you do.

SHARE YOUR BREAKFAST
Pick a photo from your album, add a title, description, ingredients, and recipe details. Preview it, swap the photo, save it as a draft, and edit or delete your own posts. Post as often as you like.

GET A BREAKFAST SCORE
Lala scores your breakfast pairing based on the ingredient categories you choose and gives you suggestions to improve it. Pick your ingredients and see how your plate stacks up against a balanced morning.

JOIN THE COMMUNITY
Browse breakfast posts and immersive full-screen photo details. Like, comment, save, visit author profiles, and follow the people whose mornings you want to see more of.

EXPLORE THE RECIPE MARKET
Search, filter, and save recipes from other breakfast lovers. Read ingredients, cooking steps, and nutrition info — or open a Mystery Box to discover something you never would have picked yourself.

SWAP RECIPES WITH PEOPLE
Start a recipe exchange with your own recipe. Accept, decline, cancel, and review your swap history, and keep private recipes set aside just for trading.

COOK ALONG IN COOKING MODE
Follow a recipe step by step with step switching, built-in timers, voice read-aloud, and progress that picks up where you left off.

KEEP A BREAKFAST DIARY
Look back on your mornings through a calendar view, revisit what you made, and see your stats add up over time.

EARN ACHIEVEMENT BADGES
Unlock achievements and badges as you post, cook, and take part in the community.

MAKE A RECIPE CARD
Generate a recipe card, preview it, and share or print it straight from your phone.

WATCH AND SHARE BREAKFAST VIDEOS
Upload short videos of your own breakfast moments, comment on other people's clips, and scroll through what everyone's making this morning.

CHAT 1-ON-1 AND VIDEO CALL
Tap into another user's profile from the community or a short video, then start a private conversation. Talk recipes, swap tips, or make it personal with a one-on-one video call — show each other what's on the table.

Download Lala and start your mornings with your people.

name: Last Landing on Mars
seller_name: YENI PROJELER REKLAM YAZILIM TICARET LIMITED SIRKETI
description:
Two thumbs, two engines, one soft touchdown. Last Landing on Mars is a calm, hand-drawn landing game: the left thumb fires the left engine, the right thumb the right one. Tilt, brake, hover, and set the little ship down gently on the pad.

LEARN TO LAND
• 15 missions across the red canyon, the white salt flats and the black volcanic ridge, each teaching one new trick: braking, gliding, wind, gates.
• Up to three stars per landing for a soft, level and fuel-saving touchdown.
• A new daily mission every day.

THE ALIEN PIT
• Drop into a shaft that goes 100 levels deep. Every pad is a checkpoint where you refuel.
• Ten zones, each with its own colour and idea: long tunnels, twin columns, a worm nest, crystal pockets, narrows, ash chimneys, a labyrinth, a hive and the core gate.
• Things happen on the way down, always announced before they act: rocks break loose (watch the dust), sand pours, steam vents blow, crystals arc, slabs crumble, the lights fail, and something enormous swims through the rock.
• Worms live in the walls. Fit a turret in the garage and drive them back.

YOUR CREW
• Choose your captain, Mert or Yiğit, and fly with ADA, the ship's AI. Every line is voiced in English, German and Turkish.
• Find the six story tablets and read them in the archive.
• Spend gold in the garage on ship colours, parts and weapons.

FAIR AND CALM
• No timers to rush you, clear warnings, and a shield that forgives one crash.
• Plays offline. English, German and Turkish.

PRIVACY FIRST
No account, no ads, no purchases. Anonymous gameplay data and crash reports are only collected if you allow it, and you can change your mind any time in Settings.

name: Laya-Voice rooms, right nearby
description:
Someone near you is speaking right now.

Laya Camping is a voice camp app that only happens where you are.

No sign-up, no phone number, no server. If these people are in the same place as you, you can see each other the moment you open the app: who is hosting a camp, who is nearby. Tap in, and you hear what they are saying right now.

People are waiting nearby
Nearby camps: See who is hosting and how many people are inside. Tap to sit down.
Nearby people: See who is around and which camp they are in. Start a conversation from their profile.
Eight seats, take one
One host seat plus eight mic seats. Ask for the mic when you want to speak — no waiting for the host.
While someone talks, a ripple spreads from their avatar and grows with their voice, so you can tell who is talking and how animated they are.
Leave the mic any time and hand the seat to the next person.
A public screen, like a circle by the campfire
Posts, photos, and off-the-cuff lines — everyone in the camp shares one public feed.
Online and offline are always visible. Messages sent while someone is away are not lost; they are marked and delivered when they return.
Talk one-on-one when it clicks
Send private messages and photos to anyone you have met in the camp.
Block or report at any time. Reports go to the camp host and stay on file.
Privacy, taken seriously
Voice, text and photos travel only between you and the people nearby. There is no server, and nothing is ever uploaded.
No account, no phone number, no ads, no trackers. Uninstalling the app deletes everything.
Microphone and photos are requested only when you need them.
Three steps to start talking:

Open the app, set your avatar and nickname.
Spot someone hosting "Evening Breeze Camp" nearby and join.
Ask for a mic seat and say your first line.

name: Leg Room: Desk Movement Breaks
description:
Leg Room reminds you to get up and move during the workday, then shows you exactly what to do.

Set your work days and hours, pick how often you want a nudge (every 30, 45 or 60 minutes), and Leg Room takes care of the rest. When it's time, a notification arrives with a simple movement and a picture of how to do it. Tap Done, Snooze for 5 minutes, or open it for more ideas.

SMALL MOVES, ALL DAY 
• 29 light movements for sitting or standing: stretches, mobility, and quick leg and back moves 
• Clear step-by-step illustrations for every movement 
• Three fresh suggestions with each nudge, so it never gets stale

FITS YOUR SCHEDULE 
• Nudges only on the days and hours you choose 
• Cadence of 30, 45 or 60 minutes 
• Pause for the rest of today when you're in back-to-back meetings

ACT RIGHT FROM THE LOCK SCREEN 
• Done logs your break in one tap 
• Snooze gives you 5 more minutes 
• Move opens the movement with swipeable alternatives

SEE YOUR PROGRESS 
• Today's breaks and a simple weekly chart 
• A log of what you did and what you skipped

PRIVATE BY DESIGN 
• No account, no sign-up, no ads 
• Everything stays on your iPhone. We don't collect any data.

Looks great in light and dark mode, and uses the full width of larger iPhone displays when unfolded.

Move gently and stop if anything hurts. Leg Room offers general wellness ideas, not medical advice.

Terms of Use (EULA):
https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/ itunes/dev/stdeula/

Privacy Policy:
https://www.taplabs.cloud/leg-room/privacy/

name: Lernwörter mit Spaß
description:
Lernwörter ist ein ruhiger Trainer für die Lernwörter aus der Grundschule. Eltern tragen die Wörter der Woche ein, Kinder üben sie – Schritt für Schritt und ohne Druck.

SO FUNKTIONIERT'S
Jedes Wort wandert durch eine Lernkartei mit fünf Fächern. Wird es richtig geschrieben, rückt es ein Fach weiter und kommt erst nach einigen Tagen wieder dran. Wird es falsch geschrieben, startet es von vorn. So werden schwierige Wörter öfter geübt und sichere Wörter seltener – genau wie mit der klassischen Karteikarten-Methode nach Leitner.

WÖRTER, DIE WACHSEN
Im Wörtergarten sieht dein Kind, wie jedes Wort vom Samen über Keimling, Pflanze und Knospe bis zur Blüte wächst. Das motiviert, ohne zu stressen.

SPIELE ZUM ÜBEN
• Artikel finden – der, die, das (und Mehrzahl)
• Buchstabensalat – Buchstaben in die richtige Reihenfolge bringen
• Lückenwörter – fehlende Buchstaben ergänzen
• Wörter-Memory – gleiche Wörter finden
• Hör-Diktat – Wort anhören und richtig schreiben

FÜR ELTERN
• Eigener Eltern-Bereich, geschützt mit PIN
• Wörterlisten anlegen, bearbeiten und löschen
• Tägliche Erinnerung, wenn Wörter fällig sind – zur Uhrzeit deiner Wahl
• Backup als Datei sichern und wiederherstellen, z. B. über iCloud Drive oder AirDrop
• Groß- und Kleinschreibung wahlweise beachten
• Dunkler Modus

SICHER UND PRIVAT
• Funktioniert komplett offline
• Kein Konto, keine Werbung, keine In-App-Käufe
• Keine Datenerfassung – alle Wörter bleiben auf deinem Gerät

Für iPhone und iPad.

name: Lesibus! Tandem
description:
Two children, one iPad, one story. Lesibus! Tandem brings paired reading to the iPad. One child reads and the other coaches. Start by reading together, then switch to solo reading when the reader feels ready.

THE DIGITAL READING GUIDE
The coach drags the guide along the bottom of the screen to highlight the current word. Both children can see where they are while the coach’s finger stays below the text. If the reader gets stuck, the coach taps to lift and enlarge the word and show its syllables in alternating blue and red. A second tap bursts it into stardust.

READ FACE TO FACE
Choose how you are sitting before you start. In face-to-face mode, each child sees the same text from their side of the iPad. The coach moves the reading guide and both views follow.

FOUR ROUNDS WITH A DIFFERENT FOCUS
Reading the same text aloud helps you get to know it. Practise accuracy, confidence and fluency, then try reading with expression. Give each other brief feedback after each round and enjoy a little magic. Round four ends with a bigger celebration, a Finished stamp and a reading log entry.

37 ILLUSTRATED STORIES
Choose from three reading levels. Every story is available in German, English, French and Spanish. Paste your own text, extract text from a photo or scan a page with the camera. Bring an excerpt from a DRM-free EPUB into paired reading.

AT SCHOOL AND AT HOME
Designed for one iPad in portrait or landscape. Choose Andika, ABeeZee or Atkinson Hyperlegible and adjust text size and sounds. Works offline. Profiles, reading progress and imported texts are stored on the iPad. No child accounts, ads or tracking.

name: Leyptr
description:
Leyptr puts the terminals on your own machine in your pocket. Start Claude Code, a build or a dev server on your VM, server or always-on PC, close the app, and it keeps running. Open Leyptr later and you're back exactly where you left off, with the screen and scrollback intact.

HOW IT WORKS
Run one command on your machine to install the small Leyptr agent. It prints a QR code. Scan it with the app and your machine appears, reachable over your private Tailscale network. There is no Leyptr server and no account: your phone talks straight to your machine.

A REAL TERMINAL, BUILT FOR TOUCH
- Full terminal with color, fast redraws and smooth scrolling
- A key row with Esc, Tab, Ctrl, Alt, Cmd, arrows and sticky modifiers
- Compose box with autocorrect and dictation for long messages and prompts
- Touch selection, copy and paste, and pinch to change the font size

MADE FOR CLAUDE CODE
- See which session is waiting for you, right on the list
- Answer Claude's questions with big buttons instead of typing 1, 2 or 3
- Get a notification when a session needs you

YOUR FILES
- Browse folders on your machine
- Read code with syntax colors and make quick edits
- Open images and stream video straight from the machine

TERMINALS THAT SURVIVE
Closing the app, locking the phone, losing signal or restarting the agent doesn't stop anything. Each terminal lives in its own process on your machine.

WHAT YOU NEED
- A Linux machine with Node.js 20 or newer
- Tailscale on the machine and on your iPhone, signed in to the same account

No machine yet? Tap "Explore the demo" to look around first.

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
Leyptr collects no data. Your terminal contents and files travel only between your phone and your own machine.

name: Lía de Simplifies
description:
Lía es la asistente que responde los mensajes de tu negocio y agenda por ti. Esta app es el lugar donde tú y tu equipo ven todo lo que pasa y toman el control cuando hace falta.

Un solo buzón
Todas las conversaciones de tu negocio en un mismo lugar, con las redes y el chat web que tengas conectados. Lee lo que Lía respondió, busca un chat y sigue cada conversación desde el teléfono.

Respondes tú cuando quieres
Toca «Pausar» en una conversación y es tuya: escribe, manda una nota de voz, una foto o un archivo. Cuando terminas, Lía vuelve a atender con un toque.

Te avisa a tiempo
Recibe un aviso cuando un cliente pide hablar con una persona, cuando entra una reserva o una venta, o cuando un canal necesita tu atención.

Lía aprende de tu negocio
Dile cómo quieres que responda, pruébala antes de que hable con tus clientes y revisa las mejoras que te propone.

Tus clientes y tu día
La ficha de cada cliente con su historial, tu agenda, tus campañas y los números de tu negocio.

Para usar la app necesitas la cuenta de Lía de tu negocio. Entras con Apple, con un código que llega a tu correo o con tu contraseña.

name: LibraryTrolley
description:
Welcome to the quietest, coziest traffic jam you’ll ever solve.
Library Trolley is a logistics puzzle set in a warm, wood-paneled library. Automatic book carts roll along a web of tracks, and you decide where they go. Flip switches, park trolleys at waiting stations, open and close gates, and time every release so each collection reaches the right shelf without a single collision.
HOW IT PLAYS
Rotate switches to steer trolleys through intersections
Park trolleys at waiting stations to let traffic pass
Hold a trolley on its platform and release it at the perfect moment
Use levers to open one gate while closing another
Pause at any time to plan your next move
10 HANDCRAFTED LEVELS
Start with a single cart on a straight track. Within a few levels you’ll be managing shared tracks, one-way roundabouts, closed sections, priority deliveries and, finally, five trolleys across the entire Grand Library. Every level is solvable, and every level is a new puzzle.
EARN THREE STARS
Finish a level for one star. Run your trolleys in parallel and keep waiting to a minimum to earn three.
FEATURES
Smooth animated trolleys and rotating track switches
Gentle background music and sound effects, each with its own mute option
Progress and stars saved automatically
No ads, no timers, no internet required
Deliver the books. Keep the carts moving. Keep the library calm.

name: Lifeline Exercise
description:
Lifeline Exercise helps you turn the moments that shaped you into a personal timeline.

ADD YOUR MOMENTS
Write down what happened, give each moment a date and a score, and see the highs and lows take shape over time. Keep building your story at your own pace.

SEE YOUR STORY
Explore your lifelines as visual timelines. Edit the moments that matter and download a lifeline image to keep or share.

SHARE BY CHOICE
Choose which lifelines to share. Use spaces to bring people together and presentations to explore stories as a group.

OPTIONAL AI HELP
Ask for help finding words or reflecting on patterns in your timeline. The app explains what information goes to the AI service and asks before you use it.

Lifeline Exercise is a personal storytelling and reflection tool, not a fitness tracker or medical service. Sign in with an email account.

name: LiftHer - Female Fitness
description:
LiftHer helps you plan your training week, log each set, and review your progress.

Plan lifts, runs, rides, walks, yoga, mobility, and rest days for this week or next week. Add more than one activity to a day. Browse the on-device exercise catalog, choose moves for a lift, change their order, and customize the sets for each one.

Record reps and weight set by set. Add set copies the previous set so you can adjust it. For a run, ride, or walk, enter time and distance or track today's route with GPS. LiftHer calculates pace from time and distance.

Progress shows this week's sessions, moving minutes, and lifting volume. Open the calendar to revisit a day, inspect a lift's history, or correct a completed workout.

Your setup, plans, workouts, and recorded routes are saved on your iPhone. Export a data copy when you want to move it yourself.

name: LiftLogic Fitness
description:
LiftLogic is a workout log built around one idea: progressive overload. Log your sets and LiftLogic tells you what to lift next time, so you keep getting stronger instead of guessing.

TRACK EVERY LIFT
• Build workouts for push, pull, legs or anything else
• Log weight, reps and how hard each set felt
• Warm-up, hypertrophy and strength sets, with a rest timer
• Hundreds of exercises, including gym machines

KNOW WHAT TO LIFT NEXT
• Weight and rep suggestions based on your last sessions
• Estimated one-rep max and volume charts for every exercise
• Personal records celebrated as you hit them

TRAIN SMARTER
• Muscle recovery map shows what's rested and what needs a break
• Technique videos and form tips for the main exercises
• Beginner programs for the gym or for home

TRAIN WITH OTHERS
• Add friends by username
• Opt-in weekly leaderboard for effort points
• Find a gym buddy with similar goals (18+, opt-in)

Your data syncs across your phone and the web at myliftlogic.com. Sign in with Apple, Google or email. You can delete your account and all your data at any time from Profile.

name: Lignote
description:
Lignote is an offline field logbook for composting. It is designed for managing batches, recording actual material inputs, performing temperature and moisture sampling, and maintaining a traceable operational history.

Tasks
View daily, batch-specific, and pending field tasks—such as temperature monitoring, pile turning, moisture checks, and follow-up inspections. A task is only marked as complete once the actual field record has been saved.

Recipes
Create recipes based on materials and moisture content. Lignote calculates the dry-basis carbon-to-nitrogen (C:N) ratio from your input quantities and estimates the amount of water required to reach your target moisture level. Recipes store the initial estimates; subsequent actual measurements are recorded separately.

Sampling Points
Manually log temperature and moisture data, including the timestamp, the instrument used, and the depth of the measurement. Each reading is linked to its specific sampling point. Averages and variations between points are calculated based solely on the observations you have recorded.

Records
If a record is corrected, the original entry is preserved, and a new version is appended. Reports are saved as snapshots at the time of generation; subsequent modifications will not alter reports that have already been exported. For backup purposes, you can export data as a JSON file, which can also be imported back into the device.

name: LineProof: Internet Monitor
description:
Your internet keeps dropping and your provider says they see nothing? LineProof writes down every drop with its date and time, shows whether your own router or the line past it failed, and turns it into a report and a letter you can send to your provider.

HOW IT WORKS
Put a spare iPhone or iPad on the charger near your router and leave LineProof open. Every 15 seconds (you choose 10 to 30) it quietly checks whether the internet answers, and every 5 seconds during a drop. When the internet does not answer, it checks your router and whether web addresses still work, and notes what failed. When the internet comes back, it notes the end. The screen dims itself while it logs.

WHAT YOU SEE
• Now: online or down, with today's drops and how long you were down.
• Router or line: whether a drop was in your home (Wi-Fi or router) or past your router.
• History: every day at a glance, a week map that shows when the drops happen, and the details of each drop.
• This was me: mark a drop you caused yourself, like a router restart, and it stays out of the letter.
• For the letter: your calls and chats with your provider, with dates and reference numbers, and what you already tried.
• A reminder, if you turn it on, when logging pauses because the app left the screen.

THE FULL REPORT
A one-time in-app purchase adds the documents:
• Your full history: every drop, every day.
• A PDF report: cover page, letter, summary, totals per day, the longest drops, day timelines, every drop and how it was measured.
• A letter in English, Dutch or German, in your name and yours to edit, plus a follow-up letter when it keeps dropping after you called.
• Send it from Mail with the report attached, or share it anywhere. Only you send it.
• Spreadsheet export (CSV).
One payment, no subscription. With Family Sharing it also works on your family's devices.

WITHOUT A PURCHASE
Logging, the live screen, the router or line verdict, the week map and the last 24 hours in full come with the app. A sample report shows exactly what the full report looks like before you buy.

GOOD TO KNOW
• LineProof logs while it is open on screen, because iPhone and iPad pause apps you leave. Keep the device plugged in. Times when it was not logging are marked, so gaps never look like uptime.
• Guided Access keeps the app on screen. The app shows you how to turn it on.
• To check your router, the app asks for access to your local network. Only your router is checked.
• The report is a record of what this device measured, not an official measurement.

YOUR LOG STAYS WITH YOU
No account, no ads, no tracking. The log stays on this device unless you share a report yourself. Each check is a tiny request to a public web address. It carries nothing about you.

Works on iPhone and iPad with iOS 17 or later. In English, Dutch and German. Made by A Brand New Company.

name: Listeio
description:
Listeio is the workspace for companies that manage holiday and long-term rental homes.

- Homes and listings: every home with its photos, details, prices and documents.
- Calendar and bookings: arrivals, departures and stays across all your homes at a glance.
- Tasks: see what is yours today, mark it done, and get a notification when a colleague gives you a new one.
- Team chat: one-to-one and group chats with your colleagues, with report and block.
- Check-ins and cleaning: reports with photos straight from your phone's camera.
- The assistant: ask about your homes and bookings, by text or by voice.

Listeio is for teams whose company uses Listeio. Sign in with your company code, username and password; your company's admin makes your login.

name: Little Otter: Sea Adventure
description:
Swim, eat, grow stronger and open the whole sea!

Little Otter is a bright 3D adventure about a small sea otter with a big appetite. Drag your finger and swim: the otter swipes the closest creature with its paw all by itself. Every creature you catch gives you its own strength for good: crabs give armor, jellyfish give shock, mussels give health.

TWO SEAS, FIFTEEN GUARDIANS
From Kelp Cove to Seagrass Bay: rocky shoals, coral isles, a glacier bay, a mangrove delta, the open blue, a volcano coast and turquoise flats. Each area is closed by its guardian, a giant crab, a shark, a cuttlefish, a walrus, a crocodile, the Kraken and more. Beat it and the way to the next area opens. After the ninth guardian a portal opens to the Second Sea: pink sands, basalt cliffs, crystal lagoons and an ancient reef, with a giant megalodon waiting at the end.

GROW YOUR OWN WAY
Pick a skill card at every level, put stones into necklaces, and build the otter you like: hard-hitting, tough, fast or poisonous.

NO RUSH
Rest and your health comes back. If you faint, you wake up on your home island and keep everything you earned. The game saves by itself.

- 2 seas, 15 areas, 15 guardians, 75 levels
- Dozens of sea creatures, each with its own power
- Necklaces, cut stones and chests
- Optional videos for extra rewards; no banners
- Plays offline
- 12 languages

name: Loadline: Tendon Pain Log
description:
Loadline is a daily check-in for lifters who train with a cranky tendon.

Three quick entries a day build a record you can actually use:

MORNING
Rate stiffness from 0 to 10 when you get up, and see how it compares with your previous entry.

TRAINING
Write down what you did and the load, then rate the most pain you felt during the session. Copy yesterday's exercises in one tap, or mark a rest day.

EVENING
Leave yourself one small, specific step for tomorrow.

SEE THE WEEK
Seven-day charts show morning stiffness and session pain side by side, with each session compared against a pain limit you choose. Switch to a list view any time.

KEEP EACH SIDE SEPARATE
Track your patellar tendon, Achilles or another tendon, left, right or both, each with its own history.

READY FOR YOUR PHYSIO
Open any past day to see exactly what you lifted and how it felt. Add days you missed.

YOUR DATA STAYS WITH YOU
No account. Records stay on your iPhone. Export everything as a file and restore it later, and Loadline keeps a backup of what was there before each restore.

Built by a physical therapist (licensed in Japan).

Loadline is a self-tracking tool, not medical advice. It doesn't diagnose or treat anything. If pain is severe, getting worse, or comes with swelling, numbness or a sudden pop, see a doctor or physical therapist.

SUBSCRIPTION
Loadline Pro unlocks the app.
- Yearly: $24.99/year, with a 7-day free trial for new subscribers
- Monthly: $4.99/month
Payment is charged to your Apple Account when you confirm the purchase, or at the end of the free trial. Subscriptions renew automatically unless canceled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. Manage or cancel in your Apple Account settings.

Terms of Use: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/
Privacy Policy: https://kengohayano10.github.io/loadline/privacy.html

name: Local Link Driver
description:
Local Link Driver is the app for drivers on Local Link, the ride service built
for Tzaneen and the towns around it. Go online when it suits you, accept trips
from riders nearby and get paid for every kilometre.

GO ONLINE IN A TAP
Switch on and riders close to you can be matched with you straight away. Go
offline whenever you want — there are no shifts to book.

SEE THE JOB BEFORE YOU TAKE IT
Every request shows the pickup, the drop-off, the distance and the fare, so you
decide which trips are worth it before you accept.

NAVIGATION BUILT IN
Follow the route to the pickup and on to the drop-off without leaving the app,
or open it in your favourite maps app.

KNOW WHAT YOU EARN
Your earnings screen shows every trip, cash and card earnings, and progress
towards your daily target.

PAYOUTS TO YOUR BANK
Link your bank account once and request a payout whenever it suits you.

SAFETY FIRST
An SOS button is always one tap away during a trip, and you can report a
problem with any trip. Chat with your rider in the app.

SIGN UP IN THE APP
Register with your phone number, add your vehicle and upload your documents.
Our team reviews your application and lets you know as soon as you are
approved to drive.

Location: while you are online, Local Link Driver uses your location in the
background so riders can see you arriving and you keep receiving nearby
requests when you switch to another app. Go offline to stop it.
