name: Locista
description:
Ideas born away from your desk, delivered back to it.

Locista is a note app that keeps the moment an idea arrives — along with its context. Place, weather, steps and your calendar are added for you, so when you look back, you also get back where you were and how it felt.

WHERE IT HELPS
• On the morning commute: say it out loud. Transcription happens on your device.
• On a walk: snap the sky by the river. Where and when stay with the photo.
• Reading papers: share a PDF to get its details (authors, journal, year) and a summary, then copy a citation.
• Kindle highlights: import them in one go, grouped by book.
• Back at your desk: send notes with their context to Obsidian, Notion, Slack, Reminders or Mail.

CAPTURE
Voice, text, photos, links and files. Save in a second from the Lock Screen, Siri, Shortcuts or the Share sheet. Context is added quietly afterwards.

REVIEW
Browse, search, and filter by place, weather or event. Once a day, a forgotten note comes back to you.

SEE CONNECTIONS
As notes grow, similar ones gather into islands. See the whole Island map, or Explore outward from a single note.

DELIVER
To Reminders, Calendar, Mail or Markdown. Every note has a permanent link, so you can always get back from wherever you sent it.

PRIVACY
Your notes and their context stay on your device and in your own iCloud. There is no developer server. Coordinates go only to Apple and the weather provider to look up the weather and place names, and notes keep only the neighborhood. No ads, no analytics.

LOCISTA PRO (AUTO-RENEWABLE SUBSCRIPTION)
Capturing, reviewing, folders, and sending to Reminders or Mail stay free forever. Locista Pro adds:
• Import PDF, Word, Markdown folders, Kindle and WhatsApp
• Look up paper details and copy citations
• Send to Obsidian, Notion, Slack and WhatsApp
• All notes on the Island map and in Explore (free: the newest 200)
• Save up to 50 places (free: 5)

Choose yearly or monthly; the yearly plan starts with a 1-month free trial. Prices are shown in the app. Payment is charged to your Apple Account at confirmation of purchase, and the subscription renews automatically unless canceled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. Cancel anytime in Settings → Apple Account → Subscriptions. If you stop, you simply go back to the free plan — all your notes stay readable.

Terms of Use (Apple standard EULA): https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/
Privacy Policy: https://locista.app/en/privacy/

name: LootBomb: Bank Heist
description:
You are a living bomb with a thief mask and a gold tooth. The plan? Roll through the bank, dodge everything and blow the vault before the fuse runs out.

ROB BANKS
• Tap to jump: the bomb rolls on its own, you pick the perfect moment.
• Dodge saw blades, lasers, armored doors, robot dogs, electric floors, rail saws and extinguisher blasts.
• Touched a trap? Boom: you lose 70% of the loot and get a new bomb.
• Crack the vault dial by tapping at the right time.

BUILD YOUR BANK
• Your bank is a target too. Place traps and test the path before saving.
• Upgrade every trap up to armored level.
• Fill your vault to move up: Neighborhood Branch, Regional Bank, Bank HQ, Mint and Central Bank.

PVP AND FRIENDS
• Rob other players' banks and see who tried to rob yours.
• Take revenge on whoever took your money.
• Trophy leaderboard, friends list and daily Gold Bar gifts.

50 TRICKY BRANCHES
• A campaign that keeps getting harder.

YOUR STYLE
• Bomb skins (Galaxy, Exploding Watermelon, top-hat Director's Ruby and more) and bank looks.
• Timed blessings, daily bonus and piggy bank.

No forced ads: only optional rewarded videos.

Terms: https://lootbomb-302c3.web.app/termos
Privacy: https://lootbomb-302c3.web.app/privacidade

name: Love Letter: Animated Card
description:
A love letter that comes to life.

Hold your phone upright and one of them is waiting on the beach at sunset. Turn it sideways and there is the other, who was there all along. They spot each other, run, and never let go. A heart, your words, and then the sun goes down and the fireworks start.

Love Letter is a little animated card for two people in love: an engagement, a wedding, an anniversary, or just because.

MAKE IT ABOUT YOUR COUPLE
Build the two of them from scratch: skin, hair, beards, glasses, outfits and height. Write your own greeting and message.

THEIR PETS, THEIR INITIALS
Add a dog, a cat and a bunny in the coat that matches theirs. Put their initials or a date in a heart in the sand, and watch the tide wash over it.

A BEACH FULL OF LITTLE THINGS
Tap the pets, the crab, the beach ball, the palm tree and the heart. Tilt your phone to look around. Turn the sound on for waves, footsteps and fireworks.

STAY FOR THE ENDING
After the hug the sunset turns to night, with stars, paper lanterns and fireworks over the sea.

SEND IT
Share the finished card with anyone who has the app and it opens as theirs.

MADE FOR IPHONE DUO TOO
On a folding iPhone the card starts on the cover, and opening the phone reveals the other half of the scene.

No account. No ads. Nothing collected. Free.

name: Love Natural Beauty
description:
Love Natural Beauty brings clean, organic beauty from brands you can trust to your iPhone, iPad, Mac and Apple Vision Pro.

We do the ingredient research for you, carefully selecting beauty, wellness, and home essentials from trusted brands that share our commitment to natural and organic ingredients.

SHOP
• Shop skincare, tallow skincare, hair & body, wellness & home, candles, and gifts $30 & under
• Discover Products We Love, our favorite clean beauty finds
• Search by product, brand, or ingredient, with instant suggestions as you type
• Filter by brand, category, price, and availability, and sort by price or what’s new
• Explore brand pages to shop everything from the makers you love
• See what pairs well with each product and find similar favorites

SAVE AND COME BACK
• Tap the heart to save favorites, and organize them into lists like Daily Skincare or Gift Ideas
• Pick up where you left off with Recently Viewed
• Your favorites, lists, and cart sync across your Apple devices with iCloud
• Add Featured Products to your Home Screen with a widget

NEVER MISS OUT
• Get notified when a sold-out product is back in stock
• Turn on price drop alerts to hear when a favorite goes on sale
• Join our email list to be the first to hear about new arrivals

CHECKOUT AND ORDERS
• Check out securely with Shopify, including Shop Pay
• Sign in to see your orders and track your shipments
• Buy Again to reorder past favorites in a tap

Naturally beautiful, every day.

name: LumiMuro
description:
LumiMuro hjelper deg med å forstå og planlegge tradisjonelle snøkammer som passive kjølesystemer.

Bruk lokal breddegrad, snømengde, rommål, isolasjon og luftsirkulasjon til å beregne innemiljø gjennom året. Se temperaturkurver, smeltehastighet, gjenstående snø og hvor mange kjøledager du kan forvente.

Vurder om rotgrønnsaker, frukt, korn, vin eller andre landbruksvarer passer i kammeret. Få oversikt over egnete måneder, temperatur- og fuktavvik, foreslått volum og om varer kan lagres sammen.

Registrer inne- og uteforhold for å få råd om når lufting hjelper, når uteluft øker varmebelastningen, og hvordan sirkulasjonen kan forbedres.

Sammenlign designendringer — mer snø, bedre isolasjon, andre luftåpninger — og se effekten på temperatur, snøforbruk og kjølevarighet.

LumiMuro gir miljøreferanse for planlegging. Appen vurderer ikke mattrygghet og garanterer ikke faktisk lagringstid eller kvalitet.

name: Luna's Quest
description:
When fire and stone unite, a bond of love will ignite. Yet through this bond, shadows will grow...

Luna has never met her father. A witch's curse tore him away the morning after her parents' wedding and took his memory with it. Her mother survives on bundles of silver leaves that arrive each week from nowhere. On her fifteenth birthday, Luna learns the truth, and what she does next is up to you.

Luna's Quest is an interactive fantasy story in the tradition of the gamebooks where you chose your own path. Every page ends in a decision, and every decision is yours.

WHAT YOU'LL DO
• Choose from three or four options on every page
• Bargain with a dragon, outwit a creature made of lies, and trade insults with a very vain guard dog
• Collect keepsakes that open new paths later in the story
• Decide whether to trust the witch who started it all
• Discover what true sacrifice means, and whether you are willing to make it

NINE ENDINGS
Some are happy, some are bittersweet, and one or two are your own fault. Take a wrong turn and you can step back one choice and try another way. The game keeps track of every ending you have found.

MADE FOR READING
• A complete story you can finish in one sitting, then replay for the endings you missed
• Your place is saved automatically
• Works on iPhone and iPad
• No ads, no in-app purchases, no account, and no internet connection needed

Trust your heart, mind the seers' riddles, and whatever you do, don't blow the horn.

name: Lunara by Andreina Nature
description:
Lunara is a daily beauty routine guided by the rhythm of the moon, created by Andreina Castillo, naturopath and founder of Andreina Nature.

Open the app each day for a gentle ritual, a moment of peace and natural hair care you can do at home.

LUNAR RITUALS
- Follow the moon phase of the day
- Guided sessions with a timer and calming music
- A lunar calendar to plan your rituals

HAIR SCAN (PREMIUM)
- Take 4 guided photos of your hair and scalp
- Answer 6 quick questions
- Receive cosmetic care guidance and up to 3 natural product suggestions from Andreina Nature
- Save your scans in your profile and see your progress

NATURAL HAIR TREATMENTS
- Step-by-step recipes made with ingredients like honey, avocado, aloe vera, rosemary and castor oil
- The first recipe in each category is free. Premium unlocks them all

DAILY DEVOTIONAL
- A short daily reading for a calm start
- Gentle reminders you can turn on or off

ANDREINA ACADEMY
- Discover Andreina's courses and learn her natural haircare method

SHOP ANDREINA NATURE
- Browse and order Andreina Nature products inside the app

FREE AND PREMIUM
- Free: daily devotional, lunar calendar, rituals, notifications and the first treatment of each category
- Premium ($3.99 per month): the hair scan technology, one scan every month and all hair treatments
- Need another scan? Premium members can add extra scans for $1.99 each
- For our launch, the first 500 people to download get one free scan

Subscription details: Premium is an auto-renewing monthly subscription. Payment is charged to your Apple ID account at confirmation of purchase. The subscription renews automatically unless it is cancelled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. You can manage or cancel it anytime in your App Store account settings.

Not medical advice. This cosmetic guidance comes from Andreina Castillo as a naturopath, from natural haircare practice. It does not diagnose or treat any condition.

Privacy Policy: https://andreinanaturestore.com/policies/privacy-policy
Terms of Use: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/
Support: info@andreinanaturestore.com

name: LUXIMA Print
description:
LUXIMA Print turns a phone or tablet into a label printing station for your Luxima catalogue.

Pair it once with a code from Luxima › Printing › Print stations. The app then keeps a copy of your products and your label design on the device, so it prints even when the shop's Wi-Fi is down.

• Find a product by name, SKU or GTIN, or scan its barcode or passport QR code with the camera
• Pick the sizes and how many of each, and see the exact label before it prints
• Prints straight to the printer – no print dialog on every job
• Office and AirPrint printers over Wi-Fi (IPP), Zebra label printers over Wi-Fi or Bluetooth, cab label printers (JScript) over Wi-Fi
• Work orders from your ERP (NetSuite) appear at the top of the search
• Everything printed is reported back to Luxima, so your records stay complete
• The catalogue and label refresh themselves whenever the design or products change

LUXIMA Print needs a Luxima account with the label printing add-on. Visit luxima.io to learn more or book a demo.

name: M&H: Made in Human
description:
Made in Human is a market and a community for people who make things by hand — and for everyone who loves things that have an author.

FOR BUYERS
• Browse ceramics, clothing, knitwear, jewelry, paintings, cards, woodwork, leather, toys, candles and more.
• See makers in your city first, or switch to the whole world with one tap.
• Message a maker right from an item, or jump straight to their WhatsApp or Telegram.
• Visit the workshop: makers can add their studio address and you can open it in Maps.
• Save favorites and follow makers you like.

FOR MAKERS
• Open your own workshop in a minute: name, photo, city, workshop address.
• List items with photos, your own price and any currency — it remembers your choice for next time.
• Mark items as made to order or shipping worldwide, and mark them sold when they're gone.
• Share your process in the feed: new pieces, firing days, dyeing, sketches.

HOW DEALS WORK
Payment and delivery are agreed directly between buyer and maker. Made in Human never takes a commission and never holds your money.

A SAFE PLACE
Only handmade items. Every item, post, comment and profile can be reported, any user can be blocked, and reports are reviewed within 24 hours.

Available in English and Russian. Sign in with Apple, Google or email.

name: Magma : le mot secret
description:
Chaque jour, un mot secret. Pour le trouver, pas de lettres à placer : écris des mots, et le volcan te dit si leur sens s'en approche.

UN VOLCAN QUI TE RÉPOND
Un mot sans rapport ? Le volcan gèle. Tu chauffes ? La lave monte et coule le long de ses flancs. Tu tiens le mot ? Éruption !

PAS DE CHAMP DE SAISIE
Tu écris en grand, directement à la place du mot. Chaque essai rejoint ta liste, rangé du plus chaud au plus froid, avec son rang parmi les 1 000 mots les plus proches : « 3e » veut dire que deux mots seulement sont plus proches.

UN COUP DE POUCE QUAND TU BLOQUES
L'ampoule te souffle un mot plus chaud que ton meilleur essai. Il compte comme un essai, et tu peux en redemander tant qu'il reste des mots plus proches.

TES PARTIES, TON RYTHME
Ta série de jours, tes chiffres, et un calendrier pour rejouer les mots que tu as manqués. Partage ta partie en image, sans jamais dévoiler le mot.

SIMPLE ET RESPECTUEUX
Gratuit, sans publicité, sans compte, sans achat. Tout reste sur ton téléphone : Magma ne collecte aucune donnée et fonctionne même hors connexion.

Proximité des mots : French Word Embeddings, Jean-Philippe Fauconnier (CC BY 3.0).
Politique de confidentialité : https://oramiapps.com/magma/confidentialite

name: Mahovina
description:
Mahovina je bilježnica za sitni život na kamenu, kori i tlu. Primakni se, snimi makro i ostavi trag onakav kakav je tog dana.

Nakon snimanja odaberi jednu od četiri teksture: mokri sjaj, pliš, prigušeni sjaj ili slojevi tame. Zatim doradi teksturu i primi mahovinu. Ista ploha dijeli isto ime, pa se njeni tragovi slažu u jedan vremenski presjek.

Otvori trag i zapiši vlagu, dodir i kratku bilješku. Možeš ga sačuvati, izvesti u album ili odbaciti. Galerija lista spremljene tragove. Presjeci ih grupiraju po imenu plohe.

Atmosfera mijenja raspoloženje aplikacije: Sljoka, Stube, Dolina ili Lišaj. Dodir zaključava izbor. „Uz brdo” prati vlažnost mjesta. U Tonu podešavaš jačinu teksture, gustoću atmosfere, brzinu spora i oštrinu pregleda.

Susret lista tvoje tragove, do dvadeset okretanja dnevno. Arhiva broji što je u kutiji i izvozi šifriranu kopiju.

name: Manabu2
description:
Manabu2（まなぶ）は、AI時代に必要なスキルを、スキマ時間に少しずつ身につけられる社会人のための学習アプリです。

生成AIの基本から、資料作成・データ分析・営業・マネジメントでのAI活用まで、仕事にすぐ役立つ実践コースをそろえています。1レッスンは数分。通勤中や休憩時間にも、前回の続きからすぐに再開できます。

■ 主な機能

・続きから学習
ホーム画面から、学習中のコースにワンタップで戻れます。

・実践コース
AIエージェント、プロンプト設計、ビジネス文書、データの可視化、A/Bテストなど、テーマごとに体系立てたコースで学べます。

・クイズで理解度チェック
レッスンごとのクイズで、学んだ内容をその場で確認。合格ラインがあるので、理解できたかがはっきりわかります。

・学習パスとテスト
会社から割り当てられた研修は、期限が近いものから一覧で確認できます。確認テストの結果もすぐにわかります。

・記録と修了証
修了したコース、レッスン数、クイズとテストの結果、修了証をまとめて確認できます。

・探す
コースや学習パスをキーワードで検索できます。

■ はじめかた

アプリ内でメールアドレスからアカウントを作成できます。Apple・Google・Microsoft のアカウントでもすぐに始められます。

■ 企業・団体の方へ

Manabu2 は社員研修にも対応しています。研修の割り当て、進捗の確認、修了証の発行などの管理機能は manabu2.com からご利用いただけます。

アカウントはアプリの「マイページ」からいつでも削除できます（会社が管理するアカウントは、その会社の管理者が削除します）。

name: Manara Rent a Car
seller_name: Kalynda Teknoloji Havacilik ve Turizm Limited Sirketi
description:
Rent a car directly from the owner at Dalaman Airport (DLM) with Manara Rent a Car. No agents, no brokers: we hand over well-maintained cars from our own fleet at the airport car park, 24/7.

What you can do
- Pick your pick-up and return dates and see every available car with its total price.
- Choose from economy, compact, SUV, automatic or 7-9 seat cars.
- Tap a price to see the booking summary and book in a few steps.
- Add your flight number; if your flight is delayed, we wait for you.
- Message us from the app, we answer 24/7.
- Manage your bookings and details under My account.

Clear prices, no hidden fees
The price you see is the total price, taxes included, with no booking fee. No online payment: you pay in cash or by card when you collect the car. Free cancellation and changes up to 24 hours before pick-up.

Pick-up and return
Collect your car at the Dalaman Airport car park and return it there. A valid driving licence and ID or passport are all you need; minimum age, licence years and deposit are shown on each car.

Start your holiday in Dalaman, Fethiye, Gocek, Dalyan, Oludeniz, Hisaronu, Sarigerme or Marmaris right at the airport.

name: Mandem GP
description:
Night-time London. Neon on wet tarmac. The roads round Westminster and the West End are closed off for one night only, and the mandem are racing.

RACE THROUGH REAL LONDON
Tear down Whitehall, round Parliament Square, past Big Ben and the lit-up London Eye, and through Chinatown's lanterns on Shaftesbury Avenue. Boost pads, power-ups, drift turbos and five rivals.

FREE ROAM THE ENDS
Side hustles everywhere: food deliveries against the clock, checkpoint sprints, speed cameras, longest-wheelie challenges and Hot Bike chases. Ten photo spots at the sights, 24 hidden dubplates and grime easter eggs to find.

TRICKS AND STUNTS
Wheelies, stoppies, kickers and near misses. Chain them for combos.

FIVE EVENTS
The Chinatown Sprint, the Westminster GP, a rush-hour snatch run, The Bowl trick session and the Bally Run escape. Medals for each.

Grime on the radio, neon on the walls, fireworks over the river. No ads, no in-app purchases, plays offline.

Bus model "London Bus 3D" by Vasyl Pavlyuchok, CC BY 4.0 (modified).

name: Maps4me RTK
description:
O Maps4me RTK transforma o seu iPhone, iPad ou Mac em uma coletora completa para receptores GNSS RTK.

CONEXÃO COM O RECEPTOR
• Receptores R10, SMA25R e SMA26 Plus/Pro, além de receptores genéricos que enviam NMEA por Bluetooth LE.
• Modelo, número de série, firmware e bateria do receptor na tela.

RTK E PRECISÃO
• Cliente NTRIP integrado: use a RBMC-IP do IBGE ou a sua própria base.
• Status Single, DGPS, Float e Fix, satélites, PDOP, idade da correção e precisões horizontal e vertical em tempo real.
• Skyplot com os satélites de cada constelação.
• PPP por satélite (Galileo HAS e BeiDou PPP-B2b) nos receptores compatíveis.

LEVANTAMENTO
• Coleta de pontos com média de épocas e limites de precisão, exigindo RTK Fix quando você quiser.
• Altura de antena por bastão ou tripé, com o centro de fase de cada modelo.
• Códigos, linhas e polígonos, pontos por offset e mapa com imagem de satélite.

LOCAÇÃO
• Locação de pontos e de linhas com mapa, bússola e modo de precisão centimétrica.
• Frente, lado e diferença de cota até o ponto, com aviso sonoro ao chegar.

COGO E CAD
• Divisão de área, linha e polilinha, offset, círculo por 3 pontos, círculo por raio, linha a 90°, régua e inverso.

SUPERFÍCIE E VOLUMES
• Modelo do terreno, curvas de nível, corte e aterro e volumes, com a margem de erro estimada.

SISTEMAS DE COORDENADAS
• SIRGAS 2000 / UTM e sistemas nacionais de vários países.
• Altitude geométrica ou ortométrica, com o modelo hgeoHNOR2020 do IBGE incluído.

IMPORTAÇÃO E EXPORTAÇÃO
• TXT, CSV, DXF, KML, GeoJSON e LandXML, além de relatório em PDF.
• Planilha do SIGEF (INCRA) gerada direto da obra.

IDIOMAS
Português, inglês, espanhol, francês, italiano e chinês.

TESTE GRÁTIS E LICENÇA
Use todas as funções gratuitamente por 7 dias. Depois, uma única compra libera o app para sempre, sem mensalidade. A mesma compra vale no iPhone, iPad e Mac com o seu Apple ID.

Requer um receptor GNSS compatível.

name: Marafek - مرافق
description:
Keep facility maintenance organized with Marafek. Give your team one place to report issues, follow progress, manage assets and plan preventive maintenance.

REPORT AND FOLLOW UP
Describe the issue, choose its location and attach photos. Find reports by status, building, urgency or linked asset. A small photo indicator helps you spot reports with images.

COORDINATE THE WORK
Assign reports to people, maintenance groups or external contractors. Update status and urgency, add notes, and review the activity history according to your permissions.

LOOK AFTER YOUR ASSETS
Browse equipment records, linked reports and maintenance history. Create one-time or recurring maintenance plans for the work your facility needs.

UNDERSTAND YOUR FACILITY
Review report totals and progress. Eligible organization plans also include trends, workload analysis and custom report forms. Export filtered reports as CSV.

MADE FOR YOUR TEAM
Use Arabic or English, choose light or dark appearance, and access the tools available to your role.

Marafek requires an existing account with a participating facility. Sign in with your company code, email and password. Ask your facility administrator for access. Features depend on your role and the facility’s subscription. An internet connection is required to sign in and synchronize data.

name: Maryam: Arab tili
description:
Maryam o‘zbek ayollariga zamonaviy adabiy arab tilini o‘rgatadi. Ilova o‘zbek tilida.

Har bir dars 45–90 soniyalik video: ustoza harfni, so‘zni yoki qoidani ko‘rsatadi. Keyin uni mashqda mustahkamlaysiz. Dars mashqda isbotlangandagina o‘zlashtirilgan hisoblanadi.

Qanday o‘rganasiz
• Ko‘ring: o‘zbekcha subtitrli qisqa video dars
• Tushuning: harf shakllari, tovushlar va misollar
• Mashq qiling: javob tanlash, tovushlarni eshitib farqlash, harf yozish, ovoz chiqarib aytish
• Isbotlang: mashqda 80% yoki undan ko‘p to‘plasangiz, dars o‘zlashtirilgan hisoblanadi
• Takrorlang: o‘rganganingiz unutilmasidan oldin takrorlashga qaytadi

Ichida
• Alifbodan boshlanadigan yo‘l: har bir harfga alohida dars
• Harf yozish: barmog‘ingiz bilan namuna ustidan yozasiz, daftaringizdagi yozuvni esa rasmga olib tekshirasiz (AI)
• Talaffuz: AI ovozingizni tinglab, qaysi tovush farq qilganini ko‘rsatadi
• AI suhbat: kafe, bozor, safar kabi kundalik vaziyatlarda arabcha gaplashib ko‘ring
• Lug‘at va takrorlash kartalari
• Haftalik hisobot: nima qildingiz va keyingi qadam qaysi

Tinch va sokin: cheksiz lenta yo‘q, reyting yo‘q, hech kim bilan solishtirilmaysiz. Davom etish uchun kuniga 5 daqiqa ham yetadi.

Telefon raqamingiz bilan kirasiz: kod SMS orqali yoki Telegramdagi Maryam botidan keladi. Ilova parol so‘ramaydi.

name: Mask Mail for Fastmail
description:
Your email. Under cover.

Mask Mail brings Fastmail masked email creation to your iPhone and iPad keyboard. Create a fresh address and insert it into the field you're filling out, without switching to Fastmail to copy and paste.

MAKE AN ADDRESS WHERE YOU NEED IT

Switch to the Mask Mail keyboard, tap Create masked email, and choose Create & insert. Add an optional description to remember what the address is for, or a prefix to personalize it. New addresses are also copied to your device's clipboard for two minutes.

TRY IT WITHOUT AN ACCOUNT

Explore demo mode with fictional sample addresses. Try descriptions, prefixes, copying, and keyboard insertion before connecting to Fastmail. Demo addresses cannot receive mail and do not use your free creations.

START WITH 10 FREE CREATIONS

Try 10 successful creations on your device, shared between the app and keyboard. Descriptions and prefixes are included. Deleting an address does not restore a free creation.

UNLOCK PRO ONCE

Mask Mail Pro removes Mask Mail's creation limit with a one-time in-app purchase. No Mask Mail subscription. A compatible Fastmail account is required separately for real addresses, and Fastmail's limits still apply.

BUILT AROUND YOUR PRIVACY

Mask Mail connects directly to Fastmail. It does not inspect the text around your cursor or send ordinary typing to Mask Mail servers. Connection credentials and cached addresses are stored in your device's Keychain. There are no ads or analytics.

GOOD TO KNOW

Mask Mail is a separate keyboard that you enable in Settings and select using the globe key. Full Access is required to create addresses because the keyboard needs to contact Fastmail and share app data. Basic typing works without Full Access. Some apps do not allow custom keyboards, and password and phone-number fields use Apple's keyboard.

Mask Mail is an independent app for Fastmail and is not affiliated with or endorsed by Fastmail.

name: Maveli - Nail Art & Designs
description:
Maveli is your personal space for nail art inspiration and design. Whether you prefer minimalist solid colors, delicate French tips, or seasonal palettes, you can explore a wide variety of styles, save your favorite looks, and gather ideas for your next manicure.

Start with colors drawn from a photo to craft your own unique color scheme. In the "Color Studio," experiment with different combinations—assigning primary, secondary, and accent colors to specific fingers—to visualize how the full set will look and transform your inspiration into a concrete design.

Use the "Nail Canvas" to customize each of your ten fingernails: select colors, add embellishments, and fine-tune the details. With features like preview, undo, and redo, you can iterate freely, save your best creations, and turn your vision into a clear, accessible reference.

Keep track of every style evolution with the "Nail Calendar." Log your manicures and removal dates by adding photos, color palettes, and personal notes. You can also schedule your next appointment and set reminders, ensuring that your favorite colors and important beauty dates are always easy to keep track of.

name: Mechanica: Gear Puzzle
description:
An abandoned factory sleeps behind rusted gates. Its engine still works — but every machine has lost the gears that brought it to life. Repair them, one mechanism at a time.

REAL GEAR PHYSICS
Every puzzle runs on true mechanics. Two meshing gears turn in opposite directions, and the speed changes with the number of teeth. Odd rings of gears jam. Nothing is faked — if the mechanism turns, your solution is right.

100 PUZZLES
• Connect the motor to locks, gates, conveyors, clocks and lifts
• Get the direction right — every mesh flips it
• Hit the exact speed with big and small gears
• Build on two tiers: brass meshes with brass, silver with silver
• Use reducers and multipliers to slow down or speed up
• Steer clear of rusty gears that jam everything they touch
• Run belts across the factory: open belts keep the direction, crossed belts flip it
• Tame speed with self-locking worm gearboxes and switch branches with clutches
• Sync two motors, filter direction with ratchets and slide racks in straight lines
The first 20 levels are free. One purchase unlocks the whole factory — no subscriptions, no ads.
Every level has one perfect solution. Find it for three stars.

DAILY PUZZLE
A new mechanism every day, the same for every player. Keep your streak going.

A FACTORY THAT COMES ALIVE
Each solved workshop starts working again: the engine pounds, the lighthouse beam sweeps, the steam hammer strikes, the whistle blows.

CRAFTED WITH CARE
• Brass, copper and steel, drawn in fine detail
• Satisfying clicks, steam and haptic feedback
• Hints when you get stuck
• Plays fully offline — no account, no ads, no tracking

name: Medalhistas Club
description:
O app definitivo para você treinar, evoluir e conquistar medalhas em olimpíadas!

Uma plataforma para alunos que buscam se destacar e conquistar medalhas nas principais olimpíadas científicas e educacionais do Brasil, como OBMEP, Canguru de Matemática, OBA, OBLI e muito mais!

O que você encontra no app:

Aulas Direcionadas: Conteúdo focado nos tópicos que realmente caem nas provas.

Simulados e Questões: Treino prático com resolução de exercícios de edições anteriores.

Gamificação e Níveis: Acompanhe sua evolução, ganhe conquistas e mantenha o ritmo de estudos.

Desempenho em Tempo Real: Identifique seus pontos fortes e o que precisa ser revisado.

Transforme a sua rotina de estudos em uma jornada de conquistas e prepare-se para subir ao pódio!!

name: MES Polls
description:
Make a poll in seconds, share one short link, and watch the votes come in live.

Your friends, family, team or class vote in any browser: they don't need the app, an account or an email. Perfect for picking a restaurant, a movie, a meeting time, or settling any group decision.

• Up to 20 options, one pick or several
• Close it yourself, after a set time, or at a date and time
• Show results always, after people vote, or only when it closes
• Allow vote changes or not
• Live bars and a donut chart, updated every few seconds
• QR code and share sheet for posting the link anywhere
• "My polls": every poll you made, with close and delete
• Optional: publish a poll on the Hive blockchain instead

Private: no account, no ads, no tracking. Polls are not listed anywhere or shown in search engines. Each phone or browser can vote once; voters are never identified.

name: MES Timer: Alarm & Stopwatch
description:
All your timers on one screen: countdowns, stopwatches and alarms side by side, with Pomodoro, interval training and date countdowns one tap away.

• Several countdowns at once, each with its own name ("Pasta", "Tea")
• Stopwatches with laps, fastest and slowest marked
• Alarms: daily or once, snooze, your own spoken message
• Pomodoro: focus and breaks, rounds, auto-advance
• Interval timer: Tabata, HIIT, EMOM and your own work / rest / rounds
• Countdown to a date: birthdays, holidays, trips
• Display mode: big tiles of just the times, great on a counter or a desk
• Live countdown on your lock screen and in the Dynamic Island
• Alarms ring even when the app is closed (on iOS 26 and later they ring like the Clock app, even on silent)
• Turn each of these on or off in Settings
• Light and dark mode, bigger text, keep-the-screen-awake option

Private: no account, no ads, no tracking. Everything stays on your device.

name: MeshChat for MeshCore
description:
MeshChat is a messenger for MeshCore, the open LoRa mesh network. Text for kilometres with no mobile signal, no internet and no account.

REQUIRES A MESHCORE RADIO. The app connects over Bluetooth or WiFi to a radio running the standard MeshCore companion firmware. No radio yet? Tap "Try without a radio" to explore the whole app with a simulated radio and a made-up mesh.

CHAT
• Public, hashtag and private channels, room servers and direct messages
• Delivery status on every message: sent, repeated ×N, delivered, with retries
• Message details: every copy heard and the route through repeaters, with names and distances
• Mentions, notifications and a Live Activity on the Lock Screen
• Block senders you don't want to hear from
• Add contacts and channels by QR code

MAP
• Nodes and repeaters on a map
• Offline maps: save a region and the map works there without internet
• Your position is shared only if you choose

REPEATERS
• See which repeaters you hear directly and which hear you
• One-tap reach check with signal both ways
• Watch your own repeater, with a warning when it goes quiet
• Remote admin of your own repeaters, using their password

NETWORK AND RADIO
• Saved networks: switch radio settings in one tap, each network with its own history
• Nodes list with search and filters
• Route details for each contact, with a reset
• Packet log and packet anatomy
• Tidy up the radio's contact list
• For iPhone and iPad

OPEN SOURCE
The source code is public under the MIT licence at github.com/Sewci0/meshchat. The same project includes an optional companion firmware for ESP32 radios that adds WiFi setup and a web chat served by the radio itself. The app does not need it: it works with stock MeshCore companion firmware.

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
No account, no analytics, no servers, no in-app purchases. The app collects no data. Messages and history stay on your device and on the mesh. Map tiles are downloaded from OpenFreeMap (OpenStreetMap data). Messages in public channels can be read by anyone on the mesh.

Available in English, Polish and Czech.

MeshChat is an independent app, not affiliated with the MeshCore project.

name: Mezurio
description:
Household utility readings are easy to lose. Paper notes go missing. Meter numbers are forgotten. It is hard to see how use changed from last month until a bill arrives, and it is hard to know whether that bill matches what you actually recorded.

Mezurio keeps those readings in one local log on this device. Open the app and add a meter for electricity, water, gas, or a custom utility. Enter a name, a unit such as kWh, and optional notes such as location. Then record each reading with its date. Consumption is calculated from the values you type. Missing numbers are never invented.

Overview shows this month total and the meters you added. Insights shows trends and comparisons from your saved history. Reports can share a PDF file or a CSV file built from those same readings. If you type a tariff, Mezurio can estimate a cost from your rates. That figure is an estimate only and is not an official utility bill.

Optional local reminders can prompt you to record the next reading. Notification permission is requested only when you choose to allow it. Backup and restore let you keep a file you decide to share. Light, Dark, and System appearance are available in Settings.

There is no account and no server. Readings, notes, tariffs, and reminders stay on this device. You can export, back up, or delete your data at any time from Settings.

Mezurio is for households, renters, and homeowners who want a clear record of utility use. It also suits anyone who logs meters for a home office or a small property and wants simple charts without sending data away.

name: Mi Campo Digital
description:
Mi Campo Digital es la app de gestión ganadera gratuita hecha para productores argentinos. Cargá lo que pasa en el campo desde el celular, aunque no haya señal, y mirá cómo viene tu rodeo.

PENSADA PARA LA MANGA
Todo se guarda en tu celular y se sincroniza solo cuando hay conexión. Nada de anotar en un papel para pasarlo después.

CARGÁ EN UN TOQUE
• Pesadas, tactos, sanidad y movimientos, animal por animal o por lote.
• Ficha de cada animal con todo su historial.
• Caravanas siempre al día, aunque el animal haya cambiado de caravana.

MAPA DEL CAMPO SIN SEÑAL
• Tus potreros, aguadas e instalaciones sobre imagen satelital.
• Descargá el mapa y usalo en el campo, sin conexión.
• Puntos de control con fotos y ubicación para seguir tus pasturas.
• Capas de vegetación para ver cómo viene cada cuadro.

UN ASISTENTE QUE CONOCE TU CAMPO
Preguntale por voz o por texto cuántos animales tenés, cómo vienen los pesos o qué te falta cargar. Si no hay señal, tu consulta queda guardada y se responde cuando vuelve la conexión.

PARA TODO EL EQUIPO
Invitá a tu encargado o a tu familia, cada uno con su rol: dueño, administrador, gerente u operador.

TUS DATOS SON TUYOS
Podés eliminar tu cuenta cuando quieras, desde la propia app.

Empezá gratis: creá tu cuenta con tu correo y en minutos estás cargando tu hacienda.

name: Midi Sing Coach
description:
See your voice on the melody, note by note.

MIDI Sing Coach is a pitch trainer for singers. Your MIDI backing track plays, the melody scrolls as a piano roll and, while you sing, your voice is drawn on top of it: green when you are in tune, yellow when you are close, red when you are off. You see at once whether you are sharp, flat, early or late.

PAY ONCE, NO SUBSCRIPTION
You buy MIDI Sing Coach once and it's yours: no monthly fee, no song credits, no account. It works offline.

SING ANY SONG, NOT JUST THE HITS
There is no closed song catalogue. If a MIDI file of a song exists, you can sing it: a local or regional song, a classic from decades ago, a song in your language that the big catalogues leave out.
Note: the app does not include MIDI backing tracks, apart from two copyright-free examples. Use files you already have, tracks you buy from a MIDI backing track store, or free tracks from non-commercial sites.

A SCORE FOR EVERY TAKE
• A score from 0 to 100 when you press Stop: notes in tune, close, off pitch and not sung.
• Your tendency, for example "flat by 12 cents on average".
• The three weakest phrases with their lyrics: Practice takes you back just before the phrase.
• The last 20 takes of every song are saved, to review with their singing line.

A BACKING TRACK THAT FITS YOUR VOICE
• Change the key (±24 semitones): the notes in the Coach move with the music.
• Slow down the tempo to learn a hard passage, without changing the pitch.
• Melody on or off with one tap: let it guide you, then sing alone.
• Mixer with volume, pan, reverb, chorus, mute and solo for every channel.
• SoundFont synthesizer, your own .sf2 banks and MIDI output to a sound module.

KARAOKE LYRICS
M-Live, GM karaoke and .kar, Yamaha XF, Solton and Soft Karaoke lyrics, under the notes or as a full page.

WARM-UP
Vocal warm-up exercises transposed into your range, sung in the Coach with a score, and an editor to create your own.

MADE FOR HEADPHONES
With headphones the microphone hears only your voice. Wired and USB headphones work best; Bluetooth headphones and AirPods work too, with latency compensation. Voice in Headphones lets you hear yourself together with the backing track.

YOUR LIBRARY
.mid, .midi and .kar files from the app's folder, iCloud Drive, a USB drive or a network server, with search and a lyrics filter.

PRIVACY
Your voice is never recorded: only the pitch line is kept, on your device.

For iPad and iPhone, landscape and portrait. In English and Italian.

name: Milafe
description:
Milafe is a private notebook for recording traditional kite structures and craft tuning. Creating and saving a new kite project uses in-app coins.
This app helps makers document skeleton proportions, bamboo placements, covering tension, and flight observations. Organize your craft with structural sketches, material dimensions, and step-by-step progress photos to ensure stable reproductions.

name: Mirilti: Cozy Cat Care
description:
One rainy evening you find a soaked cardboard box at your door. Two big eyes look up at you from inside.

Mirilti is a cozy care game about adopting a kitten and earning its trust. Your kitten won't trust you right away. You hold out your hand and wait. Day by day it comes closer, purrs, and runs to greet you at the door.

EARN TRUST WITH PATIENCE
• Help a shy kitten get used to you: hold out your finger and let it sniff.
• Pet, feed, play, clean the litter and tuck it in.
• Your bond grows through five stages: Shy, Warming Up, Trusting, Loving, Soulmate.
• Your cat is never harmed. If you're away, it simply misses you.

WORK THE TILL AT THE MARKET
• Go to your shift: scan the items, take the cash, give the right change.
• Customers you serve without a mistake leave a tip.
• While you work, your cat waits at the window and runs to you when you come home.

SPEND YOUR PAY ON TREATS AND GIFTS
• Chicken and salmon meals make your cat extra happy.
• Collars, a bow tie, new rug and bed colours.
• Dry food is always free: your cat never goes hungry.

A KITTEN THAT GROWS IN REAL TIME
• It arrives as an 8-week-old kitten and grows day by day.
• A vaccine card reminds you when core, rabies and parasite treatments are due.
• The room follows the real clock: sunshine by day, moonlight at night, sometimes rain.

GARDEN AND MINI GAMES
• Chase butterflies in the garden and collect new finds every day.
• Light chase, hide and seek, brush and bath, and a little kitchen puzzle.

A NEW PAGE EVERY DAY
• Finish three daily tasks and keep your streak.
• Each day unlocks a page of your cat's story: where it came from and why it watches doors. Two chapters, 24 pages.
• Your moments together are kept in a memory book.

SEVEN COATS
Tabby, ginger, calico, tuxedo, smoke, Siamese and Turkish Van. Change it whenever you like.

In English and Turkish. No account needed.

name: Mirutabi: Japan Live Cams
description:
Every look is a little trip.
Mirutabi puts Japan's live cameras and driver's-seat train videos on one map. The app itself has no ads (the YouTube player may show its own).

JAPAN RIGHT NOW, FROM THE MAP
More than 1,700 live cameras across Japan, pinned where they are. Filter by city, nature, sea, landmarks, snow, railway, airports, animals, roads and rivers, then tap a pin to open the stream. Sort by most watched, nearest or name, see nearby cameras and the closest station, or let "Random camera" surprise you.

RIDE THE RAILS FROM THE DRIVER'S SEAT
About 600 rail lines are drawn on the map, from the Shinkansen to city trams. Tap a line and choose from more than 5,600 cab-view videos. While the video plays, a small train in that line's colours runs along the track in step with it. Skip ahead and the train jumps too; tap the route and the video goes there. Turn on Follow and the map keeps up with the train.

SEE IT IN 3D
Switch the map between Standard, Satellite, 3D, 3D realistic (terrain relief) and 3D satellite. Look down on Tokyo Tower or Shibuya in 3D while you watch the live view from the same spot.

FAVORITES IN ICLOUD
Star the cameras, lines and videos you like. Favorites sync through iCloud, so they follow you across iPhone, iPad, Mac and Apple Vision Pro (you can turn this off in Settings).

ALSO
- Japanese and English, with station and line names shown in English too
- Light and dark appearance, autoplay, start muted, data saving on cellular
- Pixel-art pins and icons
- No personal data collected; your location is used only to show the map

Video is public live streams and videos that their owners publish on YouTube, played in YouTube's official embedded player. Streams may be offline because of weather or maintenance. The train's position is an estimate based on the video time. Mirutabi is an unofficial app; each video belongs to its publisher. YouTube is a trademark of Google LLC.

name: Mitvora
description:
Mitvora is the friendly way to keep track of everything between you and the people you care about: money you lend or borrow, things you lend out, promises you make and favours you owe. No spreadsheets, no awkward “hey, remember that…?” moments. Just tidy paper slips, gentle reminders and a satisfying stamp when it's done.

WRITE A SLIP IN SECONDS
• A guided 4-step flow: Who → What → Details → When
• Four kinds of slips: Money, Items, Promises, Favours
• Quick suggestions (Dinner, Cab, Tickets, Charger, Airport ride…) and date shortcuts (Tomorrow, Weekend, Next week)
• See your slip printed as a receipt before you stamp it

STAMP IT SETTLED
• Paid back or returned? Stamp the slip “SETTLED” with one tap
• Long-press any slip to settle, nudge or tear it up
• Settle everything with one person at once

GENTLE REMINDERS & NUDGES
• Get a reminder on the due date, so nothing slips through the cracks
• Send a friendly, pre-written nudge through Messages, WhatsApp or any app, without the awkwardness

YOUR PEOPLE AT A GLANCE
• Every friend gets their own colourful sticker card
• See who owes you, who you owe, and who's all square
• Share a summary of what's open between you

FRIENDSHIP SCORECARD
• A friendship score that rewards you for settling on time
• Money in and out over the last 6 months
• Your slip mix and the people you share the most slips with

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
• Use it instantly without an account: tap “Skip” and everything stays on your iPhone
• Or sign in with Apple or Google to back up and sync. Your guest slips come with you
• Export everything as CSV at any time
• Delete your account and all your data right from Settings
• No ads. No selling data. Ever.

Mitvora works in any currency. Pick yours in Settings.

Questions or ideas? We'd love to hear from you: mitvoraslips2611@gmail.com

WHAT'S NEW (version 1.0)
------------------------

name: MomentMarker
description:
Count down to the days that matter with MomentMarker, a photo countdown app for iPhone and iPad.

Create cards for important dates and upcoming trips, and enjoy dedicated Halloween and Christmas countdowns.

MAKE EACH CARD YOURS
Add a photo, customise the layout, choose fonts and colours, and include up to five extra text boxes. Save layouts as templates to use again.

COUNT DOWN ON YOUR HOME SCREEN
Add editable widgets, including Halloween and Christmas designs you can personalise with your own photos.

SHARE YOUR CARD
Export a PNG of your countdown card using the iOS share sheet.

OPTIONAL ICLOUD SYNC
Turn on Sync with iCloud to keep your countdowns, photos, layouts, templates and preferences across supported devices signed into the same Apple Account. Home Screen widget placement is managed separately by iOS.

MomentMarker does not require a separate MomentMarker account.

name: Mondivita – CV by Country
description:
Every country reads a CV differently. A US resume leaves out the photo and date of birth; a German Lebenslauf often includes both and ends with a place, date and name. Mondivita knows the difference, so your CV fits the country you're applying to.

HIRING NORMS FOR 15 COUNTRIES
United States, Canada, United Kingdom, Ireland, Australia, Germany, Netherlands, Switzerland, France, Spain, Italy, Türkiye, United Arab Emirates, Saudi Arabia and Singapore. For each country, Mondivita sets the photo, personal details, page length, section order, date format and paper size.

LIVE CHECKS AS YOU WRITE
Gentle tips point out what employers in that country may not expect, such as a photo where it's unusual or personal details that are better left out. Checks never block you; you decide.

ONE CV, MANY COUNTRIES
Copy a CV to another country and Mondivita shows what changes and why.

CVS IN 8 LANGUAGES
English, German, French, Italian, Dutch, Spanish, Turkish and Arabic, with regional variants. Arabic CVs are laid out right to left.

6 DESIGNS, 7 COLORS
Classic, Modern, Corner, Timeline, Wave and Stripe. Every design keeps a single column of real text, so application systems (ATS) can read it.

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
No account, no ads, no tracking. Your CVs and photos stay on your iPhone. Works offline.

FREE AND PRO
Free: create one CV, use every country's rules and checks, and see a watermarked preview.
Mondivita Pro, a one-time in-app purchase (no subscription): export, print and share PDF, unlimited CVs, copy a CV to another country, no watermark.

Country guidance is based on official and university sources and was last reviewed in October 2026. It is general guidance, not legal or immigration advice. Hiring practices vary by employer; always follow the job ad.

Terms of Use: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/
Privacy Policy: https://sites.google.com/view/yurgalar-dev/mondivita/privacy

name: MoonStory: Bedtime Stories
description:
Turn tonight’s reading into an adventure with your child in the story. Choose a world, pick up to three companions and decide how long you’d like to read. MoonStory finds a bedtime story and adds your child’s name or nickname right on your device.

• Read 30 stories in English or Polish, even without internet.
• Make one child the hero or choose siblings to share the adventure.
• Choose a short, medium or long version for the time you have.
• Save personalized stories to your bookshelf and return to them anytime.
• Set optional bedtime reminders and track your shared reading streak.

The full collection is free. There is no account, advertising or subscription.

name: MorseWatch: Telegraph Keyer
description:
MorseWatch turns your iPhone and Apple Watch into a tactile straight-key telegraph, a one-handed wrist-gesture keyer, an optical Morse light beacon, and a live local-network transceiver.

• TACTILE STRAIGHT KEY (iPhone & Apple Watch)
Tap briefly for a Dot (·) and hold slightly longer for a Dash (—). Adaptive timing, crisp Core Haptics feedback, and a clean pure-sine sidetone synthesizer make keying feel effortless and authentic.

• ONE-HANDED APPLE WATCH WRIST GESTURES
Key Morse code without touching the screen. Rotate the Digital Crown to Gesture mode and tap Start:
  – Pinch index finger and thumb for a Dot (·)
  – Roll your wrist outward for a Dash (—)
  – Shake your wrist three times to Clear

• OPTICAL MORSE LIGHT BEACON
Type any message—or tap quick presets like SOS, CQ, or OK—and transmit real International Morse Code at 5–25 WPM using your iPhone's rear LED torch or a high-contrast full-screen strobe on iPhone and Apple Watch.

• LIVE PEER-TO-PEER MULTIPLAYER
Flip on Multiplayer to automatically discover and link with your paired Apple Watch or other nearby devices on the same Wi-Fi network via Bonjour. Hear and read incoming Morse code in real time—with zero accounts, zero cloud servers, and zero configuration.

• BUILT FOR CLARITY & PRIVACY
  – Built-in interactive International Morse Code reference sheet
  – Adjustable sidetone pitch (440–880 Hz), haptic intensity, and keying speed
  – Localized in 11 languages
  – 100% private: zero tracking, zero ads, and zero data collection

name: MOTERXS
description:
MOTERXS es la app del club de moteros MOTERXS. Con ella tienes todas las rutas del club en el móvil, desde la inscripción hasta el resumen final.

ANTES DE LA RUTA
• Lista de próximas rutas con plazas libres, dificultad y si es apta para 125 cc.
• Ficha completa: recorrido en el mapa, distancia, desnivel, curvas, punto de reunión y comida.
• Previsión del tiempo en la salida, el destino y el punto más alto, con avisos de hielo y rachas.
• Obras, cortes y gasolineras del recorrido. Si indicas la autonomía de tu moto, te avisa de los tramos sin repostar.
• Inscripción en segundos con tus datos guardados, y lista de espera si la ruta está completa.

EL DÍA DE LA RUTA
• Cuenta atrás y botón para ir al punto de salida.
• Tu QR para el pase de lista.
• Mapa del grupo en directo: ves al líder, a la escoba y al resto de motos.
• Intercom de voz con el grupo, con el casco Bluetooth o el altavoz.
• Avisos al grupo con un toque: necesito parar, peligro en la carretera o SOS.

AL TERMINAR
• Tu resumen: kilómetros, tiempo en marcha y altitud máxima.

La ubicación solo se comparte durante la ruta y cuando tú lo activas. La voz no se graba.

Disponible en castellano, catalán, gallego e inglés.

name: Movlin: Auto Captions
description:
Movlin adds captions to your videos right on your iPhone.

Pick a video from Photos, or several to cut and join into one. Movlin recognizes the speech on the phone itself, Claude proofreads the text, and the captions are burned into the video in the font and place you choose.

• Speech is recognized on the iPhone. The video and the sound never leave your phone.
• Claude by Anthropic proofreads every video: punctuation, names, slang. Only the caption text is sent for proofreading.
• Trim and split your video, move the pieces around, and join several videos into one project.
• Choose the font, regular letters or capitals, and how long a line stays on screen. Drag the captions to any place on the frame.
• Save to Photos or share in one tap. Your projects stay in the app, so you can come back and edit them.

LANGUAGES
Speech is recognized in 25 European languages: Bulgarian, Croatian, Czech, Danish, Dutch, English, Estonian, Finnish, French, German, Greek, Hungarian, Italian, Latvian, Lithuanian, Maltese, Polish, Portuguese, Romanian, Russian, Slovak, Slovenian, Spanish, Swedish and Ukrainian. The app itself speaks 13 languages.

FREE MINUTES AND THE SUBSCRIPTION
The first 5 minutes of video are free. After that, the Movlin with Claude subscription gives you 50 minutes of video every month.

The subscription renews automatically every month unless you cancel it at least 24 hours before the month ends. Manage or cancel it in your Apple ID settings.

GOOD TO KNOW
On the first launch the iPhone prepares the speech model once. This takes up to a minute and needs a few gigabytes of free space.

Terms of Use: https://oleksiimazurenko.dev/en/movlin/terms
Privacy Policy: https://oleksiimazurenko.dev/en/movlin/privacy

name: Mow
description:
Mow is een rustig, minimalistisch maaispel. Stuur je maaier met de knoppen en maai het gras in nette, rechte banen. Hoe strakker je baan aansluit op de vorige, hoe hoger je combo en hoe meer punten je verdient.

- Oneindig veel gegenereerde levels met elke keer een andere tuin
- Opdrachten, weer, honden en egels die je combo breken
- Dagelijkse tuin met een reeks en een eenmalige beloning
- Verdien munten en upgrade je maaier: sneller, breder, hogere combo's
- Kies kleuren, versieringen en spoor-effecten voor je maaier
- Ontgrendel nieuwe gebieden: Tuinen, Boerenland, Golfresort en de Maan
- Luister naar de ingebouwde radio met zelfgemaakte muziek

Mow is gratis te spelen met advertenties. Met een eenmalige aankoop verwijder je alle advertenties. Je kunt ook gratis munten verdienen door een advertentie te bekijken, of munten kopen.

name: Müdaim: Barber Booking
description:
Müdaim keeps everything between you and your barber in one place.

FOR CLIENTS
• Find barbers nearby: ratings, real cut photos, prices and the next free time.
• Book in seconds; ask for "the same as last time" and your barber opens your last cut card.
• Your cut card: how long on top, which guards on the sides, how the beard goes. It stays with you.
• Move or cancel, and message your barber in the app.
• Hear first when a slot frees up from the waitlist.

FOR BARBERS
• Today at a glance: the next client, the cut they want and their sensitivities.
• A cut card for every visit: recipe, products, photos, payment.
• Calendar, requests, waitlist, end-of-day cash count and stats.
• Portfolio and reviews; your clients follow you if you move shops.
• Appointment credits: pay only for confirmed client bookings; bookings you add are free. 100 credits to start.

Clients pay at the shop; Müdaim never charges clients.

name: Mullion: Move-In & Out Photos
description:
Mullion is a camera and a record book for people who rent.

When you move in, walk each room once. Mullion names the spots worth a photo (walls, floor, oven, sealant, front door) and one tap takes each picture. Months or years later, when you move out, the camera lays every move-in photo over the live view. You stand where you stood, line up the door frame or the worktop edge, and take the same picture again.

What that leaves you with is pairs: the same corner, the same angle, two dates. Drag a divider across a pair, put the two photos side by side, or flip between them, then mark what you see: looks the same, or something changed. That mark is yours. The app does not judge the photos.

What is in it:

- A room list with suggested spots for kitchens, bathrooms, bedrooms, hallways, balconies and more. Add your own.
- Three guides in the move-out camera: the move-in photo as a ghost, its outlines as lines, or nothing.
- A tilt guide. Mullion remembers how the phone was held for each move-in photo and shows when you hold it the same way again.
- The wide lens for small rooms, and a level line so move-in photos come out straight.
- Keys and meter readings, each with a move-in and a move-out column.
- A PDF report with every pair side by side, your notes, and a list of the photo files with their SHA-256 fingerprints. The report has its own language choice, for a landlord who reads another language than you. 15 languages.
- Backup to a folder in Files, and back again. Every file is checked before anything is replaced.

What it does not do: Mullion works without an account, a server or advertising. Photos stay in the app on your device until you share a report or save a backup. Mullion arranges your photos and notes. It does not assess damage, decide who is responsible, verify when a photo was taken, or give legal advice.

Free and paid: recording a home at move-in is free and not limited, with reports and backups. At move-out the first three spots are free, so you can see the match work in your own rooms. Pay once for the full version and every spot and further homes open. Nothing renews.

name: Multa Chiara: multe e cartelle
description:
Hai preso una multa o ti è arrivata una cartella? Fotografala: Multa Chiara ti dice in parole semplici che cosa ti chiedono, entro quando, se puoi pagare meno e se c'è qualcosa che non torna.

PER LE MULTE STRADALI
• Due risposte subito: puoi pagare meno? Puoi non pagarla?
• Lo sconto del 30% con la cifra e il giorno esatto, e tutte le scadenze calcolate dalla data di notifica.
• Il controllo degli errori: notifica arrivata tardi, dati mancanti, articolo e importo che non corrispondono, omologazione e taratura dell'autovelox.
• La lettera già pronta: ricorso al Prefetto o al Giudice di pace, richiesta di annullamento, comunicazione di chi guidava, domanda di rate. La completi e la mandi tu.
• Il foglietto sul parabrezza: come chiuderlo spendendo meno.
• Il conto dei punti della patente e il promemoria del rinnovo.

PER CARTELLE, AVVISI E LETTERE DI AGENZIA DELLE ENTRATE, INPS E COMUNE
• Di che cosa si tratta e da dove nasce il debito, senza sigle.
• Quanto tempo hai, quante rate puoi chiedere e dove si chiedono.
• Chi ti aiuta: CAF e patronati vicino a te, e i numeri da chiamare.
• Che cosa cercare in casa prima di pagare, e il controllo della prescrizione.

IN PIÙ, GRATIS
• Avviso di giacenza: dal codice della raccomandata capisci che cosa c'è di solito in posta, prima di andare a ritirarla.
• Evita la prossima multa: le regole che pochi conoscono su strisce blu, ZTL, autovelox, patente e moto, ognuna con la sua fonte.
• Promemoria delle scadenze sul telefono.

LA TUA PRIVACY
• Non serve un account.
• L'archivio resta sul tuo telefono: noi non lo vediamo e non lo conserviamo.
• Per leggere un documento la foto passa dal server dell'app e viene letta dall'intelligenza artificiale (Claude, di Anthropic), che non la conserva. Prima del primo invio l'app ti chiede il consenso.
• Niente pubblicità, niente statistiche di utilizzo, nessun dato venduto.

QUANTO COSTA
I primi 3 documenti sono gratis, completi di tutto. Poi sblocchi l'app con un solo pagamento: niente abbonamento.

DA SAPERE
Multa Chiara fa un esame preliminare automatico: non è un parere legale e non sostituisce un avvocato, un commercialista o un CAF. La lettura automatica può sbagliare e le regole cambiano: prima di pagare, contestare o rinunciare a un termine controlla sempre i dati sul documento e, per le decisioni importanti, fallo verificare da un professionista. L'app non tratta le questioni penali.

Multa Chiara è un'app di Starlead S.r.l., Milano.

name: Muw Truly Identity
description:
Entdecke deine Persönlichkeit Schritt für Schritt und gestalte ein klareres Bild von dir selbst. Myw Your True Identity hilft dir dabei, Gedanken zu ordnen, Ziele zu definieren und deine innere Entwicklung bewusst aufzubauen. Mit fünf strukturierten Bereichen findest du einen einfachen Weg zu mehr Klarheit, Fokus und Selbstvertrauen.

Hauptfunktionen
- Fünf klar gegliederte Bereiche - für eine strukturierte Reise zu deiner Identität
- Dunkelblaues, ruhiges Design - angenehm für längere Nutzung und konzentriertes Arbeiten
- Geführte Reflexionen - damit du Stärken, Werte und Ziele besser erkennst
- Persönliche Fortschrittsansicht - um Entwicklungen nachvollziehbar festzuhalten
- Einfache Bedienung - schnell starten und ohne Ablenkung nutzen

Perfekt für
- Menschen, die ihre Persönlichkeit bewusster entwickeln möchten
- Nutzer, die sich mit Selbstreflexion, Zielen und innerer Klarheit beschäftigen
- Alle, die einen ruhigen digitalen Begleiter für persönliche Entwicklung suchen

Warum diese App
Myw Your True Identity setzt auf Fokus statt Ablenkung. Kein Community-Druck, keine Ranglisten und keine unnötigen Umwege. Stattdessen erhältst du eine klare, inspirierende Struktur mit fünf Bereichen, die dir hilft, deine Identität zu verstehen und aktiv zu formen. Das dunkelblaue Design unterstützt eine ruhige Atmosphäre und macht die App besonders angenehm im Alltag.

Mit dieser App kannst du deine Gedanken sortieren, Prioritäten erkennen und dich Schritt für Schritt weiterentwickeln. Ideal für den Start in einen bewussteren Lebensstil oder als täglicher Begleiter auf deinem persönlichen Weg.

Starte jetzt und beginne, deine wahre Identität klarer zu entdecken und gezielt aufzubauen.

name: My Appointment Book
description:
My Appointment Book is a simple and personal place to organise your appointments, events, plans and reminders.

Add the information that matters to you, including the date and time, contact, location and notes. Set a reminder notification so you do not forget an important entry.

Features:
• View upcoming appointments and events
• Browse your entries in a clear calendar
• Add contacts, locations and useful notes
• Receive reminder notifications
• Choose from 22 background designs or use your own photo
• Back up your entries to Files or iCloud Drive
• Import a backup while keeping your existing entries  

Your entries are stored on your device. The app does not require an account and does not use advertising or analytics services.

name: Myciltay Trips
description:
Immagina di sederti con il caffè del mattino e di aprire un unico spazio in cui trovare tutto ciò che riguarda il tuo prossimo viaggio. Myciltay Trips nasce proprio per questo momento: organizzare una vacanza senza dover rincorrere promemoria sparsi tra email, screenshot e appunti.

Tutto parte dalla scelta del soggiorno. Selezioni la struttura in cui dormirai e il viaggio prende forma intorno a quella scelta. Da lì puoi aggiungere i servizi che desideri, così ogni dettaglio resta legato al luogo in cui lo vivrai.

Le prenotazioni trovano posto nella stessa schermata del viaggio. Soggiorni e servizi compaiono insieme, in un ordine chiaro, e non dovrai più frugare nella casella di posta per ritrovare la conferma di tre settimane fa.

Anche i messaggi relativi al viaggio restano accanto alle prenotazioni, così hai sempre tutto a portata di mano.

Myciltay Trips è pensata per chi organizza i propri viaggi: una vacanza in famiglia, un weekend con gli amici o una fuga in solitaria. Ogni passaggio resta in ordine, dall'inizio alla fine.

Un viaggio è fatto di scelte e di conferme. Riunire tutto in un solo posto ti libera dalla fatica di ricordare ogni cosa e lascia più spazio al piacere dell'attesa.

name: MyCityU
description:
Το MyCityU είναι η επίσημη εφαρμογή των φοιτητών του City Unity College.

• Φοιτητική ταυτότητα στο κινητό, με QR επαλήθευσης
• Παρουσία στο μάθημα με σάρωση του QR του καθηγητή
• Το εβδομαδιαίο πρόγραμμα των μαθημάτων σου
• Τα μαθήματά σου, οι παρουσίες σου και οι οριστικοί βαθμοί σου
• Οι προθεσμίες των εργασιών σου στο eClass
• Ψηφιακή βιβλιοθήκη: αναζήτηση στον Κάλλιπο και σε άλλες ανοιχτές πηγές
• Τα στοιχεία σου — διόρθωση ή συμπλήρωση με έλεγχο από το Student Support
• Ανακοινώσεις του κολλεγίου και Student Support με ένα πάτημα
• Ελληνικά και αγγλικά, φωτεινό και σκοτεινό θέμα

Σύνδεση με τον λογαριασμό Google του κολλεγίου (@cityu.edu.gr ή @cityu.gr). Για φοιτητές του City Unity College.

name: MyTourMakers
seller_name: MyTourMakers Leisure Tour And Travel Private Limited
description:
MyTourMakers plans holidays the personal way: every trip is put together by a real travel expert, and the app keeps your whole journey in one place.

EXPLORE HOLIDAYS
• Tour packages across India and abroad: Kashmir, Kerala, Goa, Spiti, Bali, Dubai, Thailand, Vietnam, Europe and more
• Honeymoon trips and group tours with fixed departure dates
• Day-wise itineraries, inclusions, photos and verified traveller reviews
• Smart search that understands "Bali under 50k" or "5 nights honeymoon"

BOOK GROUP DEPARTURES
• See live seats and batch dates

• Apply coupons, MTM Points and your MTM Wallet

PLAN WITH AN EXPERT

MY TRIPS, ALL IN ONE PLACE
• Vouchers, tickets, GST invoices and trip documents

MTM CLUB

MyTourMakers Leisure Tour And Travel Private Limited, Noida, India.

name: N5MASTER
description:
N5MASTER 是一款为 JLPT N5 考生设计的离线日语单词学习应用，内置 900 个 N5 词条，包含假名、中文释义、词性、分类和例句。

主要功能：
• 模拟考试：可选 10 / 20 / 30 / 50 题或全部题目，支持综合随机、日→中、中→日、读音辨析 4 种题型，计时作答、逐题解析与 S/A/B/C/D 成绩评级。
• 单词卡：基于 Leitner 间隔复习，翻卡后自评「忘了 / 有点印象 / 认识」，支持智能推荐、错题优先、待复习等 6 种范围。
• 词义配对：在限定时间内完成日语单词与中文释义的配对练习。
• 错题本与学习统计：自动记录错词、考试历史、掌握进度与分类分布，用图表回顾学习情况。
• 词库管理：可导入 JSON / CSV / TSV / JS 词库，导出备份、恢复状态、恢复内置词库。

完全离线：无需账号、无需联网，不包含广告、分析或追踪 SDK。所有学习记录保存在设备本地，导出由用户主动发起。日语朗读使用系统语音合成，在设备上完成。

适合每天利用碎片时间背单词、备考 JLPT N5 的中文学习者。

name: NaadAmp
description:
NaadAmp is a music player in the classic desktop style, made for touch: a compact player, a 10-band equaliser and a playlist, drawn in NaadAmp's own Graphite look.

YOUR OWN MUSIC
• Plays MP3, AAC/M4A, Apple Lossless (ALAC), FLAC, WAV and AIFF
• Add songs or whole folders from the Files app, or copy music into the NaadAmp folder from your Mac and add it in one go
• Song titles, artists and cover art come from your files' tags
• Keeps playing in the background, with controls on the Lock Screen, in Control Centre and on your headphones
• Your playlist is saved automatically

EQUALISER
• 10 bands from 60 Hz to 16 kHz, ±12 dB each, with a preamp
• 19 built-in presets, plus presets you save yourself
• EQ Auto: save a setting for a song and NaadAmp applies it whenever that song plays
• Balance and volume controls

VISUALISER
• Spectrum bars or an oscilloscope that move with the music, or switch it off

PLAYLIST
• Shuffle and repeat
• Sort by title, file name or path
• Swipe to scroll, touch and hold to pick a song up and drag it to a new place
• File Info shows a song's details: album, composer, genre, year, file size and more

MADE FOR IPHONE AND IPAD
• iPhone: player, equaliser and playlist stacked on one screen
• iPad: panels you can drag, snap and dock together, shrink to a slim strip or show at double size
• Touch and hold for menus

YOUTUBE
• Paste links to songs, playlists or albums from YouTube or YouTube Music to add them to your playlist (up to 200 songs from a playlist)
• They play in YouTube's official embedded player, including live streams
• "Open YouTube Music" opens the website so you can find links
• YouTube songs play while NaadAmp is on screen
• The equaliser, balance and visualiser work on your own music files; YouTube songs play as YouTube provides them, and YouTube may show ads in its player

NaadAmp is free and needs no account.

name: Natida: Pizzeria Duo
description:
Welcome to Natida: Pizzeria Duo — your very own artisanal Italian pizzeria!

A Cozy Pizzeria Experience

• Charming, handcrafted visuals.
• Authentic Italian kitchen atmosphere.

• Relaxing gameplay with delightful details.
• Enjoy the little moments of running your own pizzeria.

Every pizza is a new creation. Every customer brings a new experience.

Buon Appetito!

name: Nautipass – Patente Nautica
description:
Nautipass aiuta a prepararsi all'esame per la patente nautica entro 12 miglia dalla costa e al modulo D1, con le domande dei questionari ministeriali pubblici e gli esercizi di carteggio.

ENTRO 12 MIGLIA
- Domande a risposta multipla ordinate per argomento, per studiare un tema alla volta.
- Esami simulati base e vela, composti secondo la regola d'esame.
- Revisione degli errori: ripassa le domande sbagliate.
- Stima della probabilità di riuscita all'esame.

MODULO D1
- 792 domande.
- Esame simulato nel formato previsto: 15 domande, 30 minuti, 12 risposte corrette per superarlo.

CARTEGGIO
- 185 esercizi dei questionari ministeriali.
- Strumenti sulla carta: punto, righello, compasso, rotta.
- Correzione automatica con margine di tolleranza.
- Carta didattica: non sostituisce la carta nautica 5D.

TUTTO OFFLINE
L'app funziona interamente senza connessione. Non richiede un account, non contiene pubblicità, strumenti di analisi o traccianti e non effettua alcuna richiesta di rete. I progressi restano sul dispositivo.

Tema chiaro e scuro.

GRATUITO E ACQUISTI
La versione gratuita permette 2 sessioni di studio per argomento e 1 esame simulato al giorno. Ogni modulo si sblocca con un acquisto unico, senza abbonamento: esami illimitati, revisione degli errori, stima della probabilità di riuscita e carteggio interattivo.

Nautipass non è affiliata al Ministero delle Infrastrutture e dei Trasporti né ad alcuna amministrazione. Le domande riprendono i questionari ministeriali pubblici (patente nautica entro 12 miglia; modulo D1: Allegato A del D.D. 62 del 18/04/2025). Dati cartografici © contributori OpenStreetMap (ODbL).

Un'app Reverdin Academy.

name: NCS수학: 공기업 응용수리 문제풀이
description:
NCS수학은 공기업·공공기관 필기시험의 NCS 직업기초능력 수리능력(응용수리)을 연습하는 문제풀이 앱입니다.
농도, 거리·속력·시간, 일률, 비율·금액, 확률, 경우의 수, 수열, 집합·통계, 도형처럼 자주 나오는 유형을 골라 한 문제씩 풀고, 채점 즉시 단계별 해설을 볼 수 있습니다.

■ 연습모드: 유형별 문제풀이
· 유형(여러 개)과 난이도, 문제 수를 골라 시작
· 한 문제 풀 때마다 바로 채점하고 단계별 해설 확인
· "비슷한 문제"로 같은 유형을 숫자만 바꿔 반복 연습
· 중간에 나가도 이어서 풀기

■ 시험모드: 실전 모의고사
· 랜덤 실전 또는 기관별 출제 유형으로 모의고사 구성
· 10문제 12분 / 20문제 25분 / 40문제 50분
· 남은 시간, 문항 번호판, 나중에 보기 표시
· 제출하면 한 번에 채점하고 점수·사용 시간·유형별 결과 확인

■ 풀이 공간: 직접 풀며 실전 감각
· 휴대폰: 문제 속 숫자를 눌러 식을 빠르게 적는 식 쓰기 도우미와 그리기
· 태블릿: 문제 옆 넓은 칸에 펜이나 손가락으로 필기
· 계산은 직접. 앱이 답을 대신 계산해 주지 않아 시험장과 같은 감각을 지킵니다
· 내가 쓴 풀이는 해설 옆에 함께 보여 어디서 틀렸는지 바로 비교

■ 오답노트·즐겨찾기
· 틀린 문제는 자동으로 오답노트에 저장
· 다시 풀면 지난번에 쓴 풀이와 나란히 비교
· 다시 볼 문제는 즐겨찾기로 모아 두기

■ 학습 통계
· 최근 2주 정답률과 평균 풀이 시간
· 유형별 정답률·평균 시간으로 약한 유형 확인
· 연속 학습일과 오늘 푼 문제 수

■ 이런 분께 추천해요
· 공기업·공공기관·공사·공단 필기시험(NCS 직업기초능력평가, 인적성)을 준비하는 분
· 응용수리·자료해석에서 시간이 부족한 분
· 출퇴근길에 짧게 수리 문제를 풀고 싶은 분

회원가입 없이 바로 시작할 수 있고, 학습 기록은 기기 안에만 저장됩니다.

※ NCS수학은 국가직무능력표준(NCS) 및 각 공공기관·채용 기관과 관계없이 독립적으로 만든 학습 앱입니다. 문제는 자주 출제되는 문제 유형을 바탕으로 숫자와 상황을 새로 구성한 연습 문제입니다.

name: Ne Satıyorsun?
description:
Barbaros Bey, Description alanı için şöyle bir metin önerim var:

---

**Ne Satıyorsun?** Dükkânın tezgâhına sen geçiyorsun ve pazarlık ustalığınla ticaret imparatorluğunu kuruyorsun!

Müşteriler kapıdan girer, ürünleri inceler ve bir fiyat sorar. Gerisi sana kalmış: Dost işi mi yapacaksın, normal fiyat mı vereceksin, yoksa Über Fiyat’la şansını mı deneyeceksin? Her pazarlık yeni bir hikâye, her satış yeni bir fırsat.

**İSTANBUL’DAN MARS’A**
İstanbul’un tarihi çarşılarında, Eminönü’nden Kadıköy’e uzanan dükkânlarda başla. Ticaretin ustası olduğunda Mars’a uzan ve uzaylı müşterilere satış yap.

**PAZARLIĞIN USTASI OL**
Müşterini oku, doğru teklifi ver, kârını katla. Her müşteri farklıdır ve her fiyat da bir risktir.

**ÇALIŞANLARINI İŞE AL**
İlan ver, adayların başvurularını incele, dükkânına uygun çalışanı seç. Çalışanını geliştir, yeni satış seviyelerinin kilidini aç ve dükkânın sen yokken de para kazansın. İstediğin an yönetimi devral.

**SIRLARI ÇÖZ**
Kutulardan çıkan gizli harfleri topla, saklı ifadeyi tamamla ve Hayri Dede’nin unutulmaz hikâyesini keşfet.

**KEDİLER DE BURADA**
Dükkânının şirin dostlarını sahiplen ve tezgâha neşe kat.

## Envanterini yönet, defterini tut, dükkânlarını büyüt. Asıl soru ise hep aynı: **Ne satıyorsun?**

name: Neelo: Reading Journal
description:
Neelo is your reading journal: it remembers where you stopped in every book, times your reading and shows what other readers are reading.

WHERE YOU STOPPED
• Page and line for every book, and how much is left.
• Add books by search, barcode or by hand, with a cover.
• A shelf with covers, a wishlist and the books you've finished.
• Print or e-book.

READING TIMER
• Tap play when you start and log your page when you finish.
• Pauses don't count as reading. The timer keeps going even if you close the app.
• Offline? Your time and pages are saved on the device and sent when you're back online.

GOALS AND STATS
• Daily and weekly goals in pages, minutes, days or hours, with a daily reminder.
• Reading calendar, streaks, pages per hour and charts for any period.
• 9 levels and 12 badges to earn.
• When you finish a book, rate it from 1 to 5 stars and write what you thought.

COMMUNITY OF READERS
• Follow friends and see their reading in your feed.
• Like, comment and send direct messages.
• Book clubs with discussions and group progress.
• Challenges: books, pages, days or hours in a period, with a leaderboard.
• Invite friends with a link.

PRIVACY AND SAFETY
• Your e-mail is never shown to other people.
• Public or private profile, and you choose which automatic updates are posted.
• Block or report any profile, post, comment or message.
• Delete your account and all your data at any time, right in the app.

In English, Portuguese and Spanish, with automatic dark mode.

name: NeonVat
description:
Το NeonVat είναι επαγγελματικό εργαλείο για μηχανικούς βαφής, χρωματιστές εργαστηρίου και υπεύθυνους βαφείων. Συνδέει συνταγή, λόγο λουτρού (LR), καμπύλη ανόδου θερμοκρασίας, μέτρηση ΔΕ και ιστορικό επανορθώσεων σε έναν ενιαίο κύκλο παρτίδας.

ΤΙ ΜΠΟΡΕΙΤΕ ΝΑ ΚΑΝΕΤΕ
• Δημιουργία και αρχειοθέτηση συνταγών με συστατικά % o.w.f., βοηθητικά, βάρος υφάσματος και λόγο λουτρού.
• Σχεδιασμός πολυτμηματικών καμπυλών ανόδου (°C αρχής/τέλους, ρυθμός °C/min, χρόνος διατήρησης) με προεπισκόπηση τύπου HUD.
• Καταγραφή κύκλων βαφής που δεσμεύουν συνταγή + LR + καμπύλη σε μία ταυτότητα παρτίδας.
• Εισαγωγή στόχου και μετρημένων τιμών Lab για υπολογισμό ΔΕ CIE76, έλεγχο ανοχής και ανάγνωση τάσης απόχρωσης (πιο βαθύ / πιο ανοιχτό / μετατόπιση απόχρωσης).
• Σε υπέρβαση ορίων, αυτόματη κάρτα επανορθώσεως: προτεινόμενη συμπληρωματική βαφή %, ρύθμιση LR, παράταση διατήρησης, όριο αποχρωματισμού/αναβαφής — βάσει μεγέθους ΔΕ, κλίσης καμπύλης και αριθμού προηγούμενων επανορθώσεων.
• Παρακολούθηση εκτέλεσης επανορθώσεων, κατάστασης κύκλου και δεικτών KPI: ενεργοί κύκλοι, ποσοστό επιτυχίας, μέσο ΔΕ, εβδομαδιαίο ποσοστό επανορθώσεων.

ΓΙΑΤΙ ΒΟΗΘΑ
Λιγότερες άσκοπες επανορθώσεις, μικρότερη σπατάλη βαφής και σταθερότερη απόχρωση από παρτίδα σε παρτίδα. Σχεδιασμένο για χρήση στο βαφείο: καθαρά πάνελ HUD, μονοδιαστημικοί αριθμοί διεργασίας και πλήρης τοπικός βρόχος από τη συνταγή έως το κλείσιμο της επανορθώσεως.

Όλα τα δεδομένα αποθηκεύονται τοπικά στη συσκευή. Δεν απαιτείται λογαριασμός ή σύνδεση στο διαδίκτυο για τη βασική ροή εργασίας.

name: Neurolark: Brain & Speech Gym
description:
Neurolark is a short daily workout of brain games for memory, focus, words, math and speaking. Open the app, play a few quick rounds, and keep your streak going.

A DAILY WORKOUT, FREE EVERY DAY
Each day Neurolark picks a short set of games for you: about six minutes for four games. Choose 3, 4 or 5 games a day. The daily workout is always free.

52 GAMES
• Memory: Tile Recall, Echo, Pairs, Shopping List, Word Recall and more
• Focus: Color Clash, Odd One Out, Follow the Ball, Signal Watch
• Words: Word Weave, Synonym Sprint, Idiom Builder, Five Letters, Mini Crossword
• Math: Quick Sums, Tip Percent, Fraction Match, Missing Sign
• Puzzles and logic: Sudoku, Tower Shift, Code Breaker, Grid Riddles

SPEAKING PRACTICE
• Clear Speech: talk about a simple topic for a minute, then see your pace, pauses and filler words
• Fluency Sprint: name as many things in a category as you can, out loud
• Say It: read tricky words aloud clearly

LEVELS THAT FOLLOW YOU
Every game adjusts its level to how you play. Prefer to choose? Pick Easy, Medium, Hard or Expert on any game.

NO CLOCK WHEN YOU DON'T WANT ONE
The Untimed workout and the Unwind filter let you play timed games without a timer.

STREAKS, BADGES AND PROGRESS
Keep a daily streak, earn freezes that cover a missed day, collect badges and see your level in every skill.

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
No account, no ads, no tracking. Your results stay on your iPhone. Speech is turned into text while you play, and the audio is not saved.

NEUROLARK PREMIUM
The daily workout and 8 games are free. Premium opens all 52 games any time. Premium is an auto-renewing subscription, billed monthly or yearly to your Apple Account. It renews automatically unless cancelled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. Manage or cancel in Settings > your name > Subscriptions.

Terms of Use (EULA): https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/
Privacy Policy: https://tuhin-014.github.io/app-policies/neurolark/privacy-policy.html

Neurolark is for practice and enjoyment. It is not a medical device and does not diagnose, treat, cure or prevent any disease or condition, including dementia, ADHD or cognitive decline. Skill scores describe how you play Neurolark's games, not your intelligence or brain health. Speaking games are not speech therapy. If you are worried about your memory or speech, talk to a doctor.

name: NexaTracker
description:
NexaTracker é o aplicativo para empresas de rastreamento veicular e para os clientes delas. Gerencie a frota, acompanhe cada veículo no mapa em tempo real e receba avisos importantes na hora.

PARA A EMPRESA (ADMINISTRADOR)
• Painel de Operação com a frota em tempo real: online, parados, em movimento e veículos que precisam de atenção.
• Cadastro e gestão de usuários e veículos.
• Manutenção, relatórios e histórico de rotas.
• Alertas e cercas virtuais.

PARA O CLIENTE
• Localização em tempo real e histórico de rotas.
• Alertas de ignição, movimento, conexão, bateria violada, velocidade e cerca, com escolha de quais veículos recebem cada alerta.
• Bloqueio e desbloqueio do veículo, quando autorizado pela empresa e confirmado com Face ID.

O acesso é criado pela empresa que presta o serviço de rastreamento. Para contratar, fale com o seu provedor.

name: Nexus Condica Prezenta
description:
Nexus Condica Prezenta transforma un iPad intr-un terminal de pontaj pentru companiile care folosesc NexusERP. Tableta se monteaza la intrarea in firma, iar angajatii isi inregistreaza sosirea si plecarea direct pe ecran; pontajele ajung imediat in modulul de resurse umane NexusERP.

Functionalitati principale:
- Pontaj IN / OUT cu butoanele mari "Am Venit" si "Am Plecat"
- Identificarea angajatului prin codul PIN personal, introdus pe tastatura numerica de pe ecran
- Afisarea numelui angajatului si a ultimului pontaj inregistrat, pentru confirmare
- Motive de intarziere sau de plecare (ex. delegatie, interes personal), configurate in NexusERP
- Mesaje de intampinare si fundaluri care se schimba automat
- Interfata de tip kiosk, pe tot ecranul, in mod landscape, gandita pentru o tableta folosita in comun
- Mai multe conexiuni NexusERP salvate, configurate prin scanarea codului QR al licentei sau manual

Aplicatia se conecteaza la serverul NexusERP al companiei folosind conexiunea creata in modulul Aplicatii Online. Datele de pontaj se salveaza in NexusERP-ul companiei.

Pe iOS, pontajul se face cu codul PIN; cititoarele de carduri NFC folosite pe terminalele Android nu sunt disponibile pe iPad.

name: Nexus Ospatari
description:
Nexus Ospatari este aplicatia de comenzi pentru ospatarii din restaurantele, cafenelele si barurile care folosesc NexusERP. Ospatarul preia comenzile direct la masa, de pe telefon, conectandu-se la serverul NexusERP configurat de unitate.

Functionalitati principale:
