- Saloane si mese, cu notele deschise pe fiecare masa si numarul de persoane
- Preluarea comenzilor din meniu, cu filtrare produse, moduri de preparare si produse compuse
- Trimiterea comenzilor la bucatarie/bar si lansarea servirilor pe etape
- Note de plata: tiparire nota, incasare numerar sau card, discount, bacsis, bon fiscal
- Mesagerie interna intre ospatari si bucatarie, pe nota sau pe produs, cu notificari sonore
- Rapoarte ospatar: lista note de plata, bilant ospatar, centralizator vanzari produse si incasari pe grupe de produse
- Targete de vanzari pentru ospatari
- Fotografierea produselor din meniu si incarcarea imaginilor in NexusERP

Aplicatia foloseste functionalitati native iOS: scanarea codului QR pentru configurarea conexiunii, camera pentru fotografiile produselor si tiparirea notelor prin AirPrint.

Accesul se face pe baza contului de utilizator creat de unitate in NexusERP.

name: Nexus Work Tracking
description:
Nexus Work Tracking este terminalul de urmarire a activitatilor de productie pentru companiile care folosesc NexusERP. Aplicatia ruleaza pe iPad, in mod landscape, si este gandita pentru a fi montata in atelier sau pe linia de productie, unde mai multi angajati folosesc acelasi terminal.

Functionalitati principale:
- Identificarea angajatului pe terminal cu codul de card/PIN, de pe tastatura numerica afisata pe ecran
- Lista activitatilor zilei pentru angajatul identificat (operatii din comenzile de productie), cu navigare pe zile si cautare
- Pornirea, punerea in pauza si finalizarea activitatilor, cu observatii si cantitati (lansata, predata, rebut)
- Adaugarea de activitati din lista, cand compania permite acest lucru
- Scanarea cu camera a codului QR/de bare al comenzii sau produsului, pentru filtrarea rapida a activitatilor
- Filtrarea pe utilaje si afisarea sau ascunderea activitatilor finalizate
- Vizualizarea imaginilor si documentelor atasate activitatilor
- Delogarea angajatului dupa fiecare inregistrare, pentru folosirea terminalului de catre urmatorul coleg

Aplicatia se conecteaza la serverul NexusERP al companiei; conexiunea se configureaza o singura data, prin scanarea codului QR al licentei sau manual, din ecranul de setari.

Accesul se face pe baza conexiunii si a codurilor de angajat definite de companie in NexusERP.

name: NICHE — архив вкуса
description:
Научись понимать моду за пять минут в день.

NICHE — ежедневный журнал и архив о моде для тех, кто хочет разбираться: видеть вещь на улице или у артиста и знать, откуда она взялась, кто её придумал и как носить её самому.

КАЖДОЕ УТРО — НОВЫЙ ВЫПУСК
Тема номера, вещь номера и с чем её носить, слово дня, «кто носит», показ, человек номера, готовая формула образа и вопрос дня. Пять минут — и ты знаешь чуть больше, чем вчера. Напоминание в 9:00 подскажет, что вышел свежий номер.

С ЧЕГО НАЧАТЬ, ЕСЛИ ТЫ НОВИЧОК
«Основы за 7 дней» — короткий курс: силуэт и пропорции, цвет, ткань и качество, базовый гардероб, кто есть кто в индустрии, откуда берутся тренды и как собрать свой стиль. По уроку в день, с примерами и маленьким заданием.

КАКОЙ У ТЕБЯ СТИЛЬ
Десять простых вопросов — и ты узнаешь свою эстетику: тихая роскошь, стритвир, горпкор, тёмный авангард, Y2K, новый преппи и другие. С готовыми образами и списком, что купить первым. Результатом можно поделиться в сторис.

АРХИВ, КОТОРЫЙ СВЯЗАН НИТЯМИ
Более 300 записей: дизайнеры от Шанель до Демны и Фаррелла, течения от New Look до TikTok-эстетик, легендарные показы, культовые вещи от Tabi до Yeezy 350, словарь, лонгриды и «нити» — связи моды с музыкой и искусством. Каждая запись ведёт к десятку других.

СКОЛЬКО СТОИТ И ГДЕ ИСКАТЬ
У каждой вещи — три цены: новая, с рук и похожая дешевле, с кнопками поиска в магазинах и признаками оригинала. Вкладка «Вещи» — каталог с фильтрами по типу, бюджету и стилю.

РАЗБОРЫ ОБРАЗОВ
Блоккор, тихая роскошь, горпкор, балеткор, Tabi с джинсами: из чего состоит образ, почему он работает и как повторить его недорого, средне или без лимита.

МОЙ НОМЕР
Профиль как обложка журнала: твоё имя вместо названия, тема номера из теста стиля, «Мои четыре», ДНК вкуса и список «Хочу». Своим номером можно поделиться в сторис.

ДЕСЯТИЛЕТИЕ И «КТО ГДЕ»
Мода с 2010 года, год за годом: что носили, что звучало, что изменилось. И актуальная карта: кто сейчас креативный директор главных домов.

ДЕЛИСЬ КРАСИВО
Карточки для сторис: вещь, разбор, «Мой номер» или любая цитата из статьи — зажми абзац, и получится журнальная страница. По ссылке на карточке друзья откроют то же самое в NICHE.

СВОИ БОРДЫ
Собирай мудборды из вещей архива, своих фото, цветов и заметок.

Без регистрации и рекламы. Приложение не собирает данные: всё личное хранится только на твоём телефоне.

name: Night Sky Greece
description:
Night Sky Greece shows you where and when you'll get the best night sky in Greece.

The app combines the three things that make or break a stargazing night:
• hourly cloud cover from the weather forecast,
• the Moon's phase and rise/set times,
• light pollution for each area (Bortle scale).

From these it gives a score from 0 to 10 for tonight and the coming nights.

TONIGHT
Tonight's best option at a glance: score, dark hours, Moon and clouds.

PLACES
Compare your location with dark spots near you and well-known stargazing places such as Parnitha, Cape Sounion, Kithaironas and Lake Marathon.

DETAILS
Hourly cloud cover, the dark window and a forecast for the next nights for every spot.

SETTINGS
Choose the search radius, how many places to compare and the score that triggers an alert.

Greek and English, switchable inside the app.
No accounts, no ads, no tracking.

Weather data: Open-Meteo.com (CC BY 4.0)
Light pollution data: VIIRS Nighttime Lights, Earth Observation

name: Niko: Catch the Bug!
description:
Niko the chameleon sits on a branch, and you aim his tongue.

Pull your finger back like a slingshot and let go: Niko's tongue unrolls like a party blower the other way. The farther you pull, the farther it reaches. Its sticky tip catches the bugs it touches, up to five in one shot, and Niko takes the colour of the last bug he swallows. Catch bugs of his colour one after another for a colour streak, and catch at the far end of the tongue for a Precise! catch. Butterflies and fireflies are Niko's friends, so leave them be, and watch out for the wasps: they sting!

FIVE WORLDS, 75 LEVELS
Catch bugs in Sunny Garden, Rainforest, Desert Oasis, Moon Night and Rainbow Island. Every world has 15 levels: catch the goal before your tongues run out, with no clock in a regular level, so you can aim at your own pace. Rain pushes the bugs lower, wind blows them sideways, and at night only the lanterns and fireflies light the way. Level 15 of every world is the Feast: a 45-second swarm with unlimited tongues. Each level has up to three stars.

EIGHT KINDS OF BUGS, SIX BONUSES
- Flies, mosquitoes, bees, dragonflies, armoured beetles, moths, golden flies and rainbow bugs
- Bonus bubbles: honey drop, dandelion, rainbow berry, extra tongues, chili pepper and cookie

WAYS TO PLAY
- Levels: 75 levels across five worlds
- Daily Yum: one short level every day, the same for everyone, with star coins for the win and a gift for every 7 days in a row: a hat for the Wardrobe or bonus star coins
- Endless Feast: catch until your tongues run out; a catch keeps your tongue until the bugs reach top speed
- Family Feast: Niko and his sister Mimi in a catching duel for two players on one device; on iPad both play at once, each on their own half, and on iPhone you take turns
- The Wardrobe: dress Niko in 9 colours, 3 patterns, 4 hats and 3 tongue trails; green is his own, the rest cost star coins you earn by playing

FOR THE WHOLE FAMILY
- One finger: start your pull anywhere on the screen except on Niko himself
- Kids mode: slower bugs, a bigger tip and no wasps, and in the levels unlimited tongues and no losing; set by the "Who plays?" question at first launch
- The Slow tempo setting makes the bugs fly slower for anyone who needs it, and the Left-handed setting swaps the top buttons
- Niko cheers in your language, with a caption every time
- One app for iPhone and iPad

GOOD TO KNOW
- No ads, no analytics, no tracking
- Collects no personal data: no account, no chat, no sharing
- Free to play: Sunny Garden, the first world, with its 15 levels, the Daily Yum, the Endless Feast, the Family Feast and the Wardrobe. One one-time in-app purchase, the Full version, unlocks worlds 2 to 5 (60 more levels; each world opens when the one before it is finished), lets you play the Endless Feast and the Family Feast in every opened world, and makes three exclusive Wardrobe items available to buy with star coins: the Rainbow and Galaxy colours and the dots pattern
- Star coins are earned by playing and are not sold for money
- Purchases, links and messages to us sit behind a parental gate
- Plays offline, anywhere
- Sounds, music and vibration each have their own switch
- Speaks 31 languages and follows your device's language

Niko: Catch the Bug! is made with care by HippyHopGames, a small family company.

name: Nine Card
description:
Nine is the classic card game of patience and nerve for four players — Devyatka, as it is known across Eastern Europe, a cousin of Sevens and Fan Tan that builds from the nines. Easy to learn in a minute, and a fight over every card to the very last one.

Thirty-six cards, nine each. Every suit is laid out on the table in its own row, and every row grows from its nine: down to the six, up to the ace. Whoever holds the nine of diamonds opens the deal. If you have a card that fits, you must play it; pass only when nothing fits — and everyone sees you pass. First to empty their hand ends the deal, and everyone else pays a point for every card still held, and for every pass.

FEATURES

• The complete classic rules, for four players, each for themselves
• Three computer opponents — Easy, Normal and Hard. Hard plays out hundreds of possible deals before every move, and remembers what each pass gave away
• Online play: join a table or use Quick Match, or open your own table and pass its code to friends — the computer fills any empty seat, so the game always starts
• Your house rules: what a pass costs, the score the match is played to
• Saves after every card. Close it mid-deal and Resume puts you back exactly where you were
• Pinch to zoom and drag to look around the table; highlighted playable cards if you want them
• English and Russian throughout, rules included
• Phones, tablets and Chromebooks, upright or on their side

FREE, WITH AN OPTIONAL UNLOCK

The game is free to play: every rule, the Easy and Normal opponents, unlimited games, three matches against Hard, and joining tables online. One optional payment unlocks the rest: the Hard opponent without limit, every table felt, and your own online table under your own rules. One payment, no subscription, and it stays bought.

No adverts. No tracking. No account needed to play.

Questions or feedback? support@rh1.tech

name: Nine Men's Morris – Mill Game
description:
Play Nine Men's Morris, the classic strategy board game also known as Mill or Merels. Mühle Meister brings this timeless two-player game to your phone: play offline against the computer, with a friend on one device or online with friends. Build a double mill, block your opponent and always think one move ahead.

HOW TO PLAY NINE MEN'S MORRIS
Each player places nine pieces on the board. Line up three pieces to form a mill and remove one of your opponent's pieces. Once all pieces are placed, move them along the lines. With only three pieces left, you can fly to any free point. You win by reducing your opponent to two pieces or by blocking every move. The interactive tutorial teaches the rules step by step, perfect for beginners and kids.

PLAY OFFLINE OR WITH 2 PLAYERS
• Play against the computer with five AI levels, from Beginner to Unfair
• Local two-player mode: pass and play on one phone or tablet
• Offline games need no internet, great for travel, commutes and waiting rooms

PLAY ONLINE WITH FRIENDS
Invite friends to a game with a code or find opponents online. Matchmaking may use computer opponents when needed.

TRAIN YOUR STRATEGY
In career mode, twelve computer opponents with their own play styles are waiting. Beat one to challenge the next. The daily Morris puzzle is the same for every player: find the winning line in just a few moves and keep your streak alive. Puzzle packs sorted by theme help you practice specific tactics. A brain game that gets a little more exciting every day.

MORRIS VARIANTS
Besides classic Nine Men's Morris, play Three Men's Morris, Six Men's Morris, Twelve Men's Morris on the larger board with diagonals and Lasker Morris, suggested by world chess champion Emanuel Lasker. Optional rule mutators keep every game fresh, and each weekend features a historic variant.

GOALS AND REWARDS
• Daily tasks, a daily bonus and level progress
• Monthly seasons with leagues and season rewards
• A skill rating that shows how strong you play
• Unlockable pieces, frames, titles and sound packs
• Achievements and personal statistics

FAIR AND RELAXED
Everything is unlocked with stones you earn by playing. There are no real-money or in-app purchases. Move pieces by tapping or dragging and adjust music and sound effects separately. The app contains ads for our own apps. Games against the computer work offline; online features need an internet connection. The game is available in 36 languages.

Whether you are a Morris expert or just learning the game, playing solo against the AI or as a board game for the whole family: download Mühle Meister and close your first mill.

name: Nodo Tech by Nucleo
description:
Nodo Tech reúne en una sola app todo lo que tu equipo necesita para trabajar en terreno.

TU DÍA ORGANIZADO DE UN VISTAZO
Revisa tus tareas, visitas y responsables del día, la semana o el mes en el calendario, y entérate al instante cuando te asignan una actividad nueva.

CHECKLISTS Y FIRMAS DESDE EL CELULAR
Responde checklists de seguridad, inspecciones y recepciones con fotos y evidencia en el momento. Firma y aprueba sin papeles.

TU FLOTA BAJO CONTROL
Registra el estado, el kilometraje y el combustible de cada vehículo, con la foto de la boleta cuando corresponde.

SIGUE TU RUTA EN TIEMPO REAL
Recorridos y visitas al minuto: dirección, horario, conductor y patente de cada parada, con acceso directo al mapa.

Planifica, mide, integra y mejora la operación de tu empresa con Nodo Tech, de Nucleo ODS.

Requiere una cuenta entregada por tu empresa.

name: NoNetChat – Offline Chat
description:
Talk to people around you without Internet or a cellular network. NoNetChat uses Bluetooth and available local connections, with no account or messaging server.

CHAT AND SHARE
Both people agree before chatting. Exchange text, photos, documents and voice notes, or create a private group with up to 16 members. Accepting a group does not allow private messages from its members. Walkie-talkie sends short voice clips after recording, privately, in groups or publicly: it is not live audio.

Consent does not verify identity. Compare a code or QR in person to verify your contact. Without this step, encryption does not guarantee their identity. An unverified contact can recognize you for 24 hours after your last new outgoing message; incoming messages do not extend that time. Recognition remains revocable for verified contacts.

MEET PEOPLE
Your profile and Sociable mode are optional: an avatar, About, availability and interests, with an audience for each field. The preview shows what others can see. Wave to offer a conversation; the person can accept, ignore or block. Their photo appears only after a gesture. Adults may make a profile photo public; lists keep the composed avatar. A modified app can bypass display restrictions on a voluntarily public photo. Text moments last 24 hours and go to chosen contacts, never the public area.

HELP EACH OTHER
Post a message, alert, need or offer nearby. Update your SOS and voluntarily share a meeting point or location. Public posts are signed but not encrypted: recipients can keep them. Hide, mute, block and local reporting remain available; private report evidence is never sent to the developer.

FIND A LOVED ONE
Search for a verified contact who has authorized you, with a coarse Bluetooth indication and an optional ring. The person being sought can stop from the notification. A voluntarily sent point allows offline guidance: no continuous GPS tracking or remote location requests.

YOUR PRIVACY
From age 13, protected mode limits communication to chosen contacts verified in person, with no social profile visible to strangers. Photos, documents and voice notes remain available between those contacts. Normal mode is offered from age 16. Your birth date stays private and is never transmitted. This check relies on a self-declared date and the device clock. A nickname is enough for your profile; other fields are optional. Discovery identifiers rotate. Private conversations and groups are encrypted in transit; the app does not yet encrypt local history at rest.

Relays retain encrypted private packets, and transfers can resume after disconnection. Large files use a fast connection, never the Bluetooth mesh; temporary Wi-Fi requires your approval. Range, delays and background operation depend on hardware, obstacles and permissions. Reception and permanent availability are not guaranteed.

Install the app before an outage and keep devices updated. NoNetChat does not replace emergency services.

name: NORTH COMPLIANCE
description:
NORTH COMPLIANCEは、障害福祉事業所の研修・委員会・訓練・年間計画・実施記録などを一元管理するアプリです。

日々の記録を、確かな安心へ。

「何を実施したか」「いつ実施したか」「どの事業所で、誰が参加したか」を分かりやすく整理し、事業所の運営管理をサポートします。

【主な機能】

■ 実施記録の管理
研修、委員会、訓練などの実施日、対象事業所、参加職員番号、実施内容を記録できます。項目は選択肢から指定でき、入力の負担を軽減します。

■ 複数事業所の管理
生活介護、児童発達支援、放課後等デイサービス、共同生活援助（グループホーム）に対応。複数の事業所をまとめて管理できます。

■ 年間計画の管理
年間の実施予定を整理し、月ごとの計画を確認できます。実施記録と照合することで、予定と実績の管理に役立ちます。

■ 実施状況の確認
管理項目ごとに記録の有無や確認が必要な内容を表示し、記録漏れの防止をサポートします。

■ 写真・参考資料の管理
研修や訓練などの実施記録に写真や参考資料のリンクを登録できます。

■ PDF出力
実施記録をPDF形式で出力できます。資料の保管や印刷、共有に活用できます。

■ 変更履歴の保存
実施記録の変更履歴を保存し、記録の管理に役立てます。

■ 法令対応の確認
運営に関連する管理項目や対応状況を一覧で確認できます。

【こんな事業所におすすめ】

・研修や委員会の実施状況を整理したい
・年間計画と実施記録をまとめて管理したい
・複数事業所の記録を一元管理したい
・運営指導に向けて資料を整理しておきたい
・記録漏れや確認不足を減らしたい

NORTH COMPLIANCEは、障害福祉の現場で働く皆さまの記録管理を支えるアプリです。

【ご利用上の注意】
本アプリは運営管理を支援するためのツールであり、法令や指定基準への適合を保証するものではありません。適用される基準や実施回数などについては、最新の法令および自治体の案内をご確認ください。

提供：NorthBridgeGroup合同会社

name: NoteSprint — тренажёр нот
description:
NoteSprint — тренажёр по чтению нот с листа. Ноты на нотном стане появляются одна за другой, а вы называете их, нажимая До, Ре, Ми… Подходит начинающим музыкантам, ученикам музыкальных школ и всем, кто хочет быстро и надёжно запомнить расположение нот.

РАЗВИВАЙТЕ НАВЫК ЧТЕНИЯ НОТ
Скорость чтения нот с листа — базовый навык любого музыканта. NoteSprint превращает рутинную зубрёжку в динамичную игру: каждая сессия — это набор нот, которые нужно назвать на время. Регулярные короткие тренировки заметно ускоряют распознавание нот.

ВОЗМОЖНОСТИ
• Два ключа — скрипичный и басовый. Тренируйте их по отдельности или вместе.
• 49 нот в широком диапазоне, включая добавочные линии над станом и под ним.
• Гибкий таймер — от 1 до 20 секунд на ответ или режим без ограничения времени.
• Настраиваемая длина раунда — 10, 20, 50 или 100 нот.
• Умная тренировка — ноты, в которых вы ошиблись, появляются чаще, пока вы их не выучите.
• Система очков и личные рекорды — 3 очка за ответ с первой попытки, 1 — после ошибки.
• Звук пианино, тактильная отдача и живая анимация нотного стана.
• Наглядный стан: пять линий, ключ, штиль и добавочные линии.
• Полностью офлайн — без рекламы, регистрации и сбора данных.

КАК ИГРАТЬ
1. Выберите ключи, длину раунда и таймер на главном экране.
2. Нажмите «Начать».
3. Назовите ноту на стане, нажав нужную кнопку (До, Ре, Ми, Фа, Соль, Ля, Си).
4. Старайтесь отвечать с первой попытки — так вы получите больше очков.

ДЛЯ КОГО
• Ученики музыкальных школ и их родители.
• Начинающие пианисты и гитаристы, осваивающие нотную грамоту.
• Преподаватели сольфеджио, которым нужен быстрый инструмент для разминки.
• Все, кто когда-то учил ноты и хочет их не забыть.

NoteSprint работает без интернета, не требует аккаунта и не собирает персональные данные. Просто ноты, стан и вы.

name: NumberLink One Path
description:
Connect the numbers in order and visit every cell in one path. Start at either end, slide to neighboring cells and retrace your steps when you want to try another route.

Play three difficulties or try a new 11×11 daily challenge. Resume each mode where you left off, collect badges and follow your best times and play history.

A one-time Full Version purchase adds section solving, checkpoints, unlimited hints, the current puzzle’s solution, custom backgrounds, all dynamic effects and optional private iCloud backup and restore. Buy once and get future Full Version updates for this app.

name: Nursy – เวรไหนก็ไหวหมด
description:
Nursy - เวรไหนก็ไหวหมด
แอปตารางเวรสำหรับพยาบาล ลงเวร เช็กเวร ดูเวรเพื่อน ครบจบในแอปเดียว

เปิดแอปปุ๊บ รู้เลยว่าวันนี้เวรอะไร
- การ์ดเวรวันนี้ บอกเวลาเริ่ม-เลิก และนับถอยหลังว่าเหลืออีกกี่นาที
- ดูเวรพรุ่งนี้ได้ทันที แม้วันเดียวมีสองเวร
- สรุปว่าเดือนนี้เหลืออีกกี่เวร

ลงเวรทั้งเดือนในไม่กี่แตะ
- เวรเช้า บ่าย ดึก วันหยุด แยกสีชัด ดูง่ายทั้งเดือน
- สร้างเวรเองได้ เช่น ไตเทียม OR ER ตั้งชื่อย่อ สี และเวลาได้ตามจริง
- โหมดลงเวร เลือกเวรแล้วแตะวันที่ต่อกันได้เลย
- แสดงวันหยุดราชการไทยและปี พ.ศ. ในปฏิทิน

รู้ทันทีว่าใครขึ้นเวรกับเรา
- สร้างกลุ่มวอร์ดหรือกลุ่มเพื่อน แล้วเชิญเข้ากลุ่มได้ง่าย ๆ
- ดูตารางเวรของทุกคนในกลุ่มล่วงหน้า 14 วัน
- หาวันหยุดตรงกัน นัดกินข้าวหรือไปเที่ยวได้ง่ายขึ้น
- ไม่ต้องถามในไลน์อีกว่าใครอยู่เวรไหน

สถิติเวรของตัวเอง
- นับเวรเช้า บ่าย ดึก และวันหยุดให้อัตโนมัติทุกเดือน
- คำนวณค่าเวรจากอัตราที่ตั้งไว้
- Community ดูอันดับคนขึ้นเวรเยอะสุดประจำเดือน เลือกแสดงหรือซ่อนชื่อได้

งานที่ต้องทำ
- จดงานที่ต้องทำแยกตามวัน ไม่ลืมเรื่องสำคัญระหว่างเวร

วิดเจ็ตหน้าจอโฮมและหน้าจอล็อก
- เห็นเวรวันนี้และวันถัดไปโดยไม่ต้องเปิดแอป

ข้อมูลของคุณเป็นส่วนตัว
ตารางเวรจะเห็นได้เฉพาะคุณและเพื่อนในกลุ่มที่คุณเข้าร่วมเท่านั้น ไม่มีโฆษณา ไม่ติดตามการใช้งาน และลบบัญชีพร้อมข้อมูลทั้งหมดได้ทุกเมื่อจากในแอป

Nursy เพราะงานพยาบาลเหนื่อยพออยู่แล้ว เรื่องตารางเวรควรเป็นเรื่องง่าย

name: Nuven: Gizli Sohbet
description:
Nuven, kim olduğunu bilmeden çalışan bir mesajlaşma uygulaması.

Telefon numarası, e-posta, isim ya da rehber istemez. "Hesap oluştur"a dokunduğunda sana 16 haneli bir hesap numarası verilir; hesabın bundan ibarettir. Arkadaşlarını Nuven ID'leriyle ya da QR kodla eklersin.

UÇTAN UCA ŞİFRELİ
Mesajların, sesli mesajların, fotoğrafların ve aramaların telefonunda şifrelenir ve yalnızca karşı tarafın cihazında açılır. Nuven dahil hiç kimse içeriği göremez. Sunucu, mesajları teslim edildiği anda siler.

ARAMALARDA IP ADRESİN GİZLİ
Sesli ve görüntülü aramalar şifreli bir aktarma sunucusu üzerinden geçer; konuştuğun kişi IP adresini göremez. Görüşme sırasında sesliden görüntülüye geçebilir, aramaya başka kişileri ekleyebilirsin.

GRUPLAR
Gruplar yalnızca üyelerin telefonlarında yaşar; sunucu bir grubun var olduğunu bile bilmez. Birden fazla yönetici, grup sohbeti ve grup araması desteklenir.

TÜM CİHAZLARINDA
Aynı hesap numarasıyla iPhone ve iPad'ine giriş yap. Yeni cihaza eski sohbetlerini, senin onayınla ve uçtan uca şifreli olarak aktar.

GİZLİLİĞE SAYGILI BİLDİRİMLER
Bildirim içeriği telefonunda çözülür; sunucu ve Apple yalnızca boş bir uyarı görür. İstersen bildirimlerde mesajı tamamen gizleyebilirsin.

KİMLİK DOĞRULAMA
Her sohbette güvenlik numarasını ya da QR kodu karşılaştırarak gerçekten doğru kişiyle konuştuğunu doğrula.

ÜCRETSİZ, REKLAMSIZ, KAYITSIZ
Ücret yok, reklam yok, takip yok. Konum, rehber, kullanım verisi toplanmaz.

Hesap numaranı kaybedersen hesabını kurtaramayız — çünkü kim olduğunu bilmiyoruz. Bir parola yöneticisine kaydetmeyi unutma.

name: OCD Centre
description:
OCD Centre هو تطبيق إدارة السنتر التعليمي على الموبايل، لمسؤولي السناتر والمساعدين اللي عندهم حساب على نظام OCD Centre.

بالتطبيق تقدر:
• تسجّل حضور الطلاب بمسح باركود الكارت بالكاميرا، وتقفل الحصة وتسجّل الغياب تلقائي.
• تتابع جدول حصص اليوم وعدد اللي حضروا واللي غابوا.
• تضيف طلاب جداد وتعدّل بياناتهم وتشوف ملف كل طالب وحضوره ودرجاته.
• تدير المجموعات والسناتر ومواعيد الحصص.
• تصحّح ورق البابل شيت بالكاميرا أو من الصور، وتراجع النتيجة قبل ما تحفظها.
• تصوّر ورق الإجابة بسكانر مستندات جوه التطبيق.
• تسجّل درجات الامتحانات يدوي وتصدّر الكشوف.

التطبيق بيشتغل من غير إنترنت: كل اللي بتسجّله بيتحفظ على الموبايل ويترفع على السيرفر أول ما النت يرجع.

الدخول بحساب السنتر فقط. لو معندكش حساب، كلّم مسؤول السنتر.

name: Odd Sock: Party Word Game
description:
Everyone gets the same secret word. Except the odd sock.

Odd Sock is a pass-the-phone party game for 3 to 12 players. Each player peeks at a card: most see the secret word, but one or more odd socks only see the category. Go round the circle giving one-word clues. Say too much and the odd sock works out the word. Say too little and you look like the odd sock yourself. Then vote. Catch the odd sock and score; get it wrong and they clean up. A caught odd sock still gets one guess at the word to steal the round.

WHY GROUPS LOVE IT
• One phone. No accounts, no extra devices, no setup. Hand it round and play.
• Rounds take two minutes, so it fits anywhere: dinner tables, road trips, sleepovers, classrooms.
• Built-in clue timer, secret ballots or point-on-three voting, and automatic scoring across rounds.
• Big type, loud colours and bouncy animations that read across the table.

1,261 WORDS IN 23 PACKS
Snack Attack, Critter Party, Out & About, Clock In, Game Day, Junk Drawer, Passport, Wild Weather, Showtime, Mixtape, Party Hats, School Days, Gadget Shelf, Once Upon a Time and Dress Up. Every word is family-friendly and has a near-miss twin for the trickier modes.

SEASONAL PACKS
Thanksgiving & Feasts, Winter Holidays, New Year's Eve, Valentine's & Romance, Spring & Outdoors, Summer & Beach, Back to School and Halloween. Whatever's in season jumps to the top of your pack list, ready for the next family gathering.

THREE WAYS TO PLAY
• Classic: odd socks know they're odd and only see the category.
• Near Miss: odd socks get a close-but-wrong word (Waffle instead of Pancake) and have no idea they're odd.
• Mystery Count: anywhere from one odd sock up to your limit. Nobody knows how many.

MAKE YOUR OWN PACKS
Family nicknames, inside jokes, this week's spelling list. Type them in or import a CSV, and export your packs to share them.

KEEP SCORE
Past games and all-time wins are saved on your phone. Export your game history as a CSV any time.

FREE TO PLAY
Classic mode with Snack Attack, Critter Party and Out & About is free, with no time limit. The newest seasonal pack is free too while it's in season, and the app shows the date it goes back to Pro. Odd Sock Pro unlocks every pack all year, Near Miss, Mystery Count and custom packs.

Odd Sock Pro: $29.99 a year with a 7-day free trial, or $4.99 a week. Payment is charged to your Apple ID when you confirm the purchase (after the trial, if you have one). Subscriptions renew automatically unless cancelled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. Manage or cancel in Settings › Apple ID › Subscriptions.

Terms: https://nooton.com/apps/oddoneout/terms
Privacy: https://nooton.com/apps/oddoneout/privacy

name: Office Goblin Max
description:
Your performance review is about to get weird.

You are a small goblin loose in an open-plan office. Steal snacks, bonk coworkers, launch rolling chairs, and turn ordinary office supplies into ridiculous weapons. Keep your shift alive as corporate chaos takes over.

CHOOSE YOUR DEPARTMENT
Clock in as the Breakroom Bandit, IT Gremlin, or Mailroom Bruiser. Each has its own strengths and ultimate ability.

FIND YOUR SHIFT
Start as an Unpaid Intern, tackle Mid-Level Goblin, or face the C-Suite Nightmare. Chase your best score and earn a performance review you probably should not show HR.

PLAY YOUR WAY
Designed for iPhone and iPad with touch controls. Choose from four free outfit colours. Adjust sound, haptics, and screen shake in Options.

FREE OFFICE CHAOS
Play offline with no account, no ads, and no paid gameplay advantages. Scores and settings stay on your device.

The only in-app purchase is an optional, repeatable tip: "Buy the developer a sip of coffee." It unlocks nothing. The goblin already has everything it needs.

Have an idea? The optional suggestion box sends your note privately to the developer. An internet connection is required for suggestions and coffee tips.

name: Offline Notes: REAL
description:
Keep what matters on your own device.

Offline Notes saves visual knowledge cards locally. Capture screenshots, photos, study notes and everyday ideas. Everyday note-taking and review need no account or internet connection. No ads or analytics tracking.

CAPTURE SIMPLY
A title is all you need. Add longer text, photos and a category whenever useful. Take a photo or import from your library. Imported images are independent copies, so deleting the original does not remove the saved copy. For iCloud-only originals, you can approve a system download for each image.

ORGANIZE AND FIND
Filter by several categories and search titles and content. Find categories as you type, create new ones, and choose which appear by default. Long-press a category to rename or delete it. When deleting, choose whether to keep its notes or delete them too. Cards adapt to their text and images.

BUILD A REVIEW HABIT
Enable Memory for any card to add it to spaced review inspired by the Ebbinghaus forgetting curve. See due and overdue cards, then choose Forgot, Unsure or Remembered to schedule the next review. Learning outcomes vary with the material and your practice.

RECALL BEFORE REVEALING
Optionally blur images in the list and detail view. Open the note details and tap an image to see it clearly.

KEEP YOUR OWN BACKUPS
Export selected categories or the entire collection as a password-protected encrypted backup, including images and review progress. Choose an optional filename and follow export progress. Import the backup on a new device to continue. Keep your backup and password safe: passwords cannot be recovered. Each backup supports up to 256 MB; export categories separately for larger collections.

Available in English, Simplified Chinese and Japanese, with light, dark and system themes.

There is no note cloud sync. Export a backup before deleting the app or replacing your device.

name: Okey: Agent Inbox
description:
Okey on your iPhone shows which of your coding agents is waiting for you, and lets you answer from wherever you are.

Your agents keep running on your Mac. When one stops to ask a question (run this command, edit this file, which option), the question comes to your iPhone with what the agent last said, the command or the file, and Okey's risk label. Tap an answer. Anything that runs a command or changes files asks for Face ID first, and your Mac checks every answer before it types it.

- See every agent at a glance: who needs you, who is working, what is done.
- Answer a question, tick several answers, or type a short reply.
- When one agent asks another for something, send it or decline it.
- Read what a finished task changed, file by file, and undo it.
- Stop an agent's turn, or retry a task that failed.
- "1 agent needs you" on the Lock Screen and in the Dynamic Island while Okey runs.

Private by design. Your iPhone and your Mac pair with a QR code and a 6-digit check. Every question and every answer is end-to-end encrypted: Okey's relay passes them on and can't read them. No account, no analytics, no tracking.

Okey Pro on your Mac unlocks the iPhone app. Okey for Mac works with Claude Code, Codex, Mistral Vibe, OpenCode and Grok.

For now Okey tells you about a question while it is open or was just in use. Alerts on a locked iPhone come in a later version.

name: OLTScope
description:
**OLT SCOPE — Tactical HUD Camera**

See everyday life from a different perspective.

OLT SCOPE is an iPhone camera app that overlays a tactical-style heads-up display (HUD) on live camera footage, allowing you to capture photos and videos with a distinctive visual experience.

Detect people, pets, and vehicles with on-screen indicators. Add digital leveling, cinematic filters, and customizable HUD elements to your everyday photography.

**KEY FEATURES**

**TACTICAL HUD**
Overlay reticles, compass information, and visual indicators on your camera view. Capture photos and videos with the HUD included.

**SMART DETECTION**
Display detection markers for people, dogs, cats, and cars. A short electronic sound plays when a new person is detected.

**ELECTRONIC LEVEL**
Monitor camera tilt with a color-changing reticle for intuitive leveling feedback.

**VISUAL FILTERS**
Choose from MONO, NV GREEN, NV WHITE, TACTICAL CINEMA, and other visual styles to create your preferred look.

**PHOTO & VIDEO**
Capture photos and record videos with HUD overlays. Adjust zoom and camera settings to suit your scene.

**CUSTOMIZABLE HUD**
Choose different reticle styles and customize display settings to match your preferences.

**MAKE EVERYDAY TACTICAL.**

From outdoor adventures and events to everyday moments, OLT SCOPE brings a unique HUD-inspired perspective to your photos and videos.

Note: Detection indicators and estimated distances are intended for visual effects and general reference only. They are not designed for precision measurement or safety-critical use.

name: One Ship Home: Alien Survival
description:
You crash-land alone on an uncharted alien planet. Your suit's air is running out, the nights bring hunters, and the only way home is the broken ship behind you.

Scavenge the wreck, craft tools and build a base that keeps you breathing: oxygen generators, solar panels, batteries and lights the hunters won't cross. Then head out across six regions, from the Glow Forest to the Frozen Ridge, the Ember Fields and the caves of the Deep, to recover the six parts your ship needs to fly.

Vela, your ship's AI, talks you through it, and she doesn't sugar-coat anything.

• Survive: keep your air, water, food and health up
• Build a base that keeps the night out
• Six regions, each with its own danger: spore clouds, dust storms, blizzards, eruptions and the dark
• Rebuild your ship part by part, and fly home
• Made for touch: a joystick to move, one button to act, a swipe to dodge
• Plays offline, and your progress saves automatically
• In English and Spanish

name: OneMove Air
description:
Air for your sound, free. OneMove Air is an AUv3 plug-in for iPad and iPhone that opens up the top of a vocal, a synth, a pad, keys or a whole bus.

Free. No in-app purchases. No ads. No account.

HOW IT WORKS
Air adds two layers of high-frequency lift, Mid Air and High Air, and both follow the music. Where the top is quiet and dull, Air lifts it a lot. Where it is already loud and bright, Air lifts it only a little. So the sound opens up without getting harsh, and it stays that way as the part gets louder.

ONE KNOB, OR THE FULL PANEL
• One big Air knob does the job.
• Mid Air and High Air, each with its own frequency.
• Floor keeps noise and room tone in the quiet parts from being lifted.
• Trim and Mix.
• A live display shows the lift across the spectrum as it happens. When nothing is being added, it settles to a flat line.
• Six factory presets: Default, Synth Shimmer, Pad Halo, Keys Sparkle, Bus Open and Vocal Air.
• ON / OUT is crossfaded, and OUT is your input, bit for bit.

PLAY THROUGH IT
Air adds no latency, so it's safe to play and sing through live.

KEY LINK: SEND VOCAL KEY
Put Air on a vocal and switch on "Send vocal key" in its settings. Air then sends the vocal, as it arrives, to other OneMove plug-ins on other tracks, so they can make room for the voice. It works in any host, with no side-chain routing. Air's own sound doesn't change.

TRY IT IN THE APP
The app has its own player: hear Air on a vocal over music, or on music alone, with A/B bypass. No host needed.

FROM ONEMOVE AUDIO
Air comes from the Air module in OneMove Vocal Console, our fourteen-module vocal chain. The "More from OneMove" page in the app lists our other plug-ins: Vocal Console, Resonance & Balance and OneMove Compressors.

WORKS WITH
AUv3 hosts on iPad and iPhone. Mono and stereo. Every control is a host parameter for automation.

PRIVACY
Everything runs on your device. No account, no tracking, no data collected. The "More from OneMove" page downloads our public product list from onemove.audio and sends nothing about you or your device.

Demo vocal: "Lost_Pella" by queeniemusic (CC BY 3.0), via ccMixter; excerpt. Demo music by OneMove Audio.

name: Operación - Pide Lo Nuestro
description:
Operación - Pide Lo Nuestro es la app para el equipo de los restaurantes que usan la plataforma Pide Lo Nuestro. Cada persona entra con su rol y ve solo lo que necesita para trabajar, en tiempo real.

CON OPERACIÓN PUEDES:
• Kiosko de autoservicio: el cliente arma su pedido en una tablet, elige comer aquí o para llevar y paga en caja. El dueño lo personaliza con su imagen, colores y textos.
• POS: tomar pedidos, cobrar, abrir y cerrar caja e imprimir tickets por Bluetooth.
• Mesero: ver las mesas, tomar pedidos en la mesa y cobrar.
• Cocina y barra: recibir las comandas al instante y marcarlas como listas.
• Pedidos sincronizados con el panel del dueño y con la app Mi Negocio.

Multi-sede: cada dispositivo trabaja en la sede que le corresponde.

IMPORTANTE: esta app es para negocios que ya tienen una cuenta en Pide Lo Nuestro. Para entrar necesitas el código de tu restaurante y el usuario y la clave que te asignó el dueño.

name: OrigArt
description: 东方幻想 × 原创潮玩。发现限量手办、收藏雕像与匠人新作，把心动的作品收入收藏。

name: Owlday - School Timetable
description:
Owlday is a school planner in a hand-drawn style, with a friendly owl who keeps you company. Everything stays on your phone, and no account is needed.

TIMETABLE
• See your whole week at a glance, split into morning, afternoon and evening.
• Set your own period times and school days.
• Share your timetable as an image or a QR code, and scan a friend's to copy it.
• Turn your timetable into a lock screen wallpaper.

GRADES
• Enter scores for each subject and semester on a 10, 20 or 100 point scale.
• See your average, your progress toward a target, and which subjects need work.
• Find out the final exam score you need to reach your target.

TO-DO
• Jot down tasks with a note and an optional reminder.
• Tasks are grouped by time: overdue, today, tomorrow, this week.

AND MORE
• Pomodoro study timer.
• Speak instead of typing. Speech is transcribed on your device.
• Light and dark themes.
• Back up everything to a file and restore it on a new phone.
• 12 languages: English, Vietnamese, Spanish, Portuguese, French, German, Japanese, Korean, Chinese, Indonesian, Thai and Russian.

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
Owlday works offline. Your timetable, grades and tasks never leave your device unless you share or export them yourself.

name: OwnPlayer
description:
OwnPlayer is a TV player for the playlists you already have. Add an M3U playlist, an Xtream Codes login or a Stalker Portal, and OwnPlayer shows your live channels, a TV guide, movies and shows in one place.

OwnPlayer comes with no channels or content. It plays only the sources you add, and you must have the right to watch them.

LIVE TV AND TV GUIDE
• Add XMLTV guides and see what is on now and next
• Channels find their guide by ID or by name
• Catch-up for past programs when your source supports it
• Program reminders and recordings

MOVIES AND SHOWS
• Browse the movies and shows your Xtream Codes or M3U source lists
• Pick up where you stopped, with Autoplay next episode
• Trailers when your source lists one

MADE FOR WATCHING
• Favorites, groups, search and voice search
• Multiview to watch more than one channel at once
• Picture in picture, audio tracks, video tracks and closed captions
• Backup links per channel that take over when a stream fails
• Open a stream in VLC, Infuse or Outplayer

YOUR DATA STAYS YOURS
• No account, no ads, no tracking
• Logins and your parental PIN stay in the Keychain
• Parental controls with a PIN
• Back up and restore your playlists and settings

Help and setup: https://ownplayer.siptv.link/support/

name: OXU School
seller_name: OSIYO XALQARO UNIVERSITETI, MAS ULIYATI CHEKLANGAN JAMIYATI
description:
OXU School is a free app for the school community of Osiyo Xalqaro Universiteti (Asia International University): teachers, school staff and parents. It brings the daily school routine into one place: attendance, grades, timetable, announcements and payment status.

OXU School is free to download. Sign-in accounts are issued by the school administration to its teachers, staff and parents.

ATTENDANCE
Teachers mark a class in a few taps. Late arrivals and absences are recorded with a reason, and families are notified automatically.

GRADEBOOK
Teachers enter grades, homework results and short comments lesson by lesson. Parents see them as soon as they are published.

TIMETABLE
See the schedule for the day, the week and the exam period. It stays in sync with the school's system and updates the moment a lesson changes.

CLASSROOM CAMERAS
Staff can watch live streams of the classrooms and school areas they are responsible for. This makes supervision and duty shifts easier to cover.

ANNOUNCEMENTS
Get school news and notices as push notifications. Teachers can send announcements to a class or a group of parents, and parents can message teachers directly.

PAYMENT STATUS
Check which tuition, meal and activity invoices are paid, without going to the accounts office.

EVERYDAY DETAILS
- Light and dark appearance that follows your iPhone settings
- Works on iPhone and iPad
- Secure sign-in

name: Pack Out: Truck Packing Puzzle
description:
PACK OUT is a cozy sorting puzzle about loading a pickup for the next trip.

A messy pile of camping and fishing gear sits behind your truck. Tap items off the pile and into matching totes in the bed. Fill a tote with three of a kind and it is packed. Fill the tailgate with the wrong gear and the load spills, so think a few moves ahead.

HOW IT PLAYS
• One tap per item. No timers, no swiping.
• Plan around the NEXT queue and the five spare slots on the tailgate.
• Win a level to see your truck drive to a real place on a map of the USA, from frozen lakes to desert highways.
• Heavy loads are tougher and pay better.
• Boosters help when you are stuck: Slot, Undo, Magnet and Bungee.

THINGS TO DO
• Collect stickers and finish albums.
• Upgrade your garage and keep your convoy rolling.
• Climb the weekly league. The other outfitters in the league are simulated, not real players, and the game says so.
• Try the Long Haul event: win loads in a row for a big chest. The crowd count is simulated too.
• Follow the 28 day Season Pass for extra rewards.
• Open the free daily crate and daily trip bonuses.

FREE TO PLAY
PACK OUT is free to download and play with no account. You can earn coins, boosters and lives by playing. Optional in-app purchases sell coin packs, booster and lives bundles, and a Season Pass. Everything you can buy has fixed contents. Random sticker drops, including those in the Season Pass, have their odds listed in the game before you buy. You can restore the Season Pass and the Starter Pack from Settings > Restore Purchases.

Progress saves on your device and syncs through your own iCloud if you are signed in. Reminders are optional and you choose whether to allow notifications.

Support: spacesuitgames.com/support
Made by Hive Asset Group, LLC (Spacesuit Game Studios).

name: Padri D'Acciaio
description:
Questa è l'app di chi si allena con me nel percorso Padri D'Acciaio.

Dentro c'è il tuo programma. L'ho scritto io, dopo aver parlato con te e aver capito che sport fai e dove ti manca un pezzo.

COSA FAI CON L'APP

Prima di allenarti dici come stai. Cinque domande, un minuto, e il Semaforo ti dà il colore del giorno. Verde: l'allenamento intero. Giallo: la versione breve. Rosso: solo recupero. L'appuntamento resta, cambia il lavoro.

Poi premi Avvia. L'app ti porta un esercizio alla volta. Segni la serie, il recupero parte da solo e il telefono ti avvisa quando è finito, anche a schermo bloccato.

Ogni esercizio ha il suo video. Lo guardi lì, senza uscire dall'allenamento.

I TUOI NUMERI

Trazioni, salto, sprint, mobilità. Ogni prova che fai finisce su una carta, con il livello per la tua età. Aggiungi gli esercizi che vuoi seguire e vedi quando sali. Il confronto è con te stesso di un mese fa.

Il calendario tiene il conto degli allenamenti fatti e delle settimane di fila. Se ti dimentichi di segnarne uno lo aggiungi dopo, toccando il giorno. Capita.

Il programma resta nel telefono. Al parco, dove spesso non prende, ti alleni lo stesso e quello che hai fatto si salva appena torna la linea.

COME SI ENTRA

L'account te lo apro io quando inizi il percorso. Dall'app non ci si registra e non si compra niente.

Padri D'Acciaio è forza a corpo libero per chi ha passato i trenta e lo sport lo fa, o l'ha fatto sul serio. Il tuo sport ti dà i pezzi. Io ti do il telaio.

name: Panda Samurai: Laozi, Analects
description:
Learn with Panda Samurai through everyday questions about relationships, work, learning, mistakes, comparison, rest, and change. Explore selected teachings from Laozi (the Tao Te Ching) and the Analects of Confucius.

100 CONVERSATIONS
Read 50 Laozi and 50 Confucius topics. Panda Samurai asks curious questions, and each teacher responds in approachable conversations. Every topic includes two deeper follow-up exchanges exploring context, interpretation, and the care needed when applying an ancient idea today.

ENGLISH AND JAPANESE
Switch the interface, all conversations, deeper explanations, practical examples, and reflection questions between English and Japanese. Read 100 selected classical passages in learning translations, with a side-by-side reading option. These are excerpts, not the complete books.

BEGIN WITH WHAT MATTERS TO YOU
Optional interests and profile choices suggest 13 starting topics. Browse all 100 topics or use keywords to find a prepared conversation.

READ AT YOUR OWN PACE
Bookmark passages, add personal notes, and continue from your reading position. Adjust reading text size, background music, button sounds, and animations.

Free to use, with no ads, in-app purchases, or account registration. Text, conversations, and music are included for offline use. Bookmarks, notes, and preferences stay on your device. Opening an external source website requires an internet connection.

This is prepared educational content, not a live generative-AI chat service. Keyword input finds relevant conversations; it does not generate new answers.

Conversations are fictional learning interpretations, not records of historical speech. Translations and explanations were prepared for this app with AI assistance and have not been professionally reviewed. They provide an introduction to further reading, while distinguishing historical context from present-day applications.

name: PaneMath
description:
PaneMath turns a stack of glass pieces into the numbers a stained glass panel actually consumes: area per colour, copper foil length, solder weight, came length, finished weight and a price you can defend. Everything runs on your device, with no account and no network.
PIECES BY COLOUR
- Rectangles, right triangles, circles, half circles, quarter circles and trapezoids
- Area and perimeter per piece, plus a running total by colour
- Batch entry: add the same piece as many times as you cut it
- Scaling from a paper pattern to the finished size, with area following the square
- Piece numbering you can reorder, and a cut list you can read off the bench
FOIL, SOLDER AND CAME
- Copper foil length from every perimeter, plus the overlap you actually use
- Solder weight from the bead section and the alloy density, not a guess
- Solder wire length for the spool you have on the shelf
- Lead came length with shared seams counted once, and sticks rounded up
- Flux, zinc frame and reinforcement bar quantities in the same list
- A step checklist for wrapping, soldering, flipping and framing
MATERIALS AND MONEY
- Glass library with colour, type, transmission and price per square metre
- Sheet count from your own sheet size, with a cutting waste allowance
- Cost of glass, metal, frame and labour, then a quote at your markup
- Panel weight from thickness and density, so you know what the wall has to hold
- Weighted light transmission for the whole panel
- Purchase list across every open panel
WHAT IT DOES NOT DO
- No account, no sign in, no cloud sync — your data stays on this device
- No ads, no tracking, no analytics, no third-party SDKs, no network requests
- No subscriptions or purchases: every feature is free, all of it offline
A LOG THAT STAYS USEFUL
- Projects move through design, cutting, soldering and framing
- Notes, dates and a short summary per panel
- Duplicate a panel to start the next one from the same palette
- Export a cut list or a purchase list as plain text or CSV
Panel weight and sheet counts are estimates. Measure your own glass, and check hangers and frames against the hardware maker's figures before you hang anything. PaneMath is an independent tool and is not affiliated with any glass, tool or came manufacturer.

name: PANYNOVA
description:
Moving a desk, replacing a TV, or unplugging a home theater setup? PANYNOVA helps you record where each cable goes before you disconnect it.

Take or import photos of your devices, mark the ports, and pair both ends of each cable. When it’s time to reconnect, use the wiring map and endpoint photos to find the right ports. Track what’s connected, what’s been tested, and what still needs attention.
- Mark multiple ports on one photo and pair them into numbered cables.
- Check for missing photos or unpaired ends before unplugging.
- Print matching A/B labels for both ends of a cable.
- Save wiring versions and compare changes when equipment moves.
- Keep a history of reconnect sessions and test results.
- Share a PDF wiring guide or export a project backup with photos and history.
Start with the built-in TV Cabinet sample, or create a project for your own setup.

name: Paper Plane: Nine Skies
description:
Fold it. Throw it. Keep it in the air.

Paper Plane: Nine Skies is a pixel-art flying game with one-finger controls. Hold to climb, release to dive, and slip through the gaps. The longer you stay up, the faster it gets. After three minutes, every second is a small miracle.

HOW IT PLAYS
• One finger: hold anywhere to pull the nose up, let go to dive.
• Thread the gaps between pillars and grab the stars on the way.
• Every 30 seconds the pace picks up. A meter at the top shows how hot it is getting.
• Touch anything and your plane crumples. Tap retry and you are flying again in a second.

9 WORLDS, 9 SURPRISES
Each world has its own scenery, its own music and one obstacle you will not find anywhere else:
• Classroom: pencils that take aim and shoot across the room
• Windy Meadow: windmills with spinning blades
• Neon City: swinging wrecking balls
• Dust Canyon: dust devils that throw you skyward
• Seagull Bay: water spouts that rise and fall
• Frost Cavern: icicles that shake loose as you pass
• Ember Peak: lava bombs leaping from below
• Gear Works: crushing pistons on the move
• Star Station: laser gates that keep switching sides

CHASE YOUR BEST
Distance and stars add up to your score. Every world keeps its own best, so there is always one more record to beat.

MADE FOR TOUCH
• Plays in portrait or landscape, on iPhone and iPad
• Quick runs, perfect for a short break
• An original chiptune for every world
• Works offline

FAIR AND SIMPLE
• The first 3 worlds are free
• One single purchase unlocks all remaining worlds, forever
• No ads. No subscriptions. No data collected.

How long can you fly?

name: Paper Star: Andersen Tales
description:
Fling a paper star and break the spell, one Andersen tale at a time.

Paper Star is a ricochet puzzle set in a cut-paper theatre. Drag to aim, let go, and watch your star bounce off the walls and through paper shapes drifting down toward the line. Five elements, one simple rule: each element beats the next. Fire melts Metal, Metal cuts Wood, Wood splits Earth, Earth dams Water, Water quenches Fire. Load the right card and a single shot can clear half the stage.

TWELVE TALES, TWELVE BOSSES
Every tale by Hans Christian Andersen ends with its own paper boss and its own trick: the Mole tunnelling under the meadow, the Goblin popping out of his box, the Sea Witch, the Troll King, the Clockwork Nightingale, the Mother of the Winds, the Flying Trunk, the Marsh King, Ole Lukoje the sandman and, at the very end, the Snow Queen.

GILDED CARDS
Win a tale and a storybook card turns over in your hands. Clear it without losing a heart and it turns gold. Collect all twelve, three book cards and the finale: a swan among the stars. Tilt your iPhone to watch the foil shine, then save or share your card.

A REAL PIANO SCORE
Our own piano arrangements of Mozart, Beethoven, Brahms, Grieg, Satie and Bach, played on a sampled Steinway grand: the Troll storms in to the Hall of the Mountain King, the Snow Queen arrives with Carol of the Bells. Book III and every December bring Silent Night, O Christmas Tree and Jingle Bells.

FAIR TO PLAY
- Book I (four tales, four bosses, five cards) is free.
- One purchase opens Books II and III. No ads, no subscription, no timers.
- Works offline. No account, no data collected.
- Family Sharing: buy once for the whole family.

name: PaperView Creator
description:
PaperView is the easiest way to get paid for the content you already make. Brands post campaigns with a clear brief and a bounty pool. You pick the ones that fit you, post on your own TikTok, Instagram or YouTube, and earn for the views your post brings in.

No pitching. No chasing brands in your DMs.

HOW IT WORKS

1. Browse campaigns
See open campaigns from brands, with the rate, time left and how much of the bounty pool is left, all up front.

2. Read the brief
Every campaign tells you exactly what the brand wants: talking points, the do's and the don'ts. No guessing.

3. Join and post
Join in one tap, make your post on your own account, then share your post link with us. Some campaigns also give you a tracked link for your caption or bio, so you earn on clicks too.

4. AI checks it, the brand approves
Our AI checks your post against the brief, then the brand signs it off. Fair for creators, safe for brands.

5. Earn as your views grow
Get paid per 1,000 views or per click until the bounty runs out. Some campaigns pay a bonus when your post hits its view target.

6. Cash out
Watch your wallet grow and cash out to your South African bank account.

WHY CREATORS USE PAPERVIEW

- Real briefs from real brands, with rates in rand
- Post where your audience already is: TikTok, Instagram and YouTube
- Clear status on every post: pending, verified, needs changes or paid
- A wallet that shows what's available, what's pending and what you've earned in total
- Notifications when your post is verified, when you earn and when your cash out is on its way

Small creator or growing fast, if you make content, PaperView pays you for it.

Questions? Visit paperview.co.za

name: Parcel Office Simulator
description:
You're behind the counter of a small parcel office in Kadıköy, İstanbul. Every day new people walk in with new parcels. One is sending a mug to her mother; another has sewn a fresh seam into a teddy bear's back.

Inspect each parcel: turn it, shake it, weigh it, open it if you must. Does the declaration match what's inside? A hidden battery, a leak, a fake label? Accept, refuse, add a damage note, or seize it and call the police. Then wrap it, fill the box, tape it, stick the label on and count out the change.

But Branch 017 isn't just about parcels. A businessman whose card says only "K.", a mother sending homemade sucuk to her son in the army, a retiree chasing a lost parcel, a woman hiding her line of work from her daughter… Your choices decide the fate of the neighborhood and the branch.

• A 30-day story with 8 different endings
• 570+ items, each with its own secrets
• 30+ customer types, and contradictions to uncover by asking questions
• UV lamp, X-ray, metal detector, test kit and box cutter
• Sale days, power cuts, rain, the holiday rush, a livestream, a raid
• Machines, shop upgrades, an apprentice and a cat asleep on the counter
• Endless mode once the story is over

The first week is free. Day 8 onward, all the endings and endless mode unlock with a one-time purchase. No ads, no subscription.

name: Party Games: Friends & Couples
description:
Game night, sorted. No sign-up, no accounts, no waiting: pick a party game and start playing with friends, your partner or the whole family.

Bluff Trivia
Everyone gets the same bizarre trivia question. What's a "gongoozler"? What shape is wombat poop? Secretly write a fake answer that sounds real, then try to spot the true one among everyone's bluffs. Score for finding the truth, and score even more for every friend you fool.
• 200+ weird-but-true facts and strange words
• "About Us" rounds with questions about the people in the room
• Double points in the final round

How Well Do You Know Me?
The couples quiz and best-friend test in one. One player takes the hot seat and answers questions about themselves; everyone else guesses. See your compatibility score at the end, or find out who really is the best friend.
• Couples pack for date night, Friends pack for the group
• Quick-pick and open questions (the hot seat judges how close you got)

Play your way
• Online: everyone on their own phone, join a room with a 4-letter code
• Pass & play: one phone, no internet needed
• 2 to 12 players

Safe and private
• No account, no email, no tracking
• Family-friendly filter, plus hide or report any player
• Hosts can remove players

Perfect for parties, sleepovers, family game night, date night, birthdays and holidays. Multiplayer fun for groups big and small, online or offline.

Coming soon: Truth or Dare, Never Have I Ever, Find the Spy, charades and more.

name: Pass the Dumplings
description:
Feed every guest before the plates pass them by.

Pass the Dumplings is a single-player puzzle game about setting a shared dinner table. Place dumplings, fish and buns on a glass turntable, then watch each beat unfold. Guests arrive at different times, wait only so long and take the first dish they like. A plate meant for one person may disappear before it reaches another.

Plan before you serve. Tap a guest to inspect the table, drag the timeline to preview a beat and adjust your arrangement. Later chapters add family rules: Grandma eats first, and Uncle Bo gives the turntable an extra push.

- 24 puzzles across four chapters
- A preview timeline for checking your plan
- Up to three hints each time you load a puzzle
- Replays and local best scores to improve your table
- Vibration controls and an in-game guide

Complete puzzles to unlock the next table. Progress and best scores stay on your device; unfinished attempts are not restored between launches.

Gameplay works offline, with no accounts, ads or in-app purchases. Reading the privacy policy online requires an internet connection. The interface is in English and is designed for portrait play on iPhone.

name: Password: Guess Game Show
description:
Password is the fast party game of one-word clues. One phone, two players or more, and 60 seconds on the clock.

Hold the phone to your forehead with the screen facing your partner. You hear the first letter of the word. Your partner can give you just one word at a time to get you there. Got it? Tilt the phone down. Stuck? Tilt it up to pass. Then swap roles and see who does better.

HOW A ROUND GOES
• A spoken 3, 2, 1, then the first letter of each word is read out to you
• Your partner gives clues, one word at a time
• Tilt down when you get it, tilt up to pass
• A ticking clock that speeds up as time runs out

TWO WAYS TO PLAY
• 10 Words: clear a set of ten before the clock runs out. Passed words come back around until you get them.
• Endless: as many words as you can before time is up. A passed word is gone.

MADE FOR GAME NIGHT
• Rounds of 60, 90 or 120 seconds
• Two players is enough, and a bigger group can take turns
• No account and no ads
• No internet needed to play

A NEW LIST EVERY DAY
Play free with a new list of 30 words each day, for as many rounds as you like. Want more? Unlock every word for 24 hours or forever with a one-off purchase. No subscription.

Privacy Policy: https://www.abbeyroadventures.com/password/privacy
Terms of Use: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/

name: Patent Strzelecki: PZSS & WPA
description:
Prepare for the theory part of the Polish PZSS shooting patent and WPA examination. Practise 10- and 20-question sessions or use the full verified question bank. Questions and answer choices are shuffled on every draw.

Polish remains the primary language. Supporting English, Italian, Spanish, German, Ukrainian and Russian translations help you understand the questions. Study explanations and sources, review mistakes and track results stored on your device.

Online tests are free with advertising. Closing an ad or an ad failing to load does not block an online test. An optional one-time Pro purchase removes ads and enables offline tests. No subscription; the store displays the price. Restore purchases using the same store account.

An independent educational tool by Premium ADV, unaffiliated with PZSS or the Police. No guarantee of examination success. Check current official rules before your examination.

name: Pattern Sprint
description:
A little logic. A fresh perspective.

Pattern Sprint is a collection of logic puzzles for adults, made for a quiet break or a longer challenge.

ONE FULL SPRINT
Explore 30 questions across pattern matrices, number sequences and spatial rotations. Allow about 20 minutes. There is no time limit, speed does not affect your score, and you can pause and resume or change answers before finishing.

THREE EACH DAY
Come back for three free daily puzzles and keep a local daily streak.

A GAME SCORE, FOR FUN
Your Fun IQ score is for entertainment only. It does not represent or measure your intelligence. Results must not be used for hiring or admission. This app does not provide a diagnosis. Different papers are not calibrated to each other; score trends are also for entertainment.

GENERATED ON YOUR PHONE
All questions are generated by the program. Each candidate is checked for exactly one correct option under the app's puzzle rules; candidates that fail validation are discarded and regenerated. No existing test questions are used. Questions can recur over time.

PRIVATE AND SIMPLE
No account, ads, analytics or developer server. Answers, saved progress and results are stored on your phone. Delete them in Settings. Sharing is your choice; a score card is made locally before you choose where to share it. Apple handles purchases.

FREE TO START
Your first full sprint, its score, category results, share card and three daily puzzles are free.

SPRINT UNLOCK
One non-consumable purchase unlocks unlimited new full sprints, rule-based explanations for every question and score trends. No subscription. The US price is US$1.99; the App Store shows your local price. Restore purchases in Settings using the Apple Account used to buy.

Available in English, Simplified Chinese, Japanese and Korean. iPhone, iOS 17 or later.

name: PAWS Pedometer
description:
PAWS is a simple pedometer that counts your steps automatically, with a little pug who cheers you on along the way.

COUNTS EVERY STEP, AUTOMATICALLY
PAWS uses your iPhone's built-in motion sensor, so there's nothing to start or stop and it barely touches your battery. Connect Apple Health and your iPhone and Apple Watch steps line up, with no double counting. Your totals never go backwards, and you can always see where today's number came from and when it last updated.

WATCH YOUR STEPS ADD UP
Day, week, month and year charts. A goal calendar. Your best day, best week, longest streak and lifetime distance. Tap any day to see it hour by hour.

GOALS THAT FIT YOUR LIFE
Pick a daily goal, set a different one for weekends, and aim for a number of goal days each week. Hit your goal 7 days in a row to earn a Rest Paw, so one missed day won't break your streak.

WALK YOUR REAL DOG
Start a walk with one tap. Tag which dogs came along, pick a face for each one, and turn the route map on or off. Your phone buzzes at every mile or kilometer, and the walk keeps recording when you put PAWS away. Follow along on the Lock Screen and in the Dynamic Island.

EARN BADGES ON THE TRAIL
22 badges for streaks, big days, early walks and lifetime milestones, plus a journey from Neighborhood Loop all the way to the Summit. Unlock new scenes and gear for your pug as you go.

WIDGETS EVERYWHERE
Home Screen widgets with your pug, plus six Lock Screen widgets: step count, goal ring, goal percent, streak, last 7 days, and steps, distance and floors together. Start a walk from Control Center or ask Siri how many steps you've taken.

APPLE WATCH
See your steps on your wrist, add PAWS to your watch face, and record walks with heart rate.

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
No account, no ads, no trackers. Your activity stays on your iPhone. Export your history as a CSV anytime.

Wheelchair users can switch PAWS to count pushes.

name: Paykar Ilm
description:
Paykar ILM — учебный портал для сотрудников сети магазинов Пайкар.

Приложение помогает новым и опытным сотрудникам быстро освоить работу и следить за своим обучением. Курсы подбираются по должности: кассир, упаковщик, продавец-консультант, администратор торгового зала и другие.

Что есть в приложении:
• Мои курсы — обучение по вашей должности с уроками, памятками и тестами
• Видеоуроки — короткие ролики о стандартах обслуживания покупателей
• Адаптация — пошаговая программа для новых сотрудников
• Тесты и экзамены — проверка знаний сразу после урока
• Сертификаты — подтверждение пройденных курсов
• База знаний — правила и инструкции всегда под рукой
• Новости и уведомления — новые курсы и важные объявления компании
• Достижения — баллы и награды за обучение

Приложение работает на русском и таджикском языках.

Вход только для сотрудников Пайкар: по номеру телефона и коду из SMS. Номер должен быть заранее зарегистрирован в системе обучения компании.

name: PeakRent
description: One summit doesn't need a closet of gear. Rent shells, crampons, packs and bags per trip — ready before you go, collected when you're back.

name: PEEKAPOW: Sniper Duel
description:
A real-time 1v1 sniper duel to play with friends!

PEEKAPOW is a real-time 1v1 sniper game played with cute animal characters.

Hide behind cover to dodge your opponent's shots, then take aim through the scope when it's your turn to shoot. You take turns shooting and dodging.

[Real-Time Duels with Friends]
Send a friend an invite link or a room code to play together. You can start right away, with no sign-up or login.

If you want to play on your own, use Quick Match to start a game right away.

[Hide, Aim, Shoot]
On your turn to shoot, you can fire up to three shots within the time limit. You swap sides as soon as a shot hits, when all three shots are used, or when time runs out. Predict your opponent's movement and aim carefully.

On your turn to dodge, use cover such as walls and barrels to avoid your opponent's shots. Cover can be destroyed when it is hit.

[A Random Animal Every Match]
Pandas, rabbits, giraffes, pigs, and other animal characters appear. Your character is chosen at random every match.

[Short, Fast Duels]
A match takes about 2 to 3 minutes. Play a quick round on the city rooftop or the beach.

Play with a friend, or take on a new opponent.

Questions and bug reports: support@peekapow.com

name: Perch: Airport Lounges
description:
Your lounge plans, in one place.

Perch helps you find airport lounges, save places for your next trip and keep track of your memberships and visits.

FIND A LOUNGE
Search by airport, city, lounge name or network. Explore published terminal information, opening hours, amenities, photos and entry conditions where available. Use optional location access to find nearby airports, or search wherever you are going.

KEEP YOUR PLANS HANDY
Save lounges for later. Bundled and previously saved listings remain available offline. Coverage varies by network, and some listings are updated online while others are published snapshots.

ORGANIZE YOUR WALLET
Add manual memberships with finite or unlimited allowances and your own renewal dates. Log visits and guest usage, correct a record, and renew an ended allowance period while keeping its history.

CONNECT SUPPORTED MEMBERSHIPS
Optionally connect a Canadian Visa Airport Companion account to view linked cards, reported complimentary visits, existing bookings and fresh entry codes. Connect Priority Pass through its official sign-in page to sync a digital membership card and reported benefits. The last synced Priority Pass card is available offline. Provider account access and internet connectivity are required for connected features; benefits vary by membership.

CHECK PREBOOKING
Open supported Visa Airport Companion or Priority Pass lounge pages to check prebooking with the provider. Availability, fees, payment and confirmation are handled by the provider. Priority Pass reservations remain with the provider.

YOU CONTROL YOUR RECORDS
No Perch account is required. Manual memberships, saved lounges and visit history stay on your device. Provider connections are optional and can be disconnected. Local activity and imported pass copies can be removed from Help & privacy.

Perch is an independent app. A directory listing or matching network does not guarantee admission, available space or complimentary entry. Check your issuer’s and lounge’s current conditions, guest rules and travel-document requirements. Local visit logs do not change provider balances. Visa account integration currently supports accounts issued in Canada; other supported regions link to the official provider app.

name: PhotoPlay Booth Studio
description:
Create a welcoming photobooth for birthdays, weddings, parties and corporate events. PhotoPlay Booth Studio brings event setup, guest capture, print layouts and saved memories together on your iPad.

MAKE EVERY EVENT YOURS
Create and copy events, customize welcome text and buttons, and use your own artwork. Preview your setup and rehearse before opening the booth to guests.

CAPTURE THE MOMENT
Guide guests through a countdown, photo review and retakes. Choose the effects, backgrounds, filters and optional sticker step offered at each event.

DESIGN THEIR KEEPSAKES
Arrange photos beneath your uploaded overlays. Prepare portrait or landscape 4R layouts and photo strips, then let guests choose from the formats enabled for your event.

PRINT OR KEEP IT DIGITAL
Start with Digital Only, connect a compatible AirPrint printer, or use the PhotoPlay Windows Print Bridge with a Windows-connected printer. Set copy limits and adjust the print setup for your event. Printer compatibility, paper sizes and cutting depend on your hardware and driver.

RELIVE THE SESSION
Create a Session Story video from the photo session. Offer AirDrop through the system share sheet, save finished memories to Photos, and find past sessions for reprinting or sharing. Export event photos and videos to Photos or Files.

BUILT FOR THE OPERATOR
Protect settings with a private operator PIN. Manage event history, select sessions for deletion and choose how long booth media stays on the iPad. Work in portrait or landscape.

STUDIO MONTHLY
Download free to prepare events and run clearly marked rehearsals. New guest sessions require Studio Monthly, an auto-renewing subscription at US$9.99/month (or Apple’s localized equivalent). Optional original theme packs are separate one-time purchases at US$9.99 each (or localized equivalent). New guest sessions with any theme require an active subscription.

Restore purchases using the same Apple Account. If your subscription expires, saved event media and purchased theme ownership remain; you can still access, export, share and reprint saved results.

The subscription renews automatically unless cancelled at least 24 hours before the period ends. Payment is charged to your Apple Account. Manage or cancel through Apple’s subscription settings.

Privacy: https://www.kiamcotech.com/photoplay/privacy/
Terms: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/

Classic capture and installed event artwork work offline during the Apple-verified subscription period. Internet is required for purchases, downloads, restores and renewal checks. Printing, AirDrop and other system sharing features depend on compatible equipment and local connectivity. A printer is optional. Camera access is needed for taking photos; saving to Photos and connecting to a local print bridge request their relevant permissions.

name: PhotoViewer
description:
PhotoViewer 是一款專為商業攝影師、戶外街拍與攝影愛好者打造的專業級相片檢視、挑選與批次調色工具。告別繁瑣的選相流程，在 iPhone 與 iPad 上享受極速流暢的現場挑片與交付體驗。

【核心功能特點】

一、專業星級與色彩標籤
- 1 至 5 星快速打分，重要作品一目了然
- 紅、黃、綠、藍、紫五色分類標籤，高效分組管理

二、極速全螢幕瀏覽與對焦檢視
- 左右順滑翻頁，高抗壓流暢加載
- 支援雙指 100% 像素級放大檢視細節與對焦點

三、專業暗房調色與裁切
- 支援自由比例與常用構圖裁切（1:1、3:4、16:9、9:16、原圖比例）
- 專業影調調整：曝光度、對比度、高光、陰影、飽和度、色溫與色調
- 批次調色功能：一鍵將精心調校的參數複製套用至多張相片

四、支援外接 SD 讀卡機
- 現場即插即看，透過 Type-C 或讀卡機直接讀取記憶卡相片
- 告別漫長導相等待，現場大螢幕即時挑選

五、隔空傳送與極速交付
- 支援多選批次 AirDrop 隔空傳送無損原圖
- 支援原圖安全保存與即時刪除管理

六、100% 本地處理與隱私保障
- 所有相片處理與調色純本機運行，絕不上傳任何第三方伺服器，全力守護你的原創版權與顧客隱私。

name: PianoBuddy: Learn Piano
description:
Learn piano at your level, on your own piano.

PianoBuddy listens while you play your real piano or keyboard. No cable and no MIDI needed: put your iPhone or iPad on the music stand and start playing. Your coach is Pim, a cheerful little blue tit. Pim hears every note and helps you get better, one piece at a time.

THE APP LISTENS TO YOU
- The microphone hears which notes you play, in real time
- Works with an acoustic piano, a digital piano or a keyboard
- Nothing is recorded or sent anywhere

PIM HELPS YOU IMPROVE
Play a wrong note and Pim tells you right away, short and friendly: "Almost! You played D, it should be E. One key to the right." When you finish, Pim gives you a tip for each bar, with a "Practise this bar" button.

THREE WAYS TO PLAY
- Learn notes: one bar at a time. The keyboard on screen only helps after you ask for a hint, so you really learn to read.
- Play together: play the whole piece at your own pace. Pim helps at every mistake.
- Perform: play it through like a recital, watch your live accuracy line and earn up to 3 stars.

PLAY REAL PIECES
No dull drills: you choose a piece and learn it by playing it. Easy arrangements of famous classics and well-loved songs, plus pieces written just for PianoBuddy:
- Ode to Joy, Twinkle Twinkle Little Star, Jingle Bells, Frère Jacques, Au clair de la lune, When the Saints Go Marching In, London Bridge
- Largo from the New World (Dvořák), Canon in D (Pachelbel), Minuet in G (Petzold), Eine kleine Nachtmusik (Mozart), Greensleeves, Prelude in C (Bach), Für Elise (Beethoven)
- Originals like Pim's Waltz, Morning Flight, Raindrops, Evening Light and Starlit Sky

LEARN TO READ SHEET MUSIC
The pieces are spread over levels 1 to 8, in the order piano teachers use. A few minutes a day add up: the goal is that after a year you read sheet music fluently and play beautiful pieces.

A PLAN MADE FOR YOU
- Tell Pim your goal, your experience and how much time you have: 5, 10 or 20 minutes a day
- A short level test finds the right place to start
- For complete beginners and for anyone who had lessons long ago

KEEP IT UP EVERY DAY
- Earn stars for every piece
- Build your daily streak
- Get a friendly reminder every day, at a time you choose

GOOD TO KNOW
- Works on iPhone and iPad
- No account needed
- Note names as you know them: C, D, E

SUBSCRIPTION
PianoBuddy is a paid app. After the short onboarding, choose an option to unlock all pieces and modes:
- Yearly: €99.99 per year, starts with a 7-day free trial
- Monthly: €19.99 per month
- Lifetime: €199.99, pay once
Prices are shown in euros. The app shows the price for your country before you buy.

Payment is charged to your Apple Account when you confirm the purchase, or when the free trial ends. Subscriptions renew automatically unless you cancel at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. Your account is charged for the renewal within 24 hours before the current period ends. You can manage and cancel your subscriptions in your App Store account settings. Any unused part of a free trial is lost when you buy a subscription.

Terms of Use: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/
Privacy: https://pianobuddy.app/privacy

name: PickPay
description:
PickPay 是一款專為戶外街拍攝影師、活動攝影與獨立攝影師量身打造的即時商業交付系統。告別繁瑣的後製與加好友傳圖流程，現場即拍、即選、即收、即交！

【核心功能亮點】
• 讀卡器即時讀取：直接連接相機讀卡器讀取 SD 卡相片，支援一鍵同時保存至 iPhone 相簿。
• 多人獨立購物車：支援新增「客人 1」、「客人 2」等獨立分組，多人同時選相、各自結算，互不干擾。
• 自由自訂雙收款碼：支援上載兩個自訂收款二維碼（微信支付、支付寶、轉數快等），名稱自由更改，支援雙指放大縮小方便掃描。
• 攝影師安全密碼防護：顧客付款後由攝影師輸入 4 位專屬安全密碼確認解鎖，打星星隱私保護，徹底杜絕未付款偷相。
• 100% 高清原圖 AirDrop：一鍵隔空傳送無損原圖到顧客 iPhone，保留原始 EXIF 與相機原檔畫質。
• 獨創安卓免裝 App 掃碼取相：現場建立高速傳輸通道，非蘋果手機顧客（Android / 華為 / 小米 / 三星等）只需用相機或瀏覽器掃碼，即可免裝任何 App 極速下載原圖。
• 歷史交易紀錄：自動記錄每筆交易客人名稱、時間、金額與相片，隨時可一鍵重新補傳。

name: PigWeight: Pig Weight Tracker
description:
PigWeight helps you estimate how much a pig weighs using a soft tape measure. Measure heart girth and body length, type the two numbers, and see the weight right away. No scale needed.

It was made for people who raise a few pigs or a whole pen, and who want a quick weight for feeding, selling or planning.

Calculate weight
- Enter heart girth and body length to get an estimated live weight
- A likely range is shown with every result, so you can see how sure the number is
- Quick mode needs only heart girth, with a wider range
- Works in kilograms or pounds, and centimeters or inches
- Share a result as plain text

Keep track of your pigs
- Save a weight to a pig, or weigh a whole batch at once
- Add many pigs together with a starting tag number
- See a weight history chart and average daily gain for each pig
- Set a target weight and follow progress toward it
- Add a photo to each pig
- Group pigs into batches and see the batch average

Farm tools
- Feed calculator: how much feed to reach a target weight
- Gestation and farrowing date: find the expected farrowing date from the breeding date
- Live-weight value: weight times your price per kg, for one pig or a group
- How to measure: step-by-step guide with pictures

Learn
- Short articles on daily care, feeding, health, growth, breeding and preparing for sale
- Articles are available in English and Filipino

Built for the pen, not the office
- Works offline. No account and no sign-in
- Your pigs and weights stay on your iPhone
- Back up to a file you can keep in iCloud Drive or send to yourself, and restore it on a new phone
- Export your records as CSV
- Available in English, Filipino, Cebuano, Hindi, Bengali and Nepali

Free with ads
The app is free and shows ads. A one-time Remove ads purchase hides them, and you can restore it on a new phone. There is no subscription.

How accurate is it?
With both measurements, estimates are typically within about 5% of the real weight. Quick mode (girth only) has a wider range. Results depend on how carefully you measure, and on the pig's build and posture.
