The formula is heart girth x heart girth x body length / 400, with measurements in inches and the result in pounds, the same as on pigweightcalculator.com.

Important
This app gives estimates. It is not a substitute for a scale, so do not use it to settle a sale to the last kilogram. It does not give veterinary advice. If a pig looks sick, call a veterinarian.

Questions or problems? Use Contact in the More tab, or visit pigweightcalculator.com.

name: Pin2Fret Unio
description:
Qui toca la guitarra, l'ukelele o el baix coneix aquell moment just abans d'assajar: una corda que sona lleugerament desafinada, un metrònom oblidat en algun calaix, el dubte sobre com es fa un acord que apareix a la partitura. Normalment tot això es resol amb tres aplicacions diferents, o amb cap, i part de l'atenció es perd pel camí. Pin2Fret Unio reuneix aquests recursos en un sol lloc perquè puguis començar a practicar sense canviar de pantalla cada dos minuts.

L'afinador és el punt de partida de moltes sessions. Escolta el micròfon del dispositiu i et mostra quina nota sona i quant s'allunya de la nota objectiu, perquè puguis ajustar cada corda sense haver d'endevinar-ho d'oïda. Per fer-lo funcionar cal permetre l'accés al micròfon. La pantalla corresponent t'explica per què l'aplicació el necessita i com activar-lo des de la configuració del sistema si en el seu moment el vas denegar.

Les afinacions no sempre són les estàndard. Des del selector d'afinacions pots triar la que correspon al teu instrument o a la peça que toques, i amb l'editor d'afinacions en pots crear o modificar de pròpies, definint la nota de cada corda. Aquesta flexibilitat serveix tant per a una guitarra afinada un to més avall com per a un ukelele o un baix amb una disposició de cordes poc habitual. La pantalla de to de referència, per la seva banda, et permet fixar la nota de partida amb què s'afina el conjunt, molt útil quan toques amb altres músics.

El metrònom té la seva pròpia pantalla, on ajustes el tempo i el compàs amb el control que prefereixis. Si repeteixes sovint els mateixos exercicis, els preajustos guarden aquests valors perquè els recuperis amb un sol toc. Un tempo per a l'escala de la setmana, un altre per a la peça que prepares per al concert: no cal recordar-los, només triar-los.

Quan vols sentir una progressió repetida sense aturar-te, entren en joc el seqüenciador i els bucles. El seqüenciador et permet construir patrons i reproduir-los en cicle, i la llista de bucles reuneix els que has creat o desat. El reproductor els fa sonar en bucle, i la pantalla d'informació de cada bucle en mostra els detalls perquè puguis decidir quin material t'interessa abans de posar-lo en marxa.

Els acords són on molts músics perden més temps. La pantalla d'acords ofereix la llista de formes disponibles i, en obrir-ne qualsevol, el detall et mostra com col·locar els dits sobre el mànec i tot el que necessites per tocar-lo. Si la cançó està en una tonalitat incòmoda, el cercador de capo t'indica a quin trast posar-lo perquè els acords que ja domines continuïn servint, sense haver de fer cap càlcul.

La pràctica és el que dona sentit a tota la resta. La pantalla de pràctica organitza el temps de treball, i la sessió en curs en mostra el progrés mentre dura. En acabar, pots anotar què has treballat i com t'ha anat. Les llistes de treball, amb el seu detall, agrupen els exercicis, les peces o els passatges que vols repassar, i amb el temps tot plegat esdevé un historial al qual sempre pots tornar.

Per vincular aquest material al teu perfil necessites un compte. Pots crear-ne un des de la pantalla de registre o iniciar sessió si ja en tens, i des del perfil pots revisar les teves dades. La pantalla d'ajustos et permet configurar el comportament de l'aplicació, i l'apartat Quant a l'aplicació recull la informació de la versió i les notes del producte.

Pin2Fret Unio no pretén substituir el teu professor ni la teva oïda. Està pensada per a guitarristes, ukelelistes i baixistes que volen tenir a mà, en un mateix lloc, l'afinació, el ritme, els acords i el registre de la pràctica. Quan tot això és a l'abast, l'atenció torna on ha de ser: a la música.

name: Pinglent
description: ਪਿੰਗਲੈਂਟ ਤੁਹਾਨੂੰ ਚੋਣਵੇਂ ਸਮੇਂ ਲਈ ਨੋਟੀਫਿਕੇਸ਼ਨਾਂ ਤੋਂ ਰੁਕ ਕੇ ਧਿਆਨ ਲਗਾਉਣ ਵਿੱਚ ਮਦਦ ਕਰਦਾ ਹੈ। ਤੁਸੀਂ ਸ਼ਾਂਤ ਸਮਾਂ ਤਿਉਂਤਦੇ ਹੋ, ਖਿੱਚ ਨੂੰ ਲਿਖ ਲੈਂਦੇ ਹੋ ਅਤੇ ਖ਼ਤਮ ਹੋਣ ਤੋਂ ਬਾਅਦ ਲਿਖਦੇ ਹੋ ਕਿ ਇਸ ਨਾਲ ਤੁਹਾਨੂੰ ਕੀ ਮਿਲਿਆ। ਲਗਾਤਾਰੀ, ਟੈਂਪਲੇਟ, ਅੰਕੜੇ ਅਤੇ ਪੂਰਾ ਜਰਨਲ — ਸਭ ਕੁਝ ਤੁਹਾਡੇ ਫ਼ੋਨ ਵਿੱਚ ਨਿੱਜੀ ਰਹਿੰਦਾ ਹੈ।

name: Piprelle
description:
Fully compatible with iPhone Duo models

An  can make room in your tray or send two pips around a ring. In Piprelle, what a card does depends on the puzzle in front of you.

FACET STACK
Collect exposed cards in a seven-slot tray. Three cards clear together when both rank and suit match. Each pick changes what you can reach and how much space you have left. Work through deeper layers as the levels advance.

RIBBON FOLD
Choose the same cut in two rows. The cards from each cut to the end of its row reverse order, then trade places. Put each ribbon back in its assigned suit, with its cards in order from ace upward.

PIP CIRCUIT
Pass pips from card to card around a ring. The suit tells you which way they travel, how far they go, and how many move. Get every station to its target while keeping each card between ace and ten.

Each mode has 12 levels, with no countdown. Hold a card to inspect it, learn the rules in a guided Practice lesson, or replay your latest move to see how the board changed. Free Practice lets you revisit the lesson without affecting your challenge records.

Pick up each mode where you left off, and see your best moves and fastest times in Statistics.

name: Pipskiff Card: Orbit Dealer
description:
Deal a card with a flick. Finish with a beautiful arc.

Flick illustrated playing cards into their matching suit pockets on a midnight table.
Nudge a flight with a sliding touch, bend it with side spin and hold FOCUS for a precise slow-motion approach.

Every rank has a physical weight and its own base score. Glass bumpers create bank shots;
moving pockets reward timing. Keep a clean-catch chain alive, cycle reserve cards with CUT
and choose when to spend a difficult throw with RECALL.

Master twenty-four tables across four constellations, try three faster motion trials and visit a daily selected table.
Earn collection seals and pearl-engraved backs from your actual results.

name: Pitch HLS Player
description:
Pitch HLS Player lets you watch HLS video streams from devices on your own network, right on your iPhone or iPad.

Enter a stream address once and save it with a name. Connect with one tap.

Playback controls

Live playback of HLS streams (.m3u8)
Rewind up to 5 minutes (adjustable up to 15 minutes in Settings)
Hold to rewind continuously
Jump back or forward 10 seconds
Drag the timeline to any point in the rewind window
Slow motion at 1/8×, 1/4× and 1/2×, plus 2× playback
Step frame by frame, forward or backward
Jump back to the live edge with one tap

Saved streams

Save addresses with names and switch between them quickly
A sample stream is included so you can try the app right away

iPad and keyboard

Works in portrait and landscape
Keyboard shortcuts: Space to play or pause, arrow keys to step frames, J and L to jump 10 seconds

Private by design

No accounts, no ads, no tracking
Pitch doesn’t collect or share personal data
Saved addresses stay on your device

Good to know

Pitch connects only to the address you enter. Local network access lets it reach devices on your home or office network.
How far back you can rewind depends on how much video your streaming device keeps.
Slow motion and frame stepping depend on the stream.

name: Pixelate - Photo Mosaic Blur
description:
Before you share a screenshot or photo, hide what should stay private.

Pixelate is a focused photo redaction tool: cover sensitive content fast and clean.

FOUR WAYS TO REDACT
· Brush: draw over anything to pixelate it, adjustable brush size
· Rectangle: drag to cover plates, addresses, tracking numbers
· Face detection: one tap finds and covers every face; tap a face to uncover it
· Smart text redaction (Lifetime): phone numbers, ID numbers, bank cards, emails and QR codes detected and covered automatically

THREE EFFECTS
· Pixelate: classic mosaic, adjustable grain
· Gaussian blur: soft and natural
· Solid color: 9 presets plus any custom color

Plus batch face blur for many photos at once (Lifetime), an ID-document watermark tool (Lifetime), autosaved drafts, an eraser, unlimited undo/redo, pinch zoom for detail work, and hold-to-compare with the original.

OUR PRIVACY PROMISE
· Everything is processed on your device; photos are never uploaded
· No data collection, no ads, no tracking
· Exports at full original resolution, no watermark
· EXIF location data is stripped automatically on export

Core features are free forever. Go Lifetime with a single one-time purchase to unlock the smart features — no subscriptions, no tricks.

name: PixelZodiac: Nonogram Puzzles
description:
PixelZodiac is a nonogram (picture cross) puzzle game. Read the row and column clues, deduce which cells to fill, and reveal pixel-art animals of the zodiac.

What's inside:

- Daily Challenge — a new 10×10 picture cross for everyone, every day; finish it to see how your score compares with today's players worldwide
- Weekly Mega — a big 15×15 puzzle that resets every week
- Zodiac Journey — 12 stages from Rat to Pig, each hiding a larger picture
- Quick Warm-ups — a gallery of bite-sized 5×5 puzzles
- 4 hand-tuned themes with their own colors and music, 30 achievements, and detailed statistics

No account, no ads and no in-app purchases. All puzzles work offline; only the worldwide score comparison uses a connection.

name: Pixora: Cozy Shape Puzzle
description:
Pixora gives players a small, tactile puzzle to settle into whenever there is time for a quiet break.

Drag irregular pieces into a tray, turn them to find a fit, and arrange them without overlapping. Reach the tray's fill target to finish, then return for a better arrangement or keep the result on your shelf.

Explore 72 campaign trays across six chapters and a daily tray generated on your device. Undo a move, reveal a silhouette, or ask for a piece to be fitted when you want a little help.

In the Studio, make a personal tray with a choice of sizes, shapes, fill targets and colors. Choose a photo or take one to build a palette, play your creation, and save a postcard of the result. Favorites, keepsakes and milestones give your finished trays a place to live. Add an optional voice memory of up to 15 seconds to a tray you want to remember.

Progress and personal media stay in local storage. Camera, Photos and microphone access are requested only for the optional creative features that use them. Ordinary puzzles and daily trays work offline; the Privacy Policy, Terms of Use and Support pages need an internet connection.

name: Plainleaf Pro: Markdown Editor
description:
Make room for your words. Plainleaf Pro is a Markdown writing app for iPhone and iPad, with plain-text documents, a formatted preview and flexible export options.

WRITE WITH FOCUS
Choose your font, text size, line spacing and writing width. Use light or dark appearance, keep the current line centered, or focus on a line, sentence or paragraph. Markdown formatting tools, undo and redo help you keep writing.

FIND YOUR WAY
Jump between headings in the document outline, check writing statistics, and find or replace text. Automatic saving keeps edits in your document, while local versions and recovery copies provide additional ways to recover your work.

PREVIEW YOUR DOCUMENT
Switch from source text to a formatted view with tables, task lists, code highlighting, footnotes, math and diagrams. Preview resources are bundled with the app, so local rendering works offline.

KEEP YOUR FILES YOURS
Create local Markdown documents or open compatible files through the system document browser. Edit documents in place and insert images from Files, Photos or the camera. On iPad, open additional document windows. Cloud file access depends on the storage provider you choose.

EXPORT IN THE FORMAT YOU NEED
Share Markdown, HTML, PDF, RTF, DOCX, EPUB or LaTeX. Adjust paper size, margins, orientation and page numbering, or use system printing. Export appearance varies by format and reader; DOCX and RTF equations use readable TeX text.

NO ACCOUNT REQUIRED
Plainleaf Pro has no advertising or analytics. The developer does not receive your documents or usage data. Remote images are disabled by default; enabling them contacts the image hosts. Cloud storage and sharing services handle files under their own policies.

Supports English, Simplified Chinese, Traditional Chinese, Japanese, Korean, French, German, Italian, Spanish, Portuguese, Dutch and Russian. Requires iOS or iPadOS 17.4 or later.

name: Plainleaf: Markdown & Notes
description:
A quiet place for your words. Plainleaf brings Markdown writing, a file library and formatted previews together on iPhone and iPad. Start writing without creating a Plainleaf account.

WRITE AT YOUR OWN PACE
Create Markdown and plain-text documents with automatic saving. Use the formatting keyboard, find and replace, and document outline to shape a draft. Choose your font, text size, line spacing and theme, including a dark Midnight appearance.

KEEP YOUR WORK ORGANIZED
Arrange documents in folders, mark favorites, and search filenames, text and tags. Rename, duplicate or move files as your library grows. Recover deleted documents from Trash. On iPad, keep your library beside your document or hide it for more writing space.

SEE THE FINISHED PAGE
Switch from editing to a formatted preview. Work with headings, lists, tables, footnotes, task lists and mathematical expressions. Follow links between documents and include text from other files in your library.

TAKE YOUR WORDS WITH YOU
Export Markdown, plain text, HTML or PDF, print a document, or use the system share sheet. Open supported documents and link folders through Files. Optional WebDAV connections let you manually synchronize an offline folder with your own compatible server.

CAPTURE AND CONTINUE
Save shared text and webpage links with the share extension. Use the research browser to select web content and bring it into a note. Home Screen widgets provide access to recent documents and favorites. Custom JavaScript actions can help with personal text workflows.

ORDINARY FILES, LOCAL WRITING
Your local library uses ordinary files and works offline. Optional app locking uses Face ID, Touch ID or your device passcode; it protects access inside Plainleaf, while files remain accessible through Files and device backups.

Web browsing, remote content and connected storage require an internet connection. Third-party storage requires your own compatible account or server. No Plainleaf account is required for local writing.

name: Plainproof: Home Inventory
description:
After a fire, a flood or a break-in, an insurer asks for a list of everything you owned, with proof. Plainproof is where you keep that list before you need it.

Go room by room. For each thing, take a photo, note the brand, model and serial number, what you paid and what it would cost to replace, and snap the receipt if you still have it. It takes about a minute an item.

- A report your insurer can use: every item by room with its photo, serial number, purchase details and value, and a total for each room and for the whole home, as a PDF you can send or print
- A spreadsheet of the same details, for an adjuster's own forms
- Rooms you name yourself, with a running total for each
- A list of what still needs a photo, a value or a serial number, so the gaps are easy to close
- Search by name, brand or serial number
- A backup you control: one file with every item and photo, saved wherever you choose and restored on a new iPhone
- Dark mode, and text that follows your iPhone's text size

Nothing leaves your iPhone. There is no account to create and no server: your inventory is stored in the app, and you decide where a report or a backup goes. Keep a backup somewhere other than the phone, since a list that is lost along with the house is no use.

Free for your first 20 items in one place, with every feature. Plainproof Pro removes the limit and adds more places, such as a rental, an office or a storage unit, with one payment. It is not a subscription, and nothing you have added is ever locked: the report and backups keep working when the free version is full.

Values are your own figures. Plainproof does not appraise anything, and insurers differ in what they accept, so ask yours what a claim needs.

name: Player 3Sixty
description:
Player 3Sixty is designed to empower athletes with tools to monitor their health, recovery, and performance. Stay connected with your physiotherapy progress and ensure you're always at your peak.
Key Features:
• Personalized Dashboard: Access all your physio updates in one convenient place.
• Injury Records: View and manage your injury history for better recovery insights.
• Performance Profile: Track your stats, milestones, and achievements effortlessly.
• Smart Calendar: Never miss an appointment with an integrated schedule tracker.
Take control of your performance and recovery journey with Player Physio Tracker.

name: Plimvora
description:
• Save a wall with width, height, roll size, trim, pattern repeat, and paste coverage
• Strip count is the wall width divided by the roll width, rounded up
• The last strip is the width left after the full roll widths
• Drop is the height plus trim, then rounded up to the pattern repeat
• Rolls are the total cut length divided by one roll, rounded up
• Border length is the perimeter in feet, plus a waste percent
• Paste tubs are the wall area divided by the coverage on one tub
• Erase the local file from the manual

name: Plinxir
description:
Drop it. Watch it bounce. Brew something magical.

Plinxir puts you behind the counter of a small alchemy shop. Customers line up with orders, and you fill them by dropping ingredients through a board of pegs into bubbling cauldrons.

TRAIL BREWING:
Each ingredient paints the pegs it touches with its element. Drop a second element along that trail and the two react: Ember and Tide turn into Steam, Bloom and Umbra turn into Venom. Six reactions hide on the board. Learn the trails and you can plan a potion three drops ahead.

RUN YOUR SHOP:
Buy rare ingredients at the market. Grow peppers and ferns in your garden. Send your cat Soot on expeditions to the Cinder Caves and the Tidepools. Spend gold on bigger shelves, extra rune slots and a second familiar.

CRAFT MAGIC RUNES:
Place runes on the board to bend the rules. A Prism splits a ball in two. A Portal sends it to the other side of the board. Bellows add power, and a Magnet pulls balls toward it. You decide where each rune goes.

MEET YOUR CUSTOMERS:
Villagers want simple tonics. Knights lose patience fast. Witches order only reaction brews. Scholars bring mystery orders that teach you a new recipe when you get them right. Nobles pay double for a perfect potion.

CLIMB THE GUILD:
Pay the weekly Guild fee, then brew three elixirs at once under the Examiner's eye. Pass five exams to become Grand Alchemist and brew the legendary Plinxir. After that, Endless mode raises the stakes every week.

FEATURES:
• Physics peg board with 52 pegs and 3 cauldrons
• 21 elixirs and 6 secret element reactions to discover
• 14 ingredients with traits like Heavy, Phase and Rebirth
• 11 runes to place and combine
• 8 daily omens that change the rules of the day
• Garden, market, familiars, workshop and upgrades
• Hand-drawn art and animated characters

name: Plop & Pop
description:
Plop & Pop is the classic four-in-a-row game with a fresh, cheerful look.

Drop your chips and line up four in a row – across, up or diagonally – before your opponent does!

FEATURES
• Play online against opponents and tease them with fun emotes
• Play with a friend – on one phone, or online with a 6-digit room code
• Play against the computer: Easy, Medium or Hard
• Stuck? Get a "best move" hint – 3 free hints every day
• Win coins and unlock new emotes in the shop
• Track your wins, losses and best streak in your profile
• Cute animated chips, sound effects and relaxing music
• Available in English and Thai

Easy to learn, fun to master. Perfect for a quick break or a long battle with friends.

Download Plop & Pop and start dropping!

name: Plorkee Drift
description:
Plorkee Drift is a field instrument for people who balance stones on shores and riverbanks. It does not guess what a rock is called and it is not a game. It takes the stone you are holding, measures it from its own outline, and tells you where it will stand.

Lay the stone on a scale card and photograph it, or choose a photo you already have. Set two pins on the card's ruler so the app knows the scale, then tap around the rim to trace the outline. As you trace, Plorkee Drift smooths the line, finds the centre of mass, and marks every point on the rim where the stone will rest and every point it can be stood on. Each point carries its curvature margin, and each tip comes with a table of how much tolerance it has on six kinds of seat, from a flat slab to a bed of sand, graded Steady, Fine or Hairline. Add the thickness and, if you have weighed it, the mass, and the figures are complete: length, width, Zingg shape class and a short code such as R2·T2 that sums up the stone's points of rest and tip.

Filed stones live in a tray of compartments, each one drawn standing on its steadiest tip with a gold contact mark beneath it. Open a stone to step through its points one by one on a ring dial and watch the silhouette turn to stand on each in turn, read its drift basins and its place on the shape square, add or replace its photograph, edit its name, rock and place found, or retrace it.

The Drift tab answers the question every balancer asks after letting go: where does it end up? Turn the release dial to any angle, tap Let it go, and the stone rolls to the rest point it drains to, with the angle travelled and the fraction of the rim that leads there. Below, every stone in the tray is compared by its widest basin and its steadiest tip.

The Stack bench puts two to four of your traced stones on top of one another. Choose which point faces down, slide each contact sideways and pick the seat, and Plorkee Drift checks contact by contact whether the combined centre of mass stays over its support, with a verdict that reads either how far inside it holds or by how much it is over. Save the builds you like and reload them later.

An atlas covers twelve rocks with their density, hardness and how they wear on a shore, the kit used for tracing, the six seats and the four shape classes and how each tends to balance. Any stone can be saved to your photo library as a stand passport: its silhouette on its best tip with the plumb line, beside the full table of figures.

Everything works offline and stays on your phone. Units switch between millimetres and inches, the scale card length is yours to set, and nothing asks you to sign up.

name: PocketMesh 3D
description:
Build your next game prop wherever inspiration finds you.

PocketMesh 3D is a compact 3D modeling studio for iPhone and iPad. Start with a shape or generate a prop, make it your own, and export a static model for your next project.

GENERATE A STARTING POINT
Explore 26 styles across trees, houses, rocks, crates, barrels, tables, stairs and ramps. Make pines, oaks, palms and bare trees. Build cottages, townhouses, L-shaped houses and towers. Adjust dimensions, floors, windows, roof styles, colors and more, with a live 3D preview.

MAKE IT YOUR OWN
Select objects, vertices, edges and faces. Move, rotate and scale. Extrude and inset faces, add loop cuts, bevel, mirror and arrange parts. Generated props become editable meshes when you add them to your scene.

EXPLORE MATERIALS AND MOTION
Use colors and PBR material presets, including a live water preview. Animate individual objects with keyframes. Try simple physics and touch-triggered behaviors in the Play workspace.

SAVE AND EXPORT
Completed edits save automatically on your device. Undo changes and recover earlier scenes. Export editable projects, static GLB models, OBJ with MTL and scan textures, or a turntable video. Preview your scene on a real surface with AR on supported devices.

BRING IN A SCAN
Open compatible USDZ scans. Live object capture is available only on devices supported by Apple Object Capture with the required LiDAR hardware; it is not available on standard iPhone 16. Capture and reconstruction run on device.

SMALL AND PRIVATE
No account. No ads. No in-app purchases. Procedural geometry is generated on your device, without downloading asset packs. PocketMesh 3D does not upload your models or collect usage analytics.

FORMAT NOTES
GLB and OBJ export static models. Custom water motion, keyframe animation and physics behaviors stay in PocketMesh 3D’s editable project format. OBJ/GLB import, rigging and texture painting are not included. Scanned surfaces support object transforms and animation; polygon editing is for handmade and procedurally generated meshes.

Requires iOS 17 or later. Camera features depend on device support.

name: Pocketvale - Cozy Farm
description:
Pocketvale is a tiny farming world that fits in your pocket. Open it for a minute between other things, plant a few rows and come back later: there is always something growing.

FARM AT YOUR OWN PACE
Plant wheat, corn, sunflowers and many more crops, raise chickens, sheep and cows, and fill your sheds with the harvest. A tap is all it takes, and one swipe plants a whole row. Nothing ever withers, and there is nothing to miss.

BUILD A LITTLE TOWN
Villagers move in, pick up jobs and bring your vale to life. Build workshops that turn crops into goods, upgrade your farmhouse and decorate every corner. Watch the seasons change, the rain roll in and the lamps light up at night.

KEEPS GROWING WHILE YOU'RE AWAY
Close the game and your vale keeps going. When you come back, a short summary shows everything that happened.

EXPLORE AN ENDLESS WORLD
Send your hero past the clouds to discover meadows, forests, deserts, snowy peaks and swamps. Chop trees, mine ore, open treasure chests and follow treasure maps. Further out wait rarer lands, ancient monuments and caves that each hold their own little adventure.

FISHING, MUSIC AND COLLECTIONS
Cast a line in lakes and rivers and reel in fish from common to legendary. Find music discs to play as your background music, play songs on the piano and guitar, and fill your Book with fish, relics, artifacts and trophies.

TRADE WITH THE BOTS
Robot traders pin orders on the board and the market prices go up and down. Deliver at the right moment to earn the most coins.

PLAY TOGETHER
Invite a friend on the same Wi-Fi to visit your vale and farm side by side, on iPhone or Mac.

MADE FOR IPHONE
- Tap to farm, swipe to plant whole rows, pinch to zoom
- Plays in portrait or landscape
- Save slots for several vales, saved automatically
- One purchase for iPhone and Mac
- No ads, no in-app purchases, no accounts

name: PopKind
description:
PopKind makes fundraising simple for schools, teams, clubs and community groups. Sell premium, small-batch popcorn online, and your group keeps 50% of every sale.

FREE TO START
No upfront costs, no inventory and no order forms. Set up your fundraiser in minutes, share your store link, and supporters order online. The popcorn ships straight to their door.

WITH THE POPKIND APP YOU CAN:
• Start a fundraiser and set your goal
• Share your store link and team code with one tap
• Invite sellers and see how your team is doing
• Track sales and amount raised in real time
• Edit your fundraiser's story, photo and details
• Get paid out directly to your bank account

THE POPKIND DIRECT STORE
Separate from fundraisers, the PopKind Direct Store sells our popcorn straight to you. 50% of every PopKind Direct Store purchase funds outdoor education and nature conservation for kids.

Questions? Reach us at help@popkind.co.

name: Porcelain Gather PG
description:
Welcome to a little workshop where porcelain meets possibility.

Arrange numbered ceramic suit tiles on a five-by-five mosaic. Every row and column asks for an exact poker hand. Glazed anchors stay fixed; your loose tiles must satisfy both directions at once. When the ten hands align, fire the kiln and preserve your work.

• 24 authored patterns across First Glaze, Cobalt Lines, Terracotta Study and Master Kiln.
• A fresh deterministic daily challenge, available completely offline.
• Nine standard hand categories, from high card to straight flush, explained in an illustrated field guide.
• Thoughtful Study hints that respect your current placements and acknowledge conflicting arrangements.
• Free placement and lifting, reversible kiln charges and three achievement seals per pattern.
• Original embossed ceramic pieces and a richly illustrated artisan workshop.
• Automatic local saves, English and Simplified Chinese, three appearance modes, and optional ceramic chimes.

No betting, purchases, advertising, account or connection. Just ten hands, a few pieces of clay, and a satisfying moment when everything fits.

name: PortionMath
seller_name: SAYANG ELY ELIKA BINTI ABD RAHIM
description: PortionMath scales recipes by servings or yield and converts units. Offline baking tool with no account.

name: Potbench: Potting Mix Planner
description:
How much fresh mix does a repot take, and how many scoops of each part? Potbench works it out from the pot you have, shows how it got there, and counts the scoops with you as you pour.

Measure the pot: straight, tapered, bowl or planter box, or pick a common size. US nursery sizes such as #1 and #2 are there too; they hold far less than their gallon names suggest. If you filled the pot with water and measured it, type what it held.

Then take away what is already there. When a plant moves up a size, Potbench counts the old pot as the root ball, leaves about an inch of headspace, and adds what fresh mix loses as it settles on the first watering. Each step is a line on the plan that you can read and change, and the lines add up to the number at the top.

It also tells you how big the step up is. Extension guides suggest a pot 1 to 2 inches (2.5 to 5 cm) wider; when the new pot is much bigger than that, Potbench says so, because an oversized pot stays wet.

Build the mix by parts from bark, coir, perlite, pumice, akadama, LECA, castings and more, or start from one of ten common recipes. The mix is drawn as a measuring jug with each material as a layer in its own grain, and three plain scales describe its structure, the water it holds and how fast it drains.

Pour to the line. Pick the scoop in your hand and every part becomes a number of scoops, rounded to the half scoop so they still add up. Tap a row for each scoop: the jug fills, the next material is marked, a soft knock rises as you get close, and Potbench keeps the screen awake while your hands are in the soil.

Keep what went in. Each repot keeps its pot, its mix and the amounts that really went in, with dated notes, photos and a reminder to check back after a few weeks.

Potbench Pro is paid for once. It adds unlimited repots and mixes, one batch for several plants at once, the bags to buy with the leftover in each and their cost, and the journal as a CSV file. US bags are read in dry quarts and cubic feet, as printed on the bag. Without Pro you get quick measure, one repot with its journal, one mix of your own, every starting recipe, scooping, photos, reminders and backups.

Potbench needs no sign-up, has no subscription and collects nothing. Your repots, mixes and photos stay on the device, in metric or US units, in twelve languages. Amounts are planning estimates from the pot you measured; the app gives no advice about a particular plant.

name: Prestidigo Props
description:
Prestidigo Props brings magic prop hire and the art of performance together in one place.

Explore close-up, stage and mentalism props, compare nightly and weekly hire rates, and find performance packages for your next show. View hire charges, refundable bonds and delivery fees before making a reservation.

PROP HIRE FOR YOUR NEXT PERFORMANCE
Browse the catalogue by department, explore what each prop brings to an act, and choose your hire dates. Keep favourites on your shortlist so they are easy to find when planning your next performance.

COURIER DELIVERY ACROSS IRELAND
Add your delivery details and choose the person who will receive your props. Payment is collected by the courier on delivery, including the hire charge, refundable bond and dispatch fee.

YOUR HIRES IN ONE PLACE
Keep your hire details, dates and delivery addresses together. Review the hire terms, late-return charges and cancellation policy before you book.

STEP INTO THE GREEN ROOM
Learn approachable magic with step-by-step lessons, from the French Drop to the Twenty-One Card Trick. Discover short stories about the performers, illusions and moments that shaped the history of magic.

Whether you are preparing a close-up routine or planning a stage performance, Prestidigo Props helps you explore the props and ideas for your next act.

name: Proctor Simulator
description:
Proctor Simulator is a first-person game about catching cheaters in an exam room. As the proctor, you patrol the classroom during the limited exam time, spot every trick the students use, catch them in the act, and send them out.

Features
- First-person proctoring: patrol, observe, approach, and catch - all in your own hands
- Seven cheating methods: cheat sheets, phones, smart watches, wireless earbuds, whispering, peeking, and smart glasses, each with its own tell
- Watch for decoys: ordinary watches and glasses never glow; accusing an innocent student costs reputation
- 20 levels: more students, more cheaters, and new room shapes as difficulty climbs
- Four room shapes: square, convex, star, and circle, each with its own seating layout
- Three failure endings: classroom chaos, parent complaints, and running out of time
- 32 achievements plus leaderboards: chase an S rank and zero false accusations, and compete worldwide
- Available in Simplified Chinese, Traditional Chinese, English, Japanese, and Korean

The students' little moves won't get past you. Ready to be a fair, unflinching proctor?

name: ProStudio Monitor
description:
iPhone'unu kameraya, iPad veya Mac'ini monitöre ve prompter'a çevir. Tek başına çeken içerik üreticileri, sunucular ve küçük ekipler için: kadrajı karşıdan izle, kaydı uzaktan yönet, metnini sesini izleyen prompter'dan oku.

Canlı görüntü iPhone'dan iPad veya Mac'e akıcı şekilde aktarılır. Asıl kayıt ise her zaman iPhone'un kendisinde, tam kalitede yapılır; ağ kopsa bile bozulmaz.

KAMERA (iPHONE)
• Arka kamerayla sesli 4K kayıt. Dosya iPhone'da, Dosyalar uygulamasında ProStudio Monitor klasöründe durur.
• Cihazının desteklediği 24, 30 ve 60 kare hızı; HEVC SDR, 10 bit HLG HDR, ProRes 422 ve Apple Log.
• Ağ koparsa kayıt devam eder; uygulama arka plana geçse bile kayıt güvenle tamamlanır.
• Çekim sırasında ekranı karart; istersen kayıt fenerini aç.

MONİTÖR (iPAD VE MAC)
• Canlı önizlemeyi izle, kameranın sesini kulaklıkla dinle.
• Kaydı uzaktan başlat ve bitir, lensi seç, görüntüye dokunarak netle ve pozlama yap, ±2 EV ayarla, netliği ve pozlamayı kilitle.
• Ayna, 9:16 / 4:5 / 1:1 kadraj çerçevesi, güvenli alan, ızgara, netlik vurgusu ve zebra yalnızca monitörde görünür; kayda işlenmez.
• Kameranın pil, ısı, depolama, kayıt süresi ve ses seviyesi bir bakışta. Ayarlar'daki ölçüm sayacıyla gecikmeyi kendi gözünle ölçebilirsin.

PROMPTER (iPAD VE MAC)
• Metnini yaz, yapıştır ya da düz metin dosyasından al.
• Sesle takip: sen okudukça metin kendiliğinden kayar. Konuşma dilini seçebilirsin; tanıma, dil cihazda destekleniyorsa tamamen cihazında çalışır.
• Tekrar çekim kelimesi: bir cümlede takılınca seçtiğin kelimeyi söyle, metin okuduğun cümlenin başına döner. Kayıt sırasında istenen tekrarlar süresiyle listelenir ve paylaşılabilir; kurguda işine yarar.
• Mikrofonsuz kullanmak için sabit hızda kaydırma.
• Altı yazı tipi, punto, satır aralığı, renk ve ayna görüntüsü.
• Metin ile video yan yana (dikeyde alt alta) durur; aradaki çubuğu sürükleyerek her birine ayrılan yeri seç.

BAĞLANTI VE GİZLİLİK
• Hesap, giriş ya da parola yoktur. Cihazlar aynı Wi-Fi ağında, kablolu ağda veya doğrudan Wi-Fi ile birbirine şifreli bağlanır.
• İlk bağlantıda iki ekranda aynı 6 haneli kodu doğrulayıp kamerada onaylarsın; sonra cihazlar birbirini tanır ve uygulamayı açınca kendiliğinden bağlanır.
• Geliştiricinin sunucusu, reklam, izleme ya da analitik yoktur. Görüntü, ses ve metinlerin dışarı gönderilmez. Ayrıntılar için gizlilik politikasına bak.

NOT
Canlı önizleme için iPhone ile iPad veya Mac aynı ağda olmalıdır. Bir kamera aynı anda tek bir monitöre bağlanır. Sesi dinlerken geri besleme olmaması için kulaklık kullan.

name: PSM Awards
description:
Mastercard PSM Awards 2026'nın resmi uygulaması. Ödeme sistemleri, bankacılık ve finans teknolojilerinde yılın en iyilerini ödüllendiren törene bu uygulamayla hazırlanın.

• LCV ve QR bilet: Katılımınızı bildirin, biletiniz anında hazır.
• Katılımcılarla tanışma: Kimlerin geleceğini görün, "orada görüşelim" isteği gönderin, kabul edilince mesajlaşın.
• Finalistler ve kazananlar: 30 Kasım'da finalistler, 15 Aralık'ta kazananlar uygulamaya ilk düşer.
• Jüri, kategoriler ve program: 12 kişilik jüri, 11 kategori, panel ve tören akışı.
• Katılım kartı: Fotoğrafınızla PSM Awards görseli oluşturun, LinkedIn'de paylaşın.
• Hediye çekilişi: Törendeki çekilişe uygulamadan katılın, sonucu canlı görün.
• PSM Dergi: Sektörden günlük haberler ve analizler.
• PSM Asistan: Program, kategoriler ve etkinlik hakkında soru sorun.

Gizliliğiniz önceliğimiz: Profiliniz varsayılan olarak gizlidir, kimlerin sizi görebileceğine siz karar verirsiniz. Rahatsız eden kullanıcıları engelleyebilir ve şikâyet edebilirsiniz.

name: puff: remote agents
description:
Puff is a coding and writing workspace for the agents you already run.

Open a project, keep the file tree on the left, write in the middle, and talk to an agent on the right. Puff connects to a Paseo daemon, an OpenClaw gateway, or an OpenCode server that you host yourself, so drafts and conversations stay on your machines instead of someone else's cloud.

WRITE NEXT TO THE WORK

Documents open where the project lives. Edit in place, preview Markdown and HTML, and keep your place across launches: scroll position and recently opened files are remembered per document.

AGENTS IN THE SAME WINDOW

Each project keeps its own conversations. Replies stream in as they are written, tool calls show what the agent actually did, and you can switch models or approve tool access without leaving the draft.

SEVERAL BACKENDS AT ONCE

Keep a Paseo daemon, an OpenClaw gateway, and an OpenCode server connected side by side. Projects are grouped by connection and directory, and switching between them does not interrupt work already running elsewhere.

BUILT FOR A PHONE

On a narrow screen the file tree moves into a drawer, and the middle area switches between the document and the conversation with one button. The composer stays in place, so typing does not jump around when the view changes.

TRY IT WITHOUT A SERVER

A demo workspace ships with the app: one project, a few sample files, and an agent that answers with prepared text. Nothing is stored or sent anywhere, and it resets when the app restarts.

YOUR DATA STAYS YOURS

No account, no sign-up, no analytics, and no Puff server. Files live in your own project directories and conversations live on the backend you point the app at. Settings are stored on the device.

WHAT YOU NEED

A backend is required to use Puff with your own files: a Paseo daemon, an OpenClaw gateway, or an OpenCode v2 server. The exact commands and connection details are linked from the app.

name: Pungwise Ledger
description:
Score, calculate payouts, and analyze your Riichi Mahjong deck all in one app. Pungwise Ledger replaces mental arithmetic and manual record-keeping with a smart, easy-to-follow scorebook always ready at the table.
Set up four players, choose East Only or Hanchan, starting points, Uma, and specific table rules. For each result, enter Ron, Tsumo, or tie to have the app automatically calculate the score, including Honba, Riichi Stick, house bonus, and related payouts. Special situations, Chombo, or manual score adjustments are also supported.
Throughout the game, you can view rankings, point differences, wins, losses, and Riichi claims for each player. At the end of the game, Uma and Oka results are automatically calculated, and the history is saved for viewing or sharing. Played matches are also compiled into a performance profile for each player.
Another equally useful tool is the ability to read and analyze decks. With 13 cards, the app displays Shanten, waiting cards, and the number of remaining cards. With 14 cards, you can see suggestions for discarding cards or analyze a complete hand, from each Yaku, Fu calculation, total Han, to the point value to be paid. Results can be transferred directly to the scorebook without re-entering.
The accompanying lookup section explains Yaku, Han values, scoreboards, and Fu calculation, allowing you to check important rules whenever needed.
All of this is presented in a simple and easy-to-read interface similar to a printed notebook.

name: Punto: Çengel Bulmaca
description:
Sabah çayının yanında gazetenin bulmaca sayfasını açmanın keyfi şimdi telefonunda. Punto, Türkçe çengel bulmacayı gazete sayfasının sıcaklığıyla, kâğıt dokusu ve mürekkep kokusu hissiyle sunar.

HER GÜN YENİ BİR SAYI
Her sabah yeni bir günün bulmacası seni bekler. Seriyi bozmadan her gün çöz, seri bonusuyla daha çok jeton kazan. Kaçırdığın günleri arşivden istediğin zaman çözebilirsin.

KOLAYDAN ZORA HAZIR BULMACALAR
Kolay, orta ve zor seviyelerde özenle hazırlanmış bulmaca listeleri. Birini çözdükçe sıradaki açılır; kendi hızında ilerle.

BULMACA HİÇ BİTMEZ: SERBEST MOD
Seviyeni ve boyutunu seç (9×11, 11×15 ya da 13×17), her dokunuşta yepyeni bir ızgara dizilsin. 20.000'den fazla kelimelik Türkçe sözlükten üretilen bulmacalar bir kez indirildikten sonra internetsiz de oynanır.

TAKILDIN MI? BİR HARF AÇ
Zor bir soruda jetonunla tek bir harf ya da kelimenin tamamını açabilirsin. GÖNDER'e basıp yazdığın kelimeyi kontrol et; doğruysa kelime yeşile döner ve kilitlenir. Hiç ipucu almadan çözersen ödülün büyür.

GAZETE BULMACASI GİBİ
• Sorular mavi kutularda, oklar kelimenin yönünü gösterir
• Standart Türkçe Q klavye: Ç, Ğ, İ, Ö, Ş, Ü tek dokunuşla
• Kâğıt rengi sayfa, büyük harf kutuları, göz yormayan düzen
• Dokunuşta hafif titreşim (ayarlardan kapatılabilir)

JETONLAR
• Hoş geldin hediyesi: 100 jeton
• Her bulmaca çözüldüğünde seviyesine göre jeton
• Birkaç saatte bir bedava hediye kesesi
• Jetonların hesabında kalır, süresi dolmaz

KARNEN
Çözdüğün bulmacaları, serini ve ortalama süreni İstatistiklerim sayfasında takip et.

REKLAMSIZ OYNA
Punto ücretsizdir ve reklam gösterir. Reklamsız abonelikle hiçbir ekranda reklam görmezsin.

Abonelik, satın alma onaylandığında Apple Kimliği hesabından ücretlendirilir. Dönem bitiminden en az 24 saat önce iptal edilmezse abonelik otomatik olarak yenilenir ve yenileme ücreti dönem bitiminden önceki 24 saat içinde tahsil edilir. Aboneliğini App Store hesap ayarlarından yönetebilir ve iptal edebilirsin.

EULA: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/

Soru, öneri ya da hatalı bir bulmaca sorusu mu buldun? Ayarlar → Bize yaz bölümünden bize ulaş. İyi bulmacalar!

name: Purrly.
description:
Purrly helps you read the little things your cat does.
A meow, a slow blink, or a sudden dash can mean more than one thing. The sound guide, body language, daily habits, and social cues show what a behavior might be saying.
Keep a profile for your cat, from personality to the things they like. When a moment stands out, capture it with a note, photo, video, or sound, and look back whenever you want.
A little attention each day makes it easier to follow your cat’s rhythm, and to know when to stay close or give them room.
Purrly is for everyday understanding, not a veterinary diagnosis.

name: Pyrespire Tower Defense
description:
The spire is burning. Build the wall, then be the blade.

A handcrafted fantasy hero tower defense: place and merge your towers, lead the fight in the lane, and hold every wave.

No banners. No ads in the middle of a battle. Just the siege.

HOW IT PLAYS
• Place, upgrade, and merge towers between waves.
• Lead your hero in the fight: build the wall, then be the blade.
• 20 campaign maps with bosses, three difficulties, and a world map to roam.
• Rewarded offers are always optional: double your results, call reinforcements, or grab a pre-map gold boost.

RESPECT YOUR PLAY
• No banner ads, ever.
• No ads mid-wave.
• Between-map ads can be removed with a one-time Remove Ads purchase. Rewarded offers stay available if you want them.
• The campaign plays offline; a connection is used for ads and App Store purchases.

CURRENCY
Embers are earned in play. Cinder Gems are an optional premium currency for cosmetics. Cosmetics are visual only and give no combat power.

Support: feignnarula@nexaplaytech.com
NexaPlayTech

name: QARIO PRO
description:
QARIO PRO – Livraison et services professionnels
QARIO PRO est l'application destinée aux livreurs et aux prestataires de services qui souhaitent développer leur activité et accéder à de nouvelles opportunités professionnelles.
Avec QARIO PRO, rejoignez un réseau de professionnels proposant des services de livraison et des prestations artisanales.
POUR LES LIVREURS
- Recevez des propositions de missions de livraison.
- Consultez les détails des commandes.
- Acceptez et gérez vos missions.
- Mettez à jour le statut des livraisons.
- Suivez vos activités professionnelles.

POUR LES ARTISANS ET PRESTATAIRES
- Proposez vos services professionnels.
- Présentez vos compétences.
- Recevez des demandes de prestations.
- Gérez vos missions et interventions.
- Développez votre clientèle.
UNE PLATEFORME POUR VOTRE ACTIVITÉ
QARIO PRO facilite la mise en relation entre les clients et les professionnels pour les livraisons et les services du quotidien.
Que vous soyez livreur, artisan ou prestataire indépendant, QARIO PRO vous accompagne dans la gestion de votre activité.
QARIO PRO – Vos missions, vos services, vos opportunités.

name: Qovi Authenticator
description:
Qovi will never ask you for a password. Not even once.

Most two-factor solutions sit on top of your password: you type it first, then confirm on your phone. Others still ask for one at sign-up or to recover your access. Qovi doesn't. Not at sign-up, not at login, not ever.

Your phone becomes your key. When you log in to a Qovi-enabled website, you scan the QR code shown on screen and approve on your phone. That's it.

A password that doesn't exist can't be stolen, guessed, reused or phished.

HOW IT WORKS
1. On the website, choose to log in with Qovi.
2. Scan the QR code with the app.
3. Approve or decline the request on your phone.

WHAT QOVI GIVES YOU
• No password to create, remember or type.
• You see who is requesting access, and you decide.
• Multi-device approval (quorum) for sensitive access.
• An emergency PIN that discreetly alerts people you trust.
• Secure transfer of your keychain to a new phone.

SWISS TRUST
Qovi is developed in Switzerland. All exchanges between your phone and our servers are encrypted.

Qovi works with websites and services that have integrated Qovi.

name: QR Lab: Free QR codes for life
description:
Make a QR code for anything, design it your way, and know it scans before you print it. Every code works forever. Every feature is included, with no ads, account or watermark.

CODES THAT NEVER EXPIRE
Some QR apps sell "dynamic" codes that stop working when a subscription ends, often after they're printed. QR Lab never does. Your link, Wi-Fi password or contact card is stored in the code itself, so it keeps working for as long as the paper lasts.

MAKE A CODE FROM ANYTHING
• Links, with quick templates for App Store, YouTube, Instagram, TikTok, LinkedIn, Venmo, PayPal, Cash App and Calendly
• Wi-Fi, so guests join in one scan
• Contact cards, filled from Contacts or your own card in one tap
• Text, phone numbers, messages, email, map locations and calendar events
• Aztec, PDF417 and Code 128 barcodes
• Paste something you copied, share to QR Lab from any app, or make hundreds at once from a CSV file

DESIGN IT IN THE STUDIO
• Colors and gradients, seven dot shapes and custom eyes
• Add a logo, emoji, icon or letters in the middle
• Frames with a caption like "Scan for the menu"
• Art codes: a photo showing through the pattern
• Ten ready-made looks, plus brand kits to reuse your own
• Undo and redo for every change

KNOW IT SCANS
QR Lab checks every design as you edit it and stamps it Scans, Risky or Won't scan, with tips to fix it. Pretty never beats working.

EXPORT FOR SCREEN OR PRINT
• PNG at any size, or SVG and PDF that stay sharp on a banner
• Transparent backgrounds
• Share, copy, save to Photos or print
• A print-size helper tells you how big to print for how far away people will scan

SCAN TOO
Scan QR codes and barcodes with the camera or from a photo. Join Wi-Fi, save a contact or add an event in one tap, keep a scan history, and restyle any code you scan into your own design.

KEEP THEM CLOSE
• A Library with folders, favorites and search
• Show mode puts a code full screen with the brightness up
• Home Screen and Lock Screen widgets
• Shortcuts and Siri actions
• Five themes, each in light and dark

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
No account, no ads, no tracking. Your codes stay on your iPhone and sync only through your own iCloud.

Everything in QR Lab is included. If you'd like to say thanks, there's an optional tip jar that unlocks nothing. Questions? Settings › Help has short how-to articles for every feature, and Contact Support is right there too.

name: Qualidemy
description:
Qualidemy est l’application des participants, des formateurs et des entreprises clientes d’un organisme de formation qui utilise app.qualidemy.com.

PARTICIPANTS
• Connexion avec le code personnel à 9 chiffres ou le QR code remis par l’organisme de formation, sans mot de passe à créer.
• Signature de votre présence, demi-journée par demi-journée, directement à l’écran.
• QR code d’émargement présenté par le formateur : scannez-le, signez, c’est enregistré.
• Planning, lieu, horaires, lien de classe virtuelle et message de l’organisme.
• Documents : convocation, convention, livret d’accueil, attestations.
• Questionnaires de satisfaction à remplir.

FORMATEURS
• Connexion avec votre compte app.qualidemy.com.
• Vos sessions, la liste des participants et les présences signées.
• Signature de votre propre présence et saisie d’une absence.

ENTREPRISES
• Les formations de vos salariés, leurs documents et les factures de l’organisme.

L’accès est ouvert par l’organisme de formation : l’application ne permet ni de créer un compte, ni d’acheter une formation.

name: Qudwa – Hadith expliqué
description:
Chaque jour, une parole du Prophète (paix et salut sur lui), avec son explication. Simple, sourcé et gratuit.

LE HADITH DU JOUR
Un rendez-vous quotidien : le hadith en arabe et en français, son degré d'authenticité, les recueils qui le rapportent, puis son explication et ses enseignements. Touche « J'ai lu » pour faire grandir ta série de jours.

L'EXPLICATION, GRATUITE
Ce que veut dire le hadith et ce qu'on en retient, sans abonnement et sans publicité.

DÉFILER, MAIS BIEN
Des hadiths courts en plein écran, l'un après l'autre. Une pause douce t'est proposée tous les 10 hadiths (réglable).

1 790 HADITHS PAR THÈME
Le dogme, les vertus et les convenances, la biographie, le Coran et ses sciences… et une recherche par mot : colère, parents, prière, voisin.

GARDE ET PARTAGE
Garde tes hadiths préférés et partage-les en texte ou en belle image, prête pour ta story.

TON RAPPEL
Une seule notification par jour, à l'heure de ton choix.

D'OÙ VIENNENT LES TEXTES ?
Les hadiths, leurs traductions, leurs degrés, leurs explications et leurs enseignements viennent de l'Encyclopédie des hadiths prophétiques traduits (HadeethEnc.com, version 1.17.0). Ils sont affichés sans aucune modification, avec leur source. Une erreur ? Un bouton « Signaler une erreur » se trouve sous chaque fiche.

RESPECT DE TA VIE PRIVÉE
Pas de compte, pas de publicité, aucune donnée collectée. Tout fonctionne hors connexion et reste sur ton téléphone.

name: RailSignal Studio
description:
RailSignal Studio accompagne les équipes de signalisation ferroviaire sur le terrain. L'application permet aux agents de recevoir leurs missions, de remplir leurs fiches de contrôle directement sur le chantier et de les transmettre à leur responsable.

CE QUE VOUS POUVEZ FAIRE

• Recevoir vos missions : les fiches à contrôler vous sont confiées par votre responsable, avec ses consignes.
• Saisir vite, même avec des gants : chaque point de contrôle se renseigne d'un seul geste (conforme, non applicable, réserve, non conforme).
• Signaler une réserve : décrivez l'écart, indiquez s'il est bloquant et ajoutez jusqu'à trois photos prises sur place.
• Travailler hors ligne : vos saisies sont enregistrées sur l'appareil et envoyées dès que le réseau revient.
• Transmettre au responsable : une fois la mission terminée, il la valide ou vous la renvoie pour reprise.
• Consulter les modes opératoires : ouvrez la procédure liée à la fiche que vous remplissez, sans quitter votre saisie.
• Garder vos outils et mémos sous la main.

Sur iPad, les points de contrôle s'affichent côte à côte pour voir toute la fiche d'un coup d'œil.

POUR QUI

L'application s'adresse aux agents et responsables des entreprises qui utilisent déjà RailSignal Studio sur ordinateur. Elle nécessite un compte créé par l'administrateur de votre organisation : il n'est pas possible de s'inscrire depuis l'application.

VOS DONNÉES

Les échanges avec la plateforme sont chiffrés. L'application ne contient ni publicité ni outil de mesure d'audience, et vos données ne sont partagées avec aucun tiers.

name: RaveBOX V-Machine
description:
RaveBOX is a virtual drum machine for iPad with a hardware-style front panel: knobs, LCD displays and illuminated step keys you play like a real groovebox.

SOUND
• 8 tracks, each able to use any of 9 sound machines: Kick Synth, Snare, Hi-Hat, Percussion, Bass/Lead (acid bass with accent and slide), Poly Synth, FM Keys, Drum Machine and Sampler
• Over 160 presets, plus your own user presets
• Full ADSR envelopes, filter, resonance, drive and saturation
• 7 classic-style drum kits synthesized by the app, with no third-party samples

SEQUENCER
• 16-step sequencer with up to 4 bars per track, each track with its own length
• Accent, slide, velocity and note length for every trig
• Piano roll view, one bar at a time
• Live keyboard and pads with octave shift
• 64 patterns per project in 4 banks; each pattern stores its own sounds and tempo
• Quantized pattern changes (immediate, 1/4 or bar) with no glitches
• Mute and Solo with independent memory, Copy / Paste / Clear

SAMPLER
• Import your own samples (wav, aiff, mp3, m4a, caf) from the Files app, iCloud Drive or USB drives
• Waveform display with draggable start and end points
• Sample Hub to preview, organise and assign samples and kits

EFFECTS & MASTER
• Per-track filter, bitcrusher, pan and sends
• Tempo-synced ping-pong delay and stereo reverb
• Master compressor, Overblast bass enhancer, loudness control and a look-ahead limiter
• 8 master FX presets

PROJECTS
• 4 ready-made templates: Techno minimal 140, House 130, Breakbeat 136, Drum and bass 170
• Save and load projects; the factory "Initial" project is always available
• Projects and samples are visible in the Files app (On My iPad → RaveBOX) for easy backup
• Automatic session save when you leave the app
• Background audio: keep the music playing while you switch apps

PRIVACY
RaveBOX collects no data at all. No account, no sign-up, no ads, no analytics, no tracking and no internet connection: the app works completely offline and everything you create stays on your iPad.

Designed for iPad, landscape, iPadOS 17 or later.
User manual and support: sonik-audiolab.github.io/RaveBOX-V-Machine

name: ReactiDog: Dog Training Walks
description:
Does your dog bark, lunge or panic at other dogs, people, bikes or noises? ReactiDog is the walk companion built for reactive dogs and the people who love them.

Most training apps teach "sit" and "stay". ReactiDog helps with the hard part, the walk itself.

LOG REACTIONS IN ONE TAP
• Big buttons for dogs, people, bikes, cars and noises
• Rate intensity and distance in seconds, or long-press to log instantly
• Hold to add a voice note, transcribed on your iPhone
• Log from the Lock Screen and Dynamic Island without unlocking
• Celebrate calm moments when your dog notices a trigger and stays relaxed

SEE WHERE AND WHEN
• Every reaction pinned on your walk route
• A trigger map with your dog's hot spots and the times they happen
• Hide your home area from every map

PROVE THE PROGRESS
• Charts for reactions per walk, intensity and reaction distance
• A walk summary after every outing
• A weekly coach that runs privately with on-device AI

TRAIN WITH PROVEN, FORCE-FREE METHODS
• Step-by-step plans: Find It, Look At That, Engage–Disengage, Emergency U-Turn, the 1-2-3 Pattern Game and Settle on a Mat
• Clear "move on when" criteria, so you always know what to practise next
• Positive reinforcement only. No punishment, ever.

SHARE WITH YOUR TRAINER
• A one-page PDF report for your trainer or vet

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
• No account, no ads, no tracking
• Walks, locations and voice notes stay on your iPhone
• Export or delete your data any time

ReactiDog is free to download and logging walks is free forever. Premium unlocks every training plan, full history and trigger map, the AI coach and trainer reports. Choose monthly, yearly (with a free trial) or a one-time lifetime purchase.

Subscriptions renew automatically unless cancelled at least 24 hours before the end of the period. Manage or cancel any time in your Apple Account settings.
Terms of Use: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/

ReactiDog offers training guidance, not veterinary advice. If your dog's behaviour changes suddenly, please see your vet.

name: Readly: Reading Tracker
description:
Readly turns finishing a book into a small daily habit.

• Log pages or audiobook tracks in one tap
• Set a finish date — Readly works out how much to read each day
• See your day-by-day reading plan and a grid of audiobook tracks
• Listen to your own audio files with lock-screen controls and speed
• Find books by title, author or ISBN — or scan the barcode
• Reading streaks, monthly calendar and yearly goal
• Home Screen widget, gentle daily reminder
• English and Ukrainian, works offline, no account, no ads

name: Redraw, by AVIA
description:
Redraw edits your photos from a description. Pick a photo, say what you'd like changed, and Redraw brings it back at the same size and shape.

• Make a brand-new picture from a description
• Turn midday into golden hour
• Remove people or clutter from the background
• Fix lighting, colors and skies
• Restyle a whole scene, then keep editing the result until it's just right

Edit up to 20 photos at once. Touch and hold a finished photo to compare it with the original, and pinch to zoom in on the detail.

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
• No sign-up: there's no account to create and no email to give.
• Your library stays on your phone. Our server holds a photo only while it's being redrawn, and deletes it as soon as the result reaches you.
• No ads and no tracking.

SIMPLE CREDITS
• Each edit or new picture uses 1 credit, and new users get 1 free credit to try it.
• Credits come in packs of 10, 40 or 100. They never expire and belong to your Apple Account, so they follow you to a new device.
• If an edit fails, the credit comes back automatically.

Terms of Use: https://redraw.aviaorlando.com/terms
Privacy Policy: https://redraw.aviaorlando.com/privacy

name: Reformation Paris
description:
Bienvenue chez Reformation.

Notre mission : vous proposer un Pilates sur machines à haute valeur ajoutée et à l’efficacité maximale, dans des lieux où chaque détail compte.

Dans nos trois studios parisiens, Le Marais, Palais Royal et Saint-Sulpice, découvrez nos cours de Reformer, Tower et Combo. Encadrée par des professeur·e·s expert·e·s et passionné·e·s, chaque séance allie précision, fluidité et bienveillance.

Avec l’application Reformation, vous pouvez :

• Réserver vos cours collectifs et privés
• Consulter les plannings de nos trois studios
• Découvrir nos différents formats de cours
• Choisir vos cours selon votre niveau
• Gérer vos réservations, abonnements et crédits
• Découvrir nos ateliers et suivre nos actualités

Reformation.
Pilates with intention.

name: Regents Biology: Life Science
description:
Get ready for the New York State Regents exam in Life Science: Biology with practice built for the new test, not the old Living Environment exam.

WHAT'S INSIDE
• 2,208 original practice questions in 574 short sets across all 16 chapters, each with a full explanation and a reason why every other choice is wrong
• 120 exam-style clusters, just like the real test: one reading with data, tables or diagrams, then five questions, both multiple choice and written answers
• Scoring guides for every written answer: a model answer, a checklist of what earns the credit, and examples that get credit and ones that don't
• A complete study guide, 16 chapters from scientific inquiry and data analysis to genetics, evolution and ecosystems
• Timed practice exams at the real exam's pace, plus a full shuffle of every question that saves your place

STUDY SMARTER, NOT LONGER
• Today's lab picks up to 10 questions a day: the ones you are about to forget, then new ones in chapter order
• Spaced repetition (FSRS) schedules every question you answer, so reviews come back right when they matter
• Every chapter shows its mastery as a percent, and Progress shows readiness, accuracy, a 14-day trend and your weak spots
• A question of the day, as a card and an optional reminder

MADE FOR THE NEW EXAM
• Questions follow the New York State P-12 Science Learning Standards and the Life Science: Biology framework
• Practice reading graphs, data tables and experiment designs, and writing claim-evidence-reasoning answers
• Works fully offline, on iPhone and iPad, in light and dark mode

FREE TO START
The first three sets of every chapter, two full clusters and the opening of every guide chapter are free. One in-app purchase opens everything else. There is no subscription.

Every question, explanation and guide page was written for this app. The app does not contain released Regents exam items. Regents Biology: Life Science is an independent study app and is not affiliated with or endorsed by the New York State Education Department.

name: Renovatori
description:
Renovatori is the official app of Renovatori.ge, a renovation company in Tbilisi, Georgia.

- Renovation cost calculator: answer a few questions about your apartment (area, floor, installations, demolition, rooms, bathrooms) and get an estimated price for green, white and black frame renovation.
- Prices: compare renovation packages and see what each one includes.
- Projects: browse completed renovations with photos and details.
- Consultation: book a consultation or a detailed cost estimate.
- Blog: practical renovation tips and guides.
- Call request: outside working hours, leave your number and we call you back.
- My projects: clients follow the progress of their own renovation.

The app is in Georgian.

name: Repetita Music Practice
description:
Repetita iuvant: repetition helps. Repetita is the practice player for musicians: open the song you're learning, slow it down without changing its pitch, loop the hard passage and repeat it until it's yours.

SLOW DOWN, SAME PITCH
• Speed from 25% to 200%, with quick choices from 50% to 130%
• Practice above 100% too, so the real tempo feels easy on stage
• Transpose by semitones (±12) and fine-tune in cents, to match your key, your tuning or a recording that isn't at A = 440 Hz

LOOP THE HARD PASSAGE
• Press A and B while listening, or drag the handles on the waveform
• Fine-tune the loop by tenths of a second, and zoom in on it
• Seamless repetitions, with an optional pause to reset your hands
• Play a set number of repetitions, or loop forever

SPEED TRAINER
• Start slow and let Repetita speed up a little every few repetitions, up to your target tempo

MARKERS
• Mark verse, chorus, solo and every section you need, and jump to them with one tap
• Loop from one marker to the next

YOUR FILES AND YOUTUBE
• Import audio files (MP3, M4A, WAV, AIFF, FLAC…) and videos from Files, or drag them onto the window on iPad and Mac
• Videos stay visible and in sync with the slowed-down audio
• Paste a YouTube link to practice along with a concert or a lesson: it plays in YouTube's official player, with loop, slow-down and markers (transposing works on imported files)

MADE FOR PRACTICE
• Every song remembers its speed, pitch, loop and markers
• Imported files keep playing with the screen locked, with lock screen controls
• Keyboard shortcuts on Mac and iPad: space, A, B, M, arrows
• A demo track and an illustrated guide to get started
• Works on iPhone, iPad and Mac, in 6 languages

PRIVACY
Your files stay on your device. Repetita collects no data and has no ads and no tracking. YouTube videos are played by YouTube's official player, under YouTube's terms.

name: Retroteca: Folding Museum
description:
Retroteca is a museum of classic computers designed for iPhone Duo: fold it like a laptop and the machine powers on, with the screen on top and the keyboard below.

Each machine sits on its own desk, seen from above, with its keyboard, its screen and, if it had one, its mouse or trackpad.

WHAT YOU CAN DO
• Program in BASIC on an 8-bit computer: PRINT, GOTO, POKE to change the border color, and load programs from disk.
• Use windowed desktops with their mouse: drag to move the pointer, tap to click, and touch and hold to drag or paint.
• Try out the laptops' trackpads.
• Listen to every machine: the beeps, the keys and the startup sound are synthesized on the fly.

THE MACHINES
Seven made-up computers that bring back a whole era: from the classic 8-bit that plugged into the TV to the aluminum laptop, by way of the office computer, the all-in-one, the nineties desktop PC and the one with the colorful see-through case.

NO FOLDING NEEDED, TOO
With the iPhone open you can stroll through the museum and power on any machine with the “Power on” button. To go back, turn it off or lay the iPhone flat.

No accounts, no ads and no data collected.

name: Rewilded
description:
Rewilded is a calm puzzle game set among brutalist megastructures that nature is taking back.

Each block is a concrete plaza cut with dry channels. Tap a slab to turn it. Line the channels up so water runs from the cistern to every slab, and the block comes back to life: moss spreads, grass and trees take root, vines climb down the towers, and the cold overcast light warms to gold.

• Endless blocks. Every level is generated, always solvable, and the same each time you return to it. The first 10 are free; one purchase unlocks the rest.
• One-handed play. Tap to turn a slab, drag to look around, pinch to zoom.
• A city that grows. Every block you finish stays rewilded behind you, so the skyline slowly turns green.
• Game Center leaderboard. See who has rewilded the furthest in the fewest moves.
• A world that responds. Light, plants and weather change as you rewild each block.
• A living score. The music is synthesised as you play: a deep concrete drone that opens into melody, water and birdsong as the block greens.
• Play at your own pace. No timers, no ads, no subscriptions, no accounts. Beat par to earn three leaves.

Best with headphones.

name: Reyting
description:
OTT milliy reytingi — O‘zbekiston oliy ta’lim tashkilotlari milliy reytingi natijalarini ochiq va qulay ko‘rish uchun ilova. Ma’lumotlar Ta’lim sifatini ta’minlash milliy agentligining reyting platformasidan olinadi.

NIMALARNI KO‘RASIZ

• Reyting jadvali — har bir oliy ta’lim tashkilotining umumiy bali, toifa ichidagi o‘rni va darajasi (1, 2, 3-daraja).
• To‘rt toifa: amaliy, tibbiyot, ijtimoiy-gumanitar, ijod va sport yo‘nalishlari.
• To‘rt mezon bloki: akademik faoliyat, ilmiy faoliyat, xalqaro faoliyat, bitiruvchilar sifati va raqamlashtirish.
• 25 ta indikator bo‘yicha ball — har bir OTT qaysi yo‘nalishda kuchli ekanini va qayerda o‘sish zarurligini ko‘rsatadi.
• OTT sahifasi — umumiy ball, o‘rin, mezonlar va indikatorlar bo‘yicha natijalar bir joyda.
• Solishtirish — 2 tadan 5 tagacha OTTni yonma-yon taqqoslash.
• Hududlar xaritasi — viloyatlar kesimida OTTlar soni va darajalari.
• Statistika: talabalar kontingenti, professor-o‘qituvchilar tarkibi va ilmiy salohiyati, Scopus maqolalari, iqtiboslar va h-indeks, xalqaro akademik mobillik, qo‘shma ta’lim dasturlari, xorijiy talabalar va o‘qituvchilar, bitiruvchilarning bandligi, so‘rovnoma natijalari.
• Filtrlar: yil, hudud, tashkilot shakli (davlat, nodavlat, xorijiy), toifa; OTT nomi bo‘yicha qidiruv.
• Uch tilda: o‘zbek, rus va ingliz.

KIMLAR UCHUN

• Abituriyentlar va ota-onalar — OTT tanlashda ishonchli va solishtirsa bo‘ladigan ma’lumot.
• Talabalar va bitiruvchilar — o‘z OTTining boshqalar orasidagi o‘rni.
• OTT rahbarlari va xodimlari — natijalarni tahlil qilish va o‘sish nuqtalarini topish.
• Tadqiqotchilar, jurnalistlar va ta’lim sohasiga qiziquvchilar.

name: RiarkThrang
description:
• Save a walk with distance, ascent, and a flat pace in minutes per kilometer
• Add flat time to one extra hour for every 600 m of ascent
• Show that total in hours and minutes, and the average grade
• Convert map millimeters and a scale denominator into ground kilometers, and the reverse
• Turn a contour interval and an upward crossing count into meters of ascent
• Turn a timed leg into minutes per kilometer
• Erase the local file from the manual

name: RibleTonza
description:
• Save a roof footprint, a runoff factor, a storm depth, and a tank size
• Turn square meters times millimeters times runoff into liters
• Shorten a sloped roof measurement into a horizontal footprint
• Size a first-flush volume from the millimeters you divert
• Total an average monthly rainfall across a number of wet months
• Compare tank capacity, water already stored, and an incoming catch
• Split a volume into equal barrels
• Erase the local file from the manual

name: Rivetsuit Poker : Crown Weave
description:
A beautiful deck. Three lanes. One perfect signature.

Drag ivory cards onto a garnet table, exchange positions and weave three ordered five-card patterns.
Swipe a lane to shift the whole row, hold a finished card to pin it in place and undo an arrangement when a better idea appears.

Discover six patterns, from a rising run and a single-suit ladder to a woven full house and the J-Q-K-Q-J Royal Crown.
Plan around the shared deal and seal all three lanes within the visible move limit.

Explore thirty commissions across five halls, accept three precision trials and return for a daily selected commission.
Earn royal seals and engraved card backs through actual play.

name: Rollzy Kart Rally
description:
Ready to start the engine? In Rollzy Kart Rally, the finish line depends not only on speed but also on the two dice in your hand!

Each turn, roll the dice to move, keep a good result, or try your luck with a reroll. Choose your path wisely, utilize the speed boost, and don't be afraid to collide to push your opponents behind. Rolling two identical faces even gives you an extra turn!

When your energy bar is full, unleash your special abilities to gain an advantage. Accelerate, roll the dice, make your opponents bog, or force the entire convoy to fall back. And remember to time your GO for an explosive start.

Run through 12 tracks with four different landscapes, dodge obstacles, collect items, and find the right moment to use them. Six drivers with unique abilities will provide plenty of exciting gameplay.

You can race through stages, participate in multi-round tournaments, or challenge yourself to achieve three stars on every track. Collected donuts also unlock useful upgrades in the workshop.

With easy-to-understand rules, a fast pace, and many unexpected situations, each race can become an unpredictable chase. Play offline, speed up the game whenever you want, and return anytime.

Roll the dice, activate skills, and race to the finish line!

name: Rook Raid
description:
Chess has new rules. Every turn charges your mana. Spend it on spell cards, or save up for an ultimate that can turn a lost game around.

CHESS WITH SPELLS
Freeze an enemy knight. Shield your queen. Turn a pawn into a knight with Knighting, or send Lightning at an attacker in your half. One action per turn: a move, a card or an ultimate. Every decision counts.

UNLEASH ULTIMATES
Fill your mana bar and cast Meteor, Fortress, Ice Age, Coronation or Rebirth – game-changing powers that unlock as you climb.

BUILD YOUR DECK
Pick 4 cards and 1 ultimate before each game. 15 cards in five roles – attack, defense, control, mana and comeback. Both decks are visible, so outthink your opponent.

RANKED 5-MINUTE BATTLES
Play ranked online games, win trophies and rise through 6 arenas – from the Training Grounds to the King's Summit.

PLAY YOUR WAY
• Offline bot ladder with smart AI opponents
• Daily puzzle, puzzle collection and Puzzle Rush
• Daily flame streak
• Chests, shards, boards, avatars and piece sets to unlock
• Add friends, challenge them and ask for a rematch

FAIR AND FREE
No ads. No pay-to-win. Nothing costs real money. Play without an account, or secure your progress with Apple or Google and continue in your browser at rookraid.com.

Available in English, German, Spanish, French, Italian, Russian and Chinese.

name: Rootbook: Private Plant Log
description:
No ads ever. No data tracking. No account creation.

Rootbook is a quiet, private diary for the plants you look after. Write down when you watered, fed, misted, repotted or pruned. Rootbook tells you what needs care today. That's it: no sign-up, no location, no "AI plant doctor", and nothing ever leaves your phone unless you choose to back it up.

WHAT YOU CAN DO
• Add your plants with a name, a spot ("Kitchen window") and a cover photo
• Set how often each one needs water, fertilizer, misting, repotting or pruning, from every day to once a year
• See what is due today and overdue, and what's coming up this week, on the Today screen
• Tap Done to log care. The next due date moves on its own.
• Keep a diary for each plant: notes and progress photos, newest first
• Get one gentle reminder on days when something is due, at the time you choose
• Archive plants you no longer have without losing their history
• Export your full care log and plant list as CSV for any spreadsheet
• Optionally lock the app with Face ID, Touch ID or your iPhone passcode

YOUR PLANTS SURVIVE A NEW PHONE
Back up everything (plants, schedules, diary and photos) to a single file. Save it wherever you like through the Files picker: iCloud Drive, your device or another file provider you have. On your new phone, install Rootbook and restore from that file. You can protect the backup with a passphrase. There is no account to lose and no server to shut down.

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
• Rootbook makes no network connections. The app contains no networking code, no analytics and no tracking SDKs, and App Privacy says "Data Not Collected".
• No location, ever. Your "spot" is just a word you type.
• No ads. Apple handles the optional one-time unlock; we never see your card or your name.
• Photos come from the iOS photo picker or your camera, only when you choose one.

FAIR PRICING
Try everything free for 7 days, with no sign-up and no card. After that, a single $1.99 one-time in-app purchase unlocks Rootbook for good. There is no subscription. If you don't buy it, your plants and diary stay readable, and export and backup keep working. Only adding and editing pause. Restore purchase is on the unlock screen and in Settings.

WHAT ROOTBOOK IS NOT
Rootbook doesn't identify plants or diagnose diseases, and it doesn't give care advice. It's your own record, with your own intervals. You know your plants and your home best.

Made by Southwest Blueprints with AI assistance.

name: Rope Street: Delivery Puzzle
description:
A street of colourful houses, baskets lowered from windows, and neighbours who do not like to wait. Rope Street is a delivery network game you build by drawing ropes with your finger.

HOW TO PLAY
• Drag from one hook to another to string a rope. Every rope has a basket that shuttles back and forth.
• Neighbours order bread, tomatoes, milk and tea from their windows. If ropes connect a window to the right shop, the goods are passed along to it.
• Ropes cannot cross, a hook holds at most three, and your rope is limited. Choose where it goes.
• A neighbour who runs out of patience gets upset. Three upset neighbours end the run.

AS THE STREET GROWS
Every day new neighbours move in, new shops open and orders come faster. A single line clogs up; a spare line takes room. You are free to rebuild: tap a rope to take it down and get it back.

ONE UPGRADE A DAY
After each day pick one of three cards: longer rope, faster pulleys, bigger baskets, a new shop branch, or the street cat that calms an upset neighbour. New cards unlock as you play.

THE NEIGHBOURS TALK
The auntie, the uncle, the young neighbour and the kid next door order, thank you and complain in their own voices: "Where are my tomatoes?"

FEATURES
• One finger, one rule you learn in ten seconds
• A different street every run, a new puzzle every day
• Calm music and a handmade, toy-like look
• English and Turkish, voices included
• A 2x speed button for players who do not like waiting
• No internet needed

The game is free and contains ads. Ads appear only after a run ends, never during one. You can choose to watch a short video to continue a run once. A one-time "Remove ads" purchase removes the ads, and the continue no longer needs a video.

name: RouteClasp
description:
Route Clasp je lokalno orodje, zasnovano za načrtovanje in pregled kolesarskih aktivnosti. Pomaga vam organizirati dokumente, načrte poti, sezname opravil in pakiranje opreme, preden se odpravite na pot, hkrati pa vam omogoča tudi dokumentiranje vaše uspešnosti in vpogledov po potovanju, kar olajša uporabo za prihodnja potovanja. Prilagojeno je ljubiteljskim kolesarjem, tistim, ki se odpravljajo na vikend izlete ali enodnevne vožnje, ter udeležencem cestnih dirk ali vzdržljivostnih prireditev, ki morajo upravljati z registracijskimi gradivi in kontrolnimi seznami pred dirko.

Upravljanje aktivnosti
Ustvarite in upravljajte svoje kolesarske aktivnosti (prostočasne vožnje, dirke, večdnevni izleti itd.). Filtrirajte jih po stanju – Prihajajoče, V teku, Zaključeno ali Arhivirano – z možnostmi urejanja, podvajanja, posodabljanja stanja, preklica ali arhiviranja vnosov.

Načrt poti in opomniki
