Spremljajte ključne mejnike, kot so odhodi, prevoz, nastanitev, zbirna mesta, časi začetka dirke in povratne poti. Oglejte si svoj urnik iz dneva v dan in prejemajte lokalna obvestila.

Paking in oprema
Vzdržujte osebno knjižnico opreme in shranjevalnih posod. Načrtujte količino in vir (lastni, za nakup, izposojo itd.) za vsak predmet, jih dodelite določenim torbam – kot so torbe za okvir, torbe za sedlo ali nahrbtniki – in spremljajte napredek pakiranja.

Dokumenti in opravila
Shranite registracijske kode, povezave, priloge in opombe. Spremljajte bistvena opravila priprave, vključno z nakupi, potrditvami in vračilom izposojenih predmetov.

Rezultati in predloge
Beležite svojo uspešnost in refleksije po vožnji. Uporabite vgrajene ali prilagojene predloge za hitro nastavitev novih dejavnosti. Aplikacija podpira tudi varnostno kopiranje podatkov, izvoz in prilagojene nastavitve. Vsi podatki so shranjeni lokalno v vaši napravi.

Route Clasp, osredotočen na celotno pot – od priprave do refleksije po vožnji – presega preprosto beleženje prevoženih kilometrov. Kvantificira vaše pakiranje po zabojnikih in dodelitvah, kar odraža praktično realnost kolesarskih potovanj.

name: RouteUp: Driver Gigs & Jobs
description:
RouteUp is where drivers find work and companies find drivers: gigs for today and jobs for the long run.

FOR DRIVERS
• Rideshare, taxi, limo, shuttle, delivery, courier, medical courier, van, box truck and CDL work, all in one place.
• Free to browse, apply and take gigs. Drivers never pay.
• RouteUp NOW: go Available, pick your radius, and get an alert when urgent work near you fits your vehicle and credentials. Tap I'm interested; it's yours once the company confirms.
• Driver Passport: keep your license, insurance and certificates in one place and share them with a tap.
• No car? Take jobs and gigs that come with the vehicle.
• Proof of delivery: a photo or a signature at each stop, so there's never an argument about a drop-off.
• Driver communities: ask questions, share pay and spot reports. Employers can't read or post there.

FOR COMPANIES
• Short a driver? Post a NOW gig in one sentence. Only qualified drivers nearby get the alert, and you confirm who goes.
• Post jobs, review applicants and their Passports, and message drivers.
• See each stop's proof of delivery as the route runs.

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
RouteUp uses your location only when you ask it to, never in the background. Documents and photos are stored privately and photo metadata (including GPS) is stripped. You can delete your account from Settings at any time.

Available in English and Spanish.

name: RTD Wiring
description:
RTD Wiring is a native iPhone app for one narrow job in instrumentation: showing how much a given RTD wiring arrangement will bias your temperature reading.

A Pt100 or Pt1000 element is accurate to a fraction of a degree, but lead resistance sits directly in the measurement loop. With two-wire wiring, 1 Ω per lead means roughly +5.3 °C of error near 100 °C. Three-wire cancels part of it, but only if the leads are genuinely matched. Four-wire is nearly immune, in the ideal case. None of that shows up on a drawing; all of it shows up on site.

name: RussWave Connect
description:
RussWave Connect brings your RussWave collection to iPhone and iPad.

DISCOVER YOUR NEXT SOUND
Explore RussWave instruments, effects and preset packs with official images, product information and links to learn more. Browse without an account. The collection stays up to date automatically.

YOUR ACCOUNT, IN ONE PLACE
Sign in with your existing RussWave account to view your products, permanent and Rent-to-Own licenses, subscriptions and AI credit balances. See your order history and open an order in your RussWave account on the web.

STAY IN THE LOOP
Choose notifications for new products, offers and updates. Personal update alerts use your account and the installed-product information shared by RussWave Connect on your computer. Notification categories can be changed at any time.

MADE FOR IPHONE AND IPAD
Enjoy an adaptive interface, smooth navigation, English and Norwegian language options, and support for your device’s accessibility settings.

RussWave Connect is a free companion app. RussWave audio plugins run on supported Mac and Windows computers; they are not installed or played on iPhone or iPad. This app displays existing licenses and subscriptions and does not change activations or purchase rights.

name: SA227 Performance
description:
SA227 Performance computes takeoff and landing performance for the SA227 Metro III from the Airplane Flight Manual 8AC (Reissue A, Section 4). Every number comes from the AFM tables by linear interpolation. Nothing is extrapolated past the tables.

TAKEOFF
• V1, VR, V2 and V50, takeoff torque
• Takeoff, accelerate-go and accelerate-stop distances against the runway
• Maximum takeoff weight from field length, climb and obstacle limits, with the limiting factor named
• Engine-out climb profile with obstacle clearance
• AFM configuration options such as anti-ice

LANDING
• Vref and landing distance for the runway
• Maximum landing weight and what limits it

WEATHER AND RUNWAYS
• Live METAR from aviationweather.gov, with wind converted to magnetic and split into headwind and crosswind
• Runway lengths, elevation, heading and slope from FAA NASR data, updated every 28-day cycle; Canada and Mexico from OurAirports
• Type the ATIS or AWOS values yourself when you are offline

TOLD CARD
• Departure and arrival on one card; print it with AirPrint or save it as PDF from the print sheet

WHEN A NUMBER IS NOT AVAILABLE
The app does not guess. If the conditions are outside the AFM charts, it says which limit was hit and why, instead of showing a number.

CHECKED AT EVERY LAUNCH
At every launch the app checks itself against AFM validation points and shows the result in About.

WORKS OFFLINE
After the first start, everything except live weather works without a connection.

FREE TRIAL AND LICENSE
Try every feature free for 30 days; nothing is charged and the trial ends by itself. Then the full version is a one-time purchase, no subscription. One purchase covers one iPhone and one iPad; change devices in About. For flight departments and fleets, contact us for an organization license.

IMPORTANT
SA227 Performance is a reference tool for pilots. It is not approved by the FAA or any other authority and does not replace the Airplane Flight Manual. The approved AFM and your operator's procedures always govern.

Support: sa227-performance.pages.dev/support.html

name: Salamboard: Islamic phrases
description:
Salamboard is a keyboard with ready-made phrases instead of letters. Salam and its reply, “Jazakallahu khayran”, a dua for the sick, condolences, Eid greetings: all in one tap. Arabic with full vowel marks, the right form for a brother or a sister, and the phrase in English or Russian.

Why not type it yourself?
• Everyone spells it differently. One phrase, dozens of spellings. Salamboard gives you a checked spelling, and every phrase shows where it comes from.
• A sister needs a different form. In Arabic, “you” sounds different for a brother and for a sister. Choose who you're writing to, and the keyboard picks the right form.

What the keyboard does
• Phrase and reply in one key. Someone wrote “As-salamu ‘alaykum”, and the reply is right under your finger.
• To a brother, a sister or everyone. Choose the addressee once, and the keyboard fills in the right form. The form for two opens with a long press.
• Short or full. A tap inserts the main form, a long press opens the others.
• In Arabic, English and Russian. Every Arabic phrase shows how to read it.
• 11 situations and “Mine”. Pin your favourites to “Mine”, and they always come first.

A keyboard you can trust
• No “Full Access”. The keyboard never asks for it and never goes online.
• Never reads what you type. Salamboard only inserts a phrase.
• No ads, no analytics. No counters, no trackers.
• Free, forever. No subscriptions and no paid features.

name: Sama Al-Mutewkl
seller_name: SAMA AL-MUTEWKL COMPANY FOR GENERAL TRADING LTD.
description:
Sama Al-Mutewkl Company was established on April 9, 2023, in Baghdad, with an ambitious vision to provide its valued customers with a modern and elegant selection of shoes and bags. With extensive experience in the fashion industry, the company aims to make Sama Al-Mutewkl the preferred destination for fashion enthusiasts in Iraq, while offering a distinctive shopping experience that combines high quality with affordable prices.

The company takes pride in offering a wide range of shoes and bags made from the finest materials, catering to all tastes and occasions.

SAMA AL-MUTEWKL is also committed to delivering outstanding customer service, working diligently to meet customer needs, exceed expectations, and build long-term relationships.

name: Samur: Homework Help
description:
Stuck on a question? Take a photo and send it.

Made for high school and university students, parents and teachers; intended for users aged 13 and over. When your solution is ready you get a notification: a short video where every step is written out with a pen and explained out loud.

HOW IT WORKS
1. Take a photo of the question or pick one from your gallery.
2. Crop to the one question you want to ask and choose the subject. Add a short note if you like.
3. Send it. When the solution is ready you get a notification and watch it under My Questions.

WHY SAMUR
- Not just the answer, the way there: each step is written on screen while the reason is explained.
- Pause, rewind or watch full screen.
- The final answer is also written below the video.
- Not helpful? Tell us or send a message and we will check and fix it.

SUBJECTS
Math, geometry, physics, chemistry, Turkish, history and English. Questions in English are explained in English; other questions are explained in Turkish.

CREDITS
- Each question costs 1 credit. Your first credit is on us.
- Free credits: watch 3 short ads, earn 1 credit. Ads per day are limited; you can see what is left on your Profile.
- Invite friends: a friend who joins with your code gets 2 credits right away; when their first question is solved, you get 10 credits.
- If a question cannot be read, it is returned and your credit is refunded.

SIMPLE AND SAFE
- No email or phone number needed to sign up.
- Only the solution team sees your questions. Users do not message each other.
- You can delete your account and all your data from inside the app.

Every solution is prepared and checked, so waiting time depends on how busy we are. You get a notification when yours is ready. Samur is designed to help you learn; its answers may not always be 100% correct.

The app interface is in Turkish.

CREDIT PACKS AND SAMUR PLUS
- 5, 15 and 40 credit packs are available in the app.
- Samur Plus (monthly, 6-month and yearly auto-renewing subscription): 30 questions a month, no ads, priority queue. The subscription renews automatically unless cancelled at least 24 hours before the end of the period; manage it in Settings > Apple ID > Subscriptions.

Terms of Use: https://baharogretmen.com/soruapp/kosullar.php
Privacy: https://baharogretmen.com/soruapp/gizlilik.php

name: Sand Workshop: Block Puzzle
description:
Sand Workshop is a relaxing sand puzzle where every block crumbles into colored sand. Drop pieces into a glass jar, watch the falling sand settle, and match colors to clear lines. It is a block puzzle with real sand physics and a beautiful goal: every level adds a layer to a sand art picture.

HOW TO PLAY
• Drag a block from the tray into the vessel. A ghost shows where it will land, then the block turns into sand.
• Make a line of one color from wall to wall: the sand flashes and pours into the jar of that color.
• Fill all the jars of the level to win and add a new layer to the picture.
• Keep the sand below the red line. Plan ahead: the sand slides and piles up!

WHY YOU WILL LOVE THIS SAND PUZZLE
• 144 levels in 12 chapters. Each chapter is a sand art picture: a winter forest, a samovar with bagels, a ginger cat on the windowsill, Moscow at night, sunflowers, a lighthouse by the sea, an autumn park, matryoshka dolls, mountains at dawn, an underwater world, hot air balloons and the northern lights.
• Satisfying falling sand: thousands of grains pour, slide and settle on their own.
• A fresh take on the classic block puzzle and color match games, with a calm pace and no timer.
• Helpful boosters: New Pieces, a Rainbow block that matches any color, and Shake to pack the sand.
• Large, clear pieces and gentle sounds. Play offline, no internet needed.
• A gallery of finished pictures to admire.

Relax, plan your moves and turn colored sand into art. Sand Workshop is free to play; it shows ads and offers optional in-app purchases.

name: Sandrift
description:
Sandrift is a pocket sand tray for iPhone. Drag your finger to pour grains; gravity, bounce, and dune stacking are calculated on device so you can keep painting in airplane mode.

Canvas — Seed sand with a stroke. Tune grain size and flow rate. Tap Demo for a sample river, Settle to nudge dunes tighter, Clear to empty the tray, or Save to store a PNG in your private gallery. Bundled grit maps tint grains for a workshop sand look.

Grains — Eight workshop palettes (Ochre Bench, Oxide Dust, Glass Teal, Moss Tray, Ink Grain, Pearl Meal, Ember Mix, Slate Mill) and five flow modes including Open Pour, Hourglass, Side Drift, Heavy Settle, and Whisper Fall.

Gallery — Browse local pieces with titles and timestamps. Rename, share through the system sheet, or delete. A few Sample plates appear on first launch so you can explore immediately.

Desk — Toggle haptics, reopen the field guide, read fifteen technique notes, open the privacy policy offline, erase the gallery, and check the bundle version.

Sandrift does not require an account and does not need a network connection after install. Nothing syncs to a Sandrift server.

name: Satr: Bilingual PDF Study
description:
Read English course PDFs with an English or Arabic interface. Keep your notes and confirmed meanings linked to the original page.

Organize lectures into courses. Confirm a term’s meaning, then choose it again when you select the same term in another lecture in that course. Different meanings remain separate, with their own sources.

Review only the notes and terms you choose. Try to recall the meaning, reveal it, mark your progress and return to the source. Saved content and review work locally.

Satr includes PDF import, handwriting, notes, search, annotated PDF export and full library backups. Translation uses Apple’s system service and depends on supported languages and downloaded models. Scanned-page OCR and cloud sync are not included.

Free plan: 5 PDFs and 1 course. Satr Pro is a one-time purchase that removes these number limits. Translation, notes, terminology and review are available within the free allowance. Local Pro does not include future cloud services.

name: SavaRun – free timed runs
description:
SavaRun is a free self-timed run in Ljubljana – for runners, walkers, families and anyone who wants to get moving whenever it suits them.

There is no group start and no schedule. Come to the start line, tap Start and run, jog or walk at your own pace. The app records your GPS track, guides you along the course with spoken alerts, stops at the finish and your time appears in the results.

HOW IT WORKS
• Sign up once – with e-mail, Google or Apple.
• Pick a route and go to the start.
• Tap Start or scan the QR code at the start line with the Camera app. If you tap Start before the line, the run begins with a beep and vibration the moment you cross it.
• Run. Lock the phone and put it in your pocket: the app keeps recording.
• At the finish the timing stops by itself. The server checks that you passed every checkpoint in order and covered the full course, and your time is added to the results.

GUIDED ALONG THE COURSE
• Spoken directions at checkpoints: straight on, left, right, slight or sharp turns, turnaround, which lane to take.
• A warning when you leave the course, telling you whether it is on your left or right, and a message when you are back on it.
• Lap and last-lap announcements on routes of several rounds.
• Sound and vibration at the finish – also with the phone locked.

WHAT YOU GET
• Free – no entry fee, no subscription, no in-app purchases.
• Any time – no group start, no timetable.
• Every pace welcome – run, jog or walk.
• Results, leaderboards and your run history.
• Route pages with a photo, description and map with checkpoints and points of interest (drinking water, parking, swimming beach …).
• Import runs from Strava or from a GPX file, and export your runs as GPX.
• Add a comment and choose whether a run is public right after you finish.
• Your own settings: GPS accuracy, checkpoint alert distance and how many runs a day count on one route.

PRIVACY
Your location is used only from Start to Finish of a run you started, and your GPS track is never public. Public results show only your nickname and time, and you can hide any run from the public results. No ads, no tracking and no analytics. You can delete your account and all your data at any time in the app.

ROUTES
We started with routes along the Sava and in Tivoli park in Ljubljana. More will be added as they open – in other parts of Ljubljana and in other towns across Slovenia.

Run at your own risk and follow traffic rules.

name: SBOX KDS
description:
SBOX KDS là ứng dụng màn hình bếp cho nhà hàng, quán ăn, quán cà phê đang dùng hệ thống bán hàng SBOX (sboxpos.com). Đặt iPad hoặc iPhone ở bếp, quầy pha chế: món do thu ngân hoặc phục vụ báo bếp hiện ngay trên màn hình. Đăng nhập bằng mã cửa hàng và tài khoản do cửa hàng cấp; ứng dụng không có đăng ký tài khoản.

NHẬN MÓN
• Món mới hiện ngay khi quầy báo bếp, kèm chuông báo.
• Ghi chú và phần thêm của khách hiện rõ trên từng món.
• Xem lại vé đã ra món trong 6 giờ gần nhất và gọi lại khi cần.

HAI CÁCH XEM
• Gộp món: món giống nhau của nhiều bàn gộp thành một thẻ để làm cùng lúc.
• Theo bàn: đủ món của từng bàn, từng hóa đơn.
• Lọc chờ làm, đang làm, làm xong, món trễ, bàn chưa làm món nào.

CHẾ BIẾN
• Bấm «Bắt đầu làm», «Ra món»: quầy và phục vụ thấy trạng thái ngay.
• Cảnh báo món chờ quá số phút cửa hàng đặt.
• Đọc tên món cần làm bằng giọng nói, chọn giọng và tốc độ đọc.
• In phiếu khi ra món ra máy in của cửa hàng (tùy chọn).

DÙNG TRONG BẾP
• Giao diện sáng, tối; ba cỡ chữ để nhìn từ xa.
• Xếp món lâu nhất hoặc mới nhất lên trước.

TÀI KHOẢN
• Xóa tài khoản ngay trong ứng dụng: menu ⋮ → Thông tin & tài khoản → Xóa tài khoản.

Các chức năng hiển thị theo gói dịch vụ và phân quyền của cửa hàng.
Chính sách quyền riêng tư: https://sboxpos.com/privacy-policy-pos.html

name: ScentForge: Perfume Creator
description:
Start with a perfume you love, and get a blend that is yours, with its own name. Free.

You don't need any chemistry knowledge, and you don't need an account. Start as a guest and your blends are saved on this device. Sign in when you want them on every device.

THREE WAYS TO START
• Start with a perfume you love: type its name and see its key notes in the "Found it" card. Tap "Make my version" for a blend inspired by it, with a name of its own. Only you can see which perfume it started from. A photo of your own bottle stays on your device.
• Find your scent in 2 minutes: a few quick questions, no perfume knowledge needed.
• Start from a vibe: Woody & Smoky, Fresh & Clean, Floral & Romantic, Warm Amber, Oud & Arabian or Sweet Gourmand. You can also start from one of five perfume traditions.

MAKE IT YOURS
• Swap any note, go fresher or warmer, softer or bolder.
• Choose a spray (with alcohol) or an oil (no alcohol added), the attar way.
• Get name ideas in your language, or write your own, and save it free in My Blends.

SEE YOUR BLEND BEFORE IT EXISTS
• Balance: every blend gets a score with plain reasons, and tips when something can be better.
• Scent Clock: see how your blend unfolds hour by hour, from the opening through the heart to the trail, with an estimate of how far it carries and how long it lasts.
• Blend passport: your notes and balance on one page, with Show as QR code, its Scent emblem and Hear its day. Blends stay private until you choose to share them.

EVERY DAY
• Wear Coach: what to wear today, from your blends and the perfumes you own, for the weather and the occasion, with how much to apply and where. Every wear tool sits under it: Week ahead, Shelf map, Scent Diary and Reminders.
• Reminders, only if you turn them on: a morning Wear Coach reminder and a Nose Academy streak reminder.

LEARN AS YOU GO
• Nose Academy: one material a day in a sixty-second lesson, with streaks and badges.
• Scent Galaxy: explore 800+ notes as a night sky you can zoom, grouped by family.
• Perfume Atlas: visit ten perfume traditions, from ancient Mesopotamia to the modern lab, and collect Atlas stamps.
• Perfume library and Perfume words: look up any note, or any perfume word, without the jargon.
• What note is this?: photograph a spice, a flower or a wood and find out which note it is.

MORE WAYS TO CREATE
• Studio: every control, note by note.
• AI Designer and Mood board: describe an idea or a moment and get a first draft to refine.
• Try two blends together, Scent Duet (make one perfume with someone over a link), A perfume from a name, Bottle a moment and Rebuild a memory together.
• Gift a scent with your own message, a gift link and a card, or seal a blend in a Time capsule that opens on a date you choose.
• Community: browse blends people chose to publish, like them and remix your own copy. Report anything that shouldn't be there, or hide a creator you don't want to see.

EVERYTHING YOU CAN DO
One screen lists every feature, with a search that understands English, Arabic, Hinglish and Urdu.

WORKS OFFLINE
Every screen is built into the app, so it opens and works without a connection, and your saved blends stay on your phone. The perfume search, the AI tools, Community and syncing need a connection, and the app tells you so before you start.

AI ONLY IF YOU WANT IT
The perfume search, AI Designer, Mood board and the photo features are optional. The app asks before it sends anything to the AI service, and you can report any AI result.

MADE FOR YOU
• English, Arabic, Hinglish and Urdu.
• Noir (dark) and Atelier (light) themes.
• Sign in with Apple, Google or email whenever you like.
• Delete your account and your data from inside the app at any time.

Questions or ideas? Write to info@scentforge.tech

name: Schuss: Tilt Ski Racing
description:
Tilt your phone to ski. The further you lean, the harder you carve. The slope gives you speed; every hard turn scrubs some of it off. Find the line, hold your nerve and beat the clock.

TODAY'S RACES
Four new courses every day, the same for everyone, so every time is a fair fight:
• Slalom: tight gates, quick turns, no time to breathe.
• Giant slalom: longer, rounder turns at more speed.
• Super-G: fast and wide open, with a jump to hold your line through.
• Downhill: flat out at over 100 km/h, with two jumps.
Miss a gate and it costs you seconds. The polished racing line shows the fast way down; beat the gold time, race your own ghost, and add up all four for the day's combined.

FREE SKIING
Green, blue, red and black runs that wind down the mountain until you crash. Trees, rocks, skiers who've stopped dead, ski schools in a line, ice where you least want it, and kickers for big air. The further you go, the busier, narrower and steeper it gets. Ski into a lift station to bank your run with a bonus, and open the next slope.

LEADERBOARDS FOR EVERYONE
Every finisher is on the leaderboard, medal or not: each race today, all four added up, and each slope today, this week and all time. Three initials, no account.

SKI SCHOOL
New to racing? Follow an instructor down a practice course for each race, with tips as you go. Lessons don't count, so take as many as you like.

MADE FOR TILTING
• Hold the phone however suits you: straight ahead is set as the race starts, and one tap resets it
• Prefer a finger? Drag to steer instead
• The screen stays on while you ski

No accounts and no email. Adverts are never personalised. The slopes ski offline; the daily leaderboards need a connection.

name: Scootee
description:
Scootee brings everyday work records together for employees and field teams.

Use your organisation-provided work account to:
• Record attendance and review your working-time history.
• Start work journeys, record routes and revisit previous trips.
• Submit expense claims with receipt photos or PDF attachments.
• View mileage allowances separately from manually submitted expenses.
• Follow requests and communicate through workplace conversations.
• Access leave, payslips and other work tools enabled by your organisation.

During a journey you start, Scootee uses location to record travel and may continue recording in the background. You can finish the journey in the app and manage location permissions in iPhone Settings.

Features and access depend on your organisation’s configuration and your account permissions. An active Scootee work account is required.

name: Seconds: Island Clock
description:
See the current second of your iPhone’s local time at a glance.

Seconds puts a simple 00–59 clock display in a Live Activity on supported Dynamic Island devices and on the Lock Screen. Tap Start to begin a session and Stop when you’re done. The in-app display also shows the current second.

• Follows your device’s system clock, including the change from 59 to 00.
• Uses system-rendered time updates without continuous background app execution.
• Does not play background audio or activate an audio session.
• No accounts, advertising, analytics, or tracking.

Live Activities require iOS permission. iOS controls where and when the display appears. Sessions last up to eight hours and require a new Start after ending. Seconds may be hidden when the screen is dimmed or another system activity takes priority. Dynamic Island presentation requires a compatible device.

name: SeesawCrumbKin
description:
The bakery has exactly one display stand, and it is a seesaw. A cupcake rolls off the conveyor. You drop it on the left, near the end. The plank creaks and dips. A macaron next, on the right, further out. Not enough. A cake slice. Better. The bubble slides back into the green.

SeesawCrumbKin is a balancing puzzle that runs on real torque: weight times distance from the pivot. A heavy slice far out pushes hard; a light macaron close in barely does anything. Drag each pastry from the tray onto any spot on either plank, keep an eye on what's coming next on the belt, and try to place the whole order without letting the plank stay tipped. Stay out of balance too long and the tip fuse burns down. Stack more than a spot can hold and the tower topples.

The menu gets more complicated as you go. Jelly domes wobble and take up two stack spaces. Hot buns arrive straight from the oven and have to be placed before they burn. A sliding pivot moves after every drop. And the Grand Patisserie throws all of it at you at once.

60 levels sit in a glass display case, unlocked shelf by shelf. Each was built from a known solution, so a perfectly level finish, with sprinkles and three stars, is always possible.

Daily Bake is one new order a day, the same for every baker. Rush is the endless one: pastries keep coming, and every balanced tray gets boxed up for bonus points. Both feed the All Time and Today ranks.

Pastries jiggle, the plank creaks on its spring, and sprinkles burst when you find balance. There's a music-box tune, cartoon boings, and haptic thumps that get heavier with heavier treats.

No account, no typing, no ads, no in-app purchases. Plays offline.

name: Sensory Shuffle
description:
Need a play idea for your toddler or preschooler right now? Open Sensory Shuffle and tap a tile. You get one idea, ready to try.

Sensory Shuffle gives parents of 2 to 5 year olds quick play activities, one at a time.

Pick the kind of play:
Move & Balance
Touch & Explore
Listen & Look
Push, Pull & Carry

Or tap Shuffle for a surprise. Set the pace to Active or Slow & quiet, and the cards you get match it.

Each card has a name, two or three short steps, how long it takes (1 to 5 minutes), what it needs, and a safety note. Most need nothing at all. The rest use one everyday thing, like a towel, a pillow or a laundry basket.

The free deck has ten ideas. Four more decks are available to buy, one at a time or together as All Four Decks:
Waiting Room: quiet seated ideas for appointments, lines and restaurants.
Burn It Off: big indoor movement for high-energy days.
Indoor Day: indoor ideas for long days inside and small spaces. Brothers and sisters can join in.
Backyard & Park: outdoor ideas for a yard or a park lawn.

A deck you buy is yours to keep, and you can restore purchases on a new device.

Heart the cards your child likes and find them again from the Home screen.

There's no account to make and no child profile. Open it and play.

Sensory Shuffle was created by an occupational therapist. It offers play ideas, not therapy. If you have concerns about your child's development, talk to your child's doctor or therapist.

Published by WristSkill Labs LLC.

name: Serviced: Car Maintenance Log
description:
Serviced is a car maintenance log for your iPhone. It keeps every oil change, repair, mod and receipt, and reminds you when the next service is due.

LOG A JOB IN SECONDS
• Pick the job, check the mileage Serviced has worked out, add the cost
• Scan a receipt and the date, shop, mileage and total fill themselves in
• Type the VIN and the make, model and year fill themselves in
• Each job you log gets its stamp in the service book
• Or ask Siri: "Log an oil change in Serviced"

KNOW WHAT'S DUE
• Reminders by miles or by months, whichever comes first
• Serviced works out your mileage from your records, so it never asks for it every week
• A windshield-sticker widget for your Home Screen, plus Lock Screen widgets

SELL IT WITH ITS HISTORY
• A printed service history with a check code that a buyer can verify
• Hand the whole logbook to the next owner. It opens in their copy of Serviced, and they keep adding to it
• Your name and address are left out

YOUR RECORDS STAY YOURS
• No account, no ads, no tracking
• Kept in your own iCloud too, so a new iPhone gets everything back
• A plain copy in the Files app every week
• Deleted records wait 30 days before they're gone
• Export everything at any time: a spreadsheet, or one file with every photo and receipt

BRING YOUR OLD RECORDS
Import from Fuelly, Drivvo, Road Trip MPG, Simply Auto, Fuelio, Spritmonitor and spreadsheet exports. You see everything before it's saved, and one tap undoes an import.

FREE FOR ONE CAR
Everything above is free for one car. One purchase covers the whole garage: every car, the printed history and logbook file, unlimited receipt scans, and widgets. Family Sharing is included. No subscription.

name: Sesaku: Keuangan Keluarga
description:
Sesaku adalah aplikasi keuangan untuk keluarga Indonesia. Kas keluarga, tagihan bulanan, cicilan, tujuan bersama, sampai uang saku anak, semuanya dicatat di satu tempat dan bisa dilihat berdua dari HP masing-masing.

DUA RUANG DALAM SATU APLIKASI
Ruang Keluarga dilihat dan diedit berdua. Ruang Pribadi hanya milikmu sendiri: pasangan tidak bisa melihatnya kecuali kamu sendiri yang membukanya.

YANG BISA DICATAT
• Pemasukan dan pengeluaran per kategori, dengan sub-kategori yang bisa kalian tambah sendiri
• Dompet: tunai, rekening, dan e-wallet, saldonya dihitung dari catatan
• Tagihan dan cicilan beserta tanggal jatuh temponya
• Utang dan piutang, lengkap dengan sisa pokoknya
• Tujuan bersama: menabung untuk sesuatu, terlihat progresnya
• Aset dan investasi
• Maintenance berkala: servis AC, ganti oli, kuras toren, dihitung dari kapan terakhir dikerjakan

LAPORAN YANG JELAS
Lihat uang keluarga per hari, minggu, bulan, atau tahun, dengan grafik arus uang dan ke mana uang pergi, dibandingkan dengan periode sebelumnya.

UNTUK ANAK
Uang saku, tugas berhadiah poin, dan Mode Anak yang bisa dibuka anak tanpa melihat keuangan orang tuanya. Anak tidak punya akun; semuanya dicatat orang tua.

MENCATAT DENGAN CEPAT
Tiga ketukan lewat papan angka, atau ketik biasa seperti mengirim pesan: "kopi 20rb dari gopay". Bisa juga memotret struk.

KALENDER SATU RUMAH
Jatuh tempo tagihan, cicilan, jadwal maintenance, agenda keluarga, dan tanggal penting lainnya berkumpul di satu kalender dan pengingat.

ALAT HITUNG
Kalkulator cicilan yang menerjemahkan "bunga flat 0,9% per bulan" jadi bunga efektif per tahun, plus KPR, dana darurat, dana pendidikan anak, dana pensiun, biaya kendaraan, zakat, dan titik impas usaha.

PRIVASI
Tidak ada iklan. Data keuangan disimpan di server Sesaku dan tidak dijual ke siapa pun. Kebijakan privasi dan penghapusan akun ada di dalam aplikasi.

Seluruh aplikasi dalam Bahasa Indonesia, dengan angka rupiah dan kebiasaan keuangan keluarga Indonesia.

Aplikasi ini untuk masuk ke akun Sesaku yang sudah ada. Butuh bantuan akses atau akun? Hubungi admin lewat tombol di layar masuk.

name: Sessionmail
description:
Sessionmail turns your Session booking links into emails that are ready to send.

Paste a link to one session, or to your whole booking page, and Sessionmail pulls in the session titles, descriptions, dates, time slots, prices and gallery photos. You get a finished email in seconds instead of rebuilding the same details by hand.

MAKE IT YOURS
• Tap any line in the preview to rewrite it
• Choose which photos lead the email
• Pick from forty fonts and set your own button color
• Add text, photos and buttons above or below your sessions
• Switch the preview between desktop and phone

SEND FROM YOUR OWN EMAIL SERVICE
Sessionmail hands the finished email to the email service you already use: Mailchimp, Brevo, MailerLite or Constant Contact. Send it now or schedule it. Flodesk works too, with a guided copy-and-paste. Your subscriber list never leaves your email service.

KEEP TRACK
• Drafts save as you work and follow you between your phone and your computer
• Send yourself a test before your list sees anything
• See the campaigns you have sent and how they performed

Sessionmail for iPhone is the companion app for photographers who already have a Sessionmail account. Sign in with your existing account to pick up where you left off.

Sessionmail is an independent product and is not affiliated with Session (usesession.com).

name: ShelfTag
description: ShelfTag designs shelf, bin, and product labels and exports them as PDFs. Offline business tool with no account.

name: Shopping List - Market
description:
Make your shopping list and keep your loyalty cards, all in one place.

Shopping List is simple, fast and works entirely offline: no account, no ads, and your data stays on your device.

LISTS THAT FOLLOW THE STORE
• Items sorted by category, in your aisle order
• Tick them off as you shop and see your progress at a glance
• List finished? Start it over in one tap, or duplicate it
• Add an item without leaving the list

YOUR LOYALTY CARDS ALWAYS WITH YOU
• Scan your cards' barcodes with the camera
• At the checkout, the card opens full size at full brightness
• Link a card to a list to have it at the right time

BUILT-IN CALCULATOR
• Note item prices: each list's total adds up by itself

SHARING AND BACKUP
• Share a list as text, QR code or file
• A preview before every import, and the import can be undone
• Full backup in one file, kept wherever you like
• Automatic restore points to go back in time

YOUR WAY
• Six colour moods, light or dark theme
• Designed for iPhone and iPad
• In English and French

PRIVACY FIRST
• No account, no ads, no trackers
• No data collected, nothing sent over the Internet
• Your data is not copied to iCloud

name: Shore Guide - Offline
description:
Shore Guide tells you what the sea is doing at your beach today, and when it is worth going.

Pick any of 55,000 named beaches around the world. You get the tide curve, high and low water, sunrise and sunset, moonrise and the Moon phase. All of it is worked out on your phone, so it still works on a headland with no signal. There is no account to create.

WHAT YOU GET

• Fishing. The best hours today, scored from moving water, low light, the Moon and solunar periods. Every score comes with its reason in a sentence.
• Swimming and picnics. Good hours from the tide and daylight. With online weather on, wind, waves, rain and UV count too.
• Planner. Choose your dates and Shore Guide ranks the days. Add the one you like to your calendar or share it.
• Calendar. A month of days rated at a glance, with Moon phase and tide times.
• Sky view. Where the Sun and Moon will be through the day, and when the light is low.
• Reminders. A notification before a good window at your beach.

HONEST ABOUT ACCURACY

Tides come from EOT20, a global tide model built from satellite measurements, corrected with 322 real tide gauges. For US beaches near a NOAA station the app uses NOAA's published tables. We checked every US and Australian beach against live gauges, and the tide card shows how confident the app is for your beach. The numbers are under More > How it works.

A beach on a lake or far up a river says so. It does not show a made-up sea tide.

A prediction is a guide. Wind and weather move the real water level, so check local flags and conditions before you go in.

SEE WHY

The Sun, Earth and Moon view shows today's line-up and explains spring and neap tides in plain words.

16 LANGUAGES

Beach names appear in the local script under the translation, so you can match the road signs when you travel. Search works in any script.

PRIVATE

No account, no ads, no analytics, no tracking. Your location stays on your phone. The weather forecast is optional, and it sends only the beach's position rounded to about 1 km.

One purchase. No subscription and nothing more to buy inside the app.

The map background and the weather forecast need an internet connection. Everything else works offline.

name: SignalKey
description:
SignalKey is a pocket reader for the Signal Identification Wiki, the catalogue of radio signals that shortwave listeners and radio technicians have been building for years. It answers one question: what am I listening to?

Tune across the bands and you will meet traces you cannot name — a pair of rails that shift without warning, a comb of tones that appears for four seconds and vanishes, a soft hump that carries a voice you almost recognise. SignalKey turns those shapes into a shortlist. Pick the texture you can see on the pattern board, enter the frequency and bandwidth you measured, and the catalogue narrows from a thousand entries to a handful of candidates, each one shown with its band, its modulation and the reason it survived.

Every entry opens into a reference card: a waterfall drawn from the shape rules of its family, the recorded frequency range, mode, bandwidth and location, and a short reference clip to compare against your own recording. Entries nobody has identified yet become a board of open cases you can keep and chase.

Your own log book stays on the phone. Frequency, time, place, a screenshot and the conclusion you reached — after a season those notes start to show the hours and the conditions that actually produce traffic at your location.

SignalKey is an independent reader. It is not affiliated with the wiki, and it never asks you to sign in.

name: SILLORYS
description:
# SILLORY
**Sunlight & Shadow Workshop**

**Understand the sun. Explore your space. Discover the patterns of natural light.**

SILLORY is a sunlight and shadow analysis workspace designed to help you explore how natural sunlight interacts with your home, windows, balcony, and surrounding environment.

Combining solar position calculations, interactive space modeling, horizon obstruction analysis, and personal sunlight observations, SILLORY transforms everyday spaces into a practical sunlight exploration studio.

Whether you're planning a reading corner, evaluating sunlight near a window, exploring seasonal changes, or observing how nearby buildings affect your space, SILLORY provides intuitive tools for understanding the movement of natural light.

### Solar Path & Position

Explore the sun's movement throughout the day using an interactive solar path diagram.

Adjust the date, time, and location to examine solar elevation, azimuth, sunrise, sunset, and daylight duration. Compare solar paths across different seasons and discover how the sun's position changes throughout the year.

### Interactive Space Modeling

Create personalized room and window models with adjustable dimensions and orientations.

Define window width, height, sill position, wall direction, and surrounding geometry. Explore how sunlight may enter your space at different times through interactive geometric visualizations.

### Horizon & Shadow Analysis

Build custom horizon profiles to represent nearby buildings, trees, walls, and other obstructions.

Edit obstruction angles, explore their relationship with the solar path, and estimate when direct sunlight may be blocked by your surroundings.

### Sunlight Observation Journal

Record real-world sunlight conditions in your favorite spaces.

Log observation times, identify areas receiving direct sunlight or shade, add notes, and compare your observations with calculated sunlight predictions.

Build a personal history of how natural light changes throughout the day.

### Seasonal Sunlight Insights

Discover how sunlight exposure varies across months and seasons.

Explore annual sunlight heatmaps, compare summer and winter solar paths, and evaluate estimated direct sunlight duration for different rooms, windows, and selected areas.

### Key Features

- Interactive solar path visualization
- Solar elevation and azimuth calculations
- Sunrise, sunset, and daylight information
- Custom room and window geometry
- Window orientation and dimension editing
- Horizon and obstruction profile editor
- Geometric sunlight and shadow estimates
- Sunlight observation records
- Predicted versus observed sunlight comparisons
- Annual sunlight heatmaps
- Seasonal and multi-space comparisons
- PDF reports and data export
- Offline calculations and local data storage

### Designed for Everyday Exploration

SILLORY combines practical solar calculations with a refined, interactive workspace.

Create your spaces, explore sunlight patterns, compare seasonal changes, and build a clearer picture of how natural light moves through your surroundings.

Sunlight results are geometric estimates based on your selected location, space dimensions, and obstruction models. Actual conditions may vary due to weather, glass properties, reflections, and unmodeled objects.

**Follow the sun. Understand your space. See light differently.**

name: SingMouldMaths
description:
The clay is still wet, the wheel is turning, and a 7 and a 5 are wobbling side by side. Push one into the other and they squish into a soft, shiny 12. The kiln door wants 12. In it goes, the door slams, and the fire roars.

That is SingMouldMaths: a squishy number puzzle on a slowly spinning potter's wheel. Drag one numbered blob onto another to mould them together and add their values. Flick an even blob (or double-tap it) to split it into two equal halves. Your goal is to make the exact number painted on the kiln door before the moisture meter runs dry and the clay sets for good.

The 48 pots sit across 16 studio shelves, and the studio keeps teaching you new tricks. Cracked clay won't mould at all, so you have to split your way around it. Glazed clay multiplies instead of adding, which turns a small blob into a big answer fast. Later pots have twin kiln doors that both want firing. Fewer moves and wetter clay earn more stars, so there's always a neater route to find.

Every day there's a Daily Kiln, the same pot for every potter, with its own leaderboard next to the all-time one. You play under a cheerful made-up potter name and can re-roll it whenever you fancy.

The blobs jiggle and stretch under your finger, merges pull a gooey bridge between them, and the soundtrack is wooden marimba and hand drums. The first pot teaches you by doing, with a guiding hand instead of a wall of text.

It plays offline, needs no sign-up, and has no ads or in-app purchases. Just clay, numbers and a hot kiln.

name: Sintonia – Radio locali
description:
Sintonia è l'app delle radio italiane, con le radio locali in primo piano. È fatta da chi fa radio: nasce da Radio FM Faleria, editore radiofonico locale, per dare voce ai territori.

LE RADIO DEL TUO TERRITORIO
• Tutte le regioni d'Italia, con le radio di ogni città
• "Vicino a te": le radio della tua zona, con la posizione (facoltativa) o scegliendo la regione
• Le reti nazionali e le locali più ascoltate

ASCOLTA E GUARDA
• Titolo, artista e copertina del brano in onda, quando la radio li trasmette
• Video in diretta per le radio che lo hanno, anche a schermo intero e in finestra (Picture in Picture)
• Ascolto anche a schermo spento, con i controlli nella schermata di blocco

TUTTO IL MONDO
• Le radio di ogni paese e le più ascoltate al mondo
• Cerca per nome, città, regione, paese e genere: pop, news, sport, dance, musica italiana e altri

LE TUE RADIO
• Preferiti e ultime ascoltate, salvati sul telefono: nessuna registrazione
• Sveglia con la tua radio preferita
• Timer di spegnimento per addormentarti con la radio
• Condividi quello che stai ascoltando

PRIVACY PRIMA DI TUTTO
Nessun account e nessuna pubblicità. La posizione, se la attivi, serve solo a trovare la tua regione e non viene salvata né inviata.

Sei un'emittente? Scrivici per correggere i tuoi dati, aggiungere il logo o la diretta video: andreav@radiofm.biz

Nomi, loghi e marchi delle emittenti appartengono ai rispettivi proprietari. I dati delle stazioni provengono da Radio Browser (radio-browser.info), database libero e gratuito.

name: Sinuca Brasil: Sinuquinha
description:
Sinuca de verdade no celular: mire, dê efeito na branca e encaçape contra gente de verdade em partidas online 1x1.

Escolha entre 8 Ball, Sinuca Brasileira e Sinuquinha. As três regras estão disponíveis no treino contra robôs, nas mesas online e nos desafios entre amigos. Sinuca, bilhar, bola 8, pool: o nome muda de bar para bar, a vontade de matar a bola é a mesma.

MESAS PARA TODOS OS NÍVEIS
• Treino — sinuca offline contra robô, sem gastar moedas
• Iniciante — online, entrada de 100 moedas, quem vence leva 180
• Profissional — entrada de 500, prêmio de 900
• Mestre — entrada de 2.000, prêmio de 3.600
• Lenda — entrada de 10.000, prêmio de 18.000
• Amigos — desafie um amigo para uma partida particular

ESCOLHA SUA REGRA
Ao tocar em uma mesa, escolha 8 Ball, Brasileira ou Sinuquinha. No botão Amigos, escolha a regra e o valor da entrada antes de convidar.

SINUCA BOLA 8 (8 BALL)
• Lisas de 1 a 7 e listradas de 9 a 15
• A primeira bola encaçapada sem falta define o seu grupo
• Encaçapou uma do seu grupo, continua na mesa
• Falta dá bola na mão para o adversário, em qualquer lugar da mesa
• A bola 8 fica por último: só depois de limpar o seu grupo. Matou antes, perdeu

SINUCA BRASILEIRA
• 7 bolas coloridas, de 1 a 7, cada uma vale o seu número
• Encaçape em ordem crescente: a bola da vez é sempre a de menor número
• Caçapa cantada: antes de cada tacada, toque na caçapa em que a bola vai cair
• Falta dá o castigo ao adversário, que joga com bola na mão
• Quando a preta cai, vence quem somou mais pontos

SINUQUINHA (PAR OU ÍMPAR)
• Todas as bolas são lisas: cada jogador fica com as pares ou com as ímpares
• A primeira bola válida encaçapada, de 2 a 15, define o grupo
• Limpe o seu grupo antes de encaçapar a bola 1, que decide a partida
• Bateu direto na adversária ou na bola 1 fora da vez: duas bolas de castigo
• Encaçapou bola adversária: falta, uma bola de castigo e troca de vez
• Castigos seguem as menores bolas adversárias e não se somam; a bola 1 nunca é castigo
• Branca encaçapada ou fora da mesa: reposição no D, com saída para frente

PARA QUEM GOSTA DE COMPETIR
• Temporadas com divisões para subir e títulos para colecionar
• Ranking geral, mensal e VIP
• Prêmio diário em moedas
• Perfil com vitórias, títulos e as últimas partidas

NA MESA
• Física realista: tabela, efeito e força em cada tacada
• Mira com linha até a bola e controle de efeito na branca
• 30 segundos por tacada, para a partida não arrastar
• Chat rápido com frases prontas e GIFs
• 5 modelos de mesa: Azul Brasil, Clássica Verde, Rubi, Violeta e Carbono
• Feito para jogar com o celular deitado

PERGUNTAS FREQUENTES

Dá para jogar sinuca offline?
Dá. Depois de entrar na sua conta, as três regras do Treino contra robôs funcionam sem internet. As mesas online precisam de conexão.

Qual a diferença entre bola 8 e sinuca brasileira?
Na bola 8 cada jogador tem o seu grupo, lisas ou listradas, e vence quem matar a 8 no final. Na sinuca brasileira são 7 bolas coloridas encaçapadas em ordem, e vence quem somar mais pontos.

Dá para jogar com meus amigos?
Dá. No botão Amigos você desafia um amigo para uma partida só entre vocês dois.

As moedas valem dinheiro?
Não. As moedas são virtuais: servem para entrar nas mesas e não têm valor em dinheiro.

O jogo é grátis?
É grátis para jogar, online e offline.

FEITO NO BRASIL
Sinuca com a cara da mesa de bar, do salão e da resenha com os amigos.

Baixe o Sinuca Brasil e pegue o taco.

COMPRAS OPCIONAIS
O app oferece pacotes de moedas virtuais e assinaturas VIP. As moedas são usadas somente dentro do jogo, sem conversão ou resgate em dinheiro. As assinaturas são renovadas automaticamente e podem ser gerenciadas ou canceladas nos ajustes da sua conta da App Store.

name: Skleyenie
description:
Skleyenie — это спокойное приложение для хранения ваших туристических воспоминаний, где можно аккуратно собрать билеты, маршруты и снимки из поездок. Оно создано для тех, кто любит сохранять следы своих путешествий, без лишних сложных инструментов.

Вы можете добавлять отдельные записи билетов, загружать фотографии сразу пачкой и создавать отдельные альбомы для каждой поездки. В коллекции все записи сортируются по категориям: транспорт, места, жильё и другие события. Есть поиск и фильтры по годам и поездкам, чтобы легко найти нужное воспоминание среди собранных записей.

Для каждой поездки оформляется отдельный альбом: выбирается обложка, указывается название, направление, даты начала и возвращения, а также можно добавить свободное описание. Постепенно собирая записи, вы открываете достижения, следите за количеством посещённых городов и поездок, отслеживаете свой уровень коллекционера. Все ваши путешествия складываются в личную летопись, которую приятно пересматривать со временем.

name: SKY Sound DE Feedback 8CH
description:

แต่ละช่องมี

• VOICE ONLY ปิดไมค์ระหว่างประโยค เปิดทันทีเมื่อมีเสียงคน

ไม่มีดีเลย์ (zero latency) ถ้าอินเทอร์เฟซหรือบัฟเฟอร์ทำงานไม่ทัน เสียงจะผ่านตรงแทนการเงียบ

name: Slavic Queens Club
description:
Slavic Queens Club — клуб для русскоговорящих девушек Парижа: встречи, общение и поддержка.

В приложении:
• Афиша клуба: бранчи, мастер-классы, прогулки и вечера. Записывайся в пару касаний, а если мест нет — вставай в лист ожидания: освободившиеся места достаются по очереди.
• Билет с QR-кодом для входа — в приложении и в Apple Wallet, с адресом, картой и всем, что нужно в день встречи.
• Клубная карта участницы в Apple Wallet.
• Уведомления: новая встреча, освободилось место, напоминание накануне. Если время или место встречи меняется, билет в Wallet обновляется сам.

Клуб основала Тоня Грымова. Она из Москвы и уже 14 лет живёт во Франции: «Я знаю, как важно в другой стране иметь рядом своих людей. Поэтому я создала этот клуб — чтобы русскоговорящие девушки Парижа могли встречаться, делиться советами и помогать друг другу».
 
Вступление в клуб — по заявке, её рассматривает команда клуба.

name: Smarfle for Service Businesses
description:
Smarfle runs the day of a service business from one app. Owners see every job, invoice and customer. Technicians get their day, the address, the gate code and a big Start button. Everything stays in sync with the office.

Built for field crews
• My Day shows today's jobs in route order with the customer, address and access notes
• Navigate, call or text the customer in one tap
• Tap On my way, Arrived, Start and Complete, with the customer's signature
• Add before and after photos, notes, checklist items and parts used
• Clock in and out on each job

Works with no signal
Basements, rural roads and dead zones are part of the job. Smarfle keeps your day on the phone, so you can open jobs, tick the checklist, add photos and complete work offline. Everything uploads by itself when the signal comes back, with the time you tapped it.

Run the business
• Jobs, recurring visits, a dispatch board and a calendar
• Estimates customers sign on their phone and invoices they pay online
• Cash and check payments recorded on the spot
• Customer records with history, notes and documents
• Two-way texts and email with your customers
• Reports on revenue, jobs and your team

Made for pest control, cleaning, lawn care, HVAC, plumbing and other home service businesses.

Requires a Smarfle account. Sign in with the email and password you use at smarfle.com.

Questions? Email founder@smarfle.com

description:

Take orders in the field on your phone. Orders are saved on the phone until you send them, so you can keep working without signal. Your shop's billing computer turns each sent order into a bill.

- Orders with customer, salesman and notes; save drafts or send
- Print order receipts on a Bluetooth thermal printer
- Customers with balances, history and account statements

- Money in and out, day book and day close
- View bills, purchases and suppliers

name: Smenio: Georgian Audiobooks
description:
Smenio is an audiobook app in Georgian. Georgian classics and world literature, all read aloud in Georgian: Rustaveli, Ilia Chavchavadze, Vazha-Pshavela, Akaki Tsereteli, Kldiashvili and Javakhishvili, Dostoevsky, Mark Twain and Cervantes.

With the text

• Save favourite passages as bookmarks and add notes.

Listen your way
• Speed, a sleep timer and controls on the lock screen.

• Download books and listen offline (Premium).

Library and habits

One account holds up to five profiles, including kid profiles. A kid profile shows only family books.

About the voices
Smenio's books are read by AI-generated voices. Each voice has its own name and is marked “AI voice” on the book page. The texts are in the public domain, and every source is listed in the app under About.

Free and Premium
A preview of every book and, as a rule, its first chapter are free. Premium unlocks the whole catalogue. Premium can't be bought yet: Smenio gives it as a gift, or you earn it by inviting friends.

name: SnapTag - Geo Tag Photo
description:
Prove where and when every photo was taken.

SnapTag stamps each shot with the address, coordinates, date and local time, and seals it with a Space-Time ID: a colour pinwheel calculated from the photo's place (space) & time. Change the place or the time and the pinwheel no longer matches. With over a billion possible IDs, guessing one is hopeless.

CATCH EDITS INSTANTLY
Open any photo or screenshot in Verify. AI on your iPhone reads the printed place and time and checks them against the Space-Time ID. In seconds you'll see:
• Authentic: place, time and picture all match
• ID mismatch: the place or time was edited
• Picture altered: the stamp was moved onto another photo
An invisible watermark across the whole picture ties it to its ID, and it still holds up after messaging apps and screenshots.

MADE FOR PROOF
Site inspections, deliveries, insurance claims, field surveys, property condition reports, travel logs, and anything else where "where and when" matters.

YOUR STAMP, YOUR STYLE
• Three styles: Classic, Glass and Minimal, in three sizes
• Map thumbnail: standard, satellite or hybrid
• Weather, altitude and compass direction
• Coordinates in decimal, degrees or Plus Code
• Date and time in the place's own time zone
• Notes on every photo, or one default note for a whole project

STAMP OLDER PHOTOS
Import a photo that has GPS data, and SnapTag adds its address and the weather at the time it was taken.

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
No account. Verification runs entirely on your iPhone. Your photos stay in SnapTag's own library, with an optional copy to the Photos app.

SNAPTAG PRO
Free for 7 days, then $1.99 a month or $14.99 a year. Pro unlocks taking and importing photos. Verify is always free, so anyone you send a photo to can check it.
Payment is charged to your Apple Account when you confirm the purchase after the trial. The subscription renews automatically unless you cancel at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. Manage or cancel it in your App Store account settings.

name: SolsticeEave
description:
SolsticeEave is a precision passive solar geometry and architectural overhang studio built for designers, builders, and homeowners planning sunlit facades.

INTERACTIVE POLAR SUN DOME
- Explore real-time solar altitude, compass azimuth, daylight span, and vertical facade profile angle across any latitude from -65 degrees to +65 degrees.

EAVE & LOUVER SECTION RAY SIMULATOR

12-MONTH SEASONAL SHADING MATRIX

- Tap any month bar or any hourly interval from 05:00 to 20:00 to examine oblique morning and afternoon exposure.
- Receive tailored orientation guidance for south, north, east, and west facades.

LOCAL SITE ARCHIVE & SPEC SHEET EXPORT
- Start immediately with five curated architectural climate presets or create and save unlimited custom site specifications.
- Switch effortlessly between Metric (m) and Imperial (ft) drafting units and reference 16 global city latitudes offline.
- Export complete PDF architectural specification sheets, monthly CSV audits, and JSON geometry files directly from your device.

name: Sparla
description:
Sparla is a studio for rope work you make by hand.

Open the studio with the name you want on this device. Add a work by choosing a photo, then keep the material, category, and a maker note with it. Rotate the photo, use framing guides while you place it, and save the piece to the wall or keep a draft.

The works wall shows what is on display, what you have marked as a favorite, your patterns, and the archive. Use the arrows under a piece to move it left or right along the rail. Open a work to edit the photo and details, clip a favorite, archive it, or export the name, material, notes, and photo.

The maker journal lists saved works by date and category, so you can return to a piece later.

The pattern loom is grid paper for the next idea. Set the rows and columns, choose a thread color and a knot structure, and draw on the warp. Mirror a row, repeat the top-left 2 by 2, and step back with undo and redo. Seal a pattern when you want to keep it, and link it to a work. Export the grid as PNG, SVG, or JSON, or import a JSON pattern to continue weaving.

Studio settings hold the capture guides, original-image handling, and reduced motion. Leave the studio to return to the entrance. Delete the local studio only when you mean to remove the maker name, photos, works, patterns, drafts, and preferences from the app on that device.

name: Stallkeep: Batch & Stall
description:
Every market morning is a small expedition. The tote is your pack, the folding table is base camp, and somewhere between the curing rack and the cash box a jar of honey goes missing. This is the field journal for that journey - made for beekeepers, cottage bakers and soap and candle makers who sell from a stall.

Start at the source. Write a recipe and every batch is costed down to the unit: ingredients, packaging and your own hours, with the margin at your price. Each craft packs its own gear - a lye and fragrance calculator for soap, proof and bake timers for bread, a moisture log and jar-yield helper for honey, a burn-test log for candles. No more sums on the back of a flour bag.

Then chart the route. The make calendar draws each batch as a bar heading for market-day flags, and the backward planner names the last day you can start - a polite way of saying quit stalling. Labels list ingredients by weight with allergens marked, then go to PDF or the printer as a full sticker sheet.

On the day, a table map makes the tally mirror the cloth in front of you. One tap rings up one unit, a hold picks a quantity, a swipe logs a sample or a gift. Hot spots show which corner of the table earns its keep, and the close-out compares the cash you counted with the cash you should have. Brace yourself.

Back home, reports show takings and net by product, batch and market, with CSV export for your books. Pixel portraits of your products level up as you make and sell more, a weekly streak keeps score, and the stall advisor points at what needs you next: a tote to pack, flour to buy, bars ready to leave the rack.

name: StartupKit Pro
description:
StartupKit Pro is a founder's companion in your pocket: a library to read or listen to, lessons that turn what you learn into a step in your company, and the tools that get you ready for investors.

A LIBRARY TO READ OR HEAR

446 titles on entrepreneurship, marketing, leadership and sales: 410 summaries, 13 full books, 17 articles and 6 podcast episodes, with more than 70 hours of audio. Listen on the move and keep listening as you switch screens, or read with the font size you like and in dark mode. The first page of every title is free. The library and lessons are in Arabic.

LESSONS THAT END IN ACTION

Short tracks on entrepreneurship, marketing, leadership and business development. Each lesson is one idea from one book, an example from the region, two review questions and one step you take in one of your startup's tools. The first lesson in every track is free.

TWO SPRINTS

The Investor-Ready Sprint walks you through what investors ask about: problem, value proposition, market sizing, business model, unit economics, financial projections and a pitch deck outline. The Launch Sprint covers MVP scope, go-to-market, pricing and the channels that bring your first 100 customers. Your investor-readiness score moves with every tool you finish.

EVENT MODE

Share your startup with a QR code, collect the contacts people leave, and see the meetings they book, from your phone while you are still at the event.

WORKS WITH STARTUPKIT.PRO

Same account, same data, on the web and on your phone.

name: Sticker Maker: WASticker Video
description:
Turn any photo, video or GIF into a sticker and add it to WhatsApp in a few taps. No ads, no account, no watermark, nothing to buy.

MAKE A STICKER FROM ANYTHING
• Photos, videos and GIFs from your library or Files
• Animated stickers from video and GIF, still stickers from photos
• Trim the clip, change the speed, zoom and move it into place

CUT OUT THE BACKGROUND
• One tap removes the background from a photo or a whole clip
• Add a white sticker border around the cutout
• Square, rounded or circle shapes

ADD TEXT, EMOJI AND PICTURES
• Dozens of fonts with outline, plain and boxed styles
• Every emoji, with search
• Add a second picture on top and cut it out too
• Set when each text or emoji appears and disappears in an animated sticker

FILTERS
• Vivid, warm, cool, fade, chrome, mono, noir, comic and more

YOUR PACKS
• Stickers are saved into packs on your phone
• Rename packs, tag stickers with an emoji, delete what you don't want
• Add the pack to WhatsApp with one button

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
Everything happens on your iPhone. Your photos and videos are never uploaded, and the app collects no data.

Stickers are exported in the size and format WhatsApp asks for, so they just work.

This app is not affiliated with, sponsored by or endorsed by WhatsApp LLC. WhatsApp is a trademark of its owner.

name: Stoke: Interval Timer
description:
Stoke is a focused interval timer for HIIT, circuits, mobility, stretching, and any workout where every exercise needs its own timing.

Start immediately with Quick Timer, choose an illustrated starter routine, or build a reusable workout exercise by exercise. Mark each workout as training or recovery and pick the athlete artwork that represents it and each of its exercises. During a session, Stoke shows work in coral and rest in teal, announces what's next, and keeps every cue playing with your phone locked or another app open. Your countdown stays on the lock screen and in the Dynamic Island.

Features:

- Quick interval timer with preparation, work, rest, and rounds
- Custom workouts with per-exercise duration and rest overrides
- Illustrated starter routines and exercises
- Training or recovery workouts, with athlete artwork you choose for each workout and exercise
- Color-coded timer: coral for work, teal for rest, amber to get ready
- Spoken cues for every stage: get ready, each exercise, rest with what's next, and workout complete
- Natural voice callouts for halfway, 10 seconds left, and the last round, with an optional spoken 3-2-1 and a choice of voices
- Routine packs (Pro): each starter routine is level 1 of a series, with two harder levels for HIIT, Tabata, boxing, strength, and mobility
- Backup and restore (Pro): save your workouts and history to a file and restore them on a new phone
- Sound and vibration cues that keep going with the screen locked
- Live countdown on the lock screen and in the Dynamic Island
- Pause, resume, skip, previous, restart, and safe early ending
- Completion and active-time history
- Automatic light and dark appearance, large text, and VoiceOver support
- No account needed; works offline

Stoke Pro (optional) adds unlimited custom workouts, routine packs, Trends (weekly activity, monthly totals, and your top workouts), and backup. Free includes 1 custom workout. Choose monthly or yearly, with a 7-day free trial for new subscribers, or pay once for lifetime. Subscriptions renew automatically unless cancelled at least 24 hours before the end of the period; manage or cancel them in your App Store account settings.

Your workouts, settings, and history stay on your device. No ads.

Terms of Use: https://altivia.fi/stoke/terms/
Privacy Policy: https://altivia.fi/stoke/privacy/

name: Storyfield: Meeting & Class
description:
A parents' information night, a talk, a community meeting, a class. Tap Start covering, and Storyfield records the room from start to finish while you take photos and short clips whenever something happens. Afterwards you get a written story, with every photo where it was talked about.

RECORDS THE WHOLE THING
One tap and the room is recorded until you stop, even with the phone locked or another app open. The Dynamic Island and Lock Screen show that it is running.

THE CAMERA IS THE MAIN SCREEN
Swipe sideways for a photo, up or down to zoom, hold for a short clip. The volume buttons and Camera Control take photos too. Photos are top-quality HEIF, clips are 4K HDR, and every one keeps its time. Photos you take with the Camera app during the event are found and added.

COME BACK TO A STORY
What was said becomes text on your iPhone, then a story with a headline, a lead and paragraphs, and the photos where they belong. Key points, decisions and to-dos each lead back to the words that were said. Clips get the room's sound from the same seconds, with voices brought forward if you like.

CLASS MODE
Live captions while the teacher talks, key points every three minutes, the text of the slides you photograph, a mark on the timeline where you lost the thread, and captions translated on the phone.

SHARE IT YOUR WAY
Export as a long image, PDF, Word or a web page. Photos and clips go into an album of their own in Photos.

AI ON YOUR IPHONE
Stories are written by Apple Intelligence on your iPhone. If your iPhone doesn't have Apple Intelligence, or you prefer another model, connect your own OpenAI, Claude, Gemini, OpenRouter, Qwen, GLM or Kimi account under AI (optional); you pay that service directly, usually cents per story. Recording, transcription and export never need AI.

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
Your recording never leaves your iPhone. No account, no ads, no tracking, no server of ours.

Requires iOS 26. Writing the story needs Apple Intelligence or your own AI account.

name: Streamwalkers Live
description:
See the world through someone else’s camera, live.

Streamwalkers Live connects a world map with live broadcasts from people on the ground. Explore cities and streets, find an active Streamwalker, and tap their marker to watch.

EXPLORE LIVE
• Browse the map and search for places around the world.
• Tap an active Streamwalker to open their live camera feed.
• Share a link to a walk with others.

GO LIVE FROM YOUR IPHONE
• Create a Streamwalkers account and stay signed in on your device.
• Add a title, confirm your location and filming responsibilities, then start your broadcast.
• Choose whether to enable your microphone.
• Adjust the stream’s orientation so viewers see the intended view.
• Keep the app open while broadcasting.

YOUR CHOICES
• Public map markers use an approximate location. Your camera may still reveal where you are.
• Report a broadcast or block a Streamwalker on your device.
• Request account deletion from Profile.

Streamwalkers Live is for adults aged 18 and older. A network connection is required. The availability of live walks depends on who is broadcasting. Location and camera permission are required to broadcast; microphone permission is optional.

Support: admin@streamwalkers.com
Privacy: https://map.streamwalkers.com/privacy
Community rules: https://map.streamwalkers.com/community

name: Stroovix
description:
Stroovix turns a website you're authorized to open into a premium viewing experience, powered by a true native video player.

A NATIVE PLAYER, NOT A BROWSER
Stroovix is not a web browser. It opens only sites you've been given access to — there is no address bar and no arbitrary navigation. Video is decoded and displayed by Stroovix's own native engine for smooth, full-screen, hardware-accelerated playback.

SIMPLE TO START
• Get an 8-digit activation code from the provider whose site you already use.
• Enter it once. Your site opens full-screen, ready to watch.
• No account to create inside the app, and nothing to buy here.

BUILT FOR WATCHING
• Clean, full-screen playback with on-screen controls.
• Audio and subtitle selection when the content offers them.
• Designed for phone, tablet and the big screen.

TRY IT FIRST
Tap "Try the demo" to watch Creative Commons open films by the Blender Foundation, played end to end with the same native engine — no code required.

PRIVACY BY DESIGN
No third-party ads or analytics, and nothing is tracked. You can remove a site or withdraw consent at any time, which deletes the data stored on your device.

Stroovix is a player for sites you're authorized to open. Content is provided by the site owners you connect to.

name: StructNexus
description: Please feel free to share your thoughts on the interface, workflows, or your overall experience. Your genuine, firsthand experience is more valuable than any preconceived notions. We will carefully read, organize, and summarize your feedback, using it to guide our future improvements. While we cannot guarantee immediate changes in every instance, we will do our best to ensure that sound suggestions are addressed.

name: Stylkyn: AI Closet & Shopping
description:
Stylkyn is second-hand shopping that knows your closet: sell what you no longer wear, buy pre-loved clothes that go with yours, and let your AI stylist put your outfits together.

SECOND-HAND SHOPPING: BUY AND SELL BETWEEN PEOPLE
Give your clothes, shoes, bags and accessories a second life: you free up space in your closet and someone else finds the hidden gem. Try a listing with the pieces in your closet to see at once whether it goes with what you already own.

COLOR ANALYSIS: FIND YOUR COLORS
Take a selfie: Stylkyn works out your season, your undertone and the palette that suits you, with the shades to favor or avoid. Your selfie stays private: it is used to analyze your colors, stays visible in your profile, and you can delete it at any time.

SELL WITH EASE
• List a piece from your closet in one tap: photos (up to 3), price, condition.
• No commission for the seller: you receive the price of your listing (the buyer pays the protection fee).
• A shipping label is provided; get your earnings in your bank account (payments through Stripe).

BUY WITH PEACE OF MIND
• Search and filter by category, brand or color; make an offer, ask a question, save your favorites, follow sellers you like and set up alerts.
• Card payment through Stripe with buyer protection: the seller is paid only after delivery, and you can report a damaged or non-matching item within 48 hours.
• Delivery to a pick-up point or to your door (Mondial Relay), with parcel tracking.
• The shop is for private individuals aged 18 and over.

YOUR VIRTUAL CLOSET
Photograph your clothes: they are cut out automatically, sorted (category, color, formality, pattern) and stored in your closet. Your wardrobe builds itself, with nothing to type in.

OUTFIT OF THE DAY AND VIRTUAL TRY-ON
Every morning, an outfit chosen from your real clothes, based on the weather, your calendar and your mood. Stylkyn’s rules engine rules out clashing combinations. Then see the outfit on your mannequin before you put it on (an AI tool reserved for adults).

STYLIA, YOUR AI STYLIST
Chat in writing or by voice with Stylia: outfit ideas, advice for a specific occasion (job interview, wedding, night out), style projects. Stylia remembers what you ask it to remember.

YOU STAY IN CONTROL
• A fully optional “My universe” profile, used only to refine advice.
• Location and calendar titles: read for the weather and the occasion, then forgotten.
• Delete your account and your data in one tap, from the app.
• No ads, no resale of data.
• The app is for people aged 15 and over; the shop, lingerie and AI tools are reserved for adults.

Artificial intelligence analyzes your photos once and words the advice; Stylkyn’s rules engine decides the outfit, for consistent results.

SUBSCRIPTIONS AND IN-APP PURCHASES (OPTIONAL)
You can start for free. The Essential and Expert plans (monthly or yearly subscription) extend your use of Stylia, outfits and virtual try-on; credit packs and listing boosts are also available. Payment is charged to your Apple Account when you confirm the purchase. Subscriptions renew automatically unless cancelled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period; manage or cancel them at any time in your Apple Account settings.

Terms of Use: https://stylkyn.com/cgu.html?lang=en
Privacy policy: https://stylkyn.com/confidentialite-rgpd.html?lang=en
Delete my account: https://stylkyn.com/suppression-compte.html?lang=en

name: Su Gelsin – Damacana ve Tüp
description:
Damacanan mı bitti? Tüpün mü bitti? Dert etme, Su Gelsin!

Su Gelsin ile Girne ve çevresinde damacana su ve 12 kg tüp gaz siparişini birkaç dokunuşla ver, servis aracımız kapına getirsin.

ÜRÜNLER
• Yudum Su 19 L damacana
• Boşu olmayanlar için Yudum Su + Yeni Damacana
• Intergaz, Jetgaz ve Koop Gaz 12 kg tüp

NEDEN SU GELSİN?
• Teslimat ücretsiz
• Her markanın boş damacanası ve boş tüpü ücretsiz değiştirilir (damacanada 2022 ve sonrası üretim kabul edilir)
• Ödeme kapıda nakit veya banka havalesi ile
• Her gün 08:00 – 20:00 hizmet
• Üyelik gerekmez: adını, telefonunu ve adresini yaz, siparişini ver

KOLAY SİPARİŞ
• Adresini haritada işaretle, şoförümüz kapını kolayca bulsun
• Ev, iş gibi birden fazla adres kaydet
• Siparişini canlı takip et: alındı, hazırlanıyor, yolda, teslim edildi
• Yoldayken servis aracını tek dokunuşla ara
• WhatsApp destek hattından bize hızlıca ulaş
• Teslim edilen siparişini tek dokunuşla tekrar ver

TESLİMAT BÖLGELERİ
Girne merkez, Karaoğlanoğlu, Alsancak, Lapta, Karşıyaka, Ozanköy, Çatalköy ve çevresi.

Damacana siparişlerinde en az 2 adet geçerlidir; tüp tek başına sipariş edilebilir.

name: Sujud — Prayer times & alarm
description:
Prayer at its time.

Sujud shows the five prayers of the day at their time, wherever you are. A notification arrives at each one. And for the prayers you choose, an alarm rings like an alarm clock — even on Silent.

No account. No ads. No countdown. Nothing counted, nothing kept.

AN ALARM FOR THE PRAYERS YOU CHOOSE
• Tap the bell and turn on the alarm for any of the five prayers, or for all of them. Every alarm is off until you turn it on
• It rings at the prayer's time, even on Silent, with the prayer and its time on screen and a single button to stop it
• The prayer's notification arrives too, so once the alarm is stopped you still know which prayer it was
• Each time you open Sujud, it schedules the days ahead, up to a week

THE DAY ON ONE SCREEN
• The five prayers and their times, with sunrise as a quiet line under Fajr
• The current prayer stands out, and the ones still to come follow it
• The Hijri and Gregorian dates, and the place you are in
• Go back or ahead a day, or jump to any date: the first day of Ramadan, a journey, a day you are planning

A NOTIFICATION AT EACH PRAYER
• At each prayer time, and at sunrise, one notification says which prayer and at what time
• Nothing else: no reminder before, no "missed" after

YOUR COUNTRY'S TIMES
• Where your country publishes a prayer calendar, Sujud follows its authority: the Ministry of Habous in Morocco, the Grande Mosquée de Paris in France, the Diyanet in Türkiye, and many more. Where none is published, it follows the Muslim World League's rule, and names it
• Your mosque follows another? Choose among fifty calculation methods in Settings, and set the Asr school
• Worked out on your phone, offline. After a journey, the times follow you as soon as you open Sujud
• If your phone's clock does not match the legal time where you are, Sujud tells you

MADE FOR YOU
• Arabic, French and English, with full right-to-left support and Arabic-Indic or Latin numerals
• Light and dark themes, following your phone or your choice
• Follows your phone's text size, and works with VoiceOver

PRIVACY FIRST
No account. No analytics. No ads. No history. Sujud keeps its settings and what it has scheduled, and nothing else. Your location is used on your phone to compute the times, and is never stored.

Privacy label: Data Not Collected.

WHY SUJUD EXISTS
Prayer has its times. Sujud tells you them, wakes you for the ones you ask, and stays out of the way the rest of the day. One thing, done well — free, with no catch.

Sujud — سجود — prostration.

name: Sumo Grammar: Japanese Grammar
description:
Sumo Grammar is Japanese grammar as a book: eight books, 512 lessons of one page each, from your first Japanese sentence to classical Japanese and kanbun. It teaches grammar the way Japanese schools do, with the terms Japanese students learn, and explains each step in plain English.

Eight books
• Books 1 to 5 follow the JLPT levels, N5 to N1, as a guide to how far you have come.
• Book 6 goes past N1: the written Japanese of news, essays and laws, formal letters, and keigo in depth.
• Book 7 is classical Japanese (古文) as Japanese high schools teach it: the old kana spelling, the old verb types, helper verbs, particles and 係り結び.
• Book 8 is kanbun (漢文), classical Chinese read the Japanese way: reading marks, silent characters, characters read twice and the main sentence patterns, set vertically as Japanese school books print them.

A page for each lesson
