• The point of the lesson in a line or two, then short explanations, the pattern as a formula, tables, and examples with natural English (and word for word, where that shows how a sentence is built).
• On every page, an "In school" box: what Japanese schools call this grammar and how they teach it, so you learn the names Japanese learners use (文節, 品詞, 活用 and more).
• Watch-outs for the mistakes learners make, tips that help a rule stick, and a summary to close every page.
• Sentences taken apart into their phrases, with arrows from each phrase to the one it goes with.

Tap, listen, read
• Every example is read aloud in one clear Japanese voice: tap the speaker for the whole sentence.
• Tap any Japanese word on a page to see its meaning and reading, and to hear it.
• Readings over every kanji, or none; romaji under the examples if you want it.

Practice after every lesson
• 5 to 7 questions a lesson, more than 3,000 in all: fill the gap, choose the answer, put the pieces in order, tap the phrase, cut a sentence into its phrases, right or wrong. Each one is marked at once, with the right answer and why.
• The Practice tab brings every question back: the ones you missed first, the others after 1, 3, 7, 14, 30 and 60 days. Ten questions a go, mixed across your lessons, or chapter by chapter.

An index at the back
• Every pattern, word and school term, found by its Japanese, kana, romaji or English, leads to the lesson that teaches it.

Quiet and private
No account, no ads and no internet needed: every page and its voice are in the app, and your progress stays on your device. A daily reminder if you want one. Sumo Grammar works on iPhone, iPad and Mac.

Sumo Grammar Pro (optional)
Book 1 (N5) is free: all 64 lessons and their questions, with the Practice tab, the Index and the voice. Sumo Grammar Pro opens the other seven books: N4 to N1, Japanese past N1, classical Japanese and kanbun. Try it free for 7 days.

Sumo Grammar Pro is a yearly subscription that renews automatically. Payment is charged to your Apple Account when you confirm the purchase, or when the free trial ends. The subscription renews unless you turn it off at least 24 hours before the end of the current year, and the renewal is charged within those last 24 hours. Manage or cancel it at any time in your Apple Account settings. Any unused part of the free trial ends when you buy a subscription.

The JLPT levels are only a guide to each book's level; Sumo Grammar is independent of the test.
The voice is AI-generated. The word meanings come from an open Japanese-English dictionary (CC BY-SA 4.0), credited in the app.

Terms of Use: https://sumojapanese.app/grammar/terms
Privacy Policy: https://sumojapanese.app/grammar/privacy

name: Super Lineup
description:
Super Lineup giúp bạn biến mọi dự án sáng tạo thành một kế hoạch rõ ràng, trực quan và dễ kiểm soát. Từ video, series tập, buổi phát sóng đến họp trực tuyến, bạn có thể dựng toàn bộ tiến trình trên một dòng thời gian sống động, theo dõi từng giai đoạn và biết ngay điều gì đã sẵn sàng, điều gì có thể làm tiếp theo.

Ứng dụng được thiết kế để bạn làm việc trực tiếp với các giai đoạn của dự án thay vì chỉ nhìn một danh sách khô khan. Khi thay đổi lịch, bạn thấy ngay các bước bị ảnh hưởng và có thể quyết định giữ nguyên hay dời lịch cho phù hợp.

Tính năng nổi bật
- Tạo dự án từ đầu hoặc từ mẫu - bắt đầu nhanh với cấu trúc phù hợp cho video, series, buổi gặp trực tuyến, buổi diễn và nhiều dạng dự án khác
- Dòng thời gian trực quan - sắp xếp các giai đoạn trên trục thời gian, xem ngày bắt đầu, ngày kết thúc và trạng thái của từng bước
- Kéo thả và chỉnh thời lượng - di chuyển giai đoạn, thay đổi số ngày thực hiện và xem tác động đến toàn bộ kế hoạch
- Liên kết các giai đoạn - đặt điều kiện giai đoạn sau chỉ bắt đầu khi giai đoạn trước hoàn tất, giảm nhầm lẫn khi làm việc theo chuỗi
- Ghi chú, liên kết và tệp đính kèm - lưu tài liệu quan trọng ngay trong từng giai đoạn để không thất lạc nội dung
- Kiểm tra phương án - thử thay đổi lịch trong bản sao tạm thời, so sánh ngày hoàn thành và áp dụng khi bạn sẵn sàng
- Theo dõi độ hoàn tất - xem phần trăm hoàn thành, các giai đoạn đã xong, giai đoạn có thể làm ngay và các cảnh báo xung đột
- Lưu trên thiết bị - hoạt động không cần đăng nhập, không cần internet, dữ liệu được giữ lại sau khi mở lại ứng dụng

Dành cho ai
- Nhà sáng tạo nội dung cần lập kế hoạch quay, dựng và đăng tải rõ ràng
- Người tổ chức sự kiện, buổi họp hoặc buổi biểu diễn cần theo dõi nhiều bước liên tiếp
- Nhóm làm việc muốn xem tiến độ theo thời gian thay vì chỉ theo danh sách nhiệm vụ
- Bất kỳ ai thích cách quản lý dự án trực quan, gọn gàng và dễ chỉnh sửa

Vì sao nên chọn Super Lineup
Super Lineup tập trung vào trải nghiệm lập kế hoạch bằng hình ảnh, với giao diện sáng, mượt và dễ hiểu. Bạn không chỉ biết việc gì cần làm, mà còn thấy mối liên hệ giữa các bước, thời hạn của từng giai đoạn và ảnh hưởng khi có thay đổi. Các mẫu dự án, trạng thái rõ ràng, phần xem trước phương án và lưu trữ cục bộ giúp bạn kiểm soát dự án sáng tạo một cách tự tin hơn.

Bắt đầu ngay hôm nay, tạo dự án đầu tiên và sắp xếp mọi giai đoạn theo cách bạn muốn.

name: Super Term
description:
Super Term is an SSH terminal for iPhone and iPad. Use it to work on your own Mac and Linux hosts.

A FULL TERMINAL
• Sign in with a password or private key, through jump hosts (several hops) and HTTP / SOCKS5 proxies
• True color, a Nerd Font, CJK text: vim, htop and tmux look and work as they should
• Type with any input method, or with a hardware keyboard
• Host key fingerprint check on first connection

TMUX, ZELLIJ AND HERDR SESSIONS
• See the sessions already on the host and attach with one tap
• Lose the connection, switch apps or change networks: your work is still there
• Create, rename and end sessions; keys for tmux splits and window switching

INPUT MADE FOR A PHONE
• Esc, Tab, Ctrl, Alt, arrows, Home / End and paging in one row
• Quick commands: send the commands you use most with one tap; sort them by tool, pin them, add your own
• Voice input: dictate with the system speech recognition, then send
• Several tabs open at once

FILES
• Browse, search, upload and download files on the host over SFTP
• Read and edit code, text and Markdown, and preview images

DASHBOARD AND PORT FORWARDING
• CPU, memory, disk and network of several hosts on one screen
• Forward a web service on the host and preview it on your phone

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
• No account, no analytics, no ads and no servers in between
• Host addresses stay on your device; passwords and keys stay in your Keychain
• The app never installs, downloads or changes software on your hosts

PRICE
Free to download with a 30-day free trial of everything. After that, a one-time purchase keeps it for good on iPhone and iPad. No subscription, and nothing is charged when the trial ends.

name: Sweep: Storage Cleaner
description:
Sweep is the fast, simple storage cleaner for iPhone. Swipe left to delete, swipe right to keep, and watch your free space grow.

Is your iPhone storage full? Sweep finds the photos, videos and screenshots eating your space, groups the obvious junk for you, and shows exactly how many GB each clean-up frees. No account, no clutter, no cloud upload.

A STORAGE CLEANER THAT ACTUALLY FREES SPACE
• Swipe through this week, any month or your whole library
• Start with the biggest files to reclaim the most storage first
• Undo any swipe; deleted photos wait in Recently Deleted for 30 days
• Sweep remembers what you kept, so it never asks twice

CLEAN PHOTOS AND VIDEOS AUTOMATICALLY
• Duplicate photos and duplicate videos
• Similar shots and burst photos: keep the best, clear the rest
• Large videos, sorted by size
• Screenshot cleaner: sort and clear screenshots in bulk
• Blurry and dark photos
• Documents and receipts you only needed once
• RAW photos and Live Photos

SHRINK INSTEAD OF DELETE
Convert photos to space-saving HEIC and compress big videos, so you free up storage and keep the memories.

SEE WHERE YOUR STORAGE REALLY GOES
A clear breakdown of photos, apps and system data, plus what already lives in iCloud, so you know what clearing will really free on your iPhone.

STAY ON TRACK
• Home Screen and Lock Screen widgets for storage, screenshots and your streak
• Control Center controls and Action button shortcut (iOS 18)
• Siri Shortcuts and Home Screen quick actions
• Streaks, achievements and a weekly clean-up summary
• Optional reminders when it's time to clean up

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
Everything happens on your iPhone. Your photos are never uploaded, there is no account to create, and Sweep only deletes what you swipe. iOS always asks you to confirm before anything is removed.

AVAILABLE IN 44 LANGUAGES

SWEEP FREE AND SWEEP PRO
Sweep is free to use with ads, with up to 50 deletes and 10 undos a day. Watch a short ad to unlock more.
Upgrade to Sweep Pro to remove ads, delete and undo without limits, and unlock video compression, Live Photo to still conversion and contacts merge.

• Sweep Pro Monthly: $1.99 per month
• Sweep Pro Yearly: $9.99 per year
• Sweep Pro Lifetime: $29.99, pay once
Prices may vary by country. Subscriptions renew automatically unless cancelled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. Manage or cancel any time in your Apple Account settings. Payment is charged to your Apple Account at confirmation of purchase.

Terms of Use: https://kavvara.com/sweep/terms
Privacy Policy: https://kavvara.com/sweep/privacy
Questions? hello@kavvara.com

name: Sweet Tarot
description:
Sweet Tarot giúp bạn trải bài Tarot và nhận luận giải chi tiết bằng AI cho những điều bạn đang bận tâm: tình yêu, công việc, tài chính, học tập, gia đình, phát triển bản thân…

TRẢI BÀI & LUẬN GIẢI
• Chọn chủ đề, đặt câu hỏi và tự tay rút 1 lá hoặc 3 lá.
• Nhận luận giải riêng cho câu hỏi của bạn, kèm lời khuyên cụ thể.
• Trò chuyện thêm với reader về lượt trải hoặc về từng lá bài.

THÔNG ĐIỆP NGÀY HÔM NAY
• Mỗi ngày một lá bài và một thông điệp dành riêng cho bạn.
• Điểm danh mỗi ngày để nhận thêm lá bài.

LỊCH CỦA TÔI
• Hẹn lịch trải bài định kỳ (hằng ngày, hằng tuần hoặc theo thứ) cho một vấn đề bạn đang theo dõi.
• Nhận nhắc nhở đúng giờ và xem biểu đồ năng lượng của vấn đề qua từng ngày.

KHÁM PHÁ THÊM
• Có / Không: câu trả lời nhanh cho câu hỏi đơn giản.
• Chân dung Soulmate: phác hoạ người dành cho bạn qua lá bài.
• Thư viện 78 lá Tarot với ý nghĩa xuôi, ngược và theo từng khía cạnh: tình yêu, công việc, tài chính, sức khoẻ.
• Hứng sao định mệnh: mini game nhận quà mỗi ngày.

LỊCH SỬ TRẢI BÀI
• Lưu lại mọi lượt trải, đánh dấu yêu thích, ghi chú và chia sẻ với bạn bè.

Lưu ý: Nội dung luận giải mang tính tham khảo và giải trí, không thay thế lời khuyên chuyên môn về y tế, pháp lý hay tài chính.

name: TABL: Recipes & Meal Planner
description:
TABL (pronounced "table") is your beautiful, all-in-one home for food. Discover new recipes, save your favorites into a personal cookbook, plan the week's meals, build grocery lists in seconds and keep track of the places you love to eat.

DISCOVER
Browse a curated collection of recipes by meal, cuisine, time and ingredient. Trending, seasonal and quick-and-easy picks, plus recommendations that learn from what you save.

YOUR COOKBOOK
Save recipes, favorite them, add personal notes and organize them into unlimited collections with custom covers. Write down your own family recipes with photos.

RECIPES THAT COOK WITH YOU
Clear ingredients with a servings scaler, step-by-step method and Cooking Mode: big, easy-to-read steps, built-in timers and a screen that stays awake.

MEAL PLANNER
Plan breakfast, lunch and dinner for every day. Move, swap, duplicate or replace meals, view the month at a glance, and copy a whole week forward.

GROCERY LISTS
Add a recipe or your whole week's plan to a list in one tap. Items are sorted into store aisles automatically and quantities combine. Check things off in Shopping Mode with big, easy checkboxes.

SHOP AND COOK TOGETHER
Share a grocery list with your household and see changes live. Share recipes and collections with friends and family using a simple code.

PLACES
Save restaurants, cafes, bakeries and brunch spots into collections like Want to Visit. Add your own ratings, notes and photos, and open any place in Maps.

MORE TO LOVE
- What's in My Kitchen: enter ingredients you have and find recipes you can make
- Recipe Remixer: smart swaps to make a recipe vegetarian, dairy-free, gluten-free or lighter
- Food Diary: remember great meals with a photo and a few words
- Weekly Recap: what you saved, planned, cooked and discovered

Use TABL without an account, or create a free account to sync across your devices and share with family. No ads.

name: TailGrab: Plane Spotting Game
description:
Spot it. Snap it. It's yours. Then it flies for you.

TailGrab turns planespotting into a game. Point your camera at a real aircraft's tail number, snap it, and it joins your hangar. From then on, every mile that plane really flies earns you points, tracked live from public flight data.

But hold on tight. After a one-hour hangar lock, any other spotter who grabs the same plane steals it from you, along with its future miles. The miles you already earned stay yours for life.

HOW IT WORKS
• Snap the tail number: TailGrab reads the registration for you and fills in the type and airline.
• Prove you were there: your location is checked against the plane's live position, so every grab is real.
• Watch it fly: planes in your hangar earn miles and points every time they take off, and you get a note when they land.
• Steal and defend: grab planes from other pilots, and get them back when they're taken.

WHAT TO COLLECT
• Common jets, uncommon types, rare and legendary aircraft, each worth more points.
• Foreign registrations, special paint jobs and window-seat grabs (snap a plane from your own flight) earn bonuses.
• Fill your passport with airports and countries your planes visit.

PLAY WITH FRIENDS
• Start a crew or a private league and rank against your friends.
• Monthly seasons crown a Captain of the month.
• Leaderboards for points, fleet miles and lifetime miles.
• A live map of where your planes are right now.

FAIR AND PRIVATE
• No ads. No email or phone number needed: just pick a pilot name.
• Your exact location is never shown to other players.
• Save a passkey to keep your pilot safe on a new phone.
• Delete your account any time from inside the app.

TAILGRAB PRO (optional)
Extra skins, more leagues and other extras. Pro never changes scoring: a free pilot can top every leaderboard. TailGrab Pro: $1.99 a month, $9.99 a year, or $24.99 once for lifetime. Every new pilot gets a free Pro week after their first grab. Subscriptions renew automatically unless cancelled at least 24 hours before the period ends; manage or cancel them in your App Store account settings.

Terms of Use: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/
Privacy Policy: https://tailgrab.app/privacy

Made by one plane spotter for all the others. Questions or ideas: support@tailgrab.app

name: Tallyjob: Estimate Maker
description:
Tallyjob is the fastest way for contractors and trades pros to get an estimate in front of the customer while they're still standing there.

Describe the job out loud, or snap a few photos. Tallyjob turns it into a clean, itemized estimate in seconds: labor, materials, quantities, using your hourly rate and your prices. Review it, tweak it, and send a polished PDF. Your customer can sign right on your phone.

DRAFT ESTIMATES IN SECONDS
• Talk through the job and Tallyjob writes the line items
• Add photos of the site for a better draft
• Uses your labor rate, markup and saved prices
• Leaves a price blank instead of guessing when it isn't sure

LOOK PROFESSIONAL
• Clean PDF estimates with your logo and license number
• Three templates: Classic, Modern, Bold
• Taxes, discounts and deposits calculated to the cent
• Send by text, email or WhatsApp

WIN THE JOB ON THE SPOT
• Customer signs on your phone
• Signed estimate saved with date and signature

ESTIMATE TO WORK ORDER TO INVOICE
• Turn an approved estimate into a work order with one tap
• Checklist, schedule, crew notes, before and after photos
• Turn it into an invoice, apply the deposit, mark it paid

MADE FOR TRADES
Handyman, painting, remodeling, landscaping, cleaning, plumbing, electrical, roofing, flooring and more. English and Spanish.

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
No account needed. Your clients and documents stay on your phone.

TALLYJOB PRO
Unlimited estimates, work orders and invoices, unlimited AI drafts, signatures, and no watermark. Try it free for 7 days with the annual plan.

Payment is charged to your Apple ID at confirmation. Subscriptions renew automatically unless cancelled at least 24 hours before the end of the period. Manage or cancel anytime in your App Store account settings.

AI drafts are suggestions. Always review prices, taxes and terms before sending.

Terms: https://oxvenu.com/tallyjob/terms
Privacy: https://oxvenu.com/tallyjob/privacy

name: Talvex,
description:
Built for dog and cat owners, especially households with more than one pet, Talvex brings scattered vaccination cards, care notes, and everyday observations into a clear, searchable journal. Remember what happened, plan what comes next, and find the details you need at your next vet visit.
Create a profile for each pet and quickly switch between their records and care plans. Keep vaccinations, parasite treatments, medicines, and appointments organized, with reminders linked to the right companion. Mark care as completed, snooze it, or skip it while keeping planned and actual completion times clear.
Track weight trends, feeding notes, appetite, energy, and behavior changes. Attach photos, reports, and prescriptions to preserve useful context. Save familiar purrs and playful sounds in a personal sound album, or link a recording to a health observation.
You can also record walks and training progress, browse health history by date or type, and export a selected health summary to share with your veterinarian.
From daily routines to important appointments, Talvex helps you spend less time searching through scattered information and feel more prepared for your pet’s care.

name: Tanfeeth-تنفيذ
description:
مرحبًا بكم في " تنفيذ "، منصتكم الشاملة والمتميزة لتأجير الشايهات نحن هنا لجعل تجربة البحث عن الشاليه المثالي أسهل وأكثر فعالية من أي وقت مضى، عبر تقديم خدمات تجمع بين التكنولوجيا الحديثة والخبرة. 
مميزاتنا الأساسية:
واجهة استخدام سهلة: تساعدك في عرض وتصفح الشاليهات بسلاسة، وتوفر تجربة استخدام ممتعة وسريعة. 
مجموعة شاملة: من العقارات السكنية إلى التجارية، لدينا كل ما تبحث عنه بمواصفات وأسعار متنوعة تلائم الجميع. 
الشفافية والمصداقية: نحرص على توفير معلومات دقيقة عن كل عقار، مع صور وبيانات واضحة، لتسهيل اتخاذ القرار.

name: TattwaCalendar
description:
TattwaCalendar is a calendar for planning your days, with one distinctive extra: every day shows its Tattwa rhythm, calculated from sunrise at your location.

PLAN YOUR TIME
• Month, week and day views around one selected date
• Create, edit, duplicate, move and delete activities
• Repeat activities daily, weekly (on chosen weekdays), monthly or yearly, ending on a date or after a number of times
• Change a single occurrence, this and following ones, or the whole series
• Categories with their own colour and icon; hide any category from the calendar
• Activities list with search, filters, upcoming and past activities
• Local reminders before your activities
• Show the calendars on your device and subscribed calendars next to your activities

THE TATTWA RHYTHM AS CONTEXT
• Each day begins at sunrise. From then on, the five Tattwas (Akash, Vayu, Tejas, Prithvi and Apas) follow each other in periods of 24 minutes
• See which Tattwa is active now and which comes next
• Every day in the calendar shows its sequence; the day view shows all periods next to your activities
• Each activity shows the Tattwas during its time, as information only
• Choose the order of Prithvi and Apas within the cycle
• A circular Tattwa clock shows the day's 60 periods from sunrise, the active one and the time left
• Sun & Moon: sunrise, sunset and daylight for the next two weeks, and the moon phase
• Short reference pages for the five Tattwas

The Tattwa information is traditional context. It is not health advice, and it does not tell you when to do anything.

TATTWACALENDAR PREMIUM (OPTIONAL SUBSCRIPTION)
The calendar above is free and complete. Premium adds:
• Tattwa Now widgets: the current Tattwa with a live countdown on your Home Screen and Lock Screen
• Tattwa alerts when the Tattwas you choose begin, and a summary at sunrise
• The next periods of a Tattwa, right where you plan an activity
• The planetary hours of every day at your place
• The day's energies and cycles on a 24-hour dial
• Sun and moon for the coming days: twilight, golden hour, new and full moon
• Traditional suggestions of what to do during each Tattwa

Premium is available as a monthly or yearly subscription; the yearly plan can include a free trial. Payment is charged to your Apple Account when you confirm the purchase. The subscription renews automatically unless it is cancelled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period, and your account is charged for renewal within 24 hours before the end of the period. Manage or cancel it in your Apple Account settings. If Premium ends, your activities and data stay, and the free calendar keeps working.

YOUR LOCATION, YOUR TIME ZONE
Sunrise, sunset and all periods are calculated on your device for the place you choose (your current location or a city) and in that place's time zone.

APPLE WATCH
A glance at the current and next Tattwa on your wrist, using periods your iPhone calculated.

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
No account needed. Your activities and settings stay on your device. Your location is used on the device only to calculate sunrise and the Tattwa periods. You can optionally sign in with Apple or Google to keep Premium on more than one device, and delete that account in the app at any time.

Available in English, German, Spanish, French, Italian, Romanian and Russian.

Terms of Use: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/
Privacy Policy: https://tattwa-calendar.ecoderce.com/en/privacy

name: Tayar Nar Yu - Dhamma Talks
description:
("Tayar Nar Yu" – Listen to the Dhamma) lets you listen to Myanmar-language Dhamma talks on your iPhone and iPad. The talks are shared freely by dhammadownload.com, and this app plays them online, straight from its server.

 27,500+ TALKS
• Talks by Sayadaws (monks) and lay teachers
• Paritta chanting and devotional recitations
• Dhammacariya / Pāḷi study classes
• The catalogue is checked every week and new talks are added automatically

 MADE FOR LISTENING
• Stream instantly – no need to download first
• Keeps playing with the screen locked; controls on the lock screen and in Control Center
• Resumes where you left off
• Play a whole album in order, or build an "up next" queue
• Sleep timer, playback speed, skip 15 seconds back/forward
• Favourites and listening history
• Search by teacher or talk title (Myanmar)
• Save a talk to the Files app, or share a link to it on Viber, Messenger and more
• Light and dark themes

 PRIVATE BY DESIGN
• No ads, no account, completely free
• No personal data is collected. History and favourites are stored only on your device.

 PERMISSION AND THANKS
All audio streams directly from dhammadownload.com, which publicly permits direct linking to its talks (notice on its home page). With deep gratitude to the Sayadaws and teachers who gave these talks, and to the dhammadownload.com team.

This is not the official dhammadownload.com app. It is an independent, non-commercial app made to help listeners.

Feedback is welcome by email (see the About page in the app).

Sādhu sādhu sādhu

name: Technical Officials Scheduler
description:
Technical Officials Scheduler plans the Technical Officials (TOs) of a triathlon event run under the World Triathlon Competition Rules.

Enter your races and your team, and the planner:
• gives every official a main position – Head Referee, CRO, Chief Swim, Chief Bike, Chief Run, Finish, Penalty Box, Wheel Stations, Registration, Technology and more
• adds the short jobs (Starter, start line, mount line, assistant finish, penalty box…) as second positions without time clashes
• books the meetings and briefings the rules require: Elite athletes’ briefing at 16:00 the day before the first competition day, Competition Jury meetings, start and finish rehearsals, drivers’ briefing, TOs’ meeting, daily TO briefing and de-briefing
• keeps the Head Referee on duty through the protest time after each race
• warns when starts are closer than the Event Organisers’ Manual allows
• counts the radios you need

Every format: super-sprint, sprint, standard, mixed relay, middle and long distance – on one day or across a weekend. Tick who works which race, set availability and preferred positions, lock your own choices and let the planner fill the rest. Every time allowance from the TO Checklist can be adjusted, and any duty window can be moved for one race.

See the plan as a list, personal schedules, a Gantt chart per day and a timeline. Export to Excel, LibreOffice/Numbers, your calendar (.ics) or a picture, or share the plan file with colleagues – it also opens in the free Ubuntu and web versions.

Private by design: no account, no tracking, no data collection. Your events stay on your device.

Independent tool – not affiliated with, endorsed by or sponsored by World Triathlon.

name: TeideTech Call
description:
TeideTech Call lleva a tu móvil las llamadas de tu extensión del Agente IA de TeideTech.

Cuando el Agente IA de tu negocio pasa una llamada a una persona del equipo, o te llama un cliente que has desviado a tu extensión, tu móvil suena como cualquier llamada, aunque la app esté cerrada o el móvil bloqueado. Contestas, hablas y cuelgas desde la pantalla de llamadas de siempre.

- Conecta tu extensión.
- Consulta las llamadas que han sonado en tu extensión, contestadas o perdidas, y lee lo que el agente habló antes de pasártelas.
- Lee los recados que el agente ha tomado para ti y bórralos cuando estén hechos.
- Consulta el consumo del Agente IA.
- Si eres el propietario del agente, consulta todas sus llamadas y conversaciones, bloquea o desvía números.

name: TeleHex – Telex Keyboard
description:
TeleHex is a Vietnamese Telex keyboard laid out on a 7-column hexagonal grid. The letters follow the familiar QWERTY order, but each key is about 30% wider than on a 10-column keyboard.

Delete, capitals and extra characters are gestures, so the hexagonal grid needs no backspace or shift key.

Used to a 10-column keyboard? Pick the Traditional layout ("Truyền thống"): full 10-column QWERTY with shift and backspace keys, and every gesture and suggestion still works.

ON-DEVICE, NO FULL ACCESS NEEDED
• Telex, suggestions and learned words are processed and stored on your iPhone or iPad. TeleHex has no feature that sends data over the network.
• Typing, suggestions, profiles and text shortcuts all work without Full Access. Full Access is only used for key sounds, haptics, dragging keys on the keyboard, clipboard history and letting the app know it is on.
• No ads, no account, no tracking. Open source (MIT).

GESTURE TYPING
• Swipe up on a letter for a capital, swipe down for the number, symbol or emoji shown under it.
• Swipe left on the space bar to delete; swipe further to delete word by word, with a count of the words first.
• Swipe up on the space bar for caps lock, swipe down to switch to English (no Telex).
• Hold the space bar and drag to move the cursor.
• Two-finger swipe to undo / redo.
• Slide to type: glide across the letters of a syllable or an English word, then pick the suggestion.

SUGGESTIONS WITHOUT AUTOCORRECT
• TeleHex never changes what you typed on its own.
• The six tone variants of the current syllable, one tap away.
• Fixes for neighbouring-key slips and missing or extra keys.
• Next-syllable suggestions learned from your own writing.
• Emoji by keyword.
• English mode completes words from a 50,000-word dictionary and turns on by itself in email, web address and ASCII-only fields.

MAKE IT YOURS
• Hold a key and drag it onto another to swap them, right on the keyboard (needs Full Access), or edit layouts in the app.
• Two built-in layouts, Hexagonal and Traditional. Create your own profiles, edit each key layer and set your own swipe-down character for every key.
• Old or new tone placement (hòa/hoà), text shortcuts, clipboard history (needs Full Access), incognito mode, one-handed mode, keyboard height, light/dark theme, accent colour, haptics and key sounds.
• Import your own language packs for Vietnamese and English suggestions.
• Back up and restore your settings to a single file.

TURN IT ON
Open TeleHex and the welcome screen walks you through it: go to Settings › General › Keyboard › Keyboards › Add New Keyboard, pick TeleHex, then choose the Hexagonal or Traditional layout in the app. The app is in Vietnamese.

Source code and documentation: https://github.com/alfrededison/telehex-keyboard

name: Teleprompter Flotante
description:
Prepara tus guiones y léelos mientras grabas con tu cámara habitual.

TU BIBLIOTECA
Crea varios guiones con título. Edita, duplica, busca y ordena tus textos. El guardado es local y automático; cada guion conserva sus ajustes.

A TU RITMO
Ajusta velocidad y tamaño de letra en la vista previa. Destaca palabras con negrita o énfasis y añade marcas visuales de pausa para orientar tu lectura. Elige una cuenta regresiva de 0 a 30 segundos antes de empezar. Pausa, continúa o vuelve al principio cuando lo necesites.

LECTURA SOBRE CÁMARA
Mueve el lector y cambia su tamaño para leer con comodidad mientras usas una aplicación de cámara externa. El video y el audio los graba esa aplicación; Teleprompter Flotante no graba ni edita tus tomas.

TU APARIENCIA
Elige modo claro, oscuro o el aspecto del sistema.

TUS TEXTOS, EN TU DISPOSITIVO
No necesitas registrarte. Sin anuncios, analítica ni compras integradas en esta versión. No se ofrece sincronización entre dispositivos. Desinstalar puede eliminar los guiones locales.

EN IPHONE
El texto aparece en una ventana PiP. La guía te enseña a añadir los controles al Centro de control: recomendamos Leer / pausar e Inicio del guion. Los ajustes de velocidad, letra y cierre son opcionales; puedes añadir los siete controles si lo prefieres. Requiere iOS 18 o posterior. Durante una toma, usa Centro de control; abrir notificaciones puede detener Cámara.

La compatibilidad depende del dispositivo, la versión del sistema y la aplicación de cámara. Antes de una toma importante, comprueba tu combinación con una grabación corta.

name: Tempo Chess Diary
description:
Tempo Chess Diary helps you record every chess game, review your thinking, and build a clearer path to improvement. Designed for players who want a simple, focused place to capture ideas, results, and lessons, it keeps your chess progress organised in one clean app.

Key features
- Five dedicated sections - organise games, notes, plans, reviews, and progress in a clear structure
- Clean white interface with blue accents - stay focused with a calm, modern design
- Chess journalling tools - log moves, results, thoughts, and post-game reflections with ease
- Training-friendly layout - capture opening ideas, tactical mistakes, and improvement goals
- Personal progress tracking - revisit past entries and spot patterns in your play

Perfect for
- Club players who want to reflect after each game
- Students and casual players building a better training habit
- Coaches and learners who need a simple chess notebook for analysis and notes

Why choose us
Tempo Chess Diary is built for focus, not distraction. With a streamlined five-section layout, it gives you a practical home for your chess study without clutter, leaderboards, or community noise. The white background and blue accent style keep the experience clear and easy to use, while the diary approach makes it simple to turn every game into a learning opportunity.

Whether you are preparing for your next tournament, reviewing a tough loss, or tracking steady improvement over time, Tempo Chess Diary helps you stay organised and motivated.

Get started today and make every game count.

name: Tempo Recall
description:
Learn chess openings by remembering the moves, not by cramming them. This app helps you practice and memorize opening lines with spaced repetition: each position comes back when it is time to review it.
HOW IT WORKS
• Learn: step through a line one move at a time, with a short explanation of the idea behind each move.
• Review: you see a position from a line you learned and play the right move on the board. If you play a different move, the app shows the correct one and brings the card back soon. If you play it correctly, you rate how well you knew it, and the next review is scheduled for you.
• Drill: play a whole line from the first move while the app answers for your opponent.
WHAT IS INSIDE
• Eight opening packs with 64 lines for White and Black: Italian Game, Queen's Gambit, Ruy Lopez, Catalan Opening, Caro-Kann Defense, French Defense, Sicilian Defense (Najdorf) and King's Indian Defense.
• An interactive board: tap or drag to move, legal-move hints and a last-move highlight. Choose from three board themes.
• Daily queue with limits you control: new cards per day and reviews per day. Cards from different lines are mixed so you do not just repeat one line in order.
• Hints when you need them. A card answered with a hint can score at most "Hard".
• Stats: reviews per day, retention, your streak, cards by state, and a seven-day forecast of what is coming due.
• Settings: daily goal, desired retention, optional daily reminder, sound and haptics.
• Save your progress to a file and import it again whenever you like.
SPACED REPETITION
Reviews are scheduled with FSRS, a modern memory model. You choose the retention you want, and the app spaces the reviews to match. The explanations are short and written for learning ideas and plans, not just moves.

name: TerAI - SSH Terminal & AI
description:
TerAI is a fast, full-featured SSH terminal for iPhone with an AI assistant built right in.

CONNECT IN SECONDS
• Log in with IP + username + password, or with a private key (PEM, OpenSSH, RSA, ED25519, ECDSA).
• Paste-to-connect: paste an ssh command, an ssh config block or any login text and TerAI fills in the form for you.
• Test the connection before saving, with clear error messages.

A REAL TERMINAL
• Full xterm emulator: 256 colors and truecolor, 10,000-line scrollback. vim, htop, tmux and less work as expected.
• Swipe left or right to switch between servers. Every session stays connected in the background.
• Extra key bar: Esc, Tab, sticky Ctrl/Alt, arrows, ^C ^D ^Z, Home/End, PgUp/PgDn.
• 7 themes: Dracula, One Dark, Nord, Solarized Dark/Light, Gruvbox, Monokai. Pinch to zoom.
• Keep-alive and automatic reconnect when the network drops.

AI ASSISTANT
• Command: describe what you want, get a shell command.
• Explain: select output and get a plain-language explanation.
• Fix: send the last error and get the cause, the fix and the command.
• The AI never runs anything on its own. You choose Insert or Run, and dangerous commands (rm -rf, mkfs, dd, curl | sh…) are highlighted and need an extra confirmation.

BUILD & BROWSE
• Build tab: describe a web app, follow the plan and progress, and get a live link.
• Built-in browser to open and test your sites without leaving the app.

SECURE BY DESIGN
• Passwords, keys and passphrases are stored only in the iOS Keychain on your device.
• Host key fingerprint verification with a warning when a server key changes.
• Optional Face ID / Touch ID app lock.
• One tap to erase all data.

name: Test Ammissione
description:
Preparati ai test di ammissione all'università con un'unica app.

Al primo avvio scegli il test che stai preparando; puoi cambiarlo quando vuoi dal tuo profilo:
- Professioni Sanitarie
- Architettura (ARCHED)
- Test Bocconi
- Test LUISS
- TOLC del CISIA: TOLC-I Ingegneria, TOLC-E Economia, TOLC-F Farmacia, TOLC-B Biologia, TOLC-S Scienze, TOLC-SU Studi umanistici, TOLC-AV Agraria, TOLC-PSI Psicologia, TOLC-SPS Scienze politiche, TOLC-LP Lauree professionalizzanti

Cosa trovi:
- Le prove ufficiali degli anni passati
- Simulazioni d'esame con lo stesso numero di domande e lo stesso tempo del bando
- Simulazioni per materia
- Quiz commentati, sfide con gli amici e classifica
- I tuoi progressi sempre salvati sul tuo account

L'app è realizzata da Test Ammissione S.R.L., che da anni prepara gli studenti ai test di ammissione all'università e ai concorsi.

Contatti
Sito web: https://testammissione.com
Email: info.testammissione@gmail.com

name: The Bay Area Weekend Fetch
description:
Get up, get out, go fetch the weekend.

The Bay Area Weekend Fetch is a hand-picked guide to what's on this weekend and the next two months, from Napa, Sonoma and Marin through San Francisco, the Peninsula and the South Bay, down to Santa Cruz, Monterey and Carmel.

FIND SOMETHING TO DO
• Holiday events, markets, concerts and shows, art, food and coffee
• Picks for young kids, teens and teen programs (with application deadlines)
• Dog-friendly events and dog walks, with notes on where dogs aren't allowed
• Browse by weekend or by date, filter by category and distance from home
• See everything on a map of the Bay Area coast

PLAN YOUR WEEKEND TOGETHER
• Star anything that looks fun. It lands in Our Weekend Plans.
• "Lock it in" for the day you'll actually go, and your weekend schedule builds itself.
• Start a shared plan and invite your household with one tap. Stars and plans sync across everyone's phones, with no account or sign-up.

NEVER MISS IT
• Reminders the evening before and two hours before each locked-in plan
• Add any plan to your calendar in one tap
• Directions and the organizer's page are always a tap away

FRESH EVERY WEEK
The event list is refreshed every Monday and Thursday morning, and the app picks up new events automatically.

No ads. No tracking. No account needed.

name: The Online You
seller_name: Xingheng Shiyue (wuhan) Information Technology Co., Ltd
description:
What does your connection say about you?

Your IP address, apparent location and network provider are part of how websites see you. This app helps you explore those details and understand why different services may see your connection differently.

See your internet identity
Check your public IP, its reported region and network provider. Compare the IP addresses seen by different services, and look for differences between your network location, device language and time zone.

Understand your IP reputation
View reputation signals from multiple sources, including whether your address is identified as a proxy,  data center connection.

Check access to services
See how supported services respond from your current connection and review available region information. Results can help explain access issues; they do not guarantee account access or playback.

Explore your connection
Test IPv6 support, compare public DNS response times, measure service latency, and check download speed, upload speed and responsiveness under load.

Keep a record
Run individual tools or a full checkup. Revisit saved checkup reports, share a report link or image, and import a shared report.

No account is required. Tests use your current internet connection, and results depend on the services that respond. Speed tests may use substantial data.

name: Theory Tutor
description:
Theory Tutor is the companion app for students enrolled in my German driving licence theory classes (taught in Malayalam).

With the app you can:
- Watch the recorded classes of your batch (Basic Knowledge and Class B)
- See your batch calendar, class times and holidays
- Get notices about cancelled or rescheduled classes
- Book exam preparation sessions and set your exam date
- Get reminders for classes and your exam

The app is private. Your Student ID and password are given to you by your tutor after enrolment. There is no public sign-up.

Questions? Contact your tutor on WhatsApp from the Profile screen.

name: Tickshot – Interval Camera
description:
Tickshot takes a series of photos for you. Choose how often and how many, put your iPhone somewhere steady and press start. Tickshot does the rest.

PERFECT FOR
• Time-lapse photos of skies, plants, building work or cooking
• Group photos and portraits without running back and forth
• Product and stop-motion photography
• Any time you need many photos at an even pace

SIMPLE, LIKE YOUR CAMERA
• Full-screen camera with controls that float on top
• Interval from 1 second to 1 hour
• 10 to 1,000 photos, or keep going until you stop
• Start right away or after a countdown
• Tap to focus

PHOTOS THAT MATCH
• Focus, exposure and white balance are locked when the series starts, so the photos don't flicker
• Every photo is taken on schedule – the series never drifts
• Choose 0.5×, 1×, telephoto or the front camera
• Full screen, 16:9, 4:3 or 1:1
• HEIF, JPEG, PNG or RAW (ProRAW on supported iPhone models)

TIME-LAPSE VIDEO
• Turn any series into a time-lapse video right in the app
• 5 to 60 photos per second, in 1080p or 4K
• The video is saved next to the photos in the series' album

YOUR PHOTOS, YOUR LIBRARY
• Each series gets its own album in Photos
• Browse every series one by one or as a grid
• Select photos to share, copy or delete
• Turn off the screen while shooting to save battery
• Warns you before a series if storage or battery is running low
• Shutter sound on or off (where allowed)

Works on every iPhone, including iPhone Duo – open or closed, portrait or landscape.

No account, no ads, no tracking. Tickshot never sends your photos anywhere.

name: Tikko
description:
Tikko is short drama made for your phone.

Watch vertical drama series told in short episodes of about a minute each. Every episode moves the story forward and ends on a cliffhanger, so you always want to see what happens next. Finish a whole story on your commute, during a break or before bed.

LOVE, SECRETS AND TWISTS
Romance, fantasy and drama: arranged marriages, office romances, rivalries, secrets and twists you won't see coming.

MADE FOR VERTICAL
• Full-screen vertical video you can watch with one hand
• Short episodes that fit into any free minute
• See what other viewers are watching right now

YOUR LIBRARY
• Save stories and episodes to watch later
• Like the stories you love
• Pick up right where you left off: your watch history and playback position are saved on your device
• Clear your watch history at any time

NO SIGN-UP
Open Tikko and start watching. No email, no password, no account to create.

Terms of Use: https://legal.doubarent.org/terms.html
Privacy Policy: https://legal.doubarent.org/privacy.html

name: Tile Layout: Plans & Cut Lists
description:
Lay out a floor from your site measurements. Trace corners, set the clear door opening and enter the size of the tiles you have on hand. Set the grout joint and perimeter gap separately. Work in millimeters or feet and fractional inches.

Run one grid through adjoining rooms. Mark the rows already laid. If a measurement changes, open the affected tile to see which edges to measure from, which face goes up and whether you need a new tile.

Share an installation plan, a cut sheet or a revision sheet as a PDF, editable Word document or individual JPG pages. Export the material order as a CSV. Choose the document language independently of the app language.

Try layouts and share a single-tile PDF for free. Activate complete documents for seven projects with your App Store account. Connect once to activate each project, then revise and reprint it offline. A one-time Pro purchase unlocks unlimited projects. No ads.

name: Tinselwick: Christmas Village
description:
A winter storm has swept through Tinselwick, Santa's snowy village, just weeks before Christmas. Roofs are torn, lanterns are dark and the sleigh is stuck in the snow. Help the elves put everything right, piece by piece.

RESTORE A WHOLE VILLAGE
Seven sections with 56 repairs in total: Elf Town, the Elf Workshop, the Reindeer Barn, the Cookie Factory, the Wrapping Station, Santa's Cabin and the Sleigh Repair. Watch every roof, wall, chimney and string of lights go from storm-wrecked to wonderful.

STEP INSIDE
Peek into cozy workshops full of toys, cookies and presents, and see each room light up as you fix it.

PLAY 10 FESTIVE MINI-GAMES
Toy Match, Stable Pairs, Cookie Catch, Gift Sort, Snow Sweep, Lantern Echo, Spark Lines and three tougher ones: Reindeer Slide, Garland Lights and Chimney Drop. Win candy canes to pay for repairs. Your level in every game carries over to each new section.

MEET SANTA AND THE ELVES
Every section has its own host with something to say. Chat with Santa, collect his daily gift, and once the sleigh is repaired, watch him take off for a lap over the village.

DECORATE YOUR WAY
Snowman family, skating rink, ferris wheel, hot air balloons, an ice palace, nightly fireworks and more. Preview each one in place before you buy it.

A DOOR A DAY
Open the advent calendar every day for candy canes and cocoa.

WARM AND RELAXING
Day turns to night with the aurora, twinkling lights and a choice of cheerful carols. Plays on iPhone and iPad, and in landscape on an opened iPhone Duo.

Optional: short video ads for extra candy canes or cocoa, and candy cane packs as in-app purchases. Everything can also be earned by playing.

name: Tiny Bite
description:
Welcome to Tiny Bite, a fun and relaxing puzzle game designed for iOS!   

Guide adorable little bugs to eat tasty treats like donuts, grapes, cupcakes, etc. Simply tap the numbered blocks to match and clear the board. With easy controls, colorful graphics, and exciting levels, it is the ultimate game to relax your mind and pass the time.   

Key Features:
- Simple and easy tap controls for everyone
- Cute animations and colorful sweet themes
- Dozens of fun and addictive puzzle levels
- Great for quick gaming sessions on the go

Download Tiny Bite for free today and start munching!

name: Titanox
description:
Titanox är appen till Titanox-hubben – gatewayen som gör din KNX-anläggning smart. Tryck på en lampa och den tänds direkt. Ändrar någon något på väggen syns det i appen på en gång.

ALLT I HUSET PÅ ETT STÄLLE
• Belysning med dimmer och färg, eluttag och fläktar
• Värme och kyla – börvärde per rum
• Jalusier och markiser med lamellvinkel
• Lås, garageport, grind och porttelefon
• Sensorer: temperatur, CO₂, rörelse, dörrar och fönster
• Philips Hue, Sonos, Husqvarna Automower och IP-kameror

SNABBT PÅ RIKTIGT
Kommandon går över en öppen live-anslutning till huset, så statusen är uppdaterad nästan direkt. Håll in en knapp så följer lampan fingret.

SCENER OCH AUTOMATIONER
Bio, God morgon, God natt – ett tryck. Bygg egna regler: när solen går ner, när någon kommer hem, när en dörr öppnas.

TRYGGHET
Larm med hemma-, natt- och bortaläge, Huskollen som visar om något står olåst eller tänt, skydd mot vattenläckor och brand, semesterläge med närvarosimulering.

HEMMA OCH BORTA
Styr huset varifrån du vill, tryggt via Titanox Cloud. Bjud in familjen och välj vem som får se vilka rum.

ENERGI
Elpris kvart för kvart, smart laddning av elbilen när det är billigast och smart värme.

Fungerar med Siri, widgets och Kontrollcenter.

Titanox kräver en Titanox-hubb kopplad till en KNX-anläggning.

name: To Be Driven
description:
The car is already moving. Someone you know is at the wheel.

Take the passenger seat in an illustrated, interactive story. Join the conversation, choose your replies, and look around as a painted world passes outside.

Let the road unfold.

- An intimate journey told through conversation, scenery, and music.
- A world to explore from the passenger seat.
- Illustrated scenes and small details to discover along the way.
- Separate controls for music and ambient sound.

Free to play, with no advertising, in-app purchases, or account required. The entire game works offline.

name: Tomafood Hub
description:
Tomafood Hub is the manager app for restaurants on Tomafood. Run your restaurant from your phone: take orders, update the menu, check bookings and see how the day is going, wherever you are.

  This app is for Tomafood restaurant partners and their staff. You need a Tomafood business account to sign in. If you want to order food, use your restaurant's Tomafood ordering page instead.

  LIVE ORDERS
  • See new orders the moment they arrive, with push alerts
  • Accept, reject, start, mark ready and complete orders
  • Browse past orders and check payment details

  TODAY AT A GLANCE
  • Sales, order counts and best sellers for today, this week or any period
  • Open or close your shop for online orders with one tap
  • Today's table bookings on the front page

  MENU
  • Edit categories, dishes, prices, options and add-ons
  • Build set meals and packages, with the days and times they're available
  • Manage allergens and dish attributes
  • Choose what appears on your online menu
  • Mark dishes out of stock in seconds
  • Send dishes to the right kitchen station

  BOOKINGS
  • See and manage table bookings
  • Get an alert when a new booking comes in

  REPORTS
  • Sales and order reports
  • Profit and loss, and expense tracking

  RESTAURANT SETTINGS
  • Opening hours and service types (delivery, collection, eat-in)
  • Delivery areas and charges
  • Tables, dining areas and kitchens
  • Offers and promotions
  • Restaurant details, branding and ordering settings

  STAFF AND CUSTOMERS
  • Add staff, give each person a role and choose what they can see and change
  • Manage drivers
  • Look up customers and their details


  POINT OF SALE
  • Set up and manage your till from the app

  BUILT FOR TEAMS
  • Each person sees only what their role allows, so a kitchen worker sees kitchen tasks and an owner sees the full picture
  • Work across several restaurants and switch between them from one account
  • Two-step verification keeps your account safe
  • Light and dark mode

  Everything is live: the app always shows the latest information from your Tomafood account, and changes you make show up straight away on the web manager and your online menu.

  Need help? Contact Tomafood support from your restaurant account.

name: Tonosamart REVERSI 1·2·3
description:
Play Reversi with 1×1, 2×2 and 3×3 pieces. Trap any part of a large piece to flip the whole piece. Challenge the CPU or play with a friend on the same iPhone or iPad. Includes a two-move tutorial and three music-and-scenery choices. Play offline, with no ads or in-app purchases.

In-game languages: Japanese and English, selectable on the title screen. Developed in Japan.

name: TorqueFolio
description: TorqueFolio — ಬೋಲ್ಟ್ ಟಾರ್ಕ್ ಪರಿವರ್ತನಾ ಮೇಜು. N·m, ft·lb, in·lb ಮತ್ತು kgf·m ಅನ್ನು ಪರಸ್ಪರ ಪರಿವರ್ತಿಸಿ; ಕರಪತ್ರದ ಟಾರ್ಕ್ ಮತ್ತು ಸ್ಥಳೀಯ ಕೊದ್ದಿಯ ಸ್ಥಿತಿಗೆ K ಮೌಲ್ಯದ ಆಧಾರದ ಮೇಲೆ ಎತ್ತರದ ಕೀಲಿಗುರುತ ಹೊಂದಿಸಿ. ವಿಡಲ್ ಹಬ್ಬು, SUV ಚಕ್ರ, ಸ್ಪಾರ್ಕ್ ಪ್ಲಗ್ ಇತ್ಯಾದ ಸಾಮಾನ್ಯ ಮಾನದಂಡಗಳನ್ನು ಒತ್ತಿ ಲೋಡ್ ಮಾಡಿ; ಕ್ರಾಸ್/ಸ್ಟಾರ್ ಕಟಿಬೇತ ಸರಣಿಯನ್ನು ಬಿಡಿಸಿ, ಹಂತದ ಟಿಪ್ಪಣಿಗಳು, ನೆಚ್ಚಿನ ಸಂಯೋಜನೆಗಳು, ಉಳಿಸಿದ ಯೋಜನೆಗಳು ಮತ್ತು ಇತಿಹಾಸವನ್ನು ಈ ಫೋನಿನಲ್ಲೇ ಇರಿಸಿ. ಇದು ಉಲ್ಲೇಖ ಮಾತ್ರ; ನಿರ್ಮಾಣ/ಭದ್ರತಾ ವಾಗ್ದಾನವಲ್ಲ. ನಿರ್ಮಾಪಕ ಅಥವಾ ಡಿಸೈನ್ ದಾಖಲೆಗಳಿಗೆ ಆದ್ಯತೆ.

name: tra1ner
description:
tra1ner ist die Team-App für Fußballtrainer, Spieler, Eltern und Vereine. Sie bündelt alles, was eine Mannschaft organisieren muss, an einem Ort. So bleibt mehr Zeit für das Wesentliche: das Training.

KALENDER MIT ZU- UND ABSAGEN
Trainings, Spiele und Vereinstermine auf einen Blick. Spieler und Eltern sagen mit einem Tipp zu oder ab, der Trainer sieht sofort, wer dabei ist. Push-Benachrichtigungen erinnern an neue Termine und Änderungen.

TRAININGSPLANUNG UND SKIZZEN
Plane Trainingseinheiten, zeichne Übungen als Trainingsskizzen und nutze sie immer wieder. tra1ner ist ein Werkzeug für Trainer, nicht nur eine Terminverwaltung.

KADER UND SPIELERPROFILE
Behalte deinen Kader im Blick: Spielerprofile mit Statistik und persönlichen Trainer-Notizen, die nur du siehst.

TEAMCHAT UND UMFRAGEN
Kommuniziere direkt mit deiner Mannschaft, ganz ohne private Messenger-Gruppen. Mit Umfragen stimmst du schnell etwas ab und pinnst Wichtiges oben an. Die Nachrichten werden verschlüsselt gespeichert.

MANNSCHAFTSKASSE
Beiträge, Strafen und Ausgaben übersichtlich verwalten. Jeder sieht transparent, was offen ist.

FAHRGEMEINSCHAFTEN
Bei Auswärtsspielen bieten Eltern Plätze an oder fragen eine Mitfahrt an. Kein Durcheinander mehr in der Gruppe.

FÜR ELTERN GEMACHT
Eltern verwalten mehrere Kinder mit einem Konto und wechseln mit einem Tipp zwischen ihnen.

VOM EINZELNEN TRAINER BIS ZUM VEREIN
Starte allein mit deiner Mannschaft und verbinde dich später mit deinem Verein, ohne dass Daten verloren gehen. Vereine verwalten mehrere Mannschaften zentral und nutzen ihre eigenen Vereinsfarben und ihr Logo.

EINFACH UND SICHER
• Anmeldung per Benutzername, ganz ohne E-Mail-Pflicht für Kinder
• Rollen für Trainer, Spieler, Eltern und Vereinsverwaltung: Jeder sieht nur, was er braucht
• Hell- und Dunkelmodus
• Daten in der EU gespeichert

tra1ner: Mehr Zeit auf dem Platz, weniger am Handy.
Du bist vertrittst einen Verein und möchtes die App für Spieler, Trainer, Eltern nutzen? Dann melde den Verein an unter: www.tra1ner.app

name: TrajectoryOfCreation
description:
An application dedicated to managing the personal creative process and recording the work archives, helping users fully document the entire process from inspiration conception, material preparation to completion.

Whether it's woodworking, pottery creation, model assembly, paper art design, or daily DIY handicrafts, all can be recorded through the application in an exclusive creative archive. Users can customize the production categories, record the tools, materials used, production time, operation steps, and final completion effect each time they create, making it convenient for subsequent review and optimization of the production process.

The application supports functions such as project management for production, statistics of creation time, evaluation of work completion degree, and remarks on production experiences, allowing every hands-on creation to have a trace. By continuously accumulating work records, users can view their creative growth trajectory, organize personal collection of works, and gradually form their own handmade creation database.

Suitable for enthusiasts of handicraft making, DIY players, model collectors, craft learners, creative designers, and users who wish to systematically record their personal creative process.

name: Tripper - Save Your Trip
description:
You've been to great places. Don't let them fade into one hazy memory. Tripper – Save Your Trip is a travel journal: write the trip down while the details are fresh, then find it years later, the way you left it.
Open the app and it asks for your first trip. Name the journey, pick the start and end dates, choose an icon, and the trip card is ready to go.
What you can do
- Add trips in a few taps. Each trip keeps its name, dates and icon.
- Write notes on the move. A note takes a title and up to 500 characters of text: the street you missed, the restaurant that ruined dinner, the phone number of the guide.
- Sort your trips by when you added them or by start date, and open any card to view or edit the trip and its notes.
- Keep a close eye on the stats: how many trips are coming, how many are behind you, the total, and the average length of a trip.
- Switch sounds and vibrations on or off from your profile.
A paper notebook fills up, gets lost, or lands in a drawer. This one doesn't. Keep your trips organised in Tripper – Save Your Trip, and the memories stay exactly as you lived them.

name: TriviaSpin Sports
description:
Test your sports knowledge across basketball, football, and baseball. Spin for a category, answer trivia questions, and see how high you can climb.

Play Unlimited whenever you want, take on the Daily challenge, or go head-to-head in Battle. Compare scores on the leaderboards and share your score cards with friends.

Use the same Trivia Spin account on the app and website to keep your progress and rankings together.

name: TruckMaestro
description:
TruckMaestro to ewidencja czasu pracy, jazdy i odpoczynku oraz nawigacja dla kierowców zawodowych w UE. Pomaga pilnować limitów, planować trasy dla ciężarówki i znajdować parkingi, a dane masz zawsze pod ręką.

CZAS PRACY NA ŻYWO
- Jazda, inna praca, dyspozycyjność i odpoczynek: przełączasz jednym dotknięciem
- Liczniki na żywo: ile możesz jeszcze jechać do przerwy, do końca dnia i tygodnia
- Ostrzeżenia o limitach i przypomnienia o przerwach (powiadomienia)
- Postój w korku liczy się jak w tachografie (jako praca, nie jazda), jeśli masz włączony zapis GPS
- Przekroczenia granic zapisują się same na podstawie GPS (także w tle, tylko podczas rozpoczętego dnia pracy)
- Diety, wynagrodzenie, raporty PDF, wydatki, tankowania, zlecenia, palety, delegowania, dokumenty

NAWIGACJA DLA CIĘŻARÓWEK
- Trasa z wymiarami i masą Twojego pojazdu (wysokość, szerokość, długość, nacisk, ADR)
- Warianty trasy z czasem przejazdu, przerwami i zakazami ruchu
- Pełny ekran, głos, limit prędkości dla ciężarówki, ostrzeżenia o ograniczeniach na trasie
- Automatyczne przeliczenie trasy po zjeździe z niej
- Podpowiedzi "gdzie stanąć" zanim skończy się czas jazdy

PARKINGI TIR
- Baza parkingów w Europie z ocenami kierowców i zgłoszeniami zajętości
- Dodawanie własnych parkingów (najpierw prywatnych; po sprawdzeniu możesz je udostępnić wszystkim)

DLA KOGO
Dla kierowców ciężarówek i busów w transporcie międzynarodowym oraz dla firm, które chcą mieć ewidencję i ostrzeżenia w jednym miejscu. Aplikacja w 6 językach: polski, angielski, niemiecki, ukraiński, rumuński i węgierski.

WAŻNE
TruckMaestro nie zastępuje tachografu ani oficjalnych dokumentów. Wyniki mają charakter orientacyjny i pomagają prowadzić własną ewidencję. Plany i płatności zarządzasz na stronie internetowej TruckMaestro. Pytania: kontakt@truckmaestro.com

name: Turn-Key: Northwood Game Haven
description:
Northwood Game Haven is a board game cafe, tabletop game shop, retro arcade and event center in Chippewa Falls, Wisconsin — the region's first. 3000+ tabletop games, 1000+ on the shelf in-store, 700+ video game titles on real CRTs, three game rooms, two overnight party suites, and a Guru to teach you anything you pull down. Veteran-owned. This is the app for the people who play here; the table tools work anywhere.

THE GAME COMPANION APPS — FREE, NO ACCOUNT, NO ADS:

FIRST PLAYER — settle who goes first
Everyone puts a finger on the screen and holds still; the Haven picks. Choose 1-3 winners, split 2-4 teams, or number everyone into a turn order. Twelve ring colors, confetti, an optional chime. Lift a finger early and the round re-arms.

TURN-KEY™ — the turn tracker, patent pending (needs a connection)
Host a table; others scan the QR or type the code. Your phone becomes your seat: the ring is your color and counts down your turn, and the center shows who's up by color and shape. Tap the center to end your turn. Up to 16 players, 32 colors, turn timers, emoji reactions, host controls, and seats for players without a phone.

LIFE COUNTER — Trading Card Games (TCGs)
2 to 6 players at 20, 30 or 40 life. Tap the top of your tile to gain, the bottom to lose, hold to run, drag for fives. "Around the table" flips the far seats 180 degrees so everyone reads their own total upright. Commander damage grid with partner commanders, lethal at 21. Poison, energy, experience, monarch, initiative, city's blessing, day/night dimming, dice and a coin flip. Everything is undoable, the history is plain English, and the game survives a restart.

RPG COMPANION — five tabs for the whole Role-Playing Game (RPG) session
- Dice: d4 through d100, or type a formula. Keep-highest and drop-lowest, modifiers, advantage/disadvantage. Maximums gold, ones red, drops struck through. Last 30 rolls; tap one to reroll.
- Combat: self-sorting initiative, round counter, tap HP to damage or heal, temp HP, 14 conditions plus exhaustion, concentration, and death saves at zero.
- Character: a full d20 sheet with saves, all 18 skills, spell slots 1-9, inventory, coin, features, short and long rests.
- Rules: searchable reference — conditions, combat actions, cover, resting, death saves and more. SRD 5.1, CC BY 4.0.
- Notes: recaps, NPCs, loot, quest hooks. Autosaves as you type.

IMMERSIVE EVENT NIGHTS AT THE HAVEN:
- Karaoke Battle — every room is a team. Scan the TV's QR, queue a song, sing on the house mics while the other rooms score you. Lyrics on the TVs and your phone.
- Team Trivia and event streams — play from your seat, or watch the TV feed on your phone.
- Table-Hop Gaming — check in and get your table, partner and opponents, with a round countdown.
- Tournament nights — event code, format, entry, prizes and live pairings.

EVERYTHING NORTHWOOD GAME HAVEN:
- Haven Rewards — email sign-in, no password. Your balance, the code and QR for the register, purchases and upcoming bookings.
- Food, drink and retail specials, with one-time coupons on your phone.
- Order ahead from the shop and cafe for pickup — pay now or pay at the register.
- Tonight's events, the full event calendar, room and suite booking, and the free-play game libraries.

Immersive events have to be live at the Haven to join. Companion table tools never need an account.

name: TurnLoom
description:
TurnLoom — Compost Yard Log

Keep your community compost yard organized, from incoming materials to recorded outputs. TurnLoom brings bay management, weighing, turning, temperature readings, and screening records into one practical workspace.

See your yard clearly
View your bay layout, track lot locations and stages, and manage daily tasks.

Record incoming materials
Capture gross, tare, or net weights alongside material sources, moisture observations, and contaminant handling. Group multiple materials into one intake session.

Document turns and transfers
Record whole-lot movements, water additions, checklists, work time, and before-and-after photos while preserving each lot’s history.

Follow measured temperatures
Log readings at defined points and depths, view temperature trends, and compare recorded observations around selected operations.

Track screening and destinations
Record measured feed, fine fractions, oversized material, and other products. Keep unreconciled differences visible and log storage, use, or returns to active lots.

Keep useful records
Review and correct entries with retained history, export PDF logs and CSV data, and back up or restore your workspace.

TurnLoom works offline with local storage and requires no account. Optional photos and reminders support your workflow.

Temperature trends and recorded observations support recordkeeping; they do not certify compost maturity or suitability for use.

name: Tutifruti AI
description:
Tutifruti AI es el juego de Stop (también llamado Basta o Tutti Frutti) para jugar con amigos, con un árbitro de inteligencia artificial que revisa cada respuesta y se acabaron las discusiones.

CÓMO SE JUEGA
• Sale una letra al azar.
• Escribe una palabra para cada categoría: nombre, país, animal, fruta, color y más.
• El primero en terminar dice ¡STOP! y se acaba el tiempo para todos.
• El árbitro de IA valida las respuestas y explica por qué acepta o rechaza cada una.
• 10 puntos por respuesta única, 5 si alguien más la repitió.

JUEGA CON QUIEN QUIERAS
• Salas privadas: comparte el código o el enlace y juega solo con tus amigos.
• Salas públicas: únete a una partida abierta en segundos.
• Hasta 12 jugadores por sala.
• iPhone y web juegan juntos en la misma sala.

A TU MANERA
• Elige rondas, tiempo y categorías, o crea categorías propias con ayuda de la IA.
• Juega en español, inglés o portugués.
• ¿No estás de acuerdo con el árbitro? Impugna la respuesta y la IA la revisa de nuevo.
• Chat y reacciones en cada sala.

SUBE DE NIVEL
• Gana experiencia en cada partida.
• Desbloquea avatares, temas y logros jugando.

TODO ES GRATIS
Sin compras ni suscripciones. Entra como invitado y empieza a jugar al instante, o crea una cuenta para guardar tu progreso y agregar amigos.

name: TypeScale - Type Calculator
description:
TypeScale is a modular type tool for UI designers, graphic designers and indie developers.

FEATURES
• Base size 10–32 pt
• 8 classic ratios from 1.067 to 1.618
• 4–9 level preview
• WCAG contrast check
• Export CSS, SwiftUI and JSON
• Chinese / English, iPhone + iPad
• No account, no network, no ads, no subscription

name: UBoard
seller_name: Enhancement of Bangla Language in ICT through Research & Development
description:
UBoard is a keyboard for Bangla and the other languages of Bangladesh, made by Bangladesh Computer Council. Type in your mother tongue in every app, and design your own layout key by key.

BANGLA, THREE WAYS
• Jatiya, the national standard layout
• Avro Phonetic: type Bangla in roman letters, ami gives আমি
• Khipro, with its official typing rules
Conjuncts and vowel signs come out right, and suggestions from a Bangla word list of over 44,000 words appear above the keys as you type.

THE LANGUAGES OF BANGLADESH
Layouts for Chakma, Marma, Mro, Santali, Mahale, Malto and Sylheti, each with its own script, digits and long-press letters, and English. Turn on the layouts you use and swipe the space bar to switch between them.

DESIGN YOUR OWN LAYOUT
Start from any layout and put any letter on any key in the visual editor: Shift letters, long-press letters and the number row. Find any character by name. Share your layout as a .uboard file; the same files work in UBoard for Android.

VOICE TYPING IN BANGLA
Tap the microphone on the toolbar and speak Bangla. UBoard types your words as you go, using Kotha, the Bangla speech-to-text service of Bangladesh Computer Council. Voice typing needs an internet connection and Allow Full Access.

THEMES FROM BANGLADESH
Classic, and four illustrated themes: Nakshi Kantha, Jamdani, Borsha and Pohela Boishakh, each in light and dark.

MADE FOR EVERYDAY TYPING
• Key preview and long-press letters, with hints on the keys
• Swipe the space bar to move the cursor; swipe from Delete to delete whole words
• A toolbar for the clipboard, paste, copy and moving the cursor
• Clipboard history and one-handed mode
• Backup and restore of your settings and layouts

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
UBoard does not collect what you type and does not send it anywhere. It has no accounts, no ads and no analytics. Typing works fully without Allow Full Access; only voice typing, the clipboard and vibration need it. The only thing that ever leaves your phone is your voice while you use voice typing.

Layouts for the community languages are reviewed with native speakers; if a letter is missing or in the wrong place, tell us at support@bangla.gov.bd.

UBoard is developed by Bangladesh Computer Council, ICT Division, under the Enhancement of Bangla Language in ICT through Research and Development (EBLICT) project.

name: Ufire Talk
description:
Ufire Talk er din træningspartner, når du vil tale et nyt sprog i hverdagen. Her øver du dagligdags samtaler gennem scriptede dialoger fra virkelige situationer – så du får konkret træning i præcis de situationer, du faktisk står i.

Vælg et scenarie, læs replikkerne, og øv dig i dit eget tempo. Hver dialog er bygget op omkring en bestemt situation, så du lærer ordene i den sammenhæng, hvor de rent faktisk bliver brugt. Du følger samtalen trin for trin, og for hver replik, du får styr på, vokser selvtilliden.

Appen holder øje med dine fejl. Det, du kommer galt af sted med, bliver registreret, så du kan se, hvor du snubler igen og igen. Det er ikke en dom, men et kort over dine huller – og det gør det nemmere at sætte ind præcis der, hvor der er mest at hente.

Dit ordforråd vokser med. Nye ord og vendinger bliver samlet, så din egen ordliste udvider sig i takt med dine samtaler, og du kan altid vende tilbage til det, du har haft svært ved.

Ufire Talk er til dig, der lærer et sprog for at kunne bruge det. Er du træt af at øve sætninger inde i hovedet og vil have dem ud over læberne? Så er det her, du starter.

name: Ultra Dental Store
description:
Ultra Dental Store is the ordering app for dental clinics in Kirkuk and across Iraq. Browse the catalogue, order the supplies your clinic needs and get them delivered to your door.

Order in minutes
• Browse products by category and brand, with prices in Iraqi dinar.
• Add items to your cart, save favourites to your wishlist and reorder from your order history.
• Choose delivery as soon as possible or pick a time slot.
• Apply discount vouchers at checkout.

Follow your delivery live
• Orders in Kirkuk are delivered by our own drivers. See each step of your order, from accepted to delivered, and follow the driver on the map in real time.
• Orders to other cities are sent with a delivery company and paid in cash on arrival.
• Proof of delivery with the recipient's name and a photo.

Made for clinics
• Save several delivery addresses with a map pin so the driver finds you first time.
• Invoices for every order, returns handled in the app and a support inbox for any question.
• Available in English, Arabic, Kurdish and Turkish.

Ultra Dental Store is for dental professionals and clinics. An account is required to order.

name: Unhoard: Clean Up Your Photos
description:
Got thousands of screenshots? Unhoard finds every screenshot and screen recording on your iPhone, oldest first, with how much space they take. Select them all or swipe through them one by one, then delete them in one step.

Then keep going: similar shots, blurry photos, big videos, accidental clips and media saved from chat apps, all collected in one delete tray.

Everything is scanned on your iPhone. No account, no ads, no subscription, no tracking. Unhoard is open source.

SCREENSHOTS FIRST
• Screenshots and screen recordings in one place, oldest first, with their count and size
• Select All skips favorites, edited screenshots and ones in your own albums, so the ones you kept on purpose stay
• Or swipe: left to delete, right to keep, with Undo

ALSO FINDS
• Similar shots: photos taken within two minutes of each other that look alike, grouped, with the best one marked
• Blurry photos with nothing in focus (dark and night shots are left out)
• Utility shots: receipts, labels, whiteboards and other photos of things rather than moments
• Large videos over 50 MB, biggest first
• Accidental clips: very short clips that are dark or one flat color, like a covered lens or a pocket
• Short moments: other clips under 3 seconds. Make Still saves the sharpest frame as a photo, with the clip's date and location
• Saved from apps: media that chat and social apps saved to your library, labeled with the app
• Sensitive photos: passports, IDs, cards, passwords and Wi-Fi labels. Move them to the locked Hidden album, or delete them one by one

HOW YOU CLEAN
• Grid: tap to select, drag sideways to select a range, long-press to preview
• Compare: look at similar shots two at a time, zooming both together, and pick the one to keep
• Delete tray: everything you pick waits in one tray, saved between launches, and goes in one step
• History: see how much you've cleared over time

YOUR MEMORIES COME FIRST
• Favorites, edited photos and photos in your own albums are never selected for you
• Only Similar Shots selects anything for you, and it always keeps the best of each group
• Sensitive photos are never selected in bulk
• Deleted items go to Recently Deleted in Photos and stay there for 30 days, so you can change your mind. The space comes back when Recently Deleted is emptied; Unhoard shows you how to do that in Photos
• If you use an iCloud Shared Library, deleting an item removes it for everyone in that library

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
Unhoard looks at small thumbnails of your photos on your iPhone, with Apple's Vision framework. The developer collects no data, and Unhoard has no server.

AN OPTIONAL SECOND OPINION
Not sure whether a borderline photo is a memory or clutter? Ask for a second opinion: each photo is labeled a memory, a utility shot or an accident, with a one-line reason. On iOS 27 with Apple Intelligence it runs on your iPhone. Or use Claude with your own Anthropic API key: a consent sheet first shows the exact small previews that will be sent (512 pixels at most, with no location, dates or camera details), and sensitive and hidden photos are never sent. The second opinion only labels photos; it never deletes or selects anything. You don't need it: Unhoard finds and cleans everything without it.

SCANS THAT PICK UP WHERE THEY LEFT OFF
The first scan reads your library's details, not your originals. It's saved as it goes, so a stopped scan resumes, and later scans only read what changed. Leave the app and the scan keeps going for as long as iOS allows; an unfinished scan can also finish overnight while your iPhone is charging. Categories fill in while it runs, with a percentage and the time left.

Looking for exact duplicates? Use the Duplicates album in Apple Photos; Unhoard handles the rest.

Requires full access to your photo library, to find items and to delete the ones you choose.

Open source under the MIT license: github.com/kleash/unhoard

name: Unlog
description:
Unlog turns the flat Apple Log footage from your iPhone into a finished film, without leaving your phone.

GRADE EVERY CLIP
• Put your own .cube LUTs on your footage at any strength, or start from built-in looks
• See every look on a scene it suits, then on your own clip with one tap
• Shape the light with exposure, contrast, highlights, shadows, whites and blacks
• Colour wheels, a colour mixer, split toning and white balance from a single tap
• Match a photo: build a look from the colours of any still you love

CUT IT INTO A FILM
• A real timeline with trims, cutaways on a second track, gaps and speed changes
• Transitions, music, voiceovers and captions written for you from what people say
• Pick clips straight from your folders in Files, iCloud Drive or any cloud drive
• Any shape: 16:9, 9:16, 4:5 or 1:1, with every clip reframed to fit

SEND IT ANYWHERE
• One tap for Instagram, TikTok or YouTube, in the right shape
• Save to Photos or Files
• Judge your grade on a big screen over AirPlay or a cable

UNLOG PRO — ONE PURCHASE, NO SUBSCRIPTION
• 4K export
• DaVinci Resolve export: your cut as a timeline and every clip's grade as a LUT
• Overlays and film FX: grain, halation, light leaks, burns, flashes and film frames
• Recap: a day or a trip turned into a short film automatically
• Masks for local corrections

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
No accounts, no analytics, no ads. Your footage never leaves your iPhone unless you send it somewhere.

Made for footage shot in Apple Log on iPhone 15 Pro and later, in the Camera app or Blackmagic Camera. Ordinary videos and photos work too.

name: Upp: NFC Alarm Clock
description:
The alarm turns off in the kitchen, not in bed.

Upp only stops ringing when you scan an NFC tag: the one you stuck on the coffee machine, the bathroom mirror, or across the house. By the time you've walked there, you're awake. That's the whole trick, and it works.

YOUR DATA STAYS IN YOUR BEDROOM
No account. No cloud. No analytics. Upp makes zero network calls of its own. Alarms, sleep insights and streaks are computed entirely on your iPhone. The App Store privacy label says "Data Not Collected" because there is genuinely nothing to collect. (If you turn on the spoken weather briefing, weather comes from Apple's own weather service. That is the only network touch, and it's optional.)

ONE PRICE. EVERYTHING INCLUDED.
Buy it once and every feature is yours: tag routes, custom sounds, sleep sounds, the lot. No subscription, no "Pro" tier, no upsells waiting inside.

BUILT FOR REAL MORNINGS
• Rings through silent mode and Focus (real iOS 26 alarms, not notifications)
• Tag routes: chain up to 4 tags (bedroom, bathroom, kitchen) before the alarm gives in
• Snooze budget you set the night before, down to zero
• Escalating snoozes that shrink: 9, then 6, then 3 minutes
• Gentle-wake tones that start quiet and build
• Sleep sounds generated live on your phone (rain, ocean, white, pink and brown noise) with a wind-down fade
• Streaks, wake history, home and lock screen widgets, Shortcuts and Action Button support
• A printable backup code so a lost tag never locks you out
• Face ID lock so 11 PM you can't sabotage 7 AM you

Works with any cheap NTAG stickers (a pack of 10 costs a few dollars).

GET UPP AND ON WITH YOUR DAY
One tag, one price, no subscription. Start every morning on the right foot for about the cost of one morning coffee. Once, not every month.

name: UYAP Mobile Editor
description:
Open UDF documents used by UYAP system on your Phone. Read, search, edit supported files, and export them as PDF, PNG, or TXT—all while working offline.

> READ DOCUMENTS EASILY
- Open supported .udf files from the Files app.
- Navigate multipage documents, zoom in, and search inside text.
- Quickly return to recently opened files in your local library.

> CREATE AND EDIT DOCUMENTS
- Create new UDF documents or make changes to supported files.
- Format text with bold, italic, underline, colors, and paragraph alignment.
- Use find and replace, undo, and redo when editing.
- Save edited documents as new UDF copies.

> EXPORT AND SHARE
- Export UDF documents to PDF, PNG images, or plain text (TXT).
- Import TXT files to create UDF documents.
- Convert up to 20 UDF files into separate PDFs in one batch.
- Save results to Files or share them with other apps.

> WORK OFFLINE
Reading, editing, and converting documents happen on your device. No account is needed, and document processing does not require an internet connection.


Privacy Policy:
https://udf-pocket-support.fullwallaby4.chatgpt.site/privacy/

Term Of Use:
https://udf-pocket-support.fullwallaby4.chatgpt.site/terms/

name: Vana: Pocket Companions
description:
A little world by your side.

Vana brings a peaceful Pokémon habitat to your iPhone. Choose from 25 companions and watch them idle, wander, look around, and settle in for a nap.

A LIVING MEADOW
A small 3D island with grass, flowers, rocks, and fireflies gives your companion a place to feel at home. Switch between daytime and moonlit lighting.

GENTLE INTERACTIONS
Tap your companion to say hello, offer a treat, or let it rest. Soft interaction sounds can be muted at any time.

AT HOME ON YOUR DESK
Keep Vana open while docked for continuous 3D movement beside a large clock. The layout adapts to portrait, landscape, and the changing displays of iPhone Duo.

A STANDBY COMPANION
Add Vana to StandBy for a moonlit pose widget. Wave to request a happy greeting or use the rest button to help your companion settle down. Widget refreshes are controlled by iOS; open the app for continuous motion.

OFFLINE AND PRIVATE
All models, animations, and sounds are bundled with the app. No account, advertising, subscription, or internet connection is required. Your selected companion and preferences stay on your device.

Designed for iPhone and iPhone Duo. Requires iOS 17 or later.

name: Vasfie - Prayer Times
description:
Days can get busy, and prayer time sometimes comes around sooner than expected. Vasfie keeps your prayer times close, without adding more noise to your day. When you open the app, you'll see your next prayer and how much time is left. The rest of today's times are just below.

Prayer times, wherever you are
