Vasfie finds the prayer times for your city, anywhere in the world. It starts with the calculation method commonly used in your country, but you can choose another if that's what you follow. The times match the Vasfie prayer clock, and two years of them are saved on your phone, so they're still there when you're offline.

Reminders that fit your day
Maybe a simple notification is all you need. Maybe you'd rather hear the adhan. Each prayer can have its own setting, or no reminder at all. There are adhans from Turkey, Mecca, Egypt and Qatar, including separate Turkish adhans for Fajr, Asr and Maghrib.

On iPhone, the notification plays the first 30 seconds of the adhan. Opening the notification lets you hear the full recitation.

You can also have a reminder ahead of prayer time. It's set to 45 minutes by default, or 60 minutes for Asr, and can be adjusted. For Fajr, the adhan can sound at the start of its time or 30, 45 or 60 minutes before sunrise, as is common in many mosques. If your phone is on silent, Vasfie won't start the adhan on its own.

A few more things to make life easier
Getting started is simple, with a short setup for your city and prayers. There's a Qibla compass, home screen widgets, a full month's prayer times and the Hijri date alongside today's date. During Ramadan, sahur and iftar times are available in Prayer times and Settings. Kerahat times are there if you use them, too.

Vasfie supports larger text and six languages: English, Nederlands, Türkçe, Français, Deutsch and العربية, including right-to-left Arabic.

Your privacy matters
There are no ads, no account to create and no tracking. Your location is used only to find prayer times and is rounded to roughly a kilometre before it leaves your phone. Your saved places and settings stay on your device.

Made by AHISKA, the team behind the Vasfie prayer clock.

name: VaultLink: Password Vault
description:
Keep accounts, credentials and their relationships together in VaultLink.

Organize logins, email identities, phone details, API keys and tokens. Browse by category or service, search your vault, and view how accounts connect to registration and recovery identities.

Your master password is separate from Google or Apple sign-in. Vault contents are encrypted on your device before storage or cloud sync. Link Google and Apple sign-in to one VaultLink account; existing separate accounts are not automatically merged by the app. Keep your offline recovery key safe: losing both your master password and recovery key can mean losing access.

iOS AutoFill requires Face ID or Touch ID and a recently unlocked VaultLink vault. Matching website passwords require your explicit selection. Availability varies by app and website.

VaultLink's encryption is experimental and has not been independently audited. Use test credentials only while evaluating it.

This version is free and contains no advertising or in-app purchases. Vault access, existing encrypted sync and autofill are included.

Privacy policy: https://kennyhacrt.github.io/vaultlink-privacy/
Terms of Use: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/

name: Veltra.
description:
Still remember what you benched last time? Veltra puts that answer in the plan.
Barbell, dumbbell, kettlebell, cable, machine, or bodyweight. Build it for the gym or for home. You choose the weeks, the days, and which lift comes first. Set the weight, then start the clock. Finish a set, and the next one is ready to log.
Finished work shows up as progress: an estimated max, the weight you moved, the areas you trained, and whether you keep coming back. Set a target for any lift. Your heaviest set and your best reps stay in sight.
Next time you walk in, you already know what to add.

name: Velvet Wheel
description:
Every turn changes what comes next.

Enter Velvetwheel, a theatrical strategy puzzle where two rotating rings become a mechanical score. Match symbols and tones in the right order, preserve your limited pins, and plan each move within a fixed beat budget.

THREE MOVES, MANY POSSIBILITIES

Glide advances both rings. Cross moves them in different directions. Pin holds the inner ring while the outer ring advances.

Preview your next landing before committing. A matching pair advances the score, but every committed move costs a beat—even when the next cue is still waiting.

18 SOLO ACTS

Explore handcrafted puzzles that combine ordered cues, exact-beat entrances and Pin-only targets. Later acts bring these rules together, asking you to look beyond the next match and consider the position it leaves behind.

6 DUET CHALLENGES

Direct two independent scores through one shared instrument. Choose Voice A or Voice B before each move, then decide how to use the rings, beats and pins they share.

Only the selected voice can receive a matching cue. Advancing one line changes the possibilities for the other, so switching at the right moment becomes part of the solution.

LEARN, EXPERIMENT AND REFINE

• Try a short interactive rehearsal before your first act.
• Explore illustrated guides for solo and duet play.
• Inspect the full score and preview moves without spending a beat.
• Receive practical strategy advice after an unsuccessful attempt.
• Review completed attempts beat by beat in My performances.
• Adjust wheel animations and haptic feedback in Settings.

Play at your own pace. Beats count your moves; they are not a real-time countdown.

Choose your move. Read the rings. Bring both voices into harmony.

name: Vexluma
description:
• Save a floor with room size, tile size, joint, grout depth, and thinset coverage
• Tile count along each wall rounds up, and the last piece is the length left over
• Full tiles and cut tiles are counted separately
• A waste percent rounds the tile count up to tiles you should buy
• Spacer crossings are one less than the tiles on each side
• Grout volume is the joint lines times the joint width times the depth
• Thinset bags are the floor area divided by the coverage on one bag
• Erase the local file from the manual

name: ViDubbing
description:
ViDubbing là trình duyệt lồng tiếng Việt cho video. Mở trang video bất kỳ, bấm "Lồng tiếng" và nghe video bằng giọng Việt tự nhiên, ngay trên trang.

• Mở được mọi trang web: trang video, khoá học trực tuyến, trang phim…
• Lấy lời thoại theo hai cách: phụ đề sẵn có của video, hoặc đọc chữ phụ đề hiện trên hình (nhận dạng chữ ngay trên máy).
• Dịch sang tiếng Việt bằng tính năng dịch của iPhone hoặc bằng AI của ViDubbing (dùng credit).
• 5 giọng đọc tiếng Việt (Ngọc Lan, Quang Huy, Minh Anh, Thu Hà, Yến Nhi), chỉnh được tốc độ và âm lượng.
• Tiếng gốc của video giữ nguyên, nhỏ lại hoặc tắt khi đang lồng tiếng.
• Che phụ đề gốc, đổi cỡ chữ, chế độ sáng/tối.

Đăng nhập bằng Apple hoặc Google để nhận credit dùng thử dịch AI. Có thể xoá tài khoản ngay trong ứng dụng (Cài đặt → Tài khoản → Xoá tài khoản).

name: Visual Piano Bars
description:
Turn printed piano sheet music into falling notes you can see, hear, and play.

Snap a photo of a page and Visual Piano Bars reads it right on your device, then plays it back as a glowing piano roll with a real grand piano sound. Follow the bars down to the keys, slow the tempo, and learn songs at your own pace.

NEW: PLAY ALONG
• Pick a hand and play the keys as its notes fall
• Perfect, Good, and Miss on every note, with combos
• Finish with a letter grade and accuracy score
• The keyboard zooms in so every key is easy to hit
• Start with the built-in demo, Satie's Gymnopédie No. 1

SCAN YOUR SHEET MUSIC
• Photograph pages with the camera, or choose photos you already have
• A lighting check warns you about shadows before you scan
• Reads the title and tempo for you
• Works offline. Your photos never leave your device
• Import MusicXML files too

SEE AND HEAR EVERY NOTE
• Falling notes colored by hand
• Sampled grand piano playback
• Slow down or speed up to practice tricky passages
• Suggested finger numbers on the notes
• Numbered bar lines to keep your place
• Sheet view with notation or your original photos
• Drag through a paused score to hear each note

MAKE IT RIGHT
• Tap a note to change its pitch or remove it
• Full note editor for pitch, timing, and hands
• Fix this section re-reads a single line from a close-up photo

FREE TO START
Scan up to two pages per score, keep three scores of your own, play the first two minutes of any score, and play along three times a day. The demo is unlimited.

PRO (one-time purchase, no subscription)
• Multi-page scans
• Full-length playback
• Note editing and Fix this section
• Unlimited Play along
• Unlimited library

Made for beginners learning to read music, adults coming back to piano, and anyone who learns better by watching the keys.

name: Voladito Express
description:
Gestiona los paquetes de tu casillero de Miami a Nicaragua con Voladito Express. Consulta su estado, revisa las fotos disponibles y prepara tus prealertas desde el celular.

Ingresa con el mismo usuario y contraseña que utilizas en el portal de Voladito Express.

Paquetes y rastreo
• Consulta los paquetes registrados en tu casillero y sus fotografías disponibles.
• Busca un número de tracking en Entrada General y Scanner, incluidos los resultados con estado HOLD.

Prealertas a mano
• Registra una prealerta con tracking, tipo de envío, contenido, valor declarado y una fotografía.
• Consulta tus prealertas desde su propia sección en la app.

Tu cuenta y tus facturas
• Revisa las facturas pendientes y los abonos registrados.
• Consulta los avisos disponibles de paquetes y prealertas.

Cotiza tu pickup
• Selecciona la dirección de recogida y consulta tarifa, distancia, tiempo estimado y vigencia de la cotización.
• Revisa tus recogidas existentes y sus detalles.

Una cotización no programa una recogida. Las notificaciones requieren autorización del dispositivo y dependen de la conexión y las condiciones del sistema.

Voladito Express conecta tus compras en Estados Unidos con Nicaragua a través de sus servicios de envíos aéreos y marítimos.

Volando Por Ti....!

name: Volaro: IPTV Player & M3U
description:
Will tonight's stream hold up? Volaro answers before you press play. Its built-in Flight check times how fast your provider responds, reads a few seconds of your live channels and gives a straight verdict: Smooth for 4K, Good for HD, OK for SD, or too slow for now.

Volaro is a quick, focused player for the Xtream Codes account or M3U playlist you already have.

WHAT YOU GET
• Flight check: response time in milliseconds, download speed in Mbit/s on a live gauge, and a plain-words verdict. The last 10 results per playlist stay on your phone. On mobile data it tells you first that a check uses about 20 MB.
• TV guide as a now/next board: one card per channel with what's on, how much is left and what follows. Step to any time of the day, open a channel's full day, set a reminder five minutes before a programme starts, and replay past shows when your provider offers catch-up.
• Live TV with channel numbers, logos and a progress line for the current programme, categories in a searchable sheet, and zapping inside the player.
• Movies and series with posters, seasons, episodes and resume points, plus Continue watching on the home screen.
• Favorites, your own lists, search across the whole playlist, and a child lock with a 4-digit PIN for sections, categories or single channels.
• Rewind live TV: on Xtream channels with catch-up, pause live or go back up to four hours with −10 min, −2 min and −30 s keys or the bar, then return to live with one tap. It plays your provider's own archive; nothing is recorded.
• A player dashboard under the video: now and next, signal details, today's programmes and the lineup. Audio and subtitle tracks, playback speed, a sleep timer and adjustable subtitle style.
• iPhone and iPad layouts, with the menu docked beside the content on iPad.
• Add a playlist in three steps: name it, pick Xtream Codes or M3U link (or an M3U file), enter the details. A pasted get.php link fills the Xtream fields for you.

ONLY A PLAYER
Volaro brings no channels, movies, series or playlists of its own and is not tied to any provider. You load a playlist you are entitled to use, from a provider you are allowed to use, and the app plays what that playlist contains.

VOLARO MAX
Max removes ads, lets you keep more than one playlist and unlocks your own lists. Plans and prices are shown in the app before you buy.
Payment is charged to your Apple Account at confirmation of purchase. Subscriptions renew automatically for the same period unless auto-renew is turned off at least 24 hours before the end of the current period; your account is charged for renewal within 24 hours before the period ends. You can manage or cancel subscriptions in your Apple Account settings. Any unused part of a free trial is forfeited when you buy a subscription.

Terms of Use (Apple standard EULA): https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/
Privacy policy: https://volaro-4h2.pages.dev/privacy
Questions or feedback: support@volaroapp.com

name: VRC Power Translation
description:
VRC Power Translationは、PC用アプリ「VRC Power Translation PC Bridge」（別売り）と接続して、PCから届く自分側・相手側の音声をiPhoneで文字起こしし、翻訳するアプリです。

音声認識と翻訳は端末内のモデルで処理します。認識結果と翻訳を端末に表示し、ペアリングしたPCへ送信します。クラウド音声認識・クラウド翻訳サービスへ会話を送る構成ではありません。

日本語・英語・韓国語・中国語・ロシア語を選択できます。言語や設定により追加モデルが必要です。翻訳モデルはGitHubから別途ダウンロードし、使用前にライセンスを確認します。モデル未導入でも同梱モデルによる対応言語の文字起こしを利用できます。初回はチュートリアルで、PCとのつなぎ方と、このiPhoneに合うモデルの組み合わせを案内します。

Wi-Fi/LAN、USB、Bluetooth LE接続に対応します。初回はPCに表示されるQRコードをiPhoneのカメラで読み取ってペアリングします。

表示言語・テーマ・文字サイズ・発話区切りを調整できます。

iOS 16以降のiPhone向けです。PC用アプリ「VRC Power Translation PC Bridge」（別売り）、モデルの保存領域、モデル取得時のインターネット接続が必要です。処理速度と結果は端末・モデル・音声により異なります。翻訳モデルはPLaMoを利用しています（Built with PLaMo）。VRChat公式アプリではありません。

name: VROOM Motorsports
description:
VROOM Motorsports is India's premier digital platform for motorsports athletes, racers, and enthusiasts. Discover upcoming track days, drag racing championships, and national racing events, register your vehicles, and get your verified digital paddock pass and competition number in minutes.

Key Features:
• Official Event Discovery: Browse upcoming 2-Wheeler and 4-Wheeler racing events, schedules, circuit details, and rulebooks.
• Seamless Rider & Vehicle Registration: Register across multiple FMSCI/event racing classes with automatic competition number allocation.
• Digital Rider ID & Paddock Pass: Instant QR-coded entry tickets and digital rider IDs that you can save directly to your phone.
• Garage & Document Management: Manage your registered bikes and cars, upload RC and license documents, and track scrutineering status in real time.
• Live Event Updates: Stay informed with official race control announcements, schedules, and venue guidelines.

name: Vryndal
description:
• Save a candle with inner diameter, fill height, wax density, fragrance load, and vessel count
• Volume treats the jar as a cylinder and converts cubic inches to milliliters
• Wax weight is the volume times the density you type
• Fragrance is a percent of the wax, and the pour is wax plus oil
• A batch multiplies by the vessel count and a waste percent, then rounds wax up to grams
• A starting wick band comes from the inner diameter
• A pot weight is divided into full pours, with the remainder left in the pot
• Erase the local file from the manual

name: VToss
description:
VToss turns your room into an arcade. Point your iPhone or iPad at the floor or a wall, tap, and a game appears right there: a dig site spreading across the floor, a pond sunk into it, a dartboard on the wall, a cat chasing your laser across the room.

SIX GAMES

• DIG SITE: Drive a hydraulic excavator over a beach, a dirt lot, dunes or a quarry laid out on your floor. Dig pits, build stockpiles and fill dump trucks. Take jobs, earn cash, level up and buy a bigger bucket, faster hydraulics and more land. One-button controls for kids, real twin-stick controls for everyone else.

• LASER CAT: Draw a laser dot with your finger and a cat stalks it, wiggles, pounces and gets the zoomies. It jumps up on your sofa and table after the dot. Earn new coats as you play.

• RING SWING: The beach-bar classic. Hang the hook on your wall, then swipe to swing the ring on its string. Line it up, keep it smooth and chase your best streak.

• FISHING: Dig a pond into your floor, then cast, hook and fight bluegill, perch, bass, trout and catfish. Spin the reel, watch the line tension and land the big one.

• DARTS: Hang a regulation dartboard on your wall and play 501, with checkout hints to help you finish.

• CORNHOLE: Set a board on your floor and toss bags. On the board scores one, in the hole scores three. First to 21.

MADE FOR REAL ROOMS

• Games fit the space you have: floors, tables and walls.
• Swipe to throw. Your phone stays steady in your hands.
• Quick rounds or long sessions, at your own pace.

FREE TO PLAY, FAIR TO BUY

• Ring Swing and Laser Cat are free, for good.
• Every other game has free play, so you can try them all.
• One purchase unlocks the whole arcade for good. No subscription.
• No ads. No accounts. What the camera sees stays on your device.

VToss needs an iPhone or iPad that supports AR. Clear some space, keep a firm grip on your device and watch your surroundings while you play.

name: Waiting to Die
description:
Got a little time to kill?

Waiting to Die gives your idle thumbs somewhere to go. Play an endless rotation of five deliberately low-stakes challenges:
• Tap the pulsing target.
• Swipe in the arrow’s direction.
• Rebuild a picture by sliding tiles into the gap.
• Find three matching pairs.
• Put number tiles back in order.

We keep count while you keep playing. Valid moves confirm the actual time between actions. Stop for more than 12 seconds, pause or leave the app, and unconfirmed time is discarded.

Finish a run to collect a receipt, review your local history or share your impressive achievement in nothing. Local play needs no account.

For optional world rankings, sign in with Apple and start an online ranked run. Your generated alias, server-confirmed time and rank appear on the board. Local guest history stays on your iPhone and never enters world scores.

Free. No in-app purchases, subscriptions, ads or tracking.

This is a playful record of game time. It does not measure thoughts, health, attention or a mental state.

Little games. No grand purpose.

name: Waitinger Delivery Partner
description:
Turn every wait into winning with the Waitinger Delivery Partner app! Designed specifically for delivery riders, drivers, and logistics fleets, our app empowers you to manage orders seamlessly, navigate efficiently, and maximize your earnings on your own flexible schedule.

Key Features:
• Instant Order Alerts: Receive real-time delivery requests directly to your device with clear pickup and drop-off details.
• Smart Navigation: Get optimized routing and directions to ensure every package and meal arrives hot and on time.
• Earnings Tracker: Monitor your completed trips, tips, and daily payouts instantly within a clean, easy-to-use interface.
• Flexible Schedule: Work when you want, where you want—take full control of your working hours.
• Direct Support: Access quick assistance and communication tools whenever you need help on the road.

Join the Waitinger fleet today, hit the road, and turn your time into high earnings!

name: Waqt – Prayer Tracker
description:
Waqt answers one question: did you pray?

Each day has five prayers. Waqt shows the one you're in, tells you when it ends, and lets you log it with a single slide. That's it. No feed, no account, nothing to scroll.

TODAY
The current prayer, large and in Arabic, with the time it began and when it ends. Slide when you've prayed. Changed your mind? Tap to undo.

TIMES
All five prayer times for the day, plus sunrise. Tap a circle to log a prayer on time, swipe right to mark it prayed, or swipe left for late or excused. Look back at any day, or ahead up to a week.

INSIGHTS
See your week as a simple grid, your month as a calendar, and your year as one square per day. Waqt shows your best day, the prayer you miss most, and how you compare with the period before. Excused prayers are left out, so the record stays fair.

WIDGETS
Log from your Home Screen. Tap a circle on the Tap to log widget, or press Prayed on the Log the current prayer widget. Other widgets show the current prayer, today's times, this week and this year.

REMINDERS
A quiet notification when each prayer begins. Nothing else, ever.

PRAYER TIMES
Calculated on your phone from your location or a city you choose. Choose ISNA, Muslim World League, Umm al-Qura, Egyptian, Karachi or Diyanet, or let Waqt pick for your region. Standard or Hanafi Asr. On Fridays, Waqt shows Jumuah in place of Dhuhr, and you can turn that off.

SEVEN LOOKS
Sky, Pastel and Ring, in seven colourways. Your widgets follow the look you pick.

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
No account and no sign-up. No ads and no analytics. Your prayer record stays on your phone.

name: WashDay Tracker
description:
Stop second-guessing when you last washed your hair. 

WashDay is a mindful, aesthetic routine tracker designed to help you balance your hair care cadence, track dry shampoo refreshes, and understand your scalp health—all with zero ads, zero accounts, and 100% on-device privacy.

Whether you're training your hair, following the Curly Girl Method (CGM), extending washes with dry shampoo, or simply managing a busy workout week, WashDay makes personal care visual and effortless.

WHY YOU’LL LOVE WASHDAY:

• SMART WASH CADENCE
Know exactly how many days it’s been since your last deep wash. Keep your hair healthy without over-washing or stripping natural oils.

• FULL WASH VS. DRY SHAMPOO VS. REST DAY
Not every day requires a shower. Log your quick Dry Shampoo refreshes, full wash sessions, or low-maintenance rest days with one satisfying tap.

• SCALP FEELING LOGS
Notice when your scalp feels Fresh, Balanced, Oily, or Itchy. Each log syncs an intuitive emoji straight to your calendar, so you can connect the dots between your habits and hair health.

• VISUAL BADGE CALENDAR
Never look at a confusing dot calendar again. Our spacious month view stamps bold, color-coded badges (Wash, Dry, Rest) and scalp emojis directly onto each day. Tap any past date to adjust or add notes instantly.

• PRIVATE CYCLE & PERIOD TRACKER
Your reproductive health is your business. Track your menstrual cycle alongside your personal care routines. Guaranteed 100% offline with optional Face ID / Biometric lock protection.

• CALM, TIMELY REMINDERS
Set gentle local reminders so you can plan your wash routine around gym sessions, busy mornings, or special events.

OUR PRIVACY PLEDGE:
• No accounts or logins required.
• No cloud servers. No data tracking.
• Everything stays on your physical iPhone.

Take control of your hair routine. Download WashDay and make every wash day a good hair day.

name: Waxwrite
description:
Waxwrite plans the wax and dye order for a decorated egg, then walks each step on this iPhone.

You pick a division, paint the cells, and place stars, wheat, ladders, waves, pines, or crosses. Waxwrite works out which parts to wax before each bath, and tells you when two colors would turn muddy.

Follow the egg one action at a time. A timer runs for the bath you are in. Close the app and the timer keeps going.

Share the steps as a PDF, or the finished egg as a picture.

Eggs stay on this phone. There is no account and no sign-in.

name: WAY: COLOR YOUR WAY
description:
WAY reads a color from a photo and shows you the colors that go with it.

Take a photo or pick one from your library. WAY finds the most prominent color, asks "Is this the color you meant?", then lays out its matches under ten color harmonies, each with HEX and RGB codes ready to copy.

FIND THE COLOR
• Capture with WAY's own viewfinder. Put the color in the square and watch its name and HEX code update live.
• Upload any photo from your library, or tap Try to start with a sample image.
• Not the color you meant? Step through up to five colors found in the photo, or drag across it to pick the exact spot. A magnifier shows the color under your finger.
• WAY adjusts for the color of the light on its own. For a truer read, use Set White: touch something white or gray and the cast is removed from the whole photo.
• Every reading comes with a confidence label: High, Medium or Low.

SEE WHAT GOES
• Ten harmonies in one list: complementary, split-complementary, analogous, triadic, tetradic, square, monochromatic, tints, shades and tones.
• Matches are balanced to look as light and as strong as your starting color, so a set reads as a set.
• Two wheels: Light (RGB), the screen wheel, and Paint (RYB), the traditional painter's wheel. In Paint, tints, shades and tones mix the way paint does.

PLAY WITH THE WHEEL
• Turn the wheel to change the starting color and the harmony follows.
• Switch between the ten harmonies with one tap.
• Add an undertone of white, gray or black and set how much with a slider.
• Type a HEX code or RGB values to start from a color you already have.

KEEP YOUR PALETTES
• Name and save a palette. It keeps the color, harmony, wheel, undertone and opacity, so it reopens exactly as you left it.
• Tap a color to copy its HEX code; press and hold for RGB.
• Share any set as plain text, with every HEX and RGB code.
• Every color gets a name from a list of 877. When a color sits between names, WAY tells you how far round the wheel it is, like OLIVE +12°.

NOTHING ELSE
No account. No sign-in. No ads. No tracking. No data collected. WAY works without a connection, photos are never kept, and your palettes stay on your iPhone.

COLOR YOUR WAY.

name: Website Update
description:
Website Update is the scheduling workspace for authorized Unsolicited Plant Talks staff.

Plan inventory and price changes before a greenhouse release. Search active Shopify products, add the quantities you want to restock, and schedule changes for the right date and time.

Create Exact Plants listings with photos, prices and weights. Edit drafts, rearrange photos and choose the destination update. The service prepares hidden listings ahead of time, then makes them active and publishes them to the Online Store when the update runs.

Keep upcoming updates and history together, check completion status, and pull down inside an update to refresh. Optional six-digit PIN unlock protects the saved sign-in on your device.

This app is intended for authorized Unsolicited Plant Talks staff. A staff account is required for connected store operations. Sample data is available to explore the interface.

name: Wedding Guest: RSVP & Updates
description:
Wedding Guest is the app for the wedding you've been invited to.

Enter the code from your invitation and you're in. No account, no password.

• The plan — every event of the wedding weekend, day by day, with times and directions.
• RSVP in a minute — find your name, answer for everyone on your invitation, add any dietary needs.
• Things to do — a short checklist from the couple: reply, book flights, sort somewhere to stay.
• Good to know — the venue, travel, accommodation, gifts and the couple's answers to common questions.
• Updates from the couple — turn on notifications and hear straight away if timings change or the coach is leaving.
• A countdown, because it's nearly here.

Getting married? Wedding Guest gives your guests one place for everything, and gives you one way to reach them all. Find out more at weddingguest.app.

name: Weegoon Office
description:
Weegoon Office

A simple and convenient app that helps employees manage their daily work activities, check attendance records, submit requests, and stay connected with colleagues.

DAILY ATTENDANCE

Track check-in and check-out times.
Check late arrivals and early departures.
Keep track of your daily working hours.

ATTENDANCE TRACKING

View monthly attendance records.
Check working days, working hours, and days off.
Review detailed attendance history.

REQUEST MANAGEMENT

Submit leave, late arrival, and early departure requests.
Request permission to go out, work online, or attend company events.
Track request statuses: pending, approved, or rejected.

PERSONAL PROFILE

View your account information.
Update your profile picture and personal status.
Check your current work status.

STAY CONNECTED WITH COLLEAGUES

Chat and communicate with colleagues.
Receive internal announcements and updates.
Send birthday wishes and greetings on special occasions.

Weegoon Office – Work happily, stay organized, and let the app handle the details!

name: Wego by Cellwego
description:
WEGO by Cellwego is an internal communication platform designed exclusively for CELLWEGO employees, providing a convenient and centralized way to stay connected, collaborate, and communicate across the organization.

Whether you're working at the office, warehouse, or store, WEGO helps you stay in touch with your colleagues anytime, anywhere.

KEY FEATURES

Instant Messaging
Communicate with colleagues through a simple and intuitive messaging interface. Stay connected and exchange important work-related information efficiently.

Voice and Video Calls
Connect with team members through voice and video calls for faster communication and collaboration, wherever you are.

Workplace Communication
Keep conversations organized within a dedicated company communication platform, reducing the need to rely on personal messaging applications.

Mobile Accessibility
Stay connected to your workplace directly from your mobile device, making communication convenient for employees across different departments and locations.

Designed for CELLWEGO
WEGO is developed specifically for CELLWEGO's internal operations, providing employees with a unified communication experience.

COMING SOON

WEGO is designed to evolve into an integrated workplace platform with additional features such as task management, memos, company notifications, and other CELLWEGO system integrations.

IMPORTANT NOTICE

WEGO by Cellwego is intended exclusively for authorized CELLWEGO employees. It is not a public messaging service. Access to the platform requires an authorized company account.

WEGO by Cellwego — Connect. Communicate. Collaborate.

name: WhiskyCircle TV
description:
WhiskyCircle on the big screen. Discover whiskies, explore your cabinet and relive your tastings.

DISCOVER WHISKY
Browse whiskies from around the world, with bottle facts, community ratings and illustrated flavour profiles for nose, palate and finish. Discover the whisky of the day and move from bottle to bottle with your remote.

YOUR CABINET
Explore your collection on your television, including your own ratings. Let Pour Me pick a whisky from your cabinet.

TASTE TOGETHER
Present a whisky tasting on Apple TV. Change slides with your remote or control the presentation as host from your phone. Show group scores and reveal blind bottles when the time is right. The TV follows the host live.

MEMORIES
Revisit completed tastings with your personal top three, the group’s favourites and all scores. Enjoy photos from the evening in a full-screen slideshow with gentle movement, transitions and optional music. Keep your favourite tastings close at hand.

FROM PHONE TO TV
Pair Apple TV with your WhiskyCircle account by scanning the QR code using the WhiskyCircle phone app. Open a whisky or tasting on your paired TV from your phone. Add a rating or tasting note on your phone and see the updated score on TV.

Requires a WhiskyCircle account and the WhiskyCircle app on a compatible phone to pair the TV. Internet connection required. Available in Dutch, English, German, French and Spanish.

For adult whisky enthusiasts. Enjoy responsibly.

name: White Notes
description:
White Notes is a pure-white, minimalist notes app. Open it and start writing. Nothing else is on the page.

JUST BLACK ON WHITE
• A clean white page with no colors, no clutter and no distractions
• Titles, headings, bold, italic, underline and strikethrough when you need them
• Pure White, Pure Black, or follow the system appearance
• Four text sizes

LISTS THAT KEEP UP
• Checklists: tap the circle to tick an item off
• Bulleted and numbered lists that continue on their own
• Add photos from your library or camera
• Undo and redo every step

ORGANIZED YOUR WAY
• Categories you can drag into any order
• Pin important notes to the top
• Search all your notes, or find text inside a note
• Sort by date edited, date created or title
• Recently Deleted keeps notes for 30 days

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
• Lock any note with Face ID, Touch ID or your passcode
• Optionally require authentication every time the app opens
• No account, no ads, no tracking. The app never connects to the internet
• Your notes stay on your device

YOURS TO TAKE ANYWHERE
• Share a note as text, PDF or Markdown, or print it
• Export all your notes at once as Markdown files
• Made for iPhone and iPad
• Available in 45 languages

Pay once and get every feature. No subscription, no in-app purchases.

name: WordDuel - Word Quiz Duel
description:
Pizza toppings. Dog breeds. Things in a kitchen. Your turn – name one before the clock runs out!

WordDuel is a fast, real-time 1v1 word game. You and your opponent get the same category and take turns naming answers. Get it right and the turn passes to your rival. Guess wrong and you lose a second – keep trying until your clock runs out, then it costs you a life.

HOW IT WORKS
- Tap Quick Duel and get matched in seconds.
- See the category, wait for 3-2-1, then take turns.
- You have 12 seconds per turn and 3 lives per duel.
- A correct answer passes the turn. Wrong guesses are unlimited, but each one costs 1 second.
- Run out of time and you lose a life.
- No repeats: once an answer is taken, it's gone for both players.
- Out of ideas? Use a Joker to reveal an answer or grab +10 seconds.
- Lose all three lives and you lose the duel.

PLAY A FRIEND
Create a private room and share the 4-letter code, or join a friend's room. Settle who really knows more animals, foods or famous places.

85 CATEGORIES, 16 LANGUAGES
Food, animals, places, sports, everyday things, culture and nature – plus local questions for your country. Play in English, Spanish, Portuguese, Turkish, German, French, Japanese, Korean, Chinese, Polish, Czech, Slovak, Ukrainian, Serbian, Croatian or Bulgarian, against players who speak your language. Answers are checked automatically, and small differences like accents and plurals are accepted.

LEVEL UP
- Earn XP, level up and collect coins and gems.
- Complete daily and weekly missions.
- Climb 30 tiers of the free Duel Pass each season.
- Claim a daily gift and build your 7-day streak.
- Climb the global leaderboard and reach the podium.

SHOW YOUR STYLE
Unlock answer bubble skins, avatar frames, titles, reaction stickers and season characters – your rival sees them all during the match. Equip your favourites in the Locker and check the daily deals in the shop.

FAIR AND FRIENDLY
- Play as a guest in seconds – or sign in with Apple or Google to keep your progress.
- No ads and no tracking.
- When no other player is around, a bot steps in so you never wait long – the matchmaking screen tells you when that can happen.
- Offensive words are filtered, and you can report or block a player from the results screen.
- Delete your data any time from your Profile.

Think fast, type faster. Ready to duel?

Support: https://wordduel-0.web.app/support.html
Privacy Policy: https://wordduel-0.web.app/privacy.html
Terms of Use: https://wordduel-0.web.app/terms.html

name: Wupiko: Wake-Up Alarm
description:
Meet Wupiko, a tiny sunseed who lives in your phone and really, really wants you up on time.

Wupiko is an alarm clock with one rule: no second chances. There's no snooze button. When your alarm rings, you stop it, then you prove you're awake.

WAKE-UP CHECK
After you stop an alarm, Wupiko asks for a short wake-up ritual: chase Wupiko around the screen, swipe open the curtains, drag the sun over the hills or pop sleepy bubbles. The ritual changes every day so your half-asleep thumb can't learn it. Go back to sleep instead, and the alarm rings again after 1, 3 and 6 minutes.

BUILD A MORNING STREAK
Every morning counts as on time, late or missed. Keep your streak going to grow a garden and unlock outfits for Wupiko. Miss a morning and Wupiko will be visibly sad about it.

SIMPLE ALARMS THAT JUST WORK
• Pick a time, a sound and any repeat days
• Name your alarms so you know why you're getting up
• Rings over the lock screen, after a restart and when the app is closed
• Three custom sounds: Daybreak, Chime and Ripple
• Light and dark themes with skies that follow the time of day

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
Wupiko works completely offline. No account, no ads, no tracking, no analytics. Your alarms and streak never leave your phone.

Psst — tap Wupiko. It likes that.

name: Xiaojiang: Daily Health
description:
A little care, every day.

The app interface is currently available in Simplified Chinese only. Its installed name is 小江助手 (Xiaojiang); some screens retain the original name 知常 (Zhichang).

Xiaojiang is an iPhone companion for everyday habits, records and reminders. Daily recording, calendar reviews and local reminders work without an internet connection. No account or sign-in is required.

REMINDERS THAT FIT YOUR ROUTINE
Set your water goal, movement interval, lunch break and bedtime reminders. Weekday and rest-day routines can differ. A shared lunch break pauses water and movement reminders, and you can snooze reminders when you are busy.

QUICK WAYS TO RECORD
Log water and movement in the app, from supported notification actions or through the home screen widget. Use the app icon's quick action to log a cup. Get confirmation when a record is saved, with an opportunity to undo accidental entries.

SEE YOUR WHOLE DAY
The health calendar brings water, movement, weight, waist measurements, meals, sugary drinks and bedtime confirmations together for each day. Add past entries and correct dates with conflict protection. Review 7, 30 or 90 days of trends; days with no record are not treated as zero.

YOUR RECORDS, YOUR CHOICES
There are no ads or third-party analytics SDKs. Daily records are stored on your device. Export PDF, CSV or password-protected backups when needed. Optional automatic backups write to a folder you choose; if you select a cloud folder, that provider handles file synchronization.

MAKE IT FEEL LIKE YOURS
Choose from ten themes, use larger system text and keep today's water and movement status on your home screen. The app supports iPhone with iOS 17 or later.

PLEASE NOTE
Water and movement records require your input or confirmation. Movement reminders use a timer; they do not detect sitting posture. Bedtime confirmations do not measure sleep. The initial water goal can be changed to suit your circumstances.

Xiaojiang does not diagnose illness or provide treatment plans or medication-dosage advice. Follow professional advice for medical decisions.

Notification delivery depends on permission, Focus, notification summaries and iOS scheduling. Opening the app or handling reminders replenishes its notification queue. Check the reminder-coverage status in the app.

name: Yacht Vector: Yachting News
seller_name: MSM INTERIOR DESING MOBILYA SANAYI VE TICARET LIMITED SIRKETI
description:
Superyacht and yachting industry news, every day, plus a directory of shipyards, brokers and yacht interior firms, new-build and refit projects, and the boat show calendar.

Calm, focused reading in English and Turkish. No clutter, no account needed.

DAILY BRIEFING
Start the day with the stories that matter: launches, deliveries, refits, shipyard news and market moves from around the world, written clearly.

SUPERYACHT STORIES
New builds, sea trials, refits, design and the business of yachting, organised by topic so you can read what is relevant to you.

DIRECTORY
Explore shipyards, yacht interior firms and brokers. Each company has its own page with its projects and the news it appears in.

PROJECTS
Follow new builds, refits and concepts: length, delivery year, designer and interior firm, all on one page.

BOAT SHOW CALENDAR
Boat shows and industry events in one calendar, so you know what is coming up and where.

FOLLOW WHAT YOU CARE ABOUT
Follow companies and topics. When something new happens, such as a story, a project or a launch, you get a notification. A couple a day at most, never at night.

SAVE FOR LATER
Keep the stories you want to come back to.

BUILT FOR READING
No banners, no pop-ups. Light and dark mode. Signing in is optional: you can read everything without an account. Sign in only to sync your saved stories and follows.

Two languages, one industry: switch between English and Turkish at any time.

Yacht Vector is published by MSM Interior Design Mobilya Sanayi ve Ticaret A.Ş.
https://yachtvector.com

name: YakhCalc
description:
YakhCalc hjælper dig med at forstå og planlægge traditionelle ishuse. Appen er lavet til restauratorer, arkitekter, forskere og driftsteam, der arbejder med passiv køling.

Med YakhCalc kan du:

• Beregne vinterens teoretiske isproduktion ud fra klima, bassin, skyggevæg, vind og frysedage
• Estimere underjordisk lagerkapacitet, restis, smeltehastighed og pladsudnyttelse
• Sammenligne to strukturforslag med kuppel, vægtykkelse, dybde, pakning og isolation
• Registrere årlige driftsdata for produktion, sommerrestis, temperatur og vedligehold

Funktionerne er samlet i en enkel og klar grænseflade, så du hurtigt kan oprette beregninger, gemme resultater og følge udviklingen år for år.

Brug YakhCalc som et praktisk værktøj til restaurering, forskning og genopbygning af traditionelle ishuse.

name: Yaotuji · Meteorización
description:
Yaotuji es una herramienta de cálculo de meteorización para adobe, ladrillo sin esmalte y teja. Introduce seis datos —temperatura de cocción, espesor de la pieza, inclinación del muro, orientación solar, salinidad del suelo y sombra del tejado— y obtén el ciclo de sustitución o reparación, el riesgo de hielo-deshielo y de salitre, la vida útil de la cubierta y un plan de juntas.

Funciones principales:
· Cálculo de meteorización: seis parámetros y resultado inmediato en forma de ficha
· Fichas de paramento: una ficha por tejado, con parámetros, fotos y notas de revisión
· Nota de campo: fotografía el paramento e indica superficie intacta, salitre, exfoliación o borde roto
· Lista de control: ocho comprobaciones en obra, guardadas en el dispositivo
· Avisos: notificación local diaria, semanal, quincenal o mensual
· Cuaderno de oficio y catálogo de daños: saberes populares y cuatro patologías típicas
· Conversión de unidades: ángulo, espesor, humedad y sal en ambos sentidos

Esta herramienta solo recoge la experiencia popular de conservación de materiales de horno; el resultado es una referencia aproximada y no sirve para dictaminar la seguridad estructural de la cubierta.

name: Year Sheet
description:
Year Sheet is for someone who just paid a household water, electricity, or gas bill and still has that bill on the counter. Write the kind, the amount, and the date it was paid. The calendar year of that date is the year this iPhone counts.

Open the year to see water, electricity, and gas side by side, the year total, and which of the three is the highest. Add your name and a way to reach you, then write a sheet on this iPhone for the person who shares the home. Share that file with the system share sheet. The file stays where you can see it after the sheet closes.

Only water, electricity, and gas. Amounts are the whole numbers you type. Bills and the sheet stay on this iPhone.

name: YoupiStream
description:
YoupiStream diffuse en direct l'écran de ton iPhone ou de ton iPad, avec le son du jeu et ta voix. Tu lances le live, tu passes dans ton jeu, et tes spectateurs suivent ta partie sur ta chaîne YouTube.

EN DIRECT, EN UN TOUCHER
• Connecte ta chaîne YouTube : le direct se crée tout seul, avec son titre, sa description et sa visibilité (public, non répertorié ou privé).
• L'écran part en 1080p, avec le son du jeu et le micro.
• Tu préfères une autre plateforme ? Colle son adresse de diffusion et sa clé de flux.
• Le débit s'adapte à ta connexion pour éviter les coupures.

LE CHAT SOUS LES YEUX
• Le chat de ton live s'affiche dans une fenêtre flottante, par-dessus le jeu.
• Le nombre de spectateurs reste visible pendant toute la partie.

FILME-TOI AUSSI
• Passe de l'écran à la caméra avant ou arrière sans arrêter le live.
• Un écran de pause et un écran de fin habillent ton direct.
• Régie : un deuxième iPhone ou iPad, sur le même Wi-Fi, pilote le live à distance.

ENREGISTRE SANS DIFFUSER
• Le mode REC enregistre l'écran sur l'appareil. Rien ne part sur Internet, aucun compte n'est demandé.
• Tes enregistrements se retrouvent aussi dans l'app Fichiers.

MONTE TA VIDÉO SUR PLACE
• Coupe les longueurs, ajoute des textes, des zooms sur l'action et ta voix off.
• Choisis une musique dans la bibliothèque fournie.
• Recadre en vertical pour en tirer un Short.
• Choisis ta miniature dans la vidéo, puis publie sur ta chaîne, tout de suite ou à l'heure que tu fixes.

TES DONNÉES RESTENT À TOI
• Aucune publicité, aucun pistage, aucun compte YoupiStream à créer.
• Tes données YouTube ne passent que par ton appareil et par Google.
• Tu te déconnectes en un toucher : l'accès à ton compte Google est retiré aussitôt.

Pour diffuser en direct sur YouTube, ta chaîne doit avoir le direct activé, selon les conditions de YouTube. YoupiStream utilise les services de l'API YouTube.

name: Your Empire: Kingdom Strategy
description:
You inherit a crown. The borders are negotiable

Your Empire is a strategy game about ruling a fictional country on a map of the real Earth. Begin as a young ruler, answer the events brought before you and see how far your reign can go. Between decisions, neighbors fight, cities change hands and the world carries on

Make the call
A commander proposes an attack. A neighbor demands land. A rebellion reaches the capital. Choose how to respond in illustrated events, then live with what follows. War, diplomacy and the occasional terrible idea all have a place at your court

Put real cities under your flag
Explore a papercraft map of 4,396 real cities and their surrounding territories. Watch captures and losses redraw the borders. Win a foothold, expand your realm and attempt to conquer the world within one ruler's lifetime

Watch the people near the throne
Advisers, generals and family have loyalties and ambitions of their own. A useful ally can become a rival. Balance the army, treasury and stability as trouble comes from across the border and inside the palace

See a world change
Start in a medieval world where discoveries can lead to gunpowder, factories and railways. Empires and faiths are invented for this world. The cities are real, and the drama comes with a dark sense of humor

One ruler, one lifetime
Age, stress, coups and war can bring your reign to an end. When it does, see your reign in numbers: land, population, victories and more. Share your final record and compare achievements in the Hall of Rulers

Set the pace
Pause to take a closer look, speed up time or return to your saved reign later

Free to play
An internet connection is required

name: ZAP!FM Radio
description:
Tune the world out. Turn ZAP!FM on.

Familiar hits and forgotten favourites, from the sixties to today. Take your music with you in the official ZAP!FM app.

• Start live radio with one tap and choose your stream quality.
• See the current track and artist with album artwork or an artist photo.
• Find out which programme is on and whether it is LIVE or NON-STOP.
• Rediscover tracks played in the past hour in a list with artwork.
• Keep listening in the background and control playback from the Lock Screen.
• Send your music to a compatible speaker with AirPlay.
• Explore the programme schedule and the story behind ZAP!FM.
• Call or WhatsApp the studio using the fixed action buttons.
• Choose Dutch or English; the app remembers your preference.

An internet connection is required for live radio, track information and website pages. Mobile data usage depends on the selected stream quality. WhatsApp is subject to its own terms.

ZAP!FM. Your music. Your moment.

name: ZEVQORA Gold Notebook
description:
ZEVQORA is a private notebook for the gold you own. Keep bars, coins, rings, first-birthday rings and wedding jewelry in one place, and see how much gold you hold and roughly what it is worth.

Vault
· Record gold bars, coins, rings, first-birthday rings, necklaces, bracelets and earrings
· Purity (24K, 22K, 18K, 14K), weight in grams or don, quantity, price paid, purchase date, shop and storage place
· Keep a photo of each piece together with its receipt or warranty card
· Search by name, shop or place and filter by category

Price log
· Write down the 24K buy and sell prices per don from your gold shop's board
· 1-month, 3-month and 1-year trend charts with day-to-day changes
· 18K and 14K prices worked out from gold content

Your total at a glance
· Total pure gold in don and grams
· Estimated value at your own recorded price, and gain or loss against what you paid
· Holdings by purity

Calculators
· Unit converter: gram, don, nyang and troy ounce
· Purity calculator: pure gold in 18K and 14K
· Sell estimate: what a shop may pay after its deduction
· Gift budget: plan baby rings and wedding gifts with labor fees

Gift records and gold guide
· Track gold given and received at first birthdays, weddings and holidays, with a D-day countdown
· Learn to read hallmarks, don and nyang units, buy versus sell prices, the first-birthday ring custom, care tips and a checklist before selling

Stays on your iPhone
· No sign-up, no ads, no internet connection
· Face ID lock, CSV export, backup and restore

ZEVQORA is for record keeping only. It does not buy or sell gold, does not provide live prices and does not give investment advice. Values are estimates based on the prices you enter.

name: Zodiac Curling
seller_name: HAI DUONG DEVELOPMENT AND CONSTRUCTION COMPANY LIMITED
description:
Slide curling stones with zodiac animals in Zodiac Curling, a bright offline ice game.
Choose Ox, Dragon, Tiger, Rabbit, or Snake, then play a Classic Match or a Distance Challenge on Easy, Normal, or Hard.
Drag your animal left and right to choose where the stone is released. Drag on the open ice to aim, and follow the green fan. Press and hold to charge power. Power rises and falls while you hold, and a sideways slide fine-tunes the angle. Release to throw. The opponent is a different zodiac animal chosen at random.
Features:
5 playable zodiac animals: Ox, Dragon, Tiger, Rabbit, and Snake
Classic Match and Distance Challenge
Easy, Normal, and Hard
Drag to set the release position
Drag on the ice to aim, with a green direction fan
Hold to charge power that rises and falls, then release to throw
Classic Match is best of 3 ends, with 5 stones for each side in every end
Distance Challenge compares each side's furthest stone
Stones that leave the sheet are removed
How to Play guide on the home screen
Character, mode, and difficulty saved on your device
Fully playable offline
Aim, time the power, and win the sheet!

name: Zuppy
description:
Zuppy is a journal for the animals you live with.

One pet or several. A name, a photograph, the breed, the birthday, the weight, the microchip, and the clinic you already use.

Write down what happens. A visit, a dose, a walk, a note, grooming. Pin what matters to the home screen, and look back when you need the date.

Zuppy can remind you before a visit, a dose, or grooming. The reminder stays on this iPhone.

Keep the papers with the pet. A photo or a PDF opens in the journal, and you can read it full screen.

Weight is a history, in kilograms or pounds.

The journal stays on the phone. There is no account, and nothing is uploaded. Delete Zuppy, and the journal goes with it.

Zuppy follows the language and the light of your iPhone.

This is a personal record. It is not veterinary advice.

name: Вдвоём: приложение для пары
description:
«Вдвоём» - приложение для пары: один общий уголок для дел, планов и тёплых мелочей, которые вы делаете вместе.

Пригласите партнёра по ссылке или QR-коду, и все общие разделы появятся у вас обоих. Данные хранятся в вашем iCloud и синхронизируются между двумя телефонами, без отдельного аккаунта и чужих серверов.

ЧТО ВНУТРИ

• Сегодня - главное на день: дела, события и вопрос дня на одном экране.
• Задачи - общие списки с подзадачами и заметками. Нажмите «Беру», чтобы взять дело на себя, или отметьте, что сделал партнёр.
• Календарь - события и задачи с датами в одном месте, с напоминаниями.
• Планы - копите на общую мечту вместе: цель, сумма, вклады каждого и история пополнений.
• Вопрос дня - партнёр задаёт вам вопрос, вы отвечаете, и вы узнаёте друг друга чуточку лучше.
• Хотелки - списки желаний со ссылками, заметками и фото.
• Капсулы времени - письма в будущее, которые откроются в назначенный день.
• Заметки - общие записи с блоками и напоминаниями.
• Документы - копии важных документов под защитой Face ID. Они хранятся только на вашем устройстве и никуда не отправляются.
• Виджеты - главное прямо на экране «Домой».

ПРИВАТНОСТЬ

Все общие данные хранятся в iCloud и доступны только вам двоим. Мы не собираем аналитику, не показываем рекламу и не передаём данные третьим лицам.

Приложение работает и без партнёра: вы можете начать вести дела сами, а пригласить его позже.

name: Игральня — клуб гостей
description:
Игральня — приложение для гостей клуба.

КЛУБНАЯ КАРТА
Смотри бонусный баланс и историю посещений. Если ты уже пользуешься Игральней в Telegram, войди через нашего бота — карта, бонусы и история сохранятся.

ЗАДАНИЯ И БОНУСЫ
Выбирай задания, активируй их и следи за прогрессом. Возвращайся в клуб и получай награды по условиям программы лояльности. Новым гостям — 150 приветственных бонусов после подключения карты.

БАСКЕТБОЛ
Играй прямо в приложении. Побеждай в зачётных партиях и получай бонусы по правилам клуба.

ТУРНИРЫ И СОБЫТИЯ
Выбирай события в афише, записывайся и следи за ходом турнира. UFC, FC и CS2 — результаты, статистика, рейтинг и достижения в твоём профиле.

КОМНАТЫ И ПОСЕЩЕНИЯ
Выбирай филиал и смотри доступные комнаты и свои записи.

Вход через нашего Telegram-бота с одноразовым кодом или через Apple. В настройках можно связать способы входа с одним профилем. Доступность услуг, заданий и начислений зависит от филиала и действующих правил Игральни.

name: Коктейли 2027 — Artmark
description:
Цифровое продолжение настольного календаря Artmark на 2027 год. Двенадцать месяцев — двенадцать коктейлей с живыми иллюстрациями, рецептами и пошаговым приготовлением.

• Коктейль месяца: анимированная иллюстрация, ингредиенты, приготовление, подача
• Интерактивное приготовление: налив, лёд, шейк — шаг за шагом
• Виджет «всё в одном»: календарь, коктейль месяца и погода на домашнем экране
• Погода с анимациями — дождь, снег, гроза, солнце
• Мой календарь: события и напоминания iPhone, праздники и дни рождения, уведомления

Употребление алкоголя противопоказано лицам до 18 лет. Чрезмерное употребление алкоголя вредит вашему здоровью.

name: Покер Офис
description:
Покер Офис — приложение для сотрудников и руководителей клубов спортивного покера. Управляйте работой клуба с iPhone: готовьте события, встречайте участников и следите за обслуживанием в зале.

Турниры и Floor
Создавайте события, настраивайте структуру уровней, взносы, реэнтри и аддоны. Следите за таймером и статусами участников, выполняйте регистрацию и выбирайте место на схеме стола.

Регистрация по QR
Сканируйте карту участника, просматривайте его данные и регистрацию на турнир, выполняйте чекин и рассадку.

Кухня и обслуживание
Создавайте заказы для участников и гостей. На одном экране доступны стол и место получателя, состав, сумма, категории меню и поиск блюд. Принимайте заказы, отмечайте оплату и выдачу.

Команда и участники
Работайте с карточками участников, контактами, скидками и учётом фишек. Управляйте сотрудниками и их доступом к разделам клуба.

Табло
Настраивайте оформление, подключайте экраны клуба, выводите объявления и информацию о турнире.

Для работы нужен аккаунт Покер Офис с правами сотрудника клуба. Доступные функции определяются ролью и настройками клуба.

name: Тихая минутка
description:
Тихая минутка — спокойная игра для детей от 1 года до 5 лет. Одно простое действие: перетащить деталь на её место. Без текста, без таймеров и без «неправильно»: если малыш ошибся, деталь мягко возвращается, а мишка Тумпик удивляется.

ЧЕТЫРЕ ИГРЫ
• Домики — найди место для звезды, сердечка, круга.
• Картинки — собери домик, машинку, ёлку или яблоню, кораблик, ракету, паровозик или замок. Картинки каждый раз новые: другие окна, двери, колёса и паруса.
• Машинки — отвези каждую машинку в гараж своего цвета и посмотри, как она заезжает.
• Фрукты — разложи яблоки, груши, лимоны и сливы по корзинкам.

Задания не заканчиваются и подстраиваются под ребёнка: для малышей — меньше деталей, для старших — больше.

МЯГКИЙ КОНЕЦ ИГРЫ
Сессия не обрывается посреди задания. В конце солнце садится, Тумпик зевает и укладывает игрушки спать. Длину сессии выбираете вы.

ГОЛОС РОДИТЕЛЯ
Запишите пять коротких фраз своим голосом — «Молодец!», «Ура, получилось!», «Спокойной ночи, солнышко» — и малыш услышит в игре вас. Записи хранятся только на устройстве.

ДЛЯ РОДИТЕЛЕЙ
• Без рекламы, без интернета, без уведомлений и аналитики.
• Настройки — только за «входом для взрослых».
• Вечером музыка и звуки тише, движения спокойнее.
• Профили для нескольких детей.

БЕСПЛАТНО
Все игры открыты целиком и без ограничений по времени. Без покупок внутри, без подписки и рекламы.

name: حلقات ماء
description:
تذكر لعبة الماء والحلقات اللي كنا نلعبها زمان؟ رجعت لك بشكل ثلاثي الأبعاد على جوالك!

اضغط الأزرار عشان تدفع الماء، طيّر الحلقات الملونة، وحاول تدخّلها في الأعمدة. سهلة تتعلمها، وممتعة ما تمل منها.

- فيزياء ماء حقيقية: الحلقات تطفو وتلف وتنزل مثل اللعبة الأصلية بالضبط.
- ٤ ستايلات: بحر للأطفال، عالم حالم للبنات، فضاء للأولاد، وكلاسيك نيون.
- ١٢ مرحلة متدرجة: أعمدة طويلة، ألوان لازم تطابقها، حواجز، وحلقات ممكن تطيح!
- وضع الاسترخاء: العب على راحتك بدون وقت.
- ميّل جوالك عشان توجّه الحلقات، أو العب باللمس بس.
- تشجيع باللهجة السعودية مع كل حلقة: كفو! ذيب! ولّعت!
- تشتغل بدون إنترنت.
- مناسبة لكل العائلة، بدون إعلانات وبدون جمع أي بيانات.

يلا وريني شغلك!

name: سوبر باب
description:
**سوبر باب | SuperBab – سوقك الإلكتروني في بغداد**

تسوّق من محلات منطقتك بسهولة مع سوبر باب، السوق الإلكتروني الذي يجمع متاجر وسط بغداد في تطبيق واحد، ويتيح لك اكتشاف المنتجات والتواصل مع التجار وطلب احتياجاتك بكل سهولة، مع خدمة التوصيل إلى باب بيتك.

سواء كنت تبحث عن منتج من متجر قريب أو تمتلك محلاً وتريد عرض منتجاتك عبر الإنترنت، يوفر لك سوبر باب تجربة متكاملة للتسوق والبيع من مكان واحد.

**تسوّق من متاجر متعددة**

اكتشف المنتجات المعروضة من مختلف المحلات، وتصفح المتاجر والأصناف المتوفرة بسهولة دون الحاجة إلى التنقل بين عدة أماكن.

**تواصل مباشرة مع التاجر**

عندك سؤال عن منتج معين؟ استخدم المحادثة داخل التطبيق للاستفسار من التاجر عن المنتجات والتفاصيل قبل الطلب.

**اطلب بسهولة واستلم لباب بيتك**

اختر المنتجات التي تحتاجها، وأكمل طلبك بخطوات بسيطة، واستفد من خدمة التوصيل إلى عنوانك ضمن مناطق الخدمة المتاحة.

**افتح متجرك الإلكتروني**

إذا كنت صاحب محل، يتيح لك سوبر باب إنشاء متجرك داخل التطبيق وعرض منتجاتك للوصول إلى المزيد من الزبائن.

**إدارة المنتجات والطلبات**

أضف منتجاتك، ونظّم معلوماتها، وتابع الطلبات الواردة إلى متجرك من خلال التطبيق نفسه.

**لماذا سوبر باب؟**

- يجمع متاجر وسط بغداد في سوق إلكتروني واحد.
- تصفح المنتجات من محلات مختلفة.
- التواصل المباشر مع التجار عبر المحادثة.
- طلب المنتجات بسهولة.
- توصيل الطلبات إلى باب البيت ضمن مناطق الخدمة.
- إمكانية إنشاء متجر إلكتروني لأصحاب المحلات.
- إدارة المنتجات والطلبات من مكان واحد.
- واجهة عربية سهلة الاستخدام.

**سوبر باب يجمع الزبائن وأصحاب المحلات في تجربة تسوق محلية واحدة.**

حمّل تطبيق سوبر باب الآن، واكتشف متاجر منطقتك، أو ابدأ بعرض منتجات محلك عبر الإنترنت.

الموقع الرسمي:
https://app.superbab.com/

name: وجهة - خرائط وملاحة
description:
وجهة تطبيق ملاحة عربي صُمّم لطرق العراق، يجمع بين خريطة واضحة وإرشاد صوتي بالعربية وتنبيهات مرورية لحظية يشاركها السائقون أنفسهم.

ملاحة خطوة بخطوة
• اكتب وجهتك أو اضغط مطولًا على أي نقطة في الخريطة، واختر بين المسار الأسرع والمسارات البديلة.
• إرشاد صوتي بالعربية عند كل منعطف، بأسماء الشوارع والمسافات.
• إعادة حساب المسار تلقائيًا إذا خرجت عنه.
• اختر المسار بصوتك: قل «يمين» أو «يسار» أو «الأسرع» دون أن تلمس الشاشة.

تنبيهات من السائقين
• بلّغ بضغطة واحدة عن حادث أو ازدحام أو طريق مغلق أو خطر على الطريق أو نقطة شرطة أو أعمال صيانة أو كاميرا سرعة.
• شاهد بلاغات السائقين القريبين منك على الخريطة وأكّد ما زال قائمًا منها.

خريطة نظيفة
• تعرض الخريطة الأماكن العامة فقط: الدوائر الحكومية والمستشفيات والجامعات والمساجد والحدائق.
• لا فوضى من المحلات والإعلانات على الخريطة.
• وضع داكن مريح للقيادة الليلية.

دون إنترنت
• حمّل خريطة منطقتك واستخدمها حين يضعف الاتصال.

مفضلتك ورحلاتك
• احفظ المنزل والعمل وأماكنك المفضلة وابدأ الملاحة إليها مباشرة.
• سجل لرحلاتك على جهازك.

خصوصيتك أولًا
• استخدم التطبيق كاملًا دون أي حساب.
• نستخدم موقعك أثناء استخدام التطبيق فقط، ولا نبيع بياناتك.

تنبيه: انتبه للطريق دائمًا والتزم بقوانين المرور. اضبط وجهتك قبل الانطلاق.

name: 두뇌마사지
description:
전두엽·두정엽·측두엽·후두엽·소뇌 — 다섯 부위를 게임 120종으로 골고루 자극하는 두뇌 놀이입니다.

- 두뇌 상태 진단: 15문제로 부위별 시작 난이도를 정합니다.
- 오늘의 5분 마사지: 다섯 부위 게임 25개가 무작위로 섞여 나오고 5분 안에 끝납니다.
- 난이도 20단계 자동 조절: 맞히면 어려워지고, 제한 시간 안에 못 풀면 바로 쉬워집니다.
- 날짜별 기록, 두뇌 활성화 그래프, 랭킹.

※ 활성도·뇌력·IQ 는 게임 성적에서 계산한 참고용 수치이며, 실제 뇌 활동의 측정이나 표준 지능검사가 아닙니다. 질병의 진단·치료·예방 효과를 보장하지 않습니다.

name: 바쿠다 - 한글 PDF 변환·편집
description:
바쿠다는 한글(HWP·HWPX), PDF, 워드, 엑셀, 파워포인트, 사진을 휴대폰과 태블릿 안에서 바로 바꾸고 고치는 문서 도구예요.

■ 고르고, 한 번 누르면 끝
파일을 고르면 형식 바퀴가 열려요. PDF·Word·JPG·Excel 중 원하는 걸 누르면 바로 바뀌고 저장돼요. 여러 파일도 한 번에 고를 수 있어요.

■ 파일은 이 기기 밖으로 안 나가요
변환과 편집은 모두 기기 안에서 처리해요. 문서를 서버에 올리지 않고, 인터넷이 없어도 돼요. (AI 요약·번역 같은 AI 기능을 쓸 때만 고른 글자를 보내요.)

■ 주요 기능
· 한글(HWP·HWPX) 보기·편집, PDF·워드·JPG·TXT로 바꾸기
· PDF 편집: 글자 고치기, 쪽 합치기·나누기, 워드·한글·JPG로 바꾸기
· 워드·엑셀·파워포인트 보기와 편집 (표 칸 안에서 바로 입력)
· 문서 스캔: 종이를 찍으면 반듯하게 펴서 PDF로, 사진 속 글자 읽기(OCR)
· 사진: HEIC를 JPG로, 사진 줄이기, 사진 → PDF, 사진 위치 정보 지우기
· 압축 풀기·만들기, 글자 수 세기

■ 이럴 때 좋아요
· 학교·관공서에서 받은 한글 파일을 폰에서 바로 열고 PDF로 보낼 때
· 계약서·신청서 PDF의 글자를 고치거나 서명할 때
· 종이 서류를 찍어 깔끔한 PDF로 만들 때

바쿠다 계정이 있으면 로그인해서 웹과 같은 한도와 기록을 함께 쓸 수 있어요. 로그인하지 않아도 기본 기능은 그대로 쓸 수 있어요.

문의: https://bakooda.com/contact/

name: 퇴사각 - 퇴사 타이밍 계산기
description:
하루 차이로 퇴직금·연차수당·실업급여가 달라지는 날이 있어요.
퇴사각은 입사일과 월급만 넣으면, 며칠만 더 다니면 받는 돈이 뛰는 날과 그때 달라지는 금액을 찾아 드려요.

■ 퇴사각도기
입사일·월급·남은 연차를 넣으면 나에게 가장 좋은 퇴사 타이밍과 돈 뛰는 날을 보여 드려요.

■ 돈 뛰는 날 알림 (앱 전용)
돈 뛰는 날 7일 전과 하루 전 아침에 알려 드려요. 입력한 정보는 휴대폰에만 저장되고, 알림 글에는 금액이나 '퇴사'라는 말을 넣지 않아요.

■ 계산기 4종
퇴직금, 연차수당, 실업급여, 퇴직소득세(예상 세액)를 따로 계산할 수 있어요.

■ 오늘의 퇴사각 · 공감 (앱 전용)
하루 한 번 오늘 마음속 퇴사각을 찍고 전국 직장인 평균과 비교해 보세요.
회사 이름 없이 오늘 마음을 한 줄로 남기는 익명 공감도 있어요. 회사 이름·연락처·욕설은 자동으로 가려져요.

■ 퇴사 영수증 · 테스트
근속 기록을 영수증 한 장으로 뽑고, 퇴사 욕구 테스트와 직장인 16유형 검사도 해 보세요.

이외 다른 기능들도 지속적으로 업데이트 예정입니다.

퇴사각은 참고용 자동 계산 서비스이며 세무·노무 자문이 아닙니다.
실제 금액은 회사 규정, 임금 구성, 개인 사정에 따라 달라질 수 있습니다.

name: 티픽 - 골프 티타임 비교, 나만의 골프지도
description:
티픽은 골프 티타임 가격을 한 번에 비교하고, 다녀온 골프장을 지도에 기록하는 앱이에요.

■ 같은 시간, 가장 싼 티타임
· 여러 예약 사이트의 티타임을 날짜·지역별로 모아 1인 그린피를 비교해요.
· 같은 골프장, 같은 시간대라면 어디가 더 싼지 바로 보여요.
· 날짜별 최저가 달력으로 가장 싼 날을 찾을 수 있어요.
· 원하는 시간대 티타임이 새로 열리면 관심 탭에서 알려드려요.

■ 내 라운드 지도
· 스코어 화면을 사진으로 올리면 날짜·골프장·타수·홀별 스코어가 자동으로 기록돼요.
· 다녀온 골프장 주변이 지도에 색칠돼요. 전국 시·군·구를 하나씩 채워 보세요.
· 평균 타수, 최고 기록, 파3·파4·파5별 성적을 한눈에 볼 수 있어요.

■ 랭킹과 배지
· 골프장마다 최고 타수로 순위를 매겨요. 이번 달 순위와 역대 순위를 따로 볼 수 있어요.
· 동반자 그룹을 만들면 같이 치는 사람들끼리 순위를 비교할 수 있어요.
· 1,000개가 넘는 배지를 모으고, 마음에 드는 배지를 닉네임 옆에 달 수 있어요.

■ 골프장 도착 알림
· 켜 두면 골프장 근처에 왔을 때 알려드리고, 라운드를 마치고 떠날 때 스코어 기록을 권해요.
· 위치는 내 아이폰 안에서만 쓰고 서버로 보내지 않아요.

가격과 남은 자리는 수시로 바뀌어요. 예약은 각 예약 사이트에서 하고, 예약할 때 한 번 더 확인해 주세요.
티픽은 각 예약 사이트와 제휴하거나 그 회사가 운영하는 서비스가 아니에요.

name: 파파랑 - 아빠와 아기의 놀이 시간
description:
오늘은 아이와 뭐 하고 놀까요?

눈을 맞추고, 이름을 불러주고, 작은 소리에 답해주는 시간.
파파랑은 아이와 어떻게 놀아야 할지 고민하는 아빠를 위한 놀이 안내 앱이에요.

거창한 준비 없이 시작할 수 있는 놀이부터, 집에 있는 장난감을 활용하는 놀이까지. 아이의 시기와 오늘의 상황에 맞는 놀이를 찾아보세요.

■ 우리 아이의 시기에 맞는 놀이
아이의 생일을 등록하면 현재 시기에 맞는 놀이를 살펴볼 수 있어요. 무엇부터 시작할지 고민될 때, 홈에서 오늘 함께할 놀이를 골라보세요.

■ 120개의 놀이를 모은 놀이창고
대상 시기, 발달 영역, 준비물을 기준으로 놀이를 골라보세요. 준비물이 없는 놀이부터 장난감을 활용하는 놀이까지 한곳에서 만날 수 있어요.

■ 준비부터 마무리까지 차근차근
놀이에 필요한 준비물과 예상 시간, 단계별 방법을 확인할 수 있어요. 주의사항이 제공되는 놀이는 시작 전에 함께 살펴보세요.

■ 다시 하고 싶은 놀이는 찜
마음에 드는 놀이를 저장하고 마이페이지에서 다시 찾아보세요. 찜 기능은 Apple 로그인 후 이용할 수 있어요.

■ 함께한 놀이를 기록
놀이를 마친 뒤 완료 기록과 아이의 반응을 남겨보세요. 전에 했던 놀이는 홈에서 다시 찾아볼 수 있어요.

놀이를 잘해야 한다는 부담보다,
아이와 함께하는 작은 순간을 하나씩 만들어보세요.

오늘도 함께 놀며, 한 뼘 더 가까이.
파파랑

name: えなが塾：介護福祉士・ケアマネ過去問
description:
えなが塾は、介護福祉士国家試験とケアマネジャー（介護支援専門員）試験の過去問を、仕事の合間の5分で解けるアプリです。広告はありません。

■ 本物の過去問を、そのまま
- 介護福祉士 第36回〜第38回（375問）、ケアマネジャー 第27回・第28回（120問）
- 問題文と正答は、試験センターおよび各都道府県が公表したものを原文のまま収録
- すべての問題に、アプリ独自の解説つき

■ 5分だけ、で続く
- 夜勤明けや休憩中に、毎日5問から。途中でやめても続きから再開できます
- まちがえた問題は、間隔をあけて自動でおさらい
- 試験日までの日数と、合格まであと何問かが、ひと目でわかります

■ 介護福祉士の試験に合わせた作り
- パート合格（A・B・C）に対応。合格済みのパートは毎日の問題から外せます
- パート模試は本番どおりの時間（A 105分、B 75分、C 40分）。パートごとの合格基準点つき
- 合格には11の科目群すべてで得点が必要。「0点リスク」の科目群を知らせます
- ふりがなを表示できます（試験センター公開の「ふりがな付き」問題）

■ ケアマネジャーの試験に合わせた作り
- 5つの選択肢から2つ以上を選ぶ「複択」問題を、肢ごとに採点
- 介護支援分野と保健医療福祉サービス分野、それぞれの基準点を意識した成績表示

■ 解説は根拠つき
- 解説に出てくる条文をタップすると、法令の原文（e-Gov法令検索の公開データ）を端末内で読めます
- 試験後に法律が改正されて今は成り立たない問題には「法改正あり」の印と、現在の扱いを表示

■ えなが塾Pro（一度のお支払い）
- 無料でも、介護福祉士 第38回とケアマネジャー 第28回は全問題を解けます
- Proで、すべての回、パート模試、成績の詳細が使えます。月額課金はありません

※ 当アプリは公益財団法人社会福祉振興・試験センターおよび各都道府県とは関係ありません。解説は当アプリが独自に作成したものです。解説は令和8年11月時点の法令に基づきます。

name: スクワケ｜スクショをスワイプで仕分け
description:
スクショが増えすぎて、整理できない。

行きたい場所、買いたいもの、旅行の予約、仕事の資料。
あとで見返そうと思って撮ったスクリーンショットが、写真アプリにどんどん溜まっていませんか？

「スクワケ」は、スクリーンショットをスワイプ操作でiPhone純正の写真アルバムへ仕分けるアプリです。

【スクワケの特徴】

■ スワイプするだけで仕分け

スクリーンショットを1枚ずつ確認し、スワイプ操作で仕分け先のアルバムを選択。繰り返しアルバムを開く必要はありません。

■ 最大8つの仕分け先

よく使うアルバムを最大8つまで設定できます。旅行、買い物、仕事、趣味など、目的に合わせて整理できます。

■ iPhone純正の写真アルバムを活用

スクワケ専用の保管場所を作る必要はありません。仕分けたスクリーンショットは、いつもの写真アプリから確認できます。

■ シンプルな操作

スクショを見て、スワイプして、次へ。
大量のスクリーンショットもテンポよく整理できます。

【こんな人におすすめ】

・スクリーンショットが大量に溜まっている
・保存した情報をあとから探すのが大変
・写真アプリのアルバムをもっと活用したい
・スクショを目的別に整理したい

【プライバシー】

写真やスクリーンショットは端末内で処理され、外部サーバーには送信されません。

スクショの整理を、もっと簡単に。
スクワケで、写真アプリを使いやすくしましょう。

name: チクタク - 時計と予定
description:
チクタクは、時計を読むのがまだむずかしい人のための時計アプリです。
いまの時刻、次の予定までの残り時間、時計の読み方の練習を、ひとつのアプリにまとめました。

■ いま
大きな時計で、いまの時刻を見せます。次の予定までの残り時間は、時計の上の色の扇形と「あと 12ふん」の言葉で伝えます。
残りが 10 分を切ると黄色、5 分を切ると赤に変わるので、数字が読めなくても「そろそろだ」とわかります。

■ よてい
「あさごはん」「はみがき」「ねる じかん」など、毎日の予定を時刻とくり返す曜日で登録できます。
タイマーとして時間を区切ることもできます。終わったら子どもが「できた！」を押して、自分で区切りをつけられます。

■ れんしゅう
時計の読み方を遊びながら練習できます。
・よむ：時計の針を見て、正しい時刻を 4 つから選ぶ
・あわせる：言われた時刻に、長い針を指で回して合わせる
むずかしさは 4 段階。ちょうどの時刻から、1 分きざみまで進められます。正解すると星がもらえます。

■ 子どもが使うことを考えた作り
・文字はひらがなと分かち書き。分の読み方（いっぷん、にふん、さんぷん…）もそのまま表示します
・ボタンは大きく、押しやすくしています
・予定を変えるときと設定を開くときは、保護者の確認（かんたんな計算）を挟みます
・VoiceOver で時計の時刻を読み上げます。「視差効果を減らす」にも対応しています

■ 設定
正解の音、時計の分の数字、画面を消さずにつけたままにするかを選べます。

■ プライバシー
アカウントの登録はありません。広告、アプリ内課金、解析のしくみも入っていません。予定や練習の記録は端末の中だけに保存し、外部に送ることはありません。

iPhone と iPad に対応しています。

name: 久久记
description:
久久记第一次和大家见面：

· 纪念日与倒计时：记下第一次约会、第一次旅行，首页大字显示第几天
· 精选情话库：离线生成，不联网、不上传
· 图片分享：生成 1080×1440 卡片，支持微信好友 / 朋友圈
· 数据只存本机，无需注册登录

如果你想要「纪念日提醒」「情侣双人同步」，可以告诉我们。

name: 事事有回音的清零扁担
description:
有些事不大，却总挂在心上。
一条还没回复的消息、一件没寄出的退货、一本答应归还的书……记着它们，也需要花力气。
「事事有回音的清零扁担」是一款温和的离线待办工具。把挂心事记下来，挂上竹扁担，找到一个能开始的小动作，再一件件放下。
【先记下来，给心事一个落点】
写下是什么事，分清是给自己的交代，还是给别人的回音。也可以从生活场景模板开始，少一点无从下手。
【找到小小的下一步】
不用一口气解决全部。打开订单、找到文件、发一条确认消息，都可以成为开始。
【重量由你决定】
用轻、中、重表达此刻的感受。重量不会随时间增加，不必因为暂时没完成，再背上一份压力。
【有些事，可以等一等】
记下在等待什么，约个再看看的日子。日期仅作应用内标记，不发送通知。
【办妥以后，亲手卸担】
横划麻绳，或点击完成，看秤砣落下、扁担回弹。支持音效与触觉反馈，也支持撤销。
【每一件，都算数】
办妥的事、认真考虑后决定放下的事，都会留下记录。需要时，也可以重新打开。

name: 依赖分解
description: 订单号能决定客户号，客户号又能决定客户名，这些依赖应该怎样分成关系？依赖分解把关系模式设计中的推导过程放到同一张稿纸上。你可以给 2 至 8 个属性填写含义，选择左右属性加入函数依赖，随时修改或删除。闭包页逐条展示哪条依赖加入了哪些属性，并列出全部最小候选键；展开候选键，还可核对去掉某个属性后为什么不再是超键。分解页识别 BCNF 违例，支持一次分裂或完成全部分解，树中保留父关系、所用依赖和交集决定子关系的无损依据。每个叶子可单独查看候选键和投影依赖，原始依赖则逐条核对是否被最终关系保持。保存底稿后，属性含义、原始依赖、闭包证明、候选键和分解树一起留在档案中；重开继续编辑时，旧版本仍然保留。适合数据库课程练习和小型关系模式设计复核，输入的函数依赖由使用者给定，不会从数据记录自动推断。

name: 圆管切口
description: 圆管切口为制作圆管工艺品、模型支架与展示架的人提供尺寸放样工具。输入主管外径、支管外径、支管壁厚和两轴夹角，按圆柱相交几何计算完整鞍形切口。连续的周向展开图显示外壁切边与内壁交线，拖动游标即可读取每条母线距离接缝的位置和需要量取的切深。可选12至72等分，并移动接缝相位，把纸带起点放在便于划线的位置。逐点标记已完成的母线，避免绕管划线时遗漏或重复。边差测角工具依据相对两侧的长短边差与支管外径反算轴线交角，结果可直接送回接管页面。保存底稿后，管径、交角、接缝、全部测点与备注都会保留；重开可继续试配，另存为新的修订。导出毫米制SVG纸样或CSV测点表，打印纸样附带100毫米校准尺，可依据实测长度调整输出补偿倍率。当前模型用于两轴线相交、支管不大于主管的完整周向切口，不包含偏心连接。实际制作前请用废料试配，核实材料与工具误差。

name: 子ども工房｜子どもの作品を写真で残す
description:
子ども工房は、子どもが毎日つくってくる工作や絵を、写真と声で残しておくアプリです。実物は「おうちに飾る」「ありがとうして作品集に残す」「まだまよう」の3つから行き先を決めるだけ。思い出は作品集に、おうちはすっきり保てます。

【主な機能】

■ 作品をのこす
作品を撮るか、アルバムから選ぶだけ。1つの作品に写真を4枚まで残せます。絵や手紙は「絵・手紙をきれいにスキャン」で、紙のふちを見つけてまっすぐに切り抜けます。作品のなまえとつくった人を選べば、それで残せます。作った日・作った場所・題材・素材・大きさは、あとからでも書き足せます。

■ 子どもの声
「これはなに？」ときいて、子どもの声を15秒まで録音して残せます。文字でひとことを書いておくこともできます。

■ 行き先を決める
残した作品ごとに、実物をどうするかを3つから選びます。写真と声は、どれを選んでも作品集に残ります。
・おうちに飾る … 実物を飾っておく一軍にします。飾れる数（はじめは5点）を決めておけて、いっぱいになったら、どれを手放すかを選べます。
・ありがとうして作品集に残す … 実物は、ありがとうを言ってから捨てる・ゆずる。
・まだまよう … 実物はまよい箱で30日お休み。日が来たらホームに出るので、もう一度きめられます。

■ 作品集
残した作品は、実物を手放したかどうかにかかわらず全部ここに並びます。「タイムライン」「年ごと」「成長」「カレンダー」で見返せます。設定で、作品集を子どもごとに分けることもできます。

■ おたより
園や学校のお便りをスキャンして残せます。何枚あっても1つにまとまり（20ページまで）、PDFにして送ったり保存したりできます。フォルダで分けておけます。おたよりはスマホの中だけに保存します。

■ 家族と共有
ログインすると、2つの共有ができます（iPhone・iPad は Apple でサインイン）。
・一緒に作る … 招待コードで入った家族は、アプリで作品を足したり直したりできます。みんなの端末にすぐ出ます。
・見せるだけ … アプリがなくても見られるページを送れます。おじいちゃん・おばあちゃんなど、見るだけの人に。見る人は作品を変えられません。

■ クラウドに保存
ログインしていれば、作品をクラウドに保存して、機種変更でも引き継げます。

■ マイページ
作品・飾っている・手放した、の数がひと目でわかります。子どもの名前と年を登録しておくと、作品に「つくった人」と「作ったときの年齢」が入ります。

■ 子どもモード
子どもにスマホを渡すときにオンにすると、大きな文字と読み上げになります。消す・設定などの前には、大人の確認（指紋・顔・端末のロック、使えないときは計算問題）が入ります。

■ バックアップと元に戻す
作品の記録をファイルに書き出して、あとで戻せます。うっかり消したときは、すぐなら「元に戻す」で戻せます。

【料金】
iPhone・iPad 版は購入がなく、無料で使えます。クラウドに保存できる写真は、1家族あわせて100枚までです（声の録音も1枚に数えます。超えた分はスマホの中に残ります）。

【データの扱い】
ログインしなくても使えます。そのときは作品の写真・声・記録をスマホの中だけに保存します。広告は表示しません。

提供: Yテック工房

name: 已练不欠
description:
已练不欠，帮助你按自己的节奏走进健身房，记录每一次坚持。偶尔失约，不会抹去过去的努力。

【安排自己的节奏】
设置每周健身日、休息日和请假额度。查看本月按计划坚持的天数，休息也是计划的一部分。

【记录每一次到馆】
手动打卡、过去七天补录、请假与撤销记录，方便管理真实的健身习惯。历史月历展示每日状态和已有的可信在馆时长。

【可选的自动打卡】
选择健身房并主动开启自动识别，在授权精确位置和后台定位后，累计同一次在馆的30分钟可信时间即可自动记录。可选择绑定当前健身房 Wi-Fi 辅助识别。位置不确定或信号中断的时间不会计入，识别效果受设备、权限和环境影响，主动关闭 App 可能中断识别。

【看见长期坚持】
累计坚持勋章、基础角色装扮和锁屏小组件，让你随时看看自己的进度。支持简体中文、繁体中文和英文。

【免费与付费】
App 免费下载。除自动打卡外，手动打卡、补录、请假、计划、历史、勋章、基础装扮和锁屏组件永久免费。自动打卡可主动领取连续7天免费试用，之后一次购买永久解锁，无订阅、无自动续费。具体价格以 App Store 购买页面为准。

【本机保存，无需注册】
无需创建账户，没有广告或云同步。健身记录保存在本机；卸载、清空或设备丢失可能导致记录无法恢复。恢复购买可以找回购买权益，但不会恢复健身历史。

隐私政策：https://yilianbuqian.pages.dev/privacy
用户支持：https://yilianbuqian.pages.dev/support

name: 悄悄翻译
description:
悄悄翻译：一键把整个屏幕翻译成中文。

刷到外语评论区、玩海外游戏、看外文网页，不用复制粘贴，不用切换 App。敲敲手机背面，当前屏幕立刻翻译，译文直接覆盖在原文位置上，排版一眼就能对上。

【一键触发】
· 支持敲敲背面（系统设置里叫“轻点背面”）、操作按钮、控制中心三种方式
· App 内有图文引导，一分钟设置完成

【多语言同屏翻译】
· 自动识别每段文字的语言，英语、日语、韩语、西班牙语等混在同一屏也能同时翻译
· 用户名、时间、网址、价格等内容自动跳过，不乱翻

【快，而且私密】
· 文字识别和翻译都在手机本地完成，截图不上传任何服务器
· 下载语言包后可离线使用，没有网络也能翻译
· 不注册、不登录、不收集任何数据

【贴心细节】
· 按住屏幕可随时查看原文
· 支持 13 种目标语言

使用前请先在 App 内按引导创建快捷指令，并在“设置 → 辅助功能 → 触控 → 轻点背面”中绑定。

name: 拍無痕－照片位置隱私清除
description:
你知道嗎？手機拍的每張照片，都可能偷偷記下拍攝地點、時間和手機型號。把照片傳給陌生人、貼到二手拍賣或社群，對方就可能知道你住哪裡。

拍無痕讓這些隱藏資訊「看得見」，再一次清乾淨。

【看得見】
・每張照片標示「含位置資訊」或「乾淨」，一眼就知道哪些照片有風險
・點開就能看到 GPS 座標、拍攝時間、手機型號，以及所有隱藏欄位

【一次清乾淨】
・一次選取多張照片，一鍵清除全部資訊
・另存新檔，原始照片完全不會被修改
・JPEG、PNG 直接移除資訊，不重新壓縮，畫質不變
・支援 iPhone 的 HEIC 照片
・清除後自動再檢查一次，確認真的乾淨

【清完馬上用】
・存回相簿，或直接分享到 LINE、Messenger、Email 等任何 App

【你的照片只屬於你】
・全程離線，不連網
・不需註冊帳號
・沒有廣告、不追蹤、不收集任何資料

適合在這些時候使用：
・在二手拍賣平台上傳商品照
・傳照片給剛認識的人
・貼到社群、論壇、部落格
・把家裡、小孩的照片分享出去之前

name: 拾階－每日計畫與目標拆解
description:
想存到 100 萬、想跑完半馬，卻不知道今天該做什麼？
拾階幫你把大目標拆成一階一階的小步驟，再把步驟排進每天的計畫。每完成一件，就離目標更近一步。

【每日計畫】
・寫下今天要做的事，可以加上時段（例如 20:00–20:30）
・做完就勾掉，上方進度條一眼看出今天完成幾件
・拖曳右側把手調整順序，往左滑刪除（可以復原）
・今天沒做完的，一鍵移到明天
・上方日期列切換一週裡的任一天，也能用日曆跳到任何日期

【目標拆解】
・建立長期目標，加上補充說明（例如期限、為什麼想做到）
・把目標拆成步驟，可以重新命名、拖曳排序
・任何一個步驟都能排進今天、明天或指定日期的計畫
・在每日計畫勾掉，目標的步驟也同步完成
・每個目標顯示完成幾步、百分之幾；總覽一次看全部目標的進度

【你的資料只屬於你】
・全程離線，不連網
・不需註冊帳號
・沒有廣告、不追蹤、不收集任何資料
・資料只存在手機上，會跟著手機的 iCloud／iTunes 備份

【其他】
・支援深色模式
・支援 iPhone 與 iPad

name: 敲字喵输入法
description:
敲字喵是一款淡粉猫爪主题的中文输入法，专注轻松、简洁的日常输入。

【熟悉的拼音输入】
支持九键和 26 键中文拼音、连续拼音、整句与分段选词，也可切换英文、数字和符号。

【让常用内容更顺手】
提供英文补全和下一词联想。长按中文候选可置顶或隐藏；常用语与表情面板让常用内容更快输入。候选使用习惯保存在设备本地。

【细节照顾打字体验】
圆角按键、浅色与深色外观，支持在空格键上左右滑动移动光标。可选按键震动，主 App 和键盘中都能调整开关。

【离线使用，基础输入无需完全访问】
无需注册账号，无广告。核心输入在设备本地完成，不上传输入内容，不使用第三方广告或用户行为分析服务。基础输入不要求开启「允许完全访问」；按键震动及主 App 与键盘之间的震动设置同步需要此权限。

【首次使用】
打开敲字喵查看添加指南，在系统「设置 → 通用 → 键盘 → 键盘 → 添加新键盘」中添加敲字喵，然后在输入时通过地球键切换。主 App 提供试输入、使用技巧、设置和帮助反馈。

帮助与反馈：pinecloud@163.com

name: 百物語ちず - 伝説と妖怪の地図
description:
百物語ちずは、日本各地に残る伝説・妖怪・昔話・怪談の場所を、ジオラマのキャラクターで地図に並べた iPhone アプリです。

■ 全国1,322か所の伝承
河童、天狗、雪女、鬼、ダイダラボッチ、平将門……。北海道から沖縄まで、その土地に語り継がれてきた話を、短く読みやすく紹介します。自治体や観光協会のページ、Wikipedia など、紹介の元にした出典をスポットごとに載せています。

■ 訪れたら「灯」をともす
行った場所に灯をともすと、ジオラマが金色に輝きます。現地でともすと「現地の灯」に。10か所、33か所、100か所……と集めるごとに称号が増え、百か所で「百物語」がそろいます。灯の色やお祝いの背景も、無料で選べます。

■ 地図をきせかえ
・お化け屋敷：夜の地図に人魂が漂い、夜霧が流れる
・昔話の絵本：にこにこのお日さまと、うず巻き雲
・水彩画：にじむパステルと、列島をまたぐ虹
・墨の戯画：うさぎやかえるが野をかける墨の線画
どのテーマも10秒ためせます。

■ 道順・近くの伝承めぐり
伝承の場所までの道順を、この地図の上に金の線で描きます。近くのまだ行っていない伝承を、近い順に4か所つないで回るルートも作れます（徒歩・車）。Apple マップで開くこともできます。

■ 記録帳・県の金の印
行った日と写真を伝承ごとに残せます。行った県は金色の印に。行きたい場所のリストも作れます。

■ English Edition
伝承の本文などを英語で読めます。海外から日本を旅する方にも。

■ 料金
地図・伝承の紹介・灯の記録は無料です。広告はありません。
・百物語の巻物（買い切り）：テーマ4種、道順と近くの伝承めぐり、記録帳、県の金の印、行きたいリスト、すべての灯をオーロラ色に
・地図のテーマ（買い切り・1つずつ）
・English Edition（買い切り）
・応援（機能は増えません）

■ プライバシー
記録・写真はiPhoneの中だけに保存されます。アカウント登録、広告、解析ツールはありません。道順を調べるときだけ、Apple の経路検索を使います。

※伝承・噂を紹介するアプリで、超常現象を事実と断定するものではありません。多くは神社・お寺や地域の方の暮らしの場です。夜間や立入禁止の場所へは行かず、静かに訪れてください。

サポート：https://nyaro2860-crypto.github.io/hyakumonogatari-support/

name: 祥昇汽车

name: 色の匠 - 調色パズル
description:
絵の具のチューブを長押しして色を注ぎ、目標の色をつくる調色パズルです。
どの色を、どれだけ入れるか。注ぎすぎたら戻せません。色を見る目と、指先の加減を試せます。

■調色チャレンジ
・チューブを押している間だけ絵の具が出ます。長く押すほど勢いよく出ます
・目標の色と自分の色が、ひとつの円に半分ずつ並びます。色が合うと継ぎ目が消えて、ひとつの円になります
・手を離したときに一致率が90%以上ならクリアです
・制限時間があり、速くクリアするほど星が多くもらえます（星1〜3）
・ビーカーの容量を超えるとあふれて失敗です
・最初は2色、進むと3色、4色に増えます。絵の具は赤・黄・青・白・黒の5色です
・配合を見られるヒントがあります。星3つでクリアすると1回増えます

■国旗あてクイズ
・国旗の色を、面積の割合どおりに全部混ぜた1色を見て、どの国の国旗かを4択で当てます
・1回8問、193か国の国旗が登場します
・答えたあと、国旗の色が渦を巻いて混ざり、出題の色になる様子を見られます
・混ぜるとほとんど同じ色になる国旗があるときは、答えたあとにお知らせします

■色を見比べやすい画面
・背景は色みのないグレーで、色の違いを正しく見比べられます
・ライト表示とダーク表示に対応しています
・日本語と英語に対応しています

■広告とApp内課金について
・ホーム画面と国旗あてクイズの下にバナー広告が出ます。調色中は出ません
・調色チャレンジでは、レベルを5回クリアするごとに、次のレベルへ進むところで全画面広告が1回出ます
・ヒントがなくなったときは、動画広告を最後まで見るとヒントを3回もらえます
・買い切りの「プレミアム」を購入すると、広告が出なくなり、ヒントを動画なしで補充できます（定期購入ではありません）

■そのほか
・アカウントの登録は不要です。記録（クリアしたレベルやヒントの回数）は端末の中にだけ保存されます

name: 记开笔记
description:
把听到的内容、看到的画面和当时的想法，留在同一条笔记里。

记开笔记适合会议、课程、读书分享和日常灵感记录。边录音，边转写，按时间插入照片；结束后再整理、回听和导出。

【录音与画面一起记】
支持只录音、前置、后置及受支持设备上的前后双摄。可手动拍照、按间隔拍照，或根据画面与文字变化自动捕捉。说“拍一张”“记一下”等口令也能拍照；回看最近画面，可补上刚才错过的一页。

【按时间回看与整理】
文字和照片放在对应的时间位置。可修改转写、标记重点、添加自己的想法、背景资料和标签。长静音可按设置裁剪，录音中断与缺失时段会清楚标出。

【每张照片独立管理】
前后摄照片可以分别查看、存入系统相册、分享或删除。也可从相册导入录制期间的照片与截图。删除笔记中的照片，不会删除系统相册原图。

【iPhone 记录，iPad 回顾】
iPad 宽窗口提供笔记列表与完整内容双栏阅读。两台设备连接同一局域网后，可扫码配对并手动同步已结束的笔记、照片和录音，无需注册账号。

【导出后继续创作】
支持图文 PDF、Markdown、纯文本和原始录音。可准备给 AI 工具的提示词与材料，并把外部工具生成的总结贴回笔记。App 不会自动把笔记发送给 AI 服务。

【资料以本机保存为主】
默认使用设备端语音识别。在线识别、地点和日历匹配均为可选功能；相关权限和设置由你控制。天气可在整理页手动填写。记录时也可隐藏预览与内容，结束后再完整回看。

需要 iOS / iPadOS 26.0 或更高版本。双摄与设备端语音识别的可用性取决于设备、语言及系统资源。后台或系统锁屏时摄像头暂停；录音受系统音频权限与其他 App 占用情况影响。请在录音或拍摄前取得相关人员同意。

name: 飓风影视相机-电影级LUT摄影
description:
飓风影视相机，是一款为手机打造的电影级拍摄与调色工具。它把专业摄影机的取景器、3D LUT 实时调色与后期工坊装进你的口袋，让拍摄和调色一步完成。
【实时 3D LUT 电影取景器】
· 取景器内实时渲染 3D LUT，拍摄前就能看到最终影调
· 内置 8 款院线级胶片预设：柯达 2383、飓风青橙、富士 Eterna 500T、银盐留银冲印、经典黑白电影、赛博霓虹、阿莱 Alexa 709、70 年代复古超 8
· 胶卷浓度支持 50% / 75% / 100% 三档调节，随时切换风格
【专业手动参数】
· 帧率：24 / 30 / 60 FPS
· 快门：1/24 – 1/250，遵循 180° 快门角
· 基准 ISO：100 – 3200
· 白平衡：3200K – 6500K
· 画幅：9:16 / 16:9 / 4:3 / 1:1 / 2.39:1 电影宽银幕
· 构图网格与电影画幅遮罩，取景更精准
【监看仪表】
· 实时音频 VU 表，左右声道电平一目了然
· 实时直方图，辅助判断曝光
· 录制计时与时间码显示，支持 24FPS 电影时间码
【后期影视工坊】
· 对已拍摄片段二次套用 LUT，实时对比原片与调色效果
· 曝光、对比度、饱和度、色温、色调精细调节
· 暗角与胶片颗粒强度可调，营造胶片质感
· 2.39:1 CinemaScope 宽银幕裁切
· 调色完成后导出保存至系统相册
【LUT 胶卷库】
· 内置胶片预设一键设为默认拍摄影调
· 支持导入自定义 .cube 格式 3D LUT，打造专属影调
【作品相册】
· 片段按时间排列，展示分辨率、帧率、编码、LUT、ISO、快门、白平衡等元数据
· 支持片段预览、删除，一键进入工坊调色

name: Big Auger Lab
description:
Cold start: BOOTING, ANGLER'S ENGINEERING LAB, TAP TO SKIP.

WELCOME ABOARD. SKIP. NEXT › then ALMOST THERE ›. Story: TRIP, VISION, BAIT, JIG. Primer: SENSORS, WHAT THE LAB LISTENS TO. Denied sensors show SETTINGS. READY: DEMO MODE or START CLEAN. Offline · no account · demo data can be erased in Settings.

Tabs: TRIP · VISION · BAIT · JIG · BOOK.

Vision: SPECTRA, HARDWARE. Bait: MIX IT, APPLY, RESET. Jig: READY, REC, REF, TRAIN 60 s.

Book: JIG PASSPORT, KNOTS, FISH EYES.

No sign-up. No purchases. The lab stays on this phone.
